286180.title: Salticidae Story
286180.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

382370.title: BreakFree
382370.short_description: A first-person block breaker from 1995: you are the paddle. Keep your fireballs alive and break the walls of 72 levels. Chase medals and the Daily Challenge, or build levels for Steam Workshop. Runs natively on modern PCs, with the original DOS game included.

432120.title: Age After Age
432120.short_description: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path - classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

451770.title: Aurora: Firebreak
451770.short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

521180.title: Slip Angle
521180.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

537680.title: Sheep Tag 2
537680.short_description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

563600.title: Buratino
563600.short_description: Buratino is a 2D arcade game with light adventure elements for the ZX Spectrum 8-bit computer.

611610.title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
611610.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

616780.title: Age of Space
616780.short_description: Evolve from being a nobody to being the center of power! Age of space combines real time resource management with tactical combat. Work as a mercenary for clients in our solar system as you gradually get dragged into a liberation war between the Martians and the UEA. Who will you side with?

617310.title: Mamma Mia
617310.short_description: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

618440.title: Stencil of Judgement
618440.short_description: Step into a realm where every shadow whispers of forgotten power and ancient relics hold unimaginable might. A magic and melee take on the Musou genre: hack-and-slash games where a single, overpowered hero battles hordes of enemies including bosses on massive, tactical battlefields.

637340.title: Solar Core
637340.short_description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

640840.title: Gohan Quest
640840.short_description: Gohan Quest is a humorous adventure RPG that takes place in modern Eastern Europe. Play as anime girls, explore the typical russian town, beat the shit out of gopniks and find the missing "children"! Inspired by golden age JRPGs, from fans to fans.

651950.title: Collapsus
651950.short_description: COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management! Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

660800.title: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ
660800.short_description: A girl was sleeping in the garbage outside of Kazuki's apartment, until he decided to take her in. Now a home for two, he must remember that all actions have consequences, and words can be laced with poison. But you know that all too well, don't you?

683390.title: 8 More Lives
683390.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

720190.title: Wizards
720190.short_description: Four wizards. One arena. One furious ball. Protect your library & spellbook, sling five arena-warping spells, and outlast everyone. Local AI and Steam multiplayer.

726680.title: Better Together
726680.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

737340.title: Wild Light: Darkest Isles
737340.short_description: Survive unforgiving nights in this topdown roguelite... explore the island, set up camp, and slay Titans in souls-like combat as you hunt the source of the desolation. But beware, the longer you survive, the darker the nights become

744200.title: Altiros
744200.short_description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

757550.title: Football Story
757550.short_description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

771800.title: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
771800.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

804280.title: Starwake
804280.short_description: Starwake is a free-to-play sci-fi MMO! Crew ships, battle enemies, mine asteroids, craft goods, run businesses, climb navy ranks, and conquer territory in a persistent universe with 75 star systems!

812910.title: Zodiac Legion
812910.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

833020.title: Wail of Despair
833020.short_description: A lonely girl left unaccompanied is followed into the colorful tunnels of her local fast food play place.

837520.title: The Night Janitor
837520.short_description: You were hired to clean. Nobody mentioned the ghosts. Craven & Moor Associates needs their offices spotless before the morning shift. What their employees can't know won't hurt them. Mop up the mess, take out the trash, and don't let anything catch you doing it. Five nights. One mop. Don't die.

848220.title: Split Drive
848220.short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

857650.title: Trebuchet Hold’em
857650.short_description: Conquer castles with poker in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Your deck is your army: soldiers gain experience, get wounded and fall. Play poker hands against walls and garrisons, collect war banners, march through three regions and storm the Royal City.

859020.title: Crop Dead
859020.short_description: You aren’t quite dead yet, but you're slipping. Play as a ghost defending your own comatose body from endless hordes of ravenous enemies. Plant magical crops, harvest bizarre weapons, and cultivate an automated defense of undead flora to survive the tower and complete your resurrection ritual!

867300.title: Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens
867300.short_description: One clever shot. A glorious chain of light. Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens is a cosy arcade puzzler about bouncing through jewels, unleashing magic and chasing the perfect combo. Explore eight worlds, 112 story missions and 112 challenges, plus a fresh Daily Challenge.

871460.title: Beryl
871460.short_description: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

878210.title: MATCHO
878210.short_description: MATCHO is a narrative first-person action adventure. Tag targets, build chains, and execute combos with an innovative real-time Match-3 combat. Join Max as he fights through an alien invasion, uncovers the truth behind his illness, and races to find a cure before Earth falls under alien control.

881940.title: Guns 'n Goblins
881940.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

938970.title: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine
938970.short_description: While converting the armored train (or is it a trolley?) “Draisine” into the “world's mightiest moving fortress,” they embark on a one-way journey (a breakthrough battle) back to their hometown. A 2D side-scrolling, top-down train shooting game.

1007760.title: Omni Axes
1007760.short_description: Trust your instincts - evade, aim, and shoot! Omni Axes is a shooting game that takes place in a 3D space where you can take down an endless number of enemies coming from all directions.

1008340.title: Insect Worlds
1008340.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

1020280.title: Deslot
1020280.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

1038080.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
1038080.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

1043850.title: Project Warlock: Lost Chapters
1043850.short_description: Jungle rot. Space horror. Pirate nightmares. Rip through three warped worlds of monsters, mutants and mayhem with an arsenal of spells and dozens of guns - from anchor launchers to chain spears to akimbo M60’s - in this new, standalone game featuring Warlock.

1054190.title: Parkour Bot
1054190.short_description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

1063700.title: ProtoDungeon: Episode III
1063700.short_description: A bite-sized, 2D top-down exploration adventure in an interconnected world. Fall into a lonely seaside cove, find a magic leaf beneath a shriveled lotus tree, summon sacred fire, and learn to jump, swim, and dash your way toward the chapel. No map or quest markers here; the way through is up to you.

1064250.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
1064250.short_description: A 2D platform game that comes to life through the myths of the Huni Kuin people. Overcome challenges in the Amazon, use the knowledge of the shamans and explore the world of spirits in this adventure illustrated by indigenous artists.

1068590.title: Project Sundive
1068590.short_description: Project Sundive is wave-based arena auto-shooter roguelite, focusing on ship customization and ridiculously overpowered builds

1077660.title: Drift
1077660.short_description: Drift is a narrative sci-fi horror adventure set on a desolate deep-space outpost. With your mission gone horrifically wrong, you face an unspeakable, monstrous foe. Explore the station's dark recesses, restore failing systems, survive terrifying encounters, and confront your own tormented past.

1111740.title: Cross Reverie
1111740.short_description: Follow the story of Eight of the land of Xylera’s bravest combatants and their descent into the madness known only as The Trial of Nightmare in this JRPG-inspired title featuring turn-based combat and a character-focused narrative.

1138880.title: Stemmies
1138880.short_description: Stemmies™ is a groundbreaking biological simulation. Command a fully voiced, AI-driven Chief Medical Officer with a DLC, manage a sprawling 2.5D bio-punk city, harvest cellular resources, and manipulate a live stock market fueled by ATP.

1141060.title: Spirit of Midnight
1141060.short_description: Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

1154960.title: Ardenfall
1154960.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

1159150.title: BOC: Birth of Cultures
1159150.short_description: The 4X where you shape 50,000 years of human history across planet-scale worlds.

1173980.title: Shadow of the Road
1173980.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

1184860.title: Banneret
1184860.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

1205570.title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
1205570.short_description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

1207360.title: Medieval Frontiers
1207360.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

1208890.title: Civlands
1208890.short_description: Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom in this pixel-art real-time strategy game. Your people build, farm and haul on their own while you decide what matters. Trade with rivals or march on them, bind spells to your armies, and build a wonder worth defending. Reign well, or not for long.

1209970.title: Blind Descent
1209970.short_description: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.

1221770.title: Homeplanet
1221770.short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

1225770.title: Sorted by Christmas
1225770.short_description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

1234990.title: Pry Into The Void
1234990.short_description: Delve into the hearts of monsters and people in this bleak monster-taming RPG. Exploit enemy weaknesses, confront difficult moral choices, and recruit surreal creatures by uncovering the truths hidden within their souls.

1238190.title: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
1238190.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

1244600.title: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
1244600.short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

1259770.title: Sovia: Five Year Plan
1259770.short_description: A cozy competitive card game in Sovia's broadcast station. Race to complete five plans, hand your building resources to rivals, scout their cards, and survive disasters. Six seats by default, with computer players and friend rooms.

1267290.title: Field of Heroes
1267290.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

1283480.title: Mossback
1283480.short_description: Tend a little farm on the mossy back of an ancient sea turtle as he drifts through the seasons. Fish, cook, raise animals and mend pottery with gold, then hop off to mine, dive, race and dodge bullets on a much grumpier turtle. Share what you grow with a very old friend and watch the island rise.

1288540.title: Jupiter Moons: Mecha🦾
1288540.short_description: Choose your mech, customize your loadout, and build your perfect deck. Experiment with cards to find powerful combinations as you enjoy the tactical combat and deckbuilding in this roguelike adventure!

1292510.title: Everstorm
1292510.short_description: Classic MOBA combat meets battle royale PVP, with roguelite elements. Fight other players, customize your abilities and survive hordes of monsters long enough to face the final boss. The last team standing wins. Earn permanent upgrades in between matches, then dive back in for more.

1294620.title: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
1294620.short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

1300880.title: Glitchphobia
1300880.short_description: Immerse yourself into unstable reality. In order to get out you must exploit glitch in a world around you. You can be sure of one thing, any rules you known no longer exist!! Do you have a courage to dip in it?

1312660.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
1312660.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

1314430.title: Still Rooms
1314430.short_description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

1316330.title: Quarantine Cutz
1316330.short_description: A hilarious cartoon simulation where you're absolutely terrible at cutting hair. Can you overcome your nerves and total pop culture ignorance to give your family a haircut that won't crush their dreams? Probably not, but you're gonna give it your best shot!

1318180.title: WiccAtriX
1318180.short_description: Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

1319530.title: Dunar: Dimension Two
1319530.short_description: A traditional turn-based JRPG featuring unique moments and a fascinating story centered around the forgotten past of the Purple Light, blending fantasy with inspirations from Himba culture and Indian aesthetics.

1320170.title: Lifeguard Simulator
1320170.short_description: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quads, jet skis and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

1322780.title: Unexpected Tasks
1322780.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

1333930.title: World's Worst Handyman
1333930.short_description: Suit up as the "World's Worst Handyman" in this comedy stealth game where every job is a chaotic adventure! Dodge disgruntled clients, bungle repairs, and save your beloved animal shelter from bankruptcy.

1339980.title: HS of Death
1339980.short_description: A first-person horror visual novel with point-and-click investigation. Six people are dead and you were there. Search rooms, solve puzzles that never give the answer away, and make the choices that decide whether you walk free or face execution.

1349460.title: Bravers
1349460.short_description: Build your own ship, recruit a crew to man it, and fight your way through the underground caves of a world wrecked by the Great Impact. Lead your crew through a fascinating journey full of danger, mysteries, friends and foes. Are you brave enough?

1353450.title: VoltHaven
1353450.short_description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

1355900.title: Tattered Banners
1355900.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

1358780.title: SKAZ: Shadow of the Tsar
1358780.short_description: An isometric action-RPG where memory is your weapon and four fractured realms shape your fate. Wake without a name — and survive. As long as you’re remembered, you live.

1362000.title: Skyclimbers
1362000.short_description: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

1368160.title: Heart Of Muriet
1368160.short_description: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

1375140.title: The BridgeMancer
1375140.short_description: Harness the power of Bridgemancy in this wholesome puzzle adventure. To rescue the citizens of Dolion, you must salvage materials, conjure bridges, and create escape routes for the townspeople. Just be sure not to block their path! Can you muster the magic, logic, and wit needed to save the kingdom?

1375790.title: Kakurenbo Neko
1375790.short_description: Kakurenbo Neko, a cozy hide & seek kitty collecting game.

1387110.title: Hyper Snatch
1387110.short_description: 5v5 Capture the Flag. No guns, just tag. Skill-based movement.

1390140.title: NIA
1390140.short_description: Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

1391150.title: Hack The Stars
1391150.short_description: Earth, 2040. The powerful are quietly preparing to leave for the stars. Fly a drone into their facilities, plant access, then command AI agents from your illicit Shadow Cloud to breach layered networks, train stolen models and expose who gets to go.

1391560.title: Oddsmaxxing
1391560.short_description: The odds manipulating roguelike. Oddsmaxxing lets you flip loaded coins and try to achieve specific outcomes and combos while chasing increasingly egregious targets. Unlock and use special coins to increase your chances in this satisfying gambling roguelike. May the odds be ever in your favor.

1391680.title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
1391680.short_description: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

1394650.title: Detained: Too Good for School
1394650.short_description: ☆A 2D action RPG delinquent schoolgirl simulator!★ Take control of a delinquent schoolgirl freshly liberated after half a year behind bars. Attend classes, fight gangsters, work various part-time jobs, and cause all manner of mischief however you choose in this gorgeous 2D action RPG!

1397440.title: EXOMECHA
1397440.short_description: EXOMECHA™ is a brand-new multiplayer shooter that takes place in OMECHA, an untouched planet with exotic environments. It offers you a breathtaking sci-fi gaming experience with its infantry, vehicular and mecha combat.

1399870.title: Bedtime Horror Stories
1399870.short_description: Late night. A young man called Sam is home alone. He finds a mystical book that takes him into a world of horror stories that come alive. Start reading, but you must not break the most important rule. Once you have started the book, you must finish it!

1400710.title: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
1400710.short_description: Gowf is an arcade style golf game featuring a single player adventure mode and 8 player online multiplayer. Win tournaments, complete side quests, level up, and take on friends in a variety of courses and game modes!

1405000.title: TREAD: Arcade Tank Combat
1405000.short_description: Fast-paced top-down online tank battles where skill, teamwork, and strategy decide every fight. Customize your tank with specialized hulls and turrets, each with unique stats and abilities.

1405050.title: NinMaki
1405050.short_description: What do you know as a ninja? An expert in stealth? Or a powerful killing machine? NinMaki is a side-scrolling action puzzle game where you experience a ninja mission.

1407750.title: Midnight Laundry
1407750.short_description: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

1410040.title: Necro-Matcher
1410040.short_description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

1426580.title: Situation Normal
1426580.short_description: You're a secret agent. Get in. Destroy the boss. Get the hell out. An action platformer where the faster you move, the more chaos you unleash at once.

1426870.title: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
1426870.short_description: This is a game about the painstaking and gradual process of building a fully functional, resource-harvesting, and self-defending base in the desert from scratch. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the unknown deserts!

1429060.title: Your place
1429060.short_description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

1440860.title: Past Visiting Hours
1440860.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

1442250.title: Sus Squad
1442250.short_description: Lie, sneak and vote in Impostor, or pass the bomb-ticking potato before it explodes in Hot Potato! Gather up to 14 friends or fill the room with bots, unlock special roles like the Sheriff and the Jester, and hang out in a lobby full of secrets.

1445480.title: Determinant
1445480.short_description: Realistic physics-based open-world survival game set in the future. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. Hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. Combat is possible, but more defensive in nature.

1445880.title: ROCKBEASTS
1445880.short_description: A darkly funny narrative RPG where you manage a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Book gigs, wrangle egos and navigate a cutthroat music industry. Every choice shapes your band’s story and your own. Make it big without selling out.

1456080.title: Abyss Delvers
1456080.short_description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

1459800.title: Fakutori
1459800.short_description: Fakutori is a laid-back automation game with a lot more going on beneath the surface. Combine elements, build sprawling production lines, and chase down the Legendary Blocks that only the most dedicated builders ever find. All at your own pace.

1468340.title: Gravity Blasters
1468340.short_description: Gravity Blasters is a real-time multiplayer game that recreates the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power. A game that mixes artillery games like Worms and Angry Birds with MOBAs like League of Legends or Dota.

1473780.title: Superstore Rush
1473780.short_description: Build, expand, and manage your dream store in Superstore Rush! Unlock groceries, electronics, clothing, and more while serving customers and tackling challenges like spills and power outages. Grow your shop, stock shelves, and rise to the top as the ultimate store manager!

1482470.title: Pirates Republic
1482470.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

1483000.title: Phantom Beasts - Redemption
1483000.short_description: Phantom Beasts - Redemption is a free to play cyberpunk 2.5D shooter that has the appealing blend of story, special ability system, and an explosive, gore-filled combat.

1490990.title: Isles of Krom
1490990.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.

1491520.title: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
1491520.short_description: A story rich and action packed fantasy game, that takes place in the fictional kingdom of Mythuras. Defend the kingdom against the ruthless undead in this retro-styled adventure game.

1499010.title: Project Hypnagogia
1499010.short_description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

1503700.title: Rules of Alchemy
1503700.short_description: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

1504000.title: Epic of Gilgamesh
1504000.short_description: History's first hero — Gilgamesh, who would not bow to death. Tablets fell silent; bones still speak. With wild Enkidu, cunning Ursanabi and wise healer Bau, walk from Eridu to Uruk. Take up your weapon, learn ancient spells; defy beasts, gods, and death itself.

1505940.title: Orc Warchief: Strategy Story
1505940.short_description: Carve a war camp out of an ancient forest. Grab, drop and rally an unruly Horde with the Hand of the Warchief. Rescue goblins, claim forgotten sites and storm human castles. Every conquest brings new power and a Kingdom eager for revenge.

1514040.title: Oasis the Great
1514040.short_description: Ever imagine you could play with your fellows in Online co-op , discover a tremendous world,find the treasures,build freely,do some farming,fight with others,party around ! also there are other mini games.And all these happen in a physics based oasis!! (￣▽￣)~❤

1514140.title: Cursed Night
1514140.short_description: Cursed Night is a multiplayer horror game for 1-5 players. Use your magic abilities to defeat the devil, or become the devil and seek revenge. Find talismans, collect power, release spirits, or choose the dark side and kill everyone.

1520340.title: Astario
1520340.short_description: Astario is a universe in which you can build functional ships and orbital stations with automated factories. Collect materials, craft new blocks, and expand into the universe. Nothing is ever truly static, ships, stations, asteroids, planets, everything follows the laws of orbital motion.

1526850.title: Paid in Blood
1526850.short_description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

1533990.title: Player's Eleven - Football Manager
1533990.short_description: Player's Eleven - Football Manager is a football management game in which you take over clubs with very different identities – from world club to talent factory to traditional club. It's up to you to write the next chapter of their story.

1539990.title: Team Hero Coder
1539990.short_description: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle in a classic RPG-inspired arena. Learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

1540370.title: Hans in the Internetz
1540370.short_description: Hans in the Internetz is a first-/third-person meme platform adventure game. His dream to become a wizard lays deep within the internet and you, as his apprentice must do the dirty work and “figure thiz out” Expect puzzles, toilet humour and legal drugs!

1549860.title: DOLYA'
1549860.short_description: Atmospheric fantasy 2D-RPG. In a world where everything has a Plot, Fate, and a Name. Your role is to save Fate. To find that Name that was erased from reality.

1550000.title: TRYPAN
1550000.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

1550920.title: Slime Alchemy
1550920.short_description: Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.

1551190.title: Mad Chess
1551190.short_description: Mad Chess is a turn-based strategy game that vastly expands on the classic game of chess. Explore a colorful fantasy world, recruit up to 20 unique factions, fight-off an alien invasion in a single-player story mode or battle your friends online!

1552280.title: Dice Mice
1552280.short_description: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

1553150.title: Anima Reaver
1553150.short_description: A co-op space shooter where you fly with a squad of up to four, online or on split screen, through missions, boss fights and deathmatch. Take flagships apart turret by turret, master 18 ships, and unveil the secrets of the universe.

1553590.title: Saveseeker
1553590.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

1553640.title: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
1553640.short_description: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

1555680.title: Sphere Wars
1555680.short_description: Sphere Wars is a fast-paced, class-based fantasy multiplayer shooter where Guardians, Warriors, Scouts, Mages, and Assassins clash in intense objective-based battles. Capture the spheres, master your class, and dominate the battlefields.

1556340.title: Jamir
1556340.short_description: Jamir is a free-to-play fast paced sci-fi tactical shooter created by one person. Master your abilities and items to destroy creatures and enemies. Upgrade your character, guns, abilities and items to become the most powerful along the globe.

1557130.title: Luma
1557130.short_description: Absorb light, mix pigments, and create moving art in a minimalist game of discovery. Uncover new possibilities at your own pace. Relax in Standard, raise the stakes in Hardcore, or push your limits in Mastery.

1557340.title: SkyCraft
1557340.short_description: Skycraft is an open-world survival game for 1-10 players, set in infinite procedurally-generated floating islands.

1558030.title: Tales of Anturia: Farathan
1558030.short_description: Explore, fight and discover the great conspiracy lingering in the shadows. In this third-person RPG. Pick one of three sides and enjoy the open world.

1561540.title: Ship of Theseus
1561540.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

1570260.title: Time Loop Nibiru
1570260.short_description: Your death is your greatest weapon. A sci-fi Metroidvania shooter where you are trapped in a time loop on the war-torn planet Nibiru. Explore a vast interconnected world, solve puzzles, and cooperate with the ghosts of your past lives to survive and escape.

1572950.title: CAT Interstellar: Episode II
1572950.short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's: Starship Trooper

1577020.title: MicroMayhem
1577020.short_description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

1578970.title: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game
1578970.short_description: JUST A GUY is an online multiplayer ragdoll game. Play with physics, explore small open worlds, drive vehicles, use fun items and complete objectives to earn new cosmetic outfits!

1579210.title: Riot Control Simulator
1579210.short_description: Take on the role of a Riot Control officer and control a riot. You can either brutally deal with the crowd or use more reasonable options. Will you decide to support a nascent dictatorship?

1580680.title: Psychonesis
1580680.short_description: Psychonesis is a survival extraction pursuit co-op game where you play as patients imprisoned by an evil billion dollar corporation. Betrayed by those you trusted most, you must outsmart and outmaneuver their private security in this ultimate prison break/police chase game!

1584590.title: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust
1584590.short_description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

1589820.title: Denari
1589820.short_description: Denari is a narrative action game about a boy with telekinetic powers who must fight to save his people from the invasion of an empire. Master fast-paced hack and slash combat, take down epic bosses and follow a young warrior's coming-of-age journey as he becomes the protector of his people.

1599610.title: Tiny Planet Protectors
1599610.short_description: Welcome to the TPPA! The galaxy is yours to explore. Unfortunately, you owe the company that owns it. Take strange jobs across alien worlds, discover bizarre anomalies, and rebuild a bar on a tiny asteroid.

1600110.title: Void Skirmisher
1600110.short_description: VOID SKIRMISHER is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the warp gate, hold off endless waves of hostile fleets far past any front line, and drop in or out whenever you like.

1607580.title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror
1607580.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

1619810.title: BUNNY-HOP
1619810.short_description: A first-person bhop and surf game inspired by Counter-Strike’s community servers. Hop across rooftops, ride ramps, and find out how your friend took half a second off a run you thought was clean.

1622130.title: Our Life: Now & Forever
1622130.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

1622500.title: Turf Wars: Slumika
1622500.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

1626280.title: Explory Story
1626280.short_description: Run around on the surface of many different stories. You can interact with the text, and the text can interact with you! There are boss battles, collectibles, a song, puzzles, and much more!

1628640.title: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
1628640.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

1633850.title: Jianghu Simulator
1633850.short_description: Simulated Jianghu is a role-playing game that blends sect-management mechanics with multiple playthroughs, high player freedom, and a gritty street-level wuxia style. A mobile-first launch is planned for 2025.

1635500.title: Elements Destiny
1635500.short_description: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional journey with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

1637460.title: TankRat
1637460.short_description: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

1647220.title: Once,in Times of Chaos
1647220.short_description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

1674120.title: Red Rust
1674120.short_description: As a tough Soviet KGB agent you travel around the world fighting street gangs and giant mechanical monsters on direct order from Comrade Stalin.

1681830.title: CityZen
1681830.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

1689340.title: Island of Winds
1689340.short_description: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

1690100.title: Cosminers
1690100.short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

1693940.title: TrackShot
1693940.short_description: TrackShot is a fast-paced tank PvP game where doing tricks earns you ammo. Grind rails, perform some flips, and land clean to load your shells, then fire them at your mates. Battle it out across a bunch of arenas and modes as you compete for air superiority.

1696630.title: RunMan Turbo
1696630.short_description: The Indie Legend Returns: Bounce, slide, and run fast as heck through high speed levels in five unique zones. Each time you run a level it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts to beat record times, earn medals, unlock secrets, and be the world's fastest! Wishlist Now!

1697010.title: Tri-Ger
1697010.short_description: TRI-GER is a top-down rouge-like SHMUP with technicolor vector based graphics. Fight endless waves of enemies, and be sure to match your color to get a high score!

1699300.title: Caboosh
1699300.short_description: Caboosh! is a roguelite where you build a train one silly wagon at a time. Every car has its own effects and synergies, so line up the combos, stack the crates waaay up high and pray the money outruns the fuel bill!

1702620.title: Nautilus Epoch
1702620.short_description: On an island in the Adriatic Sea lives a girl called Lily. Her world is turned upside down when she comes into contact with a mysterious seashell and finds herself lost in an endless cosmic ocean. Help her find her way back home.

1706960.title: The Mysterious Cat Tower
1706960.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

1711990.title: TOCOViX
1711990.short_description: Place Crosses on the game board and complete "Shapes". Earn "Stops" to block your opponents and make your way to victory! Play with your friends on the same device or challenge other players Online.

1716760.title: Trinity Archetype
1716760.short_description: Create busted builds and unleash crazy combos in this Skill-Crafting Roguelike RPG! Mix and match bazillions of runes, boost it up in battle, and shatter the chaos consuming your broken world.

1719930.title: Tokyo Stranger 东京诡事
1719930.short_description: Tokyo Stranger is an aerial genre of text horror game inspired by the opening ceremony of the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games. You play as a tourist from an exotic country, looking for any possibility to escape Tokyo in a static world.

1721000.title: Property Pro
1721000.short_description: Your tower is falling apart and your staff came from the classified ads. Build the rooms, take in the guests, then hire the people to keep it standing. Send the plumber to the burst pipe, not the front desk. Put the wrong worker on the wrong job and you'll watch your guests walk out.

1721790.title: Summon, then build an invincible harem
1721790.short_description: Spiritual Summoners-They can use the Mana in their bodies to summon spiritual people from another world. Your mother is going to travel far, and only left you a letter, and a...beautiful spirit war girl "Shirley". what are you going to do with the summoning technique of the spirit?

1724080.title: Plastic
1724080.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

1725710.title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
1725710.short_description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

1728450.title: My Cozy Home
1728450.short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of. The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

1729330.title: SkyCruise
1729330.short_description: Race a solar-powered ship from the mines to orbit before the sun goes down. Steer, jump and burn through 35 zones of drop hammers, traffic and open gaps, then chase Gold and Ace medals against the ghost of your best run.

1734130.title: Concerto on White
1734130.short_description: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

1735080.title: High Elo Girls
1735080.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

1736200.title: Sealed Gate
1736200.short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

1741170.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
1741170.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

1747470.title: Road Diner Simulator
1747470.short_description: Start as a cook in Becky’s roadside diner and become her business partner. Cook dozens of dishes, keep guests happy, hire and manage staff, then expand and decorate the place your way. Play solo or in online co-op.

1747630.title: For The Hive
1747630.short_description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

1749050.title: Revasion
1749050.short_description: Breakout, turned inside out. Spin a glowing ring of blocks around a ball that always curves back to the centre. Break every block, survive the bullet-storm Evade phases, and hold on as the whole game speeds up.

1751820.title: Project OutFox
1751820.short_description: Project OutFox is mod friendly, cross-platform rhythm game engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, sensor, instrument and key-based rhythm games. Play your way through 25+ years of community content and relive your nostalgia and try to outfox your friends!

1752080.title: HUNGER
1752080.short_description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

1754880.title: Vowless Blade: A Fleeting Hope
1754880.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

1767010.title: Echoes of the Stars
1767010.short_description: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

1768860.title: Bionic Shield: Battle for Space Nebula Omega
1768860.short_description: You are the Bionic Shield, humanity's last hope against the Automaton invasion. Win the space battles, drop onto new planets in your combat suit, take the wheel of drones and tanks, and shoot your way through the machine hordes. No two invasions play the same.

1773710.title: Cardseer
1773710.short_description: Cardseer is a deckbuilding game combining roguelike elements with a sprawling campaign. Choose your hero and fight your way across diverse maps filled with fearsome enemies, all while crafting your deck and collecting powerful artifacts. Can you rise to the challenge?

1779280.title: Humankind in a nutshell
1779280.short_description: Spin the slot and decide the fate of your civilization. From seeds to kingdoms, from stone to steel. From the very first turn to a thousand years later, every choice becomes history. From the first spark of fire to a forest of skyscrapers. How long can your people survive?

1779610.title: Farm Renovator
1779610.short_description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

1784310.title: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep
1784310.short_description: Embark on an epic adventure as a sword-wielding fish and restore order to the kingdom's depths. Explore an ocean world full of adorable characters, menacing foes, and hidden wonders.

1786630.title: Droid Escape
1786630.short_description: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

1787410.title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
1787410.short_description: Build a whimsical deck of cartoon animals to battle foes & uncover special treasures in this cute but competitive online Trading Card Game! Collect trading cards featuring indie artists' works, open booster packs, and complete challenges to expand your collection!

1792390.title: Life After End
1792390.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

1792780.title: Spirit Vendor
1792780.short_description: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

1794000.title: Remnants of R'lyeh
1794000.short_description: Remnants of R'lyeh is a first-person survival horror that drags you from drowned ruins and the streets of Innsmouth into Abyssal City, a steampunk city in the abyss, and down to R'lyeh itself. Fight above and below the water and find a way out before your sanity breaks.

1796710.title: Finders, Keepers
1796710.short_description: Night work at St. Ossian's: go down into crypts that never end, carry up cursed and blessed relics, and sell them to the Keeper. Every curse pays better and frays your nerve. Die below and your haul stays down there with you, waiting for you to come back for it.

1797740.title: Farming Sweeper
1797740.short_description: Build, manage and grow your farm in a unique way: Solving puzzles with traditional minesweeper mechanics and managing your business finances in a relaxing game with great replay factor.

1800240.title: SoulRoad
1800240.short_description: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

1801140.title: Guns Undarkness
1801140.short_description: A command battle JRPG by Shoji Meguro, known for scoring and directing on the “Persona” and “Shin Megami Tensei” series. The adventure takes place in a near-future world on the brink of destruction. Become a member of the private military company BTI's Alpha Team, and carry out grueling missions.

1803110.title: ASCENDANT
1803110.short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure four biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

1805170.title: Evil Dreams
1805170.short_description: Travel through nightmares until you go insane. Evil Dreams is a dark adventure, telling the story of a boy living in the 19th century and forced to face ancient evil. Delve into the world of dreams to find out the truth.

1808160.title: Demon Spore
1808160.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

1809390.title: Rebirth of Arcadia
1809390.short_description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a story-rich turn-based tactics JRPG. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, and harness the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

1811360.title: Unnatural
1811360.short_description: Unnatural is a first-person survival horror game set in a dark world between life and death. Solve puzzles, manage resources, and survive invisible monsters using your firearm and supernatural light to reveal and destroy the horrors lurking in the darkness.

1827200.title: RSOD
1827200.short_description: Shoot, crack, and quest in RSOD, an action game with elements of roleplaying, loot, and anime-style graphics.

1830110.title: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
1830110.short_description: Crash-landed on the alien world of Sirenis, you must survive, build a base and search for your missing brother. Gather, research and craft your way across a hostile planet of strange creatures, ancient ruins and a mystery far bigger than your crash.

1831110.title: Train Kingdom
1831110.short_description: This is a railway history simulation game.Set in the United States of the 19th century. Get a railroad network that connects cities in the pioneering America. Use locomotives to carry supplies, passengers, and get money through trade. Complete various quests and gain fame.

1832170.title: RoRX
1832170.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

1833210.title: Astromine
1833210.short_description: Astromine is a survival mining game about scavenging fully destructible planets. Designed for 1 to 4 players. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, fight robot factions, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

1835080.title: Taste Of Heaven
1835080.short_description: Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite ! Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery.

1835670.title: Fall Up
1835670.short_description: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

1837730.title: Loot List: Thief Sim
1837730.short_description: Rise from pauper to master thief - grab the loot list and get to work, whether it’s a roadside diner or a federal vault: slip past security and make fools of everyone, or unleash chaos and blow the place apart. Fence the haul to upgrade the hideout, gear up, and build your criminal empire.

1840410.title: Knight of the Forgotten Realm
1840410.short_description: Knight of the Forgotten Realm is a 2.5D dark fantasy action-adventure soulslike set in Austeria, a war-torn realm. Featuring visceral combat and the ability to overcharge your soul, you and a godlike being known as an Eternal head east to uncover lost knowledge. Will you survive the Eternal's call?

1842340.title: Hurling Herman
1842340.short_description: A unique platformer where you hurl vials to create temporary platforms, navigate sprawling caves, and battle creatures. With an original soundtrack and immersive environments, a challenging adventure awaits you.

1843450.title: Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH
1843450.short_description: "Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH" is a high-speed 3D action game. You dash through the world known as "HAVEN", which is controlled by the mysterious object "Nexus", making full use of various actions.

1843480.title: Autobahn Racing
1843480.short_description: No limits, no rules: 300 km/h on German autobahns and through authentic cities. Brutal street races, dense traffic, cops on your tail – pure adrenaline rush from Munich to Berlin.

1843790.title: Check x Mate
1843790.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

1846700.title: Witchbrook
1846700.short_description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

1853440.title: Tropico 7
1853440.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

1854570.title: Colossal Citadels
1854570.short_description: A fantasy strategy, featuring turn-based factory building over procedural resource types. Expand and optimize your network of towns, grow your heroes, and excel in deep tactical seamless auto-battler combat.

1859970.title: Pseudo-Psy Play
1859970.short_description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Pseudo-Psy Play is an eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. The time has come – face your fears in this bone-chilling story-driven horror game that feels (and looks) like nothing else in the genre. Are you ready, Joseph?

1860010.title: KEEPERS 1477
1860010.short_description: A story-driven action RPG set in medieval Ottoman Istanbul, featuring authentic Ottoman and Turkish miniature art. Explore the city, complete quests, master brutal melee combat, cast powerful spells, discover hidden secrets, and battle hordes of undead and demons to protect the capital.

1862300.title: Catch The Train
1862300.short_description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

1864570.title: Sender Unknown
1864570.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

1867920.title: No Humanity - Internship
1867920.short_description: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.

1868210.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
1868210.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

1871640.title: The Backworld
1871640.short_description: Slip through the cracks of reality and explore a vast, open-ended RPG world where surreal horrors collide with fantasy kingdoms and sci-fi cities. Fight in strategic turn-based battles and tense real-time action. The more your sanity breaks, the more the world and its monsters warp around you.

1876210.title: Illusion Fight — Season 1
1876210.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical universe. Fight in hex-grid combat, collect cards, raise creatures, read the novel, and watch the webtoon — all free, all connected. Built over 23 years by a solo developer. Free to play. Season 1 is live now.

1877940.title: Western Brawl
1877940.short_description: In a quiet western town, the righteous gunslinger Hannah finds herself surrounded by enemies from all directions inside a saloon. Draw your revolver, take down waves of ruthless outlaws, and fight your way through intense gunfights to carve out a path to survival!

1889850.title: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
1889850.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

1890270.title: Trailthread
1890270.short_description: Trailthread is a turn-based JRPG where players weave together brand-new attacks each turn. Follow three young adventurers as they scale Anvite Mountain and tumble through time to defeat the Obsidian Drake. Use game-changing Augments to cast dynamic combos and carve your path to the summit!

1892080.title: BLEAK Remastered
1892080.short_description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

1897660.title: The Main Menu
1897660.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

1905580.title: Kloa - Child of the Forest
1905580.short_description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

1906430.title: Halve
1906430.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

1908380.title: Binary Golf
1908380.short_description: 3D sci-fi mini-golf where you hit targets until the last target becomes the hole. Every target grants a unique ability; chain abilities mid-flight and curve your shots. Compete for stars in 4-player Battle Mode or explore a story full of bosses and secrets.

1911340.title: Dimakerus
1911340.short_description: Dimakerus is a social deduction combat game for up to 4 players. Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in procedural catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

1915690.title: Burning Skies
1915690.short_description: Burning Skies is a frantic roguelite bullet hell. Build the ultimate warjet, mix weapons and enhancements every run, take down giant bosses and overthrow the tyrants who rule the world.

1917470.title: Into The Haunted Land
1917470.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

1919410.title: Hero Dungeon
1919410.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with a twist. Collect 50+ heroes and send parties into dungeons that keep growing while you are away. Team up with friends in mega dungeons, or descend into the Endless Depths: a hand-played rogue-lite mode, solo or co-op.

1920290.title: Barkour
1920290.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

1927200.title: near the fear
1927200.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, alone and desperate, you're driving towards the light. On an ever-shifting road, turn inwards and face your ancient enemy to find the freedom you crave.

1936310.title: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer
1936310.short_description: A game of choices where you get to become a hero, impress hot girls, and slay a dragon. 💕 Choose your own adventure and make it truly sugoi!

1940510.title: Born64
1940510.short_description: You are Slayer, a Hunter dispatched to a village where the townsfolk are transforming into monsters. None of the previous Hunters ever returned. Explore 64-bit dungeons, solve puzzles, and survive what the past tried to bury.

1941920.title: Factory Island
1941920.short_description: Factory Island is an experimental game built to display 3D worlds inside a 2D renderer. Explore procedurally generated maps, build voxel structures, invite your friends to multiplayer, experiment with water and simple electronics, fight creatures and create mods for this game-engine project.

1950230.title: Galactic Diner
1950230.short_description: Galactic Diner is a cooking-themed RPG full of minigame mayhem. Explore a planet full of friends, food, and mysteries, and cook your way to the top of the galaxy!

1953430.title: DearMyFriend
1953430.short_description: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

1953850.title: VICE Undercover
1953850.short_description: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

1954240.title: Galaxy Gang
1954240.short_description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

1963680.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
1963680.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

1964900.title: Soul Dust
1964900.short_description: A third-person bullet-heaven roguelite where six factions wage war around you. Parry and brawl the horde, let your build do the killing, or mix both. Play hands-on, hands-off and break the game.

1966090.title: VoidMania
1966090.short_description: A neon arcade territory game. Carve lines through the void and seal them to the wall to claim space, but if an enemy touches your open line, it burns. Trap the sector bosses, chain your cuts and reveal every sector across 48 levels.

1970220.title: Walk Hero
1970220.short_description: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

1971470.title: Crystals Of Irm
1971470.short_description: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

1971740.title: Road Warriors
1971740.short_description: Survive on the road in this post apocalyptic world! Road Warriors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where your goal is to create the strongest build in one run!

1972940.title: Second Saga
1972940.short_description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

1973760.title: Shell Soldier
1973760.short_description: " Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

1975380.title: Kaiju Catastrophe
1975380.short_description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

1976110.title: Dreaming Worlds
1976110.short_description: Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

1980460.title: Skykipelago
1980460.short_description: Skykipelago is a chill strategy game where you build happy little cities in the sky. Explore a variety of colorful islands, care for your buildings' happiness, evolve your buildings to help you grow, and when solid ground is no longer cool enough for you - expand onto the cliff sides.

1993410.title: Laws of Nadragia
1993410.short_description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

1998220.title: Twin Jet Racer
1998220.short_description: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

1999830.title: Pin City
1999830.short_description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

2002360.title: GRUBWERK
2002360.short_description: Manufacture the tools and assemble the bombs that will raise our great nation above all others. You and your comrades will expand our new munitions factory in the eastern block.

2003070.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
2003070.short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

2008670.title: RalphGame
2008670.short_description: A handcrafted action-comedy RPG packed with fresh mechanics and surprises. After your friends are mysteriously kidnapped at sea, it's up to you to bring them home.

2012030.title: Uncounted Isles
2012030.short_description: A first-person RPG at the edge of the known world. Explore a vast archipelago from frontier towns to forgotten ruins. Wield swords and sorcery, shape your fate and fight your way through a branching story that will leave scars on your character.

2015050.title: Tattie Bogle
2015050.short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

2015450.title: Void Inside
2015450.short_description: In a world devastated by radiation, the surface of the Earth has turned into a lifeless wasteland. People long ago sought refuge in underground shelters, but even there, death caught up with them through disease. The protagonist is the last survivor in his shelter

2016400.title: Echoed Realms
2016400.short_description: Echoed Realms is a Casual Stylized Fantasy RPG focused on player experience and dynamic gameplay. Play it your way, even if that changes every day.

2017940.title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
2017940.short_description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

2022610.title: CRETE
2022610.short_description: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful.
