The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

2022640.title: CALX
2022640.short_description: Flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Double jump, dash, levitate and grapple through atmospheric ruins. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy.

2051360.title: Skip Lake 2
2051360.short_description: “Solve beautiful puzzles and listen to the melody of crashing Pots going deeper into the story of Skip Lake!”

2051890.title: Game Cafe
2051890.short_description: Game Cafe is a casual game where you can play games like Spades, Okey, Backgammon and more with your friends or other cross platform players.

2056130.title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
2056130.short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

2056960.title: Merauders: Tides of Fate
2056960.short_description: Navigate family secrets and cultural divides as mysterious abilities awaken. Every choice ripples through relationships. Every conflict resolves through understanding, not violence. What you learn and the choices you make can change everything.

2059270.title: The Last Station
2059270.short_description: The Last Station is a visual novel. It's loneliness. This is the absence of a second attempt. It's the lack of happy endings.

2064310.title: Dark Age Dinos
2064310.short_description: A multiplayer tactical roguelike for 1-4 players set in a medieval world of sword wielding dinosaurs. Strategize your way through short adventures where teamwork is the key to success!

2064710.title: Luminescence
2064710.short_description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

2066000.title: Cops N' Zombies
2066000.short_description: A multiplayer horror social deduction game where you and your friends are all police. Survive the zombies, do missions, make money, and buy fun items. But wait, there is a zombie police among you that can transform that is trying to get rid you. Do you trust your friends?

2068650.title: Northanda Chronicles
2068650.short_description: Master role-based deckbuilding in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build your party around the RPG holy trinity, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

2079920.title: NAME OF THE WILL
2079920.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

2082690.title: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World
2082690.short_description: Learn to listen to the melody of this singing world and explore an ongoing slice of life story of my personal experience seeking refuge in the woods, befriending trees, talking with mysterious doomer owls, burying a butterfly and grieving the dying of species and forests.

2089870.title: RouteDom
2089870.short_description: Build your kingdom tile by tile! Draw, place, and connect roads, fields, and resources to your city in a strategic puzzle inspired by the great tabletop classics. Easy to learn, hard to master: every placement counts.

2097020.title: RoomRun
2097020.short_description: Roomrun is a simple yet action-packed local multiplayer retro-style running game for one to four players. Run through trap-filled rooms, use the environment to your advantage, play safe and slow or fast and risky and try to reach the finish line before your friends do!

2097940.title: Theatre of War: Rearmed
2097940.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

2099730.title: BURN THE WITCH
2099730.short_description: THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH. ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING. I'M NOT AGAINST IT

2102300.title: Eternal Mist
2102300.short_description: A real-time tactical game about making the right decisions with incomplete information. Choose your battles, prepare your squads, and adapt on the fly when enemy waves unfold in unexpected ways.

2104080.title: Discharge Pending
2104080.short_description: Everyone was evacuated. Except you. A first-person psychological horror game set in an empty hospital. Ride down ten floors and decide on every floor whether anything has changed. One mistake sends you back to floor 10. Speak, and something in here learns your voice.

2110020.title: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess
2110020.short_description: A minimalist portrait roguelike built for lightweight PC gaming. Build tag combos while enjoying mini-games like fishing, blind chess, and brawls. Play P2P duels with friends. Ultra-lightweight, code-drawn visuals, playable with just a mouse. Easy to learn, deeply strategic.

2113880.title: Cave Crawler
2113880.short_description: Embark on an adventure inspired by Gameboy era games. Explore, fight bosses, and earn resources! Travel across islands and towns to engage in subtle, lore rich story.

2120430.title: Dungeon Roll
2120430.short_description: Descend beneath your family estate to uncover the truth about the crusader heroes of your bloodline, re-rolling your path floor by floor through a labyrinth built on real Crusades history. The souls of legendary crusaders grant you boons and the seven deadly sins guard the way down.

2126090.title: Epsylon - The Guardians of Xendron
2126090.short_description: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

2130280.title: BPM Boy
2130280.short_description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack.

2131760.title: SANKAN
2131760.short_description: Kill the customer the voice in your head names. Clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Or refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you. A story-driven co-op horror for 1-3 players: the night shift at a mountain gas station, Japan, 1999.

2135560.title: Arcane Survivors
2135560.short_description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

2139040.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
2139040.short_description: Welcome back, Chef! Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in this new take on a million-selling classic. With new art, a new campaign, and a new local co-op mode, there's never been a better time to get cooking.

2139330.title: Auto Immune
2139330.short_description: Auto Immune is a physics-based autobattler set in the human body. A virus is attacking your cells, and its up to you to defend them! Buy and combine cells to assemble your immune response. Discover powerful synergies to overcome a constantly evolving enemy. Can you achieve IMMUNITY?

2140620.title: The Bakerville Case
2140620.short_description: Get ready for a first-person horror, adventure and survival experience, enter the darkness in this adventure inspired by true events and enjoy incredible graphics generated in real time with Unity engine. Play as Thomas Baker and explore a remote town to discover the terrible evil that awaits there.

2141130.title: Road Kings
2141130.short_description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

2144580.title: Super Bio-Man
2144580.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

2146470.title: Miramar
2146470.short_description: Set in a hard sci-fi universe, Miramar follows a group of Tac Marines sent to investigate why contact has been lost with a far off colony. Exploration, turn-based combat, and roguelike gameplay collide. Can your squad survive?

2150030.title: Dark Tidings Online
2150030.short_description: A classic, Tiny-MMORPG experience. From a penniless nobody dropped with no memories into an unknown world, to a hero ... or a villain? Join a faction of your choice and learn a wide array of skills. Help out villagers in need, battle in the wilds and explore dungeons. Alone or with friends!

2151730.title: Meet the Rome
2151730.short_description: “All roads lead to Rome, but the tolls are strictly non-refundable.” Wrapped in the parchment of ancient bureaucracy, Meet the Rome is a satirical, choice-driven narrative game.

2153760.title: Stronghold 4
2153760.short_description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

2155070.title: Fate/EXTRA Record
2155070.short_description: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

2159260.title: Vampire Rancher
2159260.short_description: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

2162570.title: Cafe Simulator
2162570.short_description: Build and decorate your shop, diversify your products through alliances, and make the right investments to expand your business.

2164500.title: Neebota: 99 Fails
2164500.short_description: Neebota: 99 Fails is a 3D action adventure with impossibly difficult platforming challenges in 2D. It takes place in Zeebo's surreal nightmare wherein his body painfully transforms, set to music by legendary David Wise.

2168120.title: Anomalistic Revolution
2168120.short_description: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

2168330.title: Helmscape
2168330.short_description: Lead a party of fantasy heroes in action-packed battles...in SNAKE formation! Choose your party and venture forth into an ever-changing world as you discover new heroes and find better loot to keep gearing up.

2174060.title: Sincognito
2174060.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

2176490.title: Star Shift Freelancers
2176490.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

2178300.title: JUNK!
2178300.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a Scrapper, or are you just another piece of JUNK? Battle with your friends, random opponents, or an AI trainer to unlock new robots, abilities, and customizations. JUNK! is a fast paced, arena 1v1 PVP brawler.

2179180.title: Hex Party
2179180.short_description: Hex Party is a chaotic multiplayer party game for up to 8 players online or 4 locally. Roll the dice, sabotage your friends, and compete in 14 action-packed minigames. Play solo with bots or bring your friends!

2185100.title: Children of the Forest
2185100.short_description: Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat. Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

2188870.title: Hyper Drill
2188870.short_description: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at hyper speed. Drill through any obstacle, master your timing, learn level layouts, and jump between different galaxies.

2189050.title: Think And Co-op
2189050.short_description: Think and Coop is an exciting arcade game built for local and online co-op. Travel through forests and fairy-tale worlds, complete levels, and face new challenges. Coordination and teamwork are the keys to success in this fantastic adventure.

2192020.title: Phones not Allowed
2192020.short_description: School is too boring? The temptation of using your phone too strong? Be careful, teacher's watching! Like Social Media posts and collect awesome Anime Artworks while keeping an eye on your teacher & classmates. One slip... and you are suspended!

2199730.title: Crimson Deluge
2199730.short_description: Command a besieged camp from its walls. Top-down zombie horde defense: survive seven brutal days, pick new weapons as the waves speed up, fortify your camp from scrap barricades to a military fortress - and keep your survivors alive.

2205960.title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
2205960.short_description: RACE is a fast-paced combat racing game where speed, weapons, and destruction rule the road. Tear through post-apocalyptic tracks, battle massive bosses, and challenge up to four players in local split-screen.

2207260.title: Battle Titan:RAINBOW
2207260.short_description: Defeat the overwhelming forces of the ASURA Cult with the Cursed Battle Titan: RAINBOW !

2207350.title: Pararecords
2207350.short_description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

2221530.title: Vangaro Tactics
2221530.short_description: Command your cartoon army against pointy-nosed officers in this colorful turn-based strategy game with asymmetric factions, mining, and tactical Stealth Missions. Capture buildings, recruit exclusive troops, and use each commander's Power to advance through the Vangaro War.

2221690.title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
2221690.short_description: Oh no! An evil Game Master has taken over the school's tabletop role playing club and is terrorizing its members with twisted dungeons and strict rulings! As the new kid in town, do you have what it takes to stop the tyran and bring peace back to the Afterschool Adventurers Club?

2223860.title: Shardana
2223860.short_description: Shipwrecked on an island inspired by ancient Nuragic Sardinia, explore, fish, build your shelter, and help the villagers. But beware: when night falls, the infected turn into dangerous creatures. Survive alone or in online co-op with up to 6 players.

2226880.title: Redneck Redemption
2226880.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

2227480.title: Congratulations, You Failed!
2227480.short_description: Pilot a rocket through tough training courses in a physics-based arcade game where failure comes with commentary. Dodge machinery, deliver swinging cargo, and upgrade your rocket while an unimpressed announcer keeps track of your mistakes. Prove them wrong, eventually.

2228840.title: Whispers of West Grove
2228840.short_description: You're trapped in a psychiatric hospital. Your dreams are turning into nightmares. And your flashlight can change reality. Explore the twisted worlds of West Grove, solve puzzles that defy expectations, and use your strange new power to escape. Just remember: every world plays by different rules.

2233390.title: Nuclear Sub
2233390.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

2234380.title: The Doll Sitter
2234380.short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny taking care of dolls in a strange house. Watch over the dolls, complete tasks, gather clues, and uncover which one is the impostor.

2234670.title: Not Us
2234670.short_description: A solitaire style card game where you forage for plants, manage your inventory, and try to stay alive.

2239750.title: Gus & Stella's Stellar Adventure
2239750.short_description: Help Gus find out where his family is, and who was behind the attack that left his ear bitten off. Craft, Climb, Solve Puzzles, Win Battles, and Get to know the Cats at the Kitten Intergalactic Taskforce station!

2240240.title: Four Hundred Catapults
2240240.short_description: A large-scale survival strategy game with up to 3000 units on the battlefield. Build and manage your settlement, produce resources, research weapons and technologies, and recruit your army to survive in the war against the Half Dead Legions.

2242270.title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
2242270.short_description: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Wishlist this game. It is your destiny...

2242340.title: Car Rental Simulator
2242340.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

2244650.title: HexLands
2244650.short_description: Forge an island kingdom one card at a time. Each card you play raises a farm, mill, or harbor on procedural hex islands. Crack the challenge each new shore gives you before setting sail, carrying your relics and upgrades onward. No combat. The land, the weather, and your own draw are the challenge.

2245130.title: Handshakes: Hands On
2245130.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

2245760.title: Optiminer
2245760.short_description: Optiminer is a minimalist incremental about mining radioactive materials. Dig through the rock to extract raw ore and radioactive materials, then pour it all into a branching upgrade tree and go deeper.

2245790.title: Kendo Warrior
2245790.short_description: Kendo Warrior is a realistic samurai sword fighting simulator. In the game, the player will take part in exciting duels in medieval Japan. Realistic animations of the most important moves of kendo warriors will introduce the player to the world of this martial art.

2246590.title: GlitchStorm
2246590.short_description: Fight with style, hack enemies, and chase viral fame in a dying world. Earn credits, upgrade your ship, and reach new planets. Explore a city of broken Artificials—and save the only friend you have left before it’s too late.

2248150.title: Gunmetal Gothic
2248150.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

2249060.title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
2249060.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

2250230.title: House spirit cat
2250230.short_description: House spirit cat is a visual novel with interactive features. It’s a story about a kind spirit of a house in the shape of a cat who is searching for a new owner. Will it find a new home or a place of despair? You are to choose.

2250460.title: Knightward
2250460.short_description: Build towers to safeguard your crystal while you loot treasure-filled rooms and grow stronger. Knightward is a tower defense action rogue-like for 1-4 players. Will your defenses hold off enemies long enough to discover the deepest levels of the dungeon?

2256340.title: Final Remedy
2256340.short_description: You wake up in an unfamiliar, snowy place. You don't know how you got there or who you are. Solve the mystery, avoid or defeat enemies, and escape... An atmospheric, story-rich, post-apocalyptic walking simulator with puzzle elements and crafting mechanics

2256840.title: Holy Ocean
2256840.short_description: Ride your bike through the ocean of meat, alone or with friends. Raiders on your tail. They built a tower on that head island. Sneak in. Take down their leader. Destroy the whole island if needed. It is all for the love of Rose

2259240.title: DESPA
2259240.short_description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

2262120.title: Merchant Legends: The Founding
2262120.short_description: Build a new town in a Game Boy inspired fantasy world... Gather resources, recruit citizens, trade goods and grow your empire to push back the forces of evil! A love-letter to retro RPGs.

2262630.title: Wish Upon A Llama
2262630.short_description: Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

2263120.title: OutRune
2263120.short_description: A fast-paced, psychedelic room-clearing action game blending mystery and memory. Battle relentless enemies, discover and upgrade powerful items, and help Orillia survive long enough to uncover her past… and ESCAPE!

2265940.title: Evil Dungeon
2265940.short_description: ¡Fight the heroes trying to conquer your dungeon! Choose a class and fight along your comrades to stop invaders, level up, pick up loot, buy upgrades and become the greatest anti-hero

2268520.title: Divided Land
2268520.short_description: Explore a vast medieval world haunted by the undead. Craft gear, build a settlement, farm, and tame animals as you develop your skills. Adventure alone or join other players to reclaim cursed lands, restore life to the wilderness, and defend what you've built.

2269360.title: Unwound
2269360.short_description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

2271240.title: Ape Express
2271240.short_description: A co-op delivery adventure for 1-4 apes. Pile into your battered pickup and haul explosive, ticking and occasionally alive cargo across a wild valley — over mountains, through caves and past things with teeth. No signature required.

2272360.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
2272360.short_description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

2278200.title: Compicactus
2278200.short_description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

2278570.title: Mahalle Kıraathanesi
2278570.short_description: Welcome to the neighbourhood coffeehouse! Play Okey, 101 Okey, Backgammon, Kız Tavlası, Pişti and Yekta with your friends or with regulars who remember you, tease you and hold grudges. Buy a round of tea, put your chips on the table and become the boss of the coffeehouse.

2278950.title: Stars of Icarus
2278950.short_description: From the devs of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. Captain frigates, pilot fighters, and man the guns. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Victory or death, together.

2284660.title: Everything Bites
2284660.short_description: The whole wild wants you gone. Defend the Barnes family farm in a top-down pixel-art horde survivor. Fight off waves of hostile wildlife with pitchforks, shotguns, leaf blowers, and traps. Earn coins, upgrade your arsenal, and keep the harvest alive!

2285020.title: Toxic Frontier
2285020.short_description: The world ended a long time ago. Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within its ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

2286590.title: 反击战
2286590.short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

2288760.title: Night Run EX
2288760.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

2290130.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
2290130.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

2294250.title: Speed Golf Royale
2294250.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

2294620.title: Blood Peace
2294620.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

2295170.title: Emberville
2295170.short_description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

2298250.title: GearGrit
2298250.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

2298890.title: The Forgemage
2298890.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite of rune-forged magic. As a Forgemage, carve runes and chain their power into your spells until they break every law of magic. Walk into the horde alone and unleash what you forged.

2299490.title: Zombie Warz
2299490.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

2299940.title: The Button Effect
2299940.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

2300890.title: Meritaton
2300890.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

2302120.title: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
2302120.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore Infinite procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

2303850.title: Toxic Crusaders
2303850.short_description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville and beyond, one radioactive menace at a time!

2304360.title: Mainland
2304360.short_description: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

2305510.title: Deaded
2305510.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

2306130.title: DOPASPIN
2306130.short_description: Air hockey with a twist! Rotate your paddle to fire pucks that warp across the arena edges, and smash them into your opponent's Core. Match events fill the arena with pucks! Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3-player battle royale, locally, online or against the CPU.

2307020.title: Alien Boom Boom
2307020.short_description: In Alien Boom Boom you will send your enemies flying utilizing a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades. The game features a fully voiced story campaign, several distinct levels, several enemies, bosses and frequent player/weapon upgrades that are customizable at the start of each level.

2309900.title: Shadows Of Deceit
2309900.short_description: Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror game. As Janet prepares to leave Havenbrook, one last visit to the Sheperd Hotel becomes a nightmare. Investigate a friend's death, connect clues through the Mind Palace, confront anomalies, and uncover memories that refuse to stay buried.

2311200.title: Test Cricket Manager
2311200.short_description: Take managerial control of the National cricket team (of your choice) and prepare to take them to Glory! YOU pick and train the players, YOU hire and fire the staff, YOU choose the tactics under pressure, YOU get the glory when things go right ... but YOU take the blame when things go wrong.

2317790.title: Titan: The Ascension
2317790.short_description: Titan: The Ascension is a colony management strategy game on Saturn’s moon Titan. Build and expand an off-world industrial colony, extract ice to produce water for Earth, trade resources, and defend against ancient automated systems that react to technology growth. Will you prevail?

2318300.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
2318300.short_description: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

2321070.title: Dungeons and Tiles
2321070.short_description: An Action Role-Playing dungeon crawler, with randomly generated dungeons and challenging bosses to defeat for loot and glory.

2321200.title: Fire and Brim Co.
2321200.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

2321890.title: Swordeye
2321890.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons. Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks. Master your sword or die trying.

2323500.title: Shattered Souls
2323500.short_description: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who tried to shatter you. Will you try again?

2327110.title: Snap Quest
2327110.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

2327300.title: Machikado Roastery
2327300.short_description: Roast coffee across Japan, right from your taskbar. Run a tiny corner roastery along the bottom of your screen: roast beans, stock the display case, hire staff, and move your shop from Tokyo’s backstreets to snowy Sapporo as the seasons turn.

2330160.title: One More Try
2330160.short_description: Fight your way through the lands of the magical kingdom in this turn-based, roguelike deck builder game. Fight your enemies by combining powerful poker combinations, enhance their effects, endow them with new properties, find magical relics and choose new classes for your hero.

2333410.title: Bullet Maidens
2333410.short_description: Protect a school from demon soldiers. Battle followers of the occult. Discover a chilling revelation that just might lead to doom...or salvation? A turn-based tactical shooter that doesn't rely on luck about Taiwanese schoolgirls saving their refuge in a world at war.

2334600.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
2334600.short_description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

2339000.title: Portabellows
2339000.short_description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

2345030.title: Hexoria
2345030.short_description: Harness the power of magical cards and become a master strategist in Hexoria, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game. Explore a dangerous world, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience. Survive the unknown and lead your cult to glory!

2345290.title: Automatonics
2345290.short_description: Inspired by games like Super Mario and Megaman, in this adventure a little round robot is on a mission to save Earth. Lead your crew into exploring different planets in search of resources, fight enemy robots, collect different power-ups and upgrade your powers, while solving the planets' mysteries.

2345810.title: CRANE GAME QUEST
2345810.short_description: A simulation game that recreates the Japanese crane game experience. Feel the frustration of the arcade right at home. Use a variety of techniques to win prizes. Unlock prizes and stages as you master the crane game.

2345940.title: Lost Lands
2345940.short_description: A minimalistic, chill city builder inspired by Nordic culture and landscape, with mysteries to uncover and a unique world to discover.

2348250.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
2348250.short_description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

2349640.title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
2349640.short_description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

2355020.title: Lost Hellden
2355020.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

2356750.title: Rogue Kingdom
2356750.short_description: Rogue Kingdom is an Online Roguelike with every dungeon persistently simulated! Claim dungeons, settle colonists, and defend!

2359660.title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
2359660.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

2362070.title: Hollow Home
2362070.short_description: A narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. No weapons, no combat, just the choices you make and the people you make them for. Inspired by real events. Made in Ukraine.

2363230.title: 大野逐龙
2363230.short_description: 欢迎游玩这个步步新奇的东方大陆。在这里玩家将扮演一名刀笔吏——萧辰，在天下倾颓、诸侯割据的时代，萧辰背上行囊，游历东南西北，探索山海秘境、见识无数宝物，结识众多神奇有趣的伙伴，当然，也会遭遇强大的敌人……游戏介绍【不一样的东方大世界】狐国、密库、衣锦城、驼母宫、博望馆、龙府、人鱼岛、冰夷渡、古战场、高耳山、北境村庄等等，游历不一样的山川河流、秘境洞窟带来的别样氛围。【沉浸式体验海量剧情】丰富世界观和故事细节，希望能有大量支线填充。领略当地的风土人情，并且完成他们的委托来增加代入感，以及世界观的可信度。同时，游戏文案的整体风格会朝部分写实的方向靠拢，给玩家带真实的体验。

2364230.title: Pandash
2364230.short_description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

2365790.title: Let's Build a Dungeon
2365790.short_description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

2369780.title: Unnatural Worlds
2369780.short_description: Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development. Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape. It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

2373970.title: Indie Game Farmer
2373970.short_description: Grow crops. Fund your game-making dream. Tend your pixel farm, sell the harvest, and upgrade your tools while dividing each day between farming, part-time work, and game development. Turn your first potato into your first release, and build a living from crops and games.

2376260.title: Mariachi Legends
2376260.short_description: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

2376720.title: Shred-A-Bunch!
2376720.short_description: Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.

2379980.title: Ibboran
2379980.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

2385760.title: Tank Arena
2385760.short_description: Tank Arena is a chaotic top-down multiplayer tank shooter built for fast, explosive battles with friends. Jump into the arena, blast each other with shells, and see who survives the longest.

2385970.title: Kardaviik
2385970.short_description: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

2386370.title: Last Life
2386370.short_description: Last Life is a breathtaking adventure game set in NeoNova, a cyberpunk city where high technology and dark secrets intertwine. Our protagonist, a cute cat controlled by players, will embark on a mysterious journey to find their lost lover.

2387740.title: Light of Atlantis
2387740.short_description: Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

2388420.title: Steam Punks
2388420.short_description: inspired by SNES 90's classic like Mega Man X 1-3, Super Metroid & Link to the past, Steam Punks mixes elements from the classics into a lore rich adventure with some modern twists! Unlock items & power-ups and discover secrets & lore!

2388440.title: Battlecore Robots
2388440.short_description: Customize your own mech: Use swords, bombs and all kind of weapons to defeat your oponents in frenetic battles with unique abilities! Play up to 4 players locally or online. Enter the Battlecore arena!

2392010.title: Heat Division: Rescue Team
2392010.short_description: Rescue civilians from natural and man-made disasters in this Speedrunning 2D Platformer. Featuring 4 playable characters: Jack Red, John Blue, Jane Orange & Chief Green

2392900.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator
2392900.short_description: Create and expand your own mechanical keyboard venture as you master the art of maintenance, repairs, and custom builds. With real-life components and realistic hardware, refine your skills, ignite your creativity, and craft a keyboard that truly resonates with you.

2393460.title: City Of Corals
2393460.short_description: Save the coral reef city in this cute tiny adventure game! Meet the colourful residents of this underwater city, explore the streets, befriend different species of fish and help them restore the corals to their former glory!

2393870.title: Whispers of the Luminaries Part 1
2393870.short_description: Uncover the truth behind an idol's disappearance, weeks before her debut. Whispers of the Luminaries is a narrative-driven game that blends a classic detective story with the dark side of the idol entertainment industry.

2394250.title: Rich Dad Simulator
2394250.short_description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

2397360.title: Arctic Unrest
2397360.short_description: Arctic Unrest is an intense experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting & fighting are required to survive. Vehicles & Parkour & Traversal system enable you to explore the vast frigid world. Wishlist it Today. Keep frosty & Keep Alive

2399700.title: 荷莱Horae
2399700.short_description: 或许，这是你见过最自私的故事。

2402470.title: World of Anterra
2402470.short_description: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.

2405640.title: VISK
2405640.short_description: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

2406020.title: Echoes of the Anvil
2406020.short_description: A simulation and management game about a blacksmith exiled for defying an empire. Gather resources, forge tools, pay taxes, and choose between helping the people or serving the power that rules the world.

2408150.title: DreamVision Studio
2408150.short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Its the definitive content creation playground that can be used as a tool.

2411190.title: Card To Conquer
2411190.short_description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

2412540.title: Subway Nomads
2412540.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic metro system. Explore dark tunnels, battle zombies, and build your mobile base. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op. Will you escape to the surface or thrive in the underground?

2413370.title: Tribes of the Ridge
2413370.short_description: Lead your tribe in this side-scrolling colony sim! Grow a humble settlement into a thriving civilization. Survive harsh winters, manage resources, build efficient production chains, unlock new professions, and raise glorious monuments!

2420800.title: Sol Mates
2420800.short_description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

2430980.title: Staircase55: A SCP-087 Story
2430980.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror game that has you exploring a dark deep and paradoxical stairwell. Equipped only with a flashlight, navigate through the this strange staircase and uncover the secrets of the seemingly infinite stairwell, SCP-087.

2431590.title: Starship Crafter
2431590.short_description: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.

2437830.title: The Killing Rooms
2437830.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where hidden odds shape every procedural run. Choose between unknown doors, evade relentless horrors, and survive an endlessly re-playable challenge.

2438630.title: Apocalypse Blitz
2438630.short_description: Be Courageous! Again, Be Courageous! Overwhelming evil is unleashed! Fight against terrible amounts of enemies to free the helpless. Are you brave and strong enough to defeat the Apocalypse Blitz?

2439770.title: PROJECT MIX
2439770.short_description: PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative adventure. Can you find happiness after losing everything you once had?

2444400.title: Patch Zero
2444400.short_description: You are a tiny security agent inside a hacked corporate network. Blast through server rooms infested with worms, botnets, trojans and ransomware, pick upgrades, and reach the Core Server in this fast top-down roguelite.

2444850.title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
2444850.short_description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

2445200.title: Cards n' Varmints
2445200.short_description: Cowboy lizard roguelike with jobs, cards, and creature management. Build a ragtag team of varmints from over 50 weird jobs such as Gunslinger, Cactus, and Hotel Manager. Your team is your deck: think hard and play cards before each round to turn the tide of battle!

2445410.title: Checkmate MAGIC
2445410.short_description: Lead your King into tactical 6v6 battles alongside five loyal companions. Recruit allies, customize Runes and Gambits, forge powerful gear, and unleash coordinated attacks to deliver CHECKMATE. Defeat seven rival Kings, collect their relics, and unlock the mysterious Corrupted Gate.

2447480.title: Dungeon Raiders
2447480.short_description: Dungeon Raiders is a roguelike dungeon crawler game with cards to acquire and loot to find! Make your way through perilous dungeons, battle monsters with cards, outfit your raiders with the best gear and sell any extra loot you find in your customizable shop for profit!

2451050.title: Maid In Wonderland
2451050.short_description: Your fate, your duty, your suffering / love.

2451080.title: Geometry TD
2451080.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

2451390.title: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned
2451390.short_description: Create and lead a team of four investigators in this action RPG set below Jazz Age New England.

2454280.title: Hundred Battle
2454280.short_description: Grow like a roguelike, draft your party like an auto-battler, command like an RTS — a semi-auto-battler roguelike of a hundred battles.

2455930.title: SwingHard VR
2455930.short_description: Dodge with real footwork against challenging bosses. Move your arms as fast as you can to do damage. Swing hard, move often, you'll need to exercise your mind and body to win in this boss rush dark fantasy VR action game. Git Gud, Git fit, Workout guaranteed.

2465230.title: Crafted Legends
2465230.short_description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

2471710.title: Dragon Jump
2471710.short_description: One button, one dragon, one desire. Finish every level as fast as you can to regain your human body. Practice, build or cheat using machine learning. In Dragon Jump everything is permitted.

2476610.title: Summoner Arise!
2476610.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined world. Run out and you lose. With 300+ upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

2478710.title: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
2478710.short_description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

2480840.title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
2480840.short_description: Collect items, craft weapons and defeat your opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

2481190.title: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
2481190.short_description: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

2481240.title: HavenCraft
2481240.short_description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

2482110.title: Rogue Mech
2482110.short_description: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

2483270.title: Bubbits
2483270.short_description: Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter! Beat 24 other players in battle royale, play VS mode with friends or go on a singleplayer adventure. Bubbits is packed with cute customization, explosive power ups and crazy battle events to shake up the game!

2483660.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
2483660.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

2484890.title: Deeper Still
2484890.short_description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

2490390.title: Choking Hazard
2490390.short_description: Build giant toy sets with up to 3 friends, online or split-screen. One enormous pop-up manual, no adult supervision. Argue over step 8 together, or take it slow on your own. Finish a set and watch it spring to life. In Creative mode, build your own sets and share them on the Workshop.

2496330.title: Tremble of Towers
2496330.short_description: Co-op tower defense for 1-4 players where you fight alongside your towers! Build any structure from any mineral: ice slows, magma burns, lead extends range. Mix traits into countless combos and hold the Golden Vein across ever-changing, randomly generated maps.

2500500.title: Survival Of Runt
2500500.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

2500690.title: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
2500690.short_description: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.

2505230.title: Dreadwinter
2505230.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

2507690.title: Thalassophobia
2507690.short_description: Thalassophobia is a 4-player co-op horror diving game set in the crushing darkness of the deep ocean. Complete high-risk objectives and uncover long-forgotten secrets. The further you descend, the less safe you are.

2511430.title: The Mirror Dimension
2511430.short_description: The Mirror Dimension is a co-op psychological thriller and horror game for 1 to 4 players. Players investigate paranormal activities, solve mysteries across dimensions, and eliminate spiritual entities to find problems. Are you ready to explore different dimensions?

2512880.title: CrisisX
2512880.short_description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world

2513150.title: Archi Vista
2513150.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

2513200.title: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
2513200.short_description: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

2513270.title: UvsU: You vs You
2513270.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

2514420.title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
2514420.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

2515480.title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
2515480.short_description: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character via thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the dev, had growing up.

2516650.title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
2516650.short_description: On a small, snowy skerry somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, where he is or why he is there. A point-and-click mystery where atmosphere and unusual puzzles are at the heart of the game.

2519750.title: Pulp Friction
2519750.short_description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

2520780.title: Net Raiders
2520780.short_description: Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

2520840.title: Cluck Up!
2520840.short_description: Climb from a farm all the way to the moon, where one missed jump can undo it all. Dodge lava floors, leap between skyscrapers, ride rockets through space, then storm Clawrence's castle. Grab the stolen eggs and try not to fall. Play solo or with 4 friends.

2526190.title: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
2526190.short_description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

2527940.title: Little Cheese Works
2527940.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

2531840.title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
2531840.short_description: You're a seagull. The island is your playground. Everyone on it is your problem to solve, bother, or befriend. Explore freely, solve things your way, mess with everything, and create absurd moments worth sharing.

2533700.title: Love, in Debt!?
2533700.short_description: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
developers: 华东理工大学创客空间

2536140.title: Red Dust Colony
2536140.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

2537270.title: 4:AM
2537270.short_description: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. Aila must avoid detection and find their way to a new future in a world ravaged by the Yellow. 4:AM is a dystopian cinematic puzzle adventure where you rely on nanobots to duplicate objects and find unique solutions.

2537910.title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
2537910.short_description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

2541560.title: ARCHETYPE BLUE
2541560.short_description: Archetype Blue is a JRPG-style role-playing game that blends the fun of building your party and planning strategies with an engaging story. Mix and match companions with unique abilities and personalities to form your own party and enjoy the thrill of strategic battles!

2541770.title: Ether@Net
2541770.short_description: Become a Netwalker — a paranormal investigator navigating between the haunted streets of Hong Kong and a digital ghost realm. Uncover urban tragedies, forge a bond with your ghost companion, and unravel the truth that lingers beyond the Net.

2541950.title: Sirens
2541950.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

2544040.title: Starfire Skies
2544040.short_description: Your fireworks are your cards in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Launch fireworks now or save them for the finale to keep your audience of animals entertained. Open card and talisman packs, discover unique shops and events, and earn your stars so you can put on an unforgettable show!

2544730.title: Gateworlds
2544730.short_description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods.

2547010.title: Mik
2547010.short_description: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

2554980.title: Last Warrior Arena
2554980.short_description: Build your warrior. Outsmart your next opponent. Last Warrior Arena is a 1v1 roguelike auto-battler where equipment, skills, and enemy choices shape every run. Combine elemental powers, discover powerful builds, and take on deadly bosses as your warrior fights automatically.

2558290.title: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge
2558290.short_description: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge is a cozy little medieval clicker with a big appetite. You're a blacksmith pulling legendary swords from stones, handing them to knights, and stacking gold higher and higher

2560470.title: Apostle of Mustard
2560470.short_description: A difficult 3d precision platformer. Hop, skip, and skid your way across an eerie purgatory. Thread though a rage inducing gauntlet of platforms while unraveling a mustard flavored mystery. Will you make it home, or will you be stuck forever?

2562710.title: LEVEL UP YOUR BODY
2562710.short_description: LUYB - Hit or Box objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Dance to the Rhythm and Elevate in a virtual world.

2563780.title: Rift Saviours
2563780.short_description: Rift Saviours is a sword-fighting roguelite where you battle endless waves of enemies. Survive longer to earn upgrades that offer great build customization. Step into the rift and fight for your survival!

2569020.title: Centuries
2569020.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

2571610.title: Vitrified
2571610.short_description: Team up with ALAN the robot in this atmospheric post-nuclear metroidvania. Explore and fight your way through a beautiful but deadly post-nuclear wasteland, upgrade ALAN with abilities that unlock new areas, and uncover the secrets of The Worm.

2572590.title: Underground Nomads
2572590.short_description: You command a drilling train, leading a dwarf clan through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade gear, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and bring your people back home.

2576700.title: Starry-巡星之旅
2576700.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

2577730.title: Golel
2577730.short_description: Immerse yourself in the disturbing world of a first-person, Dungeon Crawler, Golel. Leverage the environment to your advantage, drop a bookshelf on an enemy, or kick them into a pit. Golel brings innovation to turn-based combat.

2580040.title: Code5erpent
2580040.short_description: The game where numbers are a weapon. On a simulated Earth, add, multiply, or combine the numbers which comprise the matrix's code, and take advantage of a rich equipment system of weapons and scrolls in order to come up with devastating combos to annihilate your enemies.

2580160.title: Angry Mother Earth
2580160.short_description: Angry Mother Earth offers a one-of-a-kind strategy experience within an fully simulated world. Wield and merge a variety of abilities to release cataclysmic forces—ranging from hurricanes and earthquakes to blizzards—upon the world of humans. But be warned: humanity won't go down without a fight!

2582710.title: Mikene's Aspects
2582710.short_description: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

2583700.title: Lucky Dog Rise
2583700.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

2585900.title: Gap Year
2585900.short_description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

2587210.title: SHUNYA
2587210.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

2587940.title: Photophore - Chapter 1
2587940.short_description: An arcade game that oscillates between shooting, brick-breaking and reflection... with a single projectile!

2588770.title: Ninkyo Dantai
2588770.short_description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

2590240.title: METRO 2039
2590240.short_description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

2591700.title: SetPoint Volleyball
2591700.short_description: Build your athlete and hit the sand! SetPoint Volleyball blends arcade beach volleyball with competitive matches online or on the same couch. Serve, spike, block, challenge your friends and climb the ranked ladder. Just watch out for the seagulls.

2593060.title: Witches' Grove
2593060.short_description: Pick a fighter, train them up and send them into the Grand Rumpus! Buy techniques and potions between rounds, weather a witch's wild spells and race through the Grove Games. Twelve quirky fighters, countless builds, one Champion's Wish. How far can you take them?

2594620.title: Figure Drawing Garden
2594620.short_description: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

2597090.title: Gravity well
2597090.short_description: Explore vast galaxies through gravity wells and realistic physics. Launch and combine celestial bodies to uncover mysterious stories hidden in space. Race friends and players worldwide for the top spot, or slow down and enjoy a tranquil deep-space atmosphere beneath the stars.

2600820.title: The Journey Home
2600820.short_description: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.

2603630.title: Foederatus
2603630.short_description: In this kingdom management RPG, you assume your father’s throne in Dalmatia to lead the kingdom, build alliances, fight rivalries and hear the pleas of your people. On the brink of change, you will define the political order. By your decisions, the future of Dalmatia is in your hands.

2603850.title: Shadow Mate
2603850.short_description: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.

2605970.title: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
2605970.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

2606690.title: Protocol Non-Human
2606690.short_description: A realistic first-person horror deduction game. Identify NON-HUMAN entities and navigate critical decisions within the Zone. Earn your survival, upgrade your booth, and-above all-don't let the NON-HUMANS in.

2607680.title: Illegourmet
2607680.short_description: From underground kitchen to culinary empire. Cook and distribute illegal food across a city obsessed with healthy eating. Expand your network of kitchens, automate production, and take over the black market for flavor.

2616540.title: Croak
2616540.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

2616750.title: Witchhammer
2616750.short_description: Face relentless hordes of enemies and overthrow the Inquisition in our gripping real-time deckbuilding roguelike. Harness the magic of your tarot deck to shape your destiny and avenge your fate. The future lies in the cards, witch!

2620450.title: Highreach
2620450.short_description: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

2621770.title: Hexrite
2621770.short_description: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

2628810.title: Instar Ecdysis: Protocol Limos
2628810.short_description: Protocol Limos is a tense psychological survival-horror game in which your cat is your only anomaly detector. As a homeless woman searching for food in a militarized school, you must rely on stealth, resource management, and absolute silence. But be careful, something in the darkness is watching you.

2628880.title: Blood & Chaos
2628880.short_description: Ancient sacrifices saved the world, but their legacy is unraveling. A party based roguelike inspired by classic '80s RPGs, where every descent into cursed dungeons carries permanent consequences.

2630930.title: World War 2 Agenda
2630930.short_description: An old-style PC game to honor the British, American and Russian soldiers who fought and defeated the Nazi Socialist party. Go behind enemy lines and destroy the Nazi Globalist agenda during World War 2.

2631180.title: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG
2631180.short_description: This Place at the End is a tactical, turn-based RPG about moving forward at the end of the world. 30 in-game days, 30 real-time hours, and 12 ways to reach the end.

2634870.title: Hazard Protocol
2634870.short_description: Race the horde in a 1–4 player top-down co-op horror shooter. Complete objectives, improvise with scarce supplies, rescue downed teammates, and reach extraction through tense 10–30 minute missions whose pressure adapts to your squad.

2635310.title: Skele TONS
2635310.short_description: A short incremental realtime tactics game about stopping a massive skeleton army.

2635320.title: Crime: 1997
2635320.short_description: Newport, 1997. Waterside gang member Henry Gallagher is thrust into a lethal spiral after a failed deal. Trapped between a police crackdown and the Sorvino Mafia, Henry must navigate a city ignited by "Pulse"—a volatile new drug turning every street into a warzone.

2636240.title: PocoDoro
2636240.short_description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Hatch a squishy slime, then poke it, stretch it and toss it around. Feed it, play with it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It lives in real time, and how you raise it shapes who it becomes.

2645730.title: Death By Misstep
2645730.short_description: The robots can hear you breathe. Match your breathing to the music, stay out of sight and find a way off the Samos, a luxury cruise turned into a massacre. First-person horror and stealth where every breath can give you away.

2645990.title: 999 Seconds! Survivors
2645990.short_description: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 300+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

2646170.title: My Arms Are Longer Now
2646170.short_description: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

2648650.title: Music of Destiny: Corrupted Dungeons
2648650.short_description: An ancient evil descends, and you will join the Crimson Knights to save the world! In this Roguelite game, assemble a team of knights and monsters, explore dungeons, collect gear, build defenses, and defeat dungeon monsters!

2648940.title: Beyond the Curtains
2648940.short_description: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.

2651780.title: Frontier Ferris For Adventurers
2651780.short_description: This is a stage-based, real-time battle action game with survival elements. You can gather resources and craft equipment and food. Defeating the boss of each stage unlocks new stages. Let’s continue to develop the frontier of Felis.

2652120.title: 驱邪师
2652120.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, complete specific tasks, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

2657180.title: Who Wants To Be King?!
2657180.short_description: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

2657960.title: Spada
2657960.short_description: Enter the arena in Spada, a brutal gladiator combat game where every strike counts. Master fast reflexes and rhythm-based button sequences, survive with deteriorating armor, and win the crowd to claim your freedom. Precision, timing, and courage are your only weapons, any mistake could be fatal.

2659410.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
2659410.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

2659460.title: Blood of Rome
2659460.short_description: Lead a Roman legion through enemy hordes in a survivors-like where every level-up adds a new soldier. Evolve your troops, strengthen your general, and build an unstoppable army. Conquer for Rome.

2659880.title: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)
2659880.short_description: A classic nostalgic side scroll game！
developers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室
publishers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室

2660600.title: Hellmet: Seven Circles Down
2660600.short_description: Your helmet is your weapon. Plunge through the seven circles of hell, swap cursed Hellmets for absurd new powers, headbutt demons into paste, and shred the hordes with bullets and blades. A boss guards every circle on the way down to the Ultimate Lord of the Underworld.

2661880.title: T-Ghoul :: Dorobou Yameta Youkei Poppu!
2661880.short_description: A mischievous Thai ghoul trades haunting for farming in this 2D isometric horror-comedy. Steal, sell, or raise chickens, avoid shamans, and decide your fate in a ghost-filled village. Survive, thrive… or devour.

2661960.title: Ginger Snap: Islands of Rot
2661960.short_description: Two games in one! GingerSnap: an action platformer with a unique ability combination system. YMIR: a non-linear puzzle platformer with collectable upgrades.

2662550.title: Roam
2662550.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

2668410.title: Feed Your T-Rex: Desktop Companion
2668410.short_description: A tiny T-Rex lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Feed it rabbits, chickens and other critters. Once it's big enough, you can even feed it... humans! Decorate its Containment, keep it happy, and when it dies, use its DNA to breed an even better one.

2668600.title: Escape from the Collector
2668600.short_description: "Escape from the Collector" is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

2669030.title: Phenomena Embattled
2669030.short_description: From the far reaching void of space. To the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. Pilot your alien trans-medium craft through aerial battles, underground caverns and deep sea trenches.

2669710.title: Tearoom of Terror
