2669710.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

2671300.title: Trailblazers: Into the March
2671300.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

2673600.title: DeskTrack
2673600.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

2674550.title: Electric Alps
2674550.short_description: You are an electrician, moving back to your hometown in the Austrian Alps, which you find lacks a certain... spark. Promptly tasked with wiring up the village, you solve electrical puzzles, blow fuses and master real-world circuitry techniques. Electrify the Alps, one circuit at a time.

2676290.title: Heroes Of Isekai
2676290.short_description: An auto-battler with roguelike elements, and no unit cap. Run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes, assemble your build — then crush your enemies!

2679840.title: Neon Auto Party
2679840.short_description: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its deck of cards that determines its performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

2680770.title: ForMind
2680770.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

2682200.title: Trope Tales
2682200.short_description: A somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs. Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist, as you venture across the world to defeat the Main Villains with the help of your friends: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend.

2686570.title: Waltz and Jam
2686570.short_description: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

2686820.title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
2686820.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

2691090.title: 14:  Overmind
2691090.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

2691410.title: Gossip & Potions: Tales from the Witch Shop
2691410.short_description: Gossip & Potions is a potion-brewing and gossip-listening simulator about a witch named Owi, the small town she just moved to, and the very specific potions its very specific inhabitants need. Help them. Or don't. Watch what happens.

2691780.title: Reports from Vera Cruz
2691780.short_description: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

2692420.title: Idlescape
2692420.short_description: Idlescape is an MMORPG combining idle mechanics with RPG elements. Progress continues offline, allowing mastery of skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. Engage in crafting, gathering, and strategic battles. Perfect for casual and hardcore gamers alike.

2692660.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
2692660.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

2697050.title: Project Polygon
2697050.short_description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

2697210.title: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls
2697210.short_description: Crime never rests... but thankfully, neither does Detective Bass! Put on your detective hat and help Detective Bass get to the bottom of a robbery, in this witty, narrative-driven detective game!

2698220.title: Dungeon Man
2698220.short_description: A bullet-hell dungeon game where you use colored gems to match the enemy in order to deal damage. Each enemy type has a unique attack style. Shoot and Dodge as you search for the evil toilet snake which lies deep within the dungeon.

2699570.title: Ooga
2699570.short_description: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

2702430.title: Usual June
2702430.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

2702850.title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
2702850.short_description: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

2703140.title: Whispers of the sands
2703140.short_description: Listen to the whispers of the sands in this meditative journey. Seek the light of the desert and confront its shadow in meditation. Uncover echoes of lost souls as you survive a boundless sea of dunes.

2704840.title: Poetry in Purgatory
2704840.short_description: After dying under mysterious circumstances, Isobel awakens in the afterlife... with a dangerous mission. Explore a strange world of mystery, character and heart as you uncover Purgatory's secrets in Poetry in Purgatory, the first part of The Dead Poetry Trilogy of visual novels.

2705270.title: Stuck with Bob
2705270.short_description: Kidnapped & trapped in a basement. Escape by drawing 7 JOKERS from 40 cards. Grind coins from jokers to buy upgrades, earn more per flip, speed up shuffles, and remove bad cards until victory is guaranteed.

2706360.title: Where The Weather Takes You
2706360.short_description: Elliot Thunder embarks on an adventure of self-discovery and exploration. Travel between towns, explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and use your weather-related powers to help those in need.

2706660.title: Dragon survival
2706660.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

2708920.title: Haunted House
2708920.short_description: You wake up in an eerie mansion, beside the one you love. To take her home, you face six lost souls — not enemies, but tragedies to understand. Each room hides a love never spoken. But when you think you've finally escaped, some truths only appear once you walk out the door.

2710920.title: Aeterna Lucis
2710920.short_description: Aeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet and the sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Become the Queen of Light, explore a vast, hand-drawn interconnected world, awaken new powers and face epic bosses to stop the Supreme God Chaos.

2711020.title: Long Trip
2711020.short_description: Long Trip is a dark fantasy VR action RPG where you explore the shattered lands aboard the skyship The Dust, battle bosses, ride legendary mounts, summon allies, and uncover ancient secrets across a world scarred by war.

2711710.title: Zero Hero
2711710.short_description: Zero Hero is a fast, endless roguelike shooter. Jump through a broken timeline, stack wild weapon upgrades, and survive waves of monsters and bosses. Bank your loot or risk it all. A free demo is available now — wishlist the full game on Steam!

2712390.title: One More Tower
2712390.short_description: This is a horde survival tower defense, I hope you'll like it! Expand the board, build towers, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive? >:3

2713380.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
2713380.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

2715880.title: Farmer's Diary
2715880.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

2716830.title: Don't Fret
2716830.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

2719670.title: The Milgram Experiment
2719670.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

2719810.title: Summit Smash
2719810.short_description: Drop your opponents in the narrowing upward field, watch out for traps and overcome challenging obstacles to come first!

2720780.title: Artemis VR
2720780.short_description: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

2721190.title: VariVaRevenge
2721190.short_description: Dodge or parry the bullets, and attack the enemy directly! This is a new type of game that adds 2D action elements to a bullet-hell game!

2721200.title: ジグソーローグ
2721200.short_description: A deck-building roguelite where jigsaw puzzle pieces are your weapons. Master the "placement" and "combination" of pieces with unique abilities to claim victory. The game system is simpler than it looks — easy to pick up and play.

2721360.title: Dark Laws
2721360.short_description: Dark Laws is a medieval fantasy extraction looter with melee, ranged, and spell-based combat. Choose one of 9 mercenaries, mount a dragon alone or with a friend, and survive the brutality of enemies on Telos Island.

2721440.title: Hyper Fin
2721440.short_description: Hyper Fin is a High-Speed Arena Fighter where you Out-Maneuver your enemies and Bash into their weak points.

2722220.title: VERY IMPORTANT NEEDS
2722220.short_description: A chaotic heist game about characters with needs that are a little too “important,” repeatedly breaking into the same neighbors’ buildings and grabbing anything valuable. One goal: leave only walls and doors behind. (Walls optional.)

2723370.title: Voiceless
2723370.short_description: Voiceless is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Go live from a mysterious mansion, complete viewer challenges, and gain subscribers. Team up with your friends or sabotage them - choose your own path to popularity.

2725630.title: Segment In Space 1985
2725630.short_description: Segment In Space 1985 is a psychological horror game about a person who finds themselves in Milotropia — a strange space made of fractured reality. Using the Second Sight and various consoles, dive into a long journey driven by one goal: to return home.

2726410.title: Ruins of the Forgotten:  A Wild Survival
2726410.short_description: Discover an open-world survival game that divides animals into two factions. While crafting, building, and taming animals, explore the forgotten ruins. Do whatever it takes to last another night and solve the mystery surrounding animal factions.

2727430.title: Kiosk Simulator
2727430.short_description: Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed, comedic take on the hustle of running a big-city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.

2730940.title: MyRummy® 2
2730940.short_description: The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

2731030.title: Dungeon Automata
2731030.short_description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

2732480.title: Emery Hearts
2732480.short_description: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

2736170.title: Glowfall
2736170.short_description: Glowfall is a co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Head into an abandoned laboratory, fight off failed experiments, grab what loot you can and make it out alive — then sell your haul, gear up and go back in.

2738170.title: Edge of Memories
2738170.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

2739560.title: Dungeons and Diners
2739560.short_description: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

2741050.title: Star of Games
2741050.short_description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

2742920.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
2742920.short_description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

2744110.title: VTumbler
2744110.short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in an unparalleled free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting spectacle in VTumbler!

2748420.title: Ascent: Rivals
2748420.short_description: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

2751070.title: Paleokin
2751070.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

2751560.title: Decurion
2751560.short_description: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

2755260.title: Dome RPG
2755260.short_description: A boy named Taro once woke up in a mysterious world. Why is he here and how will he get out? Experience this world in Dome RPG and follow a text based prequel story in Dome Zero!

2755690.title: Zero Distance
2755690.short_description: Fight overwhelming zombie hordes in a 3D bullet heaven where packing your case shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, gear and supplies to unleash fire, lightning and explosive combinations. Survive 20 minutes, defeat the boss and earn your extraction.

2755950.title: Tidebound
2755950.short_description: Chill, catch, sell, upgrade! Tidebound is a fishing game with a relaxing, cozy atmosphere where you upgrade your boat, and sail further to fish for more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

2758190.title: Our Freedom: Medieval Village
2758190.short_description: Our Freedom is A Medieval Colony Sim with Action RPG Adventures. Build a village, lead your people, produce food and materials, forge powerful weapons, recruit an army to protect your village in epic battles and castle sieges. Stand up for your people and help them defend their freedom!

2761020.title: A Little Less Desperation
2761020.short_description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

2761360.title: Hi Sudoku
2761360.short_description: Sudoku should be pure logic—never guessing. Solve 10,000+ fair puzzles across five difficulties. Stuck? Step-by-step hints show the next move and why it works, so you can spot it yourself next time. Play comfortably with mouse, keyboard, or controller in calm themes.

2763250.title: Unconventional Fantasy
2763250.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

2763980.title: MEMORYLEAK™
2763980.short_description: Immerse yourself in MEMORYLEAK, a unique FPS that blends 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay. Set in 2000s Texas with a gripping narrative, it offers stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a dynamic, interactive world. Ready for an adventure that redefines gaming?

2764530.title: Purble Place 3D
2764530.short_description: This is Purble Place 3D! - three exciting adventures in an updated classic! Create and win, just like in the good old days!

2765070.title: Iron Dawn
2765070.short_description: Pilot devastating war machines as a mercenary in an tactical mech shooter. Choose your contract, customize your loadout, deploy into fully destructible battlefields, and extract with your earnings. Get paid, upgrade your arsenal, and take on increasingly dangerous missions.

2765870.title: My Paper Plane Is Better
2765870.short_description: Throw a paper plane into a city built for flight. Every run you finish becomes a track, and other players race your ghost on it. Skim rooftops, thread alleys, pop balloons and chase the longest glide.

2766120.title: Can't See Shift
2766120.short_description: Mate. Three of you drive ONE van. The one steering can't see a thing, one's on the pedals, one's on the gears. The rest jump out with an axe, a winch and dynamite. 1-4 online co-op, every map generated from scratch. Just get the cake to the wedding. Good luck.

2766140.title: Notoris 2: Warlords
2766140.short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer. Wield influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles. Inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

2767860.title: FPS Pro Team Manager
2767860.short_description: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

2769570.title: Fable
2769570.short_description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

2771260.title: Wishbound
2771260.short_description: An ancient djinn has awakened but some bonds are stronger than magic! Help Erika and her friends face the supernatural together in this story-driven turn-based RPG. Explore the city, customise your party and uncover mysteries. Every moment brings you closer to saving the city - and each other.

2771710.title: INFINITE CHUMP
2771710.short_description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

2772700.title: OrbGuard
2772700.short_description: Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?

2773770.title: BURN IT ALL DOWN
2773770.short_description: Sneak around and BURN IT ALL DOWN! Use everything at your disposal to target key political figures and structures as you fight to free the people of New London from the oppressive grip of the Puppet Master in this Orwellian-inspired VR immersive sim.

2776440.title: Sliced
2776440.short_description: "Sliced" is an exhilarating PvP game where players engage in deadly combat, wielding axes and spears to strategically dismember opponents in a fierce arena. Master the lethal art of combat in this relentless, blood-soaked death fest.

2777100.title: GALLANT: Arena of the Alchemist
2777100.short_description: GALLANT is a multiplayer platform shooter for 2-10 players. Throw vials, draw cards between rounds, and adapt your strategy as your powers evolve. When skill meets luck across the many arenas, only one can claim the title of Grand Alchemist of Fortune!

2779740.title: Head Chef
2779740.short_description: Head Chef is a restaurant management game. Supply the kitchen, select your staff, overcome challenges, create a delicious menu and… cook! Make your guests happy and find your way to the stars. Keep control of your team and finances, because the higher you climb, the harder you fall.

2780230.title: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK
2780230.short_description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

2780750.title: Limbival
2780750.short_description: One moment you're under a guillotine, the next you've lost every limb. The crowd wants a show. You want to survive. Rip the limbs off circus monsters, attach them to yourself, master them, and clear wave after wave to escape the circus.

2781120.title: Temporal Distortion
2781120.short_description: Triple Triad on a hex board, at a lamplit table. Place a pebble, then turn it to strike: the higher number takes the lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Eight Distortion cards, four worlds, and a stranger across the table who knows whose story this is.

2783240.title: Warlondor
2783240.short_description: Build five heroes your way. Make your tank a healer if you wish, and combine their abilities into powerful party synergies. Every action takes time, but combat pauses for each decision. Time interrupts, bursts, and combos. Adapt to risky routes and run-changing affixes

2783280.title: Cat Secretary
2783280.short_description: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

2783440.title: 4D Builder
2783440.short_description: A spatial puzzle game about building, folding and exploring shapes in four dimensions. Start with familiar 3D ideas, then tackle gradually more mind-bending 4D challenges involving construction, folding and colouring - or experiment freely in the sandbox.

2784210.title: 100 Cats Greece
2784210.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all? 😺

2784280.title: 100 Cats Pakistan
2784280.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all? 😺

2784520.title: 100 Cats Argentina
2784520.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all? 😺

2784780.title: Hop'n & Bop'n
2784780.short_description: Dive into a rhythmic adventure in this dynamic 3D platformer! Navigate over 30 levels filled with challenging obstacles that trigger in sync with the music. Run, jump, slide, and slam your way through, uncovering secrets and grabbing collectibles in a uniquely musical experience.

2786760.title: Another Door
2786760.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

2787860.title: Mythical Whalers
2787860.short_description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

2791230.title: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise
2791230.short_description: 《異麒麟：初入江湖》是一款以東漢末年為背景的高自由度武俠 CRPG。 你將扮演一位與妹妹相依為命的流民少年，在黃巾之亂尚未爆發的邊境安身立命。從一無所有開始，學武、謀生、遊歷城鎮與荒野，結交形形色色的江湖人物，也在一次次對話、事件、檢定與抉擇中，決定自己要如何在這個時代活下去！

2791260.title: Iron Inc.
2791260.short_description: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.

2791600.title: Becut - An Impostor Game
2791600.short_description: Dive into this social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Collaborate to prepare the ogre's feast and identify the traitors hiding among you. Your sense of direction and memory will be key assets to avoid getting lost in this randomly generated castle.

2791780.title: Helios Horizon
2791780.short_description: Annihilate endless hordes of aliens in this action-packed sci-fi rogue-lite. Acquire a variety of firearms and upgrade your equipment to fulfill your mission.

2791900.title: Foul
2791900.short_description: Foul is an adventure survival game where an otherworldly fog mutated and turned all creatures hostile. Fight back, save your family and piece together the truth.

2792390.title: Nukes on the Loose
2792390.short_description: Compete with up to 5 other players to see who can avoid getting blown up by the hidden dirty bombs in this thrilling card game. Play secrets, veto cards, cruise missiles and a lot more. Only 1 player can survive and save their city!

2793330.title: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?
2793330.short_description: How many cockroaches can you kill before your stamina runs out? Before the Queen crawls out? Before the whole city is infested? Squash 50 roach species, grab the coins, upgrade, unlock bombs, lightning, meteors and a giant slipper, and find out in this fast incremental clicker.

2794500.title: Combo Haven
2794500.short_description: Combo Haven is a platform fighter inspired single-player game where your only task is to perform the sickest combos possible. Progress through a variety of levels and compete for high scores. Uncover new mechanics, abilities and characters along the way.

2795110.title: Petal Runner
2795110.short_description: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

2797290.title: Ten Ten
2797290.short_description: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

2797320.title: Shadow Breakers
2797320.short_description: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

2797430.title: Celestial Seekers
2797430.short_description: Defend your base from relentless enemy hordes—solo or with friends! Discover unique planets, uncover the mystery of your mission, and unlock powerful items to help you survive.

2797850.title: The Indoors
2797850.short_description: Days after your daughter vanishes, an anonymous note says she’s trapped in an abandoned indoor playground. You break in. It’s dark, rotten, silent. As you search the ruins, something watches you. You’re not alone and it knows you’re there.

2798580.title: Lord Skeleton
2798580.short_description: Night lies upon history. Beneath your blows the stone gives way, the towers fall, and the flames die in the dust. Then comes the silence of the last light quenched, and the vast shadow of the one who kept watch over the ruins.

2799050.title: Mourning Tide
2799050.short_description: A guilt-ridden fisherman sails into forbidden waters. With every catch, the echoes of his life rise to the surface. Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide. A fishing horror game.

2799820.title: FSA DRIVING
2799820.short_description: Delivery, trading, racing—showcase your superb driving skills in Nijnait City, modeled after Tianjin. Customize your vehicle, drift through corners, perform stunt drives, and glide over the city with a wingsuit. Explore streets, uncover the fastest routes, and save precious time for your clients.

2801310.title: Eight Legs, Seven Nights
2801310.short_description: Aunt Margit hasn't read your messages in nine days. At her house, a note asks you to look after her thirteen spiders for a week. You are terrified of spiders. Then the snow closes the roads. Feed them, mist them, keep them alive, and get through seven nights in a house that isn't empty.

2802730.title: Frieda is Changing
2802730.short_description: A fun-horror point & click adventure following Frieda, a 14-year-old girl, determined to uncover the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Explore an expansive village, solve puzzles, unlock memories, and discover monsters where you least expect them.

2806790.title: Fungiman 2
2806790.short_description: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

2809450.title: Headwaters
2809450.short_description: A short fishing game early in development :-). Collect fish population samples for WDOE as you rebuild a once great public transportation network with the help of your new REALLY REALLY cool bird friends. Also unlock a bunch of new areas, fishing rods and upgrades!

2809970.title: XenoTechArena
2809970.short_description: Don’t defeat your enemies—make them collide! A roguelike arena shooter where up to 10,000 enemies swarm you. Blast them into each other to trigger chain reactions and wipe out hordes! Fuse classes, combine 100+ power-ups, and build your ultimate warrior with endless possibilities!

2810080.title: Unearther
2810080.short_description: Explore a handcrafted-procedural world where discoveries and challenging adventures await. Gather resources, craft equipment, build your home, survive dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

2818060.title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
2818060.short_description: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a terrifying story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

2818410.title: Factory Tower
2818410.short_description: Factory Tower is an isometric sci-fi puzzle game inspired by Sokoban. Guide a robot courier through the abandoned towers of the TERRA complex, move cargo, operate machinery, and plan every move carefully.

2818630.title: Trucker Joe 2
2818630.short_description: Transport various goods to companies with your truck! Expand your fleet with trucks and trailers to keep the industry running. In this mix of simulation and strategy, you decide where companies are built—plan wisely, shorten your routes, and dominate the logistics market!

2819880.title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
2819880.short_description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

2820270.title: Weeny Wise
2820270.short_description: A Co-Op Adventure, Puzzle-Platformer game. Embark on your adventure with your companion in the magical world of Weeny Wise.Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass to solve puzzles together, cross platforms, and stand against creatures enchanted by Ragna.

2820730.title: Space Combat Simulator
2820730.short_description: Fly as a fighter pilot of the Coalition carrier Defiance, pick your ship and weapons in the hangar and take apart enemy capital ships piece by piece. Two story campaigns with 30 missions, free battles, split-screen and LAN duels.

2822360.title: RoadHouse Manager
2822360.short_description: How did you get here? The forgetting fog, & an unreal roadhouse lost in it. You're serving customers, over endless nights -- until hyperspace broke down & it all starting warping. Now you phase through strange realities as you serve beer, craft cocktails, & battle shapes from the fifth dimension!

2822770.title: Dead Faces
2822770.short_description: Dead Faces is a mind bending psychological horror. Unravel Jack's disturbing mind, the faces from his past and the ultimate truth behind his actions. You must remember their faces.

2823560.title: Orkendale: The Scarred Land
2823560.short_description: Orkendale: The Scarred Land is an open-world role-playing game in which the fate of an entire continent is in your hands. Whether the orcs will be able to take over the continent or humanity will defeat them will depend only on your decisions...

2825570.title: TinkerTale: Diorama Maker
2825570.short_description: TinkerTale: Diorama Maker is an easy to use sandbox toy that lets you build any world in VR. Choose from thousands of objects and create your own world.

2826170.title: Whispering Eclipsia
2826170.short_description: A first-person psychological horror detective thriller. Play as Inspector Keshav, investigate a mysterious murder, interrogate suspects, uncover disturbing evidence, and confront the terrifying secrets hidden within Woods Lane. But beware—some truths are better left buried.

2828020.title: Citystate Metropolis
2828020.short_description: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.

2833880.title: Antidote city hall
2833880.short_description: A noir pixel-art adventure where you explore the city, engage in dialogues with choices and skill checks, face tough moral decisions, and shape the story’s outcome.

2834510.title: Poop with Friends
2834510.short_description: Poop with friends is a desktop pet. Typing, pressing buttons or any input will cause a bowel movement. These inputs give you points which you can use to customize your stall with stickers, patterns and colors. Hang out with friends. play mini-games and support each other!

2834630.title: Unyverse
2834630.short_description: Unyverse is an Afrofuturistic RPG With Fighting Game Mechanics Where Your Fists, Choices, and Inner Power Change the Fate of a Galaxy.

2834990.title: CIRCLE = CIRCLE
2834990.short_description: "CIRCLE = CIRCLE" is a simulation adventure game where you participate in a doujinshi sale event. Have fun selling books, drawing in your sketchbook, and talking with unique characters.

2835130.title: 在りし日のわたし達へ
2835130.short_description: A juvenile visual novel leaving proof that we truly lived. Collect ancient relics known as "Traces" and update your journal to unravel hidden emotions and the mysteries of the world. A dream-chasing girl's fateful step forward—one that ultimately leads to a cruel destiny with a steep price.

2835350.title: No Gasoline
2835350.short_description: Carry an Atom Bomb for the Union! Build your vehicle and battle your way to the Mountain of Basil. Scavenge for parts, solve puzzles, and deliver the last hope of the labor bots!

2836510.title: Warfare Ultimatum
2836510.short_description: Modern FPS/RTS hybrid, Large-scale battles from the depth of the sea all the way to space! Either play the standard 64-player non-stop battle using Air/Land/Sea vehicles or drop in a thriller, long game of Diplomacy Warfare, experience sabotage, betrayal, war crime, organized operations and more

2838180.title: Wukong Survivors ：God Slayer
2838180.short_description: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.

2839020.title: Rebirth x Reverse Mana
2839020.short_description: Card Board RPG like "Soulmaster". The story of a boy and a girl newly enrolled in a magick school, who get involved in and confront incidents that occur in the world of sorcerers. With the help of the spirits of the four elements and mana, they fight monsters and the same sorcerers and grow up.

2839370.title: Story in the Dream World 1 -Volcano And Possession- Remake
2839370.short_description: hello! I'm South Korean, One Man Game Creator Nuriverse! This game series is made up of many traditional stories from East Asia.(Mainly the Korean Peninsula.) Thank you for stopping by!

2842310.title: Among Us Story: On Guard
2842310.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

2846390.title: Glitch Gears
2846390.short_description: In Glitch Gears, dodge, boost, and outmaneuver in a driving experience inspired by old-school arcade games, with fresh mechanics from auto shooters. Stay ahead of relentless pursuers and master endless, traffic-filled roads in this high-speed battle for freedom.

2846470.title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
2846470.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

2847820.title: Elderwood Online
2847820.short_description: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

2849490.title: Outward 2
2849490.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

2849750.title: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR
2849750.short_description: A top-down destruction roguelite. Bring down every building on your grudge list and turn the living town against itself: gas stations and propane tanks take out the vigilantes, police and soldiers sent to stop you. Between runs, build and customize your Killdozer with new armor, guns and mounts.

2850600.title: Mystical Tactics
2850600.short_description: Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.

2850760.title: Ring Craft
2850760.short_description: In "Ring Craft," you will play as a ring forging master, using various materials to add useful or useless attributes to the rings. You will explore the secrets of nutrition, oop, I mean, enchantment. Whether it's miracles-craft or disaster-craft, it's all up to you!

2852140.title: Dumb Ways to Party
2852140.short_description: The world’s dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

2852700.title: BUS: Bro u Survived
2852700.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

2853260.title: Randomly Jerk Simulator
2853260.short_description: "Randomly Jerk Simulator" is a roguelite simulation game that uses a slot machine to simulate the parasitic behavior of a jerk who relies on his parents. This game does not contain any gambling behavior or cash transactions.

2853880.title: The Lords' Game
2853880.short_description: Conquer a continent with your deck. The Lords’ Game is a turn-based strategy game with fully animated battlefield combat. Raise armies, break enemy morale, and rule through warfare, diplomacy, and subterfuge. Play solo, face friends in hotseat, or join an online campaign with up to eight players.

2854510.title: The Walls
2854510.short_description: A story of escape filled with nightmares, trapped within a simulation universe that is reality itself. Markus, dragged into a deep psychological pit by the pain of losing his family, finds himself confronting his nightmares in this simulation universe.

2857780.title: Moeblade Formula
2857780.short_description: Moeblade Formula is a turn-based tactical game. Command a cast of distinctive units and battle across multi-level terrain with elevation differences. Combine weapons and positioning to unleash stylish combos, defeat powerful enemies, and claim rich rewards.

2861080.title: Haunted Paws
2861080.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

2861120.title: Bonville Bandit
2861120.short_description: A pixel-art stealth game. During the night roam the neighbourhood and steal from houses, be careful to not get caught by the guards or other security measures. When the sun rises, live the village life and get ready for the next night.

2862160.title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
2862160.short_description: 8 Player Online Co-op. Summoned by a magical tree to free the villagers and root out the evil wizard from the shifting fortress. Fight through crypts, fire, swamp, earth and air dungeons, loot gear and gain skills. Challenge bosses, rescue allies, take the wizard down.

2866010.title: Paschalis TD
2866010.short_description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

2866900.title: Into Oblivion
2866900.short_description: Into Oblivion is an immerse interactive novel where your choices shape the story. Set in the far-future, explore a galaxy on the brink of crisis with dynamic companions. So, settle your mind and pray you have what it takes to fly Into Oblivion.

2867340.title: Nonu
2867340.short_description: Nonu is a hand-drawn 2D souls-like where every action draws from two interlinked resources-one born from inner strength, the other granted by a higher power. Explore a dying world, uncover artifacts that enable distinct builds, and piece together the truth behind its vanished god.

2867800.title: DEPERSON
2867800.short_description: Aaron wakes up in a nation where obedience is survival. As reality bleeds into a surreal nightmare, he isn’t just running from a regime. He is fleeing something far worse. Unravel Aaron's fate. Confront yourself.

2870790.title: Dumpster Gang
2870790.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

2873070.title: Endless Tactics
2873070.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

2873610.title: Hope Timbre
2873610.short_description: Guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day. In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments and solve puzzles to find various hope instruments. Later, use them to summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

2876030.title: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots
2876030.short_description: Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR! There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

2885160.title: The Sea Is Broken
2885160.short_description: Sail a cursed, ever-changing sea in this pirate roguelite for 1–4 players. Explore islands, grab loot, upgrade your ship, and battle bizarre enemies. Work together to steer, fire cannons, and patch holes. Someone should probably grab a bucket.

2887970.title: Lagrange Front
2887970.short_description: Lagrange Front is a team-based sci-fi FPS. Fight on foot, in zero gravity and in vehicles for a moving hill, haul a payload into the enemy flagship, or storm a ground map with tanks and walkers. Up to 48 players per match, with AI bots filling empty slots.

2889030.title: MUDANG: Two Hearts
2889030.short_description: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

2889710.title: The Fate of Onexora
2889710.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich fantasy RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Follow the adventures of four heroes who have been unwittingly drawn into an impending catastrophe for which they are held responsible.

2890930.title: Luminleaf Chronicles
2890930.short_description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is a local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that combines elements of survival, adventure, and roguelike genres. Acquire items, upgrade your skills, and defeat the continuously appearing bosses to survive tooth and nail in the game world, ultimately face the Skeleton King!

2896600.title: Candy Hollow
2896600.short_description: One more treat before bed? A candy hunt in your bedroom leads to a dark factory. Solve hands-on puzzles, hide from the Candy Man, and choose what goes in the mixer in this first-person retro horror game.

2902770.title: 赝作 心灵推演 Others
2902770.short_description: 这是真冬工作室开发制作的第一部AVG游戏。你将在徽市的校园中，与各位少女邂逅，体验青春恋爱喜剧，并随着日常生活中的种种事件，逐渐探寻出这个世界最真实的一面。

2905720.title: Sapphobos
2905720.short_description: Sapphobos is a mystery and horror VR game. Explore, find clues, make deductions, choose the right conclusions, and maybe you will understand what happened to your missing colleague...

2905730.title: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet
2905730.short_description: Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite. Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them. Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score. Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

2914000.title: Jumplife
2914000.short_description: Jumplife is a minimalistic platformer with lots of wall jumping and wall sliding.

2915770.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
2915770.short_description: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.

2916700.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
2916700.short_description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

2918070.title: A Tale of Sand and Bone
2918070.short_description: A Tale of Sand and Bone is a roguelike action platformer full of goofy characters and big bosses. Fight, dash and climb through an Egyptian fantasy world that changes every run.

2918660.title: Agama versus Bugs
2918660.short_description: Meet a constantly hungry bearded dragon. In pursuit of her next meal, she must watch out for various traps and obstacles lurking throughout the terrarium. Who will win this adventure? The ever-hungry lizard or the crunchy bugs?

2921480.title: Sheeple
2921480.short_description: Cast cards to turn the tides of the battlefield, gather your army, and fight to regain The Original Sheep! Sheeple is a grand real time Auto battler with roguelike and deck-building elements.

2921670.title: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
2921670.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

2923810.title: Among Shadows
2923810.short_description: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and social deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. As the Blood Moon rises, can you uncover the traitors and escape before it’s too late?

2925420.title: Fleshinsane
2925420.short_description: Fleshinsane is a narrative-driven, top-down biopunk roguelike shooter set inside a living, decaying spaceship. Kill, die, upgrade, repeat. Will you survive long enough to escape the flesh?

2930030.title: Oath of the Necromancer
2930030.short_description: Raise the bones of the fallen and create an army of the undead - warriors, archers, mages, monsters & beasts. Take revenge on the old tyrant, build a sanctuary, and resurrect ancient heroes to aid in your battle. All in the name of the Greek-Egyptian God of life & death: Serapis.

2932260.title: Trine 6: Together in Time
2932260.short_description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

2932470.title: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !
2932470.short_description: Embark on this Point and Click Visual Novel about horse riding in search of unicorns, while taking care of your equine friend.

2932650.title: CrossPieces Arena
2932650.short_description: Arrange chess, shogi, and other pieces into your own starting formation in this turn-based board tactics game. Capture the enemy Royal to win. Test your setup against the CPU, play two-player matches on the same PC, or face friends and other players online.

2932720.title: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
2932720.short_description: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest is a classic point-and-click adventure packed with humor, puzzles, and unforgettable characters. It’s the sequel to Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest — and things are about to get heavenly chaotic.

2938980.title: Unfriendly Friend
2938980.short_description: Go on an adventure with your friends to the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital and uncover its secrets. Can you save your friends or at least save yourself from the horror that awaits?

2939170.title: Galactic Disharmony
2939170.short_description: A Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode. Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.

2939450.title: Inherited Shadows
2939450.short_description: Amanda, a young woman haunted by her mother's absence, travels to the remote mining town of Cinder Hollow in search of answers, unaware that a sinister legacy awaits her. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mysteries surrounding her past.

2939680.title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
2939680.short_description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

2941280.title: 遥岸灯海
2941280.short_description: 出身术士名门却没有天赋的人类少女，在机缘巧合之下得到了和城内最强大的猫妖签订契约的机会。直到某个期限——灯海节——到来前，她都为了成为出色的术士而不断努力。尽管她身边的猫妖，似乎并不理解她的心愿。

2941450.title: Steal Deal
2941450.short_description: Embark on a journey across a dying world in a 2D top-down action roguelike—solo or in 2–4 player co-op! Traverse randomly generated levels, upgrade your arsenal, and collect Divine Deals that can grant you immense power or lead to your downfall.

2943230.title: Ocean in the Cold Sky
2943230.short_description: You can manually parry attacks, fly a little with your meagre wings, and die instantly.

2946570.title: Rise of the Bugs
2946570.short_description: RISE OF THE BUGS is a 2D pixel art adventure game about annoying bugs. Lead a colony in search of new food, discover the secrets of mutation and escape from the angry men on the kitchen. Will you be able to steal the mysterious sauce or you die crushed under a slipper?

2946800.title: Proverbial
2946800.short_description: Hire a team of monkeys and start typing. It's time to find out if the old thought experiment is right. Given enough monkeys and upgrades can you find every word? Manage your monkeys, purchase upgrades, items, and abilities, and start filling your collections to become the best.

2947710.title: DuckTape Inc.
2947710.short_description: Night shift for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. In 1-5 player co-op, keep an offshore oil rig and a polar research station running: tape pipes, hunt hacked drones, drill ice and reach the helicopter before the thing in the dark finds you. The pilot waits for no one.

2949940.title: Panic In Store !
2949940.short_description: You play a supermarket employee who must (in each level and within a given time) put the right boxes in the right departments. But be careful! Customers will come after you to waste your time!

2950490.title: Byte Survivor
2950490.short_description: Bank balance: ¥0. Shut-in gamer El, lured by her pet robot Puruya, picks up a shady part-time job inside a video game. A tinker-heavy survivors-like: runs of about 10 minutes, simple controls, screen-melting hordes. Earn, build, and uncover more of the story with every run.

2951440.title: Retro Rail: Japan!
2951440.short_description: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

2952600.title: Uphill
2952600.short_description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

2952740.title: Mercenarian
2952740.short_description: In a world inhabited by monsters, seek out stronger weapons and skillstones to snatch your enemies’ abilities. Spit poison like a spider, slash through relentless foes, and level up to face stronger creatures. Sharpen your weapons, choose how you fight, and live the life of a Mercenary.

2953070.title: Star Child
2953070.short_description: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

2954380.title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
2954380.short_description: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

2954590.title: Musgro Farm
2954590.short_description: Start a farming empire in this incremental factory builder. Plant crops, combine them into recipes, and distribute them for sale. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing automated farm.

2957600.title: Rules of War
2957600.short_description: Take command in this 4X-lite strategy game with fast-paced tactical combat and missile warfare. Build your economy, deploy land, sea, and air units, expand borders, advance technology, and navigate deceitful diplomacy. In a world of collapsing nuclear powers, can you lead your nation to victory?

2957840.title: Sleepy Cat
2957840.short_description: Who says cats are just for show? Cute can be deadly! A Roguelite ARPG featuring Day/Night cycles, Elemental counters, Skill learning, and Magic evolution—all in a fresh, vibrant art style! Become Laila the "Sleepy Cat" and uncover the vast, mysterious lore behind the Seven Valleys.

2958550.title: Deeper
2958550.short_description: Your mission is to recover lost and forgotten artifacts. Set out with your crew on underwater expeditions ever more hostile, ever darker, ever deeper...

2959460.title: Matelotes
2959460.short_description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

2960250.title: Tempus Triad
2960250.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

2960750.title: Skylark 64
2960750.short_description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

2960950.title: Choose Cthulhu Files: The Call of Cthulhu
2960950.short_description: What if the choices you make during your investigation awaken ancient beings older than existence itself. Explore the official Choose Cthulhu gamebook adaptation, every decision you take seals the fate of mankind. Will the creeping madness consume you as you uncover the darkest secrets?

2961120.title: Shop Crush
2961120.short_description: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

2962240.title: Galactic Tavern
2962240.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as you build and manage your space tavern! Craft unique cocktails, and create a bustling atmosphere with live music performances. Explore the depths of space and become the ultimate entrepreneur in this management simulation adventure!

2963950.title: Persona 4 Revival
2963950.short_description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

2965060.title: 万剑之残破修仙界
2965060.short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

2965300.title: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D
2965300.short_description: This HD-2D role-playing game pays tribute to the beloved Three Kingdoms RPGs of the classic console era. Follow the journey of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang as you recruit legendary heroes, travel across ancient China, and experience a grand tale of war, loyalty, and ambition.

2965560.title: Alpha Spectrum
2965560.short_description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where humanity is dangerously dependent on technology and social media. You are a CIA agent with psionic powers sent to investigate a devastating cyberattack that throws the world into chaos. But the system you trust may crack from within...

2967600.title: Sakagura Life
2967600.short_description: In a quiet town nestled among rice paddies, you’ve bought an old sake brewery for a bargain. Craft premium sake, build friendships with locals and friendly Yokai, and battle hostile spirits while solving puzzles in this unique blend of life sim, adventure, and brewing.

2967610.title: Nova Dawn: Overload
2967610.short_description: Take up arms and take care of robot buddies in this co-op action roguelite. Hunt giant hostile robots that have stolen the sun to harvest their mechanical parts, upgrade the machinery you can build and strengthen the bond between you and your Nova robot buddies!

2967710.title: Game Designer Simulator
2967710.short_description: Game Designer Simulator is a pixel game based on real-life themes, with a non-linear storyline and card battles. Players will take on the role of a newly graduated college student in a fictional city based on Shanghai, experiencing everything from interviews to becoming a novice game Designer.

2968000.title: House Of Slendrina Remake
2968000.short_description: House of Slendrina is a spine-chilling first-person psychological horror game where danger lurks in every dark corner. You find yourself trapped inside an ancient, decaying family residence but you are far from alone.

2968230.title: RUN Gor I
2968230.short_description: Are you capable of mastering your own body? Do you know what you need to eat? Move and build the protein your body needs before you run out of time. Face your dreams and obtain the necessary nutrients, avoid the monsters, and run. You are not alone.

2970990.title: Dark & Quispy
2970990.short_description: A Fantasy Rogue-Like game with Paper thin graphics. Cut through waves of enemies and collect their souls to increase your power! Encounter a variety of enemies and events as you make your way through the DARK.

2971430.title: Echo of Prypiat
2971430.short_description: "Echo of Prypiat" is an exciting walking simulator that immerses the player in the atmosphere of the Chernobyl exclusion zone, conveying all the horrors and fears of people left in this forgotten land. The game is created to allow the player to feel the soul of this mysterious place.

2971520.title: Venusville
2971520.short_description: Guide pioneering settlers among Venusian clouds in this space colonisation city builder. Grow food, collect energy, mine resources, balance buoyancy and weight to stay afloat in the treacherous Venusian atmosphere, and build a self-sufficient colony while navigating storms and acidic clouds.

2973000.title: ZRAGG
2973000.short_description: Defend your home planet from hordes of creatures in this retro styled roguelite!

2974040.title: Glintland
2974040.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

2974100.title: CPA:Reports Bousy
2974100.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

2974540.title: Night Machine
2974540.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

2975130.title: ULTRA MUSHROOM
2975130.short_description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and ultra mushrooms that bring joy!

2975260.title: PRISON OF HUSKS
2975260.short_description: Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. In this nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife, explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Battle lovelorn bosses and seek your lost love.

2975680.title: Revelation of Decay
2975680.short_description: Revelation of Decay is a zombie survival game that’s less “scary” and even a bit lively. Explore this pixelated world full of bizarre anomalies, awaken supernatural powers, and, amid endless zombie hordes and mutated monsters, gradually uncover the truth behind the invasion.

2976080.title: Fantasy Knight
2976080.short_description: A rouge RPG, action and sword fighting game. Use special moves, special powers and magic to defeat all monsters and creatures waiting for you down the road.

2979810.title: POLYARIS
2979810.short_description: A first-person Arctic survival game where the cold is deadlier than any enemy. Explore on skis and by boat, scavenge supplies, fight to survive, manage your warmth, food and water, uncover the secrets of the desolate North, and find your way home.

2980770.title: Necro Factory
2980770.short_description: Necro Factory is an exhilarating, stress-relieving idle game focused on mass troop spawning. On this perilous continent, you will gradually build your very own skeleton army.
developers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.

2981290.title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
2981290.short_description: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

2982920.title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
2982920.short_description: Dive into the first-person horror of Nightmare in the Old Mansion and follow John, a real estate agent called to inspect an old mansion. Amid dark corridors and hidden secrets, you must make crucial choices to escape alive.

2984800.title: Double Whammy
2984800.short_description: Run a guitar shop by day. Smash monsters by night. 🎸

2985970.title: Brain Hack Squad
2985970.short_description: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

2987920.title: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator
2987920.short_description: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator is an advanced and realistic sim with physics-based flight, analog video, kamikaze strikes, grenade drops, heavy bombers, night vision and thermal. Fly with keyboard, gamepad or your own EdgeTX/OpenTX radio: RadioMaster, Jumper, BetaFPV and more.

2988120.title: Never Be Alone
2988120.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

2994190.title: Money Simulator
2994190.short_description: Hustle to the top through jobs, deliveries, street races, gambling, and risky crypto plays. Buy, upgrade, and flip cars and motorcycles for profit. Build your empire by launching businesses, managing operations, and hiring staff. Take bold risks, make big moves, and rise!

2996650.title: True Vikings
2996650.short_description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

3001460.title: 九州之士
3001460.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

3003760.title: Come to my party!
3003760.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

3005440.title: FESTERED
3005440.short_description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

3005720.title: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum
3005720.short_description: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum is a puzzle-based escape room. Solve puzzles and discover the stories of your ancestors in the books you have inherited.

3009250.title: Garden Apocalypse
3009250.short_description: Once a thriving alien world, now a vast desert—devoured by the relentless Swarm. These towering insect invaders have left only scattered oases and buried ruins. Grow food, craft powerful resources, and uncover lost secrets to push back against the tide and restore balance to a dying world.

3010150.title: BLOODY HELL 2
3010150.short_description: Pulverize demons as a small angelic birb wielding a giant demonic hammer. Explore hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth behind the fall of heaven in this bullet-hell metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

3010530.title: True Crime Engine
3010530.short_description: Investigate cases solo or with friends. Search the web, trace digital leads, examine documents and recordings, and piece together evidence on a shared board. Compare theories, uncover what happened, and discover new cases through Steam Workshop or create your own.

3010870.title: Match Tree
3010870.short_description: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

3014640.title: Ariadne's Tale
3014640.short_description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

3014660.title: NO FURTHER ACTIONS
3014660.short_description: You have been assigned as an operator, reading protocols that force you to make decisions using buttons and switches. Every decision shapes your fate — and decides whether you’ve done what was expected of you.

3015820.title: To Kill a God
3015820.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

3018390.title: PSYCHO DEAD
3018390.short_description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

3018460.title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
3018460.short_description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

3018500.title: Broken Shell
3018500.short_description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words.

3018990.title: Eversiege
3018990.short_description: Eversiege is a roguelike, tower defense in which you'll defend a castle in procedurally generated terrain. Establish a production, build defending buildings and survive waves of enemies coming from everywhere! After defeat, buy new buildings, unlock new leaders and prepare to fight again.

3019020.title: Unseen Beings
3019020.short_description: Unseen Beings is a short survival horror game where you avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

3021550.title: Flock Off!
3021550.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

3021700.title: Astrostrike
3021700.short_description: You are the captain of the Galactic battleship, building hundreds of gun turrets, raising dozens of space fighters, establishing aircraft carrier groups, space stations, and conquering the entire Milky Way

3022470.title: Rotten Sails
3022470.short_description: A co-op horror about looting cursed islands for a cartel that won't go ashore itself. 1–4 players, in-game proximity chat, no weapons.

3031890.title: Acts of Blood
3031890.short_description: Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in Acts of Blood, a gritty and fast-paced third-person brawler with brutal combo chains and blood-soaked revenge.

3034170.title: Daimyo Reign
3034170.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

3039130.title: Rogue Wheels
3039130.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

3039960.title: Near The Sun
3039960.short_description: Near The Sun is a 2D action-adventure game where you slice through enemy lines with sharp dashes and race across a collapsing underworld. Experience a story that changes depending on the order you explore, and discover a way to save a girl from a long-lost "previous world."

3042270.title: Alex's Sketchbook World
3042270.short_description: The RPG where you fight enemies by drawing and coloring them.

3047000.title: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator
3047000.short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

3050090.title: Thalassomania
3050090.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew. Haul, gut, steer and repair while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

3052540.title: Chemist Wanted
3052540.short_description: Run a cosy chemistry lab on a sleepy space station. Identify mystery samples with real flame tests and fizzing acids, grow glowing crystals on your windowsill at night, and find out why the last chemist vanished. No timers, no fail states: just you, A.L.F.E. and a shelf of dusty jars.

3053470.title: MR. RECORDS
3053470.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

3053490.title: Bomber Hero
3053490.short_description: BomberHero is a thrilling multiplayer game inspired by Bomberman. Up to 4 players can join online battles or play against bots. Customize your hero, collect power-ups, and dominate diverse arenas. Are you ready for explosive fun? Join the action on Steam!

3053530.title: Coming Home, Little Oak
3053530.short_description: As a little oak, your life was turned upside down when you were kidnapped from your village and family by giant robots. Survive, overcome the challenges, and find your way back home!

3055110.title: Light Dude
3055110.short_description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

3055150.title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
3055150.short_description: EARTH is mutated and destroyed. You are a R.E.A.P.E.R, one of the lucky humans tasked with preparing earth for the return of humanity! Collect valuable loot and S.C.I.E.N.C.E! Travel from the REAPER space station to the infested, ancient ruins of EARTH with your fellow REAPERS.

3057720.title: Adventure Paws
3057720.short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

3058500.title: Cucumber
3058500.short_description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.

3058660.title: HARK THE GHOUL
3058660.short_description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

3058740.title: Odds Chronicles
3058740.short_description: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.

3058960.title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
3058960.short_description: Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times. It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

3059730.title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
3059730.short_description: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

3060390.title: Aetherian Chronicles
