3060390.short_description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

3063680.title: Battle of Arachnidia
3063680.short_description: Battle of Arachnidia is a fast-paced top-down shooter in which you fight back against hordes of arachnid robots. Protect your base by destroying all enemies by coming up with different tactics, improving your robot and using different help bonuses.

3065070.title: Touhou Rumble Banquet
3065070.short_description: Touhou Rumble Banquet is an unofficial Touhou Project platform fighter for up to 4 players. Choose from 11 fighters from the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, play locally or against CPUs, or go one-on-one online with rollback netcode.

3065710.title: Lucky Coin Pusher
3065710.short_description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

3071390.title: Bladesmith Shop Simulator
3071390.short_description: Rule the anvil! Harness magic-infused ores brimming with otherworldly effects to forge legendary weapons. Stock a thriving smithy, scour wild lands for epic loot, and outsmith fierce rivals in grand tournaments to crown yourself the continent's ultimate bladesmith tycoon!

3071860.title: WARAG
3071860.short_description: A modernized old-school boomer shooter with progression, upgrades and a gory combat system. Fight in a dark Byzantine-Gothic setting, gain experience, power up your weapons, build your playstyle and become a true Varangian berserker.

3074390.title: Built By Force
3074390.short_description: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

3075360.title: PhotonVERSE 2
3075360.short_description: Guide a single photon of light through 70 hand-crafted stages across 7 neon worlds. Bounce, dash, flip gravity and shift between dimensions in a precision platformer that's easy to learn and hard to master, with free updates bringing new worlds, skins and modes.

3078800.title: MMORPG Merchant Simulator
3078800.short_description: Travel back to 2008—the year where it all began—with nothing but a dismantling machine. Break down crystals, brew potions, run your stall, hunt bargains, stockpile goods, and trade the markets. Climb from your parents' basement all the way to a villa and a sports car.

3079730.title: Cartomancy
3079730.short_description: Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be. This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

3082530.title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
3082530.short_description: Lux Leonarii is a Puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

3082730.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
3082730.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

3082910.title: Classified Chaos
3082910.short_description: Classified Chaos is a multiplayer horror, action title, where you fight through creatures of various sizes, and danger. Use whatever equipment you can to fight, defend, run, or die for your team so someone gets out alive.

3084190.title: Golfadillo
3084190.short_description: Hurl yourself across vast landscapes filled with coins and obstacles in this action incremental game! Upgrade your skills and unlock abilities so you can travel even further and reach blazing speeds!

3084630.title: Program Penguin
3084630.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

3084700.title: Whispers Of The Shadow
3084700.short_description: After a report comes in about Detective Grace Lawson’s missing stepsister, Amy, two officers head to an abandoned house. When Grace arrives, she finds one of them dead and suddenly becomes trapped inside. But something else is waiting for her.

3086590.title: Gods, Death & Reapers
3086590.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

3091040.title: Haul Yeah!
3091040.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

3094870.title: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
3094870.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

3097220.title: Gray Planet
3097220.short_description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

3097640.title: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
3097640.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

3097860.title: 约会普拉斯 Date Plus
3097860.short_description: A game born from memes, featuring the “World’s Richest Person” sending you $50, a chaotic skewer vendor, and a quirky dog-shaped backpack. Dive into a whimsical yet heartfelt dating adventure full of unexpected twists and pure hilarity!

3098420.title: INSTALLATION 19
3098420.short_description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

3099830.title: Darkest Darkness
3099830.short_description: Darkest Darkness is a roguelike deck-building game with extraction elements. Choose your identity and venture into a Lovecraftian town. Craft every card yourself—collect materials, build powerful cards, plan your route, or extract with your gathered materials to gain an edge in your next run.

3101840.title: Weiß Schwarz Online
3101840.short_description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world’s No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

3102950.title: Library of Meialia
3102950.short_description: To uncover the secrets of Aethium Magic in the Library of Meialia, you’ve set out to prove your worth. Faced with doubts, pursuing forces, and sealed monsters, this journey is fraught with danger... Collect books, gather weapons, and explore the grand library alongside a diverse array of companions.

3104780.title: Spaceborne Fighters
3104780.short_description: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

3106270.title: HELLCARD II
3106270.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

3108030.title: Man in the Mocha
3108030.short_description: An active incremental game where you own a coffee shop, but your hidden agenda is to hack the customers who connect to your WiFi. Buy upgrades and grow your business!

3109590.title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
3109590.short_description: Run your very own cat cafe! Lead your cats on adventures into a magical city, gather ingredients to cook scrumptious dishes, customize your dream cafe, and bring bliss to your loyal customers in this cozy management lifesim. 🐱

3113330.title: Space Cleaners
3113330.short_description: You and your friends are building a space cleaning business. Navigate filthy and hostile space stations, clean everything up and work hard for your reputation.

3113350.title: Bloodsmith
3113350.short_description: A fierce, action-packed narrative RPG; Play as Quentin Ashborne, the archaeologist whose duty has brought him to fight tooth and nail against the damned souls. If you are to survive, you must learn to manage & manipulate blood. Ride the downward spiral.

3113400.title: Cosminomy
3113400.short_description: The colorful universe of Cosminomy offers unique colony building challenges on nice little planets. Form thriving settlements, develop them step by step, turn a profit, and expand your colony across the cosmos.

3113670.title: The Barkeeper
3113670.short_description: Swap the espresso machine for a cocktail shaker! Mix, shake and serve drinks against the clock, master new recipes in bars across the city and keep your customers happy - solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op. One wrong ingredient and it's straight in the trash!

3113690.title: Ship Miner
3113690.short_description: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

3114100.title: Cardinal Descent
3114100.short_description: Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

3114420.title: UNCRACKED
3114420.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

3114690.title: Broken & Loved
3114690.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

3116860.title: Wire Throne
3116860.short_description: Upgrade your ride and unleash devastating firepower to take down Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

3118050.title: Meteorder
3118050.short_description: Meteors are falling from the sky. Hurry up, your objective is to eliminate them by aligning same-colored blocks and launching them upward. Meteorder is an exciting tile-matching puzzle game where you can compete against opponents, explore various planets, and enjoy the beats.

3119690.title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
3119690.short_description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

3119710.title: Impious
3119710.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

3119830.title: Chaos Bringer
3119830.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

3121420.title: Monolith: Dark Matter
3121420.short_description: A round-based co-op FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living dark matter. Fight escalating waves of its zombie marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and find out how long your squad can last.

3122680.title: Night of the Living Toys
3122680.short_description: A cozy co-op toy sorting game. Play with three friends or solo. Two modes to choose from: dig through a huge pile of toys or open boxes and complete sets. Fill every shelf before the store opens and keep its secret!

3123420.title: 领航员计划 Navigator Project
3123420.short_description: A twin-stick bullet hell roguelite with anime-style Navigators to meet and evolve. Dodge barrages, combine weapons and upgrades, chart branching routes, and take on massive bosses. Unlock new Navigator forms and discover their stories.

3125140.title: Answer Campus: First Semester
3125140.short_description: Answer Campus: First Semester is a comic book style narrative adventure about identity, belonging, and the moments that define us. Make your way through the first semester of college as you make new connections, experience high stakes encounters, and settle in to your new life.

3125430.title: HyperTyper 2000
3125430.short_description: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell roguelike where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand on half the keyboard and dodge with the other hand.

3129330.title: Blood Dice
3129330.short_description: Roll or hold dice to get patterns and reach blood quotas. Modify dice, buy items and sign some suspicious pacts to escape. Craft your build, and test it against the odds or lose it all.

3129900.title: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
3129900.short_description: Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. It is a self-contained story about fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane as reality itself begins to fracture.

3129950.title: Wayfarer Of Hydrangea
3129950.short_description: 一名离职原画师，驾驶着豪车的网约车司机江芊华；外表单纯可爱，自称辣妹可爱却粘人，为了追上芊华不顾一切的少女南绣玉。围绕着VTB“紫阳”，一个美丽动人，正如盛放的绣球花般的恋爱故事即将展开。以视觉小说方式呈现的多个结局，描绘极致的百合恋爱，欢迎来到热烈的7月——

3130220.title: Sagas of Lumin
3130220.short_description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

3130880.title: Solaria
3130880.short_description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

3131260.title: Whimpact!
3131260.short_description: Collect, care for, and adventure alongside your Whims, who grant you incredible powers. Then dive into the fast-paced, cooperative arena to find and reclaim the world’s missing Starcane energy.

3131340.title: Lelu
3131340.short_description: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

3133250.title: Desk Fantasy
3133250.short_description: Desk Fantasy is an anime idle companion that lives in a transparent window on your desktop. While you work, Noa auto-battles mischievous yokai on a tropical island. Grow her on a 75-node Evolution Grid, roll dice in a 10-chapter visual novel and find one of 4 endings.

3133530.title: Ser Chub's Adventure
3133530.short_description: Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? A fantasy, sci-fi action-adventure game the likes of which is rarely seen. The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun!

3133600.title: Worlds Explorers
3133600.short_description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

3136000.title: They Are Rising
3136000.short_description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

3136340.title: Echoes Below
3136340.short_description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

3137010.title: Meat Engine
3137010.short_description: Meat Engine is a Sci-Fi boomer shooter inspired by Scorn, Quake, Dusk and Doom. The game is set in a dark and distant future stricken with war and death. Featuring fast and brutal retro combat.

3138010.title: Realms at War
3138010.short_description: A chess-inspired fantasy tactics game where every move matters. Command armies, outthink your opponent, and experience the depth of wargaming with the clarity of chess.

3139120.title: THREE VERSES³
3139120.short_description: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

3139290.title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
3139290.short_description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

3139450.title: Echoes of Taihang
3139450.short_description: Run a gunsmith's workshop in a survivor camp hidden in the Taihang Mountains. Open supply crates, assemble and enhance weapons, fulfill commissions, and search the ruins for resources. A good gun can earn your keep or help bring you home.

3140060.title: FALSE SPIDER
3140060.short_description: The web woven by spiders is only for waiting for prey to bite.

3140190.title: God, Save the Queens!
3140190.short_description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

3140580.title: Escape From Streamer House
3140580.short_description: Trapped inside a dangerous streamer's house, you must find his computer, delete a compromising private video, and escape before he catches you. Hide, solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and survive a terrifying game of cat and mouse.

3140710.title: Trellis
3140710.short_description: TRELLIS is a puzzle/adventure game featuring Fig, a robot caretaker tending to its plant. Shine the Spotlight to guide Fig and solve dozens of unique puzzles, uncovering the mysteries of an ancient alien temple long forgotten… but not abandoned.

3144810.title: Forbidden brew
3144810.short_description: Run a tavern in a dystopian city where magic is illegal. Serve ordinary customers by day, sell forbidden potions in secret, identify informants, hide the evidence and survive government raids.

3150710.title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス
3150710.short_description: “There’s no escaping a nightmare that never ends.” When the protagonist wakes up, a young girl stands before him. She introduces herself as “Entropy (entourfe), the Management Support Android.” Spreading out before the protagonist is a confined underground facility.

3153100.title: Melt Away
3153100.short_description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

3155170.title: One with the Unicycleverse
3155170.short_description: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

3155670.title: ユメザメの仮説
3155670.short_description: 『ユメザメの仮説』はあなたの力で過去を変える、マルチエンディング形式の恋愛アドベンチャーゲームです。 恋人とのデートをやり直し、振られてしまう未来を変えましょう。 デートの内容によっては恋人以外の女性との可能性も。 全てはあなたの”行動”次第。
developers: さめさめサメーション
publishers: さめさめサメーション

3156050.title: Special Case
3156050.short_description: Fight the Occupation Forces with Unique Super Powers! Destroy Helicopters, Drones, and Armored Vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

3157670.title: Office Aberrations
3157670.short_description: Office Aberrations is a first-person, spot-the-difference game set in a looping hallway. Study your surroundings for changes ranging from subtle to silly. The search area grows as you progress, testing your memory and attention. Knowing whether anything has changed is your only way through.

3161250.title: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢
3161250.short_description: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell. KNOCK, AND THEY WILL ANSWER.

3161310.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
3161310.short_description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

3164360.title: Age of Respair
3164360.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

3165740.title: Minato
3165740.short_description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

3167000.title: Bread & Bravery
3167000.short_description: Return to the era of knights and castles in a uniquely satisfying mix of Settlement Building, RTS and Castle Simulation genres. Manage complex and realistic medieval production chains, build your army and defences, satisfy the King and lead your people to prosperity. Will you succeed as a new lord?

3168210.title: Falafel King
3168210.short_description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv's Carmel Market. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you'll need every hand for.

3168560.title: Dragon's Brew
3168560.short_description: Run the board game cafe of your dreams! Craft food and drink, deliver orders to the townsfolk, collect board games, and customise your space, your way!

3170130.title: Red Recon: 1944
3170130.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

3170720.title: Spot the Pet!
3170720.short_description: Find all 600 adorable pets 🐱🐶🐥🐰🐸🐷 hidden in two hand-drawn locations! Can you spot every one? 🔍

3171790.title: Astra Sentinel
3171790.short_description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

3173780.title: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
3173780.short_description: Toadled: Eating Frenzy is an action roguelike with an appetite! Play as a toad and eat everything on your path to grow bigger and mutate into new, disgusting forms. Consuming human flesh? Fair game. Police cars, tanks, missiles? Mild indigestion. Try out hundreds of appetizing build combinations!

3175290.title: Craterlands
3175290.short_description: Craterlands is a 2D sandbox adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, mystery, and endless possibilities! Mine, build, craft, and fight your way through diverse environments as you uncover the secrets of a shattered civilization.

3175550.title: Idle Archery
3175550.short_description: Shoot targets, earn gold, hire more archers. An idle incremental game about turning one lone archer into a sky full of arrows.

3176290.title: Fishing Up
3176290.short_description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

3177730.title: Rottenroots
3177730.short_description: You play as Salem, torn between family and forbidden love, thrown into a three-day death tournament. Can you help him survive, love, rescue and betray... while figuring out who he wants to be? 25+ endings and 300+ choices await in a hauntingly beautiful dystopia.

3181720.title: Project:Null Hypothesis
3181720.short_description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

3182310.title: SubDuctis
3182310.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

3182560.title: Dorifto!
3182560.short_description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive! Settle rivalries and prove your skill in online multiplayer and local split-screen.

3184440.title: Finares
3184440.short_description: Explore a world abandoned by humanity. Rescue lonely dogs and welcome them into your pack on a heartfelt journey of friendship, survival, and second chances.

3185170.title: A Developer Nightmare
3185170.short_description: You’re stuck in a dream and must run a special program on your computer to escape. Anomalies in the house disturb you, increasing your stress. Work with 2 or more Players to clear them before your stress consumes you.

3187650.title: Jigrift
3187650.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

3188510.title: Project SEVER
3188510.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

3192590.title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
3192590.short_description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

3193990.title: Trading Kingdom
3193990.short_description: Embark on a journey from a humble farmer to a powerful merchant in 15th century Venice. Compete against rival traders, expand your influence, and build your Trading Kingdom in a land where wealth is power.

3194740.title: FUMEHEAD
3194740.short_description: FUMEHEAD is a hero-focused turn-based RPG set in an underground world. Play as Dart and Ami as you try to eradicate the new alien disease that calls itself Slither.

3194860.title: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination
3194860.short_description: An ancient order that protects a secret, kept hidden for centuries. An unexpected crime that causes you to be accused of the murder of a friend. Solve the mysteries and puzzles of a story full of esotericism to prove the truth about your innocence and hold the real murderer responsible.

3195180.title: Remnant Afterglow Tower Defense
3195180.short_description: This is a creative and challenging real-time strategy tower defense game where players need to constantly expand, build complex battle lines on the map, and fight against groups of enemies. The game has unique rules and beautiful pixel style, with each level filled with tense and exciting battles.

3196160.title: Lost Ground
3196160.short_description: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

3196270.title: Fishing Shop Simulator
3196270.short_description: Catch fish, build your store, and sell your catches! Explore a mysterious world to find new areas, and new fish to catch. Decorate to get wealthier customers to buy your big catches. As you build up your store, a town will evolve around you!

3197200.title: Emptiness Sire
3197200.short_description: Uncover a story told in fragments across 160+ challenging turn-based puzzles steeped in cosmic horror. Switch between three survivors, anticipate enemy moves and rethink your strategy with unlimited undo.

3198700.title: Snake in the Dark
3198700.short_description: Sure, you've played Snake. But this is Snake like you've never seen before? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake, Sokoban, and Boulder Dash. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twists than you expect!

3199080.title: HellPunk: Purgatorium
3199080.short_description: HellPunk: Purgatorium is a roguelite that combines stylish action with inventory management. Equip gears, manage your grid, and conquer the tower.

3201040.title: Anasozas: Another Surreal World
3201040.short_description: An ISEKAI, RPG, CRAFTING GAME!? You and your best friend got transported to another world!! Obtain Skills that allow you mine, fight and build. Sadism is rampant in this world where anyone can level up, how will you influence this world with your power?

3201370.title: ON ANY JOURNEY
3201370.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!

3203530.title: Hexmental
3203530.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

3204000.title: Chrome Carnage
3204000.short_description: Machines took all jobs but one - urban blood sport. Chrome Carnage is a multiplayer top down shooter set in vibrant chaotic cyberpunk cities.

3204820.title: RippleLoop
3204820.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

3205260.title: Barty's Adventure
3205260.short_description: The world resets every three days, but not everything has to be forgotten. Choose what carries into the next loop as you uncover secrets in a cozy metroidvania set in a world of children's toys.

3211560.title: Die Deep
3211560.short_description: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

3214740.title: Wild Island
3214740.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

3216570.title: Game Of The Chosen
3216570.short_description: Enter the horror escape game *Game of the Chosen*, where your decisions can mean survival or death. Navigate through rooms filled with puzzles and traps while ghosts and demons make your journey more difficult. Each game is unique, with randomly generated levels and interactive objects.

3216660.title: Bosnian Battlefronts
3216660.short_description: Fight across the Bihać pocket area in a team-based multiplayer FPS set during the 1990s Bosnian War. Use trenches, village houses and wooded ridges for cover in Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag modes, with bots filling open slots.

3220460.title: Lucky Scoop
3220460.short_description: Run a cozy gift shop where every scoop counts! Collect colorful gems, fulfill customer orders, solve satisfying 3D packing puzzles, upgrade your shop, and turn your little business into something special.

3220770.title: Tales of Eldoria
3220770.short_description: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

3222280.title: Infinitory
3222280.short_description: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

3223030.title: RUIN: Beast City
3223030.short_description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

3223200.title: The Tower to God
3223200.short_description: A tower built to reach God. A wound that never healed. It is bleeding the world dry. Ascend it anyway. Defy a structure that even does not want to be reached. Hope is your only weapon.

3224270.title: Pixel Quest: Guild
3224270.short_description: Your guild fights at the bottom of your screen. Hire heroes, merge them, take on bosses, collect Arcanas, call in your Steam friends, and see how deep you get before you ascend and start over.

3224600.title: Am I Nima
3224600.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

3227960.title: Stip
3227960.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

3230210.title: Tasty Business
3230210.short_description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

3230960.title: EXODUS
3230960.short_description: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

3231250.title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
3231250.short_description: CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.

3231840.title: Hydra Coil
3231840.short_description: Voyage amidst the stars in this relaxed turn-based Space Fantasy RPG.

3232000.title: echo//shredd
3232000.short_description: echo//shredd is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players in a dystopian future. Collect scrap, retrieve loot for upgrades and fight for your survival. Your life is a resource - and your commodification is part of the system.

3232560.title: Hot Dog Simulator
3232560.short_description: Start your own hot dog stand business, find the perfect spots in the city, upgrade your stands, attend festivals, and serve influencers. Expand your business by opening new branches and perfecting your hot dogs.

3233500.title: ZombMe
3233500.short_description: Old school platforming...with a twist. It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

3233860.title: The Witch's Fairy Tale
3233860.short_description: "The Witch's Fairy Tale" is an action rogue, role-playing game developed by "a little Han Han Duck OVO", you will play a witch, to find magic around the world, your adventure along the way will be written as a fairy tale to pass on.

3237870.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
3237870.short_description: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens is a cozy, Suika-inspired, puzzle game where adorable, dessert-shaped cats fall from the clouds. Unlock power-ups, set up satisfying chains and combos, brave obstacles and cheeky weather twists. Play to relax or compete to leave your pawprint on our leaderboards. 🐈

3238940.title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
3238940.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

3241270.title: Into the Void
3241270.short_description: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

3242010.title: Stranger Tavern - Brawl
3242010.short_description: Welcome to the Tavern of Wonders! Olympian deities, Norse war gods, Eastern warriors, Cthulhu horrors... all await your command. Assemble any team—misplace them? Power unleashed! Asynchronous PVP lets you challenge bizarre lineups from players worldwide. Whose tavern reigns supreme in absurdity?

3242080.title: Pawn & Roll
3242080.short_description: As the new owner, it's up to you to restore the store to its former glory—appraise, buy, repair, upgrade, and decorate your shop to attract rare clients with legendary artifacts to sell. Build your reputation as the best merchant in the realm, with just a few rolls of dice.

3242450.title: Forgotten Trails: Svalbard
3242450.short_description: Climb cliffs! Fish the fjords! Explore forgotten places! Travel by snowmobile with your dog Margis, uncovering abandoned mines, ghost towns, and shipwreck graveyards across the frozen beauty of Svalbard. We’ll be waiting for your stories at a local pub in Longyearbyen!

3244080.title: CarveLight
3244080.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Free-for-all or in teams, against friends or CPUs, on the couch or online.

3244370.title: Bounty Fusion
3244370.short_description: Suit up as a mecha bounty hunter in a gritty faraway galaxy! Fuse cards to unleash powerful combos, chase high-stakes bounties, and build the ultimate deck in this action-packed roguelike deckbuilder.

3245640.title: Starfinder: Afterlight
3245640.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

3246430.title: Ved : Journey Beyond the Cube
3246430.short_description: You are a cube. But you weren't always. Solve story-driven 3D puzzles, uncover the truth behind an ancient curse, and fight your way back to being human

3248310.title: Karting of Banban
3248310.short_description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

3248700.title: Fox Arcana
3248700.short_description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

3251170.title: Lirai: Heir Of Darkness
3251170.short_description: Lirai: Heir of Darkness is an upcoming third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies and demons, where the obsession to dominate and control the world leads to fear, violence, destruction and, worst of all, extinction.

3253930.title: Rhythm Hotel
3253930.short_description: Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game where history's most famous figures check in, and all hell breaks loose. bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. No skill barriers, no finger-melting difficulty: simple controls, catchy beats, and pure foot-tapping chaos.

3254800.title: UnepicTale
3254800.short_description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

3255110.title: Grave Seasons
3255110.short_description: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.

3258010.title: Tesera
3258010.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

3259670.title: Age of Medieval
3259670.short_description: Age of Medieval is a single-player medieval real-time strategy game. Found a village with four families and a wagon, build it house by house, open roads and trade routes, then raise an army for battles and sieges. When your lord dies, his heir inherits it all.

3260830.title: A Tiny Wander
3260830.short_description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

3261050.title: Hats and Guns
3261050.short_description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

3261250.title: Dodgeball Blast
3261250.short_description: Dodgeball Blast is a colorful 3D action-adventure where dodgeball is your greatest weapon! Explore a wild overworld, battle 10 massive bosses, master 9 wacky minigames, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, and play solo or with friends on your quest to become the Dodgeball Master!

3262820.title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
3262820.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

3263640.title: The Gambit Lost to Time
3263640.short_description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

3264020.title: Our Ephemeral Nights
3264020.short_description: As he enters his final semester of college, Kev continues to wonder if there’s something more to the future he’s carving out for himself. After a chance encounter with Vivi, an aspiring voice actor also in her final semester, he experiences the beautiful and fleeting days before his graduation.

3265510.title: Nocky el Armadillo
3265510.short_description: Nocky El Armadillo is a love letter to the 16-bit generation of challenging 2d platformers. Avoid traps and evade enemies while mastering the controls.

3266120.title: Plush Party
3266120.short_description: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

3266790.title: Bit by Bit
3266790.short_description: Build a ridiculous game with your friends in minutes, then jump in and play it together. Draw the weapons & items, record the sound effects, draw the world, modify the rules and see what kind of cursed game your group creates.

3268020.title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
3268020.short_description: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax? Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

3268960.title: Brawlers of the West
3268960.short_description: A brutal physics-based Western brawler featuring realistic melee combat, ragdoll chaos, and violent close-quarters fights in the Wild West.

3270900.title: Aura Farmers
3270900.short_description: Outlast your rivals, lock down the zone, and farm that aura. Forget hunting for kills—it's about relentless control, crazy plays, and aura farming. Engage in intense 1v1 duels, coordinate brutal team assaults, or unleash chaos in frantic multi-team brawls. Every round is a wild, skill-testing party.

3271400.title: Marsbound
3271400.short_description: MARSBOUND is a survival game in sci-fi setting which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager who must create the first Martian colony from scratch with Earth's brightest minds under their command.

3272710.title: AKEGARASU: Journey to the Underworld
3272710.short_description: Cut Down Enemies to Keep the Clock Running! Race through deadly trials and reach the end of the Underworld in this ultimate-speed hardcore runner.
publishers: Pujia8 Studio (Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan)

3274000.title: Magical Girl Critical DELUXE
3274000.short_description: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

3274380.title: Drift Halls
3274380.short_description: Explore liminal spaces and control world lighting in real-time with the press of a button. Secrets can be revealed by the light or the dark. Search for signs of life and use your radio to catch any stray broadcasts. Learn the secrets of the Drift Halls, or simply take in the sights.

3280490.title: TekRobot
3280490.short_description: I am happy to present TekRobot, the game about a robot who lived and worked in his home factory, but once he was marked for disposal. Our goal is to escape from the factory, which no longer home but the deadliest place in the world.

3281110.title: Crooklock
3281110.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

3281500.title: Danu: Rise of the Templars
3281500.short_description: Danu: Rise of the Templars is an open-world MMORPG & co-op action RPG set in a fantasy medieval world inspired by the legends of the Knights Templar. Explore dangerous lands filled with mystery, battle powerful enemies alongside friends, and earn rare gear through PvE adventures & 4–8 player raids.

3281570.title: Disc Out!
3281570.short_description: Harness the power of magical discs to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets in this top-down Disc Golf adventure. Master your timing, level up your skills, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you help Cary, a talking bag, on his quest to save Paradisc Island!

3282130.title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
3282130.short_description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

3282500.title: Sweets'Devil
3282500.short_description: 《Sweets' Devil》is a Top-View action adventure game that emphasizes one shot kill and roaming. Engage in level battles and boss challenges in a humorous and entertaining fairy tale style , ‌fight against various sweets legions that treat human as the devil in their legend .

3283430.title: Oakley the Leafbug
3283430.short_description: Your best friend is going to make a horrible mistake that brings on the end of the world. Race across the Earth in this 2.5D platformer to find her, before it's too late!

3284120.title: Sokogeek
3284120.short_description: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

3284200.title: Muri: Wildwoods
3284200.short_description: Play as Pelle, a curious cleaner muri tasked with restoring an island back to life! Explore mysterious ruins, clean away corruption, befriend cute critters, collect sketches, and save the Wildwood’s forest spirit in this cozy cleaning-sim adventure!

3287720.title: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
3287720.short_description: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...

3288170.title: Awen
3288170.short_description: Awen is a large Open world fantasy VR RPG. When creating Awen we aimed to make every aspect of the gameplay uncompromised, from movement to combat. Combat is visceral and satisfying. Exploration and progress is open-ended. Come explore the world of Awen.

3289160.title: Paddle Cats
3289160.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

3290310.title: B-Type: Space Builder
3290310.short_description: A base builder shoot'em up in Deep Space. Explore the galaxy aboard your B-Type Star Ship. Shoot down your foes to expand your territory. Build planetary facilities, collect resources and raise an Intergalactic Defense Force. Can you save the world from a robotic alien invasion across dimensions?

3290340.title: Outer Express
3290340.short_description: 500 years after Earth's destruction, humanity scours desolate planets for resources. As a Star Scavenger, lead your team on dangerous expeditions to collect valuable scrap within a limited time. Race against the clock, outwit deadly aliens, and work together to survive and complete the mission.

3291440.title: Astro Architect
3291440.short_description: A space station city builder where your employees vote on what gets built. Play the cards they choose, keep them fed and productive, endure Void waves and roll the dice on expeditions into deep space. The CEO is watching.

3291770.title: The Search
3291770.short_description: A post-apocalyptic sci-fi adventure where players harness magic and advanced weaponry to battle enemies in an open world. Engage in intense combat, explore desolate landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets while mastering both supernatural powers and tactical shooting.

3292300.title: Golf-Like
3292300.short_description: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

3292730.title: Death In Your Dice
3292730.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

3293290.title: Rage Platformer
3293290.short_description: Rage Platformer (formerly Keni Adventure) is a hardcore platformer featuring difficult levels and challenging puzzles. Master timing, patience, and skill to progress, and unlock achievements to personalize your Steam profile.

3293950.title: Underworld
3293950.short_description: Underworld is a co-op roguelike FPS with waves of monsters, boss fights, and procedurally generated levels. Upgrade your gear, buy weapons, stack buffs, and go deeper into the Underworld to discover its secrets. PC & VR Cross-play.

3294180.title: KOTA: The Survival
3294180.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world abandoned by humans, control robots as they gather resources, fight enemies, and rebuild the planet using recycled materials. KOTA: The Survival lets you revive nature and craft a new future!

3294700.title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
3294700.short_description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

3295000.title: ReVamp
3295000.short_description: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

3296990.title: Fearwoods
3296990.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

3297200.title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
3297200.short_description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

3299780.title: Grinding Guilds
3299780.short_description: Grinding Guilds mixes the loot hunt and character building from ARPGs, with the strategy elements of Auto Battlers. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

3299990.title: MEMORALYSIS: The Scorched Home
3299990.short_description: A murder mystery visual novel about catharsis.

3300860.title: Meow Below
3300860.short_description: Meow Below: Roguelike pachinko in hell. Play as a cat in a devil's parlor. Buy marbles, pull the lever, chase random multipliers, and upgrade your machine. Manage coins, debt, and stamina. Cash out or risk it all?

3302550.title: Tumbletail
3302550.short_description: Tumbletail is a 1-4 player chaotic, fast-paced party platform brawler where adorable animals race to collect ten stars while knocking rivals out of the way! Jump, dash, and brawl across colorful pixel-art arenas in a frantic free-for-all. Play locally, online, or over LAN!

3304120.title: Delusional
3304120.short_description: Delusional is a chaotic top-down roguelike shooter where you battle absurd enemies with hundreds of ridiculous weapons, all in a desperate bid to defeat the eccentric artiste who created you.

3305720.title: Lode Builder
3305720.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

3305820.title: Infinite Ball Well
3305820.short_description: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!

3305930.title: Panzer Strike
3305930.short_description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

3305940.title: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ
3305940.short_description: Juvenile/Suspense Visual Novel Heading Towards Decadence

3305980.title: Star Life
3305980.short_description: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

3307240.title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
3307240.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

3307620.title: No Gods, Only Ducks
3307620.short_description: No Gods, Only Ducks is a chaotic mix of boomer shooter, wave survival, and extraction shooter gameplay. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves of corrupted creatures, collect powerful weapons and equipment, and do whatever it takes to survive long enough to escape.

3309070.title: Zombie Must Dead!
3309070.short_description: Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.

3309160.title: Chronocracy
3309160.short_description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

3309250.title: The Rift Tower Defense
3309250.short_description: The Rift is a tower defense game with elements of RPG gameplay that will appeal to players of all skill levels. Enemies from an alternate universe are attacking and it's up to the player to stop them by strategically building defensive towers.

3310090.title: Break Shot Hero
3310090.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

3310870.title: DICTOCRACY
3310870.short_description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

3310910.title: SPACE WALK
3310910.short_description: SPACE WALK is a hands-on first-person astronaut simulation where you operate an orbital station and conduct surface expeditions across the Moon.

3312590.title: Helrift
3312590.short_description: Helrift is a free-to-play old-school MMORPG, built around the war between Aresden and Elvine. Shape your build through stats, weapons and spells. Hunt monsters, gather materials and craft your supplies, then join your allies in open-world PvP and battle for dominance in server-wide events.

3315320.title: Pico Drift
3315320.short_description: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

3316080.title: Mine of despair
3316080.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

3316610.title: Orium
3316610.short_description: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.

3316890.title: Dual Cores
3316890.short_description: A post-apocalyptic team-based sword-and-sorcery action RPG with tons of overlapping choices you can use to design your ideal battlemage.

3316920.title: TDS
3316920.short_description: A dystopian survival action game hits Early Access soon: battle factions, manage gear, face endless foes. Wield Nanite powers to endure a fractured world on the brink. Fight to survive, Survivor!

3317450.title: Short Stories Whispers In The Walls
3317450.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Detective John Palisnki, drawn to a small town after a tragic suicide. As he searches for answers, John encounters supernatural phenomena that challenge his understanding of reality. Unravel dark secrets and face your fears in a haunting atmosphere filled with mystery.

3319450.title: Armada Pet Wars
3319450.short_description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

3321100.title: Chaosfall
3321100.short_description: Push your luck in a cursed slot machine. Cash out or lose everything to a machine that fights back.

3321410.title: Keep Chopping!
3321410.short_description: Keep Chopping! is a local multiplayer game for 2-4 players where you plant and chop trees to outgrow your rivals. Earn Acorns by chopping trees, then use them to plant more or buy bonuses to help you dominate the forest.

3321650.title: ココロトーカーズ
3321650.short_description: 舞台は廃校。記憶喪失の少年と、「モノ」を自身に宿すことができる「モノマネ」の力を持つ少女。 校舎内のあらゆる「モノ」と会話してモノだけが知っている情報を聞き出し、失われた記憶を取り戻そう！

3321760.title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
3321760.short_description: A Survival Horror game: Paranormal Investigator, Jonathan Hunter, awakens in an alternate realm finding himself fighting to survive. Forced to team up with a ghost girl named Angel trapped in a strange artifact, they must work together to escape an underground laboratory and evade dangerous enemies.

3323970.title: Pinbleton Park
3323970.short_description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

3324140.title: Sever's Zone
3324140.short_description: "Sever's Zone" is a 3D first-person shooter about survival in the Anomalous Zone, full of artifacts, anomalies and dangerous inhabitants of the Zone - living and not so. The plot of the game is based on a series of books in the genre of science fiction.

3325330.title: Eionis
3325330.short_description: Enter the world of Eionis in a dynamic, free-to-play 2D MMORPG. Choose one of 9 unique character classes - from a samurai to a destroyer, and many other diverse playstyles. Explore an open world, fight monsters, collect items, and develop your character through both PvE and PvP battles.

3325820.title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
3325820.short_description: Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a people’s budding rebellion against a ruthless oppressor. Infiltrate enemy territory, defeat those who stand in your way and uncover secrets necessary to free your people once and for all.

3326420.title: Hoops Ahead: Basketball Manager
3326420.short_description: A new basketball league has been founded! Manage, trade, and sign players to help lead your team to a championship.

3326980.title: CapyBash
3326980.short_description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

3329660.title: RoMiMiMi
3329660.short_description: RoMiMiMi is a simple board game. Win the game and reach the last floor.

3330110.title: Blaze Of Empires
3330110.short_description: Real-time strategy with armies and arcane magic. Choose Legionaries, Skelestians, or Antarions, gather food, wood and gold, build a base, and command a hero. An 11-mission campaign and Gods Challenge 9 stages and bosses with special attacks. Solo or co-op.

3330730.title: Kitty Convenience
3330730.short_description: Join the adorable kitty crew in Kitty Convenience, a chaotic co-op adventure! Manage a bustling store solo or with friends in modes from Kitten Mode (ages 3-6) to high-stakes challenges. Play locally or online with emote-only chat. Adapt, team up, and keep customers happy! 🐾🛒

3333000.title: BOTO LABO
3333000.short_description: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

3333190.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
3333190.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

3333590.title: Save Our Queen
3333590.short_description: An incremental clicker game where you defeat monsters and protect the Queen's Tower.

3333850.title: Arkheron
3333850.short_description: No two runs are ever the same. New loot, new enemies, new strategies, new memories. Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.

3334170.title: Tales of Tuscany
3334170.short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

3336270.title: How Much is Happiness?
3336270.short_description: You lost Bun, a cheerful orphan girl, who was the only joy for you in this cruel world. Tired of the harsh life, she went to Paradise, but you didn't accept it. At great cost, you dragged her back into the place she desperately wanted to escape. “How Much is Happiness” is a story of joy and despair.

3338350.title: Wheelchair Together
3338350.short_description: 1-2 player physics based platformer. Play solo or with a friend in chaotic mini levels, master wheelchair movement, and learn to work together.

3338510.title: HEMA. Humetal Era Morphose Arms
3338510.short_description: 《HEMA》is a Character Action Game Mixing with 2D Metroidvania. Beating the AI-Robot army – Humetal with Stylish Combo Combat !! Explore the Humetal Base and Discover Hidden Sub-Gadget And equipment !! Beat the Boss to Upgrade your Character to perform more Flashy Combat Skill !!

3339230.title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
3339230.short_description: The game centered around Ragnar Lothbrok, a legendary Viking hero. Players assume the role of Ragnar, who has been reborn by Odin’s order to fulfill a divine quest. Ragnar embarks on a journey filled with discoveries, battles, and encounters with mythical creatures.

3339280.title: From Basement with Love
3339280.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

3339560.title: Vertigo Enigma
3339560.short_description: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

3339570.title: Adrenaline Overdrive
3339570.short_description: In this retro-styled FPS, tear through an alternate 1980s Brooklyn as a vengeful detective enhanced by experimental drugs. Master supernatural movement abilities, and uncover the truth behind your brother's murder - before the power that drives you becomes your doom.

3339990.title: Goblin Lair: Shards of Magic
3339990.short_description: Goblin Lair its a fast-paced strategic clicker! Smash your mouse like a maniac to gather crystals! Manage your resources wisely, recruit goblins, build your base and strengthen your warriors. Expand your base, enhance your clicks or automate your miners as you fend off relentless enemy raids!

3340510.title: Sculptor
3340510.short_description: Create and paint statues of beautiful women, improve your skills and follow the kinetic novel of a sculptor who fell in love with his creation. The game is inspired by the Greek myth of Pygmalion.

3342670.title: Crypts Of Carith
3342670.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

3343280.title: Trenchhold TD
3343280.short_description: Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, strengthen your forces through permanent upgrades, and launch full-scale counterattacks to crush their defenses!

3343350.title: Pitfalls 64
3343350.short_description: Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...

3343480.title: SeedGod
3343480.short_description: In SeedGod, your mission is to strategically plant in a field full of bugs. Choose the best positions, and you can discover unique plants, capture bugs, find tools, and access areas that will challenge your survival tactics.

3344520.title: Backframes: Escape Together
3344520.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

3347170.title: Project Horizon
3347170.short_description: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

3348920.title: Skill Eater
3348920.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

3349290.title: Returnless
3349290.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

3350510.title: Hellwire
3350510.short_description: A dueling deckbuilder game against other players. Learn the rules of the bizarre match unfolding before you, turn the tide with clever (and not so clever) abilities, don’t get tangled in the wires, and pray for the mercy of the Biomechanical Goat.

3350570.title: Kingsbane
3350570.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

3350860.title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
3350860.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

3350970.title: Greedspire
3350970.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

3351260.title: H.A.I.N
3351260.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

3352930.title: Dino Citadel
3352930.short_description: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

3354230.title: AVROPOLIS
3354230.short_description: VR action-adventure with fully physics-based movement. Climb ruins, fight mysterious creatures and enemies, survive deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and manage your gear as Leonardo uncovers the lost civilization of AVROPOLIS. Story-driven campaign with strong accessibility options.

3354850.title: 双魂のデュアリスト
3354850.short_description: "Dual Souls Dualist" is a deckbuilding roguelike game where you combine two decks to create endless strategies. Charge up the cards you draw, unleash powerful attacks, and conquer the evil corporation's skyscraper stronghold while defeating enemies along the way.．

3355140.title: Crimson Skyline
3355140.short_description: Set the skies ablaze in this aerial combat bullet hell! Target enemy carriers to cripple fleets, dodge relentless anti-air battleships, and outmaneuver fighter jet squadrons. As a Phoenix Squadron pilot, you are the final rampart against tyranny and your nation’s last hope to rise from the ashes.

3355740.title: Legacy of Ashes
3355740.short_description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

3356660.title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
3356660.short_description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

3358060.title: Catena
3358060.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

3358960.title: Peregrine Point
3358960.short_description: Peregrine Point is a single-player story driven game about life, death, and what comes next. Maintain the lighthouse, keep the lamp filled with oil and help guide recently departed cats get to where the need to be.

3359110.title: Total Victory: World Conflict 1939-1945
3359110.short_description: The ultimate turn-based World War 2 grand strategy game wargamers have been yearning for decades. The best ideas born from players and from wargames so huge they overtook your dining room table, and your wife’s patience. From the developer of the WarPlan series.

3359330.title: Crystal Rail
3359330.short_description: All aboard the Crystal Rail - a train game set in a crystalpunk fantasy world of extinct animals, hand-painted environments, and political revolution!

3359700.title: Runes & Revenue
3359700.short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of magic retail! Runes & Revenue is a cozy, hands-off management game where you manage your own magic shop. Recruit staff, unlock new mystical services. Strategically purchase upgrades to keep up with customer demand and ensure every adventurer leaves happy.

3359860.title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
3359860.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

3363400.title: Escape With Friends
3363400.short_description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

3364130.title: Addie Shen
3364130.short_description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

3364720.title: Rich Flavors
3364720.short_description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

3366850.title: Snipers & Airdrops
3366850.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

3367710.title: The Abyss Break
3367710.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

3367950.title: Five More Minutes
