3367950.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

3369720.title: Nuria's Redemption
3369720.short_description: How many waves of rabid babies could you survive? Join your friends in Nuria's Redemption, a frantic co-op and PvP shooter. Choose from 4 classes, level up in combat, and defend your base from random events. Save the timeline!

3369910.title: Drunk Golf
3369910.short_description: Drunk Golf is a 1-8 player multiplayer game where the more drunk you are -> the further you shoot, but it also makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, race & drift across multiple courses, customize your look and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

3371720.title: Tangles 2 تشابك
3371720.short_description: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

3374060.title: Ruins of The Titan
3374060.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

3376860.title: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
3376860.short_description: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

3376960.title: Nighthold
3376960.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

3377230.title: Seal of Solitomb
3377230.short_description: A deck-building roguelike that takes solitaire and puts it in a dungeon. Stack cards into poker hands and rid your deck of the monsters within. Assemble an invincible build and beat the demon threatening the kingdom - at least until the next run!

3377830.title: Backroom Cleaners
3377830.short_description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

3380100.title: Estella
3380100.short_description: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

3380640.title: Wildlife Sports : Untamed
3380640.short_description: Join your friends in a silly sports Showdown! Choose your totem animal and compete in wacky games. With simple yet entertaining gameplay, enjoy quick matches or all-night sessions of endless fun and laughter. Who will reign supreme?

3381860.title: Ratscension
3381860.short_description: A top-down roguelite action dungeon crawler. Ascend the tower and fight the evil rat wizard. Avoid dangerous enemies. Find valuable loot. Build your character and explore the tower. Play solo or online co-op with friends!

3382130.title: Time Champions
3382130.short_description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

3382460.title: The Remains
3382460.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

3382760.title: Black Flame Tactics
3382760.short_description: A dark fantasy autobattler roguelike. Build your party and lead it to the bottom of the world, where the Black Flame burns. Every run brings new heroes, relics, mysterious events, bosses, ancient pacts and more. Brave the descent solo or with a friend in online co-op.

3384340.title: Rico's Theater
3384340.short_description: Rico's Theater is an extremely intense first-person online multiplayer horror game. Choose multiple classes that vary in weapons & abilities & work together with friends in fighting dangerous entities.

3384570.title: Planet Party Time
3384570.short_description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

3384600.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
3384600.short_description: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.

3384920.title: Possessions
3384920.short_description: An award-winning puzzle game about perspective. Turn each room until its scattered things line up and settle into place. There are no timers and no dialogue, only a family's life, told through the things they kept.

3385580.title: Chill Chess
3385580.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

3387240.title: My Fairy Princess
3387240.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

3390210.title: 異星間恋愛ガイド ‐Interplanetary love guide‐
3390210.short_description: A romance simulation set in a future where interstellar travel is common. Explore the island, meet alien characters, and deepen your bonds through daily choices. A world woven from danger, secrets, and quiet moments of connection. Your choices shape each relationship and lead to multiple endings.

3391130.title: SHOCK
3391130.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

3392480.title: MATRYBALL
3392480.short_description: Matryoshka meets football in a roguelike cup. Every hit can crack a shell off your players. Pick a fantasy club, unleash its special power and climb the ranks of Matry Champions, where every win upgrades your build. Or play local matches with friends.

3394420.title: Sweep City
3394420.short_description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

3394560.title: Witchbound
3394560.short_description: Witchbound is a first-person reverse horror game where you play as Callisto Coven, a powerful witch defending her mansion from villagers and priests who seek to destroy the cursed relics binding her to it. Hunt them, terrify them, and become the horror they fear.

3394780.title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
3394780.short_description: The Hellspawn Trials is an endless top down shooter where you choose from a variety of dynamic weapons and Faustian upgrades with unique side effects so you can become powerful enough to discover the answer to the ultimate question: How many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

3395030.title: MICROVERSE
3395030.short_description: MICROVERSE is a sci-fi action/adventure game. It includes weapons such as laser pistols, melee weapons and a 'merchant center' where you use in-game credits to buy new weapons and upgrades.

3395180.title: Rose in the Mist
3395180.short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel featuring choices that shape the heroine's personality and the ultimate ending she will reach. Meet the residents of the Mist Witch's estate and grow closer to her mysterious guests. Love, friendship, and hatred in a captivating story.

3396160.title: Warfactory: Automation RTS
3396160.short_description: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

3396350.title: Macaronpolis
3396350.short_description: Design your own 'all-in-one' macaron factory and become the CEO of your dream bakery. Decorate recipes at your own pace, or dive deep into optimizing production and adapting to ever-changing customer demand. Start from a small shop and conquer the world as a legendary CEO!

3397240.title: Battle Air Hockey BREAK BEATS!
3397240.short_description: Super exhilarating battle air hockey! Hit the ball and score a BREAK!

3397880.title: Sokoku
3397880.short_description: A block-pushing game where you not only push blocks, you are one. Plan your movements so that the right number ends up on top, while you interact with other cubes and mechanics. Can you roll your way to the solution?

3399660.title: Ant Mill Inc
3399660.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

3400110.title: Ironweld
3400110.short_description: Ironweld is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG where every encounter feels like PvP. Survive opponents that use the same moves and parts as you. They chase, punish, launch, and pressure you back. Repair and rebuild your squad between stages as you push deeper. Lose them all and it's over.

3400130.title: Tombstone Tactics
3400130.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike autobattler where you play the Lich. Raise an undead army from the souls of fallen heroes, set the board, and let it fight. Lose a battle and your army returns; the Lich pays instead. March on the royal family and take it apart, one crown at a time.

3400370.title: Super Terrestrial
3400370.short_description: A roguelite autoscroller, where you control a spaceship navigating procedurally generated levels. Use limited aerial jumps and hover abilities to dodge hazards, collect gems, and explore alternate biomes. Each run features upgrades, power-ups, dynamic enemies, and challenging bosses.

3401150.title: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
3401150.short_description: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

3401960.title: JOIN US
3401960.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

3402110.title: HackOS
3402110.short_description: HackOS: The ultimate hacking MMO. Dive into a shared, ever-evolving world of espionage, dilemmas, competition & collaboration — all via your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.

3403560.title: Tiny Tree Talk
3403560.short_description: Grow and shape bonsai trees, build tiny dioramas, and find a new sense of belonging on a wholesome 2000s internet forum, TinyTreeTalk. Enjoy full sandbox freedom or bring requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props and enjoy chill lofi beats and a nostalgic mid-2000s Japan.

3404340.title: Chronicles of Humanity
3404340.short_description: Chronicles of Humanity is an expanding anthology of historical visual novels. Enter different eras, weigh conflicting testimony under political and personal pressure, and shape who is protected, what is recorded, and how each life is remembered. Complete stories are released as separate DLC.

3404680.title: test
3404680.short_description: A classic side scrolling game level that combines platform jumping, action combat, and puzzle exploration. Players control their characters to move horizontally on a two-dimensional plane, gradually solving puzzles and defeating enemies through jumping, attacking, and obstacle avoidance operations.

3405080.title: Smile Thief
3405080.short_description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

3405120.title: Hide The Corpse
3405120.short_description: Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

3405180.title: 杀剧回环：衔尾之蛇 Killing Tragedy Samsara: Ouroboros Reincarnation
3405180.short_description: A.D.2046 Spring, Hecate, the great novelist, was invited to La Stella Domani Detective Competition, and unexpectedly forced to play a murder game among gifted and criminal teens. With the power of time loop, could she crack those perfect crimes?

3405680.title: Teamcrafter
3405680.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build the perfect adventuring party in Teamcrafter, a cozy crafting roguelite where your heroes fight the battles, but you craft the victories. Explore serene procedural biomes, optimize your team’s build load out, and uncover the mystery of the Portals.

3407480.title: Magic Wands Workshop
3407480.short_description: A unique wand workshop simulator where you can create amazing combinations of wand elements and test their power! Immerse yourself in the world of magic and match wands to your demanding clients.

3408720.title: Kosmosis
3408720.short_description: Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.

3409650.title: Gunnar Malakor
3409650.short_description: A FULLY BLIND-ACCESSIBLE AUDIO ADVENTURE You are Gunnar Malakor: thief, failed mercenary and escape artist. Sentenced to death in the dungeons of Lysanthir castle, you'll need cunning, improvisation and a little luck to break out and leave the kingdom.

3412340.title: Two Robots: Unleashed
3412340.short_description: The first competitive card game where players can create their own cards. Build your robot, craft your deck, and brawl in 1v1 arenas in the sci-fi world of Rennova. Climb the ranks, earn your place among the elite, and design cards that change the game forever.

3413080.title: Luminest
3413080.short_description: Luminest is a hand-drawn 2D puzzle-platformer. As Lumi the light spirit, you traverse mutated woods gathering crystal shards. Solve light-themed puzzles with light, color and rhythm. Uncover hidden lore amid exploration to reignite the tiny world, featuring whimsical and soothing aesthetics.

3415380.title: CoreRunner
3415380.short_description: Imprisoned within the Core, your only hope of escape are your light blades. Strap them on, grab your guns and your katanas, then experience a retrowave prison break. Skate, shoot, and slash your way to freedom under the neon glow of cyberspace, to the tune of a pulsing synthwave soundtrack.

3416140.title: Hell and Back
3416140.short_description: Step through the gates of hell and descend into darkness. Use blades and magic against dangerous enemies and challenging bosses, collect better loot, grow stronger, and fight your way out of hell. See how far you can survive into hell.

3418090.title: Death's Legacy
3418090.short_description: Embark on an open-world adventure as a necromancer wielding dark magic. Explore vast landscapes, summon the monsters that were once your enemies, and uncover ancient secrets in an immersive experience.

3418870.title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
3418870.short_description: Throw, hit, and brawl! The legendary 90s arcade beat 'em up combining baseball and martial arts returns in HD! Packed with new characters, modes, stages, and music, plus up to 4-player co-op!

3419080.title: The Regreening
3419080.short_description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

3422660.title: FlowerBots
3422660.short_description: Flowerbots is an incremental game you can play in active or idle modes. Upgrade bots. Balance harvesting and planting. Explore synergies. Crush anomalies. And watch your plan unfold as the numbers go up.

3422990.title: CacheAdventure
3422990.short_description: CacheAdventure is a new open-world adventure sandbox game. Dig, explore, fight, loot, and build in infinite procedural landscapes. Enjoy persistent free updates/optimizations—more playable content coming!

3424380.title: From Misfortune Comes
3424380.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

3424910.title: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
3424910.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

3427820.title: Lemonade Apocalypse
3427820.short_description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

3429380.title: Kindred Ills
3429380.short_description: Kindred Ills is a dark, loot-focused tile-based dungeon crawler. Build a party of mercenaries, discover powerful spells and items, and fight your way through dangerous biomes where death is permanent. Find rare loot, and push your party further with increasingly brutal difficulties and modifiers.

3430150.title: Billiards Warrior
3430150.short_description: 《Billiards Warrior》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelite building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

3430620.title: Helcast
3430620.short_description: Fight your way from the Underworld to the gates of Asgard in a turn-based, merge-puzzle roguelite deckbuilder rooted in Norse mythology. Assemble godslaying builds and battle the unleashed dead by combining weapons, weighing velocity and mass with every shot to chain physics-driven merge combos.

3430920.title: Roadside Egg Stand
3430920.short_description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

3431590.title: Easy Drive Together
3431590.short_description: An easy and fun drive with a friend.

3431600.title: Supreme Heroes
3431600.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

3433080.title: Cube & Seek
3433080.short_description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

3434180.title: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE
3434180.short_description: A psychological horror RPG with visual novel elements, where you live the life of Hicha, a shut-in hikikomori trapped in an endless cycle of depression, anxiety, and routine.

3434920.title: SAGE
3434920.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

3437190.title: Always With You: Meow & Mystery
3437190.short_description: "Always with you" is a cute and relaxing action-puzzle game. Switch freely between controlling a girl and a cat, solve clever puzzles, explore the ancient Alto civilization, and defeat unruly guardians. Embark on an exciting adventure with three cats to find your mother!

3437620.title: Ember of Origins
3437620.short_description: Ember of Origins is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel action shooter. Explore the ruins of a world consumed by infernal flames, scavenge resources, upgrade powerful weapons, and battle demonic hordes as you embark on a dangerous journey to rescue your missing companion.

3438600.title: Battle-Lines
3438600.short_description: Like playing Go with puzzle pieces. Build, recolor and steal lines to dominate the board! Play local, online or against AI.

3438920.title: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
3438920.short_description: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.

3439410.title: HellHeart Breaker
3439410.short_description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

3439870.title: Nexus Storm
3439870.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up inspired by 90s classics! Blast through waves of alien enemies, unleash devastating weapons, and destroy your surroundings. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op as you fight to save Earth!

3440130.title: Songs of the Shore
3440130.short_description: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

3440510.title: Zap Colony
3440510.short_description: Zap Colony⚡ is a minimalist defense sim where you build a power grid and match tower energy to enemy colors. How long can you keep the colony safe?

3440770.title: The Glued
3440770.short_description: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

3442270.title: Stone of Adventure
3442270.short_description: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!

3442310.title: Trauma Record
3442310.short_description: 夜を歩く、血だまりの上を走る、永遠を断ち切る。 復讐のための翼は折れない。

3443110.title: Hexamonia
3443110.short_description: A cozy, strategic board game where every choice matters. Place hex tiles, make the most of the options you’re dealt, and build the most valuable kingdom in the land.

3443710.title: RitualRX
3443710.short_description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

3443790.title: Throw A Life!
3443790.short_description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

3444810.title: Wonderfall
3444810.short_description: Paris, 1920. The city is collapsing into sand. Play as Léon, an orphan able to manipulate sand, as you explore a reimagined Paris consumed by Entropy. A story-rich narrative adventure where exploration reveals what happened to the city and what still lies beneath its ruins.

3444830.title: Wizard Hand
3444830.short_description: Wizard Hand is a magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. You play solitaire by using your magical cards to uncover dazzling combos and accumulate magical points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

3446770.title: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
3446770.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

3450270.title: DineInn
3450270.short_description: DineInn is a cozy horror restoration sim where you clean, repair, cook, farm, explore, and manage a forgotten diner and inn to restore it for profit. Uncover its buried secrets while maintaining your sanity, or the horror will begin. (Single dev project)

3450900.title: DOSMIC
3450900.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

3452060.title: Tiny Takedowns
3452060.short_description: The Rebels thought they had their shrinking weapon under control, until the Spies turned it against them! Uncover the Spies or cause chaos as a Rebel in Tiny Takedowns! With unique skills and chaotic rounds, every match offers a fresh and thrilling experience.

3453420.title: Shroud of Gloom
3453420.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

3453430.title: Rush Your Band
3453430.short_description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

3454620.title: Social Hook
3454620.short_description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

3455380.title: Chemical-Burn
3455380.short_description: Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed. Engage in thrilling first person combat as Cindy using a variety of weapons & your dog Buddy. Plan. Execute. Survive. Repeat.

3458140.title: NimerWorld: Shadows of a Promise
3458140.short_description: Welcome to Valdix, a kingdom consumed by darkness. Rescue the kingdom's ducks and put an end to the plague. As you progress, everything becomes stranger. Will you be able to reach the top and overcome this challenging journey?

3458290.title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
3458290.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

3462190.title: PHASE ZERO
3462190.short_description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

3462240.title: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
3462240.short_description: Build the ultimate miniature hobby store! Order model kits, paint stunning miniatures, negotiate with collectors, and grow your business into every hobbyist's favorite shop.

3462580.title: Factory Life
3462580.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

3462780.title: Bee Space
3462780.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

3463690.title: Sojourn Saga
3463690.short_description: Sable and his party are trapped in a town nobody can leave. A retro turn-based roguelite JRPG inspired by Lufia II’s Ancient Cave: build your party, raise evolving Foomy companions, master gear and ornament combinations, and delve into the ever-shifting Warren to find answers.

3464360.title: tower sequence KNIGHT LOBSTER
3464360.short_description: YOU WILL LOSE EVERYTHING. YOU WILL GAIN EVERYTHING. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP.

3464710.title: Tiny Bomber
3464710.short_description: Survive the countdown in a fast-paced vertical bullet-hell roguelite. Collect coins to extend your run, graze bullets for aircraft-specific boosts, build wild upgrade combos, turn defeated bosses into companion drones, tweak map spawns, and team up in 2-player co-op to push toward the final boss!

3465440.title: CitaDrill
3465440.short_description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

3465820.title: Cyber Siege
3465820.short_description: Take control of a combat mech in an old-school sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your machine and unlock powerful support drones. Face alien creatures and hostile machines alone or with up to 3 friends in local co-op.

3469680.title: Story of Leaves
3469680.short_description: Start your new life! Build your dream farm, grow crops, craft, mine, fish, and forge heartfelt connections with charming townsfolk. Explore a vibrant world, uncover mysteries, and shape your own unforgettable story in this cozy farming / life sim RPG.

3469760.title: Click Click Chicken
3469760.short_description: A short incremental game about catching chickens, pigs, cows and sheep.

3470500.title: Ember and Blade
3470500.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

3473440.title: Sparrow Warfare
3473440.short_description: Play ever-crazier combinations of 3 tiles to free the birds in our synergy-rich deckbuilder. Let your mind take flight as you scheme and strategise. This… is Sparrow Warfare!

3473710.title: DARK IN LIGHT
3473710.short_description: A man who falls asleep while working late wakes up in an unfamiliar city overrun by monsters. Survive with limited resources and explore the city by following clues through the darkness. You must press on to make it back to the son waiting for you.

3474390.title: BOILED
3474390.short_description: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter, set in the 1920s Old West.

3474890.title: SuperCitycon
3474890.short_description: A city builder with a retro-inspired look and the freedom to shape your world. Build roads, railways and entire neighborhoods in a creative sandbox. Customize buildings, vehicles and more with SCC Studio, the in-game voxel editor, and share your creations through Steam Workshop.

3475070.title: Arrow & Fang
3475070.short_description: Take on the role of Lena Morwyn. Explore, slash and shoot arrows in this action-adventure title.

3475450.title: TohoKids
3475450.short_description: Shinjuku doesn't forgive. A village panda chasing neon lights. Join the legendary TohoKids, hack your enemies, and remember: here, your data is worth more than your life. How far will you go to avoid becoming just "meat for the slaughter"?

3475880.title: Train Goes Right
3475880.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

3478990.title: NecroMerc
3478990.short_description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

3479370.title: Deck & Defense
3479370.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

3480330.title: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
3480330.short_description: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

3480710.title: Con Clicker
3480710.short_description: Con Clicker is an incremental game about building your evil TV infomercial empire. Scam your way to fortune by running outrageous ads, selling ridiculous products, and automating your operation for exponential growth. It's satire, scams, and endless clicking fun!

3480960.title: Project Roy
3480960.short_description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

3481340.title: Potion in Motion
3481340.short_description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

3481370.title: Firewheels Shop Simulator
3481370.short_description: Co-Op Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

3481580.title: Spin Power
3481580.short_description: A short incremental building game where everything functions with your Spin Power. Build structures, mine resources, unlock new lands, upgrade yourself inside the big skill tree, automate resource mining to increase your income and awake the mysterious water tank from eternal slumber!

3481630.title: CLIMB IT!
3481630.short_description: Take on the challenge and conquer the mountain! Test your coordination and resilience as you scale sheer cliffs and navigate through mountain caves - where every misstep can come at a high cost. Join this thrilling adventure and prove your skill!

3481840.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
3481840.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

3482670.title: Bunny Jump Jump
3482670.short_description: Journey up through the sewers, across lakes and up the tallest tree to catch the fleeting blue butterfly. Hop through challenging platforming challenges as a cute bunny and see beautifully handmade and cozy world!

3484010.title: Immortum
3484010.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi horror inspired by classic horror. Trapped in a decaying spaceship, escape mind-bending traps, navigate shifting realities, solve puzzles, and uncover an impossible truth — as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child. Can you discover the truth before you’re erased?

3484520.title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
3484520.short_description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

3484960.title: Ultakia
3484960.short_description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

3486200.title: Shift Happens
3486200.short_description: Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management? No? Well too bad, I made a game about it anyway. Shift Happens is a first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, and keep the store running. The job is simple. Enjoy your shift.

3486500.title: Aftershock
3486500.short_description: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

3486940.title: The Last Liftboy
3486940.short_description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. After thirty years, a letter brings Ted Grady back to the Hôtel Grand Valmont. The hotel is barely breathing. Carry luggage, run the elevator, restore the rooms — and save the place that made him.

3489450.title: Ashcrown Gauntlet
3489450.short_description: A dark-fantasy roguelite of turn-based, three-on-three battles, played out in a living book. Your mercenaries share one pool of energy. Beat challengers to keep them for good, steal their abilities, and climb a ladder of crowns where every boss plays by its own rules.

3491720.title: MOP’N SPARK
3491720.short_description: Try, rewind, and rebuild! MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

3493880.title: Dylio's Adventures
3493880.short_description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio’s shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

3494460.title: Card: Heroes and Dispute
3494460.short_description: In this unique strategy RPG, you must collect resources and recruit an army by stacking cards in a fantasy world. Explore mysterious rooms, ingeniously use limited space to assemble powerful combat units, and face turn-based boss battles.

3498700.title: Appulse
3498700.short_description: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

3500430.title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
3500430.short_description: First-person dungeon crawling meets turn-based horror. Lead five fugitives into the depths of a cursed manor—and survive what’s waiting below.

3503690.title: Dark Omen
3503690.short_description: Push back the encroaching darkness and the Architect's foul designs, then return to rebuild your village and reunite its people. Forge powerful artifacts and arrange mystical Omens to shape your next build as you battle relentless hordes and bosses in this low-poly Action RPG Roguelite.

3503810.title: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
3503810.short_description: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. explosions. Craft potions and bombs to sabotage a tyrannical regime. Master forbidden alchemy, navigate a vertically-layered city in stealth, and ignite a revolution.

3504340.title: SORROW: Rise of Divinity
3504340.short_description: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

3504720.title: Foodgitives
3504720.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op physics arcade game where you're food on the run! Tilt and roll through restaurants as murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Coordinate with friends to survive the chopping block or master the mayhem solo.

3505400.title: LETS GO HUNTING
3505400.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

3506740.title: In Banjiha
3506740.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

3508560.title: Hallow Maze
3508560.short_description: Hallow maze is a soulslike metroidvania set in a gothic world in 2D. Use transformations into different creatures to open your way, as well as incredible tools of energy. Discover the origin of the scourge that is infecting the lands of the Evernight Valley and venture into The Hallow Maze...

3509380.title: GrimKeep
3509380.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

3509420.title: Planetbase 2
3509420.short_description: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

3510530.title: SANGRA
3510530.short_description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

3510760.title: MODULE:BERSERK (모듈 버서크)
3510760.short_description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

3511010.title: Cursed Bloodline
3511010.short_description: A narrative psychological horror where past and present slowly blur inside a remote house. The line between memory and reality is gone.

3511730.title: 終末メイドロイド
3511730.short_description: A choice-type adventure novel game in which the ending is determined by the percentage of parts recovered from the “receive,” “don't receive,” and “take” options.

3511850.title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
3511850.short_description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

3512720.title: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
3512720.short_description: 10 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

3514400.title: Prism Warriors DX
3514400.short_description: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

3515450.title: Duoshift
3515450.short_description: Defend The Wall on the tactical grid using your pair of Battle Vehicles called Duoshifters. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

3515660.title: Just a simulation
3515660.short_description: Just a Simulation is a futuristic strategy game where you master a vast arsenal of weapons, upgrade your tools, and dismantle enemy systems. Go in guns blazing or hack your way to victory.

3516350.title: BENBOWARS
3516350.short_description: FIGHT or KILL your way thru a world under attack by THE EVIL SKELETON ARMY—Episodic 2D+ Super Action Platforminger Adventurevania—The Most Indie Game Ever Made—

3516460.title: Shoot for the Moon
3516460.short_description: Shoot your spear at flying creatures, feed them to the monster beneath your feet, and grow big enough to escape the forest in this fully-voiced arcade action platformer!

3518510.title: Mochi Conquest
3518510.short_description: A roguelike JRPG dungeon crawler set in mythical Japan. Lead Mochi squads across 9 unique classes in dynamic turn-based combat with timeline tactics 👺 Meet 300+ Kami, loot weapons, power up, and shape your strategy. Conquer 100 corrupted floors to uncover forgotten fates ⛩️ A full JRPG - Every Run!

3520800.title: GraviTech
3520800.short_description: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

3521010.title: Grid Gladiators
3521010.short_description: A pixel art roguelike deckbuilder battler on a 2D grid. Multiple biomes, randomly generated terrain, and a push-your luck system of battle modifiers keep battles feeling fresh. Characters, cards, stickers, relics, and more create many paths to victory. Join the community's fight to conquer the Grid!

3521810.title: Team Buddies
3521810.short_description: A fast-paced action and strategy game where you build teams, craft weapons, and destroy enemy bases in intense online and campaign battles.

3522540.title: Death of a Dungslinger
3522540.short_description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

3523630.title: Stuck In The Backrooms
3523630.short_description: Stuck In The Backrooms is a horror multiplayer (1-4) exploration game where players find themselves trapped in a different reality. Solve puzzles and investigate levels while avoiding (OR NOT...) entities. Some things were never meant to be found…

3524050.title: Creature Containment
3524050.short_description: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

3526420.title: Rebels of the Realm
3526420.short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

3526560.title: Dwarven Village
3526560.short_description: Place your dwarves directly on the enemy paths. Keep them alive, level them up, equip them with powerful items, and build towers around them to create your perfect defense.

3529010.title: Blood Curse Legions
3529010.short_description: This is a RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

3530740.title: Die Meeple
3530740.short_description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

3531220.title: MECHBORN
3531220.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

3533500.title: Leaforia
3533500.short_description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

3534090.title: Dealicious
3534090.short_description: Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?

3534490.title: Axelball
3534490.short_description: Blast off in a battle of physics with AXELBALL. With 2 player local shared keyboard controls this game is ready to play right on your keyboard against your friends, coworkers or siblings right away. Rocket speeds with real-time physics strategy will bring the fun right to your home or workplace.

3535030.title: Sweets & Dragons
3535030.short_description: Sweets & Dragons is a simulation game of maid cafe management in another world. The player becomes the owner of a maid cafe, and while managing the shop and training beautiful maid androids, collects money and grows the shop.

3535170.title: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds
3535170.short_description: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds is an MMO of true rarity. Unique quests, permanent NPC deaths, unpredictable bosses, evolving worlds, and legendary items only one player can claim. Knowledge, not grind, shapes the world.

3535210.title: Stealer
3535210.short_description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

3535320.title: Memories Of Zattera
3535320.short_description: Memories of Zattera is a visual novel that merges fantasy and science fiction. Explore moral and political dilemmas from multiple viewpoints as tradition, progress and freedom collide. Will you see the world the same once all truths are revealed?

3535730.title: Kiki's Nightmare
3535730.short_description: An adventure RPG where you step in the shoes of a fearless hero. Navigate through unhospitable terrain, fierce enemies and save Kiki from her own terrifying dream!

3535870.title: Bayaya
3535870.short_description: A story-driven fairytale adventure about Prince Bayaya. Explore village life, help with simple work, and experience the beginning of a larger fairytale journey.

3537960.title: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
3537960.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

3538010.title: Dug Out
3538010.short_description: "Dug Out" is an exciting multiplayer PvP game for 2-4 players, where you dive into an underground arena and engage in intense battles. Armed with guns, you'll dig through the environment to uncover hidden opponents and outsmart your rivals.

3540180.title: TabletKid Activity Book
3540180.short_description: A growing collection of animated, interactive pop-up books set in a cozy playroom space filled with hidden minigames. Point-and-click to explore the library: grab books to read, play with the busy board, and find other surprises. Intended for kids ages 3-5.

3541100.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
3541100.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

3541140.title: BattleSail
3541140.short_description: Fight pirate ships in turn-based naval battles during the Golden Age of Piracy. Earn gold, hunt hidden treasures, lead your fleet through a story campaign, and challenge friends in local and online multiplayer.

3541820.title: Galactic Space Guard
3541820.short_description: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers to defend humanity’s space stations, upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace across the galaxy!

3541940.title: Breaking News
3541940.short_description: A chaotic comedy adventure where you hit a glitchy CRT TV to change reality. Shake up the broadcast and twist the story to make your uncle’s crazy conspiracies come true.

3542850.title: ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD
3542850.short_description: An abstract visual novel about a girl dealing with the challenges of having ADHD while trying to complete a school assignment before the deadline.

3543370.title: μ of the M World
3543370.short_description: 魔王としてこの世に生まれたのに、すでに世界は壊れていた。主人公の μ は何かを壊す事で、何もない世界の中から一つずつ大切な感情を手に入れていく。過去の正義を遡る3Dアドベンチャー『μ of the M World』は連載型のアクションゲーム。物語とアクションを同時に進めていくこのゲームは、無料アップデートで徐々に世界が広がっていきます。

3543400.title: Knightstones
3543400.short_description: Build your medieval Order in this atmospheric autobattler. Deploy your elite warriors on the war table, face off against the mighty Lords of the Inquisition, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be prepared… or perish in the final battle.

3543620.title: Wiz Hunter
3543620.short_description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

3546980.title: Friday at Ours
3546980.short_description: Friday at Ours is a time management-adventure game about overcoming your anxiety and visiting a party you weren't invited to.

3548810.title: Ritual Tides
3548810.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

3551090.title: Charlatan
3551090.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder, but you don't trust luck, you CHEAT it. Rig a haunted slot machine and snowball numbers into a nice dopamine Jackpot!

3551290.title: Tidy Garage
3551290.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

3551800.title: Little Timmy
3551800.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters and tear enemies apart with brutal executions. Feed your blood-thirsty shotgun until it upgrades, graft boss organs into yourself, team up with up to 3 friends, and descend into the depths to rescue your mom before it's too late.

3551950.title: Tribes
3551950.short_description: In a Stone Age–like war, stranded on a lush, isolated island, it’s up to you to command your tribe and conquer and colonize the island by any means necessary! Tribes offers Skirmish, Multiplayer, and a full Campaign mode for you to experience with friends or play alone!

3551960.title: Banned Together
3551960.short_description: A queer mystery game about book banning. Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library.

3555440.title: Lich Lords
3555440.short_description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

3555790.title: Dice Tiny Town
3555790.short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

3556110.title: You've Changed
3556110.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

3556940.title: Rune Runners
3556940.short_description: A colorful 3D action platformer for one or two players, on one couch or online. Mix water, fire, thunder and wind into combos, take on twenty bosses and come home to a cozy village between the worlds.

3557870.title: Bad House
3557870.short_description: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don’t go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

3558410.title: Swifty
3558410.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

3558670.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
3558670.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

3558830.title: Grave Benders
3558830.short_description: A co-op horror heist for 1 to 4 players. Rob the graves of the rich after curfew. Dig with your friends, which is loud, in a cemetery that listens... It's 1947 and the plague never ended. Keep your voices down. The watchman can hear you, and not every grave is as quiet as it looks.

3560470.title: Chains of Reality
3560470.short_description: Chains of Reality is a survival horror game focused on a story-driven single-player narrative, where you traverse a multitude of liminal environments and alternate dimensions in search of fulfilling your end of a deal, a deal made with someone you never should have trusted.

3561120.title: Band Stage
3561120.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

3562230.title: Ruff Day at the Office
3562230.short_description: Ruff Day at the Office is a cozy office dog simulator where you help the whole office succeed through pure dog logic. Make friends with your coworkers, solve problems you probably started and level up your office skills. Will you become the office dog of the year?

3563190.title: 追逃 Chase&Escape
3563190.short_description: "Chase & Escape" is a single-player horror game about Chen Lin, a construction worker. After his night shift, his girlfriend Jiayi vanishes, strange dolls appear, and he’s chased by her. What’s behind these eerie events? Discover the truth!

3563730.title: Obgob
3563730.short_description: Build overpowered combos! Obgob is a autobattler roguelike with a focus on allowing the player to experiment and create wacky combos with item combinations, traits, and artifacts. Select a character and recruit units carefully positioning them while utilizing your resources to make broken builds.

3563820.title: Summoner's Cookbook
3563820.short_description: An active incremental, creature collector about summoning creatures and giving them tasks. Craft them using ingredients and fill out your Cookbook with your discoveries. Take on requests, build, expand and manage your creatures to work for you while you discover new recipes!

3564380.title: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries
3564380.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

3564990.title: Vale's Echo
3564990.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

3565090.title: Goobies 2
3565090.short_description: Blow up blobs and battle bosses in co-op! Find your favorite goobie and master its abilities and evolutions. Combine mutations into unique builds and collect powerful evolving omens in this roguelite shooter.

3565660.title: ScrapWings
3565660.short_description: Fight the Consortium's armada aboard your junkyard ship in an old-school flight simulator setting. Unlock new equipment recipes as you progress and build your aircraft of legend.

3566660.title: Ammo Garden
3566660.short_description: Bullet-Hell Roguelite where you Grow and Defend the last Farm in a Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland. Farm Crops, Upgrade Weapons and Kill every Creature that tries to invade your Farm!

3568070.title: Prohibition Panic!
3568070.short_description: Run a dusty speakeasy, alone or with 3 other players, determined to become the next underground sensation! Serve your patrons the booze and carry their drunk butts out of the parlor, all while hiding from the law, ready to take you in… or take some “gifts” from you.

3568960.title: Valerie
3568960.short_description: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

3571080.title: Delving The Depths
3571080.short_description: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler with turn-based combat.

3572070.title: Athelan Battlegrounds
3572070.short_description: Made by 2 people, Athelan Battlegrounds is an old school PvP turn-based tactics where player skill matters most. Build your team and engage in a meaningful battle of wits against other players in this "Chess meets LoL" indie game!

3573190.title: Revive! Onsen Town!
3573190.short_description: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.

3574810.title: Shadow Of The Union: Survival
3574810.short_description: Fight back against the rebellious machines in an alternative USSR! Join forces in a team of up to 4 players and survive in a dangerous open world. By day, explore and gather resources. By night, defend your base against waves of combat robots!

3575220.title: Guardians of the Wall
3575220.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

3576240.title: Drug Dealer 2049
3576240.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

3576560.title: The Shadow Cosmos
3576560.short_description: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

3578080.title: Wee Boats
3578080.short_description: The chill multiplayer boaty honk game! Explore with your friends as miniature boats in this lil nautical adventure!

3578430.title: Paresis® II
3578430.short_description: Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses. Survive…if you can.

3581030.title: Edge of Madness
3581030.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

3581840.title: Misty Garden
3581840.short_description: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

3581890.title: CatLands
3581890.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

3582480.title: GoopUpClassic
3582480.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule! Fight your companions after the trial is done!

3584060.title: BONEBUILDER
3584060.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

3584260.title: Fogreaver
3584260.short_description: Shoot zombies. Earn cash. Take back your Base Camp and clear the surrounding areas. Bring home supplies, upgrade your weapons and head out for more. Wake the hordes, lure them into traps or fight from horseback. Kill every last infected to keep what you earned. Then gear up for the next run.

3585260.title: TailofScorpios
3585260.short_description: "Scorpion's Tail" is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

3585490.title: Standard Procedures
3585490.short_description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

3589430.title: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
3589430.short_description: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

3589740.title: Charlie Spotlight
3589740.short_description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

3589910.title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
3589910.short_description: A brutal action game set in a collapsing sci-fi nightmare. Battle biomechanical mutants, traverse shifting landscapes, and uncover fragments of your lost mind as you descend into a twisted post-apocalyptic world.

3590180.title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
3590180.short_description: Rotate, slide, and explode your way through more than 60 levels of corporate labyrinths in this story-rich puzzler! Find a path for Barry to meet with all his monstrous coworkers and learn about their struggles. Defeat the evils of poor management with the power of unionization!

3590370.title: Insanitation
3590370.short_description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

3590520.title: Vampires Die
3590520.short_description: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

3590570.title: Bar of Betrayal
3590570.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.

3590670.title: Gloctopus
3590670.short_description: Eight guns is better than one — if you have eight arms. Gloctopus is a bullet heaven roguelike where you equip, mutate, and build your tentacles into a one-octopus army. The ocean didn't stand a chance.

3590870.title: Ripley [Remembered]
3590870.short_description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.

3591430.title: Nono & Soso
3591430.short_description: Nono & Soso is a puzzle game built around magnets. Switch between N and S poles to push and pull your way through blocked paths and reach the goal.

3591750.title: Little Dungeon
3591750.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

3592540.title: Niverium
3592540.short_description: Niverium is a survival game in a harsh world where you have to take on the role of a man sent to the very bottom. You will have to do any dirty work for those who stand above you, under threat of death.

3592570.title: Alchemy Duel
3592570.short_description: Make poker-style hands from alchemy ingredients to create monsters, then position them and stack relics to build explosive combos in this roguelike deckbuilder.

3592770.title: Gravitus
3592770.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

3593290.title: The Town That Died In The Night
3593290.short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?

3593330.title: Plush Rangers
3593330.short_description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

3594550.title: Billy the Hero
3594550.short_description: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

3594750.title: The Last Resourcer
3594750.short_description: Survive a hostile world with your droid. Build your base, automate with robots, and manage the energy that keeps you alive. Beware. The tech you rely on may save your life – or destroy it.

3595350.title: UnGodly
3595350.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

3595480.title: Shuttle Mining
3595480.short_description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

3596130.title: Chaos Coin
3596130.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

3597310.title: Critter Cosmos
3597310.short_description: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

3597650.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator
3597650.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator

3598060.title: Reviving An Angel
3598060.short_description: How do you revive an angel? Reviving An Angel is a turn-based RPG set in a world where Archangels, the greatest creations of the Almighty, are in a path of war. Wanting to revive his beloved, Harold, a young Fallen Hunter, saw himself facing an Archangel as he challenged the limits of his mortality.

3600380.title: Clan fantasy adventures
3600380.short_description: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

3600740.title: OmniRing
3600740.short_description: OMNIRING is a world-hopping tactical RPG for multiple playthroughs. Build a squad of Samsarans, fight, interact, and shape events through your choices. Grow your squad through cycles of adventure, face the Apocalypse's final battle, and become an immortal Ascendant.

3601810.title: Clear the Snow
3601810.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

3601970.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
3601970.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

3602270.title: Whisk
3602270.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

3602780.title: Kanji Grinder
3602780.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

3604040.title: Occult Trap
3604040.short_description: Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures, you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit. Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

3604100.title: Et le grain mourut
3604100.short_description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

3605510.title: No Prospects
3605510.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

3605560.title: Ping Profit - Internet Tycoon
3605560.short_description: Run the internet your way. Build infrastructure, control traffic, stop outages, and grow a basement hosting startup into a global powerhouse.

3605570.title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
3605570.short_description: Take control of Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies in this top-down bump combat action game! Dodge projectiles, control space and outmaneuver bosses in Arcade mode or explore dungeons, solve puzzles and unlock abilities in Adventure mode.

3607330.title: Silent Hunt
3607330.short_description: Play as detective Jacques Renaud sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to predators that should not exist !

3607570.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
3607570.short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

3610770.title: Dead Miles
3610770.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

3611540.title: Potat
3611540.short_description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

3612300.title: Fool's Trigger
3612300.short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

3614730.title: Monster Pod Quest
