3614730.short_description: Monster Pod Quest is an experimental creature collector with infinitely many procedurally generated monsters. Create completely unique creatures, build your party and battle through a huge variety of worlds to vanquish the bosses of the land.

3615510.title: UNDER WORLD
3615510.short_description: A deck-building roguelite game set in a devastated underground world after the war. Your choices will change your moral and soul, affecting your strategy and rewards. Venture deeper underground in search of the world's truth...

3615890.title: Earth Parasite: Silo
3615890.short_description: Post-apocalyptic, underground mining adventure, exhilarating bullet-hell shooting, mild SAN loss, mild Cthulhu, hand-painted art style, casual action sci-fi game.Escape from the underground shelter and uncover the truth behind the fall of human civilization.

3615970.title: Vesper's Hunt
3615970.short_description: A turn-based deduction game where you play as a detective hunting vampires. Use a mirror to reveal hidden beasts and holy water to strike them down. But beware—the undead grow stronger with every attack. Outsmart the vampires… or become their next victim!

3616280.title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
3616280.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

3616390.title: Absolute Cinema
3616390.short_description: Build your own movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining a huge variety of themes and genres, hire star actors at castings, and develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and lots of humor. Prove that you are the best director! 🎬

3617990.title: Star Wrath
3617990.short_description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

3618040.title: Star Pulse:The War
3618040.short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.

3620530.title: Police Stories 2
3620530.short_description: Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Command the grittiest precinct in town in Police Stories 2 - a brutal tactical top-down shooter where arrest is the goal, force is the last resort, and every decision has an outcome.

3620610.title: Primal Survival
3620610.short_description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

3620860.title: Kung Fu Addiction
3620860.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

3621350.title: Apprentice of Darkness
3621350.short_description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

3621690.title: My Eerie Lair
3621690.short_description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

3622370.title: Trick Eight
3622370.short_description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

3622430.title: Study Abroad Simulator
3622430.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

3623100.title: INNERWHY
3623100.short_description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

3623230.title: Midnight Souvenirs
3623230.short_description: Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist! Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.

3623360.title: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach
3623360.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator. Put 1,000+ scattered objects where they belong using physics and your trusty van. Decorate however you want. Throw it. Organize it. Clean it. Help your aunt clean up this mess! Oh, and don’t forget your aunt’s grumpy chicken. She’s not exactly in the mood to help.

3625230.title: Bloomcraft
3625230.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

3625700.title: Loot, Dungeons and Riches
3625700.short_description: Manage a party of adventurers and delve into the dungeon. As you progress, you will meet new enemies, new gear, a variety of dungeon systems.

3627280.title: Get It Up!
3627280.short_description: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ ㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

3627690.title: Ramen Crisis
3627690.short_description: It’s a wacky ramen delivery action game! Hop on your scooter and deliver towering stacks of ramen without toppling them! Hurry up before the soup gets cold!

3627840.title: Waddle & Rescue
3627840.short_description: Waddle & Rescue is a sliding puzzle logic 3D game, where you'll take control of Teo the Penguin, a cute but brave adventurer, in his mission to rescue all the lost penguins around the world. Waddle your way across different biomes, sliding and solving puzzles in order to find his lost pals.

3628590.title: Too Big To Fail
3628590.short_description: Welcome to the firm. You and your friends get the worst desks in the building and one account between you. Trade, deal, cheat, invest, gamble. The market was made to be exploited. Do well and the firm will be yours, then the world, eventually.

3629320.title: Astrocraft
3629320.short_description: A first-person space station tycoon. Mine asteroids, build production lines, and run a shop for the ships that land. No conveyor belts: a crew of robots does the work, and you tune the flow by what each pallet calls for. Build at your own pace, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

3629880.title: Eye of Khaos
3629880.short_description: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

3630200.title: 妖恋西游
3630200.short_description: Transmigrated into the world of Journey to the West, you find that the gods, Buddhas, and yokai have all become girls—and you're their "new master"! To return to your own world, you set out on the road west once more. A love adventure full of romance and mystery begins here......

3631690.title: PhantomZone SemiDeus
3631690.short_description: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

3631820.title: Saintless
3631820.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

3633500.title: Mystic Cleaver
3633500.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

3634470.title: Feodika
3634470.short_description: Live your own story in a world of the early Middle Ages! Lead a dynasty, expand your domain, help your subjects, and don’t forget to leave an heir! Thy Kingdom Come!

3634500.title: LIMINAL CAT
3634500.short_description: A cat wakes up in a beautiful yet eerie world. In search of an exit, it wanders, beginning its lonely adventure. This is an adventure game featuring a cat influenced by various liminal spaces.

3634710.title: DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike
3634710.short_description: Grab your balls and set sail on your 'pirate' minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball & Pachinko, with turn-based combat whilst collecting game altering balls, relics, & runes that ensure no two runs are alike.

3634730.title: Geritmia
3634730.short_description: An incremental game where you mine, fight and grow stronger while the World Eater devours everything behind you faster and faster.

3635740.title: Subjectivation
3635740.short_description: Subjectivation is a first person horror adventure game set in a snow-covered town frozen in time. Solve puzzles, manage your body heat, and defend yourself from the warped inhabitants of the frostbitten city. Explore the town’s past - and shape its future with your actions.

3636100.title: SHEEP
3636100.short_description: SHEEP is a surreal first-person action-adventure. When an eclipse darkens the farm, you set out with your flock and a ghost sheep named Woolsworth. Beyond the pastures, living crystals rise from fallen stones, while a celestial entity lies in waiting.

3638070.title: Hermit Computer
3638070.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

3638080.title: Outcity
3638080.short_description: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!

3639200.title: Missing body
3639200.short_description: One body, 6 parts. Find them all! Missing body is a team-based multiplayer horror game where investigators recover a victim's remains while the murderers hunt them down. Proximity chat, unique abilities, and murderers in the dark.

3640270.title: Hunter's Hand
3640270.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every clue you uncover wakes the thing hunting you. Build a lethal deck across branching paths, weather corrupting biomes, and raise the Threat - then discover how much of an Ancient's attention you can survive.

3640280.title: Echoes of the Core
3640280.short_description: Echoes of the Core is a third-person platformer set in the planet's deepest reaches, where every descent is a mission, every step could be your last, and every discovery could change everything.

3640880.title: Tamabuki
3640880.short_description: A survival horror where your key to making it through the Depths is taking care of the Homunculus housed within your Tamabuki. Devastating abilities are powered by this dwarf within the chassis, but forget to feed them and they might just end up eating you.

3640990.title: Clash of Melodies
3640990.short_description: A Visual Novel Rhythm Game that tells the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together. Play the DDR / FNF inspired Arrow Mode and the original Circle Mode. Enjoy the story or go for a highscore in Freeplay.

3641250.title: FISH³: FISHTASTIC FISHING FISHSCAPES
3641250.short_description: FISH³ is high-octane, surreal speed-fishing adventure where your boat is powered by fish! Engage in time-attack stages, dual-rod fishing, and underwater spear-fishing in a dreamlike world teeming with bizarre aquatic creatures.

3644010.title: Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul
3644010.short_description: Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul is a 2D Survival Horror RPG mixing turn-based combat with real-time elements and hand-drawn art, set in 13th century France during a crusade against heresy. Slash, parry, and collect items to survive to see the end, whatever it may be. Find absolution or damnation.

3644020.title: Cleaner Company
3644020.short_description: Star Wipers, ready your mops! Cleaner Company is a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean abandoned space stations, alien outposts, and infested restaurants across the galaxy... starting with the corpses of your predecessors.

3645410.title: Midgardr
3645410.short_description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

3646330.title: Lords of Pain
3646330.short_description: Lead a party of adventurers who explore and fight on their own in this fantasy auto-battler RPG. Shape their builds, craft equipment, manage supplies, and climb 100 floors to challenge the Lord of Pain.

3647070.title: Detachment Crew
3647070.short_description: Control a crew of outcasts and try to destroy the mining tower that is corrupting the environment. Many tried before, many failed. Surely this is a good idea. A sci-fi dungeon crawling game with handmade visuals, real time combat and unique exploration options.

3648350.title: Dream Walker
3648350.short_description: "Dream Walker" is an RPG game that combines survival, scavenging for extraction, and turn-based combat. Every time you explore within the dream, you might acquire valuable treasures, but you could also lose everything.

3648530.title: Coin War
3648530.short_description: A new twist on the StS-like genre: the cards you play transform into units on a grid-based board for several turns! Coin War delivers unique mechanics, tactical combat, endless synergies, and immense strategic depth. Craving a new challenge in the StS-like genre? Give this one a try.

3648820.title: Directive: Intercept
3648820.short_description: Protect Earth's last cities from an alien fleet in fast-paced aerial combat. Upgrade and customize your aircraft to dominate the skies.

3648840.title: SPIDER HOTEL
3648840.short_description: Misfit bugs vs. Giant Spider in an asymmetrical game of tag! Cooperate to survive, or become the spider and hunt! The spider crawls on walls to capture prey. The bugs must rescue friends using teamwork. Escape the trap-filled hotel in a thrilling, hilarious survival game!

3649670.title: PayGame
3649670.short_description: 💸《PayGame》is a black-and-white hand-drawn dungeon exploration game.You must race against time through randomly generated rooms, combining items and bills to pay massive amounts of money in order to stay alive.Each run offers a brand-new challenge and a completely different experience

3649680.title: Tiny Shop: make it cozy
3649680.short_description: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

3650330.title: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
3650330.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

3650410.title: Cellscape
3650410.short_description: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

3650730.title: Miniwars
3650730.short_description: A digital turn-based strategy board game where you battle opponents, expand territory, and outsmart rivals in a tactical, tile-based warfare game.

3651370.title: Sombie
3651370.short_description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

3651840.title: Socialiskigrad
3651840.short_description: Welcome to the Republic of Socialiskigrad, a budding nation to shape with bags of cement! Build working-class districts, develop national industry, and govern the metropolises of each region. Only you can become the shining President the country deserves!

3653480.title: Time Survivor
3653480.short_description: Time drains your life away. Dodge, dash, and blast through enemies and brutal bosses. Collect resources to stay alive and grow stronger through a massive skill tree, unlocking a lot of new mechanics to master. Fight Time and its Time Keepers. How long can you last?

3655100.title: Worker: 7549
3655100.short_description: 7549 was produced as one of the worker-class servants. It continued to take orders from the humans who created it until the mine transformed from a peaceful workplace into a stronghold of rebellion.

3655270.title: Wildseed
3655270.short_description: Wildseed is a relaxing game where you grow plants and build your garden into a haven for cute animals. Keep your animals happy and your plants healthy, find rare variants, and discover the ancient secrets your garden holds - one seed at a time.

3656070.title: Don't Mind the Robots
3656070.short_description: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

3656210.title: Bōlíng: Beyond Samsara
3656210.short_description: The Shanhai Continent is dying. Ancient divine beasts are imprisoned as living batteries — their souls fuel civilization itself. You are Jiaomujiao, a shard of the Azure Dragon, first to awaken. Claws. Five elements. One hook. Tear open the iron curtain of Chinese steampunk.

3656330.title: GAZAR
3656330.short_description: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter: one prototype fighter, the Nova-X, against an unstoppable alien fleet. Battle through a 4-galaxy Story Mode or test your skills in the endless Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and local and global leaderboards.

3656610.title: Laser Guy
3656610.short_description: A twin-stick anti-shooter where you’re maneuvering your laser around coworkers trying not to blast anyone. Just another day in the gamedev office!

3659190.title: TechRunners
3659190.short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

3660710.title: Armatus
3660710.short_description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

3660840.title: Digopolis
3660840.short_description: Explore, dig and gather treasures to fuel your evergrowing lust for wealth.

3661590.title: Through Hell and Back
3661590.short_description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

3661680.title: Brink of Broken
3661680.short_description: A turn-based RPG in a world already ruined! The weapons you pick up are plentiful but fragile, you must break your foes before your weapons shatter! Explore the land in search of permanent power-ups, or win your battles with strategy alone!

3662260.title: High Tide
3662260.short_description: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

3662770.title: Frogspin
3662770.short_description: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

3665130.title: Beyond Faded Voices
3665130.short_description: Experience moments in a third-person story about my passed away parents and my british cat Zeus. It's a mix of adventure, cat simulator and even Tower Defence and first person bodycam. Be the cat - sleep, sharp your claws, eat, be petted by parents and misbehave in a few hours!!

3666790.title: In Time
3666790.short_description: In Time is a 4 player online co-op adventure. Chronosyn’s strange machine has brought back the dinosaurs, and only you and your team can set things back to normal. Explore an ever-changing environment and make it back to the machine all while hungry predators stalk your path.

3667410.title: Kodas Nereus
3667410.short_description: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

3667460.title: Tails & Talons
3667460.short_description: The tower gets stronger. So does your hand. Every card is an attack, a spell, or both. Chain the right combo and turn a scratch into a killing blow. Play as one of a crew of furry adventurers who descend into an eldritch tower, each with their own reasons, one shared goal: reach the bottom.

3667750.title: SatW Guesser
3667750.short_description: SatW Guesser is a geography-based quiz game that challenges your knowledge of world flags and country locations. You’ll be shown a flag or a highlighted country on a world map, and your task is to pick which country it belongs to.

3668380.title: Marked
3668380.short_description: Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

3668730.title: San Bernardino
3668730.short_description: Join the San Bernardino neighborhood watch as you try to save your overpriced house from zombies and dinosaurs.

3669890.title: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes
3669890.short_description: Pilot a lone ship through a collapsing orbital station in a modern 2.5D shoot ’em up. Block bullets with a 360° directional shield, destroy grotesque wreck-born enemies, defeat colossal bosses, and build new upgrade paths with every run — a love letter to classic shoot ’em ups.

3671320.title: We Need An Army
3671320.short_description: A tactical roguelike where your entire army moves as one! Shift your formation, line up powerful bonuses, and discover ridiculous combinations of units, relics, and battlefield upgrades.

3671750.title: Ashes & Blood
3671750.short_description: Ashes & Blood is a fantasy strategy RPG blending fast-paced tactical battles, 4X-inspired strategy, and roguelite progression. Break the rules, build absurd combos, uncover Varyndel's secrets, and unlock even more chaos with each expedition. Turn-based strategy has never been this unhinged.

3671780.title: Stranded in the Abyss
3671780.short_description: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

3672670.title: SiegeBorn
3672670.short_description: SiegeBorn is a top-down action RTS. Lead your troops, command powerful siege engines, and defeat the enemies!

3673010.title: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum
3673010.short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Rogue-Like First Person Arena fighter. Battle through hordes of enemies. In this cruel coliseum, it's a free-for-all. You choose where to fight and who to fight at the right moment, with the aid of Magic Crystals that give single use weapons and tools.

3673500.title: BACKROOMS
3673500.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

3674210.title: B-Ricky High School
3674210.short_description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

3674790.title: Russian Survivors
3674790.short_description: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

3674940.title: Do Crimes!
3674940.short_description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

3676080.title: World In The Abyss
3676080.short_description: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

3676530.title: JohnJohnson: Remnant
3676530.short_description: They were made to entertain. But now they want to smash and kill.

3676670.title: Ashborn
3676670.short_description: A demanding roguelite Souls-like in 3rd person view. Dodge, hit, die and start again in a dark and broken world.

3676680.title: Temple of Glyphs
3676680.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

3678480.title: Hexora
3678480.short_description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

3679060.title: Bloodpact
3679060.short_description: Cut down endless demon hordes, unlock new abilities as you level and grow stronger by forging bloodpacts with archdemons.

3679610.title: Velthos
3679610.short_description: Survive overwhelming hordes in a magical action roguelite! Discover spellbooks, transform into a giant, turn enemies into chickens, combine devastating spells, and outsmart powerful bosses. Every disaster has a spell. Can you find it?

3679870.title: 02:17 AM
3679870.short_description: A remote forest lookout fell silent at 02:17 AM. Follow the missing keeper’s trail, restore the radio and piece together the clues in an atmospheric first-person mystery. No combat or jump scares.

3679890.title: Blotbarrow
3679890.short_description: Odin sacrificed the gods to thwart Ragnarök. Now you're what's left. Tear through the Nine Realms in this fast-paced, hack and slash roguelite. Wield legendary weapons. Gain the powers of the fallen gods. Die. Come back stronger. Die again. Storm the Blotbarrow and end the All-Father.

3680120.title: Gendo The Gatherer
3680120.short_description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

3680200.title: Clowntown
3680200.short_description: A co-op minigame campaign where the minigames play you! Collaborate (or sabotage) your way through action puzzles and evolving minigames that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking for 2-8 friends.

3680470.title: Touhou Dream Duel
3680470.short_description: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

3681610.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
3681610.short_description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

3683200.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
3683200.short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

3683820.title: 轮回江湖
3683820.short_description: 2D挂机沙盒武侠网游无货币纯材料交易

3684130.title: Trash Panda Bonanza
3684130.short_description: Adopt a mischievous raccoon that lives right on your desktop. Recycle junk into coins, unlock cosmetics through mystery boxes, pick up randomly appearing junk, and even pet your new raccoon buddy!

3684990.title: Apogee
3684990.short_description: You wake up in a failing aircraft at 75,000 feet. No memory. No flight log. No rescue coming. Keep systems running and sweep for data to stay airborne. Explore a forgotten network of high-altitude stations and follow a signal that's been waiting forty-one years for someone to listen.

3685040.title: Type & Magic
3685040.short_description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

3685680.title: Night At The Mall
3685680.short_description: A psychological horror job sim. Complete security maintenance in a sprawling, desolate mall while surviving creeping, unpredictable threats. Manage electrical systems, monitor CCTV cameras, and survive a night shift where you never know what is lurking in the dark.

3686130.title: Slopeside Kings
3686130.short_description: Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racer for up to four players, where you shred the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost. Pickup and use chaotic items along the slopes to battle your way to the finish line!

3686720.title: Find Alien
3686720.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op stealth game. Copy the appearance of Earthlings, hide your true identity, avoid surveillance and traps, rescue your captured alien friends, and escape together.

3686810.title: Cave Trek
3686810.short_description: Dig passages, build footholds, and find your way past monsters and traps in CaveTrek, a single-player roguelike platformer. Explore randomized pixel caves, gather treasure, and spend it on supplies. Every shovel use counts. How much will you risk on the way to the exit?

3687370.title: The Borderless: Cozy Island Simulator
3687370.short_description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

3687830.title: Mulerun – Retro Bootlegger Simulator
3687830.short_description: Build a moonshine empire in the 1980s. Brew, bottle, deliver, and protect your cargo as you grow from a dusty village to Mulerun City. Outsmart your ankle monitor, take risky deals, and smuggle by land, sea, and air while caught between the CIA and the cartel. Solo or 4-player co-op.

3687890.title: COTS
3687890.short_description: Step into a chicken-themed tower-defense roguelike where you build and upgrade your coop, think up strategies during the day, and hope to survive when night falls. Wild predators lurk in the dark, ready to tear down your defenses! COTS is action, strategy, collectible cards…and of course, CHICKENS!

3688090.title: One Summer Holiday
3688090.short_description: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic summer vacation of rural comfort. A timeless place of natural beauty, rich conversations, quiet occurrences and indulgent detail and delight awaits you in One Summer Holiday.

3688200.title: Knight life tavern
3688200.short_description: Cook and brew endlessly, desperately trying to serve a never ending stream of customers with a temper. The medieval knight is hard to please and very vocal about his disdain for goblins and the like. Make sure everyone enjoys eachother's company, and kick the trouble makers through the front door!

3688500.title: Merchant Miles
3688500.short_description: A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.

3688510.title: Ruling Horsestown
3688510.short_description: Be a horse mayor! Make the best choices in this casual comedy management game, try not to lose, and govern the chaotic city of Horsestown where new absurd decisions and eccentric characters await you.

3691230.title: Precious Feather
3691230.short_description: Hunt for the perfect feather. Feed what's waiting at home. Sleep if you can. The rent will be due.

3692020.title: Exodus Core
3692020.short_description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

3692400.title: NuTREEnts
3692400.short_description: NuTREEnts is a strategic tower defense roguelike about growing and expanding your forest. Plant saplings, fend off bugs, and explore a desolate planet while you grow a mighty colony of trees!

3692740.title: LIGHTPUNK: Law of Inertia
3692740.short_description: Forced to abandon Inertium, Barnicle Strass returns to Quark Corp to salvage his legacy. But inside this heavy steampunk facility, a different reality awaits. As the sole carbon lifeform among light entities, he must navigate the machinery. Inside these walls, LIGHT IS ALL THAT'S LEFT.

3694460.title: The Rift Machine
3694460.short_description: The Rift Machine is an incremental game where you extract resources from inter-dimensional anomalies. Build modular defenses, research advanced technology, automate complex systems, and scale your operation into an unstoppable anomaly-harvesting engine.

3694930.title: KEGGER
3694930.short_description: Race to deliver kegs. Shove your friends into trouble. KEGGER is a competitive party game for 1–4 local players: dodge traffic, catch moving boats, and recover your keg before time runs out. Fight for the most deliveries across 16 boards. Play solo or bring the crew.

3698630.title: COLDNIGHTS
3698630.short_description: Learn how to survive, craft and build the essentials, find source of food and construct necessary shelter before the snow starts falling. And may be someday, after building a bridge, you will find your way back home. Keep building bridges.

3700120.title: Magic Kingdom
3700120.short_description: Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

3700200.title: The Last Captain
3700200.short_description: Embark on missions across an explorable star sector in this tactical, space RPG. Directly control your ship and its arsenal of point defense and special equipment in a dynamic environment. Use your hard-earned rewards to upgrade your ship, customize its modules, and lead allies in epic fleet combat.

3700510.title: Vironics
3700510.short_description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

3701180.title: Car Rental Simulator
3701180.short_description: Run your own car rental lot in this detailed simulator. Manage reservations, clean and service vehicles, and keep customers happy. With time-based tasks, strategy elements, and high replayability, every day brings a new challenge.

3702000.title: God Is Not Here
3702000.short_description: “My God, my God… why have You forsaken me?” — Psalm 22:1. Words spoken by Jesus Christ on the cross before His death.

3704080.title: Plague Genesis
3704080.short_description: A night in the forest becomes a fight for survival. Face brutal creatures, explore disturbing places, and uncover the experiments and secrets hidden behind the GENOCYTE Corporation in this 2D pixel-art survival horror.

3704330.title: Dwarf Boozter
3704330.short_description: Return Dwarven ale legacy Brawler-action with roguelite elements about Dwarf adventures through fantasy taverns. Loot, fight and upgrade.

3704770.title: Die Robot
3704770.short_description: Build traps. Fight bots. Survive the waves. Die Robot is a stylized third-person tower defense game where you defend a mysterious Data Seed from waves of robots, the Carbonites. Mix real-time base building with fast-paced combat in a strategic fight for survival.

3705410.title: Hundredfold: Hero's Ascent
3705410.short_description: Hero, the hundred-floor abyss awaits. Keep jumping down, dodge enemy attacks, and use special platforms to fight back. No grand prophecy. No complicated mission. Just one hero, one adventure, and 100 floors of monsters to beat.

3705670.title: DEAD SPIN
3705670.short_description: Gamble your way through a deadly casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Survive the campaign or challenge other players in PvP mode. Discover broken synergies and keep spinning for your freedom!

3706580.title: Alpa
3706580.short_description: Alpa is a narrative adventure game blending atmospheric exploration, emotional storytelling, and puzzle-solving across the journey of three intertwined souls.

3708610.title: TAKE THEM DOWN
3708610.short_description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

3709870.title: Nightmare Diver
3709870.short_description: "Nightmare Diver" is a roguelite shooting game where a rubber duck dives into the world of nightmares to save a young girl from her bad dreams, defeating enemies along the way.

3710600.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
3710600.short_description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

3710850.title: Become
3710850.short_description: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

3712610.title: Apollyon
3712610.short_description: 1979. P.L.U.T.O keeps sending your team of researchers back through G.A.T.E into the backrooms for deeper expeditions, but they are never happy with the lengths you go to. Nearest exit gets your team back safe. Only the deepest exit will suffice.

3713240.title: Last Drone War
3713240.short_description: You lose the war! Pilot FPV drones, helicopters, and fighter jets to unleash devastating firepower - and become a true ACE of modern warfare.

3713920.title: Dealer Shift
3713920.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

3713980.title: Crinchure Collector
3713980.short_description: A Gacha-Inspired Collectathon Game - FREE PULLS FOR LIFE!! Hundreds of cute Crinchures, sweet Swords, incredible Ingredients and more to collect, with a short novels's worth of flavor text, events, and lore! Experience the joy of ripping packs, without those pesky microtransactions!

3714280.title: FLASK
3714280.short_description: A roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

3714420.title: Delta
3714420.short_description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

3715240.title: Hello Space
3715240.short_description: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

3715810.title: Sinking Eternity
3715810.short_description: Sinking Eternity is a single-player underwater exploration RPG. Survive extreme depths, hide from dangerous sea creatures, and uncover the secrets of a civilization lost for millennia.

3717660.title: Project SARA
3717660.short_description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

3717830.title: GRINDWORM
3717830.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

3718600.title: Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us
3718600.short_description: A tactical 3D top-down zombie shooter with an innovative Field-of-View system. Tasked by researchers, you must uncover the cause of the zombie outbreak while managing scarce ammo, using tactics, melee, and grenades to survive endless waves.

3718720.title: Proxima B
3718720.short_description: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

3718800.title: Deckanism: Singularity Island
3718800.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

3719850.title: V/V
3719850.short_description: A fast paced 2d Precision Platformer game where you must move dash and jump your way through platforms that begin to decay after you touch them.

3720250.title: Miscreant
3720250.short_description: You're a rogue-in-training trying to break into a legendary vault under your school. Explore the danger-filled academy after curfew to find 100 keys hidden behind puzzles and traps, and even trapped puzzles.

3720620.title: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
3720620.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

3722100.title: Match & Magic
3722100.short_description: Match & Magic is a roguelike match-n adventure. Players defeat enemies and cast skills by matching tiles while climbing randomly generated towers. With cute cartoon visuals, it offers unique runs, loot, upgrades, strategy and high replayability.

3722460.title: 五维介质：重生（Medium5: Rebirth）
3722460.short_description: "Medium5: Rebirth" is an AVG produced by Beichen, also the first MEDIUM5 fan game with a complete world view. Through QTE and other game-play interspersed in the plot, players will experience a journey on "Shulv Planet". This game will show you the charm and another possibility of MEDIUM5.

3723090.title: Computer Manufacturer
3723090.short_description: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

3723270.title: BeNormal
3723270.short_description: Be Normal is a comedy simulation game where you send an agent to infiltrate human society and pave the way for an alien invasion. From the cockpit of your spaceship, you can give your agent voice commands. The key is to convince the earthlings that you're a perfectly normal human.

3723950.title: Last Survivor: Day on Earth
3723950.short_description: Blast through endless waves of enemies and evolve into an unstoppable force! This chaotic roguelike shooter lets you survive solo or in 2–4 player co-op, where every upgrade choice shapes your build in a battlefield swarming with monsters.

3725170.title: Riftveil
3725170.short_description: A dark fantasy rogue-lite action RPG with adaptive difficulty, dual parry combat, and structured runs full of brutal enemies and boss fights.

3725320.title: Creep Tank
3725320.short_description: Build and customize your own arcane aquarium in this cozy collection/idler game. Use your magic to summon juvenile cute creepy fish. Tend to them and watch them grow. Make discoveries, expand your collection, decorate your tanks with art and plants.

3725710.title: Supermarket Simulator Deluxe
3725710.short_description: Pizza Clicker is an Incremental Idle Game! Build the ultimate pizza empire! Click pizzas, earn slices, buy upgrades, automate production, and grow from a small pizzeria into a massive pizza making machine.

3725830.title: Citrus Summer
3725830.short_description: Citrus Summer is a yuri visual novel set in the urban workplace. Play as Rachel, a single corporate worker stuck in overtime, and navigate unexpected romance with three women—a sharp boutique owner, a talented new colleague, or your childhood best friend. Your choices decide whose heart you capture.

3726090.title: Leyline Chronicles 2
3726090.short_description: A JRPG with a dynamic, action-oriented tactical battle system and a diverse cast of unique characters, featuring a multi-world-spanning storyline that brings the epic saga of Leyline Chronicles to its grand conclusion.

3726100.title: Forestless
3726100.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric, high-speed 3D action-adventure. Journey through a world of inner doubts armed with the Arrow of Hope: ignite lanterns in full stride to gain momentum, traverse procedural mazes of memory, and shatter the shackles of negative beliefs.

3726740.title: Blue Book
3726740.short_description: Blue Book is a sci-fi detective quest with point'n'click elements, where there are no hints, there are false clues and only your conclusion. Analyze testimonies, find inconsistencies, follow the logic. Become an FBI agent and unravel a chain of mysterious disappearances in a quiet American town.

3727410.title: FriendOS
3727410.short_description: FriendOS is a 1-3 player action RPG where viruses must die! Strike and batter your opponents in Cartoon Sports Combat, and create the virtual animal avatar of your dreams. Hang out in lobbies with up to 12 friends and team up to protect the world of FriendOS from virus corruption.

3727600.title: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game
3727600.short_description: ALL THE PROMISED BURN is a hand-drawn, Knowledge-based narrative RPG about what an assassin does after the War ends. Can you learn new ways to be, when the past is still burned into you?

3727650.title: Forest Keeper Lookout
3727650.short_description: Take a temporary job as a forest ranger deep in the mountains. Complete daily tasks, maintain equipment, and enjoy the quiet, until strange things start to happen.

3728550.title: Console Dealer Simulator
3728550.short_description: A store simulator game where you manage your own game shop by buying and selling console games. Manage inventory, meet customer needs, and expand your shop. Playable in single-player or multiplayer mode.

3729110.title: Basefall
3729110.short_description: A competitive multiplayer strategy game blending lane combat and dynamic upgrades. Spawn units, unlock spells, and create insane build synergies to destroy the enemy castle.

3729930.title: The Mirage Project
3729930.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

3730210.title: Metal Soldiers 3D
3730210.short_description: Blast through a rebel army across 50+ levels in this side-scrolling run-and-gun. Pilot tanks and mechs, upgrade your weapons, and take down powerful bosses in a 2.5D arcade action adventure.

3730340.title: Cannabiz: Weed Shop Owner
3730340.short_description: Build, customise, and grow your cannabis empire from a tiny shop to a booming city-wide business! 🌿💼

3731460.title: Troop vs Troop
3731460.short_description: Tactical turn-based combat in WW2. Lead U.S. infantry, tanks, and artillery through procedurally generated battlefields. Use cover and clever tactics to outmaneuver German forces.

3732810.title: Deadhold
3732810.short_description: Deadhold is a roguelite zombie survival/strategy game where your choices impact who lives and who dies. Rescue survivors, scavenge resources, fortify your base, and protect your community against stress, infection, and zombies! Can you find a sense of normalcy in this cruel new world?

3733250.title: Where the Chips Fall
3733250.short_description: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with your abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

3733660.title: IsekaIdle
3733660.short_description: A fantasy idle progression game inspired by deep skill-based systems. Train skills through use, conquer dungeons, manage your settlement, and optimize every system at your own pace, with no prestige resets and permanent progression.

3734220.title: Guns of Eschaton
3734220.short_description: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

3734300.title: Don't Get Fired!
3734300.short_description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

3734580.title: My Axion Shop
3734580.short_description: Build your own Axion shop, collect rare parts, create powerful combinations, and battle your way to becoming a Pro Axioner! My Axion Shop offers a unique gaming experience blending strategy, trading, and collection elements.

3734940.title: Hextalia
3734940.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

3735080.title: Bookie
3735080.short_description: The horse racing roguelike, with cards. Bookie is a fast paced deckbuilder game, in which you build your own stable of horses and try to figure out which one will win the race. Manipulate the odds by modifying the cards and buying game-changing charms that will help you get all the trophies!

3738120.title: First Age
3738120.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

3738550.title: Super Kart Blast
3738550.short_description: Super Kart Blast allows you to experience a unique way of kart racer with customizable karts, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!

3738890.title: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
3738890.short_description: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

3739840.title: Battlecaster 2
3739840.short_description: Battlecaster 2 is an intense top-down action roguelite. Descend to the center of a hostile world where control, precision, and aggression decide every fight. Push forward and dismantle enemy pressure through skillful play. Shape powerful, expressive builds as danger rises.

3739920.title: math is hard
3739920.short_description: math is hard is a sokoban-style puzzle game where the numbers are blocks you push around until the math works out. Line them up into equations, hit the target value, and master special blocks that change the rules.

3740710.title: Fireteam Breach
3740710.short_description: Fireteam Breach is a competitive 5v5 PvPvE tactical shooter built on destruction. Every round plays like an operation gone wrong. Civilians panic and get in the way. Get reckless, and they call the police, who can turn the round. Play by day, at dusk, or in a night storm where the power fails.

3741240.title: Jesus Christ: Necromancer
3741240.short_description: This is a fast, brutal gothic metroidvania: reap the damned with the scythe, raise their bones to fight beside you, grow stronger at every shrine, and carve your way through a dead [un]holy city to the Four Horsemen. Jesus is back... and he's back for Blood.

3745430.title: Rustborn - Outland Threat
3745430.short_description: You’re a cowboy abducted by aliens who accidentally ends up with a biomechanical arm. Run, climb, and shoot like crazy to survive hordes of deadly robots in this third-person bullet-hell shooter. Conquer the mothership and find your way back home!

3748050.title: Grav My Balls
3748050.short_description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

3749480.title: Drudgemark
3749480.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

3749580.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
3749580.short_description: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!

3749760.title: Sushi On Wheels
3749760.short_description: Sushi On Wheels is a cozy management game where you run your dream sushi truck business in a Japanese setting inspired by the real life Izu Peninsula. Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals as you travel around Japan and complete your grandmother’s dream!

3751230.title: Danganronpa 2x2
3751230.short_description: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

3753100.title: Drift.Wav II
3753100.short_description: Drift.Wav II - a synth-wave inspired drifting game that does not attempt to emulate actual drifting mechanics. But more serve as a fun game to slide around in single-player or multiplayer with over 200 car options, work your way to the top of our many leader-board's.

3753840.title: FrostBite
3753840.short_description: You buy your grandfathers house again after he died, but that was the biggest mistake you ever made. You listen to the tape the previous owner left behind and find the secrets of this old looking cabin.

3755200.title: Cannon Keep
3755200.short_description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

3755250.title: Life Overhaul
3755250.short_description: Design, build, and live the ultimate garage life. Create vehicles, trailers, and homes from scratch, customize every detail, and shape your own open world. Play solo or host friends in a growing community-driven sandbox of creativity and craftsmanship.

3755560.title: Lots at Stake
3755560.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

3758850.title: Kui & Chai: Evolution Survivors
3758850.short_description: Kui and Chai is a single human survivor game that collects various materials, strengthens itself, defeats evolving enemies, and perseveres until the last moment, perhaps knowing the truth of everything.

3758980.title: NO STRAIGHT ROADS 2
3758980.short_description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

3760470.title: Boy Escape from School
3760470.short_description: Help the Kid escape from school by solving puzzles and riddles in the latest installment of this thrilling adventure series! You’ll need wit, attention to detail, and ingenuity to break out of the locked school.

3760540.title: Dungeon Manager
3760540.short_description: This is a PVE auto Battler! Right after graduating from the management school but before getting degree certificate, you are snatched away by a red dragon and forced to be a dungeon manager. You need to fighting against the invaders of the evil empire together with the cute creatures in the dungeon.

3760980.title: DeckTerra
3760980.short_description: DeckTerra is a 4X strategy game built around cards. Explore procedurally generated maps, research new technologies, develop your settlements, and raise armies all while building a deck that complements your strategy.

3761130.title: Ash and Flame
3761130.short_description: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

3764180.title: Lone City
3764180.short_description: Lone City blends romance, shooting and survival in a post-apocalyptic open world. Explore ruins, scavenge supplies and fight zombies and mutants. Drive a sports car through the city with your dog. At home, grow closer to beautiful women with distinct personalities and build a life together.

3764290.title: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
3764290.short_description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

3764730.title: Winter Resort Simulator 3
3764730.short_description: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

3765000.title: Seaworks: Trap Season
3765000.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

3765610.title: Desktop Pet Engine
3765610.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

3766630.title: OCULUM
3766630.short_description: OCULUM is a challenging first-person platformer set within a strange and unsettling world. Every step is a gamble, and every mistake is brutal. Climb toward the summit, uncover its secrets, and face whatever is waiting above. Will you endure?

3766830.title: Grow a Girlfriend
3766830.short_description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.

3767190.title: Untamed Ehizia
3767190.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

3768050.title: Top Drifters
3768050.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".

3768570.title: Neon Dash
3768570.short_description: Neon Dash is a Retro-Futurism style rhythm platformer game. Get past challenging obstacles to the music's beat, and journey back to the dreamy 80s to push your limits!

3768690.title: Hookah Simulator
3768690.short_description: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

3768880.title: Torebia Online
3768880.short_description: Torebia: Island Odyssey is an old-school sandbox MMORPG. No classes, no pay-to-win. Craft, fight, trade, and rise through the Adventurer's Guild ranks your way. One shared world. Pure adventure.

3769010.title: Nildigo
3769010.short_description: Spicy-zen puzzle roguelite with dangerous money grids, hundreds of Perks and Powers, and a high degree of exponential breakability.

3769800.title: Elevator
3769800.short_description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

3769870.title: RUNE GUNNER
3769870.short_description: RUNE GUNNER is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you combine guns and magic to create game-breaking synergies. Each room hits harder, so you must mix classes mid-run and collect runes to become overpowered.

3770340.title: Bull Gone Wild
3770340.short_description: Play as a bull where you build momentum, chain attacks, and slam into enemies as everything around you explode into chaos. It’s all about feeling powerful, out of control in a good way, and turning every fight into something loud, messy, and fun.

3771500.title: One Matter, One Hexagram
3771500.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

3776320.title: Fawn's Gambit
3776320.short_description: Guided by fate, you enter a mysterious card-and-board battle. Collect monster cards, build your deck, defeat legendary heroes, and uncover buried secrets. When the truth emerges, you will fight alongside heroes of old against the darkness.

3777040.title: The Alchemist Of Alderglen
3777040.short_description: The Alchemist of Alderglen is an alchemist simulator where you nurture rare plants, harvest exotic ingredients, and brew potions using your recipe book and alchemy tools. Unlock new plants, upgrade your workspace and run a thriving potion shop.

3780570.title: pond thing
3780570.short_description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It follows Shen Qingheng, a narcissistic young man who is drawn into a sacrificial ritual. As his mind grows numb and begins to break down, he is ultimately saved by his family’s “love.”

3780750.title: Flarebound
3780750.short_description: Tiny dungeon puzzle game. One flare. Ten steps. Draw a path through a forgotten dungeon before your light runs out. Avoid dangerous traps and evil creatures. 20 quests, 100 rooms.

3781790.title: Eternal Anima
3781790.short_description: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

3782570.title: Mystery of Prophecy
3782570.short_description: Mystery of Prophecy is a pixel art Metroidvania based on biblical prophecies, health, and parkour.

3782840.title: Mingle
3782840.short_description: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.

3783630.title: WorldWasGray
3783630.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

3784320.title: Kwad
3784320.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

3784600.title: In a Bleak Midwinter
3784600.short_description: In a Bleak Midwinter is an immersive third person grounded tactical shooter experience set in a real world inspired conflict, where you will survive alone or with others in the frontlines doing assault missions. Push your limits, your glory awaits!

3786640.title: Fred's Idle Garden
3786640.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that sits anywhere on your desktop while you work or do other things. Grow and sell crops in your own little shop, earn coins, unlock upgrades and expand your garden!

3788110.title: DungeonBox
3788110.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

3789600.title: 100 Barcelona Cats
3789600.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

3789620.title: 100 Amsterdam Cats
3789620.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

3789960.title: Varslo Tactics
3789960.short_description: Prove your worth as a commander in this turn-based tactical game with RPG elements! Level up your units to unlock traits and abilities to specialize their tactical usage. Fight to survive as war erupts across the continent!

3790280.title: Over the Radio
3790280.short_description: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

3790670.title: Call Of Resistance
3790670.short_description: Call of Resistance is a real-time tactics game where you lead a group of resistance fighters in occupied France during World War II. Step into the shoes of shadowy heroes and discover the sacrifices and strategies needed to stand against the enemy

3791650.title: Optix: Cinematography Masterclass
3791650.short_description: Optix is a virtual workshop and sandpit that teaches you key concepts and techniques in lighting, camera, and composition. Play through 29 interactive lessons, design shots for clients in endless procedurally-generated scenarios, or experiment freely by building your own scenes from scratch!

3791670.title: Crafters Heaven
3791670.short_description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox where you design and build your own items piece by piece. Create unique weapons, tools and equipment, build your base, fight wild creatures, and explore an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

3791850.title: Instruments of Power
3791850.short_description: Prime the battlefield with the spells you built. Consume what you laid down to summon an army of your selves, then strike the shadows before your tether to this world gives out. A turn-based tactical RPG where every spell you cast is one you built, and every summon is a choice.

3792120.title: Rogue's Odyssey
3792120.short_description: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die, and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG. Combine skills across classes, creating thousands of unique builds, such as a potion-brewing Warrior or a wizardry Cat, the choice is yours!

3793270.title: Bygoner
3793270.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

3794250.title: The Last Tape: Before The Mine
3794250.short_description: Mia Jane disappeared in 1990 during a camping trip. Years later, Gabriel finds her recording while searching for a cure for her infection at the Lurmont facility. Explore two timelines, uncover the hidden truth, and survive the presence that lurks in the shadows of Black Wood.

3794760.title: MonsterGirl 3:Wukong
3794760.short_description: "Monster Girl 3: Wukong" is an interactive narrative game that combines strategic battles with branching storylines. Collect various mystic elixirs for trading, and unlock enchanting demoness characters to keep as desktop companions.

3794850.title: Pay Your Space Debt
3794850.short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

3794870.title: Cyan Breach
3794870.short_description: Cyan Breach is a 2D action RPG set in a post-apocalypse world with classic Castlevania-like combat and exploration. Explore the intersected game world map, defeat enemies, gain unique weapons, skills and items, increase character's power, and finally reveal the secret that caused the apocalypse.

3795610.title: Lightbound : A Rolling Ball Game
3795610.short_description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Solo or split-screen for up to 4 players.

3796480.title: Whale Life Simulator
3796480.short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

3796670.title: The Legend of Simurgh
3796670.short_description: You are a small bird traveling through 7 valleys to find the Simurgh and bring life back to your village.

3796790.title: The Facility
3796790.short_description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

3798350.title: InOut
3798350.short_description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

3798500.title: Tower of Elyndium
3798500.short_description: Tower of Elyndium is a single-player action RPG featuring souls-like combat, where you ascend a mysterious tower. Face challenging enemies and bosses while exploring puzzle-filled floors and uncovering the secrets hidden at the tower’s peak.

3798930.title: Analog - MIRROR
3798930.short_description: An unopened 90s shooter game offers an unexpected distraction during a quiet weekend at home. What seems like a harmless way to pass the time may lead to consequences you never expected.

3801400.title: Sovia: Box & Order
3801400.short_description: Run a busy little paper warehouse. Shelve chilled, fragile and bulky goods, pack the right boxes, rest a tired crew and chain their skills into an ensemble. Follow eight stops to recover a lost route book, then reshape any warehouse in the level editor.

3803380.title: Arena
3803380.short_description: Directional, team-focused medieval PvP. Fight 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 with sword, bow and staff, choose your abilities from a wide selection, and outplay your opponents with timing, reads and teamwork. Climb the ranked ladder. Now in open alpha.

3805400.title: Bonds of the Zodiac
3805400.short_description: Rei, a grieving girl, is drawn into a mystical realm where the Zodiac spirits are bound by the Jade Emperor. Mediate their inner struggles and guide them toward freedom in a first-person journey steeped in myth, conflict, and emotion.

3805460.title: Rookie Taoist
3805460.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

3805560.title: CyberQuest
3805560.short_description: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

3806160.title: electric strategy
3806160.short_description: A turn-based tactics game where every action costs energy. Command robots across a grid-based battlefield, transfer power between units, and help machines reclaim their will.

3806350.title: Harventure
3806350.short_description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

3806530.title: OneMore
3806530.short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

3810050.title: Rabona
3810050.short_description: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.

3810600.title: Reng Azure Requiem
3810600.short_description: No jumping. Only 4-way teleportation. Travel through eras, collect Skill Gravestones, defeat bosses, explore armor sets, and choose your final act in search of resurrection in this 2D pixel art Metroidvania.

3810840.title: Cairns
3810840.short_description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

3812700.title: CORINNE
3812700.short_description: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

3812730.title: SOS (Save Our Ship)
3812730.short_description: SOS is a 4-player online co-op horror-action game. Operate your ship, explore dangerous islands, loot valuable treasures, and escape deadly enemies to repay your soul’s debt. Strategy and teamwork are key to survival!

3814960.title: miniopolis
3814960.short_description: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.

3815360.title: PC Versus
3815360.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

3815560.title: Ashfield Hollow
3815560.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

3817210.title: Unicycle Gorilla
3817210.short_description: Ride a motorized unicycle as a gorilla in Unicycle Gorilla! Casual 3D speedrun with global leaderboards, hilarious crashes, and wild levels. Balance with L1/R1, dodge bombs, and rule the urban jungle!

3818500.title: Ultra Damage
3818500.short_description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy.
