Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

3820000.title: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy
3820000.short_description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true Chess Master!

3820870.title: Gridpaper
3820870.short_description: If you're shooting more than once, you're doing it wrong. At the junction of the physical and informatic realms, Gridpaper is a high-precision FPS headshot speedrunning game where missed shots are punished. Destroy brains, harvest their Informatica for speed, and climb the global leaderboard.

3821020.title: Wheel Wills
3821020.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

3821140.title: The Horror Quest
3821140.short_description: The Horror Quest is a project of a secret organization that creates bloody shows under the guise of games. There are no scripts and safe zones here - only real danger, primal fear and the fight for life. Will you be able to get out of the game alive?

3824000.title: Small Living World 2
3824000.short_description: Is a peaceful ecosystem simulator, bringing every aspect of nature to life. From the water cycle and plant growth, to animal behaviors and reproduction, observe your small living world evolve. All the tools are at your disposal to create your perfect forest.

3824590.title: Decision Point: Battlegroup Operational Simulator
3824590.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

3824720.title: Descent Of Lunaris
3824720.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

3825770.title: 天工骇客 Shadow Hacker
3825770.short_description: Tear through cyberpunk defenses with kung fu and tech in this 3D roguelike fighter with comic-book style! Play as a skilled "cyber-ghost" employee, tearing through the Penglai Corporation's defenses with traditional kung fu, high-tech weaponry, and ancient magic.

3829320.title: Margin of Error
3829320.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this deckb-building roguelite RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the monster makes you pay.

3830030.title: Rollout Rally
3830030.short_description: Race solo or with friends in Rollout Rally, a physics-based marble racing party game. Play with up to 4 players in split-screen on one PC, or up to 6 online or over LAN. Team up in 3v3 races, steer, boost, shove rivals with Pulse, block hits with Shield and roll to victory!

3830400.title: The Calling
3830400.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

3830590.title: Stealing Them Softly
3830590.short_description: A popular Japanese visual novel by Dark One! — a touching story of two people torn by inner conflict and sorrow as they face separation from the one they love. What kind of ending awaits them…?

3830930.title: Mariole
3830930.short_description: MARIOLE is a narrative management game inspired by the traditional culture of the south of France. Take on the role of a young travelling merchant named Mariole, as she journeys through medieval/post-collapse landscapes in search of her friend, a missing ‘Trobairitz’ (a troubadour woman).

3831050.title: Smash Simulator
3831050.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

3831610.title: Yatai Master
3831610.short_description: Run Neko Ramen, the street food stall you inherited in Fukuoka, for one last year. Shop at the markets, cook more than 100 dishes by hand, and get to know 40 regulars who come back night after night with their own stories.

3831690.title: Aftershock
3831690.short_description: An earthquake has just struck the building you’re in — and caught off guard, you’ll have only moments to react. Every step could mean the difference between life and death.

3833200.title: Chest & Blade
3833200.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

3833330.title: The Friendliest Skunk
3833330.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

3834020.title: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
3834020.short_description: Build your own Japanese supermarket! Stock unique products, organize shelves, serve customers, hire staff, set prices, and grow your cozy anime-inspired store into a thriving business. Every decision shapes your supermarket!

3834100.title: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
3834100.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

3834160.title: HOTLIME
3834160.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

3834770.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
3834770.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

3835080.title: Terrafarmer
3835080.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

3835100.title: Pinkwilds
3835100.short_description: A sci-fi multiplayer survival RPG with no guns - fight with weapons and magic instead. Explore an alien world, gather resources, craft gear, and build your base. Trade, form alliances, raid, or betray other players to survive.

3835430.title: Golden Steam
3835430.short_description: Golden Steam is a thrilling arcade-puzzle adventure where you collect Golden Steams and activate machine parts to recover artifacts scattered through fractured time. Navigate 10 worlds, master geometric rotations, and control time itself in a steampunk sci-fi universe where every second counts.

3835520.title: Chess 2048
3835520.short_description: Chess 2048 – Classic chess moves meet fresh puzzle-strategy twists: watch the board reshape, adapt on the fly, and master piece combos. Then escape poison gas, jump between water tiles, use portals, and pull off clever tricks.

3836240.title: Chibi Engine
3836240.short_description: Make your desktop a lively place with cute chibi characters. Pet them, talk to them, give them gifts, and decorate your workspace with image or GIF stickers. Join our community on Steam Workshop to share your own characters and discover what others create

3836360.title: 问仙程
3836360.short_description: 《问仙程》是一款追寻鲜活修仙体验的开放世界角色扮演游戏。你将踏上一段修仙之旅，体验不同寻常的修仙境界、凝练法相真身。与百态角色互动，触发丰富事件——结交仙友、争夺奇遇秘境。你的抉择将深刻改变众生命运，这片开放天地中，是救世之道还是灭世之途？全凭你一念之间！

3836750.title: Uncivilized
3836750.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

3836940.title: Realm Nine
3836940.short_description: On the land of Jiuzhou, there are fragments of your plundered Elf Wings hidden. You will play as five types of real-time shapeshifters and embark on a journey to find the lost fragments.

3837070.title: Enchantalot
3837070.short_description: Strike and enchant weapons on a magic workbench. Each success makes them stronger and worth more - but the higher you climb, the riskier every blow. Send your gear out on quests, collect relics that build on each other, and watch the numbers spiral out of control.

3837160.title: Strawberry Flavor Sci-Fi
3837160.short_description: Like strawberries? If they went extinct, how would we find their taste again? This fundamentalist suspense & sci-fi visual novel lets you step into the shoes of an Ocular to unravel a series of conspiracies woven from tech ethics and human nature in a near-future world that could arrive anytime.

3837280.title: Born Without Rights
3837280.short_description: Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by The Last of Us and Max Payne, experience a tense linear story of survival and resistance in a world without freedom.

3837420.title: Wild Wordopia
3837420.short_description: Language x roguelike. The incarnations of an ancient language (Proto-Indo-European) that is said to have existed about 6,000 years ago are reborn as "Wild Words"!

3837790.title: Fathoms
3837790.short_description: Fathoms: Narrative psychological horror meets anomaly game. Survive 24 days in a row with your wife in an apartment in the underwater city of Fathoms while you lose your mind or die – and the nightmare starts all over again...

3838040.title: Dukun
3838040.short_description: a relentless, psychedelic bullet-hell FPS where you harness black magic and carve a blood-soaked path through seven powerful shamans to ascend as the ultimate witch.

3838350.title: Astropark
3838350.short_description: Astropark is a single-player VR game where you explore the Solar System through interactive, science-based missions. Adjust gravity, launch rockets, and discover real planets in a fun, educational, and non-violent space adventure.

3838540.title: Lushlands Adventure
3838540.short_description: Reach the finish without being seen in a cozy top-down stealth puzzle adventure. Sneak past guards, use distractions, push objects, and explore colorful pixel-art areas from farms and forests to caves and snowy villages.

3839530.title: ObeyE
3839530.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

3839680.title: BLIGHTFALL
3839680.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike FPS built on momentum. Slide-jump, air-strafe, and bunny-hop through relentless hordes, chain mid-air dash-executions, charge shrines for loot, and break the game with stacked builds before time runs out. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

3840100.title: Miraclawns
3840100.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

3840240.title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition
3840240.short_description: Stack, flip, and drop your way to burger glory in this cozy physics-based cooking game. Whether you’re actively grilling or letting orders wait, Tiny Kitchen is perfect for focused breaks and relaxed chaos.

3840430.title: FalseGods Gambit
3840430.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

3840770.title: Shapesetter
3840770.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

3841840.title: Loopstructor 2: Skyspine
3841840.short_description: Build rail networks, deploy battle trains, and use turret enchantments to create mobile fortresses. Hold the line in the wasteland left by the Sinking, uncover the floating city's dark truth, and choose between conviction and rebellion.

3842110.title: Bookmark Hero
3842110.short_description: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

3842830.title: ANDREAD
3842830.short_description: Complete randomly assigned errands in Torpa, a strange neighborhood trapped in an endless time loop.

3843130.title: Astrobound
3843130.short_description: Survive and explore space in Astrobound! Visit strange planets, encounter cosmic calamities, and keep your crew alive as you journey through the stars in a retro-inspired whimsical space adventure.

3843210.title: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor
3843210.short_description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

3844950.title: Depth Perception
3844950.short_description: It’s the 1980s. A rural cop investigates a fellow officer’s disappearance. With limited ammo and failing gear, you'll explore eerie landscapes, piece together clues, and face your own fears; no jumpscares, just tense psychological unraveling. Will you find the truth… or lose yourself?

3845350.title: Ignitement
3845350.short_description: Shape your flame in this explosive roguelite and survivorslike inferno. Craft unique fire magic, unlock new masks and abilities, collect ancestral loot, and incinerate hordes of enemies in a never-ending battle against your inner demons.

3845950.title: Farm of the unseen
3845950.short_description: Something is wrong on this farm. Shadows and horrors lurk in its corners, waiting as you uncover buried secrets and solve twisted puzzles. Explore lakes, stables, and fields. Wander through mazes and cursed chambers. The unseen are waiting. They have always known you were coming.

3846340.title: Hexabot Stranded: Defend Or Die
3846340.short_description: Action tower defense with physics & couch co-op: carry your turrets, hurl objects, and survive swarm attacks.

3846470.title: Obitus
3846470.short_description: Obitus is a multiplayer survival game where players are thrown into a hostile wilderness. Scavenge weapons, avoid traps, and eliminate your rivals – only one survives. Inspired by The Hunger Games, with tactics, tension, and a fight to the death.

3846560.title: ClickiBrick
3846560.short_description: In ClickiBrick matching is the name of the game. Match at least 4 colors together to break them, chain them, and score points! See how high you can get! Easy to get into, and hard to put down.

3847530.title: ChildStory 2: Say Cheese!
3847530.short_description: Say Cheese is a farmer simulator with roguelike elements, in which Sonya will not only develop her own cheese factory, but also find out the reason why everyone in the city has nightmares at night.

3848360.title: Snakez Arena
3848360.short_description: Snakez Arena is a 2.5D platformer shooter with it's unique movement, projectile characteristics and includes multiple game modes! Download now to try out the bulllet hell!

3848440.title: Mimic Sleuth
3848440.short_description: No chest is safe in this logic puzzle roguelite! These mimic-filled dungeons are just waiting to be looted... but only the most observant and clever adventurers will make it out alive.

3848760.title: Pax Astralis
3848760.short_description: A real-time strategy game in retro vector graphics. Settle an eleven-world star system where no single world can feed an army, ship ore and troops along the orbits, and storm the Imperial Palace on Imperia, throne world of the Empire.

3849030.title: Tired of Being the Hero
3849030.short_description: You saved the realm. Now you just want to chop wood, but monsters won't let you retire. Train your villagers, pull them out of harm's way, unlock new abilities to outlast the next assault, and try to remember why you became a Hero. Hold the line together in this short, story-rich, fantasy action RPG

3849050.title: Witch War 1
3849050.short_description: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelike. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

3849330.title: Chaos The Devil
3849330.short_description: Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way. A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

3849950.title: Barzakh: Star Gardener
3849950.short_description: Survive a plane crash and enter the veil between life and death. Solve physics-bending puzzles, collect lost stars, and cultivate a garden within your mind. In this atmospheric journey inspired by The Little Prince and Sufi mysticism, the only way out is within.

3850090.title: Coup de Koala
3850090.short_description: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a cute bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala king, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

3850310.title: Inuyo High: Lesson 1
3850310.short_description: Welcome to Inuyo Academy, an all-ages school once filled with joy. Something terrible happened after the school’s mascot staff was revealed to the public, and it’s your job as an officer to investigate the abandoned building, in search of evidence to figure out the truth.

3850490.title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
3850490.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

3850920.title: SPEEDING
3850920.short_description: An arcade-style racing game — experience the thrill of speeding on over 30 tracks! Drive over 30 cars and explore over 5 different game modes! Linear difficulty progression, from easy to hard — each stage brings a new challenge.

3850980.title: 687 Days on Mars
3850980.short_description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

3851730.title: Desktop Legends
3851730.short_description: Desktop Legends is an idle desktop action game featuring fantasy character progression, incremental resource management, and visual customization. Help your hero take their legendary stand against the forces of darkness right on your desktop!

3852130.title: Akashic
3852130.short_description: Akashic is an AI-powered interactive storybook game that blends Roguelite elements with role-playing narrative. Every adventure is unique — driven by AI-generated dialogues and dynamic worldbuilding, where your choices, emotions, and conversations shape the unfolding story.

3852390.title: CubeMate
3852390.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. A 34-level campaign tree from 2×2 to 7×7, Free Play, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

3852830.title: HYVE
3852830.short_description: HYVE is a competitive online 2v2 card game set in a cyberpunk future. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and combine your cards to create powerful synergies. Infiltrate the enemy network and destroy their C.O.R.E.

3853110.title: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
3853110.short_description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

3853380.title: Tiny Kitchen: Sandwich Edition
3853380.short_description: Click to drop ingredients and build your own chaotic deli-style sandwich in this cozy physics cooking game. Stack it tall, stack it wrong — just don’t forget the bread!

3854080.title: Interwoven Dream
3854080.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

3854680.title: Bet Shop Simulator
3854680.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

3854950.title: You're Nuts!
3854950.short_description: Wake up, little robot: it's time to plan your escape. Solo or with up to 3 friends, crack the factory's puzzles, craft gear, open shortcuts and upgrade your base to go faster and further every day, until you carry the key to the exit. Set it up your way, from super cozy to nearly impossible.

3856360.title: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
3856360.short_description: A cult donkey hops around a tiny island. You build the loop it hops on, play Rite cards mid-jump and dress it for the end of the world. Fill six quotas before the Ritual Candle burns out and Krakhaw, the donkey-kraken of the deep, rises to carry you into the sunset.

3856480.title: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
3856480.short_description: A spell-slinging hack-and-slash action roguelite. Devour enemies and seal their abilities into cards. Draw cards to switch spells and chain them together to destroy everything in your path!

3856490.title: Salt and Spice
3856490.short_description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

3856530.title: About Fishing
3856530.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

3856590.title: Bone-Bound
3856590.short_description: Bone-Bound is a turn-based roguelite strategy game where you summon creatures, evolve cards, conquer castles, and build your deck across 12 species in lane-based combat with quests, fog of war, and castle upgrades.

3856950.title: Bridgelands
3856950.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

3857400.title: Screenbreak
3857400.short_description: Screenbreak is an action roguelike RPG set inside a corrupted computer system overrun by a dangerous virus. Fight through glitching programs, broken files, infected security systems, and unstable digital worlds as you uncover the truth behind the infection.

3857940.title: Island Core
3857940.short_description: The Otherworld invasion left one island base standing. You are the Core, a central AI with the personalities of fallen scientists. Mount lasers, saw guns, flamethrowers and drones, and hold the line through snowfield, desert and swamp. Single-player horde defense × character builds.

3858030.title: Immortal Coil
3858030.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

3859060.title: SCP: Scavenger Project
3859060.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror set in the SCP universe. 1-12 survivors trapped in a collapsing Foundation site, and one of you is infected. They know it, and they're hiding it. Complete objectives, trust no one, and try to escape.

3859070.title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
3859070.short_description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

3859230.title: Crow's Requiem
3859230.short_description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

3861270.title: Pip sellfish
3861270.short_description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

3861510.title: UGOMEKU NOTE
3861510.short_description: A world more real than reality itself— It begins to wriggle into life.

3862360.title: Goblin Mode: Loot & Lunacy
3862360.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player online co-op physics sandbox where goblins live for loot, destruction and mayhem. Explore, steal and build ridiculous contraptions with your friends. From platforming to car chases to fighting giant beasts, these little goblins can do it all.

3863190.title: Alt梦魇救赎
3863190.short_description: Psychiatrist Marine and her assistant Felix make an emergency visit to Egas Psychiatric Hospital for her important patient Edward on Christmas Eve, but they get caught up in a crisis...

3863400.title: Not My Floor
3863400.short_description: Not My Floor is a horror game set in the grim stairwell of a Soviet-era apartment block on the outskirts of Kyiv in the early 1990s. After a long shift at the factory, all you want is to get home—but the elevator and the entire building have their own sinister plans, driven by a mysterious entity.

3863410.title: Novella Divina
3863410.short_description: 🍀A philosophical fairy tale about art and catgirls, inspired by Dante, Nietzsche, and Scriabin. The Musical Aether drives everyone mad—but you are the Hero...

3863490.title: Lost Hearts
3863490.short_description: A horror game inspired by the works of M.R. James. Explore Aswarby Hall to uncover your family’s secret history. Decide the fate of your ancestors by re-living each ghost’s last day on earth, with several endings for every story. Lift the family curse and save yourself… if you can.

3864940.title: Trainwatch
3864940.short_description: A time-management psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. What seems like a simple 1-month job as a gatekeeper operating a crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folk, and trying to fix your own life.

3866080.title: Stick A Round
3866080.short_description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

3867450.title: SUPERPANEL
3867450.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

3867520.title: Frozen Feathers
3867520.short_description: Throw snowballs, slide across the ice and shove your friends into the sea in short, chaotic penguin battles. Play online with up to 4 players, split-screen on one PC, or tap PLAY and fight bots in seconds.

3868160.title: The Mortal
3868160.short_description: 《下凡》是一款俯视角角色扮演模拟经营游戏。怀揣憧憬，你告别故土踏入喧嚣陌生的大城。前路万千，没有唯一的活法：务工谋生、寻玉赌石、卜算吉凶、赶海远航，在市井烟火与机缘变数里，邂逅羁绊，书写属于你的人间际遇。

3868460.title: Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition
3868460.short_description: Sauce it, top it, drop it! Build pizzas with flying ingredients and bouncy physics in this charming, low-pressure cooking sim. Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition is part chaos, part calm — all cozy.

3868550.title: Mini Shopkeeper
3868550.short_description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

3868710.title: Tokyo Shop Simulator
3868710.short_description: Run your second-hand shop under Tokyo’s neon lights! 🏮 Find, buy, and sell unique Japanese goods and grow your store! 💰🎎

3868820.title: 2048 Bosses
3868820.short_description: 2048 Bosses is a puzzle roguelike where your 2048 score is your weapon: every merge builds Power, and merging into your hero's attack tiles strikes the boss. Combine skills and heroes into game-breaking builds and discover the routes that lead to each boss.

3869250.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
3869250.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

3869540.title: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
3869540.short_description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

3870720.title: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
3870720.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

3871310.title: Rustmire
3871310.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

3871940.title: Still Stars Echo
3871940.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

3872550.title: Rhea of the Remnant
3872550.short_description: “Rhea of the Remnant” is a mecha Tactical RPG where you command a small group of allies to take on a powerful enemy force. Anticipate enemy moves, combine your allies' abilities, and devise the best strategy to secure victory!

3872580.title: Stackatalbi
3872580.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

3872940.title: Ruin and Rebirth
3872940.short_description: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

3873230.title: Liar-for-hire
3873230.short_description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

3873360.title: Chumaky
3873360.short_description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

3873460.title: ExoDomia
3873460.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

3874910.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
3874910.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

3875110.title: Before the Silence
3875110.short_description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

3875520.title: Synthellia: Awakening Protocol
3875520.short_description: Explore a mysterious 2D sci-fi world where fragmented symbols slowly become meaning. Uncover hidden truths, solve environmental puzzles, and descend deeper into the Awakening Protocol.

3875670.title: Winemaker Simulator
3875670.short_description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷

3875790.title: Alien Snap
3875790.short_description: Explore an alien planet, snap pictures of wildlife and build relationships with your crewmates in this heartfelt sci-fi Point & Click - Visual Novel.

3875930.title: Lawless Streets
3875930.short_description: Build your own criminal empire and dominate the city’s underworld. Command your soldiers, capture territories, expand your businesses, and make choices that will shape your future.

3876300.title: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
3876300.short_description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & mazes to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic – keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he slipping away into lava!

3877130.title: The Princess's Reongemt
3877130.short_description: In a world ruled by alien gods, the last kingdom "White Crown" secretly creates an artificial human with foreign memories. As their only weapon against the divine oppressors who control all resources, this being may hold the key to humanity's rebellion———

3878170.title: Trade Anchor
3878170.short_description: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

3878300.title: Veriventure
3878300.short_description: Combine a toolbox of enemies, hazards, items and objects to build dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and combat. Alternatively, cartwheel into levels created by other players, or ready your weapon and explore the story mode, in this retro-inspired 3D Dungeon Maker.

3878630.title: Veils of the Past
3878630.short_description: A cinematic mystery visual novel about a vanished woman. You're the detective on the case. Twelve years ago, your sister disappeared the same way. Four investigations lead to four different answers about what really happened — and none of them is the wrong one. The truth is whichever one you find.

3879220.title: 阴阳妖怪
3879220.short_description: Creature collection + text AVG + adventure! Catch 200+ unique yokai, meet distinct companions in a story of conflicts, feelings and secrets. Kincyo, town of human-yokai harmony, is in crisis. Team up with Miumiu to expose the villain—you hold its fate.

3879550.title: My Bookshop Dreams
3879550.short_description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, pet kitties and puppies, collect literary works while helping authors, as you grow your reputation across cities and build a legacy.

3880050.title: Amanita
3880050.short_description: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

3880770.title: Table for None
3880770.short_description: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

3880790.title: Tinker's Ascent
3880790.short_description: Explore floating islands in Tinker's Ascent, a cozy open-world platformer and crafting adventure. Run, jump, and dive through the skies, gather resources, craft tools, and build structures as you discover a world high up in the clouds.

3880860.title: Croak Tales: Deep Dungeons
3880860.short_description: Explore, scavenge and survive ... or croak trying. Dive into murky, abandoned dungeons with your friends to recover an ancient object and reveal the history around this world. It's high-stakes extraction where teamwork is vital, survival is unlikely, and the chaos is half the fun.

3881530.title: Lens Of Fear
3881530.short_description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

3881910.title: THE FORMIO PROGRAM
3881910.short_description: Terraform the moon Io from an isolated, fully simulated outpost as an operator for the F.O.R.M.I.O program. Master interconnected devices, take your (MANDATORY) daily dose of RADOX, and ignore the robot :)

3882400.title: 救済の日
3882400.short_description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

3883150.title: Fastline Rivals
3883150.short_description: Fastline Rivals is a high-speed racing game featuring circuit, drift, rally, street, and highway races. Customize cars, master tracks, and become the ultimate racing rival!

3883280.title: CO-OP TWINS
3883280.short_description: CO-OP TWINS – a two-player cooperative deck-building roguelike. Split-screen chaos. Two players, one rhythm, one deck. Total co-op mayhem. Rhythm action meets deck-building card play. Two players, one body. This is fusion co-op like you’ve never seen.

3884310.title: Kayotica
3884310.short_description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

3884660.title: My Cozy BookShop
3884660.short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

3885030.title: Ashen Vow
3885030.short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

3885170.title: Rentcthulhu
3885170.short_description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

3885300.title: Echo Protocol
3885300.short_description: A sci-fi survivors-style shooter. Hold the line across boarded stations, neon extraction runs, convoy escorts and frozen outposts. Level up mid-fight and stack elemental rounds, drones and auras into a run-ending build — or gamble on pacts that cut as deep as they hit. Every run feeds your Echoes.

3885850.title: Tour - Chess Puzzles
3885850.short_description: Move the chess pieces to visit all the light squares. Explore a dozen mechanics and their interactions across 300 hand-crafted puzzles.

3886430.title: Wade: Fly Fishing
3886430.short_description: Step into a Quebec river and fly fish in VR. Hand-crafted rod and line physics, living currents, and fish fights that demand real focus, hook it, fight it, and try not to lose it.

3887660.title: Blue Dynasty:Town Defense
3887660.short_description: Blue Dynasty is a Medieval ARPG blending fast-paced Hack & Slash combat with strategic Tower Defense. Upgrade your hero's equipment, master a massive passive tree, clear deadly dungeons, and build impenetrable defenses to protect your kingdom from relentless hordes.

3888010.title: 白噪
3888010.short_description: What?! Mr. Boring is trying to invade the universe? No way! Grab your shotgun, power gauntlets, rocket launcher, and the 24/7 rock ‘n’ roll bass cannon! Unleash a storm of bullets to the beat of the sickest rhythm and save the world the only way a true superhero can, White Noise!

3888070.title: Dystopia RPG
3888070.short_description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

3888250.title: HexBrandPre
3888250.short_description: Story of VoltSpark. Choose the most suitable set of equipments for you, then dodge the bullets and crash the enemies. A bullet-hell game, which is quite difficult. Instant reactions, level understanding, strategies are requird to beat this game. As agile as leopard, ruin everything like thunder.

3890260.title: Edenwound
3890260.short_description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with elements inspired by the survival and roguelike genres. Face the horrors of Eden and discover what lies at the bottom of the abyss...

3891450.title: Cube Party
3891450.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

3891520.title: TUNE
3891520.short_description: You lost everything in the war, except the memory of a faint prayer of a being who stayed beside you. Years later, you return to trace its prayer across a ruined Earth. Search through static, uncover the truth, and remember what others have forgotten.

3891790.title: Caution! Platforming Ahead
3891790.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

3891900.title: FLINT
3891900.short_description: Multiplayer survival in an open world. Build your base, farm, hunt different creatures, survive in a harsh world, fight or team up with other players and evolve through the ages.

3892890.title: Infinite Soul
3892890.short_description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

3892940.title: Dungeon Hunting Grounds
3892940.short_description: A deck-building video game featuring single and two-player local co-op battles against monstrous foes in treacherous dungeons.

3893230.title: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
3893230.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+ soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

3893340.title: DREADSHELL
3893340.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

3894750.title: The Sword Wizard - Part 1
3894750.short_description: A 2D action-adventure game through a fun and silly story. Use magic to launch swords at enemies. Explore maps to find more swords of various types and questionable designs. Magically combine swords into new powers to unleash even more swords at enemies.

3895050.title: Chronia: The Rotcore
3895050.short_description: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

3895110.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
3895110.short_description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

3897620.title: Aboxcalipse
3897620.short_description: Grab supplies, stack boxes, and toss them into the truck while smashing zombies with crates along the way. In Aboxcalypse, you're warehouse workers in a zombie apocalypse, using your own inventory as a weapon to survive.

3897630.title: RUST MOON
3897630.short_description: RUST MOON is a cyberpunk pixel side-scrolling action game. Play as ALPHA-7, whose memory has been rewritten, and cut through blockades with firearms, blades, and cyberware abilities — from the neon city all the way to a lunar base. Someone wrote your past for you. What comes next is up to you.

3897770.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
3897770.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

3897830.title: Frog Knight
3897830.short_description: A brave little frog and his talking sword climb a cursed well in this precision platformer. Jump, bounce, and master your timing to save the world. No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just one long climb... or fall.

3897920.title: Zavix Tower 2
3897920.short_description: Zavix Tower 2 is a challenging Party based roguelike with turn-based RPG about Dungeon Crawling through a tower. Recruit Heroes, Upgrade your Town and try to help your mysterious host unravel the mysteries within Zavix Tower!

3898910.title: The Waiting
3898910.short_description: Please make your way to the top floor. Bob is waiting for you.

3900220.title: Proximity
3900220.short_description: Proximity- game about exploring randomly generated galaxy, combining RTS and FPS mechanics. Build factories, manage colonists and their needs. Design any vehicles with polygonal modelling and fly seamlessly from the surface into space. Adjust design to handle realistic physics. Have fun with friends

3900700.title: Noël macabre
3900700.short_description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

3901540.title: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
3901540.short_description: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

3902150.title: Rift Tavern
3902150.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

3902160.title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
3902160.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

3902270.title: Forager's Finds
3902270.short_description: Go foraging in a vast forest. Strap on your utility belt and head out to explore, photograph, journal, and pick your finds. Sell them at Forager’s Finds to unlock perks and upgrades. A relaxed mushroom picker simulator with many species to discover and document — if you take the time to look.

3902580.title: Re:Curse
3902580.short_description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

3903050.title: Shapes N Music
3903050.short_description: A brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a varied soundtrack synced to intense levels. Master 4 more game modes built to steal your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

3904080.title: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
3904080.short_description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring over 40 fishing destinations and 260 fish to discover. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

3904230.title: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow
3904230.short_description: Live-action interactive romance game. Play as an archery coach meeting three heroines. Your choices shape the story, unlock different romantic routes and multiple endings. Movie-grade production with immersive experience.

3905170.title: Castles & Castellans
3905170.short_description: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

3905700.title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
3905700.short_description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

3905920.title: Space Cowboy Radio
3905920.short_description: An indie action-RPG where you pilot customizable ships through side-scrolling combat, level up unique characters, and dismantle a corrupt galactic regime one mission at a time.

3906790.title: Flipper of Eridanus
3906790.short_description: A fantastical sci-fi pinball experience featuring advanced physics, unique table mechanics, mini-games, and a full pinball tutorial!

3906820.title: Immunity
3906820.short_description: Fight waves of bacteria and viruses as powerful immune cells in this fast-paced survival game. Choose mutations, unlock new characters, build stronger defenses, and protect vital organs before the infection takes over.

3907040.title: Day of Astrology
3907040.short_description: Turn-based battle/battle decryption/decision-type level, players need to play, fight, and choose through independent levels. The game is non-linear, and the order of entering each level will also affect the shape and ending of the level.

3907570.title: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
3907570.short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

3908520.title: SYDI
3908520.short_description: SYDI is a turn-based JRPG inspired by tabletop RPGs like by D&D, where every battle comes down to the roll of a die. Explore a silent, colorless world and find your friends again, and face the question waiting for you at the end.

3908680.title: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
3908680.short_description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

3910140.title: 残阳 1645/1937
3910140.short_description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

3910860.title: Chinese Black Dragon Legend
3910860.short_description: " Chinese Black Dragon Legend" is a daily comedy Cantonese-style visual novel (galgame). The story follows Sino-French footballer Zhong Guolong's romantic journey with four heroines: Bai Xiaotong, Aisha, Frolana, and Kim Sung-ae.

3911490.title: Forge the Fates
3911490.short_description: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

3911520.title: Fantasy Sino-Japanese War：Rebirth
3911520.short_description: ​​Dragons roar, history bends. As Admiral Ding Ruchang, you command magical sea beasts, not ships, in this thrilling SRPG. After a crushing defeat, lead the Beiyang Fleet's last hope against Japan's monsters. Rewrite the Sino-Japanese War.

3911600.title: SCRATCH CO.
3911600.short_description: Build a deck of scratch tickets, chase rising quotas, permanently upgrade your gas station, and pay off your debt! Scratch the itch of gambling in SCRATCH CO.

3911770.title: Village of the Ages
3911770.short_description: Raise a village of quirky little people, turning their bright ideas into new tools, and steering them through the ages, fires, tornados and all. No tech trees, no progress bars: just a community that grows up and starts making its own choices.

3911890.title: Elemency Island
3911890.short_description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

3912040.title: Peg Together
3912040.short_description: Peg Together is a multiplayer puzzle game that puts you against a friend to see who can achieve the highest score by hitting the most pegs with the furthest shots! Explore through different levels and worlds and master them all to win against your friend!

3912600.title: UFOntastic
3912600.short_description: Jano has debts to pay, and the easiest place to get money is on Earth! Use your flying saucer: abduct objects, people, enemies and much more from the environment to progress through dungeons and mini-games. Amass a fortune!

3912870.title: Wibby Buddy
3912870.short_description: Explore a beautiful forest and bond with adorable animals! Build closeness with various creatures, and as your bond grows, gift them cozy homes to live together. Gather resources and craft to create a unique home with your animal friends. Turn a shabby, lonely space into a warm, lively haven!

3912940.title: 宥蘿的巫女修行錄 Miko Yuro: Training Record
3912940.short_description: The sequel to the Japanese-style adventure game Yuro’s Fantasy Adventure, set several years later on an ordinary day, Yuro continues her journey as a shrine miko of Kanai Jinja, training relentlessly to refine her swordsmanship and onmyo magic, the entire game is played from a third-person.

3913420.title: Stabjack
3913420.short_description: It’s just you, a deck of playing cards, and a knife that won’t shut up. Stabjack is the roguelike, blackjack deckbuilder where you cheat to win. Tuck cards up your sleeve to use later, change your deck, and invoke supernatural items as you investigate a dark, devilish, comic-noir world.

3914430.title: Aethelon
3914430.short_description: Aethelon is an infinite, open world creative voxel sandbox. Build across massive procedural worlds with realistic biome systems. Share your world with reproducible seeds. Experience infinite creative freedom at impressive scale.

3915380.title: Manaftory
3915380.short_description: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

3915630.title: Worn By The Forgotten
3915630.short_description: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.

3915640.title: Cardoom
3915640.short_description: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

3915940.title: Ekholux
3915940.short_description: Ekholux™ begins with escape-room puzzles. Solve physics-based challenges inside sealed chambers to break free.

3916030.title: Stellar Nemesis
3916030.short_description: A high-definition arcade shooter blending old-school action with modern polish. Battle across the Solar System, upgrade your weapons, and unlock tougher challenges in Nemesis Mode - all set to a hypnotic, retro-electro soundtrack.

3917550.title: Leapin Lads
3917550.short_description: Leapin Lads is a surprisingly rich, randomly generated two-button arcade experience. Leap one space or leap two through an endless stream of challenges, finding your rhythm and flow as you discover just how far you can go.

3917640.title: Live Fire Exercise
3917640.short_description: Inspired by classic training missions from your favourite FPS games, Live Fire Exercise is a time trial arcade shooter that challenges you to complete rounds as fast and accurately as possible.

3918200.title: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
3918200.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

3918220.title: Fastrak : Metro
3918220.short_description: Fastrak: Metro is a simcade train game where you drive Aussie trains on real railways to get the highest score!

3918370.title: Korean Noodle House
3918370.short_description: A Singleplayer cooking experience. Exploring Korean cooking recipes and culture in a cozy environment. Make customers happy with delicious dishes, gain experience and level up, earn achievements and discover pieces in the art gallery!

3918820.title: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical
3918820.short_description: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy world populated by cats. Create your feline fighter, build your team, explore a free-roaming world and lead your cats through tactical battles full of choices, equipment and strategy.

3919120.title: Adeline's story
3919120.short_description: «Adeline’s Story» — a psychological-horror visual novel about a girl who moves from a bustling city to a godforsaken village, where the nighttime silence is ripped apart by inhuman screams and people vanish one by one.

3919160.title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
3919160.short_description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

3919600.title: KaiKi
3919600.short_description: This is a walking simulator-style adventure game where you walk along the beach from a first-person perspective. Take photos along the beach and reminisce about the protagonist's precious memories. When you reach your destination, the ending will change depending on the number of memories you have.

3920340.title: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words
3920340.short_description: Tune the radio. Silence the voices. Escape the dark. Signal Lost is a psychological horror experience where every sound matters. Lost in an abandoned underground relay station, your only link to reality is the static between transmissions.

3921070.title: Mainelander
3921070.short_description: Sandbox Mode: Manage trade, explore ten regions, complete various commissions, challenge the arena, recruit partners, develop your team in depth, and conquer various dungeons. Rookie Mode: Each game offers a different experience. Player Leaderboards: Challenge other players!
developers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
publishers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

3921560.title: COMANOMALY
3921560.short_description: COMANOMALY is a mix between a whodunnit mystery game & horror game, with different randomly selected culprit each playthrough. 🩺 It's 1985. You are Susi, a nurse working for Sudaritra Hospital, you have to protect your patient: a wealthy and powerful man with weird symptoms and peculiar conditions.

3921650.title: Sign My Petition
3921650.short_description: Sign My Petition is a beat-’em-up adventure about a mouse trying to save their tribe from extermination. Explore bizarre neighboring apartments, fight off strange enemies and bosses, and meet oddball characters along the way.

3922320.title: Atelier of Oblivion
3922320.short_description: An atelier in the forest. The Artist’s brush halts before an empty frame, leaving the portrait unfinished. Lost souls arrive with memories of tragedy. Render the cruel truth, or shield their eyes with an eternal lie. A Gothic Mystery granting rest to the dead.

3922410.title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
3922410.short_description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

3923050.title: Slide Soldiers
3923050.short_description: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

3923060.title: PLA-TOON 2
3923060.short_description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

3923070.title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
3923070.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

3924030.title: Cardbound Heroes
3924030.short_description: Cardbound Heroes is a Draw & Strike Roguelite where you combine cards to match numbers, cross out fields, fight enemies and unlock powerful combos. Build your deck, discover hidden combo cards, and master a campaign that changes every run.

3924200.title: The Rat Eater
3924200.short_description: Collect strange loot in this absurd world. Choose your simple rat and turn him into complex killing machine. Explore unique skill trees, craft items and eat rats. What more would one want?

3924640.title: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER
3924640.short_description: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER finally lands on Steam with intense battles, unique characters, and indie soul. Get ready for electrifying 3D fights in a universe full of style, personality, and urban legend inspiration.

3924650.title: Dismal Night
3924650.short_description: A story-driven 2D folk-horror mystery set in 1990s Poland. A man has vanished near a house in the woods that should be empty, yet someone still tends its flowers. Search for clues, keep them in your police notebook and solve puzzles to uncover old crimes and village secrets.

3925240.title: Otaku Love Story
3925240.short_description: Behind the keyboard, you're a struggling web novelist. In reality, a socially anxious shut-in. Your life is a simple loop of writing, gaming, and binge-watching, until four very different girls crash into your world—right through the internet.

3925800.title: Little Guy Friday
3925800.short_description: Enter the Uncool Underground and face the Leet 14 in this irreverent creature collecting roguelike! Gather your ragtag team of silly Little Guys and guide them towards ascension... or just crash out and try another run!

3925840.title: Grim Fate: Cloverleaf Bay
3925840.short_description: Immerse yourself in a polished VHS style psychological horror experience, with an atmospheric first person view, branching dialogues, environmental clues, a mystery to uncover and some things that aren't quite right that will keep you questioning what's real and what's not.

3926400.title: Starship Dice
3926400.short_description: Fill your fleet with different weapons and equipment, and return to base with loot. The fleet will engage in automatic battles in three-dimensional space, and you will plan the star map route and action mode, but it is best to pray for permission from the God of Dice.

3927390.title: Bore Bore
3927390.short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

3927570.title: イミテーション
3927570.short_description: ――It seems that in this world, immortal humans are called “Players.” Eve, a girl living in a world where immortality is commonplace. Become her, gather information through conversation and exploration, and unravel the mysteries of this world.

3928010.title: retrospect
3928010.short_description: "retrospect" is a linear, full-length visual novel. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

3928950.title: Duckload
3928950.short_description: 1,000,000 rubber ducks have been dumped deep in a mountain forest. Alone. Scared. Squeaky. Ship every last duck downstream for cash. Start with your bare hands and scale up across a massive upgrade tree to increase your duck harvesting power!

3929100.title: Project Damascus
3929100.short_description: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

3929160.title: Secret of Havendor
3929160.short_description: Can you preserve your humanity in a world ruled by blood and gold?

3929340.title: We Build Below
3929340.short_description: Get rich or get eaten. Build underground factories, automate production and defend against parasites in this 1-3 player co-op roguelite.

3929530.title: Bring Me Home
3929530.short_description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

3929660.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch
3929660.short_description: In this side-scrolling horror adventure game, explore multiple eerie spaces rooted in Rules Kaidan. Every adventure, you will encounter all kinds of terrifying beings born from kaidan legends. Follow and memorize every rule — however conflicting or bizarre — to survive each trial.

3929720.title: BONEMARROW
3929720.short_description: BoneMarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray due to the meddling of a dark cult, you finally have your opportunity to escape.

3929800.title: Valdrin
3929800.short_description: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.

3930910.title: ENTRY_13
3930910.short_description: ENTRY_13 is a psychological horror experience inspired by Backrooms lore. Explore its meta, multi-layered narrative, and its procedural, ever-changing maps. Track your way in, find your way out. Survive the encounters.

3931380.title: Little Red Riding Hood
3931380.short_description: Experience an expanded retelling of the famous fairy tale, Little Red Riding Hood, in this terrifying yet beautiful adventure horror game. Discover an enchanted forest as you solve puzzles, run, hide, and sneak to avoid the Big Bad Wolf.

3931390.title: Spooky Lord
3931390.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

3931980.title: Paccarat
3931980.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

3932020.title: ころコロ 2
3932020.short_description: corocoro 2! A gyro-exclusive casual game where you tilt the ground to guide 5 uniquely shaped balls to the goal. Overcome the obstacles across all 50 stages!

3932170.title: This Is Not A Dungeon
3932170.short_description: TINAD is a unique tower defense game where you defend your retirement home from overeager heroes. Play as the dungeon itself. Deploy traps, summon minions, and prove you’re just trying to enjoy your golden years in peace against heroes who can’t read the sign and assume every dungeon is evil.

3932780.title: Crime & Anomaly
3932780.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

3932900.title: Warrior Is Just Going
3932900.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

3933180.title: Torii: Beyond The Gates
3933180.short_description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

3934000.title: Multitales: Hood, Gun & Contraband
3934000.short_description: Red Riding Hood takes up a shotgun and explosive pies to find her missing father. Beneath the bright fairytale lies a dark story of fear, betrayal, and choices made when there’s nothing left to lose.

3934280.title: Pledged to a Princess
3934280.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

3934500.title: Spheromania
3934500.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

3934510.title: A Cold Comfort
3934510.short_description: A tragic yuri visual novel about wolfgirls, selfish cruelty, and the grim inevitability of death. Lost deep in the frostbitten frozen tundra, a group of intrepid explorers on a doomed expedition die one by one as the cold slowly creeps in.

3934590.title: Donjon: The Dark Fantasy
3934590.short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

3935200.title: North Pole Workshop
3935200.short_description: Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for 1-4 players. Team up with your merry elves and lightly strategize how to complete various toy recipes. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls!

3935520.title: A Service Call
3935520.short_description: Your first assignment alone. An island where no one has lived for thirty years. A lighthouse that stopped shining. The job was only supposed to take a few hours.

3936190.title: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
3936190.short_description: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

3936320.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-
3936320.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

3937680.title: Arcane Shores
3937680.short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.

3938050.title: Vein-Weaver Knitting
3938050.short_description: Activate, Jump, Bomb, Out Run, Get Power Ups, Find Hidden Items, Speed Run, Pull Levers, Activate Switches, Out Smart Enemies, And Unravel The Story And Destroy The Dimension Crafted By An Ancient Craft Called Vein-Weaver Knitting.

3939120.title: Sumalia
3939120.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

3939300.title: Barista Dream
3939300.short_description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

3939420.title: Launch Hazard
3939420.short_description: Launch Hazard is a single-player physics score attack game. Send a rocket-powered athlete crashing through arenas, steer mid-crash to chain targets, and complete objectives to score higher and earn better ranks in 90-second runs.

3939570.title: The King's Bargain
3939570.short_description: Thirty years ago the King sold his wife to the devil. Now Hell's collections department wants its money. Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, build your King with a skill tree and devilish boons, raid dungeons and smash Hell's middle managers in a darkly funny ARPG.

3939660.title: Mewts
3939660.short_description: Handcrafted party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Use your body as a slingshot and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in handcrafted clay arenas!

3940180.title: SacriFrogos
3940180.short_description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

3940470.title: KILLSEC
3940470.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

3941390.title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
3941390.short_description: A vtuber-coded RPG with dynamic boss fights, curious exploration, and silly shenanigans. FREE to Play!!

3941960.title: Ghost Hunter
3941960.short_description: Ghost Hunter is a co-op horror escape game for 1–4 players. As the owner of a supernatural agency, you accept ghost-related cases and carry out cleansings. You’ll need to choose your gear wisely, and you can tackle the cases solo or team up with others to survive and succeed.

3942240.title: War of Blobs
3942240.short_description: Massive multiplayer slasher combat, reduced to circles and sticks. Directional swings, real parries, two hits to die...and 60+ other blobs in the lobby trying to kill you first. Everything that doesn't sharpen the fight has been cut.

3942270.title: Midnight Video Store
3942270.short_description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

3942390.title: Falcon Fall™
3942390.short_description: Dropped deep in hostile territory with no backup and no way out but through. Every street is a kill zone, every shadow a threat. Built in UE5 by seasoned VR devs and combat vets, Falcon Fall™ delivers the most unforgiving tactical VR combat experience. Wishlist now - deployment scheduled for 2026.

3942630.title: Rogue Reigns
3942630.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice.
