Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

3942690.title: SCP 1985
3942690.short_description: Welcome to Site 78 in 1985 where the foundation would experience one of its first major breaches. Escape the facility and survive the scps.

3943110.title: Goreticulture
3943110.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

3943190.title: PenguPult
3943190.short_description: Grab your hammer and launch yourself through ice and snow in PenguPult! Climb the mountain with precise jumps or slip and fall back to the bottom. If you crave a challenge you need to try this!

3943450.title: Island Keeper
3943450.short_description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

3943550.title: I Have Been Here Before?
3943550.short_description: A psychological exploration through a liminal dreamscape: no guides, no paths, just you and small environmental mysteries.

3943670.title: Stakeroom: The Final
3943670.short_description: A turn-based gambling game where every round brings a different threat: poison, electricity, and more. One player, one table, and the same rules every time. How much are you willing to risk?

3944310.title: ByteCrawler
3944310.short_description: Pick a hero, build your swarm, and hold off enemy waves. Place units, watch your energy, and level up to survive in this lane-defense strategy game!

3944380.title: Woodland Werewolf
3944380.short_description: The mist came without warning. One morning, the residents of the village woke to find their lakeside settlement wrapped in an impenetrable fog—thick, cold, and utterly wrong. Within hours, people began to vanish. No screams. No signs of struggle. Just empty spaces where lives used to be.

3944900.title: SUBSELF: Lies Deep
3944900.short_description: You are a prisoner offered a single chance at freedom. In exchange, you must descend into the depths of an alien ocean and recover lost data from a sunken research station, abandoned under mysterious circumstances by a powerful space mega-corporation.

3946240.title: Demon With A Candy Crisis
3946240.short_description: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

3946330.title: Snap & Print
3946330.short_description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! 📸 Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

3946550.title: Sunny Orchard
3946550.short_description: Run your own sunny fruit orchard! 🍇 Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and upgrade your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations. Collect all cute premium fruit stickers to show your customers the quality and care of your fancy produce.

3946640.title: The Abyssal Diplomat
3946640.short_description: Humans and Monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best. But will its best be enough?

3947070.title: Tasmon's Little Island ~ Cursed Mascot
3947070.short_description: Raise a mysterious creature "Tasmon" on your desktop!! No need to pay attention constantly, enjoy interacting with them in your free time. Once it has grown enough, you can challenge simple auto battles. The Tasmon's appearance upon birth will depend on what you do on your PC

3947270.title: Road Survival: Bigger on the Inside
3947270.short_description: In a toxic, zombie-ridden wasteland, survival is brutal. Upgrade your RV into a foldable-space mobile base—farm, craft, gather resources, and fend off the undead to build your last safe haven.

3947720.title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
3947720.short_description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

3948460.title: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
3948460.short_description: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

3948540.title: Incremental Heaven
3948540.short_description: Start as a tiny mech, spread as a cosmic parasite, or rewrite reality as a living cursor. Destroy enemies, unlock hundreds of upgrades, evolve through massive transformations, and grow from scrapyard survivor to universe-shaping power.

3948940.title: Isekai HKV
3948940.short_description: Enter another world with a VTuber ally. Move, dodge, collect magic and items, and survive the monster waves. Your VTuber ally can protect, break you out, revive you, and change how each fight plays.

3949000.title: Incralife
3949000.short_description: Live an unpredictable life shaped by evolving choices, random opportunities, and the habits you build over decades. Grow your skills, build wealth, form relationships, and discover which unique Life Archetype your story becomes.

3949420.title: Runic Tower
3949420.short_description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

3950060.title: Pip & Bones
3950060.short_description: Pip & Bones is a score-based deckbuilder roguelike with domino rules. Connect really long chains, score a lot of points, forge your perfect deck, enchant tiles, unlock new strategies with powerful idols and win the title of Tavern Champion!

3950670.title: Fireworks Incremental
3950670.short_description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

3950720.title: Wander Her Way VR
3950720.short_description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

3950730.title: Tidy Tidy
3950730.short_description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

3950950.title: Shadowbound
3950950.short_description: Shadowbound is a minimalist 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally. Overcome short challenges, manipulate light, and recover lost colors to rebuild the memories of a lifetime.

3951770.title: Slingbox
3951770.short_description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

3951990.title: By The Orchid
3951990.short_description: 中式原生家庭环境下，少年找寻存在方式的故事。

3952080.title: FEARSFROMARS
3952080.short_description: You are a space hunter from Mars. Hunt with friends, capture bizarre aliens alive, and sell them to the highest bidder. In this galaxy, alien or not, they all share one fear... FEARSFROMARS.

3952620.title: Snack Shop Simulator
3952620.short_description: Run your own snack shop where eating snacks makes you stronger! Order 45+ treats online, stock shelves, feed employees, serve customers, or hire a team to help you. Build your business, boost your power, and create the ultimate snack heaven!

3952820.title: Desserted
3952820.short_description: Desserted is a 1-6 player co-op survival horror game. Explore procedurally generated map in your mobile food truck. Gather, cook, and defend your power grid from sabotaging monsters. Complete sacrifices and survive the deadly Blackout when the lights go out!

3953700.title: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
3953700.short_description: Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

3954320.title: Neo Bananas
3954320.short_description: In this sci-fi speedrun-platformer, destroy every neo bananas, get the S+ ranks, and uncover why you're the last gorilla on Earth. Go fast. Go wild. Go bananas!

3954820.title: Omicrox
3954820.short_description: Stuck in an unusual game night. Break the contract and escape. In Omicrox, you are drawn into a twisted match of Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe against an uncanny foe. Uncover the mysteries of this twisted game and escape.

3954950.title: Backrooms: Rogue 0
3954950.short_description: A routine expedition into the Backrooms goes silent. You are the last call. Now trapped in endless corridors that loop into themselves, you’ll soon realize you are not alone. Something moves heremany things—and none of them can be fought. Your only hope is to stay unseen. Never trust what you see.

3955010.title: Love Letter to a Vampyr
3955010.short_description: Love bites … especially when you’re in love with a Vampyr. In this survival horror game, travel to the ominous ruins of Castle Helenox in order to deliver your personal love letter to the monster who stole your heart. After all, who said that love has to be a pain in the neck?

3955130.title: 42 Space Mayhem
3955130.short_description: Fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter where every run brings new upgrades, enemy waves, and ship evolutions. Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op to survive, adapt, and dominate the galaxy.

3955700.title: Grid Forge TD
3955700.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

3956120.title: 星渊勇者 StarAbyss Heroes
3956120.short_description: Torn by an ancient cataclysm, the world lies in ruins. In this ARPG, play a hero exploring relics, looting treasures, forging weapons, and mastering skills on a decaying yet fantastical journey.

3956860.title: Battlethorne: Reckoning
3956860.short_description: Fight, build, and strategize in a massive third-person action-strategy RPG with hundreds of units and large-scale tactical battles across vast battlefields.

3957390.title: アストラリス
3957390.short_description: I awoke on a lonely shore beneath a sky of countless stars. A mysterious traveler appeared, speaking of constellations soon to fade. Together, we set out on a journey— to meet new people, uncover the truth of this world, and face the choice that awaits me. An adventure of stars and memories begins.
developers: ほしをつくりしものたち
publishers: ほしをつくりしものたち

3957460.title: Electio
3957460.short_description: Four blanks, two bullets, and a choice. Save yourself and sacrifice the others, or save them and risk your eternal death. Electio is a short narrative horror game that can be played only once. Choose wisely.

3957900.title: A Day with Wuki
3957900.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

3959230.title: Daisy la Fleur
3959230.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

3959430.title: 动物城大法官
3959430.short_description: 成为动物城的新晋大法官，在庭审过程中收集证物，记录证言，翻阅新闻，判断原告被告的诉求是否合理，引导案件走向真相并最终做出合理判决和量刑，一同守护动物城司法正义！

3960080.title: GOGOGO!pomal!
3960080.short_description: Your roguelike monster adventure begins here — explore a vast 2D open world, capture and fuse creatures, and create the one-of-a-kind team that carries you through every challenge.

3960110.title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
3960110.short_description: Defeat, choose, grow, and break the battlefield. A Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you Limit Break 14 skills and cut down hordes of yokai. Defeat bosses, forge gear from their rewards, and face even stronger foes.

3960400.title: Gargoyle Garden
3960400.short_description: Grow magical plants, open enchanted seed packs, hire cute critters, and upgrade your greenhouses. Visit the local gargoyle shopkeeper and complete your plant collection in this cozy incremental gardening game.

3960500.title: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
3960500.short_description: Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

3960860.title: Bloomino
3960860.short_description: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop 💐 Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

3961150.title: Bono
3961150.short_description: A calm first-person village life and survival game. Chop wood, catch fish and collect scrap, do daily jobs for the shopkeepers to win their friendship and secrets, drive the mountain road, and get through four seasons in a small village below the mountains.

3961370.title: Tornado Hunter
3961370.short_description: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.

3961850.title: Void Raid
3961850.short_description: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

3961880.title: The Fake Freedom
3961880.short_description: The Fake Free is a short interactive visual novel game. Enter the inner world of a young scholar suffering from mental illness, and experience a struggle between despair and hope in a grotesque and unique style, and witness the different endings of the story through the power of “choice”.

3961950.title: Layang Atma
3961950.short_description: An isometric survival horror about grief and loss. Fight terrifying manifestations, search through distorted memories, and uncover the truth behind the person Yus cannot let go.

3962180.title: 广东爱情故事
3962180.short_description: 2010 年代深圳，你持二本毕业证成为「广漂」，出租屋旧风扇、城中村烟火、薪水追不上房租的落差，撞开青春与现实的序章。​这场跨十余年的成长里，你从职场新人蜕变为奋斗者，亲历移动互联网普及、电商爆发、P2P 暴雷、房价飞涨、疫情等时代节点。在写字楼与大排档间，每个选择皆有重量：为晋升失约恋人，或守片刻温暖？留一线，或归故土？​三段情感各有滋味，粤语老歌、缴费单、地铁站相拥，都是青春注脚。​作为聚焦普通人的视觉互动游戏，无开挂人生，只有真实挣扎与觉醒。在压力与理想间拉扯，于时代与选择中徘徊，终会明白：归宿从非某座城，而是漂泊中寻得的自己。

3962800.title: Eclipsed Realms
3962800.short_description: Journey through fractured realms in a rich, immersive world. Solve intricate puzzles, battle deadly foes, and uncover lost lore. Teleport between parallel realities to alter environments, unlock secrets, and conquer challenges across shifting, surreal landscapes.

3963060.title: Celestial Lumina
3963060.short_description: Forge your own path by finding temporary tools or permanent abilities. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where you ascend from the depths as the heir of a fallen underworld, to awaken radiant abilities & uncover the truth behind a heavenly world full of dystopian secrets.

3963500.title: Bedrotting Simulator
3963500.short_description: Lock the doors. Reply to her texts. Don't stumble onto the wrong account. Track down your missing friend, salvage your relationship, and survive the nights alone—assuming your mind doesn't break first.

3963730.title: Overland Journey
3963730.short_description: Drive cars or trucks across uncharted terrain, manage fuel and supplies, carry as many resources as possible to upgrade your vehicle, and explore deeper into the wild.

3963760.title: The Immolation Apartment
3963760.short_description: An ancient cult lurks in an old apartment; a mother sacrifices her daughter. A decade later, her son enters the Netherworld to save his family from a deity’s torment, evading spirits to reach "Penglai Island" and destroy the Soul-Refining Furnace. Uncanny Abode blends 1990s Taiwan with cult horror.

3963860.title: Tax It Easy
3963860.short_description: Uncover shady expenses as a full-time Tax Scrutinizer! Check tax files, spot suspicious invoices, and decide: approve, reject, or pocket a bribe in this satirical inspector sim. Upgrade your office, build connections with big companies, make the most money for the government... or for yourself!

3965090.title: Cardboard Tanks
3965090.short_description: Co-op tank roguelite for 1–4 players. Blast through a fully destructible world, online or on the couch.

3965540.title: A Baby CEO?!
3965540.short_description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

3965700.title: Moonlight Cradle
3965700.short_description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

3965730.title: Celestial Golf
3965730.short_description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

3965780.title: HYPER DETONATOR
3965780.short_description: HYPER DETONATOR is a chain-reaction bullet hell shooter set in cyberspace. Blast through the virus spreading across the mainframe, and detonate bombs to set off devastating chain reactions. How long will you survive?

3965940.title: Gunfetti
3965940.short_description: Pick a hero, jump in and start shooting. Fast multiplayer action in pixel art.

3968490.title: Train Cargo: NightShift
3968490.short_description: October 21, 1998. You are the night clerk at Hollow Pine freight yard. Weigh the crates, check the seals, sign the manifests. Follow the rules on the board in the booth. When the signal is red, do not move. Do not look at the train that is not on the schedule.

3969500.title: Knight Paths
3969500.short_description: A free, chess-inspired strategy duel where every square can be used only once. Control a single knight, outmaneuver your opponent in online PvP, or challenge five AI difficulty levels offline. Simple rules. Every move matters.

3970080.title: Zombies Hate to Die
3970080.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

3970880.title: Eggspedition
3970880.short_description: ENTER THE EGGSPEDITION - A TERRIFYING SURVIVAL HORROR WITH DINOSAURS! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

3971340.title: Something is Wrong with the Library
3971340.short_description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

3971680.title: Shogi: AI’s Forbidden Move
3971680.short_description: A groundbreaking shogi game created entirely without a game engine. From rule design to thinking algorithms, everything has been conceived and built by AI. Experience a unique worldview and gameplay that sets it apart from any shogi game before.

3972140.title: Shifting Chambers
3972140.short_description: Shifting Chambers is a solo / co-op survival horror game where you need to escape from a mansion where rooms shift when the bell rings. Explore the rooms, reorient yourself, solve puzzles and survive the unpredictably intelligent guardians.

3972230.title: Investment Fund Game
3972230.short_description: Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches.

3972970.title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
3972970.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

3973220.title: Cruise Control
3973220.short_description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

3973500.title: Bar Master
3973500.short_description: Bar Master is a management game where you play as a bar owner and must develop your business. Start by serving beers in a simple bar, hire waiters, unlock new drinks, expand your bar, and buy new bars in the city!

3973740.title: 模拟修仙录
3973740.short_description: 《模拟修仙录》是一款修仙题材的策略构筑游戏。穿越获得无限模拟金手指的你，将利用系统随机提供的天材地宝、流派秘法及修仙百艺，一步步积累真元、修炼突破，构筑独属于自己的修炼法门，最终证道长生！

3974460.title: Wizard Tower Wars
3974460.short_description: A multiplayer fantasy RTS with deckbuilding. Choose your wizard and tower, customize your spellbook, and battle up to 3 friends. Summon armies and buildings, cast spells, and level up while your forces fight on their own, so planning beats micro. Ally, betray, or fill empty seats with AI.

3975250.title: Merry Crisis
3975250.short_description: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed?

3975490.title: Castellan of Aurelwatch
3975490.short_description: Rebuild Aurelwatch, explore a world of medieval fantasy, and lead your heroes into turn-based battles. Discover its past, gather allies, and use clever tactics to overcome your enemies.

3975560.title: Midnight Dies Y2K
3975560.short_description: It’s December 31st, 1999. As the Devil’s daughter, you’ve been dared to stop your dad’s plan to take over the world before midnight. Solve wacky problems, collect bizarre items, and choose carefully—your decisions shape the ending!

3975880.title: Check My Papers
3975880.short_description: 2027. One year since the superpowers’ standoff came to a head. The nuclear winter has lifted, but people still hide in bunkers, afraid of the radiation. Who gets a new home—and who is cast out into the wastes? Lives are in your hands, Captain.

3975960.title: Everything Store
3975960.short_description: Everything Store is a game where you can manage your own thrift shop! Buy items, fit them into your store and sell them by negotiating with customers!

3976200.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
3976200.short_description: Beat up punks in fast isometric combat, then win them over with burgers from your food truck. Brawl through the city, upgrade your kitchen, learn combat moves, and unlock new neighbourhoods. Grab your spatula and take back the streets!

3976270.title: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
3976270.short_description: "Paradise Beyond the Nightmare" is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

3976380.title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
3976380.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

3976580.title: 和平东京
3976580.short_description: This is an anti-war themed destruction game. Our goal is world peace! To achieve this great mission, we must first establish peace in Tokyo!

3977670.title: Isometric House Builder
3977670.short_description: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

3977770.title: Tiara
3977770.short_description: Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through days (and dream through nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

3978490.title: Diatonic
3978490.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

3978590.title: Warp Bound
3978590.short_description: In this roguelite auto battler, you've been thrust into an uncharted sector of the Galaxy, discovering friends and foes alike. Traverse different environments, seek out and deal with traders, equip unique parts for your ship, form varied strategies, and fend off a variety of hostile factions.

3979370.title: Shit-Stealing Gnomes
3979370.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

3980070.title: OVERCRASH
3980070.short_description: Devastate the roads with your vehicle, wreck objects, explode traffic, take down helicopters, boost everywhere and chain combos to unlock new rides and challenges.

3980340.title: Imprinted
3980340.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

3980790.title: Red Tide
3980790.short_description: Red Tide is an EXTRACTION FISHER set in the irradiated wastelands. Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.

3980930.title: Nitrania
3980930.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

3981150.title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
3981150.short_description: Inspired by the legends surrounding Asia's infamous Bhangarh Fort, set in 1985. When his wife, Vanya, mysteriously goes missing, an investigator follows a lead to the abandoned ruins of Bhangarh Fort. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a fight to survive the untold story of Bhangarh.

3981530.title: Emoji Guess Party
3981530.short_description: Think you can guess the answer from a few emojis? Emoji Guess Party is a lighthearted emoji puzzle game filled with idioms, wordplay, internet slang, and brain-teasing riddles. Play solo or guess together with friends.

3981680.title: Carte Blanche
3981680.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

3981970.title: Platform Anomaly
3981970.short_description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!
developers: macrayb is the coolest and Nikolai Tapchenko contributed 23 percent of the game

3982150.title: Low Level Hunters
3982150.short_description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

3982430.title: Omertà: Mafia Novel
3982430.short_description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

3982440.title: Deep Claims
3982440.short_description: Deep Claims is a space exploration game where you upgrade your ship and equipment in order to mine increasingly valuable and hazardous asteroids. Can you make it to the core?

3982690.title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
3982690.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

3982770.title: Love and Peace Simulator
3982770.short_description: 《大爱仙尊模拟器》是一款开放世界RPG，身为掌门不仅要提升自身修为，还要强大宗门实力。您扮演蓝夏与蓝珂兄妹，不择手段的活下去。黑暗孕育出恶之花，在没有人伦道德的约束下，在未来等待着的，是何等的欢愉……

3983040.title: 白銀のユークロニア
3983040.short_description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

3983930.title: Tokyo Supplier
3983930.short_description: As a post robot in a future Tokyo under lockdown, deliver packages under pressure. Dodge blockades and hostile bots, beat the clock, and unlock skins for your bot, dog companion, and delivery van.

3985280.title: Song of Kings
3985280.short_description: Song of Kings is a puzzle platformer inspired by Sri Lankan myth. A Yaksha boy, captured by humans, must escape a ruthless king. Guided by his grandfather’s spirit and armed with a magical flute, he uncovers his heritage and fights to return to his people.

3985880.title: INTERVOID
3985880.short_description: A co-op horror game for 2–4 players. You have been brought back from the dead to uncover what happened in an underground complex. Solve its puzzles, survive its trials, and stop the one who killed you.

3986560.title: FIND KITTENS 12: Cave Town
3986560.short_description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

3987140.title: LOOPR
3987140.short_description: A fast-paced puzzle platformer where you must loop through variations of the same level in order to win! Collect artifacts to make the previously impossible actually possible.

3987430.title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
3987430.short_description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

3988220.title: KAKUREONI: Hide-and-Seek Horror
3988220.short_description: This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight. With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness. Experience the thrill of a deadly hunt.

3988640.title: Forbidden Love
3988640.short_description: Love for forbidden dreams, Forbidden Love is a visual novel about the love between a teacher and a student, in pursuit of a forbidden dream.

3989460.title: Coloratura
3989460.short_description: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

3989750.title: One Try Only!
3989750.short_description: A hardcore platformer where you only get one attempt. Fall once, and the game is locked forever.

3989790.title: Cranked
3989790.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

3989800.title: FIND KITTENS 13: Pirates
3989800.short_description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

3990000.title: Echoes of Fire
3990000.short_description: Survive the relentless cold in a stylized, post-apocalyptic wilderness. Gather wood, build fires, and fight to stay alive against the wind, snow, and the wild.

3990340.title: Royal Verdict
3990340.short_description: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

3990450.title: DomeLand
3990450.short_description: Leaving the city behind, driving a pickup truck to a remote wilderness to build a dome farm from scratch. Hand-fabricating components, erecting shelters, growing crops, and running an aquaponics system, then bringing the harvest straight to the farm table.

3990610.title: Escape Path
3990610.short_description: Navigate through complex non-linear mazes dotted with traps, enemies and unique mechanics to rebuild a protective crystal. Watch and think, because rushing in headfirst will lead you to death! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

3990710.title: Invasion Of Britannia
3990710.short_description: Lead Rome’s conquest of Britain in a third-person strategy RPG. Fight, craft, trade, lead armies, and manage settlements in a living world where towns grow, caravans travel, people gain experience, shortages spread, and conquest reshapes the land, even when you are elsewhere.

3991140.title: The Hambagu Shop
3991140.short_description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

3991790.title: Attack of the Astrals
3991790.short_description: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!

3992000.title: FC Tycoon 2027
3992000.short_description: A data-driven football management simulation where you take control of your club's journey — from tactics, scouting and transfers to finances and facilities. Build your philosophy, shape your destiny, and lead your team to greatness.

3994460.title: Drone Farmer
3994460.short_description: First-person farming sim in the middle of a drone war. Shoot down AI drones and explore the village to find seeds and ammo. Use your farm drone to fulfill vegetable quotas faster. Will you let AI replace you, or will humanity prevail?

3994560.title: Sirin's Feather
3994560.short_description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

3998040.title: Fossilfuel 3
3998040.short_description: Navigate an open-world Siberian island overrun by dinosaurs. Circle the island high above the ground on a monorail while a relentless Giganotosaurus hunts you below. Lock and load for the explosive third entry in the Fossilfuel series!

3998640.title: BUG SQUASH
3998640.short_description: Defend your Command Centers against relentless waves of mutated insects! Customize powerful tanks with an arsenal of weapons and tactical modules in this action-packed tower defense game. Go solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

3999040.title: Devoid
3999040.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

3999820.title: Make The Dead Dead Again
3999820.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

4001430.title: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
4001430.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

4001660.title: Undying Knights
4001660.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

4002670.title: Sime Returns
4002670.short_description: Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him. Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

4002700.title: Fist of Goal
4002700.short_description: Fist of Goal is a soccer tournament for one-wheeled robots with levitating fists. Score goals, outsmart your opponents, knock them off their wheels, and use anything you can get your hands on. Preferably for its intended purpose. / Keep going / Think fast / Beat 'em up /

4004550.title: Crystals Bureau
4004550.short_description: Command your Escort Cart and navigate freely across the map! Plot your own defense routes, build towers, hunt for powerful artifacts, and defeat Umbra monsters to bring the Crystal Core home.

4004630.title: Pizza Syndicate
4004630.short_description: Run your pizza empire in this quirky retro tycoon! Manage restaurants, hire staff, craft menus, and outsmart rivals. Dive into the underground syndicate—rob banks, hire hitmen, sabotage competitors, and use any scheme to dominate the city with humor and strategy! WISHLIST NOW!

4004820.title: FreeStyle Football 2
4004820.short_description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

4006370.title: Santa's Legacy
4006370.short_description: Become Santa and run Christmas. Build your workshop, manage mischievous elves, craft millions of gifts, and deliver them all before Christmas morning.

4006570.title: Scrapborne
4006570.short_description: A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world.

4006670.title: Titanic: Honor & Glory
4006670.short_description: Explore the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible, situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard.

4007640.title: Signal Station
4007640.short_description: Remote listening station. 1984. You're the operator decoding an impossible signal using oscilloscopes, tape machines, and analog equipment. Align satellites. Analyze waveforms. Make choices that determine humanity's response. Multiple endings. DISCOVER THE TRUTH!

4007910.title: ORE x TRACTOR
4007910.short_description: ORE x TRACTOR is a short, incremental game about demolishing space rocks with a variety of weaponry.

4008580.title: Vapor Strange
4008580.short_description: Select a Universe to explore. Then jump into bizarre psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, while experience shifting rulesets, and mini-games for a wild and truly strange experience.

4008690.title: REVOLVER
4008690.short_description: Tired of immortality, the Demoness has lured you into a trap and asks for a favor: remove the curse from her revolver, bet your life and rip the lost soul of suffering. This rendezvous will make you take full risks. But remember: once you sign the Act of Blood, no chance to turn it back.

4009100.title: Fallen Valkyries: Prologue
4009100.short_description: An Anime Wave-based Arena Shooter, Kill Goblin > Collect Bounty > Buy Upgrade > Survive

4009490.title: Arctic Drive
4009490.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

4010050.title: Rule of Iron: Dark Age
4010050.short_description: Build your realm in a turn-based campaign. Command your armies in real-time battles.

4010070.title: Lumber Plumber
4010070.short_description: Lumber Plumber is a game about tree felling, water plumbing, ore mining, rock crushing, metal bending, resource exploring, and wonder assembling. Transport lumber across long distances using steam locomotives and conveyor belts.

4011130.title: Ants Megapolis
4011130.short_description: Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world by forging your unique Pheromone, a weapon that dictates your evolution. Carve out an empire from the dirt as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

4011630.title: Not My Base!
4011630.short_description: Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn. Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

4012160.title: Fire Crew Simulator
4012160.short_description: A co-op firefighting sim for up to 4 players. Fly helicopters with water buckets and drive the fire engine against a forest fire that spreads tree by tree, all on the same map. Or run the lookout tower campaign on your own.

4012170.title: Spellbroker
4012170.short_description: Become a master Spellbroker — wield magic and money in a fast-paced, isometric pixel art marketplace. Buy low, sell high, and bend the market to your will as you build your fortune in a world where profit is pure magic.

4012380.title: Cut the Strings
4012380.short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

4012720.title: Posse of 3
4012720.short_description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

4013270.title: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
4013270.short_description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

4013860.title: Drowned in the Light：Gloom
4013860.short_description: Drowned in the Light: Gloom is a high-difficulty, real-time turn-based, story-driven character development game. Players will explore the unknown world.

4014030.title: Maidle Cafe
4014030.short_description: Run your own maid café in this charming idle incremental game! Hire and upgrade maids, decorate with unique items, and grow your café into the ultimate cozy hotspot—all while earning profits even when you’re away.

4014190.title: Teddy Won't Help
4014190.short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.

4014210.title: Sweep Squad
4014210.short_description: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

4014610.title: Necromancer's Workshop
4014610.short_description: Necromancer’s Workshop is a fantasy tycoon game. Craft zombies, work the land. Build a cozy countryside business, worth waking the dead for.

4015800.title: Deck Breach
4015800.short_description: We fused roguelike deckbuilders and autobattlers to create a whole new experience. Pick your favorite weapon, craft a unique deck, create your unique playstyle, and play powerful cards to influence the outcome of the battle in a unique combat style where your Hero’s actions are your resources.

4016500.title: Point In Time
4016500.short_description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

4018480.title: Pistonica
4018480.short_description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

4018610.title: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
4018610.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. Play solo or with friends (1 to 4 players), with crossplay.

4018940.title: The Beginner Investor
4018940.short_description: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

4019040.title: One Last Sacrifice
4019040.short_description: Most autobattlers reset after every match. One Last Sacrifice doesn't. Unlock skills across a branching skill tree. Build a deck. Improve creatures by crafting. Compete in 1v1 duels or 8-player elimination tournaments - sync and async play supported.

4019190.title: Pradera
4019190.short_description: Pradera is a first-person psychological horror. You play as Clarice, an ambitious lawyer taking on an impossible case. Nine people were decapitated. The bodies remain. The heads are gone. A gamble for fame becomes a real nightmare.

4019440.title: Wanderer's Deck
4019440.short_description: “Wanderer’s Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deck-building game. Every choice reshapes your fate: build your deck, step through mysterious doors, battle deadly foes, and face powerful bosses lurking in the dungeons.”

4020470.title: Echograve
4020470.short_description: You have been appointed warden of an underground complex. Check documents and identify dangerous citizens by their behavior and sounds. Decide whom to let through the airlock and defend against threats from below. Until your shift ends, their lives — and yours — are your responsibility.

4021110.title: Factory Time
4021110.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

4021250.title: Pages of Tomorrow
4021250.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

4021290.title: Shake
4021290.short_description: A Revolutionary Fillet Action Game! Control a salmon fillet, something you never knew you wanted—until now.

4021650.title: Redline District
4021650.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy about evacuation coordination. As the voice on the radio, guide survivors through real-world city streets, manage squad roles, and calculate every move in deterministic combat before the expanding hazard zone engulfs the district.

4021890.title: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope
4021890.short_description: Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!

4022050.title: Turbo 16
4022050.short_description: Turbo 16 depicts a coming-of-age narrative through combining arcade racing and storytelling. Turbo 16 is a racing game and provides players with racing challenges (3 modes), the game is equally an environmental narrative experience.

4022200.title: Destiny Is Dice
4022200.short_description: A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls. The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place. She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team! Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

4022310.title: Wheelie Bad
4022310.short_description: Grab the wheels solo or sync up in co-op. Race a high-speed wheelchair through deadly tracks, dodge brutal hazards, and restart on every hit. Push your reflexes, beat the timer, and claim 3 stars on every stage.

4022420.title: Hellborn: No Survivors
4022420.short_description: Hellborn: No Survivors is a cute, unique survivors-like/bullet heaven where you descend into hell and slay hordes of undead, demonic creatures. Balance risk versus reward, master the flames of hell, collect powerful relics and evolve to unlock your potential and take on endless waves of the wicked.

4022580.title: Hero's Unison
4022580.short_description: Hero’s Unison is a 2D pixel action RPG where you are summoned as a hero to a mysterious new world. Form a 3-hero party, link souls with your allies, and unleash unique powers to stand against the darkness threatening all realms.

4022970.title: Infinity Rising
4022970.short_description: Infinity Rising is an open‑world sandbox set between Cornucopias—the Nation in the Sky—and Earth Below. Players traverse both worlds to explore, gather, craft, build bases and land plots, trade in a player‑driven economy, and respond to rift‑related events and Terra through PvE.

4023310.title: Cluepuff Adventures
4023310.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

4023590.title: Neon Dreams
4023590.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

4028760.title: Cosmo Cargo
4028760.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

4030360.title: Undertaker
4030360.short_description: Hunt eldritch horrors in the cursed lands of Transylvania. Stalk your prey with blades and bullets, craft your ideal loadout, and conduct unnatural rituals in this gothic shooter.

4031300.title: WORLD WAR V: LAST CALL
4031300.short_description: Lighthearted comic war action! Battle across voxel and pixel worlds to stop the V Empire’s ambition. Break terrain, uncover items, and face unique bosses. Behind the cute visuals lies a truly challenging game waiting for you!

4033640.title: Delivery Survivors
4033640.short_description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

4033660.title: Mr Bear Goes to Washington
4033660.short_description: A satirical hand-drawn 2D action platformer where a grizzly bear runs, jumps, and mauls his way through enemies in solo or local co-op. Blending fast-paced combat and platforming with a nostalgic, poster-inspired art style, every level feels handcrafted and full of character.

4034350.title: Loss Prevention
4034350.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

4036440.title: Metamorph Clicker
4036440.short_description: An evolution clicker where you guide a larva from simple forms to incredible creatures. Click, collect resources, unlock upgrades and progress through stages. At the end of each stage, a spectacular metamorphosis awaits - a complete transformation into a new species!

4036920.title: Everbrew
4036920.short_description: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

4037100.title: Tower of Creation
4037100.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

4037400.title: Lunar Lakes
4037400.short_description: Who said death is the end? In Lunar, death is just the start. Catch mysterious creatures, uncover wandering merchants’ stories, make new friends, and build your own trading empire. All of it happens in the corner of your screen. Still think death is the end?

4038300.title: Lost In Your Eyes
4038300.short_description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

4038890.title: Total Destruction
4038890.short_description: A 2D side-view action game focused on dynamic destruction and awesome explosions, featuring tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers, ships, APCs, IFVs, artillery and more. May contain nuclear weapons.

4039480.title: 恋语彼方
4039480.short_description: 这是一款青春恋爱百合视觉小说，讲述温曦瑶与顾晨曦于大学校园重逢之时，终于将暗藏多年的心意诉诸彼此。然而，一场意外让两人分别。可距离不曾磨灭眷恋的火种，跨越过记忆与厄运的障碍。最终，她们选择紧握彼此的手，以坚定的温柔共赴命运，写就一段关于勇气与深情的动人恋章。

4040130.title: Ghosts With Hats
4040130.short_description: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

4040480.title: 桂冠之人 Laureate
4040480.short_description: “世间仅此一件的视觉小说，一件没什么用，却又独一无二的艺术品。”

4041410.title: Noir Tycoon
4041410.short_description: Build your criminal empire in the turbulent 1960s, manage rackets, outsmart rival gangs, and rise from the streets to the top of the underworld.

4041780.title: Dungeon Buster
4041780.short_description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

4043810.title: Syncblade
4043810.short_description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

4044990.title: DEG
4044990.short_description: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

4045810.title: City God Alice：城隍愛麗絲
4045810.short_description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

4046540.title: 白日梦Daydream
4046540.short_description: "Daydream" is a light puzzle game that is based on the connection between real life and dreams. The inspirations gained by the player in the dream give them strength, which makes them more powerful in reality.

4047220.title: Drone Soccer
4047220.short_description: Drone Soccer is a 5v5 full-contact aerial sport. Pilot a caged drone as the Striker to score through the goal hoop, or play Defender and smash opponents out of the sky to clear the lane. Compete in online multiplayer or sharpen your flying in solo practice.

4047630.title: Sketch Switch
4047630.short_description: You draw on a sheet of paper. Kakiko, an AI, looks at it and says what it sees. Whatever Kakiko says is what happens next. Drawing skill doesn't matter. A round takes about five minutes.

4047890.title: Digging Out
4047890.short_description: Digging Out is a realistic co-op digging game for up to 8 players. Work together to dig a tunnel, upgrade your tools, and break into the bank. Every shovel counts plan smart, dig deep, and pull off the perfect underground heist.

4048090.title: The Chessboard Mystery:47 West Street,Highgate
4048090.short_description: Step into Highgate a fog-shrouded town in 1956, where a mysterious murder shatters the silence. As a private investigator, explore scenes, gather evidence, and question suspects. Use your evidence board to trace lies, face branching choices, and uncover the hidden truth behind the crime.

4048230.title: SATSUBATSU SUCCUBUS
4048230.short_description: YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS. KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

4048480.title: Last Ride
4048480.short_description: YOU are launched at full speed into the arena, determined to crush your opponents at the wheel of your racing car. But even when your car gives up the ghost, the fight isn't over. You continue the battle on foot until there is only ONE SURVIVOR left!

4048490.title: Wetter
4048490.short_description: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

4049200.title: Moon Stop
4049200.short_description: In a silent, isolated lunar base, a lonely astronaut embarks on a moving journey to recover her daughter’s final memory. Through cold corridors and fragments of the past, a profound story unfolds about love, loss, and the human need for connection.

4049230.title: 颠倒世界 World Inverted
4049230.short_description: The sky lies beneath our feet.Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun.This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

4049820.title: Rest Here
4049820.short_description: Your world above, the ever changing Shadows below: Terraform your world, mine resources, craft gear, fight monsters, make alliances, rescue who you can, extract what you carry. Make it back and your cozy world thrives. Die? and the Shadows keep it all.

4049990.title: Logistics Simulator: America
4049990.short_description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

4050070.title: Infinite Bloom
4050070.short_description: Embody beings from vast cosmos to tiny plankton, and even your mind in Infinite Bloom! Use your hands to flap or swim. Power, identity, and scale become fluid. Faced with the vastness of the world, human is only a drop in the ocean, part of a continuum of life far greater than us.

4050260.title: King's Haven
4050260.short_description: A combo-driven roguelike, where every Citizen is a card in your deck. Draft a Knight, Vampire, Rat King, Chef or over 100 other unique Citizens to chain together powerful synergies. Construct landmarks, survive seasonal threats and defend your Haven in this quirky roguelike deckbuilder.

4050290.title: Rise of Sorcery
4050290.short_description: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

4050580.title: Toxoplasma
4050580.short_description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

4050590.title: HABAP
4050590.short_description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

4050710.title: Loot And Defend
4050710.short_description: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

4051470.title: BrokenLore: ASCEND
4051470.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

4051500.title: Gensou Bullet Battle
4051500.short_description: This is a top-down shooter designed primarily for multiplayer. Players control a variety of unique characters and battle across stages filled with intense bullet patterns. (This game is an unofficial fan game based on the Touhou Project.)

4051800.title: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
4051800.short_description: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

4052030.title: Heart of Vinterium
4052030.short_description: There is an artifact capable of granting any wish, but only the strongest are destined to find it. In Heart of Vinterium, you must explore grim and shifting worlds where every step could be your last. Fight, collect magical cards, and solve mysteries.

4052120.title: EpiDexa Racing
4052120.short_description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

4052280.title: Forest of Fear - Into the Woods
4052280.short_description: A first-person horror journey through a haunted forest, created by a solo developer. Explore a single large map, uncover hidden story fragments, and survive unpredictable scares in this atmospheric debut made with Unreal Engine 5.

4052920.title: Fragments of Chaos
4052920.short_description: Want to explore dungeons, master spells, hunt monsters, or spend the afternoon fishing? Go for it. Want to paralyze another player, steal their loot, and disappear before their friends arrive? That works too.

4053550.title: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
4053550.short_description: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

4054200.title: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
4054200.short_description: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

4054750.title: Tidewake
4054750.short_description: Tidewake is an arcade naval roguelite for one to four captains. Sail, fight and loot your way up a shelf of bottled sea battles, bolt on cannons, stack relics that bend every shot, and beat the lackey at the top to win your soul back from Davy Jones.

4054790.title: Beatrix
4054790.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

4054850.title: Forgotten - Whispers of the Past
4054850.short_description: Something in this abandoned boarding school refuses to rest. Use your flashlight to survive what lurks in its hallways and solve the puzzles that reveal its dark past. Will you find the truth, or will you be the one forgotten tonight?

4054990.title: Crystal Realms
4054990.short_description: Crystal Realms is a MMO game where you can gather resources and make your own worlds! You can fight enemies, complete quests, craft items, build worlds, make friends and much more.

4055170.title: Cherry on Top
4055170.short_description: Chain abilities, get rich, and bake an unbreakable defense!

4056000.title: Cleaning Raccrew
4056000.short_description: Bonk your friends and knock them away to become the proud owner of the coveted Golden Broom in Cleaning Raccrew! Cleaning Raccrew is a multiplayer game, both online and local, inspired in games like sumo, where you must knock your opponents out of an area to win, using wacky powerups!

4056060.title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
4056060.short_description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

4057870.title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors
4057870.short_description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

4058300.title: Deep Siren
4058300.short_description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

4059040.title: Snake Fusion
4059040.short_description: Snake meets roguelike. Eat everything in your path, fuse matching pieces into stronger forms, choose powerful upgrades, and build an absurdly powerful snake as you fight to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

4059090.title: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
4059090.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

4059620.title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
4059620.short_description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

4059710.title: MineEngineer
4059710.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

4061170.title: SlashZero
4061170.short_description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

4062420.title: Pill After Pill
4062420.short_description: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. DRIVE, SHOOT, RAM, EXPLODE, DRINK BEER, TAKE PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL>...

4062680.title: Zeroth
4062680.short_description: Guide fallen heroes through a post-life adventure in the absurd and ever-changing 0th circle of Haell. Exploit the sandbox physics and experiment with mysterious treasure to postpone your inevitable death. Emergent chaos and exasperated heroes, only in Zeroth.

4063560.title: Still Hope
4063560.short_description: An investigation becomes a nightmare when Sam searches for missing Jess. Explore a private research facility and confront his story-rich, emotional journey into psychological horror.

4065590.title: 卡恩特村
4065590.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

4067800.title: My Little Coffee Shop
4067800.short_description: Open your own coffee shop, brew coffee and desserts, serve customers, decorate the interior, and grow your business.

4067820.title: Please, Spin
4067820.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

4068280.title: Dittomatic
4068280.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

4068390.title: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
4068390.short_description: Join Cain & Iddo in this cartoony action platforming adventure! Traverse through 12 levels with 16 bosses on the quest to have the best Break Week ever, against all odds.

4069050.title: Mage Escape 2000
4069050.short_description: A 32-player extraction ARPG. Battle monsters and rival squads for priceless loot as the Isle collapses around you. Die, and lose it all. Extract, and live to raid again.
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra
publishers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

4069240.title: Frog Up!
4069240.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

4069740.title: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
4069740.short_description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

4070510.title: Luminids
4070510.short_description: A cozy colony-building adventure with two ways to play: experience the story campaign or create your own colony. Shape the land, build homes and grow food for little creatures with lives of their own. Plan from above, then switch to first person to explore your settlement and the world beyond.

4070570.title: Unfathomable Titans
4070570.short_description: A turn-of-the-century transportation management game in which you control the world's largest cargo shipping company. Connect ports, deliver cargo, cultivate relationships, and adapt your business all while trying to avoid getting fired.

4070690.title: HeroesSagaZero
4070690.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

4070810.title: Crosstalk
4070810.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

4071450.title: Pink Light
4071450.short_description: In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.

4071770.title: Rampart
4071770.short_description: Build and upgrade towers, defend your fortress from the growing onslaught. With each wave, the challenges become more difficult, but a smart strategy and the right decisions will help you endure and prevail!

4072030.title: Straying Rules
4072030.short_description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

4072630.title: Neighborhood Video
4072630.short_description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

4072900.title: Unknown Call: Ohio
4072900.short_description: You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you. Escape the creatures in the dark and find your friend.

4072920.title: True Nightmare - Diner Loop
4072920.short_description: You're a rookie FBI agent trapped in an endless loop inside a roadside diner. Spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive the entity hunting you. Every mistake brings it closer, and every loop reveals something more terrifying. A psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic.

4073500.title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
4073500.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

4073840.title: Roll or Die
4073840.short_description: The roguelike dicebuilder. Build your dice bag and go as far as you can in this underground casino! Earn chips, place your bets, combine unique dice, and create absurd synergies as you advance through increasingly exclusive rooms. Bet it all, challenge your luck, and reach the top — or die trying.

4074890.title: Sibling Steelers ~Forge & Family~
4074890.short_description: This game is created with RPG Maker MZ. Play as Alyssa's brother, slaying monsters, collecting materials in dungeons, and completing various events for the sake of your sister's dream...

4075210.title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
4075210.short_description: Build the ultimate die-cast car model shop! Find, buy, and sell rare miniatures, customize and expand your store, create racing tracks, and grow a small local shop into a world-famous destination for collectors.

4075630.title: Bloomies
4075630.short_description: A cozy incremental creature collector that lives on your taskbar! Plant seeds, hatch eggs and raise over 70 unique Bloomies while you work or play. Unlock skills until it all runs itself, defeat bosses for new seeds and hunt rare Sparkle variants to complete your collection.

4075830.title: Evocation
4075830.short_description: Evocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.

4075840.title: Front Page
4075840.short_description: As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. What kind of Editor will you become?

4077890.title: Rank & Ruin
4077890.short_description: Real-time squad combat meets roguelite progression. Pick your faction, earn legendary heroes on the battlefield, and grow stronger with every run in Rank & Ruin

4078190.title: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
4078190.short_description: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

4078600.title: PiPu Party
4078600.short_description: PiPu Party is a chaotic puzzle action game. Share a magic symbol bag to reshape the entire level in real time. No single 'correct' way to play it. Solo puzzles & 2 player co-op & 2-8 player competitive chaos party.

4080200.title: Once Upon a Swagman
4080200.short_description: A relaxing survival experience where you journey from place to place, camping along a pixel art coastline as a traditional Australian swagman. You will face a realistic simulated coastal bush environment, follow in the footsteps of the old swaggies, and discover what lies at the end of your journey.

4080660.title: Camino Ghosts
