4080660.short_description: Enter a world overtaken by ghostly beings. Choose your companion, survive alone or in a team, restore infrastructure like power and water, build your home, and hold back the ghostly hordes. Explore the vast open world and uncover the cause of the change.

4080740.title: The Man Who Walked
4080740.short_description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

4082870.title: Gridbound Tactics
4082870.short_description: Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP tactics auto-battler where TFT-style drafting meets Backpack Battles-style spatial buildcraft. Draft units, multiply local trait power with placement, and find the strongest shape for the pieces you hit.

4083240.title: ERROR:Ai.lien
4083240.short_description: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

4083460.title: Memories Of Tacticians
4083460.short_description: Memories of Tacticians is a turn-based tactics RPG about keeping your party alive. Move across the grid in chess-style patterns, roll dice to hit, and upgrade your heroes between fights. Each battle is built around who you have left, and the fallen stay dead. How far can your party go?

4083600.title: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
4083600.short_description: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

4083810.title: WotaBeats
4083810.short_description: 《WotaBeats: Code Aria》 is a VR rhythm experience fusing music, idols, and energy. Swing your glowsticks, fight BUGs, and keep the stage alive—feel the beat, live the light. 「Feel the rhythm. Recode the idol.」

4084360.title: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise
4084360.short_description: Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac has returned to Chichester, England for a secret mission. Can the protagonist stop her?

4084400.title: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
4084400.short_description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

4084710.title: Rayman Legends Retold
4084710.short_description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

4084970.title: Backrooms: Eternals
4084970.short_description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

4085280.title: Paw Pop Breakout
4085280.short_description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

4085600.title: Fever Tilt
4085600.short_description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

4086080.title: Bones will Fly: Tower Defense
4086080.short_description: A cozy 3D tower defense where every hit makes the bones fly! Build and upgrade towers, give them specializations and blast marching skeletons into bouncing, physics-driven bones. Watch the skies for flying skulls and defend 25 levels across meadow, snow, desert, lava and graveyard.

4086160.title: Pogo Together
4086160.short_description: Pogo Together is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top using pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping, You just control the movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together and race to the finish line!

4087100.title: Ominous Gift
4087100.short_description: Escape this dungeon that's like a prison! Embark on an adventure through the remnants of an ancient kingdom, using unique weapons that define how you traverse the world, fight your way through hostile inhabitants as you find the path out of this dungeon that was once a great kingdom.

4087340.title: Dominar Sanctum
4087340.short_description: Why just command your army when you can join the fight? Build your fortress, command your minions, and possess your hero to unleash third-person combat in this dark fantasy fusion of dungeon management, RTS and action.

4087500.title: The Final Hold
4087500.short_description: You and your teammates must survive as long as possible against relentless robots and deadly creatures. Your aim matters, but so does your strategy. Every enemy type fights differently, so stay ready. Fortify your base with turrets, healing stations, traps and a variety of upgrades.

4087510.title: North Pole Defense
4087510.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

4087530.title: Breaking Armor
4087530.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

4087550.title: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
4087550.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

4088520.title: MeowFactory
4088520.short_description: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

4088870.title: RoboSquare: Recharged
4088870.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

4089390.title: Down Under Destruction
4089390.short_description: Down Under Destruction is a stylised first person action brawler with an Australian twist, featuring a vengeful bricklayer taking on a demonically influenced building corporation, one brick throw at a time.

4090280.title: Feral Prince
4090280.short_description: Rip Soul Orbs from weakened enemies, forge them into black-jade Soul Tiles, and lock five into a poker hand that reshapes your next fight. Dokkaebi Masks cheat the rules, while escaped Husks return as Wraiths carrying the power you stole. A 2D action roguelite.

4090570.title: Like Me
4090570.short_description: Turn your shut-in childhood friend into a VTuber and aim for 10 billion followers! Click SNS "Like" buttons in this clicker x idle x Adventure game. When growth slows, use "reincarnation" to boost SNS power and unlock new "Tsukimin" forms. A fresh take on modern SNS society with cute visuals.

4090610.title: Less Miserables
4090610.short_description: A historical comedy adventure game, loosely based on Les Misérables, with classic point-and-click puzzles, hand drawn art and an amazing voice cast.

4091620.title: Suiren
4091620.short_description: "Suiren" is a 2D platformer game in which you use the power of nature to perform various actions and progress through the stages. One day, a fire of unknown cause breaks out, and it is solved by utilizing the power of water and the natural forces of various regions.

4091990.title: BUZZ QUIZ
4091990.short_description: Buzz Quiz is the best way to liven up any gathering: play alone or with friends, create your own quizzes with photos and videos, share them in the workshop, and turn them into cool videos or offline parties. Fast, fun, and always your way!

4093020.title: Zone Shot
4093020.short_description: Zone Shot is a new and original sports game with roguelite elements. Choose your team, draft, train, and trade players. Choose between weekly events to build up your HQ and deck. Be the coach, choose your cards, and manage player choices in game to earn your way to holding the championship!

4093040.title: Saimin Gakuen: Intrusion Edition
4093040.short_description: A classic title from renowned Japanese visual novel developers Fudegaki Soft! What kind of unexpected encounters await the seemingly ordinary protagonist in his professional journey...?

4093200.title: Buggos: Death Squad
4093200.short_description: Buggos: Death Squad is a 4-player co-op wave defense game. Build a base with turrets, walls, shields and robots, fight hundreds of Buggos at once in first person, and attack their nests to slow down the waves. In Versus mode, you can also play as the Buggos against your friends.

4093880.title: Angry Cleaner VR
4093880.short_description: The night shift has gone wrong. In Angry Cleaner VR, you’re the janitor in an office full of secrets. Move quietly, take them down one by one, and leave no one behind.

4093950.title: Outage
4093950.short_description: Noah had run from his past, from his sins. But they had other plans for him. The mind always harbors its deepest dread, and when the time comes, you must face it. For Noah, that time has come.

4094280.title: Eryndor
4094280.short_description: Eryndor es un RPG de supervivencia y acción en estilo low-poly donde exploras vastos mundos, recolectas recursos, combates enemigos y compites en intensos modos PvP.

4094820.title: Space Evolver
4094820.short_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

4095000.title: Ballistic Brews
4095000.short_description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

4095120.title: Chaos Company🔥
4095120.short_description: Third-person 2.5D action roguelike where mercenaries fight undeads, monsters, and heretics for money. Take deadly contracts, survive brutal combat, collect loot, and grow stronger with every run.

4096240.title: Delta 4 Terminal Protocol
4096240.short_description: Wake up to silence. One terminal, one survivor, one dying ship. Can you bring the Delta-4 back online? Delta 4 is a sci-fi survival terminal sim—type commands, decode logs, and fight to keep a dying ship alive.

4097620.title: Cartefact
4097620.short_description: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity’s energy crisis.

4097660.title: The Wonderland Killings
4097660.short_description: The Magic Circle is excited to welcome you to a truly wondrous experience. Relax by bonding with your fellow Guests! Then investigate and argue over their murders! In this Danganronpa-inspired Visual Novel, your mystery-solving skills will truly be put to the test. Please, enjoy your stay.

4097720.title: StoneSpace
4097720.short_description: Crashed on an alien planet, your only hope of seeing home again is building a new ship from scratch. Explore, gather resources, expand your base, level up your skills, and craft hundreds of items – from flint tools to nuclear reactors.

4098070.title: SHALTER-03
4098070.short_description: Time is ticking. In this co-op first-person puzzle-adventure game where the senses of sight, hearing, and speech are disabled, each level introduces new mechanics. Think fast, balance buffs and debuffs, and find the most efficient path to victory. Adaptability is your greatest weapon.

4099200.title: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES
4099200.short_description: A groundbreaking 3D dungeon RPG where you aim for the ultimate goal — the 999th floor. Live-action footage and 3D CG merge to create an overwhelming sense of immersion, where reality and fantasy intertwine. Explore hyper-realistic dungeons and face powerful monsters that will test her fate.

4099250.title: 薪上人 Salaryman
4099250.short_description: "Xinshangren" is a simulation management and cultivation + romance adventure GalGame. As an unemployed and money-strapped individual, you encounter various girls while working part-time, sharing the hardships of survival. Amidst the daily routine, sparks of affection ignite, shaping your unique

4099630.title: Tiling Town
4099630.short_description: Open-world logic puzzle game about building towns by laying tiles.

4100300.title: Sunderborn
4100300.short_description: This is a multiplayer asynchronous sandbox with elements of puzzles, logic games, world exploration, and strategy. Take on the role of the Creator, shaping your own reality out of the surrounding Chaos. Manage your created world and compete with other Gods!

4100780.title: Raiders Of Below
4100780.short_description: Create absurd builds, discover powerful item synergies, discover secrets, challenge the dungeon alone or with up to 4 players.

4100870.title: Trashcan Man
4100870.short_description: Propel yourself to victory in this recoil-driven platformer where shooting is the only way to move. Survive 100+ challenging levels in your trusty trashcan, utilizing physics and precise aim to soar through five unique worlds. Do you have the skill to beat the creator?"

4101830.title: One Song, One Life
4101830.short_description: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

4101920.title: Blight Doctors
4101920.short_description: DISCOVER, DIAGNOSE, EXORCISE. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

4102020.title: Idle Garden
4102020.short_description: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

4103020.title: Shutter Evidence
4103020.short_description: Only you can uncover the truth hidden in the darkness. Glide into crime scenes with your drone, find keys, unlock doors, and photograph evidence. Be careful — if the culprits spot you, your drone could take heavy damage.

4103180.title: Kugle
4103180.short_description: Raise your Kugle, explore open worlds and take on your friends in mini-games where gravity knows no bounds. Free-to-play, cross-platform on PC and mobile.

4104520.title: PECADO
4104520.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

4104790.title: Drako: Blood Heist
4104790.short_description: Drako: Blood Heist is an action roguelite set in a world of vampire cats. Hack, mod, farm and fight in a fur-raising attempt to empty the city’s blood banks!

4105030.title: Dice Slinger
4105030.short_description: Become a dice slinging legend in the weird west world. Carefully craft your deck of dice and stratagems to hunt ever more dangerous bounties. Who knows, maybe even the Death itself shall fall to your ingenuity. Become the one true Diceslinger.

4105040.title: Russian Village Business
4105040.short_description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again — just like in the good old days!

4105500.title: Agent Pigeon 7
4105500.short_description: Shoot your way through endless waves of government drones! Grab loot, level up, unlock pigeons and upgrades to create unique and crazy gun loadouts as you destroy mindless waves of government robots.

4106260.title: Silurian Planet
4106260.short_description: Silurian Planet is a first-person survival horror game. Survive on a hostile and oppressive planet, seek shelter, manage resources, and make decisions to escape creatures lurking in the darkness.

4107800.title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
4107800.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

4108680.title: Nightholme
4108680.short_description: Nightholme is a 12-player, third-person PvEvP extraction horror game. Hunt solo or in duos through an ever-changing city where one encounter can set off a chain reaction. Fight with abilities, not guns. Transform into a monster for devastating power, at the cost of your sanity. How far will you go?

4109040.title: FamCram
4109040.short_description: FamCram is a 3D grid-based puzzle game about two dads putting their kids to bed. Guide the children through increasingly challenging and multicultural settings, each with unique items, mechanics, and humor.

4109510.title: Realm of the Wyvern
4109510.short_description: A tactical turn-based RPG set in a fully handcrafted dark fantasy world.

4109640.title: Perfect Timeline
4109640.short_description: A fast-paced action runner game, features roguelite play style. Race against enemies, battle relentless threats, and collect energy to unlock powerful skills and upgrades. Stay fast, stay powered, and prove you are the ultimate Reality Hunter.

4110700.title: Love Rebirth: Rebellion
4110700.short_description: This is a story-driven adventure focused on player choice and psychological immersion. Your decisions shape relationships, influence the narrative, and lead to multiple endings within a richly atmospheric cyberpunk world. This experience prioritizes story and emotional tension.

4110770.title: Apple Crumble
4110770.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

4111540.title: Night Hike
4111540.short_description: Find your way through a dark wilderness in this puzzle roguelite where you assemble the trail. Choose your path, interact with lost souls and navigate obstacles with the spin of your compass to escape the endless night.

4111800.title: Cosmist
4111800.short_description: Expand your empire one sector at a time in a fast-paced turn-based 4X strategy game. Capture planets, harvest resources, command powerful fleets, and adapt your strategy with unique Emperors and unpredictable divine interventions. Play solo, or challenge rivals in tactical PvP.

4112020.title: Medieval Tax Evasion Simulator
4112020.short_description: Run a medieval market stall where every sale's a choice: pay your taxes like an honest merchant or evade them. Hide your untaxed wealth, train companion animals for help, and survive audits in this first-person stealth management game. Check how good you are at the fine art of looking innocent.

4112440.title: RPG Map Maker
4112440.short_description: RPG Map Maker is a tool for creating fantasy maps. Create epic grim-dark worlds, ancient kingdoms, or mysterious forests with ease. Perfect for DMs, world builders and game developers.

4112500.title: Wolfsbane Manor
4112500.short_description: Team up, explore, and survive the night in Wolfsbane Manor—a 4-player co-op horror game of trust and betrayal. Search for weapons, clues, and hidden artifacts before one player becomes possessed, gaining deadly powers. 4 possession types mean no two games play the same. Work together...or die alone.

4112580.title: AstroDiner Manager
4112580.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

4112620.title: Flapverse
4112620.short_description: Take flight through surreal 2D worlds where beauty and danger go hand in hand. Every level in Flapverse has its own atmosphere, visual style, and challenges that demand precision, quick reactions, and perseverance.

4113000.title: MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA
4113000.short_description: With refined battle mechanics and new characters joining the fray, the moonlit mania enters the next stage. A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream...

4113190.title: The Story of Mikagoyama
4113190.short_description: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

4113400.title: Slaughterhouse
4113400.short_description: Trapped inside a snowbound mansion, you must eliminate the five employees responsible for your parents’ deaths and their plot to seize the family fortune. Combine household objects to create deadly traps, protect what is yours, make sure not a single one of them leaves the mansion alive.

4113890.title: STARLET☆DISORDER
4113890.short_description: Join STARLET☆DISORDER, the reality show: get famous, loved, watched. Live with rivals. Perform love. Survive confessionals. Go viral. Truth is ammunition. But there’s no clean truth. Broadcast turns your week into a story that never happened. Go live and swear you didn't mean it. It’s all recorded.

4113930.title: Gambition
4113930.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

4113970.title: Lostade
4113970.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

4114060.title: こっくりさんのいうとおり
4114060.short_description: A 3D horror game where movement is prohibited. (Japanese Only) 3D一人称視点「移動禁止」ホラーゲーム。観察・会話・こっくりさんが鍵。

4114290.title: Love and Bread
4114290.short_description: Homeless, jobless, and buried in debt, rebuild your life in Moonville. Farm and cook custom meals, juggle your physical and mental needs, work jobs or launch your own business, and win over the town's people and cats along the way.

4114520.title: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island
4114520.short_description: Welcome to Phantasmal Neon Island! In this sleepless city, you inherit your father’s legendary host club after his accident. Manage debts, recruit new hosts, and survive rent hikes and rival clubs. Will you build a nightlife empire—or fall in love and lose it all?

4114620.title: Auto Ball Arena
4114620.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

4115040.title: Infini Orbis
4115040.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

4115300.title: A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS
4115300.short_description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

4115510.title: Meowzic Survivor
4115510.short_description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

4115740.title: Blind Dog
4115740.short_description: You are a detective who is slowly going blind. The only faces you can still see clearly belong to those who are about to die. A visual novel investigation where every choice affects the fate of Tokyo and leads you either closer to the truth or deeper into darkness.

4115910.title: Card Kingdom
4115910.short_description: Stack cards, merge them and grow your kingdom during the day, and protect your land against waves of bandits at night. A survival micro-RTS card game that takes you from survival to ruler of the island.

4116250.title: Bad Beat: Dark Fantasy Roguelike
4116250.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy roguelike. Slide rows and columns of a cursed grid, line up winning combos and chain effects to defeat the casino's Dealers. Every turn is a gamble. Every bet costs a piece of your soul.

4116400.title: Sunstone of Time
4116400.short_description: Step into the role of a brilliant scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secrets, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs.

4116630.title: Hold My Winch!
4116630.short_description: A co-op survival adventure about driving, climbing, and winching your way across a deadly island to reach & repair its antenna.

4118860.title: Ranch Revolution
4118860.short_description: A piglet kidnapped by a vile butcher. Dive into a gory field of vengeance, rescue the piglet, and bring it home!

4120420.title: Pharmacy 24
4120420.short_description: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

4120520.title: Hex-Caliber
4120520.short_description: Dive into the depths of Hell's Vestibule as a gunned Ritualist. Fight off roaming scores of monsters by empowering your firearms with spells and Rituals in a fast-paced dungeon crawler roguelike.

4122580.title: Card Storm Idle HD
4122580.short_description: Card Storm Idle HD is a Free to Play incremental game that blends idle and active play. Explore and build your card deck, master three attack modes to earn tons of resources! Summon Heroes to your aid, build up your power, and see how far you can go. Unleash a card storm on paper monsters!

4123460.title: Breakrooms
4123460.short_description: You wake in the seams of a world that shouldn't exist. Breakrooms is a sci-fi horror adventure set in an alternate dimension that will make you question your own reality.

4123880.title: Shoot till you meet Death
4123880.short_description: You can’t outrun Death — but you can make him wait. Shoot till you meet Death is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter. Survive endless waves, forge powerful bullet synergies, and push your limits until you finally meet DEATH himself.

4124290.title: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
4124290.short_description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

4124480.title: BlackHole Defence
4124480.short_description: You are the black hole. Pull in matter, gain mass and grow while your attacks keep the battlefield moving. Turn a small singularity into the centre of a cosmic battle.

4125070.title: Pumpkin Reaper
4125070.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is an action roguelike where skill placement shapes your build. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to trigger synergies and awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

4125320.title: SimpliCity: A Desktop Companion
4125320.short_description: A relaxing city builder on the bottom of your screen. Place homes, create services, maximize your population happiness. Grow your city at your own pace.

4126350.title: HERD
4126350.short_description: HERD is a co-op adventure game about shepherding sheep. 1–4 friends play as young shepherds, disguised with wool mustaches, tasked with delivering sheep to distant villages for their father. He definitely should not have trusted kids with this job.

4126730.title: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
4126730.short_description: Play well-crafted interactive stories shaped by mood and choice, or create your own branching story without coding.

4127500.title: Mutagenic 2
4127500.short_description: Mutagenic 2 is an online action RPG of with endless replayability and build potential. Forge your character with a massive passive tree and a vast library of skills, supports, and gear. See you in the Realm!

4127730.title: Micron Survivor
4127730.short_description: Micron Survivor is a bullet heaven game where you play as alien microorganisms under the microscope. Evolve, unlock research objectives, find symbiotic weapons, upgrade your builds, and fight hordes of terrestrial organisms to rule the microcosm.

4128330.title: CoinClave
4128330.short_description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

4128730.title: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes
4128730.short_description: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes is a turn-based tactical strategy game. You lead a team of mercenaries from different races, each with unique skills. Explore a randomly generated fantasy world, recruit defeated enemies, capture pets, challenge demon lords, or conquer the world step by step.

4129300.title: Grim Path
4129300.short_description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

4129970.title: Late Night Chats
4129970.short_description: In this game you play through a series of late night conversations within a dysfunctional friend group, while the narrator awkwardly judges every decision you make. It’s intense, suffocating, and a little unhinged. "I need to go back, I need to change my choices." - My Mom

4130710.title: NPC Simulator
4130710.short_description: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

4131340.title: Chiasmus
4131340.short_description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

4131380.title: Adventurer’s Guild Manager
4131380.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

4132310.title: Open Land
4132310.short_description: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

4132460.title: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
4132460.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

4132510.title: C.H.I.M.P.
4132510.short_description: C.H.I.M.P. is a cooperative multiplayer game where players work together to control a spaceship. On the spaceship, each player must perform their assigned role, such as piloting, shooting, or reloading. Can you reach your destination without fighting with your crewmates?

4132590.title: Bomba Arena
4132590.short_description: A bunch of friends, a bunch of bombs, and zero mercy! Bomba Arena is the chaotic party multiplayer (2-4 Players) where you blow up your buddies, snatch wild items, and power up your bombs. Friendships will be tested — only one can claim the crown!

4133850.title: Lapistasia
4133850.short_description: 3-min learn, 100-hour addiction! Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro. The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless! Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

4134260.title: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer
4134260.short_description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

4134430.title: The Prey’s Game
4134430.short_description: "The Prey’s Game" is a dark romantic visual novel where you, a revenge-driven heroine, must survive and manipulate six dangerous, obsessive men. Every choice determines if you end as prey or hunter. Navigate a web of lethal attraction with over 30 possible endings.

4134620.title: IIIIIIlI
4134620.short_description: "Draw. Disguise. Kick the can." An asymmetric versus game of drawing and can-kicking, set on pixel-art stages. "Mimicry" by doodling on yourself and the stage to blend in, plus fast-paced mind games that end in minutes. Enjoy online matches for up to 16 players — casually, with AI bots or friends.

4134940.title: The New Year's School
4134940.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

4135010.title: Chess Club Manager
4135010.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

4136150.title: Caster Crew
4136150.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

4136190.title: The Book of the Alchemist
4136190.short_description: 1980s America. A dying doctor follows the call of an ancient book to a fog-shrouded town of disappearances, unsolved murders, and secrets. Dark alchemy offers a cure—at a horrific price. Will you die human, or kill your humanity to survive?

4136610.title: Magnet Agent
4136610.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

4136620.title: Emissary One
4136620.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

4136870.title: Asteroid Patrol
4136870.short_description: An incremental arena shooter where asteroids rain down and bounce back for more. Blast them apart, dash through creature swarms, protect the settlement’s houses and watch your numbers explode as you upgrade, beat bosses and push into new biomes.

4136890.title: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
4136890.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

4137750.title: 东方铭珠塔
4137750.short_description: "Eastern Mingzhu Tower" is a multi-ending tower defense & AVG game. After the "Snow-house" is shattered by the tower's sudden emergence, you lead Ye-Luo Academy, its last guardian. Decide whether to intervene.

4137960.title: 狂猎世界
4137960.short_description: As a tactician, the player will take on the role of a demon hunter squad commander. Lead your team into the dungeon to collect resources and develop the team, confront the combat challenge known as "Flood," and ultimately succeed in passing the final trial.

4138400.title: SUS!
4138400.short_description: One of them is a thief. Blend into the crowd, steal, knock out your targets and escape, but you have to cough now and then. Spies watch the streets through CCTV, scan the crowd and get one clean stun shot. Stun an innocent and it costs you. Online PvP for 2 to 10 players, or play against bots.

4138540.title: Stuck in a Trench
4138540.short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

4138550.title: Rondo's Romp
4138550.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

4138920.title: Aliya: Timelink2 Dawn
4138920.short_description: A truth spanning time—connect with Aliya and meet diverse characters from 1,000 years later. In this real-time synchronized adventure, help her escape the Courtyard and team up to uncover the massive corporation’s hidden secrets...

4138960.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
4138960.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

4139000.title: Ominous Room -不気味な部屋-
4139000.short_description: Destroy quantum spheres that record human deaths and escape together in this co-op exploration extraction horror game. Each sphere you destroy alters the space and materializes the deceased's experiences. Hostile entities born from their emotions emerge. Escape, or push the investigation deeper.

4139020.title: AUTOMA
4139020.short_description: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

4139530.title: Frank and Stein
4139530.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

4139660.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
4139660.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

4139890.title: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
4139890.short_description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

4140220.title: Backstage Football
4140220.short_description: Manage transfers, staff, and finances like a real sporting director. Backstage Football takes you behind the scenes of professional football. Football isn’t just a game — it’s an empire to build. Take control of the club and decide everything… except the score.

4140770.title: Khinkills
4140770.short_description: As a cute khinkali dumpling, fight over the last piece of cake through fast paced and chaotic arenas. Smash your frenemies, steal their candies and kick everyone’s butt in this cute’n gore world.

4140990.title: FOGBOUND
4140990.short_description: A retro psychological horror game set in a polluted city taken over by toxic fog that hollows out its inhabitants. Place air monitors, hold your breath, and get her out of here.

4141240.title: Thothic
4141240.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

4141410.title: Venture Pals
4141410.short_description: Choose your own Pal and venture out to grind skills and gather loot right from your desktop. Forge powerful gear, cook and brew invigorating meals and potions, and discover rare cosmetics. Manage energy, cleanliness, and training to grow. Or, just enjoy the company of your Pal

4141760.title: NERO
4141760.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

4142080.title: GREED
4142080.short_description: GREED - "roguelite" with "drag-drop" elements and item physics. Сhaos of constantly falling random items and advancing enemies. Create items from a variety of combinations, expand the tower in the upgrade tree, use magic to apply effects, and buy what you need to plan your steps ahead.

4142130.title: WOLFOUT
4142130.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

4142360.title: Paradox Tower
4142360.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

4142520.title: MANIFESTO: The Capitalism Roguelike
4142520.short_description: Hire employees. Arrange your office. Turn burnout into profit. MANIFESTO is a corporate roguelike auto battler. Combine worker abilities, stack upgrades, and replace exhausted staff to meet totally unrealistic sales targets. Good luck, CEO. The shareholders expect results.

4142990.title: Atomic Blastman
4142990.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

4143130.title: Fishy Business
4143130.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

4144410.title: TiNk
4144410.short_description: Connect each part of your life, and make your own path in your worlds. Draw, take notes, and enjoy your mind :)

4144550.title: Cosmic Cubicle
4144550.short_description: Cosmic Cubicle is a magical crafting puzzle game where you create the elements that make up the world. Watch the elements explode, splash, and crackle with simulated physics as you combine and hurl the elements at each other.

4144590.title: Brew & Dash
4144590.short_description: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps in this new take on the genre.

4144860.title: Ramen://protocol
4144860.short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

4144910.title: Fairyland Journey
4144910.short_description: A Hall-of-Fame competitive turn-based RPG. Cultivate Eudemons (Mythical Beasts) exclusive to you, and utilize hundreds of skills to make every battle more intense and diverse. Unleash their true power and dominate the PvP arena!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

4144950.title: Picatso
4144950.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

4144960.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
4144960.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

4145180.title: Water is Heavy
4145180.short_description: Become an ordinary fish descending endlessly into the pitch-black abyss. In this 3D marine roguelite, master bubble attacks and combine diverse skills and powerful items to survive the crushing pressure of swarming enemies. At the end of the harsh abyss, what belief will you ultimately forge?

4145790.title: Mystic Rest Stop: Weekend at Stillpoint
4145790.short_description: Leo Carter, a content creator, arrives at SteelPoint to investigate the local urban legends. What seemed like a peaceful getaway soon turns into a nightmare when he discovers that the forest hides a cult willing to do anything to keep its secret.

4145840.title: Her in the Abyss
4145840.short_description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

4145970.title: KLITTER
4145970.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

4146080.title: Bring It
4146080.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

4146620.title: Riftbound Survivors
4146620.short_description: Riftbound is a survivor-like bullet heaven focused on spell combinations and massive enemy waves. Defeat thousands of enemies, experiment with elemental chain reactions, and break the game with overlapping status effects. Play solo or in co-op.

4148090.title: SpaceRabbit
4148090.short_description: A space bunny working for a ruthless delivery company! Dodge asteroids, collect stars, customize your rocket, and compete with players worldwide. Survive the harsh life of a space courier!

4148210.title: REALM ARCANA
4148210.short_description: REALM ARCANA is a 1v1 online strategy card game. Take turns deploying units, combine abilities and positioning, and adapt to randomized battlefields that change the rules of combat. Read the field, outplay your opponent, and find a new path to victory each match.

4148470.title: Serenity Sketch
4148470.short_description: Relax and paint with water in Serenity Sketch, a guided mindfulness sandbox. Create ephemeral art, follow gentle voice prompts in atmospheric landscapes, and find stillness in letting go. A self-care ritual where each evaporating brushstroke brings freedom and reflection.

4148770.title: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
4148770.short_description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

4148940.title: Crystal Vein
4148940.short_description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

4149030.title: Ad Iterum
4149030.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

4149080.title: Ittzy Fearless
4149080.short_description: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

4149390.title: SILKRUN
4149390.short_description: SILKRUN is an arcade racing game! Master silky smooth powerslides around insane tracks, even on a keyboard — race against time, computer opponents, and online in different weather conditions and time of day. Super Cars 2 meets Slicks 'N Slide, Outrun, Stunts & The Need for Speed in modern 3D racing!

4149610.title: Young Suns
4149610.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

4149640.title: On the Rocks
4149640.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

4150060.title: FragFrame
4150060.short_description: FragFrame is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a modern take on classic shooters, set in a dark dystopian, neon sci-fi world. Battle friends in intense multiplayer matches fueled by high-energy electronic music and a rave-like atmosphere. Create and share custom arenas with the built-in level editor.

4150110.title: Guardian Demon
4150110.short_description: Protect the helpless peasant Myson from an army of angry orcs for as long as possible in this action arcade game. Defeat hordes of orcs with simple and easy to learn intuitive controls, earn gold to customize Myson's appearance and compete with others to see who can survive the longest!

4150210.title: Undying War: Gate Of Pioneer
4150210.short_description: Undying War: Gate of Pioneer is a subculture-style multiplayer brawl action game where unique characters clash in real time. Enjoy fast-paced and thrilling battles that unfold within five minutes.

4150720.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux
4150720.short_description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

4150970.title: Five Shifts at Zlata’s
4150970.short_description: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

4151050.title: Divided Empire: SENGOKU
4151050.short_description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

4151270.title: ATOMIC LANCE
4151270.short_description: Wield heavy weapons. Fly faster than a bullet. Nuke your enemies. You are a Black Project, an ATOMIC LANCE.

4151300.title: Sublustrum
4151300.short_description: Enter a mysterious machine built to explore the human subconscious and complete your brother’s final experiment. Descend into a world where memories become places, solve sound-driven puzzles, and uncover a hidden truth in this first-person narrative adventure.

4153180.title: So Stoked
4153180.short_description: A chill and cozy surf game about timing, flow, and discovery. Travel between islands, ride clean waves, and enjoy a calm, skill-driven ride with light RPG-style tasks and progression.

4153310.title: Plants One Shot!
4153310.short_description: 《Plants One Shot!》 is a party game for up to 4 players. Your sect has been attacked by villains. To revive your sect and uphold justice, you must kill monsters and obtain better spells and equipment so that you can gain enough power to defeat the villains!

4153570.title: The Memphis Chronicles
4153570.short_description: The Memphis Chronicles is a first-person tragicomedy set in a world between worlds. Explore a mysterious city layered with stories and connections, in which memories creep up on you. No one there to hold your hand. The only way is forward. This is the trip of a lifetime.

4153580.title: Boundless Evil: Awakening
4153580.short_description: A first-person horror experience set in a desolate highlands village. Track your missing archaeologist sister, unravel her clues through exploration and puzzles, scavange for loot and face the dark force she accidentally unleashed.

4153760.title: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
4153760.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

4153900.title: Zoomalia
4153900.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

4154160.title: Andromis
4154160.short_description: Mission-driven third-person action game with 50 explosive missions. Fight rogue machines, rescue civilians, and battle across a war-torn city and iconic locations. Drive cars, armed vehicles, and a tank while unleashing heavy weapons and large-scale urban destruction.

4155330.title: Pulse Citadel
4155330.short_description: An incremental defense game where each run funds your next upgrade. The Citadel shoots automatically. Pick what to research, then time your abilities to keep it alive.

4155560.title: Iron Tracer
4155560.short_description: Iron Tracer is a tactical shooter where you play as a spec-ops soldier sent across the globe to stop threats before they happen. Every mission demands stealth, precision, and quick decision-making, one wrong move can end the the mission.

4155990.title: Dice chess
4155990.short_description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

4156060.title: Anna's Bakery Shop
4156060.short_description: You’re Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

4156300.title: Fragment Collapse
4156300.short_description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

4156710.title: Coin Maker Simulator
4156710.short_description: Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

4156730.title: fCorvus
4156730.short_description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

4157190.title: Sandnight Hill Revelation
4157190.short_description: In order to find her runaway cat,a girl ventures into the deep mountains where monsters roam. However, this mountain hides the truth of the world. By collecting the journals of lost wanderers who entered the Black Forest, she gradually approaches that truth. What, indeed, awaits her ahead...

4157660.title: Life Balance
4157660.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

4158700.title: The Final Like
4158700.short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

4159160.title: Ellsydia
4159160.short_description: Welcome to Ellsydia! Escape to a small cozy medieval fantasy haven where you can build, customize, and manage your dream village. Make it thrive and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel truly happy and fulfilled.

4161260.title: As We Planned
4161260.short_description: Stealth PVE heist with friends. Steal valuables, solve puzzles, use tools, upgrade your base, and complete quests. You can go quiet or loud — the choice is yours. Up to 4 players. Every raid is unique!

4162610.title: Project Lighthouse
4162610.short_description: Trapped inside a scientific anomaly, solve puzzles with evolving teleportation tech and uncover the fate of the vanished “keepers”. Built alongside our community, props we made for Project Lighthouse are free for other game developers.

4163520.title: Mermaids are Seafood
4163520.short_description: You're a new hire at a company that sells mermaids as seafood. Bet your blood, navigate conspiracies, and cook for customers in this psychological horror game with 11 endings. Are mermaids more like fish, people, or monsters?

4164330.title: Oomi’s Nook
4164330.short_description: Oomi’s Nook is a cozy and relaxing sticker decor game. Decorate a little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

4164650.title: SNAKEPIT [USA]
4164650.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

4165030.title: Beatcore
4165030.short_description: A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

4165170.title: Beatcore zero
4165170.short_description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

4165280.title: The Last Wait
4165280.short_description: Trapped in a sterile hospital, clinging to life, you anticipate your daughter’s arrival as reality slowly begins to slip. Your only chance is to endure the long, suffocating wait. The Last Wait. Can you hold on long enough to see her once more?

4165680.title: Dices golf
4165680.short_description: Turn-based golf where your choice of die balances reach and precision. Beat courses to welcome visitors, reinvest their earnings in your estate and skills, and take on ever tougher challenges, all the way to Hell.

4166450.title: Dadi Kingdom
4166450.short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

4166900.title: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator
4166900.short_description: Run your own pub in this atmospheric and story-rich job simulator. Featuring a full brewing pipeline, dynamic NPCs, side quests, bar upgrades and expansions, branching dialogue, a freely explorable city, and a deep narrative set in dystopian Napolis City.

4167640.title: Horde of Distraction
4167640.short_description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

4168190.title: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
4168190.short_description: Command the Chinese People's Liberation Army in Crimson Banner: War of Liberation. Fight through the campaigns of the Chinese Civil War in a turn-based wargame played on a hex grid.

4169090.title: VERDGE
4169090.short_description: VERDGE is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

4169530.title: FatSheep Crisis:RE
4169530.short_description: Baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa. Baa.

4170350.title: M.A.Y.A
4170350.short_description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

4170540.title: Picasho
4170540.short_description: Become a rich and famous artist with your friends by painting wild creations, completing commissions, and exhibiting your art. Unlock all kinds of unusual tools, turn everyday objects into art, expand your gallery, and rise to riches in 1–4 player co-op!

4170670.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
4170670.short_description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

4170790.title: The Fridge
4170790.short_description: THE FRIDGE is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Find or purchase weapons in each run and face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Obtain magical catalysts to boost your weapons’ power and experiment with different combinations to adapt your combat style.

4170840.title: Akina
4170840.short_description: Akina is an arcade drift game set in early-90s Japan. Drift down mountain passes, race friends online, and explore a peaceful summer countryside shaped by the golden age of Japanese street-racing culture.🗾🎌

4171110.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
4171110.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

4171130.title: Isekai Guardians
4171130.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

4171150.title: Auspicious Clouds
4171150.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

4171620.title: Cozy Craft
4171620.short_description: A relaxing soft crafting and resource gatherer game. Explore, collect materials, refine them, and restore a ruined castle to rescue the kingdom's princess. No rush. No danger. Just build, collect, and watch your cozy world come to life.

4172060.title: DRAMAtical Murder re:code NITRO ARCHIVE
4172060.short_description: NITRO CHiRAL's hit BL adventure game DRAMAtical Murder re:code is now available on Steam! Aoba, our protagonist, spends his days working part-time at Hum-Drum Junk. All he ever wanted was to live a peaceful life. However, strange events have begun transpiring in places beyond his fathoming.

4172090.title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
4172090.short_description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

4172340.title: pyTexas
4172340.short_description: Completely free Texas Hold'em game, play with your friends, find public lobbies around the world, or play alone with bots. You can also add bots when your lobby doesn't have enough players.

4172750.title: 4DEAD
4172750.short_description: ‘4DEAD’ is a high-speed roguelike action game where you control the invincible creature “No. 42,” which dies if it doesn't consume prey within 4 seconds. Devour invaders relentlessly to survive! Keep devouring enemies within 4 seconds and save humanity from extinction with your own hands!

4172830.title: Jash Retro
4172830.short_description: Inspired by classic retro games such as Double dragon/Target renegade, Ikari warriors/Commando, Contra, Golden axe. Follow the story and explore all the games for fun moments!

4172880.title: Hacker The Dark Shadow
4172880.short_description: Become a young programmer diving into the dangerous world of cybercrime. When the elite hacking collective Dark Shadows challenges you with a series of ruthless trials, you must push your genius to the limit. Will you prove your worth or become another digital casualty?

4172970.title: One Last Push
4172970.short_description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

4173530.title: Recalibration
4173530.short_description: Take down all your enemies using as few bullets as possible. Be both stylish and efficient – that’s what a true assassin is all about. Uncover the betrayal, track down the culprits, and bring them to justice in the name of global peace.

4173560.title: Jacaro: Looming Dread
4173560.short_description: A single session of Jacaro stands between you and a fate worse than death. Whilst something is lurking and waiting for a mistake.

4173600.title: SkyRen
4173600.short_description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

4173770.title: Ghost Justice
4173770.short_description: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

4174280.title: Dungeon Potato
4174280.short_description: Dungeon Potato is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike where your loadout shapes the story. Survive unpredictable encounters, forge unique builds, and battle through a perilous labyrinth. Will you rise as a servant of the Potato God or rebel against it?

4174850.title: Friendgeist
4174850.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

4174880.title: Kōyō
4174880.short_description: Fast, satisfying top-down combat meets cozy progression. Slay yokai, grab loot, craft upgrades, and explore an Edo-inspired valley in a stylized 2.5D action RPG.

4174980.title: SHATTERSHAPE
4174980.short_description: SHATTERSHAPE is an arcade-style shooter in which you are a lone circle fighting hordes of enemies with evil vertices. SHATTER your enemies with numerous power-ups. ONLY THE ROUND SURVIVE.

4175110.title: TAKE OUT
4175110.short_description: "Take Out" is an emotion-driven visual novel and rhythm adventure about 30 days with Morning, an android delivered to your home. Your choices shape your bond, while each day's emotions unfold in webtoon-style cutscenes and rhythm gameplay as she grows from a household assistant into a band vocalist.

4175510.title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
4175510.short_description: You are randomly assigned “Civic Disturbance Duty” and must complete tasks using the power of your butt. Explore a world filled with absurd gameplay, chaotic tasks, and mediocre visuals.

4175680.title: Midnight Manhunt
4175680.short_description: Hunt down a hidden target through a cyberpunk city in this turn-based game of cat and mouse. Coordinate four Grid Runners to eliminate his escape routes one by one, deduce his position and close the net before he completes his mission. Or become the Ghost, laying false trails to survive the night.

4175810.title: Space Daram
4175810.short_description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

4176230.title: Milkraid
4176230.short_description: Defend the milk at all costs! Place towers, build your base, recruit minions, and battle endless swarms of enemies. Unlock new towers, characters and base upgrades, and upgrade them to create ridiculous builds. Every run is unique.

4176330.title: Colosseum
4176330.short_description: In this Fast Arena FPS, you play as a prisonner in hell, forced to battle for eternity to please the crowds of the Colosseum ! Wave after wave of enemies, you battle ancient warriors to the rythm of their songs.

4176430.title: Disquieted
4176430.short_description: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

4176600.title: Phoe
4176600.short_description: Phoe is a classic single-player platformer where chaining momentum is the key to speed; how fast you go is up to you. Master tight controls and refine your route through levels designed to push your platforming skills to the limit.

4176740.title: Tiny Desk Pot
4176740.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

4177020.title: Demra: Rifts of War
4177020.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself.

4177350.title: Quack Ball!
4177350.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

4177420.title: Fatemender
4177420.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

4177830.title: Life of a Cockroach
4177830.short_description: Yes, you’re a cockroach, so your top priority now is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

4178060.title: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮
4178060.short_description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

4179170.title: Noble Steed
4179170.short_description: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

4179640.title: Overtake: Taskbar Racer
4179640.short_description: Overtake is an idle racing game that lives on your taskbar, built for people who spend all day at the keyboard. Your car cruises along while you work, and every keystroke gives it an extra push. Collect skins and trade them on the Steam Community Market, climb the leaderboards and never stop moving.

4179700.title: Galactic Arms
4179700.short_description: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.

4179880.title: Mars Incremental
4179880.short_description: A short incremental game about terraforming Mars. Build, automate, and deploy drones to harvest power, gas and water, then watch a quiet, red planet wake into a living world, one horizon at a time. Just follow the instructions: step one, change the entire planet.

4179890.title: Monarchs at Play
4179890.short_description: Turn-based 4X strategy in just one hour. Place buildings, chain adjacency bonuses, optimize resources, and outsmart rival monarchs through trade or war to earn the most Glory - solo or multiplayer.

4180050.title: Mourningwood Lodge:Pray
4180050.short_description: "Mourningwood Lodge:Pray" is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action mystery horror game. As the third installment in the "Mourningwood Lodge" series, players will delve into an entirely new story, assuming the role of a fresh character to embark on a suspenseful journey.

4180270.title: Loop of Command
4180270.short_description: 👁️ Loop of Command is a cute automation puzzle about small horrors of corporate culture. Program obedient robots to survive your next performance review.

4180510.title: Space Snatcher
4180510.short_description: 1-6 player co-op horror chaos where you scan monsters aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

4180840.title: Shadowstone
4180840.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players. Plan your turns together, chain your heroes’ skills into combinations that break the run open, and fight your way out of a labyrinth that changes every time. A turn-based tactical roguelite about what your party can do together.

4181040.title: Immortal Rebirth
4181040.short_description: Hunt for treasure and face formidable foes in an ink-wash fantasy world. Fit your gear into a limited inventory to create powerful combinations, and forge your own playstyle with a wealth of affixes and an expansive talent tree.

4181130.title: Greys the Dream Slayer
4181130.short_description: 自幼和妹妹相依为命的时引光在考入英南大学后，自称“葛瑞希”的魔女赐予他五根能实现他人愿望的火柴。“美梦成真，亦要付出相应的代价。”表面上力量无穷的火柴，却是撕开这世界虚伪面纱的钥匙。当时引光回过神，才发现自己早已陷入了魔女制造的漩涡中。人啊，究竟更愿意直面现实，还是沉湎在虚妄的美梦中？

4181350.title: Wares & Wonders: Fantasy Shop Simulator
4181350.short_description: A cozy first-person fantasy shop simulator. Every customer has a profession, a budget, and a reason to stop by today. Choose what to stock, arrange your displays, take on quests, and run the shop solo or with friends. Everything is physical. Everything can be broken.

4181380.title: Taiyi Saga
4181380.short_description: Taiyi Saga is a deck-building roguelike set in Chinese mythology. Pulled into a god's private realm, you build your deck, battle rival gods' invaders, and collect relics forged from ancient beasts — fighting your way toward the truth, and a way home.

4181990.title: The Industrial Council
4181990.short_description: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

4182190.title: Too Deep To Quit
4182190.short_description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

4182440.title: Little Frontier
4182440.short_description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

4183020.title: DORM
4183020.short_description: First-person horror. An old student dormitory in a provincial Eastern European town, strange residents, brutal encounters, blood, dark humor, and explicit scenes.

4183320.title: DETRUST
4183320.short_description: DETRUST is an online co-op game for up to 12 players, built on teamwork and betrayal. You’ve been sent to repair a damaged facility before the scheduled decontamination begins. Complete tasks, stay alert, and try to escape alive… before one of you tries to kill the entire crew.

4183920.title: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
4183920.short_description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

4183980.title: Caliban
4183980.short_description: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

4184000.title: Tidal Life
