4184000.short_description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide, enrich your island. collect or defeat them all !

4184130.title: Foxy Dumplings
4184130.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your customers, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

4185280.title: Little Christmas Workshop
4185280.short_description: An adorable, stocking stuffer-sized factory automation game

4186890.title: Kitman
4186890.short_description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player job simulator set in the backrooms of a football stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

4187010.title: Kiosk 199X
4187010.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

4187450.title: Gothic Steel
4187450.short_description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

4188160.title: LOVEKO
4188160.short_description: Aha… so you want to know what real love is, huh? Then maybe… try this RPG.

4188250.title: Breaking News Live
4188250.short_description: When the truth and business are at odds, money prevails. Shape the reality of others by curating which news are worth telling and which are worth altering.

4188500.title: Crawl To The Depths
4188500.short_description: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person dungeon crawler where you venture into a forgotten underworld. Explore procedurally generated voxel caves, battle dangerous creatures and build increasingly powerful weapons to face what lurks below.

4188590.title: The Interpreter
4188590.short_description: You are The Interpreter. Use voice recognition to interogate suspects and find out if they have been tainted. Explore the dystopian world of B26, controlling technology with your voice. Be the judge, jury and executioner.

4188620.title: Karusel
4188620.short_description: 1984. Denis is trapped in a never-ending summer day in a Soviet village. The sun is frozen at its zenith, and familiar paths lead to dark secrets. Uncover the nature of this anomaly and discover: what price must you pay to finally reach tomorrow?

4188900.title: Dulat
4188900.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

4189120.title: Debauchery & Magic
4189120.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

4189690.title: SuperBird
4189690.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

4190310.title: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD
4190310.short_description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

4190610.title: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
4190610.short_description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

4190760.title: The Fish Corner
4190760.short_description: Run your own cozy fish shop, collect unique breeds, care for your tanks, and decorate your home. Breed rare fish, manage customers, and grow your store. Build, customize, and create the aquarium life you dream of.

4192370.title: Droste Detective
4192370.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

4192590.title: Poreia
4192590.short_description: Manipulate magnetic forces to solve puzzles and uncover the truth of the world in this 3D puzzle adventure - become a memory-lost cat robot and explore a mysterious world!

4193300.title: Fleshborn
4193300.short_description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

4193310.title: 水浒女神录
4193310.short_description: Every word you say will directly touch the hearts of Liangshan heroes through advanced AI technology, awaken their dormant star power, and even change their fate trajectory.

4193690.title: Terranigma
4193690.short_description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

4193770.title: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
4193770.short_description: A free introduction to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator is your chance to make dreams come true in a fabulously clean business. Run a car wash for Clever Emma in Winston Springs.

4194230.title: Stream Survivors
4194230.short_description: Build a growing camp in a fresh take on the incremental genre. Farm endlessly spawning resource nodes, unlock upgrades and new buildings, and climb multiple leaderboards designed for both idle and active players. Play solo or in multiplayer with full Twitch integration.

4194570.title: Gray Space
4194570.short_description: Light is a luxury. Sanity is vital. Group up with your friends to escape a crumbling medical organization in GRAY SPACE. Scavenge for tools and resources. Run and hide from fear entities and other anomalies that lurk. Extract the antidote at all costs. A lo-fi first-person survival horror nightmare.

4194840.title: Mombo Combo Legacy
4194840.short_description: The most tongue-tastic hero is back! Jump, fight, and complete MOMBO COMBOS in a new journey packed with action, intense challenges, and monstrous bosses. Explore new worlds in this 2D platformer with powerful forms and a mighty army of pets! The world needs our little purple hero once again!

4194890.title: Reel Tiny
4194890.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

4195000.title: SWOM
4195000.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

4195200.title: Feast of the Beast Unleashed
4195200.short_description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampiric clans as you advance toward the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that is consuming the world."

4195210.title: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
4195210.short_description: Mike’s new job at a women’s dorm leads him into unexpected bonds, rising danger, and tough choices as local gangs target vulnerable students. Protect the girls, navigate romance, and face the city’s hidden threats.

4195890.title: Heather's Haunted House Party
4195890.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl. A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

4196280.title: Tamerlane Chess
4196280.short_description: Not a chess. It is a war strategy. Tamerlane Chess is the digital version of the board Timur used to shape his battlefield tactics. With a larger board, unique pieces, and deep strategy, every move demands the mindset of a true commander.

4197090.title: Scratch your Luck
4197090.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

4197280.title: Kingfisher - An Autism Tale
4197280.short_description: Experience how people with autism see, feel and interact with the world around them in this thrilling detective adventure, taking place near the Belgian coast and in the woods around a local nature reserve.

4197340.title: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
4197340.short_description: A funny pixel art roguelite strategy. You manage a fantasy island kingdom connected by magical portals. By day — build, gather resources, hire heroes, and dive through portals to expand into new lands. By night — defend! The same portals unleash hordes of demons straight from Hell.

4197390.title: FENDERSHOT
4197390.short_description: A lawless street racing league with the fiercest rivals and the latest Race Tech™. Can you and your crew handle the heat? Included in the box: Wild sense of speed. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Underglow Neons. 60+ FPS on Steam Deck.

4197690.title: 164: Fragile Ascent
4197690.short_description: 164 Floors. The ultimate test of mind and body. The ascent is simple, mechanical, yet unforgiving. Every step brings you closer to the summit… or your own annihilation. 164: Fragile Ascent is a first-person rhythm challenge where the certainty of the machine clashes with the fragility of the mind.

4198100.title: The Eternal Experiment
4198100.short_description: The Eternal Experiment is a first-person horror game set in a collapsing futuristic lab. A deadly creature hunts in total darkness. Survive by managing your inventory, crafting, and creative problem-solving as you navigate the lab and fight to escape with your life.

4199110.title: Gravitten
4199110.short_description: Take control of Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Journey through 5 distinct biomes, manipulating gravity and perspective to solve intricate puzzles.

4199250.title: War Tactics
4199250.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

4200020.title: Chess You
4200020.short_description: Play classic chess against girls who tease, provoke, and challenge you.

4200350.title: Twilight Haven
4200350.short_description: Twilight Haven is based in a wonderful, magical but also strange and dangerous place hidden far north of the country known as Hazeldawn. It is not a place you will find on any map, nor in any book, it is hidden from the eyes and minds of all those but the few souls that it chooses to bring home.

4200530.title: Spell Fist
4200530.short_description: Unleash fists of arcane fury in this boss-rush brawler. Punch, parry, and steal spells as a broke wizard fighting rival mages to escape crushing debt.

4200910.title: COREDUMP: 口口口口
4200910.short_description: COREDUMP: 口口口口 is a Metroidvania inspired puzzle platformer where you recover lost colliders, switch between phasing through walls and charged bouncing, and uncover hidden paths across an interconnected world.

4200960.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
4200960.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

4201140.title: Dungeon of Departure
4201140.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious cave system, four dungeon explorers struggle to find a way out before the light fades forever... Navigate a mysterious underground as you navigate through multiple story paths in this text-based, pixel-art, dark fantasy rpg, visual novel computer game

4201250.title: FingBlade
4201250.short_description: Fingblade is a physics-driven Rogue-lite action game. Swing your mouse to control the weapon's real inertia, slashing through endless waves of enemies. Unlock 4 unique weapons, master Chain Lightning and Necromancy builds, and collect gems for permanent upgrades. If the blade breaks, you die.

4201610.title: soupsoup
4201610.short_description: Explore diverse illustration magazines in soupsoup, a hidden object game filled with unique artistic visions. Experience over 200 creative stages featuring relaxing healing sounds. Collect stars to unlock new magazines and immerse yourself in beautiful worlds created by talented artists.

4201740.title: WING-IT
4201740.short_description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

4202020.title: Koimori
4202020.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living pond with this peaceful idle overlay. Let koi drift around while you work or relax, drop snacks to see them gather, and unlock rare koi patterns as you spend more time with your little friends.

4202190.title: VIRUS_31.EXE
4202190.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

4203240.title: Childrens Story
4203240.short_description: Childrens Story is an Anthology Game that presents a growing collection of stories on VHS Tapes. Each tape contains a one-off story with unique plot and setting elements that evoke fear, wonder, and live entertainment. Tune-in Next Time!

4204240.title: Liar's Lift
4204240.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

4204430.title: Maum
4204430.short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

4205030.title: Legend Of Asha
4205030.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

4205170.title: Son Of A Dealer
4205170.short_description: Turn forgotten treasures into a thriving business in this narrative-driven second-hand shop simulator. Haggle for the best prices, uncover the stories behind every item, and build deep relationships with the townsfolk. Your choices shape not just your shop, but your life.

4206100.title: SlotsNStocks
4206100.short_description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

4207000.title: Curse of Cards
4207000.short_description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

4207360.title: 2P连接中
4207360.short_description: In the virtual world known as MoMoLand, bugs are no longer glitches but the tools you rely on for survival and breaking the rules. Your goal is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various bugs to evade patrolling service robots and ultimately reach the exit.

4207450.title: FlockSol
4207450.short_description: FlockSol is an incremental top-down survival game. Light up the dark and defeat the monsters hiding inside. Spend their essences to unlock and upgrade your skills. Summon your past souls to fight alongside you. Reach your full potential, survive the night and cleanse the world of darkness.

4207560.title: Gay It Loud
4207560.short_description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

4207650.title: Almamon
4207650.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

4207890.title: Giri-Jump Star Rush
4207890.short_description: Experience the ultimate Giri-Jump! Looks impossible, but can you make the jump? Escape all kinds of close calls with a single jump! Master Giri-Jump in this extreme side-scrolling action game! Meticulously crafted Giri-Jump points, tuned down to the pixel, await your challenge.

4207980.title: Cook Together
4207980.short_description: Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab, to create drugs for big boss. Finish the product in time without blowing yourselves up. Upgrade your lab, perfect the purity of your products and become the biggest producer in town.

4208160.title: Frontiers of the Realms
4208160.short_description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

4208630.title: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
4208630.short_description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

4209930.title: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
4209930.short_description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.
developers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills
publishers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

4210100.title: AENIGMA
4210100.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

4210140.title: Brofish
4210140.short_description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

4210400.title: Lounge Café
4210400.short_description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

4210810.title: NIGHT SHIFT: HAUNTED MALL
4210810.short_description: The mall closed at midnight. The ghosts didn't. 1–6 friends. 5 lost items. 1 date with Mika… and only one of you gets it. Frying pans, bazookas, banana peels: anything goes. And don't scream: the ghosts can hear your mic.

4211060.title: Meaningless Random Numbers
4211060.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

4211340.title: Biryado
4211340.short_description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

4211350.title: MAEVOR
4211350.short_description: MAEVOR is a 1-4 player co-op horror game set in a cursed forest where every sound can get you killed. Recover three ancient artifacts, break the Harpy Vampire Demon's curse, and survive against creatures that hunt by sound while fear distorts your senses.

4211380.title: Loop Tower
4211380.short_description: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!

4211490.title: Fast Food Wars
4211490.short_description: Fast Food Wars is a bullet-hell shoot'em up rogue-lite game in a procedural generated restaurant with random power ups, weapons. You play as a burger fighting to claim back all the invaded burger restaurant from other fast foods

4212650.title: Horns
4212650.short_description: Horns is an evolving dark fantasy RPG inspired by retro ARPG adventures of the late ‘90s. Join Lyssandra on her search for the king in a collapsed, magical world as she grows more grotesque on her trek for truth. Fight the darkness — or become it — and watch the world react accordingly.

4212790.title: DIEATHLON
4212790.short_description: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

4212830.title: Void Nebula
4212830.short_description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

4212940.title: Sepium
4212940.short_description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

4213770.title: 孤狼之春
4213770.short_description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

4214200.title: Mars Base Alley
4214200.short_description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

4214860.title: rock[et]
4214860.short_description: Destroy thousands of asteroids and repair your destroyed rock[et] in this cute incremental that's secretly 3 games in 1! Unlock game-changing skills, invent run-breaking synergies, employ a drone army, discover new planets, and much, much more.

4214910.title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
4214910.short_description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

4214960.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
4214960.short_description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

4215620.title: BugoPhobia
4215620.short_description: BugoPhobia is an indie survival horror game where you explore haunted places, avoid ghosts during ghost hunts, collect clues, and correctly identify the type of ghost

4215680.title: Petri Party
4215680.short_description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

4216250.title: Path of Glory
4216250.short_description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

4216480.title: FOTR
4216480.short_description: A quasi-documentary trip that leads to a phone booth in 2002, where feelings of nostalgia and pain from broken parental relationships intertwine.

4216820.title: Santa's Burnout
4216820.short_description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

4216920.title: Road 88
4216920.short_description: Road 88 is a car anomaly game where you must spot the differences on an endless road loop and avoid deadly hazards.

4217030.title: Broken Race
4217030.short_description: Have you ever tried driving without sleeping? In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

4217940.title: Trenchblocks
4217940.short_description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

4218210.title: Goat's Odyssey
4218210.short_description: Just a goat. A boring peg. And a postcard that changed everything. Embark on a surreal journey in a shadow theatre style: from a village garden to lunar craters. Solve absurd puzzles, troll a rooster, and find out if the grass is truly greener on the other side of the universe.

4218660.title: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
4218660.short_description: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

4218970.title: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
4218970.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

4219000.title: World without Time
4219000.short_description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

4219050.title: Veldrak: Dark Revenant
4219050.short_description: A multiplayer action RPG of dark survival. Customize your warrior, infuse magic through alchemy, tame wild beasts, and lead autonomous NPCs to build and defend your settlement against rank 1 to 5 demons.

4219310.title: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend
4219310.short_description: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend Series is a narrtive video game for PC, Mac and Linux. It last about an hour and a half and it is not a traditional video game. We break the fourth wall to bring you this extraordinary story to life.

4219500.title: Twilight Gallery
4219500.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

4220030.title: Chicago 4th of July
4220030.short_description: Chicago 4th of July is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in a near-future Chicago — a glamorous yet oppressive megacity wrapped in a mysterious Veil. Uncover the truth behind the Veil, navigate a world ruled by power and rise against a system built to keep you blind.

4220300.title: Dragon’s Breath : Chronicles of the Red Dragon (レッドドラゴン戦記)
4220300.short_description: The Red Dragon returns. Venture into the dungeons of Mount Firebreath. This 2D adventure RPG is brought to life with stunning retro pixel art. Classic bump-combat evolves with timing-based action for tense battles. Upgrade your gear, master key items, and defeat the Dragon.

4220590.title: DJ till Dawn
4220590.short_description: Be a cool DJ and battle crowds in a rhythm roguelite where every beat is a weapon. Build your DJ loadout, unlock new tracks and keep the party alive till dawn to win!

4220770.title: Static Between Stations
4220770.short_description: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

4221270.title: Cauldron Chaos: Co-op Potion Shop
4221270.short_description: Run a potion shop with up to 3 friends as wooden witch dolls. brew potions, levitate everything, fling each other across the room, and try not to blow up the cauldron. You will.

4221560.title: Puzzle Rogue
4221560.short_description: Puzzle Rogue is a roguelike homage to the original Puzzle Quest! Guide your party through the forbidden castle, gathering equipment and items to bolster their strength! Encounter enemies and battle them in 16-bit JRPG style gem-based combat!

4221850.title: RailTangle
4221850.short_description: RailTangle is a minimalist, Zen puzzle game where you lay tracks to continue your train's journey. Untangle rail networks, find the perfect spot for every tile, and watch your railway expand as you set new high records.

4222500.title: Solid Boat Adventure
4222500.short_description: Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

4222970.title: Demolition Expert 拆迁专家
4222970.short_description: Blast through walls, destroy pillars, and enjoy the moment of collapse. This game lets you destroy buildings in any way you want!

4223070.title: Football Survivors
4223070.short_description: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS BEGUN! Thousands of crazy fans are storming the field. Defend against the fans’ attack! 70+ unique heroes, professions, and abilities 50+ upgrade items 10 different classes Strategically place your heroes, manage your team, and repel the waves of fans!

4223220.title: DISPEL
4223220.short_description: In DISPEL, play as the sole survivor of an unknown magical calamity. Explore the ruins of a corrupted wizard academy, avoid the shades of your former friends, solve puzzles to discover new areas of the school, and uncover what happened in Feylight Academy.

4223700.title: Unchest
4223700.short_description: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

4225140.title: Orbital Command
4225140.short_description: Orbital Command is about controlling planet based weapon systems to defend your planets from large asteroids and hostile invaders. Will you be able to complete the Dyson Sphere, or will your planets end up barren husks?

4225180.title: Make Burgers: GRILL UP
4225180.short_description: Embark on a burger-filled adventure with chef Bobby Grill and his bright yellow food truck! Get ready to serve unique burgers not only to regular customers, but also to sweet tooths, robots, zombies, and even aliens!

4225190.title: BoomScroll
4225190.short_description: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

4225370.title: The lost trail
4225370.short_description: Play as a raccoon on a heartfelt and dangerous journey to find the boy who once saved you from poachers. Explore the wild, avoid traps, uncover secrets, and experience a story of friendship, survival, and hope.

4225760.title: FotFoot
4225760.short_description: Run a football club your way: sign stars, set your tactics and change the game from the touchline as the big moments play out live on a 2D pitch. Over 4,200 clubs, 110,000 players and 158 countries, from the lowest divisions to the world stage, in a world that never stops moving.

4227410.title: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
4227410.short_description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

4227800.title: Runan Ritual
4227800.short_description: In Runan Ritual, you step into the boots of Vitz, a warrior caught in the crossfire of a planetary invasion. After a devastating encounter with the Runan, Vitz is left changed no longer fully human, but not quite one of them. Fight back against the shadows!.

4228060.title: Pluffy Nightmare
4228060.short_description: Blast through a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with funny weapons! In Pluffy Nightmare, your mind is dragged into a doll´s body to battle possessed plushies, dolls, and toys in bizarre fantasy worlds.

4228630.title: QUIET
4228630.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

4229310.title: Red Nox
4229310.short_description: Red Nox is a horror roguelike deckbuilder with realistic graphics and a liminal space aesthetic. Gamble, explore, and create your own synergy of cards and relics to survive against the uncanny abominations within the Forbidden Lands.

4229620.title: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator
4229620.short_description: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

4229880.title: Souq Boss Simulator
4229880.short_description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

4230360.title: Haramball
4230360.short_description: Haramball is a multiplayer football tactics card strategy game where you pick the players, merge their attributes, set up the best formations and then watch your tactics unfold in real-time. Will you play beautiful football or become the football terrorist you were always meant to be ? You decide.

4230380.title: Tinker Islands
4230380.short_description: Gather your friends and sail a vast ocean filled with wonders and danger in this cozy Caribbean sandbox. Discover islands, gather resources, upgrade your gear, make a new home, and see what's waiting over the next horizon.

4230750.title: Alea
4230750.short_description: A PvP brawler where every hero is two fighters in one. Human to werewolf. Fire to ice. Shield to greatsword. Swap mid-fight to outplay a rival in a 1v1 duel, or team up for 2v2 and 3v3 clashes.

4231210.title: Inn Over Your Head
4231210.short_description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

4231670.title: Hysterical Strength
4231670.short_description: A boogeywoman driven by vengeance guides a mysterious boy north across a decrepit world, cutting down the warlords in her way. With an ancient blade, a magical top-break revolver, and the perfect combo of drugs, survive or live in this 2.5D hack-and-slash FPS hybrid adventure.

4232310.title: StalSide
4232310.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.

4232390.title: Hierosaga Overture
4232390.short_description: Enter the tomb of the Pharaess and tactically maneuver through a plethora of challenges and monster-filled gauntlets in this homage to strategy roguelikes of the 90s.

4232700.title: Castle Cats
4232700.short_description: Idle RPG and Cat-Collecting Adventure. Build a guild of heroic cats, train and evolve a wide cast of over 400 feline characters, take on quests at your own pace, customize your base, and dive into seasonal events and fun story updates in a cozy, ever-growing universe.

4232720.title: ProTax 98
4232720.short_description: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

4232950.title: Charming Blood: Twelve days
4232950.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

4233200.title: 七不思議に至るまで
4233200.short_description: The protagonist, a member of a university occult club, obtains a mysterious notebook about a high school’s “Seven Mysteries” The story branches based on your choices — will you uncover the truth, or meet an ending best left hidden? A suspense-driven horror visual novel exploring the Seven Mysteries.

4233350.title: Inverted Dreams
4233350.short_description: This dream driven psychological exploration game guides you through shifting landscapes shaped by buried fears, fractured memories and unsettling truths. As the world bends, every shadow becomes a clue, and every step pulls you deeper into the subconscious you’ve tried to forget.

4233420.title: Bugs with Afterburners
4233420.short_description: Use wits, tactics, and cybernetic fighter bugs to conquer the marshes! Command battles from your carrier or fly individual bugs in intense dogfights. Play solo or co-op, manage resources, and fight your way to victory for aphid high command.

4233500.title: Possums
4233500.short_description: Possums is an NPC-driven co-op heist game for 2-6 players where every character reacts to your actions. Distract them, use them, or stay out of their way — loot their city to pay the forest taxes.

4233710.title: Case Shop Simulator
4233710.short_description: Open cases, collect rare skins, try your weapons, and run a shop where you sell, trade, and grow your arsenal.

4234320.title: Dithered
4234320.short_description: DĪȾĦɆꞦɆĐ invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

4234680.title: Nanjing Massacre: John Rabe's Diary
4234680.short_description: This text game is based on John Rabe's diaries. Play as Rabe in the desperate Nanking Safety Zone. Your choices shape blood-stained diary entries. Decide refugees' survival under extreme resource scarcity. Help the younger generation re-examine this heavy history through immersive narrative.

4234750.title: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
4234750.short_description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

4234960.title: Idle Transporter
4234960.short_description: Idle Transporter is a fun incremental game to have running while you work on something else. Build your own little company and watch the cars zoom around the screen while you are in a zoom call.

4235280.title: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
4235280.short_description: Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀 A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

4235290.title: I can offer you Flowers
4235290.short_description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

4236680.title: 离校 School's Out
4236680.short_description: A first-person 3D horror adventure. Trapped in a mysterious world modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero teams up with enigmatic heroines to face looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they seek escape and the truth, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

4236790.title: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
4236790.short_description: Become an untouchable U.S. military soldier in Japan! Combine the wild, chaotic humor of Goat Simulator with the lawless street action of Saints Row. Smash rogue ninjas, unleash chaos, and turn the city into your ultimate playground!

4237540.title: The Dark Curiosity
4237540.short_description: First-person psychological sci-fi horror set on an abandoned space station. Left alone, you explore and piece together what happened. Something is moving in the dark, and the closer you get to the truth, the closer it gets to you.

4237570.title: THE DAY THAT WASN'T
4237570.short_description: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

4237680.title: Gulovacka
4237680.short_description: Snowballs knock you back so hard that you will be flying. Your friends having a blast watching it happen. Put on a snowsuit of your choice and dive into chaotic snowball fight in Gulovacka.

4237900.title: Point Zero: Victoria
4237900.short_description: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?

4238060.title: Good luck, little Rocket !
4238060.short_description: A new experimental rocket prototype has been built: your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to test its reliability by landing on the various platforms below you. Once this mission is accomplished, restore hope to humanity with your exceptional skill.

4238140.title: Infant God
4238140.short_description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

4238180.title: Lone Tower
4238180.short_description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

4238320.title: Game Jam Watercooler Sim
4238320.short_description: A story-driven game featuring Chinese-style group chat simulation + Game Jam Survival Guide. You will join an online group and experience the full 21-day game development competition: teaming up, arguing, teammates ghosting, and more. It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

4238590.title: ECHOES OF THE GOLDEN BRANCH - M-501 Aberrant Emotion Evolution Report
4238590.short_description: Wish Upon a Star That Does Not Exist. A dark parable blending idle collection, desktop-pet interaction, and rules-based horror.

4238660.title: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void
4238660.short_description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

4238760.title: Mommy Dies
4238760.short_description: 100 mommies. 100 ways to die. Only one survives. A psychological horror visual novel where your choices determine who lives and who dies in a twisted underground facility.

4238940.title: MadHouse For Toys
4238940.short_description: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

4239600.title: ATK：画境小镇
4239600.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

4239890.title: The White Lamb: No Shelter
4239890.short_description: Psychological horror meets fast-paced FPS combat. Play as the Ego, traverse the looping nightmarish Persona Storm realm of Id (Red Cloak) and Superego (Blue Cloak). Fight twisted trauma echoes, make fateful choices to forge reconciliation, unearth chilling truth in fractured memory.

4240220.title: Pinball Realm
4240220.short_description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters!

4240570.title: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
4240570.short_description: The idle planet creation game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the birth of a planet, upgrade the Catalyst, discover new biomes, and shape your own solar system while you work or relax.

4240800.title: Liv
4240800.short_description: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

4240850.title: Protect the Pit
4240850.short_description: Attack with your cursor, build towers and walls to defend your pit! An incremental clicker that combines tower defense, maze building, and large upgrade trees. Earn money, upgrade your defenses, and build winding mazes to stop the hordes of the Dark Forest.

4240880.title: 鸥鹭罔继
4240880.short_description: 你将观测一段虚构的故事，通过选项的干涉决定被观测者的命运。你将观测的对象是一个迷茫、执拗，有着孩童的天真与暴虐的女孩，你开始观测的时刻，她失去了自己生命中最重要的人，面临决定未来的诸多抉择。你的每一次干涉，都会将她的故事导向截然不同的方向。

4240920.title: HANDSUP
4240920.short_description: Escape a vertical nightmare with up to 4 friends using physics-based parkour. Equip Magic Rings to customize your climb. Don't let go, just keep your Hands Up.

4240930.title: Loot Goblins
4240930.short_description: Crack open chests, chain buffs and recruit the ultimate goblin crew in this fast-paced incremental auto-battler. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

4241310.title: Oceanarium Fishing
4241310.short_description: Fish, explore and survive in a co-op horror adventure for 1–4 players. Brave the ocean, upgrade your boat and build your aquarium. But save enough of your catch to feed the island’s Keeper: its daily quota is growing, and the water hides more than fish.

4241360.title: Tiny House Finds
4241360.short_description: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

4241390.title: War Company: Fortress Europe
4241390.short_description: Lead armies across a dynamic 3D campaign, then command the battles they create in real time. Logistics, maneuver, and tactical success combine to decide the fate of the war.

4242200.title: Hauntworks
4242200.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

4242890.title: Encryptid
4242890.short_description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

4243120.title: Chronicles Meteorfall
4243120.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

4243240.title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
4243240.short_description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

4244420.title: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
4244420.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, unleash the power of your towers against the ever-growing zombie hordes.

4244530.title: Towerlings
4244530.short_description: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

4244870.title: The Bed Above My Head
4244870.short_description: You’re playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

4245240.title: Ascend
4245240.short_description: A fast-paced first person puzzle platformer about a ghost making its way to Heaven.

4245280.title: Kundara: art of cards
4245280.short_description: Kundara is a frenetic and artistic elemental card roguelite game featuring combat against enemies in a theatrical kabuki adventure. Activate the power of cards, collect artifacts, and form alliances with spirits in an adventure across the five nations of Kundara.

4246130.title: Fig and Totems™
4246130.short_description: Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online party game (2-4 players). In 2min30, everyone hides a totem then hunts everyone else's. Listen closely to find them, or ambush and steal from your friends before they score. Win by throwing the most totems in the box, the fastest! Bonus if unfound.

4246560.title: PhotoLoop
4246560.short_description: Boot up the world's oldest PC to take photo editing commissions from a colourful cast of virtual strangers. In PhotoLoop, the only thing stopping you is your imagination... and probably your entire editing interface.

4247050.short_description: Build a space program from one launch pad to colonies on distant moons and planets, in 2D, with real orbital physics. Design rockets, fly every mission by hand, dock stations, mine asteroids, and launch with friends in online co-op. Deorbit a moon if you want.

4247230.title: GONE DIGGING
4247230.short_description: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

4247440.title: Leafborn
4247440.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

4247630.title: Flip & Shop Simulator
4247630.short_description: All simulators in one game! A cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a single large world. Open stores, earn money, and develop the shared city - together or separately.

4247790.title: 雨声 Rainy Days
4247790.short_description: Rainy Days is a short campus visual novel with 2+ original soundtracks, 10+ illustrations and a 30,000-word storyline. Play as the protagonist to encounter Yu, a mysterious girl, and start a sweet youthful campus rom-com. Make choices to alter the plot, unlock hidden stories.

4248140.title: Echophobia
4248140.short_description: Echophobia is a multiplayer game where sound is your only vision. A blind Hunter hunts through sound and microphone detection, while Runners navigate complete darkness to complete objectives and escape before being caught.

4248260.title: Land and Sword
4248260.short_description: Lead a group of survivors in a new land, build a functional settlement, manage deep production chains, and prepare defenses to face growing hordes of creatures. Balance growth, logistics, and survival in a world scarred by a creeping plague.

4249000.title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon
4249000.short_description: Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.

4249080.title: Misguided Remastered
4249080.short_description: Misguided Remastered: Third-person action-horror. Silvia, high school girl trapped in otherworld nightmare. Desperately search for missing best friend & mom's cherished letter her only memory. Survive Indonesian folklore horrors with axe/knife combat, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets!

4249580.title: 园区物语
4249580.short_description: You play as a tourist trapped in a scam compound. fight to survive, sneak around and seize escape chances. Gather hidden clues, master scam skills reluctantly to survive, meet captives stuck here for various reasons, dig out its dark secrets, and choose between escaping the den or ruling it.

4250680.title: AGX GP
4250680.short_description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

4251030.title: Maledictum
4251030.short_description: In Maledictum (1–4 co-op), you’re not a ghost hunter you’re an Investigator of Guilt. Identify the entity, uncover the victim/culprit/cause, and decide a final ritual to free or condemn a spirit that reacts to your voice.

4251210.title: Backflip Madness
4251210.short_description: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!

4251810.title: Rings of Heaven
4251810.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike action platformer with a focus on teamwork and cooperation. Play as angel vtuber Amai Lilia and friends and take on heaven's deadliest gauntlet, the Rings of Heaven.

4252270.title: Last Couriers
4252270.short_description: Dive into the post-apocalyptic Zone in this fun co-op extraction action! As fearless couriers, harvest anomalous hogweed, craft batteries, and power up teleports to proceed. But your loot attracts infected enemies you can't permanently kill... Сan you hold the line and escape in time?

4253020.title: Murder Meet Cute
4253020.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

4253280.title: REMOTE CONTROL
4253280.short_description: A missing crew triggers an investigation that you must lead. 6 human subjects are at your disposal to aid the mission. Control their every move by typing commands to explore the ship. Be wary: the deeper you go, the more dangers that will risk their lives and test how disposable a life really is.

4253570.title: Reshine
4253570.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

4253750.title: Habitus
4253750.short_description: Detective RPG • TTRPG-Style Interrogation • Dark Political Thriller In Zehergrad, crime is a disease. As Inspector Mehmed Başar, break suspects in brutal interrogations and make the political choices that will decide the city's fate.

4253770.title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
4253770.short_description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

4254260.title: Corner Quest
4254260.short_description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

4254520.title: Scrapfall
4254520.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

4254600.title: Economic Biathlon
4254600.short_description: Test your wits in an arcade quiz. React quickly and overcome tricky challenges. You can set new records and compete in Economic Biathlon.

4254920.title: Possessed Kingdom
4254920.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Play cards to balance your economy, defenses and army. Read the enemy, draw your army’s route, and choose when to strike.

4254950.title: Hollow Faces
4254950.short_description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

4255030.title: 纤维
4255030.short_description: Connections are like fiber threads—tugged and tangled. Some tighten; others fray. Grades, the future, and family expectations steal her breath. Between closeness and distance, hope and avoidance, she tries to understand—and be understood.

4255190.title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
4255190.short_description: This is a very short game 🥳 We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all? 🔎🙀

4255550.title: Voxel Throne
4255550.short_description: Voxel Throne is a voxel-based action adventure RPG. Explore a beautiful world, alone or with friends! Help townsfolk, defeat enemies, loot powerful items and create your ultimate build!

4255850.title: Grimmloch
4255850.short_description: A persistent text-based MMORPG where NPCs remember your secrets and shape a living world rooted in European folklore. Turn-based tactical combat, criminal gameplay, and collaborative storytelling that writes itself into canon. Built by Role-players for Role-players.

4256670.title: Picker Magnate Simulator
4256670.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

4257040.title: 100 Anomaly Cats
4257040.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4257480.title: LADR
4257480.short_description: Gather your team and step into LADR: a fast-paced 5v5 arena brawler blending the depth of MMORPG combat with the intensity of a fighting game. Challenge friends and rivals alike.

4257680.title: Odds At Oddity
4257680.short_description: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

4258290.title: We Are So Cooked
4258290.short_description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

4258370.title: Task Force Barbro
4258370.short_description: Task Force Barbro is real-time tactical infiltration in an alternate Cold War Sweden. Build the ultimate Stay-Behind unit, and take up the fight against occupiers and traitors. Guns, stealth or subversion.. the choice is yours!

4258530.title: Limes 235
4258530.short_description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

4258930.title: Modified Girl Eurie!
4258930.short_description: Modified Girl Eurie is dispatched to Tengetsu Town. Her mission is to rescue those who are powerless to fight and wipe out the monsters near the town.

4259460.title: Ratmageddon Underground
4259460.short_description: Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

4259630.title: La Cosa Nostra
4259630.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story focused, cinematic 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s Prohibition era US. Play as Johnny, an Italian American immigrant forced into a life of crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a noir mafia themed narrative.

4259930.title: Harpooner
4259930.short_description: Harpooner is an action-driven incremental fishing game. Dive into the ocean depths, hunt alien fish, collect stars and unlock exponential upgrades. Scale your power, stack stats, and take down massive bosses to clean up the coast!

4260300.title: Tombbound
4260300.short_description: Welcome to the afterlife’s most dangerous internship. In this co-op extraction horror, you serve Anubis. Raid cursed tombs, dodge mythological horrors, and collect enough cursed relics to meet the God of Death's quota. Remember: The scales of justice do not tolerate lighter wallets.

4260840.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
4260840.short_description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

4261190.title: Fairy Isle
4261190.short_description: This is a simulation construction game. You will play as the steward of a Sky Island, where you need to engage in farming, construction, smelting, and gathering on this pristine island. Your goal is to develop the island into a more splendid place.

4261370.title: Orbit to Riches
4261370.short_description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

4262250.title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
4262250.short_description: A retro FPS you can play solo or in two-player online co-op. Protect civilians from falling infected in Lockdown, or fight through dark floors and choose when to extract in Infiltrate.

4262480.title: Sneaker Store Simulator
4262480.short_description: Run a collectibles store and keep fakes off your shelves. Check sneakers, jerseys, tees, skateboards, bats and lighters against the Brand Book before you buy. Haggle with sellers and customers, bid on rare pairs at auction and grow a store collectors trust.

4262780.title: Unregret
4262780.short_description: An angry office worker named Butch snaps and sets off on a brutal journey toward his dream of becoming a Hollywood actor. Fight through hordes of enemies in a fast-paced 2D beat ‘em up, using combo-based combat and any weapons you can find - from bare fists to automatic rifles.

4262840.title: Seasonal Lockdown
4262840.short_description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

4262870.title: Pack and Ship: Warehouse Simulator
4262870.short_description: Build your logistics empire from the ground up. Choose the most profitable contracts, optimize your warehouse layout for maximum efficiency, and upgrade your equipment. Balance risk and reward as you adapt your strategy to a shifting market. Every lift, every pallet, and every decision counts.

4264000.title: Orion Blue
4264000.short_description: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.

4264060.title: Town of Tinysville
4264060.short_description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

4264190.title: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
4264190.short_description: Embark on a colorful adventure set in a nighttime environment in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures and demons with eight attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim Realms, and overcome perilous demons, creatures, and obstacles to complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

4264410.title: STEP THEATER
4264410.short_description: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

4264440.title: Dragon Guardians
4264440.short_description: Raise and evolve your own dragons in this roguelike action RPG. Build a deck of rare power cards, defeat epic bosses across dangerous lands and protect your village from the Dark Lord. Every run makes your dragon stronger.

4265600.title: Finguedom
4265600.short_description: Finger everything in the sandbox. Build your dream seaside retreat on a tropical island, Fuse structures with concrete, Shape multi-story homes upon the terrain, manage resources and workers, and construct roads, overpasses, canals, and vehicles to bring your island to life.

4265830.title: Spyder: Agent 8
4265830.short_description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

4266310.title: St. Mary's 1985
4266310.short_description: You wake up on a red chair in the waiting room of a closed psychiatric hospital. You know this place. Clothes that aren't yours. A file with your name you don't remember reading. Your heartbeat rises. The memories come back. Not all of them want to be remembered. St. Mary's, 1985.

4266710.title: Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure
4266710.short_description: Ice Pond is a cozy but true ice fishing game taking place in a whimsical snowy animal world. Pick a spot and fish! Level up, get stronger, and buy gear and power-ups to boost your performance. Do odd jobs or challenges to earn extra cash. Join tournaments and festivals to unlock new lakes!

4266820.title: Steam & Glory
4266820.short_description: Steam & Glory is a hybrid arcade/simulation train game where you take control of a 20-ton steam train as you steam, brake, ring your bell and blow your whistle to power through to the goal! Take in the scenic old west views as you race to get to the station on time!

4267040.title: Spiritual Mesh Theory
4267040.short_description: Spiritual Mesh Theory is a gamified software simulation that explores the topology of mesh networks in 3D space. A video game designed like medical software meant to be enjoyed like a visualizer. It is as much art as it is logic; giving way to theory. A clever twist on vibe\cozy gaming and software.

4269330.title: Shmandala
4269330.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

4269700.title: Minutes to Meltdown
4269700.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

4271530.title: Skyrest
4271530.short_description: Skyrest is a first-person action roguelike where you summon procedural generated islands, gather resources, upgrade your boat, craft items and weapons and fight ghostly enemies using an arsenal of spiritual weapons and runic attacks.

4271710.title: 绯想觅剑录 TenshiSwordQuest
4271710.short_description: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

4272480.title: Stickers, please
4272480.short_description: Decorate a fantasy location with sticker packs. Place or rearrange anything however you want, there are no rules.

4272560.title: BREAKOUT BABY
4272560.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

4274600.title: Fractal Forge: Sierpinski's Sanctuary
4274600.short_description: An incremental idler about recursively creating several famous fractals, managing your workers, finding treasure, fighting a dangerous fractal, and balancing multiple production lines to overcome the exponential growth in which fractal construction tries to imprison you.

4275000.title: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
4275000.short_description: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.

4275610.title: One man's junk
4275610.short_description: Hassle the unsuspecting residents of Chislington in order to barter your way up from a paperclip to a car, so you can go visit your family for the holidays.

4275900.title: Last State
4275900.short_description: Every decision has a cost. Scavenge, hunt, craft, and build a life in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic wilderness. Last State is a hardcore survival simulation where hunger, cold, injuries and one bad decision can end your story for good.

4276800.title: Spin, Baby, Spin!
4276800.short_description: Spin, Baby, Spin! is a short incremental game about slot machines. Spin the reels, upgrade your income and drop chances, craft new slot machines, and collect powerful artifacts. Choose your talent cards and earn enough chips to buy back your soul from a demonic clown!

4276900.title: Silent Mainland
4276900.short_description: Silent Mainland is a Roguelike deck-builder mixing positioning and board tactics on a 5×12 battlefield. Every card is a life-or-death choice. As monster waves surge like a tide, only sharp positioning and smart deckbuilding carve a path to survival.

4277510.title: Auredis: Vaelen's Requiem
4277510.short_description: The sun is dead. In the golden capital of Sol-Nihil, flesh fuses with stone. As the Unfused Champion, you alone can move through the stagnation. Breach the walls, slay the Puppet King, and destroy the Lich Lord in this punishing, hand-crafted Action RPG.

4277550.title: Break Protocol
4277550.short_description: The protocol has called… and it’s time to destroy everything! BREAK PROTOCOL reinvents the brick-breaker roguelike: build powerful combos, exploit card synergies, and face unique enemies and bosses across increasingly dangerous sectors.

4278420.title: Tiny Survivors
4278420.short_description: Carve a path through massive hordes of enemies while creating ridiculously broken builds. Collect powerful loot, unlock new characters, and combine upgrades to create a tiny but unstoppable force. How long can you survive the onslaught?

4279640.title: Dont Stop Walking
4279640.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

4279900.title: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game
4279900.short_description: Take a cozy road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, discover charming small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

4280040.title: Pocket Chef: Asia
4280040.short_description: Pocket Chef: Asia is a cozy, hand-drawn ramen shop game. Start at a little Japanese street cart, make every bowl with your own hands, crack riddle orders, count out the change and keep your quirky customers happy. In the full game, the journey continues across Asia.

4280690.title: Cafe Life Simulator
4280690.short_description: Manage your dream cafe, but don't stop there. In this comprehensive simulation, explore a living city! Drive cars, build relationships, work side jobs, and build your empire. From brewing coffee to becoming the most famous name in town—how will you live your cafe life?

4280840.title: Roller Coaster Park Simulator
4280840.short_description: Build and run your very own Roller Coaster Park! Play alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op. Design your own coasters, hire staff and serve your guests... or just mess around. There’s plenty to break, crash and blow up!

4280880.title: SHORE
4280880.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

4281020.title: Magic Moon
4281020.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

4281390.title: Orbz Collector
4281390.short_description: Orbz Collector is a 3D re-imagining of the 90s classic Chip's Challenge. Collect coloured keys to unlock the corresponding locks, avoid patrolling enemies and warp around to figure out the variety of puzzles throughout the 12 levels. Some of the levels you'll recognize and some of them are new!

4281870.title: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim
4281870.short_description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

4285140.title: Hired Blade
4285140.short_description: Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!

4285280.title: Martyr
4285280.short_description: Rise as a Martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, pagan rites, and relentless foes, you will fall and rise again and again. Death is not the end. Relics await based on your holy or heretical choices, and rival factions will hunt you according to your actions.

4285780.title: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets
4285780.short_description: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and block puzzle happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.

4285870.title: Pigs and Wolf
4285870.short_description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

4286510.title: Plobania 47/B
4286510.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

4287260.title: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right
4287260.short_description: This is a simulation game that emphasizes the long-term impact of choices. Players take on the role of a Chinese woman born in the 2000s who has experienced trauma from her family of origin and must raise her newborn child until adulthood, ensuring the child's mental and physical well-being.

4287810.title: The Missing Threads
4287810.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

4287970.title: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
4287970.short_description: All Those Dungeons in Alva’s Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alva’s mind.

4288270.title: Crooked Cooks
4288270.short_description: Crooked Cooks is a chaotic co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss’ criminal jobs, mixing fast-paced cooking with shady business.

4289280.title: Wizard 64
4289280.short_description: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

4289610.title: Mongolian Wind Script 1: Chongzheng Academy
4289610.short_description: A historical visual novel set in early-20th-century Inner Mongolia. Make choices for Saran, a girl placed in the real Chongzheng Academy, and branch her story toward five true endings. Featuring native vertical Mongolian script rendering and reimagined period music.
