4290560.title: Matchward
4290560.short_description: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

4290690.title: Poker Warrior
4290690.short_description: This is a roguelike deck-builder game around poker suits. Hearts fuel survival, Spades drive strength, Diamonds power wealth, and Clubs embrace chaos. Through deck construction and card fusion, you can twist the suits, break expectations, and uncover wildly different builds.

4290910.title: X Space
4290910.short_description: A sudden, devastating strike has reduced your interstellar voyage to ruins. As the sole survivor in X SPACE, you must rebuild your space base from scratch, assemble a versatile fleet, and pilot your massive mobile fortress into the depths of the universe.

4291020.title: Heartseers Grove
4291020.short_description: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

4291160.title: Cults of the Endtimes
4291160.short_description: The world is in agony. The only salvation is faith. Forge a god from the fears and hopes of a dying humanity. Spread your ideas like a virus, mutate dogmas, and battle other egregores for the last souls on Earth. A strategy game about manipulating consciousness without direct control.

4292740.title: Tome Improvement
4292740.short_description: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

4292750.title: No Reason to Climb
4292750.short_description: A simple yet challenging 2D platformer where the only goal is to climb as high as possible for no reason at all. Jump, dodge, and face precision-based challenges across 5 increasingly difficult worlds, where one mistake can send you falling and cost all your progress.

4293000.title: SWAT God
4293000.short_description: SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

4293120.title: Jest Messters
4293120.short_description: A comedy-mystery otome (GxB) visual novel full of dad jokes, cringe puns, and an unexpected mystery! Come and join the pun!

4293320.title: D3LIGHT
4293320.short_description: rhythm game abomination that mix keyboard and mouse inputs

4293560.title: Revil Bone
4293560.short_description: A spooky co-op survival game for up to 6 players. Explore shifting worlds, mix crystals for Statue demands, gather resources, and survive chaotic encounters where heavy hits trigger physics-based bone reactions.

4293800.title: For Good Measure
4293800.short_description: Two measuring tapes stuck together... Why? No time to explain, you have puzzles to solve! Don't let the simple two-button movement controls fool you into thinking it'll be easy. Tackle the puzzles alone or team up with a friend in online or local co-op.

4293870.title: Day 22
4293870.short_description: You're a cop checking an abandoned barn. Simple assignment. But the longer you're there, the less you can trust what you see — or yourself. A first-person psychological anomaly horror experience built around paranoia and perception.

4294210.title: Date the Difference
4294210.short_description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

4295600.title: Depono
4295600.short_description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

4297250.title: Dungeon Trader
4297250.short_description: Become a Dungeon Trader and climb from Beginner to Legendary Trader! Buy, Sell, Negotiate risky deals, Play unique Mini-Games, Unlock strange visitors, customize your appearance, and uncover hidden secrets lurking beneath the Dungeon.

4297380.title: type:def
4297380.short_description: Welcome, user. This [type:def] tower defense training module simulates a network defense scenario. Hostile data is attempting to escape the system. Deploy defensive nodes, type commands to control them, and secure the network - your only weapon is your keyboard!

4297610.title: Local Zombies
4297610.short_description: Shape unique characters in this choice-driven life sim, then turn them into zombies. Each human’s attributes determine their zombie form and skills. Build your undead squad and conquer Hippo City in automated battles.

4297710.title: Interstitial
4297710.short_description: Interstitial is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the unease of liminal spaces, blending environmental storytelling, exploration-driven gameplay, and slow-burning dread to create an experience where the world itself becomes the threat.

4298110.title: Harmony Of Tea
4298110.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

4298340.title: BumperMania
4298340.short_description: An online car brawler made of voxels. Ram the other cars until they fall apart or push them off the edge. Grab weapons from crates, like a lasso, an orbital laser or an hourglass that stops time. Last car standing wins. Play with friends or against bots.

4298470.title: 闪耀！我的游戏班
4298470.short_description: You are her teacher. She is the last student in the game design class, and she dreams of making great games. For three years, guide her through classes, game development, part-time jobs, and competitions. But the industry is collapsing. Will she rise, or disappear? That is up to you.

4298650.title: Shothop
4298650.short_description: SHOTHOP is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

4298670.title: Please fix the mess
4298670.short_description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

4298730.title: Catching Breaks
4298730.short_description: In this first-person office comedy, you fix busted microwaves and put out fires while coworkers try to stop you for a chat. Use the right tool for the job, or slap a machine and see if it holds until the end of your shift.

4298750.title: Blob Wars
4298750.short_description: Blob Wars is a turn-based tactics game where efficiency is key. Use each Blob’s unique abilities to defeat the enemy army in as few turns as possible, the fewer turns you take, the greater the reward. Traverse a branching world map and carve your own path through this replayable experience.

4298810.title: Moosio
4298810.short_description: Moosio is a chaotic party brawler where you play as moose blasting mushrooms at each other! Gobble up mushrooms around the arena and spit them at your friends in ridiculous combat. Play local or online. Pure mayhem. Pure moose. Pure mushroom chaos!

4299200.title: Qamar
4299200.short_description: Roll a planet through an ink-and-wash world in this physics-based precision platformer. Build momentum, ride walls, glide across gaps, and use sidespin to nail your landings. Dodge catapult fire, brave huge drops, and chase your perfect run.

4299250.title: Plenty of Cards in the Sea
4299250.short_description: Gather around the table and play a variety of card games with your friends!

4299460.title: Sweepcremental
4299460.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

4299690.title: Keybort
4299690.short_description: Turn your keyboard into a powerful idle machine! Press keys, earn Gold, automate with AI Cursors, unlock skills, open chests, build combos, upgrade your Key Forge, and take on Glitch Bosses as your system grows stronger.

4299750.title: Meet Mary
4299750.short_description: A Cinematic 1-4 Player Co-op Horror Story Adventure. One of your friends has gone missing. While experiencing strange visions, you uncover a secret bunker with suspicious intentions. Meet the people, solve puzzles, and explore the facility. Meet your host Mary. How far would you go to save a friend?

4300260.title: 4Below
4300260.short_description: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota... together!

4300270.title: 雾卷·知白
4300270.short_description: Mist: Conscious of the Light​ is a 2D top-down rogue-lite game. Players can assume the roles of different characters, acquire various weapons and items, and engage in combat by attaching pages with diverse effects to their weapons. Seek out story-driven items, complete individual narratives

4300350.title: The Joy of Sculpting
4300350.short_description: The Joy of Sculpting is a 3D party game about sculpting, describing, and ruining each other's art. Shape anything from a huge object library and clay-like blobs, then pass it between friends across four multiplayer modes and watch it mutate into something gloriously unrecognizable.

4300400.title: Blades & Trades
4300400.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

4301340.title: Gutterspace
4301340.short_description: Gutterspace is a hand-drawn, human crafted, poetry-powered couch co-op game about sharing one body and surviving it.

4301480.title: Dont Look
4301480.short_description: Your boat stops working. You are forced to the nearest dock. A fog-covered island lies before you. Abandoned buildings. Dense forest. No guidance. Blood everywhere. Warnings remain. You need to leave. Something is watching. It wants you to look.

4301510.title: Slot Siege
4301510.short_description: Build defenses by day and fight off hordes and bosses by night in first-person co-op. Spin for gear and keep your team’s slot machine standing through 10 nights.

4301840.title: Operation Together VR
4301840.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op military VR simulation. Complete tactical operations, neutralize terrorist threats, and rescue civilians.

4302300.title: Empire Water Works
4302300.short_description: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

4302740.title: Shadow Runner
4302740.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

4302790.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
4302790.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

4303120.title: Blank Slate
4303120.short_description: Blank Slate is a first-person crime sandbox — craft graded fake IDs, run shady storefronts, launder dirty cash, hire a crew — ID makers, a dealer and a store manager — train them up, pay their wages, and let them lift the work, and outrun the heat in a city that looks the other way.

4303160.title: Roll For Damage!
4303160.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

4303570.title: Hook Nook
4303570.short_description: A cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Catch fish to unlock different biomes, socialize with shopkeepers, upgrade your gear, and maybe even try wearing a duck for a hat! Study, work or watch shorts while fishing with friends.

4303930.title: Ashen Swarm
4303930.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where you wield the power of deadly sins. The Judge knew not all were guilty, yet condemned the world. Burn hordes with Wrath, turn foes into swine with Pride and devour the fallen with Gluttony. Survive the swarm and face the boss of each arena.

4304100.title: Paranormal Research Society
4304100.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

4304150.title: Recovered Occurrence
4304150.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

4304360.title: Mine Liebe Musik 1
4304360.short_description: Cute little troublemakers put on elegant bullet-hell spectacles and trade some very inelegant insults in this weird, story-driven bullet-hell adventure. You're invited to a 40-minute prologue—the opening act of a strange and twisted tale.

4304470.title: On Sight
4304470.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

4304740.title: Escape from Ashville
4304740.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

4304790.title: Reunions with you billions of times
4304790.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

4304890.title: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
4304890.short_description: Run a mad science shop by day, pilot a giant robot by night. In this 1-4 player co-op comedy sim you stock shelves, brew unstable potions and expose undercover agents - then split the robot's controls with your friends to flatten 5 cities and beat 5 superheroes.

4305160.title: ZHITEN
4305160.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

4305180.title: Mad MOJO
4305180.short_description: Mad MOJO is a monster-catching deckbuilder with a deep, fourth-wall-breaking meta game hidden beneath the surface. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands. Break the game by tackling puzzles in an in-game PC. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

4305360.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
4305360.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

4305390.title: Reaction
4305390.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

4305490.title: Humanity's Fall
4305490.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

4305650.title: Crosstown
4305650.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

4305900.title: Serenity
4305900.short_description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

4306130.title: Subway Story
4306130.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

4306240.title: For the Glory of Wilson
4306240.short_description: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite where you recruit allies who fight alongside you and influence every battle.

4307270.title: Little Lilicia
4307270.short_description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

4307320.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco
4307320.short_description: A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. Because the world is big enough for all!

4307390.title: Cursed Gas Station
4307390.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

4307810.title: Pumpkin Survivor
4307810.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

4307830.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
4307830.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

4308000.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
4308000.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

4308100.title: Scales
4308100.short_description: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

4308270.title: Hunter Road
4308270.short_description: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

4308420.title: Arizona Sunshine®
4308420.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

4308630.title: Dopamine rogue
4308630.short_description: Manage your dopamine, earn money, build decks, and navigate life's challenges in this psychological life-simulation roguelike. Every choice shapes your story as you struggle to survive your own mind. A solo-developed project crafted over two years.

4309400.title: Which Sea Is This?
4309400.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

4311050.title: Legend of Idle
4311050.short_description: In this short incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

4311660.title: Welcome, [Employee Name]
4311660.short_description: Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

4312030.title: Dwarven Mining Company
4312030.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

4312150.title: Lost Dude
4312150.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

4312750.title: Type The Rhythm
4312750.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

4313010.title: Buy The Game, I Have a Gun 2: Online Open World
4313010.short_description: Save the world from Alien Jesus in this 1-10 player online co-op sandbox game where you explore an open world, do quests, watch a HIGH-QUALITY interactive movie, and play minigames! Now that’s a mission for Sheesh-Man, his wife, his mom, and his dad!

4313400.title: Gunfort
4313400.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

4314170.title: Jibbers
4314170.short_description: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

4314520.title: DepotDash
4314520.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

4314580.title: NightMeer
4314580.short_description: NightMeer is a 2D exploration adventure about the nights you can't sleep. Wrapped in the pressure of having to fall asleep now, Noah drifts through her darkened room. Guide her with a click, and slowly let the tension leave her body and mind. How she gets through this night is up to you.

4314600.title: Toe-tal War
4314600.short_description: TOE-TAL WAR is an action-puzzle platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death. Some levels may require a little practice and hard thinking.

4314710.title: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
4314710.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

4314870.title: Infinite Crosswalk
4314870.short_description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

4314970.title: VANADEN
4314970.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

4314980.title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
4314980.short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

4315080.title: Indie Hoverboard Racing
4315080.short_description: A high-speed sci-fi hoverboard racer. Survive hostile regions, defeat elite rivals, and earn your place on the Nocturnia City Circuit.

4315530.title: Rayman Origins Enhanced Edition
4315530.short_description: Jump back into an iconic 2D platforming adventure as you leap through 60+ colorful levels solo or in up to 4-player co-op, now enhanced in 4K/60 FPS with new quality-of-life features and brand-new collectibles.

4315950.title: Mars Colony Simulator
4315950.short_description: Stranded alone on Mars. Mine iron and ice with a tactile beam, rebuild a broken colony, and survive the freezing night on stored sunlight and rationed oxygen — while a sandworm's dust plume crawls the horizon. An austere low-poly survival builder about earning your way home.

4316030.title: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
4316030.short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable realms.

4316380.title: ComboCraft Legendary
4316380.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

4316530.title: Clash of Worlds
4316530.short_description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing "in real life". Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

4316570.title: Orbital Upgrade
4316570.short_description: As the AI of a space station, you control programmable bots and solve automation puzzles. Plan precise processes, optimize your strategies, and watch your solutions execute autonomously.

4317040.title: Alone After Dark: Head Practitioner
4317040.short_description: Attend to patients and fill out paperwork as 22-year-old Kimora Jackson on her first shift after graduating nursing school. Draw blood, administer medications, and try not to lose your head in the chilling hallways of Coldrock Medical Center.

4319030.title: Kwartikum
4319030.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

4319260.title: Lucky Rabbit
4319260.short_description: GAMBLE to pay off your debts! Buy power ups (drugs) to increase profit and see how large your bankroll can get! Play Slots, Casino Classics, and more! Remember: Fortune favors the bold, go all in!

4320070.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
4320070.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

4320140.title: Awakewood
4320140.short_description: Will returns to bury his mother and leave right away, but everything changes when he finds a stranger in the woods. As the house decays and roots swallow everything, saving her comes with an irreversible cost: uncovering a truth hidden in Awakewood for ten years.

4320730.title: Super Onslaught
4320730.short_description: A real time strategy, arcade, tower defense game where you repeat short runs in order to get more knowledge about the mechanics and turrets. With good knowledge and preparation, you will survive longer and even maybe reach the wave 100 milestone.

4320880.title: Pillow Punk
4320880.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

4321120.title: The Curator
4321120.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

4321390.title: The Last Opening
4321390.short_description: You are dead. To return, you must survive 40 nights in the woods, making brutal choices by day and playing chess against Death each night. The forest is cold. The nights are long. Win, and you may see the dawn. Lose… and the world forgets you.

4321950.title: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
4321950.short_description: Climb a hazardous mountain that gets meaner with every ascent... until it breaks you. Master Goblin Mountaineering, including rubber-arm slingshotting and fart propulsion. Not challenging enough? Hunt down bizarre accessories to become the most 'ahem' gorgeous Goblin.

4324270.title: RLRacer
4324270.short_description: Master the season in this 2D roguelike racer! Meet escalating targets against tough AI up to the finale. Invest tactically in upgrades & crew. Win to unlock new cars with unique abilities that completely change your strategy for the next run.

4324770.title: BattleSpinners
4324770.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

4324940.title: Fartimus!
4324940.short_description: Use your voice to defeat enemy wizards in this online PVP Spell Casting Duel!

4325760.title: Night on Bald Mountain
4325760.short_description: Orbit, dodge, and touch! Light up the stars in an action game built around Night on Bald Mountain!

4326110.title: Sky Defense
4326110.short_description: A card-driven tower defense game where one wrong choice ends your run. Place defenses, upgrade your deck between rounds, and protect your floating island from endless waves of enemies.

4327180.title: RAPIDS
4327180.short_description: Dare to Deliver in RAPIDS, a frantic co-op roguelike. Either solo or as a group of friends, navigate a hazardous river while delivering packages. Master magic, charm cute critters, and upgrade your boat, one fast-paced run at a time

4327620.title: DEWORLD AURALIS
4327620.short_description: The village was alive. The factory was running. Then they found something. Now inside remains only what they believed in… and what their madness became.

4328320.title: OVER SAND
4328320.short_description: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!

4328560.title: Evergrowing
4328560.short_description: Play as a squirrel in a cozy adventure about growing your tree home. Help woodland neighbors, build along the branches, and travel by balloon to other trees. Venture beneath the roots and discover what’s waiting below.

4328620.title: Slavic Warband
4328620.short_description: Slavic Warband is a tactical RPG in which you lead a pack of peasants searching for a better life in early medieval Eastern Europe. Explore, fight, equip, and level up your company to ultimately create your own small kingdom.

4330540.title: Pirate & Darkmage
4330540.short_description: A life simulation RPG set in a world of pirates and magic. Farm, fish, build friendships, and set out on adventures at your own pace. Complete goals without feeling restricted, and shape your own story through the choices you make.

4330750.title: Tiny Ramen Shop
4330750.short_description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

4331050.title: Totally Normal Ramen
4331050.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

4331850.title: Night At The Mall VR
4331850.short_description: Night At The Mall is a first-person, narrative-driven psychological horror game where you take the night shift inside an abandoned shopping mall that refuses to stay still.

4332830.title: Nijoaju
4332830.short_description: Two characters. One goal. Think as one. In Nijoaju, control a powerful stone creature and an agile water creature, combining their unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles, overcome obstacles, and prove that only by working together can you move forward.

4333430.title: The Apartment
4333430.short_description: A new apartment. A polite neighbor who knows every package you get. He wants his share. Every day, a little more. Keep him fed or become the meal. A first-person psychological horror.

4333680.title: DreeM Ascension
4333680.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

4334090.title: SLENDYJAN
4334090.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

4334240.title: Leaf Us Alone
4334240.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

4334350.title: Sin Return
4334350.short_description: An obscure adventure begins in the Silent Kingdom, a land decaying under the spread of the Sin-fication plague. This dark fantasy turn-based RPG emphasizes exploration. Reclaim lost memories in this sinful land, defeat formidable foes, and piece together the truth behind the catastrophe.

4334710.title: 夢酔のバーテンダー
4334710.short_description: A hazy, dreamlike visual novel with a touch of the surreal. Step behind the bar of a mysterious, ethereal space. Craft cocktails, share quiet conversations, and connect with your guests' hearts. Mix drinks as you please, and lose yourself in this gentle, dreamlike world.

4335690.title: Sea Pets: Match & Merge
4335690.short_description: Drop adorable sea creatures into the ocean and merge them into bigger ones in this relaxing yet addictive physics puzzle. How long can you keep the ocean under control?

4335990.title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
4335990.short_description: Face yourself, endure surreal trials, and survive a clinical evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave. Your intake begins in a psychological horror experience where your fears, choices, and personality profile carry into future chapters.

4336090.title: Bad Tides
4336090.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

4336330.title: Delete The Hypercube
4336330.short_description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

4338730.title: Neuroma
4338730.short_description: A fast-paced vertical shmup where a living brain controls a combat ship to battle grotesque alien creatures across biomechanical worlds filled with massive bosses and intense arcade action.

4339590.title: No Clean Start
4339590.short_description: No Clean Start is a first-person survival horror with roguelite elements set in a hostile underground facility. Explore dangerous sectors, scavenge for weapons and supplies, manage resources, and fight or avoid deadly enemies. Complete objectives, adapt your strategy, and survive each expedition.

4339840.title: Walking With The Wild
4339840.short_description: Nature so serene… yet so violent. In this adventure-thriller, you are cast into a mystical world with nothing but your mind and body. To survive, you must leverage your five powerful senses and overcome the horrors that surround you. Can you make it home, or will the journey be too draining?

4340180.title: Ash of the Covenant
4340180.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where brutal melee combat meets dangerous divine power. Accept blessings from forgotten gods, build powerful synergies, and face the hidden cost behind every gift.

4341570.title: Hold My Cargo
4341570.short_description: A first-person smuggling sim. Buy low, sell high, stash the good stuff where customs won't look and talk your way past inspection. Grow from a rust bucket to a freighter, escape the galaxy, then do it again. Online co-op for 1–4 players arrives in the first major update.

4344270.title: Tiny Misery
4344270.short_description: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

4344380.title: PAWA
4344380.short_description: P.A.W.A is an auto-chess roguelike inspired by TFT and Slay the Spire. Build a team of cool and cute creatures, combine and position your units wisely, create powerful synergies, and defeat challenging bosses.

4347560.title: Checkpoint '38
4347560.short_description: You're a German border guard in 1938. Check passports, catch forged papers, and decide who crosses as the rules tighten. Then go home and face your family. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise. Free demo on Steam.

4347660.title: Bros of Bench
4347660.short_description: Bros of Bench is a minimalist cooperative platformer in which two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Take turns lifting each other and using the jetpack. Mastering coordination, physics, and timing will be key to winning!

4347690.title: Mine Climbers
4347690.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

4347770.title: Fiets-Together
4347770.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op bike game for 2-4 players where each of you controls one shoe on a pedal. Together, you control the bike's acceleration and steering. Agree on which path to ride, chase best times, customize your shoe and try to preserve your friendship.

4348560.title: Slotlander
4348560.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

4348630.title: Bus Station Simulator
4348630.short_description: In Bus Station Simulator, take over a forgotten bus station and bring it back to life - solo or in co-op! Take care of passengers, your fleet, and the infrastructure as you transform a rundown terminal into the beating heart of Winston Springs.

4349470.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
4349470.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

4349580.title: The Gauntlet
4349580.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

4349700.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
4349700.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

4350100.title: Orbrix
4350100.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!

4350110.title: Bullet Time Agent
4350110.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

4350480.title: Flywheel
4350480.short_description: Flywheel is a 2D action game where you dash through the skies using jumps and flight. Each run challenges you with ever-changing terrain. With retro pixel art, nostalgic sound, and simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoy.

4351820.title: Farming with lasers
4351820.short_description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

4352090.title: Liminal:Childhood Memories
4352090.short_description: Exhausted by the gray reality of adulthood, a 21 year old awakens in his forgotten past. Childhood Memories is a puzzle-free, melancholic exploration experience driven by the nostalgic atmosphere of 'Liminal Space' and 'Kenopsia'. No monsters, only memories.

4352540.title: Sekigahara
4352540.short_description: The fate of Japan is in your hands! Sekigahara is a digital adaptation of the acclaimed two-player strategy board game set in 1600, during the epic campaign that unified Japan. Command hidden armies, manage loyalties, and outmaneuver your rival!

4352900.title: Tiny Fortress
4352900.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

4354570.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
4354570.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

4355110.title: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
4355110.short_description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

4357130.title: SnatchDeck
4357130.short_description: Steal, Adapt, Survive! SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

4357470.title: Pubes
4357470.short_description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

4359360.title: Scrappy Craft
4359360.short_description: A shop keeper game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10,000 absurd weapons like banana swords or frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes, and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

4359960.title: Rayborne
4359960.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

4360780.title: Scaredy Cats
4360780.short_description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

4361640.title: OutSpin
4361640.short_description: Ram, bump and launch enemy spinners out of the arena! OUTSPIN is a physics arena brawler roguelite with living arenas, epic boss fights and 10 Heat levels. Pick your spinner, build your run and master the ring-out – on PC and Steam Deck.

4362060.title: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
4362060.short_description: Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't). Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session.

4362230.title: Can I Get a Job?
4362230.short_description: Operator, you have been appointed to the position of labor resource allocator. The System observes and analyzes every decision you make. Compliance with instructions is recommended. Begin work.

4362490.title: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
4362490.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

4362550.title: 9Clock OverPack
4362550.short_description: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

4362620.title: Your Maid
4362620.short_description: A desktop companion simulation featuring a charming 3D character living on your screen. Drag, rotate, and pose your companion. Collect poses across rarity tiers, unlock costumes, play 7 mini-games, and set alarms while your fantasy friend keeps you company throughout your workday.

4362660.title: Stellar Frontline
4362660.short_description: A unique tower defense game where you build and upgrade defenses by placing hex tiles. Protect your rocket from hostile spaceships to unlock new tiles after each defeated wave.

4363390.title: Diamond Legacy Online
4363390.short_description: Set in an ancient world, this MMORPG lets you develop your character, strengthen your equipment, and challenge guilds. Progress solo or with a party, take risks, and earn the rewards of your effort. In this world, power is not given; it is earned.

4363570.title: Wrath of the Arcane Realms
4363570.short_description: Wrath of the Arcane Realms is a hexagon-based, turn-based roguelike strategy game. Assemble a party of 3 from 6 heroes, chart your path across the realms, and craft your own synergies by drafting unique skills. There is no "correct" way to save the Arcane Realms. Don't seek the solution—define it!

4363730.title: Bonk Universe
4363730.short_description: Explore an infinite universe with unlimited possibilities, Conquer the Celestials, Build civilizations, and more! This is an open universe sandbox game, and not even the sky is the limit!

4363880.title: Ashes - Doomsday Borer
4363880.short_description: A side-scrolling game featuring adventure, exploration, level progression, boss battles, and puzzle-solving. Take on the role of a modified rodent warrior, piloting an underground vehicle to fight against an artificial intelligence and save the creatures living beneath the surface.
publishers: Homeless Network Technology Guangzhou Co., Ltd

4363890.title: Slay the Slime
4363890.short_description: An incremental game where you slay thousands of slimes in an epic power fantasy. Stack upgrades, master unique classes, equip powerful relics and defeat mighty bosses on your way from rookie to the guild's top adventurer.

4364220.title: This is not Chess, It's War!
4364220.short_description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

4364310.title: Cook The Dungeon
4364310.short_description: Cook the Dungeon is a first-person roguelike deckbuilder where every fight feeds the next. Descend through branching paths, forage for herbs, hunt strange creatures, and build a deck of Cuts, Preps, and Seasons. Land precise cuts, harvest monster parts, and cook meals for the battles ahead.

4364740.title: These Eyes
4364740.short_description: These Eyes is a no-text adventure game with elements of action, platforming, quests, and horror. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and interact with other characters.

4364880.title: 键盘农场 Keyboard Farm
4364880.short_description: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.

4364920.title: CHEAT
4364920.short_description: CHEAT is an exam-themed card Roguelike game. You play as a student who must collect and use various bizarre cards and skills. Stay vigilant, dodge the teachers, improve your scores and rankings, and ultimately achieve victory in the exam!

4365230.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
4365230.short_description: In a single night, your family's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by *fixing* the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

4365430.title: Striders
4365430.short_description: Plunge into the sea trenches and command an army of summoned allies. Upgrade you and your team, stack devastating synergies, as you overwhelm the relentless HORDE. Transform from a lone diver into an unstoppable force backed by an ocean of allies in this Vampire Survivors–inspired action roguelike.

4365610.title: Creatures
4365610.short_description: Breed, teach, and guide your Norns as they grow into independent creatures. Explore the world of Albia, develop their skills, and build new colonies by sending your strongest Norns into unexplored worlds!

4365740.title: Chrono Vanguard: Primal Survival - Dinosaur
4365740.short_description: Cut through relentless dinosaur hordes, unlock powerful heroines, and survive long enough to become unstoppable.

4366220.title: Evolution: Code of 6 Desires
4366220.short_description: In this evolutionary simulation game, you play as a deity sowing the seeds of life. Each human you create possesses a unique genome, where the combination of desire genes determines their behavioral patterns and fate trajectory. A sandbox about life, choice, and destiny awaits your discovery.

4366240.title: Silent Still 3
4366240.short_description: Silent Still 3 is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on sleep paralysis, limited movement, and environmental tension. Fear builds slowly through silence, observation, subtle audio cues, and realistic spaces, creating a lasting sense of unease as control gradually slips away.

4366510.title: Lattice Defense
4366510.short_description: A tower defense game meets top-down shooter. Build a maze of walls and elemental towers by day. Defend yourself by night. Dash, build, and blast your way until dawn. Play solo or in online co-op.

4368670.title: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil
4368670.short_description: 🍂🍷A mystical and devilish visual novel about two demonic catgirls, a lonely author, and the nature of Evil — with music, philosophy, dark humor, and hand-painted gouache artwork.

4369040.title: Infected Zone Survival
4369040.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

4369570.title: Lacustris - The War over Water
4369570.short_description: An innovative, realistic point-and-click game where you step into the shoes of a mysterious character in search of his identity and a shocking truth. Puzzles to solve, complex dialogue, and realistic graphics are the focus of this engaging game.

4369680.title: Moldborne
4369680.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op turn-based roguelike. The Father stopped answering prayers years ago. Then the mold came up out of the ground, and the dead started getting back up. They remember everything. So do you.

4370100.title: Cute Country
4370100.short_description: The world's first simulation management single-player game with an alternate world theme! The world's first city-building RPG game!Build a home with a catgirl, farm with a dragon maid, and embark on an otherworldly adventure you've never experienced before! You absolutely cannot miss out on Curry!

4370210.title: Split Brain Samsara
4370210.short_description: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

4370340.title: Asa's Ascended
4370340.short_description: A boss-rush bullethell with custom fights made by the community through the editor! Enjoy multiplayer, leaderboards, and tons of unique items.

4371150.title: Runeline
4371150.short_description: Design, build, and code a factory within the magical world of Runeline! Work on producing increasingly complex products, which will require you to write not just functional but optimized code, all within the simple instructions of the machine core.

4371220.title: Ash Dawn
4371220.short_description: Dodge or Die! You are out of potions.

4371320.title: Party Time Bowling
4371320.short_description: Strike up the neon-soaked fun in this competitive party sports game for up to 8 players. Bowl, roll, and battle it out in Air Hockey, unlock 100+ ball skins and custom pins with Alley Bucks, and keep the good times rolling.

4371380.title: March of the Kingdom
4371380.short_description: A party-management roguelite RPG auto-battler where you explore diverse lands, hunt the enemies of the kingdom, and face unpredictable encounters. Build your team, level up, and collect powerful weapons, artifacts, and relics to aid you on your journey.

4371600.title: Dice Brawl
4371600.short_description: Dice Brawl is a dice customization roguelite map crawler game. Progress through different areas defeating enemies to unlock additional customization options. With different die face actions, rarities, and modifiers, dice customization has never been so rewarding. Roll for your destiny!

4371860.title: Killware: Under Review
4371860.short_description: Adrenaline-fuelling, gory, arcade-style roguelite shooter where survival is mandatory. Outlast escalating waves, grow stronger with each run, and defy the Content Compliance Police in a dystopian future that’s watching your every move.

4371900.title: Case File: Archived 3:12AM
4371900.short_description: At 3:12 AM, someone knocked. The door was locked from the inside. A story-rich psychological horror where you explore and investigate a Kolkata home as reality begins to repeat, change, and remember.

4372070.title: Devilbreath: The First Seal
4372070.short_description: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

4372150.title: Thieves Guild Master
4372150.short_description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

4372450.title: Almarti: Trade in the Woods
4372450.short_description: Almarti: Trade in the Woods is a point-and-click puzzle game. In the woods by the lake, a female who calls herself Almarti hopes for your help. Please follow her guide, do sort of things, and finally achieve that ulterior purpose……

4372990.title: EVO Card
4372990.short_description: A biopunk roguelike deckbuilder where you evolve by stealing enemy organs. Devour rivals, mutate your entire body, fuse material cards, and build the ultimate chimera. Kill or be eaten—become the apex predator.

4373320.title: Forgefolk
4373320.short_description: Forge weapons and tools by hand, repair what others have broken, and uncover the stories buried in old steel. In Forgefolk, every scar means something — and what you find may force an old master smith to face the one thing he never managed to fix: his past.

4373420.title: All Haul the King
4373420.short_description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

4373910.title: Unending Watch - Dead Man's Fingers
4373910.short_description: A steampunk extraction survival game built on brutal melee combat and constant tension. No guns—only heavy strikes, smart counters, and raw survival. Enemies hunt, adapt, and ambush. The world shifts mid-run. Extract with loot… or be claimed by the dark.

4373990.title: Slots Up!
4373990.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

4374200.title: Snack Factory Together
4374200.short_description: Manage a snack factory together! Produce various treats for maximum profit. Upgrade machines, unlock new products, and deliver massive orders. Can you handle the demand?

4374270.title: Hustle
4374270.short_description: Hustle is a VR adventure game where you play as a Bounty Hunter taking on various jobs for interplanetary corporations and conspiracy groups. What will you do for a taste of everything?

4374530.title: Keep It Up!
4374530.short_description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

4374750.title: Bound By Fate - Cursed Soulmates
4374750.short_description: Break the cycle and find new love, or embrace your handsome (but creepy) Yandere soulmate in this horror romance visual novel.

4375040.title: Dwarfspire
4375040.short_description: Dwarfspire is an idle shopkeeper that sits on the edge of your screen. Manage a shop of hand crafted gear while sending expeditions of dwarves up mountains to gather rare materials and forge new items. Mine ore, craft items and become a master shopkeeper!

4375130.title: Mage On The Move
4375130.short_description: Mage on the Move is a rouge like game with many upgrades and things to unlock to avoid dying from the robots that will chase you through your runs. Purchase stat upgrades with skill points and physical upgrades with the legendary currency of the Vietnamese dong (in game currency only).

4375510.title: Lane of the Eternal Night
4375510.short_description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it’s more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

4375740.title: Island
4375740.short_description: Island is a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You appear on the beach of the island, not remembering your past, and your goal is to survive. The wildlife, the other inhabitants of the island all around want you dead. Make the right choice, because it may be the last one!

4375930.title: Undead Apocalypse: Hellbreak
4375930.short_description: Fire, throw, and ride your way through a zombie-infested city. Shoot them down, blast with grenades, and escape on a motorcycle - a survival TPS built on constant action and momentum.

4376210.title: Whirlwind Survivor
4376210.short_description: Movement IS damage. A roguelite survivor with 100+ skill cards across Fire, Frost, and Lightning. One stick, total carnage. Every run builds different, every run plays different. Pure chaos and flow state.

4376810.title: That One Dungeon Room
4376810.short_description: An action-infused Idle/Incremental game that blends effortless play with satisfying combat. It combines rewarding incremental progression with action and RPG elements, creating a deep, grind-driven progression system focused on upgrades, long-term growth, and a highly addictive gameplay loop.

4376830.title: V.E.C.T. Impact
4376830.short_description: Smash through geometric hordes with your lance. Spend each run’s credits on permanent upgrades in your skill tree to unleash orbitals, sword waves and chain lightning. Keep upgrading until every enemy you smash ignites a blast. Click. Charge. Cue the fireworks.

4377120.title: Way to Oasis
4377120.short_description: Way to Oasis : a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You lead a six-member caravan after the captain’s death. Manage scarce resources, navigate moral dilemmas, and face hidden threats. Your choices decide if the group survives or perishes.

4377360.title: Abyss Chamber
4377360.short_description: Maintain an underground research facility full of abyss entities. Fulfill their needs and survive long enough to solve all of the mysteries. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game.

4377860.title: Bumpers & Dragons
4377860.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

4377960.title: GNOSiS
4377960.short_description: Lost, alone, & vulnerable, a voluntary candidate of a twisted treasure hunt attempts to survive inside someones sadistic nightmare . . Explore this Open-World Survival Horror carefully & let the guiding signals orientate your escape from this hellish reality!

4379070.title: Echoes of Sin: Drain
4379070.short_description: DRAIN is an action RPG set in a dark fantasy world after a sudden catastrophe. The focus lies on its combat gameplay and deep story, where the destinies of intriguing companions revolve around yours. Exploring the world and solving its mysteries and puzzles will be crucial.

4379620.title: The Lonely Meadow
4379620.short_description: In The Lonely Meadow, you are a wandering spirit in a silent world. Glide over yellow plains to spark vibrant life in your wake and seek out 16 shattered landmarks. Reassemble the past to restore colour, sound, and soul to this forgotten sanctuary. Will you wake the meadow?

4379870.short_description: "Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

4380220.title: NULL
4380220.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about grief, obsession, and love. Sleep to enter dreams, take control of them, and descend into deeper layers where time moves slower. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of a grieving father who created a world frozen in time.

4380350.title: Buckshot Bunny
4380350.short_description: Buckshot Bunny is a single-player, fast-paced 2D action platformer, testing your speed and agility, navigating challenging locations as the cybernetic rabbit, Buck. Run, smash and bullet-jump through hazards and enemies to free your family and find your way back home.

4380730.title: Red Passport: Deported
4380730.short_description: A sequel to the adventure game Red Passport. After being deported from Japan, the hero faces a long journey home to Moscow. With no money or documents, you must hitchhike, ride freight trains, work odd jobs, and solve local problems to survive the road.

4380860.title: Fool King
4380860.short_description: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat!

4381120.title: Virtual Driving School: Trucks
4381120.short_description: Train like a professional HGV driver. Master trucks and buses, manage blind spots and long loads, avoid bridge strikes, navigate level crossings, and operate vehicle-mounted cranes. Real rules, real risks — zero real-world consequences.

4382270.title: 鱼干集团那些事：征途
4382270.short_description: 《Furry Journey in Other World》 IP Furry Anime 2D Role-Playing Visual Novel GameYou will take control of the protagonist — HuiYuan — and continue writing the story of Yugan Group in this sci-fi world. Embark on an epic journey together with your friends and comrades-in-arms.

4382360.title: Lucky Sip
4382360.short_description: This is a time-management restaurant simulation game with roguelike elements. Master a wide range of tasty drinks, meet all kinds of customers, and learn diverse management skills. Combine your options wisely to conquer both casual stage runs and the rent challenge!

4382680.title: River Drift
4382680.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

4382760.title: EonDeluge
4382760.short_description: Welcome to EonDeluge, a turn-based bullet hell game. Two players take turns. One draws the bullet patterns in real time while the other steers through them; at the end of the round you swap, and it goes on until someone's energy runs out.

4382960.title: Snackrifice
4382960.short_description: Feed your hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. You decide which chaotic curses afflict your run as you overcome the many levels of Purgatory.

4383210.title: Splatt
4383210.short_description: Race your friends to the finish line while carrying a very breakable egg. Throw eggs at the racer ahead, dodge their traps and try not to drop yours. Win Drips, unlock Carties and perk cards, and paint your racer into a masterpiece or a mess.

4383310.title: GraveDiggers
4383310.short_description: Online co-op horror for 1 to 6 undertaker cats. Every day, find the body, drag its coffin across a cursed Louisiana swamp and bury it before sunrise. Skeletons, Lazarites and the midnight mist will try to stop you. Eat cheese whenever you can.

4383780.title: Anomalift
4383780.short_description: Everything is normal. Or is it? Anomalift is a cooperative anomaly-spotting game where observation is your greatest tool. Search each area, and report your findings. One mistake leads you somewhere you were never meant to be.

4384150.title: KUBIKA
4384150.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

4386140.title: Arrow Hell
4386140.short_description: Play as a Magical Arrow and Fight for your Survival in the Space. A fast-paced arcade game packed with relentless and sci-fi enemy waves. Dodge, Attack & Upgrade and stand until the end in this Short & Minimally Designed Action Arena.

4386570.title: Click to Medieval Roguelite
4386570.short_description: Don't want to play a massive complex campaign? Grow your medieval province with just a few clicks, sell your meager hamlet/kingdom then unlock auto hire workers with incremental upgrades for a more idle playstyle, watch your kingdom grow wealthy and powerful with ease.

4387050.title: SCP Tower
4387050.short_description: You were hired as a ranger into National park. Your job? Taking care of Suntop Lookout. However once you get there, ceiling trapdoor is blasted open, showing continuation of Suntop Lookout. Will you enter?

4388690.title: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
4388690.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

4388880.title: Star TD
4388880.short_description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

4389770.title: Deep Breach
4389770.short_description: Fight relentless alien swarms in a top-down action roguelike that blends intense shooting with tower defense. Customize weapons, assemble deadly turrets, unlock HELIOS technology, and push through enemy lines to destroy the alien core.

4394130.title: Unbox the Room 2
4394130.short_description: The cozy unboxing and interior design experience returns — bigger, warmer, and more reactive. From homes to small businesses, each space responds to your choices and reflects its owner’s personality.

4394410.title: Inner Rooms
4394410.short_description: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

4395320.title: Logisticats
4395320.short_description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

4395460.title: Guns, Princess and Braves
4395460.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

4396230.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
4396230.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

4396550.title: Outdraft
4396550.short_description: Lead an esports team in a MOBA discipline, draft heroes, manage players, and guide your organization to championship glory in a strategic autobattler with deep management elements.

4396830.title: Dfiance: Dominance
4396830.short_description: Three worlds at war. Grind ranked, crush enemies, or go for tournament glory. Build your deck, trade skins, play solo or with friends. Three factions, endless strategies. Free to play. Your dominance starts now.

4397360.title: The Flying Feather Shotgun
4397360.short_description: There's tales told about a shootgun that can burst dreams into reality... Well, no, to be honest, it's just a single succubus that illegally entered MacDude's room that tell that. Let's believe her! And off we go to a 2d arena shooter with movement bound to the recoil of your weapons!

4397880.title: ReEvolution Project
4397880.short_description: A singleplayer story-driven horror game set in a desolate post-apocalyptic world. Explore a decaying abandoned house, scavenging for supplies and uncovering fragments of its story. Solve environmental puzzles that challenge your perception, and decide how deep you're willing to dig.

4398250.title: Antiutopia
4398250.short_description: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

4399080.title: PapyPanic
4399080.short_description: Dive into the chaos! Play as an object in a wacky Prop Hunt with friends, or try to survive behind the wheel of a brake-less "Grandpa-mobile" with unforgiving physics. The twist? Your Twitch chat controls the action in real time. Will you survive your viewers?

4399120.title: Smart Train Simulator
4399120.short_description: Take the controls of the classic 81-717 and modern 81-765 on Moscow Metro Line 7. Master authentic cab controls, braking and safety systems, and explore stations and depots on foot. Built on professional train simulator technology.

4399160.title: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
4399160.short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

4399300.title: Bandit Life
4399300.short_description: Build a hideout, gather your gang, and live off what others cannot defend. Explore a medieval world, set ambushes, develop your outlaws, and face the consequences of decisions that could make you the terror of the roads—or bring your entire gang to ruin.

4400550.title: Superheroes Inc: #VictoryLeague
4400550.short_description: As a social media influencer recruited to a team of heroes, can you earn their trust, defend the city, and prove you’re worth more than your follower count? A text-based interactive superhero novel.

4401350.title: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic
4401350.short_description: War erupted over the last Buddha Relic. In the land where Maitreya Bodhisattva is destined to descend and attain Buddhahood, Gesang lost all memory in an air raid. Doubting salvation itself, Gesang met Udum—same fate, rare disease, yet utter faith. They became inseparable as cruel reality closed in—

4401360.title: The Necessary Evil
4401360.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

4401840.title: EPOCH EXPRESS
4401840.short_description: A roguelite action game where you control a train, build and customize deadly wagons, and face enemies that evolve across eras by learning from how you play and how you die.

4401950.title: Indie City Mixtape 2026
4401950.short_description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

4401980.title: Ashes of Darkness
4401980.short_description: Ashes of Darkness is a 2D Soulslike Action RPG set in a dark medieval world. Master fast-paced combat, defeat powerful enemies, collect rare artifacts, and forge your own build as you grow stronger and challenge deadly bosses.

4402040.title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
4402040.short_description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

4402300.title: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
4402300.short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

4402360.title: Mech Support
4402360.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

4402490.title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
4402490.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

4404050.title: The American Dream: Past Due
4404050.short_description: The American Dream: Past Due is a realistic choice-driven sim. Play as a suddenly laid-off middle-aged man keeping up appearances. Balance family finances and emotions while facing mounting bills... Can you get your life back on track before your family falls apart?

4406990.title: Cafe Card
4406990.short_description: Cafe Card is a coffee shop game where you prepare drinks and desserts by creating card combinations and serve them to customers.

4408740.title: Dawn of the West
4408740.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

4410710.title: Fields of Aaru
4410710.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

4411250.title: E.S.D.E
4411250.short_description: Humanity is nearly extinct, and the few who remain have become soulless anomalies. Enter deadly zones, scavenge valuable loot, sell it, and upgrade your gear to investigate the horrors humanity has become.

4411510.title: Incremental Mass Rewritten
4411510.short_description: Watch your mass skyrocket! Incremental Mass Rewritten lets you upgrade, prestige, and unlock cosmic layers of growth. From tiny beginnings to multiverse-scale numbers, it's perfect for anyone who loves exponential progression and optimizing every step of the journey.

4411580.title: Geareo
4411580.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

4412040.title: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive
4412040.short_description: Hijack enemy processes. Steal their kits. A tactical roguelike on a 7×7 grid where every enemy is carrying something you can take lifesteal, defense, entire ability kits. Build from 200+ programs. The system adapts to hunt you. Permadeath. No negotiations.

4412620.title: 日本一周漢字の旅
4412620.short_description: Everyday Japan, in a quiz! Interested in Japan? Don’t miss this! Join Hina-chan for fun Kanji challenges!

4413220.title: Streetball Legends
