4413220.short_description: No rules. No fouls. Just baskets and beatdowns. Team up in co-op or go solo against increasingly tougher opponents in chaotic arcade basketball. Unleash devastating Power Shots, earn game-changing gear, and keep your run alive. Or go PvP and challenge a friend in Versus mode.

4413250.title: Falling Up
4413250.short_description: Falling Up is a 3D adventure game, your goal is to get to the top of the mountain. There will be a lot of challange duration your trip, you have to either beat them, or be sneaky. Don't be frustracted when you fall from the mountain, you are leveling up each time you fall.

4413970.title: DriveLine
4413970.short_description: Return to the track in DriveLine: follow your comeback in the Season Book career, buy and sell used cars, build your garage, and make every car yours with the livery editor. Race circuits, rally stages and drift events in dynamic weather, online or in optional VR.

4414620.title: Book Nook
4414620.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

4415050.title: The Tram
4415050.short_description: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

4416070.title: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
4416070.short_description: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.

4416300.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
4416300.short_description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

4417060.title: Dark Roll 2
4417060.short_description: A physics-driven 3D precision platformer where you roll, bounce, dodge traps, snatch gems, and race against other players’ ghosts through a dark-fantasy gauntlet designed to make “one more try” a deeply questionable life choice.

4418020.title: Deck paper scissors
4418020.short_description: It's rock paper scissors, but as an incremental roguelike deck builder.

4419320.title: Scourge Realms
4419320.short_description: Slay monsters in evil realms inflicted with scourge. Find Majestic Loot, Collect powerful enchanting materials and xp to survive the scourge and obtain god-like power.

4420220.title: Oogie’s Chicken Quest
4420220.short_description: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

4421190.title: Shatterswarm
4421190.short_description: Command Captain Hope's ship in this strategic 2D space game. Build structures, deploy fleets, and manage resources to defend the Citadel against waves of enemies. Combine direct ship combat, tower defense, and base building as you face epic boss battles.

4421670.title: The Kingsward
4421670.short_description: Explore an open-world Sandbox RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

4422000.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
4422000.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

4422260.title: Hakoniwa Electric
4422260.short_description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

4422640.title: PERKS
4422640.short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

4423230.title: Watch Out: Shark!
4423230.short_description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

4423330.title: They're Gonna Get In
4423330.short_description: "They're Gonna Get In" is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

4424220.title: Specshong
4424220.short_description: Cyndi wants you to turn up the volume and paint the town red. Import any song to generate chaotic levels in this intense rhythm shooter. Master absolute free movement, execute precision shots, and destroy the digital static to your favorite beats.

4424600.title: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
4424600.short_description: A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

4424620.title: Parent Printer Driver Simulator
4424620.short_description: Relive the anguish of being your family's IT support! Scroll, paint, ski, type, and search through a wonderfully ugly internet of the past. Find the best, and least virus filled, printer driver for whatever kind of cheap off-brand printer your parents have. Or just play the skiing game...

4424710.title: Cryotank Rogue
4424710.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

4424760.title: Hellcrown
4424760.short_description: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

4424970.title: Another Map Simulator
4424970.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

4425090.title: DOOBAK
4425090.short_description: While you were sleeping, a blizzard buried the entire village in snow. Now you need to evacuate alone or with a team of up to 4 players! Dig tunnels, scavenge for supplies, warm up by campfires, and try to call for rescue.

4425790.title: Static Maw
4425790.short_description: You take the night shift at StaticCore, an antenna station built over a sealed mine. The old mining machines never left. Keep the station running, track them on radar, drive them back with radio waves, and find out what the antennas are really listening for.

4425810.title: Pirate Royalty
4425810.short_description: A free to play fantasy pirate MMORPG where you choose one of four classes, assign your own stats, learn skills, hunt rare loot, forge gems into gear and enter timed dungeons with other players. Every advantage is earned through play, with no power for sale.

4426010.title: Seven Nights Ghost 2
4426010.short_description: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

4426150.title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
4426150.short_description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

4426260.title: Hidden Shore
4426260.short_description: After many years, you have finally reached this mysterious place. Now, will you be able to uncover all its secrets and finally find what you have been seeking for so long? Explore a secret island, solve puzzles and riddles to uncover the truth.

4427620.title: Tilelings!
4427620.short_description: A chaotic battle of wits with friends!? A fresh new competitive party game combining puzzles and action! Online multiplayer for up to 4 players! Have a blast with your friends in a variety of game modes that test both your puzzle-solving and action skills!!

4427720.title: Pigs On Wings
4427720.short_description: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.

4427770.title: The Falling Skies
4427770.short_description: Explore a cursed forest where the past refuses to die. As a new forest ranger, uncover the truth behind a forgotten tragedy, navigate shifting paths, and face mysterious distortions that blur the line between reality and nightmare.

4427980.title: THE WITCH'S GRIMOIRE
4427980.short_description: An atmospheric experience in the dark and eerie world of classic fairy tales, progressing solely through your choices. No complex mechanics; just sit back and focus on the story. Make the right decisions to avoid danger and try to survive the twisted endings of these tales.

4428070.title: Ram Fights
4428070.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

4428590.title: Screams Echo
4428590.short_description: Screams Echo is a dark top-down action roguelike where you must fight through hordes of mutants in a procedurally generated underground complex. Find powerful items that can completely change the course of a run, combine them with weapons and hero abilities, and build insane synergies that turn desperate survival into total chaos.

4428800.title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
4428800.short_description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

4429290.title: The Incentive Program
4429290.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite set within a surreal corporate nightmare. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos as you fight to escape the program.

4429900.title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest
4429900.short_description: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest is an exploration adventure game. Reveal the house of Detectif Poirry as a robot vacuum cleaner, bump its inhabitants for stories, and clean your way to victory.

4430020.title: Hamsteria
4430020.short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

4430350.title: 幻想乡毋宁
4430350.short_description: Grow crops, build a home, and venture into Gensokyo in this 3D Touhou Project fan game. Explore the Human Village, get to know familiar characters, and combine everyday life with journeys and action combat beyond your fields.

4430580.title: But in briefs
4430580.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a minimalist platformer.

4431100.title: Moonlight Apothecary
4431100.short_description: Brew concoctions, befriend Ravensport's many fantasy inhabitants, and unravel the mystery of the Evernight as the newest apprentice of the Moonlight Apothecary.

4431230.title: Super Chasm Hunter
4431230.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

4431610.title: PSYKOS
4431610.short_description: A co-op horror where your voice can get you killed, monsters can break into your hiding spots, and captured players must be rescued before it’s too late.

4432100.title: polymorphite
4432100.short_description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

4432150.title: Soulstonia
4432150.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this single-player 2.5D fantasy RPG. Control them individually, as a party, or set goals for them to gather, craft, and fight on their own. Explore five regions in a procedural world, complete quests, train 20+ skills, and summon an army. Free to play.

4432380.title: Tsuki Journey
4432380.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

4432710.title: Where Giants Fall
4432710.short_description: Fight your way from desperate survival to overwhelming power in a 3D fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. Combine weapons and active abilities into devastating builds, outmaneuver swarms and bring down towering giants. Take on greater danger for richer rewards.

4433020.title: Blood List
4433020.short_description: "Blood List" is a hardcore action game specialized in boss battles. As the "Contractor," you will eliminate every formidable foe standing in your way.

4433030.title: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma
4433030.short_description: Emma starts journalism school: new friends, awkward first meetings and maybe her first love. Listen to voiced dialogue, click any word and learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese or Turkish inside a living story. The free demo is out now.

4433380.title: ChessSnake
4433380.short_description: Chess... chess never changes. How much can you do?! It's time for something new - a combination of chess and snake!

4433410.title: The Cave of Doubt
4433410.short_description: Lovecraftian horror game with elements of psychological and survival horror genres. Where Allen is lost in a cave and is forced to face horrors beyond his imagination. Survive the cave, solve mysteries, reveal the lore lost in time.

4433420.title: OpTek
4433420.short_description: An interactive co-op repair game with horror elements. Up to 4 players will work together to survive routine maintenance sessions conducted in chambers that store dangerous entities. Work together to survive and bring the chamber online before certain death...

4433430.title: FLOWSXTY
4433430.short_description: FLOWSXTY is a minimal action game. A brutal trench runner where you WASD between four lanes.

4433460.title: Is This the Way
4433460.short_description: Is This The Way is a chaotic 1–4 player online co-op survival game. Escape adaptive robot enemies, conquer physics-based parkour, and respawn to try again as teamwork turns into hilarious sabotage in unpredictable, fast-paced matches.

4433720.title: Tartaria: Frozen Frontier
4433720.short_description: Lead the ruling clan of a confederation in early-medieval Siberia. Develop cities and crafts, manage specialized vassals, prepare supplies for the harsh winter, and defend the entire confederation in this turn-based survival strategy game.

4434030.title: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War
4434030.short_description: Gunpowder vs Samurai: A Tower Defense + Auto Battler. Wield the Ming dynasty's cluster bombs, rockets, drones, and cannons against pirate fleets from the sea. Build formations, set up artillery, can you replicate Qi Jiguang's legendary 0:2000 kill-to-loss ratio?

4434040.title: Unseen - Someone
4434040.short_description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

4434200.title: REMNANT: Rebirth
4434200.short_description: Explore the silent echoes of a fallen open-world in REMNANT: Rebirth. Navigate lush, overgrown ruins where nature has reclaimed its throne and zombies lurk in the shadows. Master survival, uncover secrets of a lost civilization, and endure the challenges of an untamed post-apocalyptic era.

4434240.title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
4434240.short_description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

4434360.title: The Creator: Live Together
4434360.short_description: The Creator: Live Together — a world built for creativity. Take on jobs, build your career, or create freely in Sandbox Mode. Design dream homes, craft cozy spaces, and play with friends.

4434480.title: Applied Shamanism
4434480.short_description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

4434510.title: The Old Parish
4434510.short_description: A cozy top-down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Sow and harvest the family farm, mow and bale the hay, raise cattle and sheep and fish the lake. Then head into a town where every door opens, for Sunday Mass, a pint at O'Brien's and a hand of Twenty-Five.

4434530.title: 9 Layers of Hell
4434530.short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you and your party go?

4434630.title: Fancy Farm Brawl
4434630.short_description: Farm by day, fight by night! Fancy Farm Brawl blends top-down action combat, tower-defense challenges, light farming, and a quirky island adventure. Plant crops, earn coins, meet colorful residents, overcome obstacle courses, and unleash powerful attacks to defend your home on Qilin Island.

4434640.title: The Long Mine
4434640.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

4434700.title: Postponed: Game Dev Management Roguelite
4434700.short_description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

4434770.title: We’re In Trouble
4434770.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

4434980.title: Don't Wake the Queen
4434980.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

4435040.title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
4435040.short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

4435100.title: Incredigble
4435100.short_description: Uncover dinosaur fossils as you mine through rocks, earn money and upgrade your abilities! Fill your museum with your discoveries to reach the goal of becoming world renowned!

4436130.title: Protect the President
4436130.short_description: A night-time tower defense auto-battler where you protect the President at all costs. Draft cards to deploy defenses, switch to night vision or thermal, take over a gun and fire it yourself, and grow your command between runs.

4436410.title: Thousands of Chroma
4436410.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

4436520.title: Zebulon 3D
4436520.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.

4436550.title: Hey, Focus!
4436550.short_description: Hey, Focus! is a productivity game featuring light visual novel elements. Xiaoning, a girl who loves gaming and anime, is here to accompany you while you work and study. Complete focus timers to unlock over 200 voiced interactions, personalized outfits, and perhaps... a few hidden secrets?

4437050.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes
4437050.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

4437310.title: The Oath of Runeveil
4437310.short_description: An online-enabled 3D action RPG set in a vast world to explore. Centered on real-time battles and character progression, it can be enjoyed both solo and in cooperative play.

4437580.title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
4437580.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

4437650.title: Stinker Golf
4437650.short_description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

4440440.title: FLEETING ESCAPE
4440440.short_description: FLEETING ESCAPE is a wave-based survival horror game where every choice could be your last. You must escape to a different island at the end of each wave to survive. Each island has monsters, items, and loot to be discovered.

4440650.title: KAGE
4440650.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

4442220.title: The Altar Boy Adventures
4442220.short_description: Step into the shoes of Józef, a young man and altar server in a Polish village. Repair electronic equipment, prepare the sacristy for Mass, and help your neighbors. Experience a unique and moving adventure centered around liturgical service.

4442580.title: Chaos Rune : Heroes
4442580.short_description: Chaos Rune: Heroes is a stat-based action game. Can you clear it in the shortest time by positioning yourself, observing enemy positions, and using attacks to one-shot enemies.

4442750.title: Void Hunters
4442750.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

4443330.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
4443330.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

4443440.title: NS Drive Simulator
4443440.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

4443610.title: PredaDeck
4443610.short_description: PredaDeck is a trading card game that transforms the brutal yet exquisite real-world food chain into a competitive strategic duel. Here, knowledge is your sharpest claw, and strategy is your only law of survival.

4443820.title: Silentia
4443820.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

4444210.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
4444210.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

4444330.title: Quackoban
4444330.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

4445180.title: VeriData Inc.
4445180.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

4446070.title: Splorbit
4446070.short_description: Splorbit is a physics-driven horde survival game. Bounce, split and explode balls through swarming enemies, build a loadout from upgrade cards, break the gold off named bosses, and survive 20 minutes per world across 5 worlds. Solo or local co-op for up to 4 players.

4446990.title: Menhera Maiden
4446990.short_description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri’ Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

4447620.title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
4447620.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

4448050.title: TORION:Escape
4448050.short_description: TORION:Escape is a fast-paced parkour game where nothing stops you from going forward and Escaping the simulation in record time. Run, jump, and control the environment alongside a variety of relaxing drum and bass tracks playing in the background.

4448570.title: STILL BOUND
4448570.short_description: A weekend trip ends on a mountain road. You wake in the wreck, alone, deep in a forest where every trail promises help. A story-driven, first-person psychological horror game about searching for rescue - and finding out what answers.

4449470.title: The Outer Islands
4449470.short_description: Explore a quarantined island chain and an automated hospital abandoned for twenty years. Investigate a returning signal, read the evidence left behind, solve mechanical systems, and evade machines that still believe they have patients.

4450000.title: Kaori
4450000.short_description: Kaori is a first-person puzzle and adventure game. Explore ancient ruins on a sun-drenched archipelago and uncover the many mysteries of a lost civilization.

4451340.title: Head Full Of Zombi
4451340.short_description: 1948, post‑war England. On Holy Island, a buried alien artifact known as The Eye corrupts prisoners, monks, and guards into flesh‑hungry ghouls. Technology fails, chaos reigns. You crash‑land among the wreckage—supplies scattered, hordes closing in. Survive or be consumed.

4451470.title: Traffic Monster
4451470.short_description: Traffic Monster is a fast-paced endless runner! Dodge heavy traffic, collect power-ups, and customize your dream car. Challenge real players in online multiplayer, place bets, and survive the chaos!

4451860.title: Dino Age: Survive the Eras
4451860.short_description: Explore one island across three prehistoric eras in a single-player 2D survival RPG. Build your camp, craft better gear and hatch prehistoric companions. Face dangerous creatures and heal fractures in time to open the way forward.

4451910.title: NGC-404: Fractured Sector
4451910.short_description: Lead a small fleet in a cut-off 2D space sector where trade, colonies, fuel, supplies and battles decide who survives. Build your faction, explore unknown systems, develop colonies, fit ships and shape a living simulated galaxy alone or with friends.

4452120.title: Jingle Balls
4452120.short_description: Santa is injured and the gift list is gone. Jingle Balls is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Search each house for clues, choose the right gift, and leave it without being seen. House layouts change between visits. Face different enemies and use a range of items.

4452700.title: STAGE TOUR
4452700.short_description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

4452890.title: Caution Ahead: Part 3
4452890.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

4453540.title: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
4453540.short_description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

4454020.title: Fort Synergy Demo
4454020.short_description: A funny co-op tower defense game where you and your friends need to work together to defend yourselves against all the incoming waves of monsters! Decide whether to roam the map or stay near the towers!

4454280.title: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
4454280.short_description: A first-person archive work simulator. Sort through boxes of documents, arrange files on the shelves, and bring order to the archive by following its filing rules. Handle stacks of records, keep each section organized, and enjoy the satisfying process of restoring order step by step.

4456110.title: Planet No More
4456110.short_description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

4456460.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
4456460.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

4456670.title: Thieving Together
4456670.short_description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

4456740.title: FishInc
4456740.short_description: A minimalist incremental fishing game about mastering the sea. Time your strikes, chain perfect hits, build your boat, and design powerful trophy loadouts to survive increasingly chaotic runs.

4457140.title: WARONOMY
4457140.short_description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

4457420.title: Bermuda Bastion
4457420.short_description: Survive 33 days in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle! Build triangular structures to defend against malevolent squares, pentagons, and other geometric monsters. In this chaotic city-builder roguelike, every mistake pulls your Bastion closer to the depths.

4457900.title: GearGrave
4457900.short_description: 2D side-scrolling strategy game. Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

4457980.title: Spurfall
4457980.short_description: Restore life to a forgotten Wild West valley. Rebuild ruined settlements, bridges, watchtowers, farms, and cabins. bring back settlers, defend against bandits, and transform abandoned lands into thriving frontier towns.

4458000.title: Pull It Together
4458000.short_description: Pull your weight and your wagon as a crew of up to 4 on this cooperative adventure. Gather supplies, keep your wagon rolling, and band together to face unpredictable events before the storm closes in! Each journey will have different trails, different troubles, but the same trusty wagon.

4458040.title: Ninpo Renju
4458040.short_description: Link four to unleash ninpo. Link five for a chance to strike with ninsatsu. NinpoRenju blends five-in-a-row tactics, ninja combat, and roguelike builds. Collect special pieces, synthesize your deck, and challenge friends online. Five in a row is only the beginning.

4458220.title: Little Beast in the Big Maze
4458220.short_description: A fantastical, atmospheric Metroidvania platformer where you jump, fight, and expand your abilities to escape your exile and confront the beastly Queen who banished you. But will this fairy-tale end with you becoming a hero, or a beast?

4458340.title: Quiet Men: Mafia Simulator
4458340.short_description: A 1970s mafia simulator. Start with a back room, one street corner and a few friends, and build a Family the Commission has to respect. Every choice is remembered: men earn nicknames, debts come due, and someone is always talking to the feds.

4459150.title: The Legend of Wijaya
4459150.short_description: Experience a story-rich, classic 2D action RPG steeped in 13th-century Java. Play as Raden Wijaya using fluid hack-and-slash combat, archery, and magic. Outsmart the traitors and invading Mongols and forge the largest empire in Southeast Asia.

4459230.title: 字走三国
4459230.short_description: Hidden within the words lies a chilling killing intent; the chess pieces radiate a boundless fighting spirit. Tiny words weave the Three Kingdoms narrative, yet aspire to contain profound emotions.

4459420.title: Moonlight Cornelia
4459420.short_description: Akane Riho’s peaceful student life changes when she awakens as the magical girl Moonlight Cornelia. Switch between school exploration and real-time combo battles, customize skills and crests, bond with companions, and stop the Demon Queen’s revival.

4459510.title: The Nightwal Legacy
4459510.short_description: A first-person supernatural thriller where you explore a manor overtaken by darkness. Wield a mysterious power to confront an ancient evil, unravel the truth, and save your brother.

4459630.title: Radical Tower Defense
4459630.short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

4459930.title: The Aether Project TD
4459930.short_description: Place and upgrade towers to defend your objective. Use abilities and the terrain to hold back advancing enemies.

4459990.title: Screen Survivors
4459990.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

4460050.title: Nexus Survivors
4460050.short_description: In Nexus Survivors, you don't get a pre-made fireball handed to you. You build it yourself — from cards that determine how it moves, what it does, and what happens when it hits. Every spell in your arsenal is your own creation.

4460510.title: HOLER!
4460510.short_description: Dig, dig, and DIG! One meter deeper, one second longer. A relentless mining action game where you plunge into an endless underground world! Your only rival is your past self. The eternal challenge to shatter your own "Best Record" begins now!

4461460.title: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
4461460.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

4461560.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
4461560.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

4461590.title: Roidgrinder
4461590.short_description: Origin story of a famous roidgrinder. Mine, upgrade, trade and explore in this incremental space mining adventure. You'll interact with the ship's systems through a CLI/terminal. Crossbreed of 2D arcade, lightweight simulation and some idler elements. Note: KEYBOARD REQUIRED.

4461680.title: Bad Goons
4461680.short_description: Blast through cover, carve trenches, and build massive fortifications to dominate the battlefield. Adapt to ever-changing environments and discover new tactics with every match. Outsmart your enemies with pure War-IQ. No more gooning around! It’s time to join the fight.

4462080.title: Hidden Streets
4462080.short_description: Find cats and hidden objects in illustrated streets full of detail.

4462130.title: LOVE D3ATH LOVE
4462130.short_description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

4462580.title: BLIGHTEN
4462580.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

4462720.title: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
4462720.short_description: A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.” Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

4462770.title: Planet Sweep Company
4462770.short_description: Clean up the danger zone on an undeveloped planet and find hidden landmines! Planet Sweep Company is a game that brings the familiar fun of Minesweeper into 3D space. Analyze the number hints to deduce landmines, plant flags to clear dangerous zones, and build up your achievements!

4462830.title: One Billion Ducks
4462830.short_description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

4463500.title: DesktopSaurs
4463500.short_description: Turn your desktop into a dinosaur battleground! Defeat waves of enemies, earn rewards, and create devastating builds in this idle RPG. Adapt your strategy, defeat powerful bosses, and conquer prehistoric eras. All while you relax, work, or browse the web!

4463630.title: Chicken Must Fry
4463630.short_description: Chicken Must Fry is a survivor-like game where you play as a raw chicken refusing to be fried, wiping out monsters from the ruthless Frying Empire. Combine various skills and items, upgrade your characters, and survive the endless waves of enemies!

4464020.title: Tears of Sulfuria
4464020.short_description: Tears of Sulfuria is an emotional visual novel about two sisters in a dark fantasy world that rejects them. Marília and Adka must survive at any cost—and their choices may scar Sulfuria itself. Sacrifice yourself, lose your sanity, and do the unforgivable to move forward.

4464250.title: Fantasy Mountains
4464250.short_description: Paper Mountain is the first chapter in Fantasy Mountains. A casual, friendly, single‑player VR climbing game. Enter a fantasy paper world. Meet and interact with the mountain creatures along the path. Collect useful and less useful items. Find your way to the mountaintop.

4464270.title: Beyond the Cradle
4464270.short_description: Build factories on tiny planets where every part rides a belt you lay yourself. Launch rockets with cargo to eight more worlds and assemble, module by module, a stellar engine to take your star away before the wave arrives. No enemies: pure logistics.

4464400.title: Tyrants Must Fall
4464400.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

4464410.title: Dark Horizon
4464410.short_description: Dark Horizon is a single-player survival FPS game that takes place in Russia. After a near-fatal accident, your squad-mates have been killed, and you are deserted in the middle of a deadly conflict fueled by the city's government. Will you escape, or choose to thrive in the city until it falls?

4464430.title: Basement Server Simulator
4464430.short_description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

4464860.title: Sunny Hollow
4464860.short_description: Move to a magical city to live with your grandmother and make it your home. Explore vibrant districts, build relationships with 100+ villagers who remember how you treat them, help with errands and jobs, fish at the waterways, customize your home, and discover the stories throughout Sunny Hollow.

4464970.title: Astral Bloom
4464970.short_description: Grow a living alien world in this incremental base-builder. Cultivate strange plants, command loyal wisps, and reshape the sky with powerful wishes. Automate and expand your ecosystem as you uncover lost memories. As your sanctuary grows, will you stay... or leave in search of something more?

4465410.title: MMA Career Simulator
4465410.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

4465590.title: I Want To Be a Child
4465590.short_description: Family is the most precious thing you have. No matter what, right

4465830.title: Confessional: Reality TV Manager
4465830.short_description: A reality TV production management game. Cast, create or download contestants, design your season, and watch drama unfold in the most complex relationship sim ever created. Scout hidden talent, manage moods, watch challenges play out, and survive dramatic tribal councils. Build your franchise.

4466110.title: Narcissist Tail
4466110.short_description: You are a player who was called upon to help a strange wolf family escape. Figure out why they were kidnapped. Find hidden secrets with an in-game screenshot system. Battle monsters in bullet hell combat. But most importantly, find a way to out together.

4466120.title: Min5 Min - Party Edition
4466120.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

4466140.title: EIDOL
4466140.short_description: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

4466380.title: Army of the Potomac
4466380.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

4466430.title: Caspian's Quest
4466430.short_description: The world of Caspian’s Quest is built around travel. Your wagon is more than transportation — it is your storage, shelter, lifeline, and symbol of progress. Preparation matters. The right meal, tool, potion, or crafted item can make the difference between a safe journey or an untimely end.

4466800.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
4466800.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

4467600.title: Z Drive
4467600.short_description: Drive, explore, search for resources, and craft! And drive! Do it for as long as you can! This FPS takes place in a rough world after a zombie attack. Prepare your wheeled fortress for every possible adventure! Explore the dead world and search for the remnants of civilization.

4467690.title: Susia - Wolf Life Simulator
4467690.short_description: Live the fun life of a wolf! Find a mate, start a pack, hunt together and survive in the wild! Befriend other packs or defeat them to become the sole wolf pack. Adventure through the island and settle down or keep moving, it's all up to you!

4470890.title: Expedition Idle
4470890.short_description: An idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters!

4471080.title: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王?
4471080.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

4474590.title: HUSH
4474590.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

4475320.title: 你离开之后
4475320.short_description: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

4475520.title: SKINFACE
4475520.short_description: SKINFACE is a gruesome horror-thriller where you skin strangers alive to create the perfect disguise. Evade the police, earn your target’s trust and carry out the hit. Knock knock!

4475640.title: Veil of Despair - Episode 1
4475640.short_description: Veil of Despair is an episodic psychological horror series set in a fractured mirror world born from grief and suffering. Episode 1: Death's Reach is completely free and kicks off a descent into loss, trauma and raw emotional pain through suffocating atmosphere and intense psychological tension.

4475950.title: System Status: SuperCritical
4475950.short_description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

4475960.title: Hold & Advance
4475960.short_description: 2D action sandbox about exploring an underground world, crafting and tactically defending alien stations. Build turrets, combine modules and repel enemy waves to unlock powerful upgrades that radically change your playstyle.

4476390.title: Lost Camp
4476390.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

4478270.title: PWC Simulator
4478270.short_description: PWC Simulator is a jet ski simulator with online racing, freestyle, and mod support. Ride stand-up and sit-down skis with simulated water, hull and rider weight. Customize your rider and ski, race buoy courses or freeride in surf and flatwater, or flip and do tricks on flip skis.

4479090.title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
4479090.short_description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

4480140.title: KILL BREACH
4480140.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

4481140.title: Synthwave Dice TD
4481140.short_description: Roll the dice, defend your tower, build your deck! Synthwave Dice TD is a neon-drenched roguelike tower defense where every roll matters. Demo: Pure roguelike TD action. Full Game: Adds deckbuilding with 5 playable cards that manipulate your dice fate!

4481230.title: Terra: The Voracious
4481230.short_description: "Terra: The Voracious", also known as "TTV", is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat to defeat and escape stomachs, pouches, and much more!

4482610.title: Skatebound
4482610.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

4482750.title: Tower Of Hope
4482750.short_description: 30 years ago, heroes sealed an Evil God within the Tower of Hope. Now the barrier is broken. You are an adventurer seeking glory, but the truth of what really happened waits inside.

4482970.title: Overbooked
4482970.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

4483320.title: Lost in Art
4483320.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

4483400.title: MR MAGEBOY
4483400.short_description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage opening a Rescue Ranch for lost Familiars. Gather resources, upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and turn a profit to help your village thrive.

4483470.title: Outer Empires 2
4483470.short_description: A top-down space MMO where every action shapes a persistent, player-driven galaxy. Trade, fight, explore, and colonise as you build your empire. Run supply chains, wage faction wars, and customize ships in a living economy driven by real supply and demand.

4483920.title: TAMITOS: Tale of Understanding
4483920.short_description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

4484810.title: Winter Whiskers
4484810.short_description: In this short, cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

4484990.title: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
4484990.short_description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

4485060.title: HAE Stack
4485060.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

4485080.title: Flow - The Tidal Whispers
4485080.short_description: A challenging narrative platformer built for the NES, where kindness shapes the journey.

4485120.title: Nordfolk
4485120.short_description: A text-based management game set in the Norse Viking Age, focused not on war, but on peaceful colony building. Assign villagers to tasks, build production chains, and stockpile food and firewood before winter sets in. Survive, found a saga, and return stronger.

4485320.title: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
4485320.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

4486120.title: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3
4486120.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

4486230.title: Dig n Fight
4486230.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

4487050.title: Find the Ojisan
4487050.short_description: You must not overlook coworkers hiding to work overtime—a surreal horror clocking-out simulator where you try to leave a strange office safely, day after day.

4487320.title: LastRoll
4487320.short_description: Post-apocalyptic tactical roguelike. Assemble a crew of 4, roll dice to fuel your skills and fight your way to the final boss. One lost battle means starting over. No cards. No mercy. Just dice.

4487810.title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
4487810.short_description: Forget classic breakout games. In Shroomanoid, you are the projectile. Control the frantic flight of a giant mushroom, smash enemies into a bloody pulp with precise ricochets, and stack insane combinations of abilities.

4488080.title: Infinigama
4488080.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

4488270.title: RelicFairy
4488270.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

4488460.title: worm_game_2
4488460.short_description: Currently, a point-&-click, silly tone game where you wrangle jellyfish as an axolotl using just the mouse curser & left-click; with other sandbox-lite'esc features like dragging objects/entities around, NPC-to-player dialog, &, of course, blowing bubbles :0 o o o x :)

4488990.title: Carmilla : Crimson Moon
4488990.short_description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

4489630.title: This is Not a Snake Game
4489630.short_description: ▶When the classic Snake Game becomes self-aware, eating apples is no longer enough! Help this little snake exploit bugs to escape the game and roam your desktop. Collect adorable outfits and dress up its long, wiggly tail! (⦿ʌ⦿)

4490840.title: Lurking
4490840.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

4491050.title: The Comyths
4491050.short_description: The Comyths is an action arcade and visual novel hybrid starring six Scholars with unique cosmic powers. Uncover their intertwined story, master their abilities, and chase the perfect S-Rank.

4492420.title: Out of Body
4492420.short_description: James wakes up one morning—and his physical body is gone. Even worse, no one seems to notice he’s disappeared. After drifting through 1993 San Francisco for months unseen, he eventually stumbles onto what he must do to get his body back and live a life worth knowing.

4494730.title: DEATH CASINO
4494730.short_description: DEATH CASINO is an adrenaline-pumping blend of tabletop strategy and Russian Roulette. Duel the deranged Glassman in an ever-escalating battle of speed and wit, where each round brings in more mayhem and strategy to master. Shoot, stab, and drink your way out of the Death Casino!

4497500.title: Conquering Other Planets Idle - COPI
4497500.short_description: A deep idle RPG where numbers go up, gear gets weirdly strong, and prestige when you want to be stronger or weaker. Build your permanent wardrobe across prestiges, pick your gear to start a run with, but be prepared to upgrade.

4498560.title: Green Inferno
4498560.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

4498670.title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
4498670.short_description: “Wonder Air: Lunara’s Adventure” is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

4499240.title: Count The Draw
4499240.short_description: Count The Draw is a time-loop western mystery where every decision, conversation, and discovery could change your chances of surviving the final duel. You have twelve hours. Explore the town, learn its secrets, and prepare for the man waiting for you at sunset.

4500280.title: Hecatomb
4500280.short_description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

4500310.title: Staatio
4500310.short_description: Real-time territory conquest. Drag to send troops, swallow the map region by region, forge alliances and break them. Play solo against bots or invite friends over Steam or LAN.

4500520.title: Tide Fall
4500520.short_description: Explore dangerous islands, build and defend your base, sail the seas, and raid rival crews in this open-world pirate survival game.

4500530.title: Raging Blasters 2
4500530.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

4500620.title: Subclidean
4500620.short_description: Subclidean is a puzzle based single-player where you traverse and navigate infinite worlds, solving non-euclidean based puzzles and uncover the truths about the secrets of why you are here and how to escape.

4500800.title: Goblins for Good
4500800.short_description: A Warcraft-inspired incremental game — grow a goblin army while raising money for charity! Upgrade your goblins, merge them into massive units, and unleash comedic, wholesome chaos! 90% of profits are donated to causes like The Alzheimer's Foundation of America and Parkkinson’s Foundation.

4501650.title: Spinbot
4501650.short_description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

4501800.title: AL-SARAB
4501800.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game inspired by Silent Hill set in a distorted Gulf neighborhood, where familiar places turn hostile and every alley hides something wrong.

4501960.title: HAIGLA
4501960.short_description: Confined to a wheelchair, explore a hospital pulled into a distorted world beneath reality. A slow psychological horror focused on exploration, tension, and the unsettling atmosphere of this place.

4502050.title: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
4502050.short_description: Retire in the Fairy Mountains is a Chinese-style farming game that integrates planting, fishing,cooking, mining and free building. Players take on the role of a farmer at the foot of the Immortal Mountain, unlock various interesting items and build their own world.

4502060.title: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles
4502060.short_description: "Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reshape the boundary between two intertwined worlds to reach the goal. Turn characters into terrain to create paths, but every change affects both sides of the world. Use logic, shifting gravity, and creative thinking to solve complex puzzles.

4502660.title: Homeguard
4502660.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

4502680.title: Monsters Awaiting Parcels
4502680.short_description: Parcels arrive every day — along with those who want to claim them. Find the parcels, make decisions, and don’t make mistakes, because if something goes wrong, the consequences can be… unpleasant.

4502760.title: Beeline
4502760.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this base building horde-survival roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue and hatch unique bees, build your Hive, and retake your bee empire.

4502910.title: Devils on the Moon Pinball
4502910.short_description: A classic-style Creature Collecting Pinball game based on old school masterpieces with modernized gameplay. Pixel-crafted in full monochromatic glory.

4503230.title: The Letter
4503230.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

4504240.title: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars）
4504240.short_description: Dada Dazhan is a casual real-time strategy game. No frantic micromanagement—just focus on your troop formations and city management. Grab a cup of coffee and watch these little cartoon soldiers charge into battle for you.

4504300.title: PixelWehr
4504300.short_description: Shoot down incoming missiles before they tear apart your pixel city, where every pixel can be destroyed. Draw your own buildings and missiles, arrange them into story acts with your own dialogue, and publish it all to the Workshop.

4504350.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
4504350.short_description: A point-and-click mystery game. Search for the truth in 26 days, playing as two different characters, in a town during 1907.

4504610.title: Paralegal
4504610.short_description: Jump into the stress of the working world, as [Law firm's name here]'s newest Paralegal with this 2d side-scroller! Do important and fulfilling tasks, such as bringing coffee, sorting decades old files and letting a client scream at you, all while the clock is ticking in the Background.

4504650.title: Bone Bazaar
4504650.short_description: This is a Sword And Sandals inspired Turn-based arena RPG. Play a skeleton gladiator in the Greek underworld: pick one action per round, shatter enemy armor, forge and enchant weapons, cheer up a crowd of ghosts. Beat 4 arenas and 4 bosses to face Hades, who swore the winner goes free.

4504730.title: 澄心大学
4504730.short_description: 《澄心大学》是一款校园题材剧情向视觉小说。在鲜活而平静的大学日常中，走近四位拥有不同故事的女主角，并通过选择与分支推动人物关系，走向属于你的青春结局。

4504880.title: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
4504880.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

4504970.title: AetherCycle
4504970.short_description: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.

4505100.title: Aliens Go Home ReRun
4505100.short_description: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

4505140.title: Starting a Village from Zero
4505140.short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

4505360.title: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball
4505360.short_description: Mass Edge is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer that challenges your perception of movement, space, and timing. Built around a unique physics-based rolling mechanic, players must navigate intricate 3D environments by carefully controlling momentum, balance, and spatial awareness.

4505410.title: Crystal Core
4505410.short_description: Incremental mining game about mining resources, digging up artifacts and upgrading your powers to obliterate everything.

4506170.title: Breath of Digital God
4506170.short_description: Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditative bullet hell. Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music. Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

4506540.title: The Final Lane
4506540.short_description: The Final Lane is a 3D Deckbuilding Roguelite about Bowling in Hell where the BALLS ARE THE CARDS! Draft a sinner-gistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle other sinners as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

4507060.title: Vanguard Valiants
4507060.short_description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

4507460.title: Static Line
4507460.short_description: Take control of an airborne mecha and fight your way home in a side-view action roguelite. Break through enemy lines, defend key positions, and turn the tide alongside allied forces—then rebuild your machine with interchangeable parts, weapons, and movement styles.

4507790.title: NETRUN
4507790.short_description: With dual grappling hooks in hand, swing, thrust, and dash your way to victory in this fast, momentum-based precision platformer packed with traps, enemies, and physics-based challenges.

4507800.title: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜
4507800.short_description: 『DARK・PLANETARIUM』PLANETARIUM×HORROR GAME.Girl &deformed head get lost in a dark planetarium an a dying planet and travel through space. 「Don't forget. This planet」It features antique pixel art with a space theme.

4507990.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
4507990.short_description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

4508050.title: Undead Yet Again
4508050.short_description: You are patient zero. Punch humans. Spread the undead. Mutate your zombie horde into an unstoppable vessel of apocalypse. And then do it all over again.

4508220.title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
4508220.short_description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

4509620.title: Ovis Mollis
4509620.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

4509640.title: NANOTINKER
4509640.short_description: Nanotinker is an isometric 3D plateformer. Use your tools and your mind to evolve in an abstract universe that blends known plateformer and puzzle features. Unriddle environmental puzzles, progress and outsmart traps to unravel a mysterious story.

4509920.title: Sunrise Isles
4509920.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

4510450.title: Call into the Hollow : [ 2300 ]
4510450.short_description: HELIX — a communication device connected to the future. On the other end of the line was a girl who had lost her memories, still fighting all alone. There are no choices. Speak into your microphone to warn her of danger, guide her actions, and keep her going.

4510990.title: Ward Zero
4510990.short_description: Enter a chilling psychological horror solo or with up to 4 co-op investigators. Track a missing persons case through twisting mazes, tense puzzles, and hidden evidence. Uncover dark experiments, confront hostile entities, and fight to survive as routine turns deadly.

4511570.title: HOLO-KINGDOM
4511570.short_description: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.

4511810.title: Idle Slot Machine
4511810.short_description: Build a bustling pixel-art casino in this idle management game. Hire monkeys to spin your slots, combine machines and chain reactions, shape your skill tree, and prestige for lasting progress. Collect cosmetics and take on challenges beyond the casino floor.

4512090.title: Scuffed Stick Arena
4512090.short_description: Top down 2D 'stick arena' type shooter. Keyboard keys to move, get a weapon and click to aim and shoot!

4512320.title: Stonecall
4512320.short_description: Stonecall is a permadeath action roguelike where every room tests your skill. Dodge, reposition, and time your shots while building powerful synergies to survive the deadly challenges of the Stone Vault.

4512860.title: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2
4512860.short_description: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.

4513180.title: Don't Drop The Ball
4513180.short_description: Don't Drop the Ball is a 1-4 player co-op game about keeping a beach ball in the air as you race through checkpoints together. Punch the ball, make desperate saves, and whack your friends when they get in the way. Race the clock, climb the leaderboard, and remember, DON'T. DROP. THE. BALL.

4513280.title: POK
4513280.short_description: Step into the arena where the Sun and Moon were born. POK is a 3D arcade sports game that blends competitive gameplay with fighting mechanics, inspired by the ancient Mesoamerican ball game. Compete in 1v1 and 2v2 matches where timing, positioning, and teamwork define victory. Every hit matters.

4513350.title: God's Game
4513350.short_description: A young woman is reborn as a princess in a fantasy world. Haunted by memories of her past, she feels out of place and detached, but at least there is peace... until the death game begins once again.

4513540.title: Pure College Football
4513540.short_description: Build your college football dynasty and compete for control. Master NIL recruiting, develop your coaching staff, and manage demanding boosters. Play solo or battle in online dynasties with up to 32 real players.

4513660.title: YGGDRA: Path of Relics
4513660.short_description: The World Tree is corrupted, and the Nine Worlds tremble. Assemble your deck with 50+ unique Valkyries and march toward Yggdrasil's heart! Only your strategy can prevent destruction. Roguelite deck-building meets Norse mythology in the world of YGGDRA.

4514030.title: Wonderking WD
4514030.short_description: WonderKing WD is a 2D side-scrolling MMORPG featuring a unique Transformation System that lets you transform and use skills in battle. Explore a colorful fantasy world, challenge powerful bosses, and develop your character through exciting adventures.

4514040.title: Shadow & Steel
4514040.short_description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

4514140.title: CHEW YOUR FOOD
4514140.short_description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this survival horror.

4514390.title: Singulost
4514390.short_description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

4514780.title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
4514780.short_description: The definitive version of the beloved post-apocalyptic road trip. Fully remastered visuals, redesigned soundtrack, complete gamepad support. Tyler's journey begins again.

4514920.title: THORNSPELL
4514920.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

4515150.title: GUN MONKEY!
4515150.short_description: Help your monkey escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

4515920.title: BABKA-TERROR
4515920.short_description: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.

4515980.title: Increment Isle
4515980.short_description: Increment Isle is an incremental game about plundering a mysterious island. Destroy everything, discover new resources, strategically buy upgrades and avoid scurvy to become the richest person in the universe!

4516170.title: 100 Lunar Cats
4516170.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4516210.title: Studio Sim
4516210.short_description: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

4516640.title: Megabait
4516640.short_description: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

4516720.title: Rune Tale
4516720.short_description: Rune Tale is an incremental auto exploration game where you harvest and utilize rune energy by matching sets on an expanding grid to level up and become an all powerful wizard. Small game window doesn't take much space on your desktop so you can focus on other things.

4516990.title: ShardSpace
4516990.short_description: Shard Space is a minimalist strategy game. In the distant future, you awaken from a long slumber. Guided by a loyal lieutenant, you must rebuild your drone fleet and embark on a journey to uncover the ultimate truth of the universe.

4517210.title: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）
4517210.short_description: A unique fusion of Roguelike, Deckbuilding, and Tower Defense! Play as the Reborn Demon King, deploy Chibi-style units, and use strategic Talent Cards to conquer the continent. Featuring the innovative "Story Card" system for uninterrupted combat.

4517570.title: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
4517570.short_description: ...Everyone suspects you of murder. Become the Villainess everyone thinks you are. Create or join a cult. Manipulate people using the Emotion Palette. Enjoy power and peaceful moments... until bigger problems arise.

4517780.title: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
4517780.short_description: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional visual novel where choices shape four characters' fates. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

4518120.title: 黑哨 DirtyRef
4518120.short_description: This is not just a football game! As the referee, we don't need fairness! We only want money! Buy lottery tickets, use dirty off-field tactics and contacts, and use your status as referee to become a billionaire! "It's not personal, it's business."

4518270.title: Mad Ever After
4518270.short_description: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

4519100.title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
