4519100.short_description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

4519230.title: Penguin Pirates
4519230.short_description: Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!

4519660.title: Cloudpaws
4519660.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

4519930.title: Clifton
4519930.short_description: Clifton is an open-world survival game set on a remote tropical island. Explore, survive its dangers, and find a way to escape before the island’s unsolved mysteries find you. Play alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

4520870.title: Seek Shellter
4520870.short_description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

4520900.title: The City of Endless
4520900.short_description: A run-based auto-battler with asynchronous PvP. Each run you build your board as you ride the rails of an infinite city, arranging items and skills into powerful combos. How long can you keep your life on the rails?

4521110.title: The Polar Darkness
4521110.short_description: A Lovecraftian folk horror mystery set during the polar night of 1980s northern Finland. When a child preacher disappears during a revival sermon, a journalist becomes trapped in an isolated village where something ancient is beginning to awaken.

4521510.title: Pokorama
4521510.short_description: Run a boutique decorating studio where every client has unique tastes, quirks and expectations. Experiment with paints, fabrics and textures to create interiors your clients will love (or not), build your reputation, and unlock beautiful materials and interiors as your studio grows.

4521620.title: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
4521620.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

4521770.title: Drunk Woodcutter
4521770.short_description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A short physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

4521790.title: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism
4521790.short_description: A first-person co-op farming sim in a dictatorship you design yourselves. By day, your family grows the Party's weekly quota under the guards' watch. By night, you dig a secret tunnel under the border wall. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

4522410.title: Ember Express
4522410.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

4522450.title: Afterglow
4522450.short_description: Afterglow is a neon light-bike arena battler. Ride at full speed, leave a glowing trail behind you and trap your rivals in it before they trap you. Battle AI riders, friends in split screen, or up to 10 players online over Steam.

4522670.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
4522670.short_description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

4523640.title: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～
4523640.short_description: 意外な豆知識とカスみたいな嘘を見分けながら、謎の少女「豆カスちゃん」の秘密に近づいていくADV。

4525330.title: 三位一体の単一点
4525330.short_description: "AI is hacking into brains, driving people to suicide—" Three strangers with no apparent connection. Their fates inextricably intertwine, ultimately plunging them into a crisis that shakes the world. This is an ensemble drama where human bonds stand against a solitary justice.

4526760.title: Online Boxing 3D
4526760.short_description: A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

4527280.title: Vindobona
4527280.short_description: A top-down action-adventure in a Slavic-folk world grown over a ruined Roman town. A child is taken beyond the walls, and getting them back is not the end of it. Choose one of three travellers, follow the roads beyond the walls, and walk them to their ends.

4528060.title: Dominoir
4528060.short_description: Dominoir is a domino roguelike set in a noir casino. Match tiles to build chains, loop them back on themselves, and combine Schemes and Marks to chase huge scores. The House changes the rules, so your strategy has to keep up. Think Balatro meets dominoes.

4528660.title: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale
4528660.short_description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

4529110.title: System Says Normal
4529110.short_description: You were hired to watch. Not to ask questions. Night shift. Corporate building. Cameras, reports, anomalies. Your predecessor left no final report. Now you're going to find out why. Please proceed.

4529730.title: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
4529730.short_description: “XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution. Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

4530250.title: End of Empires: Breaking the Cycle
4530250.short_description: A Sci-Hy game exploring CenLib: separate private property from the means of production. Second game in the genre WILLSWAYSTUDIOS is pioneering. Multi-Perspective 3D strategy-ARPG—survive, craft, build, fight, counter-economics, direct democracy. Custom engine builds every asset from code.

4530330.title: Action & Automation
4530330.short_description: Action or automation? In this asymmetric, side-scrolling action-RTS, fight on the front line yourself, let your machines do the work, or do both at once. Each of the three species plays by its own rules.

4530740.title: Marmorea
4530740.short_description: Venture into the Tuscan village of Pietralba to solve the mystery of your brother’s disappearance. Uncover the dark secrets buried within the marble quarries and your own family's past.

4531290.title: The Refuge
4531290.short_description: Build and upgrade your refuge, gear up, and take on dangerous missions alone or with up to 3 players. Recover valuable resources, expand your camp, and choose your contracts wisely: the greater the reward, the greater the risk.

4531440.title: MARBLE SOULS
4531440.short_description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

4532280.title: 裸辞修仙传
4532280.short_description: Fed up with the corporate grind? A portal to another world just appeared by your desk! Hop in! As a mere mortal, step into a strangely familiar realm, follow the legendary "First Cultivator," and explore a vibrant world of immortality in this Roguelite RPG.

4532500.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
4532500.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of an adventurer with no memories as she faces her past. New features add to the depth of battles and alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

4533230.title: Farmed & Dangerous
4533230.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

4533670.title: 66: Dinosaur Survival
4533670.short_description: 66 is a brutal multiplayer dinosaur survival game where you hunt, grow, hide, migrate, and fight your way through a prehistoric ecosystem where every mistake can be fatal.

4534960.title: Dear Passengers
4534960.short_description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

4535470.title: Endless Castle: Under Siege
4535470.short_description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

4535610.title: Vegetableau
4535610.short_description: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game. Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty. Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.

4535650.title: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
4535650.short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

4535750.title: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
4535750.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

4535780.title: Love is Undead
4535780.short_description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

4536480.title: All Rats on Deck
4536480.short_description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

4536500.title: Prismfall
4536500.short_description: Prismfall is a strategic incremental game about defending your Prism from waves of enemies. Earn gold, wield powerful abilities, and buy upgrades from a deep and extensive upgrade tree.

4536520.title: Abyss Card Legend
4536520.short_description: Clear stages for god-tier gear, sacrifice to summon the Boss! In Abyss Card Legends, resurrect the ultimate Demon King with your own hands and claim the most game-breaking loot!

4536960.title: Brewery Simulator
4536960.short_description: Run a medieval tavern in first person: plant 18 crops, brew beer and wine with the exact flavors your guests ask for, hire a crew, and turn a roadside alehouse into a legendary tavern. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

4537040.title: Sky Safari: FPV Drone
4537040.short_description: Take to the skies with a high-speed FPV drone and become a wildlife photographer. Track lions, bears, crocodiles and more across a breathtaking open world, master realistic flight physics and capture the perfect shot – without scaring them away.

4538520.title: Shape Sift
4538520.short_description: Build experimental sorting systems to separate, transform, and route flowing shapes in this minimalist physics-based automation puzzle game.

4538640.title: MINAGOROSHI : THE RISEN AVENGER
4538640.short_description: Sneak up and brutally assassinate enemies from behind. A hardcore stealth action game where the tension of instant death upon a single glance intersects with the exhilaration of transforming into an Asura and slashing through everything.

4540240.title: International Football Manager 27
4540240.short_description: Football doesn't follow a script… and neither does International Football Manager 27. Make decisions, face the consequences, and experience a more exciting, authentic, and unpredictable simulation as you lead your football team to the top.

4540310.title: Bus Terminal Simulator
4540310.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

4540860.title: Chip Away
4540860.short_description: A roulette game with roguelike progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

4541130.title: Div Zero
4541130.short_description: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.

4541880.title: Fenix
4541880.short_description: Step into a vibrant 3D open world platformer inspired by classic adventures, where you play as Fenix, a curious fox exploring a lively forest. Discover unique NPCs, memorable landmarks, enemy encounters, and hidden secrets as you freely navigate an unforgettable world full of mystery and wonder!

4541890.title: Sneakin Femboy
4541890.short_description: Play as a femboy in this short 2D stealth comedy game :3

4544250.title: VVV
4544250.short_description: Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!! Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time. Roguelite × 3D Action Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

4545700.title: Enjoy Your Stay
4545700.short_description: Spot surreal and grotesque anomalies to escape a 1960s hotel that refuses to let its guests leave. Explore hidden liminal spaces, collect strange items, and discover the fates of those who checked in before you.

4546740.title: INDOORS: Trespasser
4546740.short_description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

4546890.title: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
4546890.short_description: A broke king wins back the crown at the blackjack table. Stack side-bet combos, cheat with Crown cards before suspicion catches you, and pledge villages, mines and keeps to five creditors, the Devil included. Build a kingdom worth losing.

4547120.title: Artificial Violet
4547120.short_description: A visual novel about identity and validation on social media. Step into Violeta's shoes and make decisions that will define who you really are.

4547330.title: Hotel Beresford
4547330.short_description: 1929. The Beresford Mansion once again becomes the stage for a tragic story. Follow its new owner, Samuel Chapman, on his descent into madness in this dark visual novel.

4547550.title: Railway End
4547550.short_description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

4548190.title: Ironfront Express
4548190.short_description: Customize and upgrade the Ironfront Express to kingdom come in this bullet-hell, tower-defense roguelite. Engineer and command the Ironfront Express in a unique take on lane defense, where you upgrade with specialized turrets, drones, and tactical abilities. Scrap the swarm!

4548700.title: Mindreaders
4548700.short_description: How well do you actually know your friends? Mindreaders is a social party game about syncing up. One player hints, the rest guess where on the Wheel they meant. Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, perfect for couch nights or Discord calls.

4549270.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
4549270.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

4549600.title: Skate Mates
4549600.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls just one skate! Leap over lava, race across icy tundras, ride horses, dodge spinning blades, and even fly on dragons together. Only strong teamwork and great communication will get you safely to the end.

4549910.title: G.E.E. (Ghost Evade & Extraction)
4549910.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror extraction. As disposable scouts, you raid dangerous zones for relics while unkillable monsters hunt in swarms. You can't kill them—only stun, repel, and control the creatures, then flee. Grab loot, drag friends out, and reach extraction... if your friendship survives.

4550270.title: Bingo Bingle
4550270.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

4550700.title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
4550700.short_description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

4550740.title: Kidnapped Simulator
4550740.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

4551440.title: Linkisa
4551440.short_description: Linkisa is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world inspired by Malagasy folklore and steampunk aesthetics. Play as General Linkisa, stripped of his memories, and explore the rain-soaked regions of the Empire of Orana in search of your past and the restoration of order. Masina ny orana.

4552010.title: CounterMind
4552010.short_description: A planetary RTS against an adaptive enemy that learns how you play. Lead machine legions or the hive swarm across ground, sea, air, and space. The enemy doesn't cheat. It plays smarter. Can you outsmart the opposing minds?

4552180.title: Jester Under Pressure
4552180.short_description: Diskarte, jester of the high castle, has one job: entertaining the queen. This would be easy except Queen Bahaghari has a penchant for magically exploding the heads of subjects falling below her exacting standards. Can Diskarte avoid this frightening fate?

4552280.title: YiShi Contagion: Versus
4552280.short_description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, a fast-paced 1v1 action game where you fight through enemy waves, collect power-ups, build your character, and race your rival to defeat the final boss first 💥

4553170.title: Cozy Interiors
4553170.short_description: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

4553180.title: Paragon Colonists
4553180.short_description: Settle uncharted lands in Paragon Colonists, an economy-focused, turn-based 4X strategy game. Build thriving colonies, meet local Orc clans, defy the Ashen Horde and break with the Paragons to fulfill your dream of an empire of your own - solo or in asynchronous multiplayer!

4553260.title: Working From Home
4553260.short_description: You went freelance the week before lockdown. Now stuck at home with no boss and no office, your days are your own. Work enough to pay the bills, manage your needs, blow your wages on gambling, shopping, and vapes, and try to survive the lockdown that never ends.

4553370.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames
4553370.short_description: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

4553990.title: Fuman Ghoul
4553990.short_description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

4554030.title: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
4554030.short_description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious, we hope you feel welcome here. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

4554250.title: Hellforged
4554250.short_description: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

4554510.title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
4554510.short_description: Drive slow cars fast. Haul cargo that shifts and spills, keep taxi passengers comfortable and chase suspects through the packed streets of 1990s China, all in forgotten workhorse cars with more character than horsepower. Inspired by ’90s games like Midtown Madness and Driver.

4554530.title: Exile Era
4554530.short_description: In the wasteland ruled by AI, a weekly exile game unfolds.Will you choose to survive alone, lingering in the shadow of zombies and mutated creatures? Or rally your companions and build a haven of hope for old humanity on this desolate island with your own hands?

4554700.title: BroCode
4554700.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

4554950.title: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
4554950.short_description: Build a deck of dominoes, chain together powerful combos, and break the rules in Pipfiend, a roguelike deckbuilder packed with strange enemies, dangerous synergies, and countless ways to shape your run.

4555760.title: Container Hunter Simulator
4555760.short_description: Salvage lost containers from the depths, uncover their hidden value, and sell them at auction to build your maritime empire.

4556220.title: SANDSTRIKE
4556220.short_description: A free top-down shooter set in a world that ran out of humans. Blow robots apart in PvP, a 16-robot battle royale and a night-time co-op convoy run. 28 guns, 7 gadgets, 22 implants. Pay-to-win not included.

4556280.title: Decks & Dashes
4556280.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

4559070.title: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
4559070.short_description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

4559210.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
4559210.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

4559420.title: Five Families
4559420.short_description: Turn-based mafia strategy. Lead a Cosa Nostra family through 40 years of New York crime: build rackets, command your crews, outplay four rival families and survive the FBI. Every decision has consequences.

4559610.title: You Will Fall
4559610.short_description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

4560260.title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
4560260.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

4560830.title: Terminal Drift
4560830.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

4560870.title: ガッチャ！サバイバー
4560870.short_description: A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight. Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts! Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

4560940.title: Your Chibi Chicken: Lo-Fi Desktop Pet
4560940.short_description: A chicken library with a lofi library, for your Steam library.

4561330.title: Back For Loot
4561330.short_description: Smack bosses for gold, buy permanent upgrades, and push further with every run in this incremental roguelite. Lead four unlikely heroes through a fantasy kingdom that can't let anything end. Your party wants out. Your next upgrade says otherwise.

4561550.title: Racetrack Tycoon
4561550.short_description: Build race tracks, expand your venue, attract racing series. Host everything from amateur club meets to world championship events in a true 1:1 scale simulation. Racetrack Tycoon challenges you to manage your budget, meet demanding series requirements, and entertain tens of thousands of fans.

4561760.title: Fieldwork
4561760.short_description: Your editor sent you to explore an abandoned ship graveyard. Photograph the evidence, stay quiet and get out alive.

4561890.title: Pastry Pile Up
4561890.short_description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

4562540.title: Linlang's Ledger
4562540.short_description: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

4562860.title: Extracto Proviso
4562860.short_description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

4563740.title: Outliers: Incrementum
4563740.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

4565530.title: Divinuet
4565530.short_description: A compellingly unique deterministic musical tarot experience, which guides you through a tarot reading in two segments. In the first, each card plays its own musical theme. In the second, music and videos combine to tell the overall story of your reading. A short ritual made to be returned to often.

4566010.title: Red Echoes: Berlin
4566010.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

4566430.title: Daughter of Dawn
4566430.short_description: Only you can shape her destiny. Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future. An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

4566710.title: Catapulteers
4566710.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player online co-op physics comedy where cursed Catapulteers haul weird ammo, lose their heads, load one giant catapult, and stop a Troll that really hates catapults.

4567180.title: Giant's Heart
4567180.short_description: A mysterious journey across a collapsing island. Reforge a lost blade, defeat ancient giants, and uncover the truth about your past. Save the island before it’s too late.

4567600.title: One More Voyage
4567600.short_description: ONE MORE VOYAGE is a minimalist 4X game all about exploring strange planets. On each voyage you are on the hunt for vital resources to make your next jump. The further you get, the more points you can invest in permanent upgrades. Can you find the star cipher to chart the way to a new galaxy?

4567670.title: Chick'n Slide
4567670.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

4567690.title: LUMINOUS GATE
4567690.short_description: LUMINOUS GATE is a fast-paced 3D action adventure. Master elemental abilities, wield giant weapons, and challenge powerful bosses. The current demo showcases the core combat experience, with a larger world and new adventures planned for the full release.

4568000.title: POUND SAND
4568000.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

4568320.title: Flesh Grinding
4568320.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

4568330.title: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor
4568330.short_description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

4569140.title: Slay the Party
4569140.short_description: Gather a party of 4, choose a class, and dive into chaotic turn-based mayhem! Navigate a board full of monsters and tricky decisions, growing stronger with every kill. Use your class skills and meme-fueled relics to sabotage and slay your party members, and be the first to achieve all winning feats.

4569750.title: Brawling Beetles
4569750.short_description: Die. Adapt. Fight Back. In this faced-paced top down multiplayer beetle brawler, every death makes you stronger. Choose between abilites, classes and weapons. Battle in matches with up to 4 players, fight PvE enemies, collect loot, and unleash powerful ultimates to claim victory.

4569790.title: Anathema Requiem
4569790.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

4570030.title: HIGH HORNS
4570030.short_description: CLIMB TO CONQUER! Physics-based co-op VR climbing

4570290.title: Urban Echoes
4570290.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

4570390.title: LIMICORE
4570390.short_description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

4571090.title: Masked Up
4571090.short_description: Online Rogue-like Game. Choose a various characters and masks to defeat your enemies.

4571160.title: Rainbow Tower Defense
4571160.short_description: Your towers don't fire a single shot. You block the horde with the lines between them. Deploy the right towers and mix diverse line synergies to craft your winning strategy. Classic tower defense, completely reinvented. Test your tactical limits against escalating waves.

4572060.title: Snow Panic
4572060.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

4572620.title: Canvas Attack!
4572620.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

4572720.title: GAP OR DIE
4572720.short_description: There’s only one rule: make the jump. Push your speed, commit to the gap, and survive as long as you can in this high-risk endless racing game. Upgrade your ride, and see how far you can go before everything goes horribly wrong.

4572830.title: Drumk
4572830.short_description: DRUMK is a physics-based pirate action game where you command a fully interactive ship, battle enemy crews, and survive roguelite runs solo or with up to 6 players.

4572930.title: Just More Doors : REFRAMED & REDACTED
4572930.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR TO WIN! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

4573270.title: 中等生
4573270.short_description: 这是一部中式校园（高三）为背景的百合向视觉小说。 只要考上大学，一切都会好起来吗？手牵着手，心跳扑通扑通，我们只是朋友吗？大家说只是开个玩笑，感到不舒服是正常的吗？想要挣脱母亲的期待，这是不孝吗？您将跟随主角周语桐，探索青春期的疑惑，帮她作出选择。

4573410.title: Apple Picker
4573410.short_description: Start with an apple tree, end with a multiverse turned to pulp in this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. Uncover the source of this all-consuming apple obsession. But whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.

4573500.title: Arms Race
4573500.short_description: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

4573960.title: Cauldron: Haunted Harvest
4573960.short_description: Haunted Harvest is a farming spinoff set in the Cauldron universe. Play three evolving minigames, grow some magical crops, and restore a corrupted village to its former glory. If your favorite plant is still an upgrade tree, then grab your watering can and start the harvest!

4574080.title: Shoes in the fridge
4574080.short_description: You wake up on a normal day - except maybe a little late, everything feels normal... until you realize... your shoes are in the fridge. Shoes in the Fridge is an achievement hunting game with multiple funny endings. Will you ever make it to work?

4574220.title: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
4574220.short_description: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold. Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

4574370.title: Sword & Banner
4574370.short_description: Mount & Blade's campaign meets classic RTS battles, in pixel art. Lead a warband across a fantasy continent at war, raise peasants into knights, trade, and carve out your own faction. Command every soldier in fast, brutal real-time battles and sieges.

4574460.title: Rabbit On The Rails
4574460.short_description: A short 3D side-scrolling puzzle horror game set on a mysterious circus train. Explore eerie train cars, solve unsettling puzzles, and guide a young girl as she tries to escape a world that feels both warm and deeply disturbing.

4574740.title: The Last Grave Job
4574740.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 4 players. Sneak into a cemetery at night, find the right graves, dig up the loot and haul it back to your wheelbarrow. Stay quiet, avoid the Keeper and get out alive.

4574960.title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
4574960.short_description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

4575030.title: Dead Reckoner
4575030.short_description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

4575080.title: Lost Exit
4575080.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

4575400.title: Space Postal Service
4575400.short_description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

4575640.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
4575640.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

4576540.title: Regnum Last Sanctum
4576540.short_description: Regnum Last Sanctum begins with Saga I — Combat: Wrath of the Goblins. An dark epic, Action RPG, Regnum's Quest to defend its last sanctum against the invading goblins. Master skill-based combat, fight clever foes, and progress in the realm of Regnum where death has consequences. Will you survive?

4577040.title: 致，我亲爱的
4577040.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror visual novel. Player's choices lead to distinct emotional paths and story outcomes. "You" navigate a shifting consciousness, making choices within fragmented scenes that buried memories.

4577220.title: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
4577220.short_description: "The world of deity : Part 1" is the free first part of a sci-fi romance ADV "The world of deity" published by Cloudside Games. By cooperating with "little sister" Yiran to uncover the truth behind the chemical plant explosion, players can gradually discover the hidden secrets behind this world.

4577250.title: Court Vision
4577250.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

4577310.title: ALTAR CORP
4577310.short_description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

4577730.title: Star Seed Protocol
4577730.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

4577860.title: Gravity Witch
4577860.short_description: Master gravity as a witch whose mana has been stolen. With no elemental spells left, use your creativity to manipulate the weight of the world, solve puzzles, and face dangers. Reclaim your power in an action-adventure journey where gravity is your only and greatest ally.

4578640.title: Ro Sham Brawl
4578640.short_description: Ro Sham Brawl is a rock, paper, scissors fighting game where you brawl your friends in chaotic rounds of fast-paced, physics-based competition. Launch powerful attacks with crazy abilities, while destroying arenas and friendships with every shot.

4578680.title: Red Epic: War of Resistance
4578680.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

4578910.title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
4578910.short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

4579030.title: Bluff or Bust
4579030.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

4579110.title: Courier Beware
4579110.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

4579250.title: I Am Octopus
4579250.short_description: 🐙What would you do if you woke up one day and you were an Octopus🐙 Even worse, being held captive by the evil Dr Docto who is back on his evil ways...and wait, is he using you as a test subject?

4579290.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
4579290.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

4579630.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
4579630.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

4579700.title: Rites of Accord
4579700.short_description: Turn-based hex tactics with six radically asymmetric factions. Climb the Survival leaderboard or outsmart a rival in a full match in 30-40 minutes. Raise the dead as Echoes, spread living terrain, or share damage across the Choir. Free demo available now.

4579930.title: Kepler Protocol
4579930.short_description: Kepler-186e. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against a swarm steered by stimulus and pheromone.

4580050.title: Sunrise Story
4580050.short_description: Run your own seaside homestay in a cozy pixel art life sim 🌊 Welcome travelers, cook Southeast Asian–inspired dishes, and build a peaceful life by the sea.

4580160.title: Caravan Bazar
4580160.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

4580250.title: Smash Them All
4580250.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

4580360.title: Dreadfold
4580360.short_description: A single-player dark fantasy card battler on a 3×3 grid, built on Final Fantasy VIII's core Triple Triad rules. Place a card next to a rival's: if your touching number is higher, theirs flips to your colour. Every win earns a card. A loss can cost one.

4580570.title: MUGENDUNGEON
4580570.short_description: “MUGENDUNGEON” is a top-down roguelike action game where players explore procedurally generated dungeons. Collect keys, reach the goal, clear each floor, upgrade gear in the shop, and dive deeper in this single-player adventure.

4580700.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
4580700.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

4580790.title: Mine Mage Minion
4580790.short_description: A mining game where you play as a mage digging deeper into the earth. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor for yourself and your minions, defend your operation from enemy waves and bosses, and protect your underground colony from creatures trying to sabotage your progress.

4581050.title: My Demon Academia
4581050.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

4581160.title: Folders On The Run
4581160.short_description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

4581340.title: Perplexicube
4581340.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

4581560.title: Eleven Legends
4581560.short_description: Eleven Legends blends football management, character growth, and strategic matches. You are not just a manager on the sidelines, nor just one player on the pitch. Plan each week, build bonds, find mentors, and lead your team to victory.

4581600.title: import robots
4581600.short_description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

4581650.title: RED RESET
4581650.short_description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil. Following chapters will be available for purchase soon.

4581670.title: Beyond Orbit
4581670.short_description: A tab-target space MMO inspired by Earth & Beyond. Choose between three classes, Warrior, Explorer or Trader and make your way through the galaxy. Fight, mine, haul and craft with other pilots.

4581800.title: Thalyn
4581800.short_description: Build a cosy world. Then step inside. Create cottages, gardens and places to stay, from above or in first person. Shape the atmosphere with simple choices, text or voice, wander through your creation, and export it as glTF to keep and share. No coding or 3D modelling needed.

4581860.title: Jett Rider - Mini Hero
4581860.short_description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

4582320.title: VoidHue
4582320.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

4582430.title: This is not just a farm
4582430.short_description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

4582550.title: Kabsa Spilled?
4582550.short_description: Spill Kabsa everywhere in this chaotic co-op physics game. Grab a buddy and lead the adventure of two chefs delivering the Kabsa plate through deadly firepits, tricky platforms, angry vendors and much worse things that will DEFINITELY make your friendship better.

4582650.title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
4582650.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

4582760.title: What Remains
4582760.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

4583010.title: Sign It
4583010.short_description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

4583020.title: Chihuahua Racing
4583020.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 18 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

4583030.title: (Debt Feeds Debt
4583030.short_description: A turn-based bond card strategy game. Buy bonds, fulfill orders, build FEVER combos, and push progress to 100 before decay—and the demonic contract—catch up.

4583040.title: Factor Zoo
4583040.short_description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

4583060.title: Unregistered Scene
4583060.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

4583070.title: Misplaced
4583070.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

4583150.title: Greda Inferno
4583150.short_description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

4583170.title: Chief Bubble Officer
4583170.short_description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

4583360.title: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE -
4583360.short_description: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

4583840.title: Winter Hunts Us
4583840.short_description: Lead a prehistoric clan across a brutal hex map in a turn-based survival roguelite. Outrun the glacier, fight hunger, face strange events, and defy extinction.

4584190.title: Looplash
4584190.short_description: Looplash is a fast-paced arcade action roguelite where your skills rotate around you in a constant loop. Move to control timing, position yourself precisely, and survive the chaos. Push the system to create builds that bend the rules.

4584860.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
4584860.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

4585010.title: Jackpot Colosseum
4585010.short_description: Your slot machine is the weapon. Spin to load guns and bullets, then unload the whole build when it hurts most. Bet bigger for stronger symbols, gamble the gold you need to survive, and climb five leagues of the colosseum. A turn-based reel-building roguelike.

4585370.title: Bounty Gunman
4585370.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

4585530.title: Mind The Gap
4585530.short_description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

4585580.title: Game of Warriors
4585580.short_description: Defend your city, conquer enemy lands, and build a powerful empire in this unique tower defense strategy game. Upgrade defenses and technolgy, command troops, and face massive waves, siege weapons, and war elephants as you expand across the map.

4585610.title: Finding Cats In Green Street
4585610.short_description: Find cute cats in Green Street. Can you find them? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

4586060.title: Script Strike
4586060.short_description: Script Strike is a strategy game where you fight with code. Command your knight and solve levels in your favorite language, from variables and loops to algorithms, debugging, and concurrency. Collect weapons, unlock skills, and face the challenges of a medieval fantasy battlefield.

4586090.title: Remaining Kingdom
4586090.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

4586510.title: Psyai
4586510.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click detective adventure. Investigate a neon-soaked city, hack corporate networks, and diagnose broken AI minds. Inspired by Policenauts and Snatcher.

4586580.title: Astro Kitty: Space Mining
4586580.short_description: Astro Kitty: Space Mining is an incremental mining game where you dig through planets, collect valuable resources, upgrade your gear, automate your mining operation, and travel between planets on an adventure with cats.

4586780.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
4586780.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

4586870.title: Leaky Business
4586870.short_description: A small deckbuilder about the daily struggle of running a business. Choose your die, craft your deck, manage resources, and fix leaks before things fall apart. The odds aren't in your favor, but with a little planning and a bit of luck, you might just make it.

4587820.title: Unfallen Bastion
4587820.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

4587940.title: Stray Service
4587940.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

4588070.title: Mystery Box Simulator
4588070.short_description: Run your own mystery box business! Source returned shipments, storage finds and second-hand treasures. Hunt for hidden gems, identify valuable items, restore them and create the perfect mystery boxes to satisfy your customers while maximizing your profits!

4588490.title: Last One Breathing
4588490.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

4589360.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
4589360.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

4589530.title: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
4589530.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

4589630.title: Sonnet
4589630.short_description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

4589690.title: HardLuck
4589690.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

4589970.title: Breakkaboom
4589970.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

4590270.title: Fallgrade
4590270.short_description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

4590940.title: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
4590940.short_description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. CARGO CRUSH ZERO is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

4591140.title: Exile of Arcadia
4591140.short_description: A high-octane platformer utilizing a teleporting dagger to traverse through a futuristic city!

4591360.title: Void Balls
4591360.short_description: A 3D survivors-like where you play as a ball. Roll, jump, dash and parry everything: every shot you catch flies back at its shooter. Stack auto-firing weapons, gears and items into a wild build, beat the balls that rule the void, then play as them.

4591580.title: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil
4591580.short_description: A high-intensity, Touhou Project survivor-like action game set in Gensokyo, playable in just 5–10 minutes! Break through overwhelming enemy hordes and bullet hell attacks using your own unique builds and pure player skill.

4591730.title: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental
4591730.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about flying through space, popping bubbles, and harvesting Bubble Matter. Build combos, land skillshots for massive multipliers, and spend your loot in a sprawling upgrade shop.

4591740.title: Numpad Chef: Pizza Rush
4591740.short_description: Turn your numpad into a pizza kitchen. Type fast, cook faster. Master a unique number-based control system as you prepare, top, and bake pizzas under pressure in a cozy 3D farm kitchen, where every order counts and every mistake matters.

4592040.title: Just Chessing Around
4592040.short_description: A tactical dungeon crawler where your party is a chess army and the board tries to kill you. Plan around tornadoes, quicksand swallowing your pieces or flying lava stones. Turn bishops into necromancers, stack pawns on other pieces or give Jerry a BBQ. No king to checkmate, just enemies to destroy.

4592080.title: Schoolgirl vs Fishman
4592080.short_description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

4592130.title: The Blinking Room
4592130.short_description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

4592250.title: Take Profit
4592250.short_description: Step into the role of elite Spec Ops agent Lucy “Talent” Lawson as she dismantles a global crime syndicate to rescue her kidnapped sister. Hunt down The Trust, eliminate its leaders, and seize their profits in this intense, story-driven third-person shooter.

4592350.title: Spruce Falls
4592350.short_description: You're locked in a diner! But for a good reason. Someone chopped down the Grand Spruce, and the collateral damage is Big News. Figure out which of the many suspicious characters murdered the town's journalist by essentially bugging everybody.

4592540.title: Lantern
4592540.short_description: A mysterious exploration adventure set on a transformed Mars. At the controls of LANTERN, a forgotten rover, explore, drift, jump, and photograph the strange. Every discovery updates its BIOS, revealing new objectives and new leads to follow.

4592620.title: Dopamine Fuel
4592620.short_description: Parkour through a procedurally generated city to avoid the rats, sentient trash, robot pigeons, and more! Pick abilities and items to make a build capable of fighting off the swarm! In style of course.

4592880.title: Black Resonance: Obelisk Siege
4592880.short_description: A dark 2.5D combat roguelite with arena-defense elements where a rock musician turns sound into a weapon, builds defenses around an ancient obelisk, and holds back waves of monstrous enemies in a gothic world of darkness and metal.

4593190.title: Elemental Lands
4593190.short_description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

4593760.title: Zoti's Train Workshop
4593760.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

4593810.title: Pollex
4593810.short_description: Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war. Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

4593890.title: Desktop Planet
4593890.short_description: Desktop Planet is a sci-fi building game centered on automated production lines. Start with mining, smelting and manufacturing, plan your logistics and power supply, then assemble a fleet to explore new planets.

4593920.title: Gnomonatics
4593920.short_description: Gnomonatics is a third-person action-adventure game. Explore an open island, solve ancient puzzle dungeons, and battle corrupted creatures with sword and crossbow as the shadows transform everyone around you.

4594190.title: Toy Tycoon
4594190.short_description: You're the owner of a toy business. Start with a small store in a suburban area. Increase your profits, unlock new toys, hire employees, move to bigger locations, manufacture your own toys, and expand your company. Build your empire and become a toy tycoon!

4594200.title: UFO Craft
4594200.short_description: You are a UFO. Your target: anything that moves and isn't properly secured. Pilot the UFO, sow chaos, and abduct everything! Equipped with a powerful gravity beam, destruction physics, and deep ship upgrades. Abduct cows, cars, and people in this insane cosmic abduction simulator. Earth isn't ready!

4594580.title: DT.O: Hanes
4594580.short_description: When a woodcutter is hired to map the ancient forest of Ethrna, a mysterious substance called ■■■■■ shatters his reality. Face a world of forgotten memories and a past that shouldn't exist...? Can Phabius find the truth within his mind?

4594740.title: Still Breathing
4594740.short_description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

4595270.title: Tactical Commanders R
4595270.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

4595300.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
4595300.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

4595870.title: Stack the Spells
4595870.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

4595980.title: Ship or Burn! Coop express
4595980.short_description: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.

4596090.title: Your Mother Disgusts Me
4596090.short_description: Your Mother Disgusts Me is a yuri horror visual novel about 3 women taking refuge in a shipping container during the apocalypse. A mother, a stranger and a daughter have to hash out their differences, lest they attract the attention of the disgusting Parasites infecting humanity.

4596180.title: Table of Fates
4596180.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

4596350.title: DeskFarm: Idle Garden
4596350.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

4596680.title: Pocket Paradise Restaurant
4596680.short_description: Run your restaurant on the paradise island of Isla Sabor ! Dive in the ocean to get food, design and expand your restaurant, buy supplies and cook meals for your clients !

4596780.title: The Defective One
4596780.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

4597790.title: PIGGO
4597790.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party card game where players race to collect four matching cards, bluff their friends, and react at the perfect moment. Play with 2-4 players through fast unpredictable rounds. In PIGGO, it’s never just the cards.

4597950.title: Tower Tanks
4597950.short_description: TEAM UP! BUILD UP! BLOW UP! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike where you and your friends build and crew giant war machines. Work together to customize your tank, power up the engines, put out fires, and man the guns as you blast apart anything in your way!

4598030.title: Endless Harvest
4598030.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

4598920.title: The Pyroxene Ages
4598920.short_description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

4599010.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
4599010.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

4599110.title: Hotel Simulator
4599110.short_description: Take control of a motel in Winston Springs! Design unique interiors, care for guests, earn and invest in a hotel network. Plan room layouts and furnishings, and hire staff. Transform outdated spaces into luxurious apartments with attention to every detail. Will you create the hotel of your dreams?

4599140.title: Oath for Glory
4599140.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

4599180.title: Pantheon
4599180.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

4599250.title: Moldhaven
4599250.short_description: A first-person survival horror action-adventure. Explore an anomalous zone, find your sister's missing expedition, and fight a maddened cult. Manage your resources and evade an ancient power awakened by a corporation.

4599270.title: Wanderfolk
4599270.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

4599540.title: Antarctic Showdown
4599540.short_description: Kill your friend! Antarctic Showdown is a 1v1 roguelike shooter. Grow stronger with every defeat and claim victory!

4599590.title: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen
4599590.short_description: Hollowmoor is plauged by a series of strange disapperances — and at the core of it all lies centuries old Trinity Acadamy of Witchcraft. Step into the shoes of young Ruby and her house spider Mifi to discover the truth behind the schools dark secrets.

4599730.title: Irondrive
4599730.short_description: A vehicular roguelite where you manage a crew inside a moving fortress. Your base is on the move, your crew is at the breaking point: automate repairs, manage priorities, and survive relentless attacks as you cross a hostile, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Keep moving.

4600060.title: Seal The Breach
4600060.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

4600230.title: KeelOver
4600230.short_description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

4600380.title: ELLA in da room
4600380.short_description: A seemingly cozy (but ultimately frustrating) 2D platformer, where a little girl’s imagination transforms her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures in which every object becomes part of a story, all while testing your patience to its limits.

4600800.title: Astral Echelons
4600800.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

4600910.title: Dendron 64
4600910.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

4601090.title: Hold Your Position
4601090.short_description: An incremental-style tower defense game where you face waves of orcs, undead, and demons. Recruit more troops, buy and upgrade skills, obtain powerful spells, and hold your position.

4601100.title: False Oath
4601100.short_description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

4601110.title: Smokey Mike
4601110.short_description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

4601370.title: Yashi - Sand Driver
4601370.short_description: In an endless desert, you are Yashi, a lone survivor... until this radio signal changes everything. Jump in your van with your faithful coyote, drive across the wastelands, survive the heat, scavenge resources, craft tools, fight the elements & find your way to New Eden in this feel-good road trip.

4601470.title: Going my way?
4601470.short_description: You're a train conductor in a world that doesn't sleep anymore. People are losing their minds, and Wanderers hide among them. Your job sounds simple: get the train to the City, watch the passengers, and never forget that the train demands sacrifices.

4601560.title: Ember
4601560.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

4601700.title: Incremental Defense
4601700.short_description: Optimize, automate, and scale your defense to survive increasingly challenging waves in this addictive incremental tower defense.

4602110.title: Chains of Vithra
4602110.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

4602450.title: Void Strike
4602450.short_description: Shred endless waves of hostile spaceships in a 1-bit arcade survival roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, unlock pilots, upgrade your fighter, and survive escalating dogfights against swarms, elite enemies, and colossal bosses.

4602760.title: Anomaly Planet
4602760.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

4602770.title: Tower of Genn
4602770.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests and discover new interactions with special blocks, strategically placing your pieces, to build a lasting legacy for your people.

4603020.title: TRANSMIT
4603020.short_description: A 1-bit, point & click and puzzle short story about horror, mystery and deception. TRANSMIT, translate and search for coded messages as part of your telegraph operator job and figure out what's behind the new SS PURGO.

4603100.title: ASANA Visual Novel
4603100.short_description: A sci-fi dark comedy visual novel with English voices. Build your stats, choose branching routes, and try live AI conversations and persuasion challenges as Captain Asana. N.E.K.O., your judgmental cat-shaped ship AI, has opinions. He is still not impressed.

4603240.title: ARCADE LOOP: ROGUELIKE
4603240.short_description: Dive into ARCADE LOOP, a massive, ever-expanding collection of classic and modern arcade simulations. Featuring deep meta-progression, unlockable characters, powerful relics, weapons, bosses and a dynamic scaling system that keeps every run fresh.

4603450.title: Mega Squad Survivors
4603450.short_description: Become Hua Tuo and lead 50 great officers of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as women, across 25 stages. Unlock new officers and art, master 200+ skills, and combine 35 Tales of Three Kingdoms lore with 5 formations to forge a peerless legion. The physician takes the field to heal a land at war!

4603700.title: Save Princess Torosso
4603700.short_description: Save Princess Torosso is a fantasy 3D action adventure with ranged magic combat, skill card progression, and 3D platforming obstacles. Instead of complex builds, it focuses on intuitive controls and stage clearing like a classic arcade game.

4604230.title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
4604230.short_description: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

4604660.title: Honel's Identification
4604660.short_description: A document inspection sim in a fantasy republic gripped by reform. Check papers from humans, elves, orcs, trolls, and beastfolk against rules that change every day. Follow the law, or your conscience? Every issuance has a cost.

4605420.title: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story
4605420.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

4605780.title: Archerman
4605780.short_description: Two archer on a ridge. Wind blows. One arrow flies. ARCHERMAN is a minimalist 1v1 archery duel — turn-based, physics-driven, and stripped down to what matters: the arc, the wind, and the moment you release.

4606100.title: Verbal Vendetta
4606100.short_description: DITCH BUTTON MASHING! Bark real-time orders to your champion to outplay & counter your opponent! Dominate the leaderboards, and win through words, not buttons! Built by a solo dev!

4606480.title: Nozie Tower Defense XL
4606480.short_description: Defend against waves of invading balloons in this colorful tower defense adventure. Place and upgrade 8 unique towers, including fire, slow, explosive, and sniper types, across 20 challenging levels. Mix strategies, complete goals, and try to beat the developer’s high score!

4606750.title: Turno Nocturno
