4606750.short_description: Work for corporations on desolate planets, complete dangerous shifts, recover valuable resources, and survive strange creatures while uncovering the remains of an ancient humanity that was actually our own.

4606910.title: Archa
4606910.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

4607150.title: Satanic Panic
4607150.short_description: DEMONS VS ANGELS | A fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. Defend against waves of Angelic assaults with a small army of Demons, then upgrade them with a variety of abilities and buffs to tear through increasingly large and powerful hordes of Angels.

4607180.title: PulseWave
4607180.short_description: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

4607420.title: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
4607420.short_description: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

4608670.title: Don't Stop The Pop!
4608670.short_description: Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿

4609100.title: Just Barricade!
4609100.short_description: Just Barricade! is a brutal home-defense simulator about earning money, building protection, and surviving the consequences of your own decisions.

4609150.title: Flakeparty
4609150.short_description: Build the perfect cereal bowl and reach extremely high scores in this relaxing roguelike deckbuilder. Scoop up cereals, craft powerful synergies by placing them well, earn toys by playing rule-twisting minigames and eat tasty snacks to improve your cereals as you reach the highest scores!

4609300.title: No Elevator
4609300.short_description: You as a claustrophobic guy refuse elevators and climb a massive building from the outside, using a plank gun and create your own path.

4609450.title: Магический мир Константина Кадавра
4609450.short_description: Enter Konstantin Kadavr's absurd magical world through a refrigerator in the woods. Ask a video fortune orb, click for coins, catch flying bonuses, and test your patience to earn red chairs. The game is available in Russian only.

4609500.title: Defense Front
4609500.short_description: Take command of routes and firepower in a fresh take on classic tower defense. Deploy towers, seal off key junctions, and reshape enemy routes on the fly. Turn the tide with branching upgrades, customizable targeting priorities, and direct target designation as you defend humanity across the globe.

4609540.title: ScaMMO
4609540.short_description: Incremental game where you play as a frustrated rich MMO veteran promising to make the next WoW killer. How far will you get before cashing out?

4609950.title: Rock, Paper, Severed
4609950.short_description: You are invited to play a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors to wipe away your sins. Sit down. Make your throw. Try not to lose anything you can't reattach.

4609970.title: The Midnight Dump
4609970.short_description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

4610060.title: SYSTEM 21
4610060.short_description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

4610140.title: Birdflop
4610140.short_description: An intense platformer with a unique one-button control. You've fallen from your nest, and you're just learning how to fly. Can you make it back to the top?

4610300.title: MUNer
4610300.short_description: Early this century, a school Model UN event steeped in emotional conflict and tragedy changed every participant’s life. Years later, the scattered youth reunite and seek revenge, amid fractured friendship, love, ambition and lost dreams.
publishers: ローズペタル・アトリエ

4611080.title: Knut
4611080.short_description: SAVE THE PLANET, FIND YOUR FISH! In this epic 2D platformer, a simple rescue mission spirals into total planetary chaos. Knut, a one-eyed rodent with a nuclear-grade grudge, engages a robotic army to find his pet. Master twitchy physics and massive upgrades. Nothing stands between you and your fish!

4611120.title: The Observation Exit
4611120.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you must identify anomalies, choose the correct elevator to progress, and escape an endless loop in a hospital corridor while avoiding deadly entities.

4611130.title: Angler 2003
4611130.short_description: A regional television programme from 2003 that you fish inside of. Cast into ponds, storm drains, sofa cushions, and the internet. 135 "Fish" species. Hosted by everyone's favourite Pineapple Cat.

4611200.title: SCP RP
4611200.short_description: Run the Foundation. Survive the breach. SCP RP is a free-to-play multiplayer roleplay game where players and AI staff share one living facility. Take a role, follow your orders and host your own server.

4611880.title: XiaoLuo's English War
4611880.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

4612490.title: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
4612490.short_description: A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts. Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow. Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

4612810.title: Bullet Barrage
4612810.short_description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

4612880.title: Dumb Dunks
4612880.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

4613550.title: GhostomVillage
4613550.short_description: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

4614430.title: Power Up!
4614430.short_description: Your first office job has one rule: move up by beating your manager at the company’s card game. Explore a strange corporate tower, solve workplace problems through observation and choice, build your deck, and climb floor by floor.

4614490.title: AI VS ARTISTS
4614490.short_description: Prove the power of human artists in this narrative-driven story game! Do you have what it takes to dethrone Scylla Corporation?

4614870.title: Apiary in Flow
4614870.short_description: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

4614970.title: Plink Lab
4614970.short_description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

4614990.title: Desert Struggle
4614990.short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

4615240.title: Little Joe the Dodger
4615240.short_description: A high-difficulty puzzle action game featuring monochrome minimalist graphics and extremely simple controls — you can only jump.

4615580.title: OVERCHESS
4615580.short_description: You are a pawn in an endless but not always fair chess world. Enslave your enemies and turn them into slaves. Build your own army. On the path to glory you will face alcoholism, alligators and ludomania. Test your luck in OVERCHESS.

4615910.title: Horde Reapers
4615910.short_description: Face hordes and bosses, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Shape your build with weapons, items, and elemental powers, then bring resources back to rebuild your village and unlock permanent upgrades.

4616210.title: Scarecrow Simulator
4616210.short_description: No swords. No dragons. No heroic destiny. Just you, a scarecrow, standing proudly in a medieval field while the world grows around you. Surprisingly relaxing. Surprisingly addictive.

4616970.title: S-Ranker
4616970.short_description: Fight through short dungeons in this action roguelite. Choose new powers in combat, equip runes between runs, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank.

4617170.title: Broadside Bets
4617170.short_description: Your crew trusts you with their lives... Bad idea. You’re about to wager them on the cards! Collect rule-bending Booty and sail across the sea. Some routes lead to treasure, others lead to a merchant who will try to sell you a cursed map and you’ll probably buy it anyway.

4617520.title: Diggems
4617520.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

4618210.title: Casanova Simulator
4618210.short_description: This is a visual novel game where players step into the shoes of a charismatic young man, building emotional connections through thoughtful choices. Your decisions directly influence affection levels, shaping your romantic interactions and delivering an engaging romance experience.

4618340.title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
4618340.short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

4618850.title: Route 340
4618850.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

4619020.title: Magical Magic World 2
4619020.short_description: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

4619040.title: Valken
4619040.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

4619500.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
4619500.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

4619600.title: Funny Rummy
4619600.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

4619810.title: Vatan
4619810.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

4620000.title: 拉克夏家的女仆
4620000.short_description: 「The Maid of Luxia」is an otome visual novel.Rebirth. Redemption. Rewriting tragedy. Facing the truth of the heart.Experience not only the twisted love of seven masters poured upon you at once, but also a journey of self-growth.

4620100.title: Bad AI
4620100.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

4620150.title: The Hollow Archive
4620150.short_description: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

4620760.title: SPLATTER KING
4620760.short_description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

4620790.title: Cargo Lines
4620790.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

4622320.title: Magically Sorted
4622320.short_description: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

4622880.title: 疾擎速骋Rapid Engine Speed
4622880.short_description: 《Rapid Engine Speed》 is a realistic motorcycle racing game focused on authentic handling. Ditch the convenience of automatic shifting, and experience the full manual gear-shifting process from pulling the clutch and shifting gears to throttle control.
publishers: 重庆疾擎速骋科技有限公司

4623010.title: PARRALYSIS
4623010.short_description: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

4623140.title: The Landlords
4623140.short_description: A story-driven property-trading board game built on The Landlord's Game, Lizzie Magie's 1904 original. Buy land, charge rent and strike deals with characterful rivals or friends online, under her ruthless Monopolist rules or her Prosperity rules, where everyone can win.

4623720.title: HAUL
4623720.short_description: From broke and jobless to full-time flipper — source, clean, and resell your way through thrift stores, blue bins, and sketchy meetups in a small-town hustle sim.

4624230.title: Whale Cleaner
4624230.short_description: Take charge of a deep-sea wash station for filthy marine giants! Upgrade bizarre bio-industrial tools to scrub whales, dolphins, sharks and other mysterious beasts. Get them spotless before Mr. Claw docks your pay in this relaxing, atmospheric, and satisfying cleaning simulator. Find hidden secrets!

4624730.title: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！
4624730.short_description: （本作根据真实事件改编）你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

4626570.title: Fixpert
4626570.short_description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

4626950.title: Grow/Tend/Reap
4626950.short_description: Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back. Your farm IS your deck. Grow crops. Tend fields. Reap what you sow.

4627520.title: Smoke Easy: Hookah Lounge Simulator
4627520.short_description: Run your own hookah lounge! Seat guests, pack the bowl, keep the coals burning, put out fires (literally) and grow your business from a tiny spot to a place worth staying for.

4627540.title: Kinetic Conundrum
4627540.short_description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

4627770.title: DOOMFRONT
4627770.short_description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

4627900.title: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
4627900.short_description: Combine classic pinball physics with addictive incremental progression! Place bumpers, unlock massive skill trees, and watch your score skyrocket into the millions!

4628030.title: Tinplate Scramble
4628030.short_description: Two factions battle across land and sky in Tinplate Scramble. Win firefights and melees on foot, pilot a fighter or hovercraft into the fray, and tip the scales in open skirmishes and handcrafted missions involving 100+ fielded units.

4628560.title: What The Dog Doing?
4628560.short_description: A relaxing idle digging game that sits at the corner of your screen. Work (or don't) while your best friend digs for items, collects treasures and unlocks new biomes and outfits.

4628970.title: Bullet Beast
4628970.short_description: A 3D movement based bullet hell where you swing, dash and use beast powers to survive swarms of enemies.

4629660.title: HellFactory Inc.
4629660.short_description: Run a factory in Hell. Automate production lines, hit monthly revenue targets, bribe the board of Seven Deadly Sins, and skim slush funds to seize control — before they terminate you. A roguelike fusion of factory automation and boardroom politics.

4629850.title: Project ACCIPITER
4629850.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

4629920.title: Backrooms: Echo
4629920.short_description: The next level of Backrooms games. Co-op for 1–4 players. Procedurally generated levels, terrifying entities, and a realistic atmosphere. Every playthrough is a unique experience. Try to find the way out, but don’t trust everything you hear and see.

4630010.title: Goblin Kaboom
4630010.short_description: A fast-paced casual auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

4630150.title: The Life You Missed
4630150.short_description: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

4630600.title: Saviour & Religion
4630600.short_description: With no memory of who he is, he awakens in a dark dungeon. Twisted patients, a doctor with unknown motives, deadly trap hidden within ancient halls, and a disturbing cult devoted to an unseen god… A story of wishes, religion, reality and illusion—and salvation.
publishers: 萊斯特的帽子 Lester's cap

4630680.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
4630680.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

4630710.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom
4630710.short_description: The research team is gone. You're next. A first-person psychological horror in the Backrooms - explore ruined levels, keep your Synchronization steady, and uncover what destroyed your research team. Free demo: the Prologue.

4631120.title: Dead Hand
4631120.short_description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

4631260.title: Slay the GoblinZ
4631260.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped! Play as a knight hired to rescue Her Highness in this short fantasy incremental game. Craft unique equipment, experiment with deadly builds, and unlock dozens of powerful upgrades.

4631400.title: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
4631400.short_description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

4631410.title: Long Rescue
4631410.short_description: Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis. Will you rescue your dog?

4631780.title: Paycheck to Paycheck
4631780.short_description: A life sim where you grind late-night jobs to pay off debt. Manage hunger and fatigue as you work. Want a shot at turning your life around? Scratch and pray!

4632020.title: Historarium
4632020.short_description: Shape continents, civilizations, and see the rise and fall of empires. Follow individual characters as they rise to power. Or as mighty rulers fall to irrelevance. Create nations and see them evolve through the centuries. Or destroy it all and watch civilization react to your actions.

4632490.title: 紀事盆栽 Potted Archive
4632490.short_description: Potted Archive is an idle desktop companion blending sci-fi storytelling with plant cultivation. Grow over 20 exotic plants in a transparent, low-energy window. As they evolve, unlock diary entries to uncover an epic tale of interstellar exile right from your screen.

4632560.title: KILLWORLD
4632560.short_description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

4632690.title: Papers or Death ⏱️
4632690.short_description: Screen travelers in a post-war world where lies are common. Check documents, spot inconsistencies, and decide who passes. Take bribes or stay honest—your choices shape the outcome. No action, just tension, tough calls, and hidden truths.

4633650.title: Cluckin' Crash
4633650.short_description: Cluckin’ Crash is an asymmetrical multiplayer party game where a chicken sprints through wild platform courses while a driver tries to crash, ram, and knock it off the map. Fast-paced best-of-five rounds create unpredictable physics chaos.

4633700.title: Feast for Frogs
4633700.short_description: Leap into this incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

4633710.title: Melody Teacher
4633710.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

4634360.title: Mio: Resonance
4634360.short_description: Talk in real time with AI characters who remember you. Customize their personality, appearance, and voice, then keep your unique companion by your side in desktop companion mode.

4634690.title: Pilipka
4634690.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure based on Belarusian mythology and folklore. Pilipka just wanted to finish his shift at karchma and come home for dinner. And then so much happened that now he has to go on a trip to get Fern Flower in the company of his friend, a talking mouse.

4634750.title: Debts & Jackpots
4634750.short_description: Start broke, crack safes, chase jackpots, and build your fortune. Upgrade your operation, hunt for rare treasures, and fight your way out of crushing debt!

4634970.title: The Shaman: What's in Your House?
4634970.short_description: "Something is in your house." As a Shaman, you are the only one who can face the unknown. Investigate haunted homes, uncover secrets, and exorcise malevolent spirits. Your choices determine the client's fate. Experience a chilling K-horror story where every decision matters.

4635160.title: Dawn's Wake
4635160.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

4635290.title: Grave Mistakes
4635290.short_description: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

4635330.title: Mini Survival: final adventure
4635330.short_description: Build a shelter in a world overrun by zombies. Recruit survivors, grow food, craft equipment and venture into dangerous regions for supplies. Fortify your base, defend against zombie waves and bring rescued pets along on your next expedition.

4635380.title: 天机：大唐重构
4635380.short_description: Tianji: Reforging Tang is a 2D side-view deckbuilding rogue-like set in an alternate late Tang Dynasty. Play as a modern science student, build Physics and Chemistry decks, break enemy armor, read hidden intents, and reshape the fate of Tang.

4636160.title: Rowan Needs Shinies!
4636160.short_description: [NO AI] A whimsical incremental game with a colorful cast of critters. Help the greedy crow Rowan gather more shinies with the help of the local wildlife. Discover how to craft strange potions and empower your new friends. All so that you can gather EVEN MORE SHINIES!

4636180.title: Cook Cook Village ~!
4636180.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

4636260.title: Caravanserai Simulator
4636260.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

4636430.title: Memory Farm
4636430.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

4636640.title: increTower
4636640.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game. Upgrade your tower, upgrade your enemies, repeat!

4636700.title: Fishing Fever
4636700.short_description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 75 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

4636740.title: Meteor Shower
4636740.short_description: Blast away never-ending hordes of falling meteors in this incremental tower defense game! Smash rocks to pieces with railguns, flak cannons, giant lasers and more as you work to defend your base from the stellar onslaught.

4636750.title: Loot The World: Three Kings
4636750.short_description: An infinite procedural RPG. Explore a dangerous world, roll the dice in combat, loot everything, and hunt down the Three Kings.

4636810.title: What Was Lost
4636810.short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 4 in Early Access, with Chapters 5 to 7 coming in free updates.

4637130.title: Snackrifice
4637130.short_description: Satisfy your ravenous appetite by slaying the Old Gods of a ruined, forsaken realm, and use their corpses as ingredients for the ultimate divine sandwich! Master your skills, timing and determination to deflect their unique and challenging attacks in this Boss Rush.

4637680.title: Index 1391
4637680.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

4638060.title: Rogues & Fate
4638060.short_description: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

4638280.title: Peter the Stash Hunter
4638280.short_description: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

4638290.title: Card of Fate
4638290.short_description: Card of Fate is a roguelike deckbuilder where you wander the path to Heaven or Hell. Construct a powerful deck, find legendary relics, and defeat the guardians of the afterlife. Will you master the celestial arts of the Angel or the devastating fury of the Demon?

4638780.title: XENOFALL
4638780.short_description: A single-player anime action roguelite on a ravaged Earth. Slash and shoot through alien horrors across hostile stages, stack game-breaking item synergies, and master 5 fighter classes. Every run is different. Every death makes you stronger.

4639140.title: Dough it Yourself
4639140.short_description: Run a cozy bakery where every ingredient comes from your own farm. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into flour, butter and jam. Bake fresh bread, serve hungry customers, get to know the regulars, and grow your bakery one step at a time.

4639170.title: Tileburg
4639170.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

4639240.title: Gladiator's Revenge
4639240.short_description: A roguelite where you are the gladiator. Pick one of nine fighters, each with a strength and a weakness. Walk the map, choose your fights and rise from slave to champion. Every win brings a new skill. Buy armor you can see on your fighter, and find 100+ items that change how you fight.

4639410.title: Signal Zero
4639410.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

4639450.title: CandyPop
4639450.short_description: The Great Sweet Battle Begins! "CandyPop" is a confectionery war set in the Land of Sweets! A top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game! Are you ready?

4639710.title: Steel Horse
4639710.short_description: Muster your knights, call upon your champions, bring forth your... M4A4 Sherman? Steel Horse is an atypical fantasy turn-based strategy game. Take control of Samuel and Andrew, two tankers from the far future of 2025 summoned to this world to save it from its own rabid wild taken form!

4640550.title: Street Food Restaurant Owner
4640550.short_description: Build your own street food business! Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, manage ingredients, unlock new recipes, and protect your reputation as you transform a small local food stall into a legendary destination.

4641210.title: Get-Out-Hoomanz
4641210.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

4641260.title: All Night Ascension
4641260.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler built on a three-layer Bagua board. Arrange methods, artifacts, and materials to unleash flying swords and cannons, ascend through realms, and time your Domain to turn asynchronous duels. Try the free demo—three sects planned for Early Access.

4641990.title: Blokour
4641990.short_description: Jump, build and fight through the dungeons of Blokour! In this puzzle platformer, you place and break blocks whilst solving puzzles and dodging dangerous traps. Featuring 125 levels, 4 boss fights and more than 60 different types of blocks, you'll venture through a wide range of exciting challenges.

4642090.title: Urban Feather
4642090.short_description: Urban Feather is a local co-op digital tabletop game for 1-4 players about avian migration. Navigate a procedurally generated city, manage environmental hazards, and learn real-world strategies to prevent bird-window collisions.

4642250.title: Prevent WW3
4642250.short_description: You have no direct power - only diplomacy and influence. A global strategy game where you lead an international organization: stop conflicts, resolve economic crises, and restore stability before the world descends into chaos.

4642350.title: Pachinko Life
4642350.short_description: A bullet hell pachinko roguelite where the board shoots back.

4642410.title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
4642410.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, fortify the frontier and crush the alien swarm in a story campaign, survival operations or online co-op for up to four players.

4642670.title: 超时空怪盗
4642670.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

4642770.title: Rock Diver
4642770.short_description: Become a Rock Diver as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and get nice and friendly with hordes of local wildlife.

4643190.title: 回圈Loop
4643190.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

4643500.title: Rex Summons a Meteor
4643500.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You helped a wizard wish on a shooting star, and got a meteor instead. Every dinosaur talks in emoji: work out what each one wants, find it, and play absurd mini-games like skateboarding and rhythm duets. No timer, no game over. Now go save the dinosaurs.

4644230.title: Triad: Elemental Saga
4644230.short_description: A tactical card battler with dynamic decks. Pick three heroes, each channeling Fire, Water, Earth, or Air, each chasing a personal quest. Complete in-match quests to earn resources, and unlock epic items and spells from your Archives.

4644470.title: Neon Arcade
4644470.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

4644480.title: Dungeonery
4644480.short_description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

4644500.title: Fearless Crew
4644500.short_description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

4644540.title: Kindred Pieces
4644540.short_description: Kindred Pieces is a relaxing world-builder where you shape beautiful landscapes one hex tile at a time. Discover 6 unique biomes, unlock cute characters, and master a subtle layer of strategy to build the biggest world imaginable.

4644550.title: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
4644550.short_description: In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it. Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: find out how this story truly ended.

4644870.title: Green Mist over Portland
4644870.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

4645020.title: SpringTale
4645020.short_description: Explore, fight and play together in a roguelike platformer MMO. Adventure through changing worlds, meet other players along the way and team up to take on challenging bosses. Collect powerful gear that shapes how you play.

4645450.title: Exipath
4645450.short_description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

4645710.title: Mother ZERO
4645710.short_description: In Mother ZERO, a cyberpunk action-adventure game, fight your way through a decaying world full of mysteries and threats. Explore deep underground bunkers, battle corrupted creatures, and encounter bizarre characters.

4645990.title: Block Machine
4645990.short_description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

4646270.title: Her Name Was April
4646270.short_description: Her Name Was April is a 3D platform game developed by a single developer. It aims to stand out with its story and visuals, while also not being overly difficult.

4646290.title: Animal Clicking
4646290.short_description: Animal Clicking is a cute, cozy island builder that blends farming, automation, and resource management with the addictive gameplay loop of clicker games into a completely new sandbox experience.

4646420.title: On Time In Full
4646420.short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

4646760.title: War for Ylinthia
4646760.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

4650000.title: CRIKEYMAS
4650000.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

4650640.title: MeowRig
4650640.short_description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

4650800.title: Mafia Boss Simulator
4650800.short_description: They shot you on your own driveway. Now dig your way back. MAFIA BOSS SIMULATOR is a cinematic crime saga from 1920s Sicily to 1950s New York — stealth, driving, shootouts, and a story of loyalty, betrayal, and the price of the crown. Welcome to the Family.

4651300.title: Hotel Paraíso
4651300.short_description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by ghosts in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Battles play like tactical puzzles: match colors, chain combos and stop the ghosts before they cross the board. Meet its animal guests and uncover what tore the worlds apart.

4651710.title: IN:DARK RECALL
4651710.short_description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

4651810.title: Adventures in tower defence land
4651810.short_description: Go on an epic tower defence adventure, collect rare parts, and craft the ultimate combination of towers, while meeting silly characters on your way.

4652050.title: Gunshot Arcade
4652050.short_description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and reach a new record, good luck.

4652090.title: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
4652090.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

4652300.title: Tax On Dice
4652300.short_description: Help Gibo to collect the King's taxes. Every season, roll dice to send Gibo in corresponding towns and collect their resources. In your downtime, buy dice and town upgrades to satisfy the ever-growing King's greed.

4652830.title: Synapse Idle
4652830.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

4652840.title: Waddle Detour
4652840.short_description: Help Waddly, a very likeable penguin, reach his fishing spot in a deceptively cute but seriously challenging puzzle game. Combine blocks, harness their unique abilities, and find your very own solution so Waddly doesn't stay hungry for much longer!

4653100.title: Train Set Code
4653100.short_description: Aim for a high score by creating complex train set layouts. Program points and signals to direct trains and keep them moving. Run more and more trains… but don’t let them crash!

4653190.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
4653190.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

4653250.title: Cats And Pillows
4653250.short_description: Run a cozy cat shelter where every whiskered guest has their own needs! Place shy cats in quiet corners, sleepy cats on soft pillows, playful cats near fun spots, and stinky cats away from sensitive noses. Each level brings a new cozy setting and a fresh puzzle full of picky little paws.

4653380.title: Anvilia
4653380.short_description: Cozy crafting meets chaotic fantasy adventure. Forge every tool by hand with friends, open your shop and serve customers while your dog chases thieves. Then step through the portal into living caves and forests full of rare loot and monsters. Mine it, forge it, sell it, explore deeper. Repeat.

4653480.title: Greebly Gambit
4653480.short_description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

4653530.title: Red Rising
4653530.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

4653750.title: The Brave Few
4653750.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

4654240.title: Beyond The Blight
4654240.short_description: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

4654450.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
4654450.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

4654600.title: Just a Clicker Game
4654600.short_description: Acquire energy. Build a city. Consume the universe. Just a Clicker Game is a darkly humorous incremental experience where your quest for efficiency might just break reality. Manage simulation instability, unlock the massive Neural Tree, and remember: the Ducky Council is always watching.

4654980.title: Bio-Breaker
4654980.short_description: Fight against over 30+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

4654990.title: Not a Trolley Problem!
4654990.short_description: A trolley-problem incremental where morals gave way to growing numbers. Instead of choosing whom to save, you throw people onto the tracks yourself, earn coins, grow an upgrade tree and hunt for rare residents.

4655010.title: Digi Dice
4655010.short_description: A rogue-like dice-building game. Craft your own dice, play them strategically, upgrade your modifiers and discover magnificent combos.

4655030.title: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth
4655030.short_description: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure. Journey across the Eternal Continent, where the Theocracy, Gaia faction, and forces of Sin struggle for power. Explore dangerous regions, battle powerful enemies, and collect the scattered fragments of the Rebirth Relic.

4655060.title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
4655060.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

4655290.title: School Owner Simulator
4655290.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

4655620.title: PrayPal
4655620.short_description: PrayPal is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play as an overworked god, build divine Authority decks, and squeeze faith out of mortals to survive your next performance review.

4655750.title: Trucker: Master Drivers
4655750.short_description: Experience the realistic truck driving experience in Türkiye, and start your journey to becoming MASTER DRIVERS through realistic vehicle breakdowns and road experiences.

4655770.title: Rune Tavern
4655770.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

4655890.title: The Park Keeper
4655890.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

4656770.title: Mobius
4656770.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

4656880.title: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
4656880.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

4657650.title: DAIMIENS TOWN OF WITCHES
4657650.short_description: Open a cursed book and awaken as a witch in a dark 18th-century world. Fight with sword and magic, brew potions, complete rituals, collect cards, transform your body and summon mystical animal companions while uncovering a story that crosses time.

4657730.title: Grandpa Needs Fish
4657730.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

4657840.title: PolyFarm
4657840.short_description: PolyFarm is a relaxing and satisfying farm simulator in isometric view.

4657860.title: GranEndeSaga
4657860.short_description: Find the legendary hero Neo and reclaim your identity!

4657890.title: Destroy The Moon
4657890.short_description: A cosmic survivors-like where every upgrade brings you closer to becoming a living superweapon. Burn through alien hordes, rupture pocket dimensions, escape black holes, and survive the cosmic war for the Moon.

4657930.title: Dwarven Shift 98
4657930.short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

4658040.title: The Sons of Earth
4658040.short_description: An asymmetric hex wargame about occupation and insurgency. Command the alien Verkhan Empire pacifying a human world — or the fractured Sons of Earth fighting to reclaim it.

4658160.title: Reach The Banana
4658160.short_description: A chaotic two-player climbing game where you control one monkey together, one arm each, and battle physics, panic, terrible coordination, mistimed grabs, desperate recoveries, and an endless chain of bad decisions on every climb.

4658230.title: DANCE DANCE INCREMENTAL
4658230.short_description: Hit incoming notes to collect bytes. Spend them to upgrade your device, build your army, and download new tracks! Dance Dance Incremental is a rhythm incremental game inside your own Y2K mp3 player.

4658480.title: Chromagami
4658480.short_description: Rip and tear through the competition in Chromagami, an interdimensional, fast-paced, handmade (literally) hero shooter. With 3 distinct origami characters, paper-built maps, and a boxload full of wacky events, learn to outfold both your friends and foes by putting them through the shredder!

4658550.title: ALL GAS
4658550.short_description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a highway that crumbles behind you as you drive. Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic. Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

4658620.title: Silicon Architect
4658620.short_description: An incremental hardware engineering game with a Windows XP themed UI. Configure and optimize processor components, build your own CPU, and run automated benchmarks. Harvest telemetry and gather research funding to unlock new hardware, and scale your processing power.

4658980.title: Wuxia Life
4658980.short_description: You never truly knew your father. Wuxia Life is a single-player wuxia RPG set on Yingzhou. Investigate his death and your origins, expose the Blacktide Gang's betrayal of Yingzhou, and shape your ending through ATB combat, Five Inner Voices, inner demons, and the Heavenly Storyteller.

4659110.title: AllWheelDrive
4659110.short_description: Drive a single vehicle together, literally. In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

4659180.title: sh2dow cat
4659180.short_description: A feline game of light and shadow! sh2dow cat is a puzzle platformer that combines two 2D perspectives. Switch between a physical white cat and a shadow cat, and use the light to find your way through the levels.

4659400.title: Supernatural Archives：The Frontrooms
4659400.short_description: A first-person light psychological horror exploration game. Explore unknown spaces, observe environmental anomalies, discover hidden clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets behind the Frontrooms.

4659460.title: SALMON
4659460.short_description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels satisfying and ridiculous. Jump off walls, race against your friends, explore the strange world. Most people don't realise how athletic salmon can be.

4659840.title: Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator
4659840.short_description: Become a master weaponsmith in this fantasy simulator! Combine unique parts, materials, and effects to craft countless types of weaponry. Haggle with customers, fulfill orders from across the realm, and build and decorate your dream medieval weapons shop!

4660170.title: Witch Shop Simulator
4660170.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

4660190.title: ZAIBALY
4660190.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

4660480.title: The Plus-One Kingdom
4660480.short_description: In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

4660540.title: Bloody Cleanup TOGETHER
4660540.short_description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered.

4660800.title: Blooming Canvas
4660800.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

4660870.title: DarkCage
4660870.short_description: DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

4660970.title: Spasiba!
4660970.short_description: Build a scrappy deck, chain actions, and outscore your rivals in Spasiba!, a courtyard deck-building card game. Choose your kingdom, find card combinations, and turn a modest starting hand into a winning engine.

4661090.title: Inn Kreeper
4661090.short_description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

4661190.title: INTERRED
4661190.short_description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

4661210.title: Landers
4661210.short_description: Pilot a nimble combat ship through hazardous terrain, complete high-speed objectives, destroy ground threats, collect hidden rewards, and master precision flying in a single-player action campaign built around skill, momentum, and replayability.

4661790.title: 结界大阵：生灵庇护所 Warding Sanctum: Creature Refuge
4661790.short_description: A strategy game blending Xianxia (cultivation) elements with tower defense and settlement-building mechanics. Recruit and cultivate creatures, fuse them into formations, repel demon invasions from the outside world, and build your Creature Sanctuary.

4661890.title: Hexstride
4661890.short_description: Movement is combat. No attack button. Your positioning and movement patterns trigger abilities automatically. Choose your class, complete objectives, and descend deeper into procedurally generated dungeons. Every step is a tactical decision.

4661960.title: Escape to Ariah
4661960.short_description: Master deep skill trees, forge god-tier gear, and carve through relentless hordes in this dark fantasy ARPG. Endless build variety, thrilling boss fights, and endgame adventures await you.

4662040.title: Island Wolves
4662040.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

4662140.title: Goodnight, B
4662140.short_description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore weird, dream-like environments, meet wacky friends, and find secrets to help B discover the ominous truth behind her nightmares!

4662150.title: We Die Below
4662150.short_description: 1–4 player co-op dungeon crawler. Choose your class and gear! Fight through procedural dungeons, complete objectives, and outrun the horrors you awaken. Deep combat. High stakes. Permadeath if your party falls.

4662170.title: Larva
4662170.short_description: LARVA is a tactical co-op horror FPS for up to 4 players. Explore environments, collect valuable loot, face deadly anomalies, and extract before it's too late. Coordinate, survive, and don't go alone.

4662350.title: Chess 2
4662350.short_description: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

4662390.title: RogueBlocks
4662390.short_description: Stack Rows. Beat the Target. Survive the Chaos. RogueBlocks is a comic-inspired roguelite puzzle game that challenges the familiar rules of falling-block games. How far can you push your luck?

4662400.title: Crimson Monarch
4662400.short_description: The old Monarch is dead. Long live the Monarch. Rule over five vampire factions, forge alliances, and decide who lives or dies. Protect the Veil of secrecy or let it burn. Every judgment creates friends or enemies in a high-stakes political visual novel

4662880.title: Quarter Note Cafe
4662880.short_description: Act as Charithy, serving coffee to cultists, instruments and the regular passerby from your coffee shop in a city filled with all sorts of weird, kind and potentially dangerous people.

4662960.title: Project: C.E.L.L.
4662960.short_description: An arcade incremental where you break glucose, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn ATP into powerful upgrades. Experiment with different builds, discover powerful combinations, and push a retro-futuristic cell simulation to its limits.

4663390.title: Order of Beast
4663390.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite with deep builds, stunning painterly art, and compelling fragmented storytelling. Shape each skill through randomized upgrades with Path of Exile–style build depth. Explore a beautiful, decaying dark fantasy world and uncover the buried past of the Order of Beast.

4663670.title: Defend The Nest
4663670.short_description: Help two super intelligent crows make silly weapons out of whatever junk they can find in a city park, and then watch them fight off a horde of critters. A relaxing and yet chaotic auto battling roguelike.

4663840.title: S4NCTU4RY
4663840.short_description: A cyberpunk bar that runs at the bottom of your screen. Build your menu around the synergies of 50 cocktails, and welcome 15 guests in Story Mode. Your job is to make one drink a sanctuary for the exhausted.

4664310.title: Underking
4664310.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

4664490.title: Burger Smash
4664490.short_description: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced single-player cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

4664610.title: Academ Dreams
4664610.short_description: An unhinged genius returns to his childhood town in search of a dream, only to uncover dark secrets from the past. People vanish in the forest, fires that raise the dead burn by the “cursed” sea, and demon bikers throw wild parties. Can he find himself amid the chaos?

4664790.title: Oh, For Bugs' Sake!
4664790.short_description: Team up with a cute spider family in this cartoonish asymmetric co-op platformer where communication and coordination are crucial. Avoid electrified cables and dodge one extremely angry giant finger who really, really wants to squash you.

4664860.title: Sail On
4664860.short_description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

4664980.title: Fox Two Protocol
4664980.short_description: Hit the afterburners in modern fighter combat. Fly the campaign, duel in PvP, race through Time Attack or take on an endless mission. Build your own mix of upgrades and equipment, then find a reason for one more sortie.

4665270.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
4665270.short_description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

4666130.title: Echo of Me
4666130.short_description: Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. Explore a maze of memories, solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and uncover notes as you piece together a story in which every new answer changes the meaning of what came before.

4666440.title: Crounds
4666440.short_description: Crounds is a fast-paced PvP chess roguelike. Choose a powerful King, draft game-breaking upgrades, and bend the traditional rules of chess to destroy your opponent! Synergize your chaotic upgrades to create your winning strategy!

4666520.title: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
4666520.short_description: A 2D painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.

4666530.title: Signs Of Devourer
4666530.short_description: Its another night shift in the store, except this time you are trapped with monster disguised as one of the items. Keep the floor clean, shelves full, serve the customers... and try to not get devoured until the dawn.

4666750.title: Lang Ops: Corrupted Files
4666750.short_description: Malicious virus attacked your PC which contained all your files! During the recovering process, file code showed as letters in different languages. Therefore, you've created special forces of cursors to counter the corrupted files!

4667260.title: Prison Queen
4667260.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

4667450.title: Backrooms: Savior
4667450.short_description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

4667460.title: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
4667460.short_description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

4667620.title: Chicken and Tank
4667620.short_description: 【鶏和戦車】は、戦車戦闘と戦車改造、資源収集、アイテム製作を中心としたサバイバルRPGゲームで、下馬戦闘も含まれています。

4667970.title: Coldline: Disconnect
4667970.short_description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

4668080.title: VCR83
4668080.short_description: VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

4668110.title: Time To Waste
4668110.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

4668140.title: Groove Core
4668140.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

4668190.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
4668190.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

4668250.title: Mini Sushi Factory
4668250.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

4668350.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
4668350.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

4669050.title: Get Stoned
4669050.short_description: Get Stoned is an incremental tower defense game where players design their own bullet loadouts. Gather resources, unlock unique boulders, and discover game-breaking synergies while defending your castle. It's time for everything to get stoned!

4669140.title: The Real Guest
4669140.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

4669370.title: Cult Inc.
4669370.short_description: Cult Inc. is an incremental clicker where you control and grow a cult. Attract curious outsiders and persuade them into joining the organization. Upgrade your cult, unlock new abilities, and dominate the world through sheer numbers, with a little sacrifice of course.

4669620.title: Defense Of Legends
4669620.short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

4669940.title: Textures Not Found
4669940.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

4670120.title: Still With Me
4670120.short_description: A short psychological horror experience about returning to a familiar place where something has been waiting for you.

4670350.title: Hookeye
4670350.short_description: It's the end of the line. Resist the madness and use questionable bait to just keep fishing. Sacrifice everything for a bigger catch. It has to be worth it.

4670400.title: Dark Brew
4670400.short_description: The darkness surrounding the Odyssey Coffee House is undeniable, but what’s the connection behind these unusual occurrences? Who’s the culprit? Dark Brew is a mystery/thriller cafe simulator set amongst the stars. Play as Leon the racoon, and manage the coffee house while talking to patrons.

4671040.title: Fool
4671040.short_description: You're a jester traveling the realm solving people's problems with the power of juggling. You'll save relationships, resolve conflicts like battles, and even make crops grow all with the mystical power of juggling!

4671100.title: X SPACE: Meditation Pod
4671100.short_description: Work, study or unwind in a sunlit space cabin with a cozy companion by your side. Set a Pomodoro timer, mix lo-fi music with soft ship ambience, and watch Earth, a nebula or a black hole drift past your window. Every focused hour carries you somewhere new.

4671270.title: Data Breach Inc.
4671270.short_description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

4671450.title: World of Slime
4671450.short_description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

4671460.title: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传
4671460.short_description: 这是一款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

4671600.title: Devour The Kingdom
4671600.short_description: Sell ​​your soul to a dark deity and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Gather the troops and devour the kingdom. A mix of incremental and auto-battler.

4671790.title: 豚の背に明日への金貨を
4671790.short_description: Is it hope you carry, or a heavy burden? Tomorrow’s Coins, Pig’s Back is a roguelike action RPG. Brave randomly generated maps that grow larger and deadlier as you ascend. Exchange loot for coins, upgrade your stats, and enhance unique weapons. Your choices forge your path in the abyss.

4671900.title: Eyes Wide Open
4671900.short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

4672190.title: Flippin Broke
4672190.short_description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

4672560.title: Glaring Flaw
4672560.short_description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

4672750.title: Final Rites
4672750.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

4672770.title: Little Writer Desktop Companion
4672770.short_description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

4673010.title: Gridbound
4673010.short_description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

4673370.title: Interzone
4673370.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

4673650.title: Crown Control
4673650.short_description: RPG Roguelike Deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

4674650.title: Eggnob
4674650.short_description: Eggnob is a precision platformer about a flatulent egg. Guide it through multiple traps dressed up as levels. Or don't. Let it die, see if I care. Floors vanish, spikes appear, the exit lies. Drag that Egg through hell. It won't thank you. It can't. It's a stupid Egg.

4674770.title: Throneforged
4674770.short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists. Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

4674810.title: Broke Street
4674810.short_description: A 1-6 player co-op roguelike trading sim where you and your friends start broke at a Wall Street hedge fund. Share one balance, make risky trades, use items to find winning strategies, and hit rising quotas to survive each day. Fail, and pay the price.

4675640.title: Sellsword
4675640.short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

4676120.title: Vestalborne
4676120.short_description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

4676180.title: Severed Souls — Chapter I
4676180.short_description: Above, a floating golden city promises utopia. Below lies an abyss of poverty and despair. In this parallel narrative RPG, guide two brothers separated at birth: a royal heir and a slum orphan raised by a stray dog. Will you bridge their severed worlds, or doom them to a fatal collision?

4676660.title: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
4676660.short_description: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.

4676820.title: Trigger Range
4676820.short_description: A fast-paced, competitive shooting range game where speed and precision are everything. It's like Track Mania with guns.

4677580.title: Flagship Down
4677580.short_description: Tactical roguelike auto-battler. Assemble your fleet and equip your flagship with modules and weapons. Recruit and assign crew members to your ships. Start the round and watch your strategy unfold in fully automated battles.

4678500.title: Crack a Pack
4678500.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

4678530.title: Shape Wars
4678530.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

4679490.title: Mirrorbane
4679490.short_description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world with atmospheric pixel art. Recruit unique heroes, combine their cards into a single deck, and develop your team in town between expeditions.

4679710.title: Tetrush
4679710.short_description: Based on a fake mobile game ad, "Tetrush" brings the classic puzzle game Tetris to an infinitely-rotating board of 31 columns. Because of its larger size, there also are more difficult pieces to place. Drop carefully.

4679730.title: Estancia Protocol Zero
4679730.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4680260.title: Pirates Dig Deeper
4680260.short_description: Dig with your crew. Defend with your cannons. Pirates Dig Deeper is a co-op blend of digging and tower defense. Descend into the island, fight off rival pirates, and unseal the ancient temple to steal the elixir of immortality.

4681180.title: A Court of Seven Crowns
4681180.short_description: Navigate a web of intrigue and assassination to make peace among warring fae! The fate of their realms and yours is in your hands! A text-based interactive novel.

4681370.title: DeadLoop
