4681370.short_description: DeadLoop is an underwater sandbox set in a miniature ocean inside a glass cube. Raise a flock of water sheep, discover rare breeds and colors, and keep your coral reef thriving. Then summon a storm or a whirlpool and see how your flock reacts.

4681560.title: Leadville
4681560.short_description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

4681710.title: Now With More Plunk
4681710.short_description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

4681770.title: Everfront
4681770.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

4682090.title: Waywardens
4682090.short_description: Lead three heroes with one shared deck in a dark fantasy tactical roguelite. Play each card as an action or a chess-inspired move. Read enemy attacks, break their formation and turn a desperate hand into a winning plan. Build your company. Brave the road.

4682150.title: Crafty Marbles
4682150.short_description: Build whatever you want for your marbles! Crazy machines, incredible races, spectacular chain reactions, frantic battles or anything else! Turn any idea into organized chaos!

4682870.title: Star Talent
4682870.short_description: Run a Hollywood talent agency from a one-room office to the top of the industry. Scout unknowns, sign stars, negotiate the deals and fight rival agencies for every role, in a living, deeply simulated film world where every career is yours to make or break.

4683110.title: Billionaire Life Simulator
4683110.short_description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

4683140.title: Vanguard Tides
4683140.short_description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

4683250.title: Ragnarok Mining Co.
4683250.short_description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

4683390.title: Defend Your Fish
4683390.short_description: An Arcade style strategy game where you must protect your bucket of fish from crabs, seagulls, and other such enemies. The goal is to survive as long as possible to build up your score, earn coins to unlock cosmetics and upgrades to help your future runs!

4683450.title: Carpet Racers
4683450.short_description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

4683550.title: Farmdustry
4683550.short_description: Cozy farm automation game: lay roads, send out cute cargo bots and turn wheat into bread, then bigger recipes. No timers, no fail states. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 friends.

4684030.title: SpellMart: Monster Girl Shop Simulator
4684030.short_description: Build your dream magical shop in SpellMart! Stock modern potions, set competitive prices, and manage a quirky team of Monster Girls in a vibrant neon world. A stylish tycoon simulator where retail strategy meets anime charm. Can you turn magic into big business?

4684120.title: It Was Not a Suicide
4684120.short_description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

4684430.title: Quadfort
4684430.short_description: Build a ring. Break theirs. QUADFORT is an arcade strategy party game for 1–4 players: snap walls around your fortress, arm it with cannons and aim every shot yourself. Play with friends on one screen or online, or climb the 15-stage solo campaign. A new island every match.

4684480.title: DECASTLE
4684480.short_description: A turn-based medieval fantasy deck-building game where every card shapes how you break enemy castles. Build your deck, plan your strategy, and unleash powerful actions to collapse fortifications in stylized, physics-driven battles.

4684610.title: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom
4684610.short_description: A Knight's Fury is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler built for one lone knight. Choose attacks to exploit each monster's weaknesses, gather loot, upgrade your gear, and venture deeper into dangerous fantasy realms—without party management or endless grinding.

4684640.title: Reefdeck
4684640.short_description: What if your deck was made of fish? Reefdeck is a cartoon underwater auto-battler roguelike where you collect, deploy, and battle absurd sea creatures. Crack open coral packs, build your roster, and survive bullet hell chaos beneath the waves.

4684930.title: MEMORY DEALER
4684930.short_description: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.

4685120.title: Ravenous Greed
4685120.short_description: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

4685310.title: Chrongrid
4685310.short_description: Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative experience. Inside an author's story blueprint, you make your own choices and the world responds in its own way — every choice echoes, no two journeys alike. Built-in blueprints are the start; play others' stories or write your own, in any language.

4685480.title: PAWTENTIAL DISASTER
4685480.short_description: A chaotic physics co-op game where a pack of dogs must get one very unlucky baby back home and a avoid Pawtential Disaster.

4685950.title: Incremental Ants
4685950.short_description: Hatch ants. Explore parks. Steal picnic baskets. Incremental Ants is a game about growing an ant colony. Gather food using a variety of ants, upgrade their skills, unlock new species, and expand into territory where no ant has gone before.

4686590.title: Belt Nine
4686590.short_description: A neon vector shooter on rails. On the run in a stolen ship, slide down the Belt and blast through corpo hunters, fighter squadrons, krakens and things that should not live in space. Stack power-ups, ride the turbo for score, and see how far one hull can carry you. The run never ends. You do.

4687570.title: DIG! DIG! DIG!
4687570.short_description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

4687640.title: JERONIMO
4687640.short_description: JERONIMO is a roguelite shooter where you play as the Eraser against your eternal enemy: the Drawer, a frantic pencil who summons waves from his rolling lab. Wield up to 6 unique weapons, stack broken builds, and crush the hordes. Every enemy is a drawing from my 6-year-old nephew's notebook.

4688000.title: Chonkstars
4688000.short_description: Chonkstars is the ultimate multiplayer showdown where food is your weapon and being hefty is your greatest strength! In this arena, you'll be tossing pizzas, slinging fish, throwing eggs, and serving up absolute chaos. Gear up, because the fight to become the heavyweight champion has just begun!

4688260.title: Heroes Frontiers
4688260.short_description: A charming, bustling colony sim in retro pixel art. Carve thriving towns out of an untamed fantasy world. Recruit heroes to defend them or send them questing for fame and loot, and survive a procedurally generated continent full of danger and adventure.

4688400.title: Cats In The Shell
4688400.short_description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

4689230.title: Market Manager Simulator
4689230.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

4689930.title: Spin Cycle
4689930.short_description: A roguelite strategy game where you keep the books for the criminal underworld. Take contracts from cartels and sanctioned regimes, build money routes across dozens of jurisdictions, play the market of sanctioned coins. And try not to annoy Interpol.

4690210.title: Snowday Co
4690210.short_description: Start with just a shovel and build your snow plowing business across an open-world town. Take on jobs, expand your territory, and keep up with whatever the winter throws at you.

4690270.title: Arena 2006
4690270.short_description: A sci-fi shooter inspired by the golden '06 era: a story campaign, arena modes with bots or online play, drivable cars and rocket jumps. No waiting queues, no microtransactions, no 60 GB patches. We're here to frag.

4690380.title: Memoware
4690380.short_description: MEMOWARE! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle game where you must record the history of civilizations that vanished without a trace in a mountain with no name. Collect all the MEMORIES and organize them in each book of each civilization in chronological order.

4690580.title: Astral Industrial Complex
4690580.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

4690620.title: Most Scuffed Golf
4690620.short_description: Tired of the same old mini-golf courses? In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own! Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale. The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

4691240.title: Bowl Big
4691240.short_description: An incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Unlock a tech tree. Upgrade pins and balls. Dodge obstacles. Watch numbers skyrocket. Ditch the 10-pin limit and Bowl Big!

4691290.title: ONE MAN'S DECEIT
4691290.short_description: One Man's Deceit is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. Explore a world filled with secrets, search for clues, follow your instincts, survive deadly encounters, and fight different creatures on your journey.

4691890.title: Unlander
4691890.short_description: Unlander is a survival video game where you explore the never-ending world of the banished. From hunger to monsters, everything is set to kill you. Uniquely, every action must be played with dices. As you progress, you will find upgrades and you’ll craft stronger items to defeat the nightmares.

4692500.title: No One Returns
4692500.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

4692870.title: ZArmory
4692870.short_description: You won't pull the trigger. You'll make sure it never jams. Arm the last remnants of humanity against endless zombie hordes. From the "safety" of your workshop.

4693120.title: Norselings
4693120.short_description: Guide your Norse clan from Helheim to Asgard through runestone strikes and the rise of a Norseling settlement.

4693440.title: Slime to Me
4693440.short_description: Guide your brother's soul, trapped inside a slime, by interacting with mana sources. Solve puzzles and find the path to the portals to bring his soul back home and return it to his body. Can you find the solution with the fewest clicks in each level?

4693580.title: Shelf Shock
4693580.short_description: Shelf Shock is a first-person puzzle game taking place in a wacky warehouse. Follow clues, place items, make trickshots, and dodge lasers as you stock the shelves within the time limit.

4693700.title: The Infinite Library
4693700.short_description: A narrative incremental where the UI tells the story. Discover rare Words, craft Phrases, fill shelves until reality buckles. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers.

4693770.title: Still Waters
4693770.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.

4694340.title: XGA SPECIAL EDITION
4694340.short_description: Survive the nightmare of XGA! Trapped in the rotting corpse of a space station, you must explore, fight and hide in this intense Horror-Metroidvania! But remember, XGA is hunting you.... PROUDLY USING NO GENERATIVE AI

4694460.title: Shady Business
4694460.short_description: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

4694720.title: Sleighers
4694720.short_description: A festive anthro-themed hero shooter set in the atmospheric and whimsical Arctic Circle. Choose your class, and help your team decorate and dominate in this more festive twist on the Domination game mode, but watch out for Old Man Winter and his periodic blizzards!

4695230.title: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0
4695230.short_description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

4695500.title: Hello Mayor
4695500.short_description: You are not merely building a city—you are governing it. Plan districts, balance the budget, investigate local problems, chair government meetings, appoint officials, negotiate with investors, and watch every decision travel from public concern to policy, implementation, and consequence.

4695600.title: Space Fighter
4695600.short_description: Experience the unique mix of modern fast-paced multiplayer action with intuitive twin-stick controls and a retro pixelart look. Battle against other pilots in quick PvP sessions of classic versus and space racing - or team up with friends in Co-op to defend against aliens and hunt difficult bosses.

4695660.title: PLANETOON
4695660.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

4695770.title: Hyakki Yagyō: Endless Nights
4695770.short_description: A roguelike dungeon defense game inspired by Dungeon Maker. Recruit mercenaries, set traps, and fortify against nightly yokai hordes. Romance your allies, unleash cinematic ultimate skills, and survive as long as you can — or fall to the Hyakki Yagyo.

4695780.title: TAILS GEAR HD
4695780.short_description: A revamped version of "Tales Gear," originally released in 2007, featuring high-resolution support, new systems, and rearranged background music. A full-fledged 2.5D vertical-scrolling shooter characterized by the Tail Pod, an optional weapon that combines offense and defense.

4695950.title: Censor Me Totally
4695950.short_description: An absurd censor simulator in the Committee of Public Happiness. Censor images and texts, wheel and deal, chase the money, solve problems, try not to get caught, spread your wings, and keep your sanity.

4696040.title: Always Summer Out Here
4696040.short_description: Always Summer Out Here is a visual novel about life in a small post-soviet town with management elements. Atmospheric locations, soulful dialogues, non-linear questlines, and tough decisions that shape the game world await you. Welcome to the Province!

4696190.title: 江湖藏锋
4696190.short_description: Jianghu: Hidden Edge is a hardcore turn-based Roguelike RPG blending deckbuilding and inventory management. Lead your martial artists through the perilous grid map—will you risk all for legendary gear or retreat with your haul? Uncover the conspiracy brewing in Songhe Town.

4696210.title: Five Nights at Bowl City High School
4696210.short_description: You've just been hired at Bowl City High School, but its not what it seems... Use your flashlight to light up the office and look for lurking teachers, locate hiding spots to survive, and block off vents to stop them from getting into your office. Most importantly, however, you must stop Mr. Gut...

4696280.title: Death by Taxes
4696280.short_description: A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes. Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

4696520.title: Arena Bot Manager
4696520.short_description: Manage a scrapyard bot-fighting team on the Lunar Ring World and prove your worth in brutal, high-stakes arena matches. Build machines from scrap, hire a team of engineers and programmers to give you an advantage, and wreck your opponents as you rise the ranks. Wreck - Rebuild - Repeat 'til you win.

4696800.title: Standard Procedure
4696800.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op espionage experience where you and your friends do dirty jobs for the government.

4697150.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
4697150.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

4697630.title: Quillzyra
4697630.short_description: Create persistent AI characters, shape their personalities and relationships, and chat privately on your own device. Three conversation quality levels are included. Add local portrait generation with the optional NVIDIA DLC.

4698090.title: The Encroaching
4698090.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

4698660.title: I Chew, Therefore I Am
4698660.short_description: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

4698700.title: Deep Space Observatory
4698700.short_description: Scan the stars, unlock technologies, automate data collection, and build an ever more efficient observatory.

4699060.title: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame
4699060.short_description: WW2 turn-based aircraft war game that puts you in the USAAF/USAF, RAF or Luftwaffe air operations HQs. Build your squadrons, wings, air bases & pilots. Engage in bombing missions, dogfights & interceptions over Britain, N. Africa & Europe. Historical & what-if fighter/bomber airplane game scenarios

4699170.title: Mataha
4699170.short_description: You are in an ever-shifting maze, with countless enemies who are tasked with keeping you imprisoned. Can you unlock the secrets of Mataha and find your way out? And Remember you lose everything on death, except what you have learned about the maze, it's guards and yourself.

4699220.title: Lone Lines: RPG
4699220.short_description: An atmospheric damn stylish 3D roguelike that will hurt you. Or make you feel good. The honest randomness of the Dead World is unfair to the fragile Rover and the Pilot connected to it. Rejoice, suffer, level up, and dive deeper into a universe After Absolutely Everything.

4700360.title: Gearomancer
4700360.short_description: Step into the mechanical apocalypse in Gearomancer, a fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite. Play as elite V.E.R.T.E.X. agents to dodge brutal bullet hells and obliterate elemental horrors. Harvest Arcane crystals, forge permanent upgrades at your hub, and die to return stronger than ever.

4700420.title: SKEW
4700420.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

4700540.title: Vehicle Game
4700540.short_description: It is a game where you gather resources, secure food, and build structures to survive to the very end.

4700550.title: Handwalk
4700550.short_description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

4700720.title: In Game Leader
4700720.short_description: Become your teams In-Game Leader and lead your team of 5 agents to victory.

4701410.title: Alchemist Chronicles
4701410.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

4701810.title: Pistol Cat
4701810.short_description: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

4701930.title: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
4701930.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

4702010.title: Final Life Simulator
4702010.short_description: Rise from the streets to a financial empire in continuous real time ⏱️. A deep life and economic sim ticking second by second with zero idle shortcuts: work interactive shifts 💼, manage stores 🏢, secure mortgages 🏠, invest in gold & crypto 🥇, and trade options with real Greeks 📈.

4702140.title: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
4702140.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

4702230.title: Hip to be Squared
4702230.short_description: Hip to be Squared is a fast paced, bullet hell dungeon crawler where you create insane builds to clear an ever changing dungeon filled with abstract enemies. All enemies in Hip to be Squared attack in sync with the music. The only path to success is to choose your upgrades wisely.

4702350.title: Design my drink!
4702350.short_description: Create drinks! Unlock more decorations, flavors and options for your drinks. Restore and manage your little cafe and meet locals.

4702440.title: Sunder
4702440.short_description: Sunder is an orbital-artillery RTS in a living star system. Every world is a gun platform on a moving orbit: bend shots around the sun, shove planets off their rails, and crack rival worlds to the core. Draft your arsenal as you fight — solo skirmishes or online war with up to 8 players.

4702610.title: Crimson Animatronic
4702610.short_description: Choose your path, survive, break your mouse from button mashing and reach disturbing endings! In this analog horror visual novel, you play as werecat radio host Daiane, who must survive the Crimson Order, a cursed cult of vampires, and Charkelene Chan, a massive red maned wolf animatronic!

4702660.title: AI Slop TCG
4702660.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike where a cheating AI drags you through a digital wasteland of twisted creatures. Build your deck, survive the chaos, and win a game that doesn’t want to be fair.

4702730.title: Wuxing - Elemental Array Poker
4702730.short_description: Poker hands aren't just played here — they're placed. Drop each card onto a 3×3 altar where the Five Elements feed and fight their neighbors, cascading multipliers across the board. A roguelike deckbuilder about space, not sequence.

4702900.title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
4702900.short_description: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique!🍫 Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

4702910.title: Scope Creep
4702910.short_description: Scope Creep is a roguelike first-person shooter set in abandoned places where strange occurrences are spreading. Each run takes you through randomly generated levels. Scavenge supplies, fight off unwanted “pests,” and push deeper to clear the area again and again much like this never ending project.

4702990.title: Roam
4702990.short_description: A fantasy turn based tableau building strategy game. Designed by Red Raven Games.

4703140.title: Orbit Crisis
4703140.short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

4703230.title: While 1
4703230.short_description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

4703240.title: Freshly Caught
4703240.short_description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

4703250.title: Tiny Patisserie
4703250.short_description: Run your own cozy pastry shop. 🍰 Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

4703930.title: Grilluminati
4703930.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

4704000.title: Shark Mart
4704000.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

4704260.title: Aptacris : Dipolos Anomalia
4704260.short_description: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds. Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles. Play as Ai'Lynn, searching for a fragment within her own mind.

4704340.title: Green Space
4704340.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

4704370.title: Squeak
4704370.short_description: Squeak is a cooperative tactical game for 2 players about the symbiosis of Spirit and Human. Choose your role, unlocking unique ways to interact with the world. Combine your abilities and act as one to overcome the trials.

4704420.title: runz
4704420.short_description: RUNZ is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where every bullet in your magazine matters. Draft bullets like an auto-battler, combine three of a kind, stack synergies and upgrade your gun to survive 20 waves.

4704590.title: The Veiled Moon: Tengu
4704590.short_description: Harness elemental physics to restore the Star-Stone in a mystical Zen world.

4704630.title: Beer Baron: The Brewery Tycoon
4704630.short_description: From backyard to beer baron! Build your 19th-century brewing empire: grow hops, perfect recipes, sign contracts with taverns, and outsmart cunning AI rivals. An atmospheric turn-based economy tycoon with rich Belle Époque charm.

4704810.title: Junebug
4704810.short_description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

4705220.title: Gridforged
4705220.short_description: Forge a powerful army in this roguelike auto-battler. Play 1–4 player co-op across PC and mobile, combine units, empower them with runes, and choose your bosses and Nemesis to conquer.

4705590.title: Capybara Clash
4705590.short_description: These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer.

4705670.title: ALL OUT WAR
4705670.short_description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

4705760.title: Combat Arena Tactics
4705760.short_description: Draft your army and face your opponent in this strategic 1v1 board game. Like chess, we can choose between blitz, rapid, or longer classical matches. What is your ELO going to be?

4706020.title: PRO: Push React Outgun
4706020.short_description: PRO: Push React Outgun, is a next-gen tactical FPS with realistic visuals. Experience the raw impact of close-quarters combat where every bullet counts. Master strategic positioning and razor-sharp reflexes to win. See the unseen, hear the unheard, and survive under pressure.

4707130.title: Neural Repair
4707130.short_description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

4707390.title: To Def Or Not To Def
4707390.short_description: Defend your castle in this roguelite tower defense! Use towers and spells against endless waves of enemies. Merge your towers, build powerful combinations, strengthen your King, and survive as long as you can!

4707430.title: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
4707430.short_description: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

4707580.title: War in Asia
4707580.short_description: Take command of any faction in the East Asian theater of World War II (1937–1945). Govern your nation’s military, economy, and transportation through realistic simulation systems, and direct your forces via a structured chain of command across a 7 km-scale map to conduct operations.

4708010.title: Mountkin
4708010.short_description: Climbing meets Roguelike: climb a corrupted mountain, restore its nature, and build a character powerful enough to reach the summit. Each run brings new synergies to exploit, and new challenges the mountain throws your way. Fall, learn, grow stronger, and climb again.

4708250.title: Mindless as the Mountains
4708250.short_description: Mindless as the Mountains blends platform jumping, lite roguelike and Tarkov-style collection. Embark on an adventure, improve yourself and beat tough challenges. What lies beyond the mountain? Characters join you with different motives, and many mysteries are waiting to be revealed.

4708270.title: The Red Weight
4708270.short_description: A story-rich mystery on Mars where your choices matter. You play as a geologist in a Martian habitat investigating a secret that has been ten thousand years patient.

4708510.title: MAVI
4708510.short_description: MAVI is a casual but challenging Drone flying game. There are many levels with dynamic obstacles getting in your way. There are also targets floating around, get them all and progress through the level. Show your skills while managing the drone's charge and health. Have a fantastic flight.

4708560.title: Backroom Casino Simulator
4708560.short_description: Run an illegal business solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Manage a legitimate storefront, build a secret casino, hire staff, keep customers happy, upgrade security, manipulate the odds, and stay one step ahead of police raids.

4708640.title: Behind Room 102
4708640.short_description: In a dark nation of crime and corruption, you're more than just a hotel worker. Inspect the people in front of you, catch their lies, and make decisions. Your boss expects the best. To survive in this ruthless world, doing what you're told is a MUST! But will you follow every order?

4708690.title: Final Buzzer : Idle Basketball Manager 🏀
4708690.short_description: Basketballs rain onto your street court and every shot that drops earns you cash. Spend it on a 196-node skill tree, grow your squad to 30 shooters, and play real 5v5 pixel-art matches to climb seven leagues. An idle basketball game you can actually watch.

4708780.title: Rookie Raiders
4708780.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

4709020.title: BRAVERUN
4709020.short_description: Thrilling action and epic boss battles! Dash through a 90s-style pixel world in the retro action RPG BRAVERUN — cut through hordes of enemies and face mighty foes!

4709270.title: DEEPWARD
4709270.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

4709890.title: DropCell
4709890.short_description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

4711240.title: Necromania
4711240.short_description: A top-down roguelite with souls-like combat, set in a monster-infested Victorian mansion. Play as members of the necromantic Greville family. Master stamina-based attacks and perfectly timed dodges. Explore ever-changing rooms filled with strange treasures, deadly enemies, and unique weapons.

4711270.title: please have fun in the dream
4711270.short_description: A card game where battles unfold in dreams — use your wits and luck to win fun, exciting duels.

4711640.title: Parcel Panic
4711640.short_description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

4712140.title: Clonefall
4712140.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where your clones are part of the solution. Create clones to reach new places, block hazards, activate mechanisms, and manipulate physics to overcome each challenge.

4712420.title: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
4712420.short_description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters. Chase those online high scores! And if you have a VR headset, play in VR!

4712430.title: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game
4712430.short_description: Roll the dice and conquer the magical board! Upgrade monster lairs, unleash unique character abilities, and bankrupt your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

4713090.title: ai.ai
4713090.short_description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley.

4713100.title: the moon is a gun
4713100.short_description: A planet-defense roguelite where the moon is your gun. Use the planet’s gravity to bend your shots and defend its cities from waves of enemies. Between nights, build your arsenal with new weapons, upgrades and abilities to take down bosses.

4713660.title: The Last Admiral
4713660.short_description: Abandoned on the Outer Rim with four ships, you name a new empire and conquer inward to the galactic core. Fight gridless tactical fleet battles, shove warships into black holes, claim hulls from 14 factions, and face living God Dragons. Lose the run, keep your fleet.

4714080.title: Full Metal Hell
4714080.short_description: A roguelite shooter that combines physics-based collisions, inventory management, and active skills. Choose from a wide range of vehicles, weapons, and builds, then crush everything in your path through the machine hordes!

4714090.title: FOXFIRE
4714090.short_description: Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

4714420.title: Color War
4714420.short_description: A simple, relaxing real-time strategy game. Play as the blue human race, summon troops mid-battle and take the continent from the Red, Yellow and Green nations.

4714820.title: SuperReap
4714820.short_description: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.

4714830.title: Desert Echo
4714830.short_description: Echo is an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Build and upgrade turrets, hold the gates, level up your skills. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op.

4714860.title: Meander
4714860.short_description: Draw with crochet stitches, draw new brushes to fit any aesthetic, draw little animation paths to bring your art to life! There are no goals or timers. Just a lot of options to let you relax and be creative. Fill your scrapbook with your doodles and decorate them with stickers and text! (No AI)

4715130.title: Juice Board
4715130.short_description: Add some juice to your typing with custom carets, satisfying effects, and reactive word combos that work across multiple desktop applications.

4716000.title: Welcome Back to Work
4716000.short_description: Revive and team up with your past selves in a single-player survivors-like. Each rescue adds a full loadout to the fight, with up to 6 weapons per self. Arm a whole line of past selves, discover weapon fusions for stronger builds, and blast through a twisted office.

4716070.title: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void
4716070.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.” Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

4716640.title: Rejoin
4716640.short_description: Rejoin is a sorting and restoration game about caring for a museum where Japanese folding screens come to life at night. Swept up in the festivities of the Night Parade, a procession of curious spirits, they leave their panels scattered by morning. Reassemble them and clean up the night’s mischief.

4717180.title: Murder at Monty's Mansion
4717180.short_description: Step into a goofy murder mystery where you play as a detective who cannot speak. Use your notepad to interrogate guests, explore Monty’s mansion, and discover who murdered the butler.

4717850.title: Magical Girl Taboo Village
4717850.short_description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

4717990.title: Fantasy to Kill
4717990.short_description: PARRY enemy attacks in a Turn-Based RPG with Real-Time Mechanics. You spawn in an end game zone where monsters are powercrept beyond what is possible to win using traditional turn based combat. If you want to survive, you have to be equally as unfair.

4718040.title: Neutrophils Rush
4718040.short_description: Neutrophils Rush is an incremental game where you control a group of white blood cells to defend against various infections. Process the DNA collected to evolve your cells and jump back in the fight!

4718090.title: Pathogen
4718090.short_description: The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens. You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late. Will you make it out alive?

4718590.title: 透明罪 - Blue Tears
4718590.short_description: A novel, a game, a judgment document, a self-confession letter. On an ordinary summer morning, the arrival of an unexpected visitor awakened the dormant memories of a small island. You will play the role of Lynn Chan, and face your "Invisible Sin" by searching for a "Non-existent friend".

4718670.title: Divine Sin: Death Duel
4718670.short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike featuring a unique Clash combat system, where every duel becomes an exchange of calculated moves and deadly counters.

4719020.title: Seaside Wash
4719020.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

4719120.title: Polish Pierogi
4719120.short_description: Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare delicious Polish dumplings step by step, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen and master the art of keeping everyone fed, happy and coming back for more.

4719500.title: Explosive Exchange
4719500.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer arena party game where up to 8 players create absurd builds, outplay their friends, and turn every match into explosive chaos. Play locally or online.

4721060.title: Elite Engineering
4721060.short_description: Elite Engineering is the ultimate sandbox engineering game, characters, environments and creations all created by you and the community.

4722210.title: Vampire Invasion
4722210.short_description: You are the invasion. Command a growing vampire horde in this pixel-art reverse tower defense. Deploy unique vampires, build your formation, exploit their abilities, and tear through human defenses and deadly traps.

4725190.title: Project Melvin
4725190.short_description: Project Melvin is a story driven 3rd person adventure game with main story quests and side quests to get excited about. Discover story lines you never thought were possible and humour you never wanted but got.

4725220.title: Slice of Fortune
4725220.short_description: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.

4725370.title: Wavertree Mountain
4725370.short_description: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

4725930.title: Idle Tides
4725930.short_description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where your goal is simple: Catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new boats to automate your fishing, upgrade your fleet, and help the island with this fish overpopulation!

4726060.title: Stack Out
4726060.short_description: Obviously, Cubes are known for their aerodynamics. Dash, slide, wall run, grind, and swing through dreamlike worlds. Play solo or with up to 5 friends. Chase every medal, then architect a world of your own and see how you stack out.

4726070.title: Feline Fury 3D
4726070.short_description: Hunt down the mouse invasion as a chunky cat with claws, bombs, and lightning. Feline Fury is a fast roguelite where every run reshapes the woods, the desert, the tundra, and the volcano around you. Build a deck of abilities, chase community milestones, climb the Furmament.

4726130.title: DIGSITE ZERO
4726130.short_description: Destroy meteorites, collect crystals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools to dig even deeper beneath the surface of the cosmic rock. In DIGSITE ZERO, a simple mining loop leads to a mystery that’s out of this world.

4726330.title: DEAD UNIT
4726330.short_description: A titanic complex. An insignificant man. In this grim horror, you are a prisoner classified as a DEAD UNIT. Explore your prison, bypass security systems, evade escaped Entities, and piece together material traces for a single chance to make it out alive.

4726580.title: Cielle is Not Happy
4726580.short_description: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.

4726840.title: Battle Worms
4726840.short_description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

4727330.title: HEXHOLD: SIX FORMATIONS
4727330.short_description: Hex-grid tower defense set in the Three Kingdoms. Build your deck, summon legendary heroes, and hold the last stronghold through 20 waves of endless night.

4727370.title: ZENITH
4727370.short_description: ZENITH is a score-attack puzzler fusing Tetris with roguelike deckbuilding. Assemble a build all your own from 100+ enhancements. The higher you stack, the more your multiplier climbs — and when synergies click, one clear can erupt for tens of thousands of points. Chase an absurdly high score.

4727820.title: content moderator.
4727820.short_description: Eidopathy is a disease in which hallucinations spread through photographs. To pay for your mother's surgery, you apply for a suspicious part-time job as a Content Moderator, deleting photos containing hallucinations. Make it out of the anomalous office alive.

4727850.title: Slop Squad
4727850.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Vacuum up valuable scrap from procedurally generated maps and get it back to the scrap crusher before the things lurking inside get you.

4727940.title: OxVOID
4727940.short_description: OxVOID — a minimalist puzzle game where physics, logic, and environment work as a single system. Master the rules through carefully crafted challenges. Then push the boundaries — create your own levels in the built-in editor.

4727960.title: The Deepest Shift
4727960.short_description: Barents Sea, 1987. Your friend Belov is missing. As a chemist on the offshore platform Sarja-7, you follow his trail from a fissure deep underwater to the tap in your lab. A first-person psychological horror game.

4728350.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
4728350.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

4728510.title: JMT -DUeL-
4728510.short_description: A super-serious Rock-Paper-Scissors game, JMT DUeL. Rock-Paper-Scissors + Stats + Skills + Transparent AI Patterns. It will rewire your Rock-Paper-Scissors brain. Let's Duel!

4729050.title: Vibe Train
4729050.short_description: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

4729090.title: Senti Metrica
4729090.short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

4729280.title: Rogue Reels
4729280.short_description: Rogue Reels is a pirate roguelike where you build a slot machine to survive the Flying Dutchman’s toll. With over 100+ symbols and unique mechanics you can create combos to outrun a ghostly toll, and climb the global leaderboards. No real-money gambling included

4729600.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
4729600.short_description: On a dreary night, a lighthouse keeper must sweep their beam to guide lost souls ashore, and burn back the dark creeping from within.

4730120.title: Runic Dungeon
4730120.short_description: Runic Dungeon is a challenging fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Level up and assemble arcane runes to craft unique, ultimate builds. Gear up your character and clear dungeons infested with deadly monsters!

4730130.title: Aita: The Dark Domain
4730130.short_description: Every card is both an attack and part of your survival in this 1–4 player co-op roguelite. Spend cards to strike, preserve enough to survive the counterattack, and combine sacred suit powers with 100+ Blessings.

4730170.title: Meow Mart
4730170.short_description: Experience the immersive fun of first-person restocking and cashiering. Launching with 6 distinct cat breeds—breed them freely, sell them for a profit, or keep them as collectibles in your store to boost customer traffic.

4730280.title: Hellsino Pokerlike
4730280.short_description: Gamble for your soul in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your life. Build deadly poker hands, unleash massive Nexus combos, and shield your cards from demonic Dealers. Cheat the casino and break the house before it breaks your deck.

4730320.title: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
4730320.short_description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

4730460.title: Farm Bang
4730460.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

4730780.title: Sturmjäger
4730780.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

4730920.title: Duelists
4730920.short_description: A 2D arena brawler for two to four players, on the couch or online, where losing is the fastest way to become dangerous. Between rounds the shop reads the scoreboard and arms whoever is behind. The cat running it is not sorry.

4731200.title: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
4731200.short_description: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

4731230.title: NowLoading Forever
4731230.short_description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

4731440.title: AIRSKIPPER
4731440.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

4731490.title: A Sweet Treat for Nona
4731490.short_description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

4731610.title: New Science
4731610.short_description: Combine illustrated cards in an open-ended world of discovery. Follow Targets through 16 Ages or experiment freely with every card you find. Build your collection, trade with other players and make discoveries nobody has found before.

4732340.title: Penance
4732340.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

4732750.title: Rose Guns Days -Season 3-
4732750.short_description: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

4732820.title: Select Kiss +Plus
4732820.short_description: Select Kiss +Plus is a lighthearted visual novel where you choose two people from a colorful cast of six and lock them inside “The Room You Can’t Leave Until You Kiss.”

4732890.title: Get Tao Now
4732890.short_description: A simple point and click game where you find characters in a static image.

4733080.title: Simulacre
4733080.short_description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror where familiar voices may not belong to your friends. Explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, survive together, and never be certain who—or what—you can trust.

4733270.title: Kingdom Isles
4733270.short_description: Kingdom Isles is an intense Survival City Builder with Roguelike elements. Build a mighty Kingdom, Trade resources on the market, and defend your Island against increasingly tougher Viking raids! Can you lead your people to victory?

4733370.title: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
4733370.short_description: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

4733430.title: Plucked
4733430.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

4733500.title: PP Inflation
4733500.short_description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

4733950.title: Exiled Ark
4733950.short_description: Fight, build, and survive aboard a ruined interstellar colony ship. Scavenge resources, forge powerful weapons, establish strongholds, and reclaim humanity's last Ark. Master six attribute paths, unlock four technology trees, and shape your own ending through roguelike and relentless combat.

4734150.title: Eightfold
4734150.short_description: Eightfold is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder set in a cursed carnival. Play poker hands, build your deck, and sign Pacts you might regret. Face ancient Gods who break the rules your deck relies on. Take their souls and pay your debt.

4734380.title: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires
4734380.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

4734680.title: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
4734680.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is a 3D top-down Zelda-like ARPG focused on non-linear exploration. Navigate intricate labyrinths, gather hidden loot for alchemy, and slay ancient tyrants in unforgiving blade combat.

4734720.title: ClickCrafter
4734720.short_description: A dark cozy incremental crafting game about reclaiming yourself while marooned on a mysterious island. Click, craft, collect, construct and restore your way back to humanity while uncovering the island’s secret history. But beware — is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans?

4734800.title: Corrupted Dice
4734800.short_description: Roll your dice and choose where to play them to reach each round’s score target. In this roguelite, you can take on heat for extra points, but too much heat ends your run. Dice break when they run out of uses.

4735330.title: The Divided
4735330.short_description: Co-op extraction action-RPG for 1–4 players. Take missions from the hideout, drop into hostile zones, and fight or sneak past the infected. Loot what you can carry and extract — or die and leave it all behind. Melee is the smart play. Guns invite the horde. Craft, trade, gear up. Bring friends.

4735670.title: SEO or Die
4735670.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

4735680.title: Orbsorber
4735680.short_description: Orbsorber is a single-player, action-adventure RPG focused around collecting Orbs. You play as a cosmic ball of energy exploring uniquely themed zones, smashing obstacles, defeating bosses, and gaining new abilities. Absorb Orbs to upgrade your powers and awaken your true potential.

4735720.title: Pegs & Sorcery
4735720.short_description: Aim your orbs. Power your party. Build your deck. In this pachinko roguelike deckbuilder, bounce through pegs to earn mana, then unleash cards in turn-based battles. Combine heroes, cards, and upgrades as you choose your path through each run.

4735920.title: Taiikooz War
4735920.short_description: Taiikooz War is a fast-paced, single-player zombie survival FPS. Survive hordes of the undead and plunge into a brutal where only survival matters.

4736520.title: Celestial Oath
4736520.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

4736700.title: Old Mate Dave
4736700.short_description: Pachinko meets ragdoll physics. Be 'A Chad', catch the falling Daves with your trusty gurney, shoot the Daves around the Pinball table and shoot for a Plinko high score! Go ahead and treat yourself to a laugh and treat that Dave like the ball he isn't!

4736720.title: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
4736720.short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by Dan Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

4736860.title: FD's Industry Tycoon
4736860.short_description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

4737150.title: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics
4737150.short_description: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics is a railway game focused on shunting, freight transport, and logistics work on the tracks. Take on the role of a train driver and railway operator, operate locomotives, assemble trains, transport freight wagons, and complete tasks on sidings, stations, and railway lines

4737240.title: Stevedore
4737240.short_description: No more job in the city. Managed to find one in the middle of nowhere. Stevedore. Crane worker. It feels off, but you need money. Stevedore is a short industrial horror game where you take a role of a crane worker. Lift containers, load ships and complete your contract. What could go wrong?

4737390.title: Hwaseo
4737390.short_description: A Korean folk dark fantasy deck-building roguelike. Three souls. One bound fate. Three companions are bound to one shared deck — every draw is a party question, not a single hero's. Journey through layered shrines drawn from Korean folklore.

4737980.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
4737980.short_description: Run a shady potion shop for dysfunctional monsters! Brew custom elixirs, manipulate toxic relationships, collect bizarre ingredients, and turn every monster's misery into profit.

4738100.title: 10 Million Pixels
4738100.short_description: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.

4738220.title: NGL Biathlon 2027
4738220.short_description: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks

4738580.title: Space Annihilator
4738580.short_description: Command a powerful space warship and fight your way through relentless waves of enemy ships and bases to achieve the ultimate victory!

4738810.title: Wrath
4738810.short_description: As a soul who wakes up stuck in hell, you must kill the 7 Deadly Sins to escape! In this melee third person boss rush game you will have to collect upgrades to stand a chance at defeating the devils who keep you trapped, let alone the one who trapped you here in the first place...

4738890.title: Turtle Up
4738890.short_description: Only up — with the turtle and skateboard!

4739250.title: Hustle On High
4739250.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

4739340.title: Crown of the Dungeon King
4739340.short_description: Crown of the Dungeon King is a party-based tactical RPG featuring random encounters, loot and inventory management, boss fights, and partially procedural levels. Inspired by tabletop games, it is designed to be fast-paced and rules-light while still offering a good variety of meaningful choices.

4739760.title: On Break
4739760.short_description: Fresnel Labs needs a Box Stacking Technician. Press the button, drop the box, build a tower that won't topple. Chain colors, earn your pay and spend it on strange office decorations that rewrite the rules of the job. Your robot supervisor, B.A.S.I.L., thinks you'll do great. Probably.

4739790.title: Souls in Conflict
4739790.short_description: High-intensity 3v3 arena fights in third person. Every ability is aimed by hand. Play Warrior, Fire Mage, Poacher or Priestess. Land hits to build Soul Shards for your most devastating abilities. Spend your stamina on quadruple jumps, sprinting and rolling. No pay-to-win, no grind: just skill.

4740470.title: Autobus - The Card Game
4740470.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

4740920.title: Fox Idle
4740920.short_description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, complete quests, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

4741510.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
4741510.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

4742310.title: Wands & Whiskers
4742310.short_description: Rescue cats, discover rare coats, and grow a cozy network of shelters in this idle cat collector. Wave a wand for a roomful of playful chaos, decorate their favorite spots, or relax while the donations roll in, even while you're away.

4742430.title: PuzzlePlants
4742430.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

4742440.title: Cold Contours: Intake
4742440.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

4742690.title: Bytes and Knights - Adventure
4742690.short_description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale TCG set within an RPG world, with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets, collect cards, build your deck, and battle increasingly difficult opponents. Each new card brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

4743310.title: Tabletop Tycoon
4743310.short_description: In Tabletop Tycoon you start your own board game company from a single desk and grow it into the biggest name in the industry. Design games that sell, design your own box and make every piece fit inside. Research new genres and mechanics. Build and decorate your office as you outgrow your rivals.

4743710.title: God Codex
4743710.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

4743720.title: Tank Them All
4743720.short_description: The ultimate tank party game! 2–6 players blast each other in quick one-hit rounds — on one screen, online or via Remote Play Together. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive spike traps, tornadoes and air raids across 90+ arenas and 4 modes. Bots fill every empty seat.

4743880.title: Turtles on Crocodiles
4743880.short_description: The world out there is full of wonders. Explore it at a turtle’s pace. Take your time. Along the pilgrimage, friendships may bloom. And sometimes, even sweet, sweet love.

4745010.title: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you
4745010.short_description: 실존 코스튬 플레이어 5인이 직접 등장하는, 실사 비주얼 기반 연애 시뮬레이션. 옛날부터 알고 지내던 누나의 부탁으로 작은 메이드 카페 「코스텔라」의 임시 매니저가 된 당신. 라강, 아희, 보미, 아소, 린땅 — 다섯 명의 메이드와 함께하는 예상치 못한 일상 속에서, 다섯 가지 마음의 이야기가 시작됩니다.

4745080.title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
4745080.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

4745300.title: Flightline: Airline Sim
4745300.short_description: Flightline is an airline management sim about building an airline that has to make sense. Set routes, choose aircraft, price seats, and shape a network where passengers route themselves through real markets. Expansion succeeds only when the entire operation holds together.

4745340.title: Hi Planet Save The Earth
4745340.short_description: Six explosive chapters. Thirty-one stages. Smash through robot swarms and battle a boss at the end of every comic-book chapter. Every chapter is a battle.

4745370.title: Your Momo
4745370.short_description: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.

4745460.title: Block Dash
4745460.short_description: A short, fast-paced action game where you move and dash your way through an abstract obstacle course. Encounter a wide variety of blocks that all pose different challenges. Will you be able to make your way through and see what lies at the end of it all?

4745800.title: Heroes Must Die
4745800.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

4746540.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
4746540.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

4746740.title: Plank Wars
4746740.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

4747490.title: I Like Trains
4747490.short_description: I Like Trains is an incremental game about growing a single train line into a sprawling network full of trains, upgrades, and strange anomalies. Build, expand, and watch the map come to life while deciphering anomalies and revealing the story within.

4747680.title: Cardelis
4747680.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

4748830.title: D.A.M.N!
4748830.short_description: Outplay your friends with cards instead of out-rolling them! In a cheerful race to the finish: help your partner, get in your rivals' way, combo, knock out, freeze, use ults... Collect awards, compare stats. Solo, in a team, with bots, hot-seat, cross-play online or offline — no limits!

4748920.title: Melody Flow
4748920.short_description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Fly through procedurally generated musical worlds, dodge shifting obstacles, and compete for high scores in fast-paced arcade gameplay. Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer.

4749120.title: Fuel Needed
4749120.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

4750350.title: Kings of Oros
4750350.short_description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

4750910.title: Evergreen Clicker
4750910.short_description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

4750920.title: Emberline
4750920.short_description: Emberline is a real-time roguelike deckbuilder where your train never stops. Generate and spend Ember to play cards, reinforce your train and fight creatures attacking across a 3×3 battlefield as you chart a path through the hostile continent of Pacifica.

4751080.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
4751080.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

4751270.title: KUMANO
4751270.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

4751620.title: Legend Dary
4751620.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

4751740.title: One More Chop
4751740.short_description: One More Chop is a short, fast-paced incremental woodcutting game. Chop down trees, gather resources, craft axes, unlock skills, and invest your resources in an expansive upgrade tree to grow stronger!

4751800.title: Ocean Cargo Manager
4751800.short_description: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

4754300.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger
4754300.short_description: Play as estrogen-fueled Dracul in this parodic roguelite 'yet another Vampire Survivors clone'. Fight off hordes of bums, haters, and similar ludolols, collect delicious potatoes, and upgrade your trashy arsenal. Survive this boring clunker, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

4754310.title: The Singular Ones
4754310.short_description: Help a group of teenagers with unique powers uncover the mystery of the Soul Mirror in this cozy logic mystery puzzle game. Place characters and objects in the right rooms at Corvane Academy by following a set of coexistence rules.

4754410.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
4754410.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

4754540.title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里
4754540.short_description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

4754860.title: Bad Grip Club
4754860.short_description: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game where you grab ledges, pull friends up cliffs, use ridiculous items, and survive four cartoonish biomes. Play on PC or in VR, team up with friends across platforms, and enjoy the chaos together!

4754910.title: Steal & Sell Simulator
4754910.short_description: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.

4755090.title: Snapshot Survivor
4755090.short_description: Snapshot Survivor is an action-focused take on Snapshot, inspired by games like Vampire Survivors with an extra dose of naughty story telling. Roam around in an outskirt of Tokyo trying to survive taking upskirt pictures for profit to unlock new weapons and cutscenes!

4756050.title: WHIPLASH
4756050.short_description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

4756280.title: Signarchy
4756280.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about road signs. Help a delivery truck reach the market before it opens and keep a bus out of traffic jams. Change signs during the shift, pause to think, and use cards to find out what caused a crash or jam.

4756910.title: Phylactery Slayer
4756910.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

4756930.title: Beats & Brains
4756930.short_description: Beats & Brains is a co-op rhythm beat 'em up game. Fight zombies to the beat as Mona and Lu to rescue your bandmate in the apocalyptic Toronto subways. Play co-op, stay in sync, and jam against the living dead. Compatible with classic guitar and drum controllers!

4756960.title: The Villages That Cave
4756960.short_description: With just three decisions before each battle, build a defence against creatures emerging from caves that turn your villages into more. In this turn-based strategy, exploit terrain, grant villages special powers, use wildcards to wipe out chunks, and upgrade your units and structures.

4757770.title: Anomaly Sweepers
4757770.short_description: Join a starship cleanup crew and take on bizarre jobs across space. Memorize each site before anomalies appear, then spot what changed and hold to remove it before time runs out. From a salon where hair regrows as fast as you cut it to a tango hall that won't stop dancing, 20 strange sites await.

4757940.title: Gridiron Football GM
4757940.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

4758040.title: Just A Watermelon
4758040.short_description: Put aside all the responsibilities, bills, and stress that come with being human. You’re just a watermelon.

4758480.title: Eddie on Fire
4758480.short_description: Rescued at birth from a life of bondage, Eddie resolves to win his mother’s freedom from the tyranny of his father by defeating him when they meet in the arena. Join Eddie as he fights for his life in this non-combat adventure to dethrone a champion and rescue a slave.

4758500.title: X Calibur
4758500.short_description: X Calibur is a top-down hack-and-slash roguelike! Every run starts with building your own dungeon-crawler path. Collect sword parts, forge powerful builds, and become unstoppable! No checkpoints to save you from the robots. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

4758520.title: Please File Accurately
4758520.short_description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

4758650.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
4758650.short_description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

4759220.title: Kinbound
