4759220.short_description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

4759440.title: Scraw's Blooms
4759440.short_description: Design sunflower fields, control cross-pollination, and scale your harvest with careful or chaotic management. As the field's scarecrow, Scraw awaits perfect blooms while scaring off those pesky crows. What new varieties will you grow?

4759500.title: Hostile Process
4759500.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

4759570.title: No Road Home
4759570.short_description: Our goal is to let you build and defend your own base, recruit survivors, deploy automated defenses like combat drones and artillery, reclaim settlements from bandits and mutants, and upgrade your car in a hostile post-apocalyptic open world.

4760080.title: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
4760080.short_description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

4760310.title: Long Carnage
4760310.short_description: Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Explore an isolated house, find resources, restore power, and survive unique killers with their own mechanics in dynamic and unpredictable matches.

4760770.title: 7Komada
4760770.short_description: A GAME TO BE PLAYED WITH ONE'S WHOLE LIFE. A killing game based on Werewolf and Mafia, set in an alternate-universe Europe. Your graduation trip is cut short with your entire class kidnapped and locked in an abandoned mansion. Figure out who's behind it, and who you can trust.

4760930.title: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
4760930.short_description: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

4760970.title: Quilt
4760970.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

4761080.title: DIE as HEROES
4761080.short_description: Dark fantasy tabletop adventures for 1–4 players, solo or with friends, online or offline. Play, create and share campaigns through Steam Workshop. Join the Guild of Faceless Heroes in Kelgard, where fame and death await!

4761280.title: Bank Life Simulator
4761280.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own bank branch! Handle teller transactions, spot fake IDs, and offer loans and deposits to a living population. Hire and train staff, trade on the stock and black markets, survive strict audits, and rise from a small branch to a financial empire.

4761470.title: Beep Beep Until You're Rich!
4761470.short_description: A cozy incremental treasure-hunting game about digging up buried loot with your metal detector, unlocking upgrades, and building a pirate fortune. Help Bia buy her very own pirate ship!

4761630.title: Neural Drift
4761630.short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

4761830.title: Final Signal
4761830.short_description: A signal has been detected deep inside the Backrooms. Go on your first mission with PATROL, explore levels, avoid entities, and work together to find John B., before all that's left of him is his Final Signal.

4762500.title: MSO FreeCell Arena
4762500.short_description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

4762550.title: Arcane Colosseum
4762550.short_description: Arcane Colosseum is a first-person PvP action game where you draw runes and cast spells with your voice to battle other wizards. Master a variety of spells, choose powerful augments, and forge your own strategy to become the last wizard standing!

4762680.title: The Undergrowth
4762680.short_description: The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is earned, not given.

4762700.title: ROADS: Tangled in Traffic
4762700.short_description: The city is strangled by its own explosive growth. Identify the chokepoints, invest in infrastructure, and redesign the network. One well-placed roundabout could nurse it back to life. Can you relieve the pressure and let prosperity flow as freely as the traffic?

4763310.title: Tavern & Tombs
4763310.short_description: Tavern & Tombs is an action roguelite looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore procedural dungeons, blast hordes of monsters with powerful magic, and collect epic loot. Return to your tavern to brew potions and spend essence on permanent upgrades before your next run into the crypts!

4763380.title: Heartbeat Under One Roof
4763380.short_description: Sakura, the protagonist’s childhood friend, gets scouted by a talent agency and begins her journey as an idol. She moves in with the protagonist, who works in Tokyo. With his support, can Sakura rise to become a top idol with one million fans?

4763700.title: Kagenazo
4763700.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

4763900.title: 雀神 Sparrow God
4763900.short_description: Mahjong hands meet roguelike deckbuilding. Choose a faction, collect Jokers and talismans, and beat score targets with limited plays. Take on eight chapters and 24 blinds, then push your build further in Endless Mode.

4764490.title: Nock Nock Loose
4764490.short_description: An active incremental tower defense game where you defend your city from enemy armies. Aim for the biggest crowds to boost your archers' accuracy, unlock powerful abilities in a massive skill tree, and crush every warlord who dares besiege your walls.

4764860.title: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者
4764860.short_description: This is a fast-paced roguelike hack-and-slash game where weapons, characters, and skills can all be developed independently and freely combined to create your very own build!

4764980.title: Crystal Siege
4764980.short_description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

4765210.title: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff
4765210.short_description: Find 850+ mischievous guinea pigs across a cozy hand-drawn hidden-object adventure set in a Peruvian-inspired finca. Collect snackos, unlock secret rooms, solve tiny puzzles, and follow the crumbs toward the legendary Golden Corn.

4765270.title: Idiots 4 Order
4765270.short_description: Swipe deliveries, scream directions, juggle pizzas and drive like a maniac in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game. One moped, 4 idiots, infinite chaos.

4765460.title: A Moon Full of Money
4765460.short_description: Blast rocks, upgrade your base, and earn lots of money in this compact incremental game. Expand and automate your operation with powerful abilities like mining robots, drones, mines, supply drops, an orbital laser, and more.

4765550.title: Fairy Forge
4765550.short_description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

4766290.title: Roll Dice no Die
4766290.short_description: Choose your pawn and build a dead man's deck! Challenge yourself in a deadly reimagining of the famous tabletop game where every dice roll can save or kill you! Manipulate the board, make fateful decisions, outsmart the Master, and win this ultimate game of survival!

4766400.title: Fairyland Online
4766400.short_description: Set in a beloved Fairyland universe, this charming MMORPG brings together iconic Fairyland characters, quests, and pets from around the world into a warm, whimsical fantasy adventure. The Global Edition is inviting players worldwide to join the adventure together!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

4766820.title: Pandora's Arcade
4766820.short_description: A collection of bite sized arcade-style games with a frantic pace and game-changing modifiers.

4766910.title: Project Angels 2 - Visual Novel
4766910.short_description: The visual novel sequel to Project Angels. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two factions of the ANGELS have tormented the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was whole under a new home.

4767360.title: CATACOMBOS
4767360.short_description: CATACOMBOS is a physics-driven roguelite combo-builder where you throw and merge cats, build absurd synergies with cards and cat hats, and crush armies of dogs in the depths of the catacombs.

4767390.title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
4767390.short_description: Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator.

4767690.title: Pepo Sort Master
4767690.short_description: In Pepo Sort Master, take on high-speed sorting puzzles in a whimsical factory. Among the mysterious creatures called "Pepo" streaming down the line, "Pepo Imposters" are hiding in the mix. Master the art of Pepo inspection and earn your title as a certified Master Pepo!

4767720.title: BOOSTDRIVE
4767720.short_description: BOOSTDRIVE is a free-to-play arcade racing game set in stylized cyber-city environments inspired by Central Asia, featuring fast driving, neon tracks, and multiplayer competition.

4767790.title: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
4767790.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

4767830.title: INROOMS
4767830.short_description: A cooperative psychological horror experience up to four players where you and your friends must survive the deepest, most distorted liminal spaces of the Inrooms, the deepest levels of the Backrooms.

4767850.title: Deathless Oath
4767850.short_description: Become an ancient unholy creature rising against mankind to claim its right to exist through fire and steel. Cut through crowds of enemies, crush them in brutal melee combat, and turn the medieval battlefield to ash. Death waits. The oath remains.

4767880.title: The Caffeine Chronicles
4767880.short_description: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

4768190.title: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
4768190.short_description: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

4768270.title: Acid Clashers
4768270.short_description: Acid Clashers is a single-player turn-based Autobattler game with a strong focus on incrementing stats.

4768310.title: 觀淵決:Abyss run
4768310.short_description: This is a Roguelike strategy game centered around "Dice-Building" and "Distance Control." 🔹 Customizable Dice: Ditching traditional deckbuilding, you can engrave skills directly onto your dice faces to create unique tactical builds.

4768470.title: Witch’s Tidy-Up
4768470.short_description: Witch's Tidy-Up is a calm first-person tidying game where you put 5,412 objects back in their places in a cluttered witch's house. With Lumi the cat, open the rooms one by one, learn spells, and send the flying things back where they belong.

4768940.title: Moon Basketball
4768940.short_description: This is basketball. On the moon. Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

4769130.title: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
4769130.short_description: Start as a weak Magical Girl and become an unstoppable force! Fight weird Shadows, collect resources, unlock powerful upgrades, and annihilate the Witches in this Incremental Bullet Hell!

4769280.title: Covenantum
4769280.short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

4769350.title: Pro Football Dynasty
4769350.short_description: The ultimate American football management sim. Call plays, sign free agents, scout prospects, draft superstars, and dive into deep stats for every player and team. Take control as a coach or GM, chase championships, and build a storied dynasty.

4770020.title: HackMeNow
4770020.short_description: Investigate compromised systems through a fictional Linux-style terminal. Read logs, uncover hidden files, decode secrets and avoid traps across 15 story-driven puzzle levels. Every command brings you closer to the rogue intelligence watching from behind the screen..

4770100.title: Gemtide
4770100.short_description: A short and satisfying incremental game about collecting gems underwater. Break rocks, get gems, go deeper, repeat.

4770300.title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
4770300.short_description: Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun: procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

4770480.title: Elemental Knights Online
4770480.short_description: An anime MMORPG where your look is the main quest. Mix 30,000+ outfits, then explore a living 3D world by hand - no auto-battle, no auto-farming, no stamina timers. Free to play with random-item purchases. A lively world from a series running since 2008.

4770900.title: Desktop Mart
4770900.short_description: Run a cozy little supermarket right on your desktop. Stock the shelves, serve happy customers, and grow your tiny store — a relaxing idle game for your second screen.

4771310.title: MANDATUM
4771310.short_description: A Clay-Style online co-op game, with 4-player missions, about the maximum contribution of players to the boss's local elections. History is written by the winners, right? So we’re doing whatever it takes. MANDATUM.

4772080.title: Click through Earth
4772080.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

4772650.title: Cubuild
4772650.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where you can't jump. Use limited blocks, sprints, and resets to complete the experiment.

4772660.title: Anomaly Grid
4772660.short_description: Anomaly Grid is a turn-based strategy puzzle game about numbers, colors, and control. Capture tiles, merge units, spend score on upgrades and abilities, and outplay an escalating AI before the grid collapses.

4772710.title: Cue Knight
4772710.short_description: Cue Knight is a physics roguelite inspired by billiards. Slingshot yourself through dungeons, smashing monsters with precision shots. Collect powerful weapons and items, upgrade your stats, and clear an endless series of rooms in as few moves as possible.

4772980.title: Dragon Up! Together
4772980.short_description: Combine the Baby Dragon's versatility with the Young Dragon's strength to overcome challenges and guide this team of Dragons back home. Play solo with both Dragons or team up with friends to jump, solve puzzles, dodge hazards and glide your way to safety. Just make sure they don't fall all at once!

4773320.title: Bet Shop Simulator Prologue
4773320.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

4773650.title: Petricor: Tower Defense
4773650.short_description: Face off against hordes of shambling skeletons in this magical rogue-like tower defense! You're just cat-sitting for a shopkeeper, but an evil necromancer has other plans! Summon living statues to defend the shop and discover powerful spells to create devastating combos!

4773720.title: A Real Life Party
4773720.short_description: hey ill be there soon. u should go in tho my roommates are super chill.

4774000.title: Sufficiently Advanced Witchcraft
4774000.short_description: "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic!" Practice witchcraft, summon daemons, harness crystal vibrations, and never EVER let the Magic Smoke escape as you help the villagers, protect the kingdom, and strive to unlock magic's deepest secrets in this cozy, witchy sim!

4774250.title: Professional Money Relocator
4774250.short_description: So much wealth is cluttering up this place! Enjoy a relaxing, satisfying collectathon where you clear out a massive vault. Pack loot into your bag and upgrade your gear to claim every valuable. There is nothing quite like the sound of crisp bills filling your pockets.

4774560.title: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
4774560.short_description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

4774750.title: Hidden Lines - Family mysteries
4774750.short_description: Find your unknown parent. Follow clues, meet eccentric characters, analyze DNA results, and search archives to solve the mystery of your own life. Secrets, false leads, and unexpected allies await. Every discovery could change your life.

4775110.title: Alien Nature Rampage
4775110.short_description: A Topdown action game where you play an alien entity that must destroy all industry on earths major cities. Viewing the world from above the player selects a city to the help "save" from industry pollution.

4775390.title: Novis
4775390.short_description: You are an Umbra Corporation operator connected to an Avatar on Earth-01 as part of an inter-reality experiment. Build a unique character by combining abilities with dozens of items and spells, interact with the inhabitants of Earth-01, and discover why you ended up in this particular universe.

4775490.title: Nocta
4775490.short_description: "Before the beginning, Time and Nothingness danced..." Become Nocta, the Embodiment of Time, and safeguard Creation from the abyssal hands of the Void in an original cosmic creation myth. Hand-drawn stained-glass art by 花凛. Wishlist now!

4775820.title: Clock-out Denied
4775820.short_description: Clock-out Denied is an asymmetric multiplayer stealth game where Employees build shadowy office hideouts, complete tasks, and sprint for the clock-out machine while one Boss hunts them with light. Hide in the darkness you created, whisper with coworkers, and escape overtime before the final second.

4775860.title: Slammo
4775860.short_description: Conquer a charming woodland world in a grid-based strategy game where everyone moves at once. Expand your territory, predict rival plans, and fight dice-driven battles as adorable animal factions clash for control.

4775900.title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
4775900.short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

4776060.title: Doctor Plague
4776060.short_description: It tells the legendary story of Doctor Plague, who slays demons and cures diseases. Medical skills are honed through battles, and knife skills are refined through treating patients. The combat part adopts Metroidvania, while the healing part uses rhythm game.

4776220.title: 3 AM Delivery
4776220.short_description: In 3 AM Delivery, you play as a sailor tasked with delivering a cursed shipment across a decaying maritime world, navigating shifting environments and uncovering multiple endings shaped by your choices.

4776470.title: Wild East: The Straw Man
4776470.short_description: 1993, just after Czechoslovakia split in two. Play as reporter Marek and investigate the death of a company director in name only. In Prague, journalist Eva pursues a case of her own. Explore locations, read documents, and uncover where their cases meet in a classic 2D point-and-click mystery.

4776500.title: Carry On Together
4776500.short_description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

4776590.title: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
4776590.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

4776880.title: Mega Golf
4776880.short_description: Smash your friends into the ocean and bowl through buildings in your giant armored golf ball! Race through the chaos . Smash your way through buildings, navigate boosts and bounce pads, avoid landmines and oil slicks as you explore and devastate the courses.

4777140.title: Tomboy: Muscle Inferno
4777140.short_description: Blast through thousands of biomechanical creatures and survive until extraction! Tomboy is a sci-fi casual rogue-lite where your choices shape devastating builds and overwhelming firepower against endless waves of horrors. Make bullet heaven real.

4777630.title: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
4777630.short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic farming roguelike. Combine quirky animals, items, and strategic layouts to create explosive, poop-powered chain reactions!

4777640.title: Christmas Night: Brothers
4777640.short_description: Survive a terrifying Christmas night inside a massive luxury mansion. Play solo or together in local split-screen co-op while collecting gifts and avoiding deadly creatures.

4777960.title: Cats and Hats
4777960.short_description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats! A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

4778050.title: 10000 BC
4778050.short_description: Build a civilization from the Stone Age to the distant future in this roguelike strategy game. Recruit unique residents, construct your settlement, survive enemy waves, and shape history through difficult choices.

4778100.title: H3xatr0n
4778100.short_description: Your trail is your weapon... and your biggest danger. Trap endless enemies, escape an ever-changing maze and trigger bullet time to survive. Unlock 13 powerups and discover 30 deadly Quantum Link combos as you grow stronger and chase higher scores in a retro-futuristic neon arcade roguelite.

4778320.title: Aiya Desire
4778320.short_description: Exploration × Rhythm Game × Horror Adventure?! After her mother dies and her father disappears, Aiya heads to Sentinel Radio Tower. Explore, solve puzzles, talk, flee a relentless pursuer, and survive 2-button rhythm boss fights. Did HC, the Harmony Chip, end the Infection Panic—or hide a secret?

4778390.title: Planet Harvester
4778390.short_description: Planet Harvester is a sci-fi automation and resource management sim where you deploy autonomous drones, harvest planets, transfer resources to your mothership, buy upgrades, solve bottlenecks, and expand across the galaxy.

4778770.title: Skyline Sim
4778770.short_description: Build your airline from a single aircraft into a global carrier. Plan your network, schedule every aircraft, manage the operation, and compete in a living aviation market.

4778960.title: NARROWS: Naval Checkpoint Simulator
4778960.short_description: Trade has flowed through the Narrows for centuries, now it's yours to command. Inspect every ship, check for contraband, deal with smugglers and pirates. With war on the horizon, every choice has its cost, choose well.

4778990.title: Blightmarch
4778990.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical RPG of war, corruption, and impossible choices. Lead a mercenary squad into an Abyss-tainted front, recruit scarred companions, and survive brutal turn-based battles with weapons, terrain, and forbidden power. Victory may save your squad, or make you accept the slaughter.

4779040.title: Stellar Abyss
4779040.short_description: Stellar Abyss is an online space sandbox. Command and customize your ship as you explore, fight, mine, manufacture, and trade between star systems. Take on contracts alone or join a fleet for rescue and escort missions. Start with a small ship and find your next opportunity among the stars.

4779290.title: Meme Paint
4779290.short_description: Meme Paint is a unique take on the well-known Paint

4779500.title: Doonbound
4779500.short_description: Doonbound is an MMORPG of endless adventure, battle, and creation, where everything is built by the Community.

4779940.title: Creovia
4779940.short_description: A 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build worlds, craft gear, explore dangerous subworlds, trade with players, and grow your legacy in a persistent, player-driven universe.

4779980.title: Stepwell
4779980.short_description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

4780650.title: Bus Station Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
4780650.short_description: Bus Station Simulator Prologue: Early Day is a free prologue where you take over a neglected bus station in Winston Springs. Manage passengers, vehicles, and infrastructure as you transform a run-down facility into the thriving heart of the town.

4780760.title: After 9:59
4780760.short_description: After 9:59 is a psychological horror game set on Halloween night, you're alone in your new apartment. A list of strange rules may be your only protection once 9:59 PM passes and the knocking begins.

4780800.title: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story
4780800.short_description: Create and sell various pieces of art using fuse beads. Earn money to cover your daily expenses and pay off your debts. As your Store Level grows, you'll unlock useful tools and new types of beads

4780840.title: Conquer
4780840.short_description: Build, trade, and fight in this competitive multiplayer shooter played on a board. Build settlements and roads across a shared island, trade resources with your rivals, and gun down anyone who stands between you and the victory point goal. You can Conquer the world!

4781040.title: Cats and cats and coffees!
4781040.short_description: Your new coworkers have paws, tiny aprons, and ambitious nap schedules. Build a cozy idle cafe on your desktop: hire cats, brew coffee, open themed cafes, and fill your album with rare visitors while you work or unwind.

4781060.title: THREE KINGDOMS: STRATEGY SIMULATOR
4781060.short_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine.

4781710.title: Xmas Squad
4781710.short_description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

4782200.title: Crittermancy
4782200.short_description: Become a Crittermancer in this roguelike deckbuilder with real-time combat. Master the art of critter alchemy: combine, transform, and mutate critters to discover new cards and build your deck. Venture deep into the dark forest and unleash your creations against the monsters lurking within.

4782230.title: Chobisuke's Weird Farm
4782230.short_description: Protect the farm by any means necessary. Grandpa’s secrets, the mysterious villagers, and the yokai that emerge at night... Every mystery and a thrilling battle await you!

4782300.title: Get Up, Man!
4782300.short_description: Get Up, Man! is a ragdoll comedy about Kolya, an engineer taking part in the first public experiment in crossing between universes. Four limbs, three actions, one voice off-screen and a very long way home.

4782600.title: Grindbound
4782600.short_description: A single-player, top-down 3D auto-looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore dungeons, defeat enemies, collect randomized gear, and combine skills and equipment to create powerful builds. No complex controls or quick reflexes required.

4783110.title: Mad Cafe
4783110.short_description: Serve coffee, pastries, and smiles to increasingly disturbing customers in this atmospheric psychological horror game. Keep the café running, master the perfect brew, and try not to lose yourself as each shift becomes more unsettling than the last.

4783350.title: Retro Football
4783350.short_description: Retro Fútbol is a football management game inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Manage your squad, transfers, tactics, stadium, and finances, and lead your club to the top season after season.

4783700.title: Ashen Throne
4783700.short_description: A free-to-play, top-down action MMORPG. Play as a Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, explore dungeons and hunt bosses with friends. Find and craft equipment, develop your skills, and join your guild in battles for territory and Ashen Castle.

4783900.title: Football Club Builder
4783900.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

4783980.title: GUNBOAT-8
4783980.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

4784260.title: Separator
4784260.short_description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

4784550.title: Another One
4784550.short_description: Flip 7 cards without a repeat and you'll hit like a truck. Draw a double? Bust, your whole hand is gone. A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder with silly boosters, bosses that cheat, a Daily Challenge leaderboard and a mode where you build your deck from scratch.

4784590.title: TRUMPP VS ELON TYCOON
4784590.short_description: Build your vehicle empire in Neo-Berlin 2157! Manufacture cars, military vehicles and orbital spacecraft in this dark humor idle tycoon. Automate factories, outsmart rivals and rise from street hustler to orbital overlord!

4784980.title: Contrail Blazer
4784980.short_description: A side-view airplane game. Circle items or enemy attacks with your contrail to make them yours. A planet slowly freezing over. Fly at a relaxed pace through rusted ruins and winter landscapes. Missions run about 3 minutes, controller only. Free to play.

4785150.title: Recruiting Against Rodents
4785150.short_description: View resumes, hire employees, train them into roles, and defeat the rodents! Recruiting Against Rodents is a small indie roguelike auto-battler where you, a hiring manager, must build a team to fight 15 waves of rats from a nearby cave.

4785500.title: Beetle Island
4785500.short_description: Beetle Island is a relaxing idle game for beetle lovers. Buy beetles, raise them and sell them to grow your fortune! Turn an empty patch of land to a buzzing oasis filled with exotic beetles, wacky decorations, and love!

4785630.title: Jellscape
4785630.short_description: Jellscape is an arcade-style fast paced race against doom. Control your gloopy ball to navigate daunting trails and obstacles. Each death is just another chance to prove you have what it takes to beat the next level!

4785780.title: Ticker Panic: Stock Market Simulator
4785780.short_description: Trade in a chaotic stock market sim where absurd headlines, hype cycles, crashes, and liquidity traps can make or break your portfolio. Start small, survive the chaos, and take over the market.

4785790.title: 明末：甲申年
4785790.short_description: Set during the fall of the Ming dynasty in 1644, this historical grand-strategy narrative game lets you rule as the Chongzhen Emperor, fight for the Shun regime, lead another faction, or survive as a commoner. Govern, wage war, manage resources, and reshape history through AI-assisted court debates.

4786060.title: Primal Tactica
4786060.short_description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack synergies to create wild gamebreaking teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

4786130.title: Blightsilver
4786130.short_description: Join a paranormal investigation where card battles are the key that uncovers the conspiracy beneath the city. Duel on a secret 5×5 grid. Reveal your opponent’s hidden information—while they hunt for yours.

4786330.title: Bikini Island Cricket
4786330.short_description: A third-person sports party game that blends cricket with playful island mini‑games, stamina challenges, and popularity‑boosting antics, offering emergent mechanics and lighthearted chaos on Bikini Island.

4786470.title: 核心防线 core defense line
4786470.short_description: You are a cloud operator. In the game, to protect the core and resist the continuous virus invasions, you build defenses, construct cards, install creatively designed plugins that provide you with various attack methods, repair external nodes, and at the same time offer you more convenient defense.

4786500.title: DoloTwin
4786500.short_description: All of South Tyrol in 1:1 scale as an open world in Unreal Engine 5. Drive across 7,400 km² of real alpine passes, explore the mountains on foot in multiplayer, or connect your bicycle and treadmill directly to the game via our Companion App.

4786550.title: Devil in the penthouse
4786550.short_description: Slay bosses and climb the demonic skyscraper in this stress-free incremental RPG. Gather loot, unleash powerful active skills, and upgrade your knight to achieve ultimate power. Can you reach the Penthouse and defeat the Devil?

4786570.title: Silas' Speakeasy
4786570.short_description: The local speakeasy has been closed down for quite some time due to an undisclosed incident involving the local mob. You've been given the job of finding your way inside, locating, and destroying any and all incriminating evidence that you can get your hands on before it can be used against you.

4786580.title: Squimo
4786580.short_description: The Squimo have taken over this planet. Grab your weapons, fight your way through endless hordes of Squimo, and face the Squimo King to reclaim the planet!

4786600.title: Ants TD
4786600.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

4786800.title: No Return Address
4786800.short_description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just don’t make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

4786880.title: PROTOCOL BOUND
4786880.short_description: BOUND is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

4787010.title: Rogue Striker
4787010.short_description: Draft. Play. Upgrade. Win. Combine fast-paced football action with roguelite drafting strategy to build the perfect team and reach the World Finals.

4787330.title: Baggage Belt
4787330.short_description: Grow a tiny pixel-art airport all the way to the stars in this cozy idle game. Check in bags, hire the crew and book routes that multiply your income. Every airport has its own minigame, and the belt keeps running while you're away. Your crew chief is a corgi called Biscuit.

4787480.title: STATE Z
4787480.short_description: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

4787530.title: Harrowgate Asylum
4787530.short_description: HARROWGATE ASYLUM is a first-person survival horror where fighting back is not an option. Study patrol routes, slip between hiding spots, and hold your breath while something walks past you in the dark. If you are seen, running is all you have left.

4787640.title: LANCELOT: The Silver Knight
4787640.short_description: Experience the legends of “Lancelot: The Silver Knight”, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and… chickens?

4787920.title: Screw You Party
4787920.short_description: "Screw You Party" is a 1-4 player online or local multiplayer party board game. Roll dice across the map of the United States, earn coins in mini-games, and win medals by sabotaging other players and stealing their coins. Become the President of the United States!

4787970.title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
4787970.short_description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

4788460.title: Affictionate
4788460.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

4788530.title: Chopex
4788530.short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

4788850.title: Echo Tide
4788850.short_description: Create your protagonist and inherit a house in Caelmere, a coastal village where romance, mystery, and hidden mermaids are only the beginning. Investigate your uncle's death, meet 15 unique love interests, and choose whether to become a mermaid or something far more mysterious.

4789090.title: System // Crash
4789090.short_description: A momentum platformer, with combo-centered hack 'n slash combat. Use your trusty sword, TyBreaker (Among other weapons), to cut and destroy every TyCorp drone in your way. Cut the drones, and take back the world.

4789360.title: Imma Potato
4789360.short_description: ImmaPotato is a survival sim where you play as a potato farming crops, cooking meals, automating machines, and launching food into a giant's mouth to keep it happy. The longer you survive, the tastier the recipes get and the harder the giant becomes to please. Machines and automation are the key.

4789920.title: Grass Cutting Incremental
4789920.short_description: Cut grass. Build power. Reset for permanent progression. Automate production, unlock new worlds and mechanics, and push further through layer after layer of an ever-growing incremental adventure where the grass is only the beginning.

4790460.title: WyrmGate
4790460.short_description: A turn-based online RPG in the dark-fantasy Wyrmlands, where abilities decide the fight: 39 abilities, spells and cantrips across three classes, 31 combat effects, 11 damage types. Loot with 100+ affixes, +10 enhancement, enchanting orbs. Async PvP and a co-op dragon lair for 2-5 heroes.

4790710.title: Shanhai Phantasm
4790710.short_description: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

4790720.title: Infinite R: Idle Racing
4790720.short_description: "An idle racing management game tailor-made for second screens. Perfect for 'desktop slacking,' watch your car auto-race while you work. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!"

4791150.title: Idlecraft
4791150.short_description: A mining incremental game where you dig by day and survive the night. Break blocks, fight the mobs that climb onto the board after dark, and spend every run's haul on skill trees, enchants, gear and prestige. Every run makes the next one stronger.

4791310.title: Frontactics
4791310.short_description: Frontactics is a strategic roguelike auto battler about building your own tactical squad. Recruit units, win battles, and earn resources! Awaken units into new roles each run, combine diverse synergies, and lead your squad against stronger foes.

4791430.title: Dead Rose
4791430.short_description: Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a Metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical. Everything is handmade, with love and passion. A story inspired by my father’s, to whom I pay tribute.

4791800.title: Concerto on White: Bass Hero
4791800.short_description: Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes, and grow your fan base to perform in larger venues!

4791970.title: Hex Tower Boogie
4791970.short_description: A tower defense MOBA inspired by Future Cop: LAPD, on a cardboard hex board. Four bases around one throne, last base standing. Build your ammo chain, send your army down the lanes and fire the launcher yourself. 1 to 4 players online, bots fill empty seats, about 20 minutes a match.

4792060.title: Hazel Rush
4792060.short_description: You need to explore the world, outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

4792220.title: Diet Survivor
4792220.short_description: Survive the first day of your diet in an action-packed survival roguelike where junk food comes alive. Run, dodge, collect fruits, grab power-ups, and face dangerously delicious enemies that grow bigger, faster, and harder to avoid.

4792260.title: Blood of Rations
4792260.short_description: A first-person PvPvE WW2 extraction looter shooter. Slip alone into a war-torn Europe to scavenge what the dead left behind. Hunt loot. Fight deserters and strangers. Extract alive — or lose it all. Every raid begins in your warm, safe bunker. If you're lucky, it ends there too.

4792370.title: Lexip
4792370.short_description: Lexip is a cozy fantasy factory game about magic, rail logistics, and questionable sustainability. Build production chains across the overworld and underground, power machines with local magic, fulfill contracts, and keep Null pollution under control.

4792560.title: Groder Reborn
4792560.short_description: Turn a low-poly town into your physics playground. Shove, grab and tumble with friends, drive manual cars, handle weapons and magazines, and patch up injured limbs. Spawn your own chaos in Sandbox or join a server and see what happens next.

4793120.title: Sushi Loop
4793120.short_description: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

4793530.title: Remains on the bus
4793530.short_description: Deliver packages to the last people living in a beautiful, abandoned brutalist world. Every delivery pays. Every destination gets stranger. And some packages should never be opened.

4793860.title: Hammered!
4793860.short_description: Hammered! is a top-down pixel-art action crafting roguelite. As a cursed genius blacksmith, uncover the source of a looming darkness. Forge weapons in real-time, hurl them at enemies, gather allies, and smash your way through!

4793980.title: Pest Protocol
4793980.short_description: Pest Protocol is a short incremental game about a very tired exterminator, a cursor, and infested sites that refuse to stay clean. Squash some pests, buy yourself better tools, and eventually let the whole operation run itself while you make a cup of tea.

4794120.title: BLACKOUT: Fatal Exposure
4794120.short_description: Your job is to sort through normal photos from ghost photos. You have five days to finish, but it won't end there. Mysterious visitors keep arriving and an unknown terror bleeds into your reality. Can you escape this curse?

4794160.title: Catacomb
4794160.short_description: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

4794590.title: Gemfall
4794590.short_description: The match 3 roguelike! Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop. Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

4794780.title: GnomeBoozled
4794780.short_description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

4795360.title: Conglomerate
4795360.short_description: One Earth, millions of cities, competing companies. Conglomerate is an economic simulation where every city is a moving part and every company is part of a shared global economy. Build supply chains, hire local workers and expand city by city.

4796520.title: Counter Ducks
4796520.short_description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

4796710.title: Road Meal
4796710.short_description: A driving game. A cursed artifact. Race to complete deliveries on behalf of a company with roots deeper than human tools can cut.

4796860.title: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
4796860.short_description: A desktop alchemy game. Type and move your mouse to gather resources; control the heat, forge items, find rare affixes and fill your collection. Exchange supplies with other players. Eligible items can enter Steam Inventory and the Community Market. Internet required.

4797150.title: Bullets & Boletes
4797150.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

4797200.title: Squabblin Goblins
4797200.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

4797900.title: Chodd
4797900.short_description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

4797910.title: JAWED
4797910.short_description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

4798050.title: Beyond the Rain Sound
4798050.short_description: You are the player, exploring a hospital that appears in your dreams while collecting fragments of memory and discovering what happened to you in this psychological horror game. As the story progresses, you will be forced to confront yourself. What awaits you beyond that...

4798090.title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
4798090.short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

4798230.title: Mesozoic Protocol
4798230.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend outposts with towers and your armed HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

4798260.title: 花散る社のハナビメ
4798260.short_description: Hanachiru Shrine no Hanabime is a Japanese-inspired sorting and idle game where you gather faith by discerning people's wishes and restore a once-abandoned sacred shrine. Enjoy a unique blend of peaceful, relaxing moments and fast-paced shrine duties as you rebuild the divine sanctuary.
developers: ハナビメプロジェクト
publishers: ハナビメプロジェクト

4798770.title: Pinball Millionaire
4798770.short_description: A physics pinball incremental game where every bounce earns money, triggers upgrades, and turns your board into a chaotic money-making machine.

4799230.title: Fetidity
4799230.short_description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

4799620.title: Thiccfoot
4799620.short_description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

4799760.title: The Black Shift
4799760.short_description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

4800250.title: Open Skies
4800250.short_description: The deep Aerobiz successor. Build a turn-based airline empire across 175 real cities, painted like the 90s Koei classics: court sixty patrons, hire executives, make the Herald's front page, and outplay rivals that follow your rules and play to win.

4800640.title: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.
4800640.short_description: Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

4800930.title: Diavento of Skyroar
4800930.short_description: The only weapon is the “Blade.” This is a bullet-hell action game that emphasizes the thrill of attacking. There are no attacks you can just fire off indiscriminately. Pilot the combat robot “Diavento,” dodge enemy attacks to build up energy, and turn the tide with a single strike.

4800970.title: wormin
4800970.short_description: Synchronize Wormins with ancient glyphs in a mysterious world of signs and snakes. Discover strange rules, clever interactions, and puzzles hidden beneath the surface.

4801140.title: I Don't Do Quests Anymore...
4801140.short_description: Be the quest giver in this casual guild management game! Tired of doing all these quests for random NPCs? This time, you can be this NPC! Take your place in your very own adventurers guild and distribute quests to heroes. brew potions, craft gear and make smart choices to help them survive!

4801270.title: Ashes of Macedonia
4801270.short_description: Survive the chaos of the Greek Macedonian Front in a brutal WW1 first-person shooter. Hold the line against overwhelming assaults, manage dwindling resources, and fight to stay alive. Death is permanent. One life. One soldier. One chance.

4801500.title: SWIFTALE PLAYER
4801500.short_description: [Japanese language only] Solo TTRPG powered by your own LLM. All in-game text and player input are in Japanese; there is no English support.

4801620.title: DEEP RESET
4801620.short_description: Dig through destructible terrain and defeat enemies in this top-down 2D looter shooter. Craft your own build and venture ever deeper.

4801630.title: Us Against Wood
4801630.short_description: Us Against Wood is a co-op casual game where you and your friends share one simple goal: chop down a single enormous tree. Work together or alone to carve deeper into the trunk.

4801830.title: Myriad Strategy
4801830.short_description: Myriad Strategies: a turn-based strategy game. Rule a nation amid wars, famine, plague, and refugees. Manage cities, talent, economy. The world shifts. Win by holding cities, stabilizing lives, solving refugee crises, building food systems & spy networks, or surviving the chaos.

4801980.title: Rain of Lead
4801980.short_description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

4802220.title: SnorQ
4802220.short_description: SnorQ is a dark fantasy pixel art action roguelite. Explore levels generated in ever changing sequences. Collect crystals, unlock abilities, choose bonuses. Survive the monsters and face SnorQ, your own deformed self who wants to keep you in oblivion. Local coop for up to 2 players.

4802240.title: Starforge Pirate
4802240.short_description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

4802330.title: Project Miasma: Prelude
4802330.short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Board abandoned ships, explore their dark corridors, uncover what happened to their crews, and survive threats you cannot fight as something watches from the dark.

4802890.title: LIMINAL
4802890.short_description: You arrive skinless in an endless, fogbound world. Cross into 47 impossible realms, kill what lives there, and take gifts that mutate your body until you are worse than anything hunting you. Stay too long and the ground dissolves beneath you.

4803020.title: Tales of Linxi: Idle Wuxia Village
4803020.short_description: A massive narrative idle game with extremely rich systems: farming, logging, fishing, cultivation, reincarnation, recruiting heroes, building a town, raising an army and conquering nations until you unify the continent. Includes over 300,000 words of story. Idle while reading a visual novel!

4803280.title: Little Girls Escapeventures
4803280.short_description: The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations. Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know? Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

4803660.title: Heatline
4803660.short_description: Heatline is a single-player open-world cops-and-racers game. Race as an outlaw, escape police pursuits, and unlock a police career to hunt down rivals. Customize your cars, equip pursuit tech, and decide when to push for bigger rewards or return to base to bank your earnings.

4803970.title: Succubus Busy Line
4803970.short_description: #Urban Fantasy Visual Novel Game#1v2 Demon Romance (BL)# You're a low-ranking succubus who just came of age in Demon City. All you want is to work hard and live a peaceful life, but two extraordinary demons keep stirring up trouble in your world...

4804190.title: Mecha Wars: Kitbash Rebuilt
4804190.short_description: One day, young Lumina accidentally witnesses a shady incident and gets dragged straight into the crossfire. From that moment on, she’s forced into a desperate war against the evil organization “Tenfold Piercing Arrow”. To crush her enemies, she must scavenge parts and forge an even stronger mecha.

4804280.title: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
4804280.short_description: A fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike meets a TCG. Draft a deck, explore branching dungeon maps, collect relics and defeat hero bosses, or build your collection and duel with a 30-card deck.

4804610.title: RumBall Stadium
4804610.short_description: Vehicles. Arenas. Friends to crush. RumBall Stadium: the Free to Play multiplayer vehicular combat game ! Drive Tanks, 4x4s and Racers in explosive arenas ! Collect Coins, equip Super Powers and crush your friends ! Discover multiple arenas and game modes !

4804630.title: Cube Colony
4804630.short_description: Grow a colony one cube at a time and keep Industry, Nature and Science in balance. Your colonists have opinions. Your balance bar has limits. Push it too far, and it all comes crashing down.

4804770.title: Uncharted Lands
4804770.short_description: Will you be able to save shipwrecks from uncharted lands in medieval Europe? Get ready to survive, fight, explore and dominate

4805310.title: The Lantern Man Cometh
4805310.short_description: Become the Lantern Man of the lakes in this spooky incremental roguelite. Use your mystical light to lure boatmen to their doom, harvest their souls, and upgrade your powers.

4805350.title: Imperium of the Stars
4805350.short_description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.

4805430.title: Armed-Mageddon
4805430.short_description: Top-down bullet heaven with randomly generated weapons and maps. Find guns, level up, unlock everything, upgrade and evolve your weapons to create unique and crazy builds as you blast your way through the end of the world!

4805970.title: The Kept Fire
4805970.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

4806070.title: Routes and Forges
4806070.short_description: A unique blend of RTS, Tycoon, and Tower Defense, where you are the architect, mayor, and commander of a growing village (and conurbation of villages). Your goals are simple: build a prosperous community, optimize production chains, and survive the horrors that emerge from the dark.

4806170.title: It's Not a Bomb
4806170.short_description: Throw explosives, dodge chaos, and blow your friends sky-high in this frantic multiplayer party game! Battle across explosive arenas, unleash crazy power-ups, and prove who's the master of mayhem in modes like Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Demolition, and Team Battles!

4806510.title: Island Miner
4806510.short_description: Island Miner is an automation game about expanding your factories across a vast island empire. Mine and refine ore into advanced materials, connect islands into a production network, then buy new ones with profit from a shifting galactic market. No enemies, no timers, just smart logistics.

4806650.title: Minesweeper 2007
4806650.short_description: The future of minesweeper games we were promised. Minesweeper 2007 is a mine flagging puzzle game with new mechanics and a nostalgic 2000’s Frutiger Aero aesthetic. Flag your way through dozens of original puzzles, relax, and pretend it's still 2007…

4806670.title: Whitopia
4806670.short_description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

4807210.title: Arithmancy
4807210.short_description: Solve a shifting medieval crypt with math as your only weapon. Arithmancy is a grim, grid-based FPS dungeon crawler. Armed with a cryptic calculator, you must decipher numerical runes, crack procedural vault puzzles, and manipulate the environment to survive the dark. Can you calculate your way out?

4807270.title: Angel Ascension Exam: RE
4807270.short_description: The Angel Ascension Test. Join Marie, an apprentice angel, and take on brutal challenges with precise drag-jump controls in this hardcore platformer. Claim your place among the angels!

4807560.title: Scrim-Mage
4807560.short_description: Scrim-Mage is a casual 2d fighting game where you and a friend play as gnome wizards and can customise your moveset with different spells. Competitive silliness is a guarantee in this colourful combination between traditional and platform fighters.

4807630.title: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension
4807630.short_description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

4807990.title: Ashes of Pantheon
4807990.short_description: Become the Ash Fire. Chart your gladiator’s course through the arena with directive cards, then watch your plan play out in real time. Build your deck, manage resources, and rekindle divine power in a turn-based strategy deckbuilder steeped in ancient Roman mythology.

4808140.title: Drive To The Top
4808140.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

4808290.title: Nozomu School Daze
4808290.short_description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

4808490.title: Kindling Wilds: Symbiotic Wasteland
4808490.short_description: Ember: Symbiotic Wilderness is a 2D pixel-art co-op survival game set in a living wilderness shaped by temperature, weather, seasons, and ecology. Start with a single fire, divide the work with your team, and build a camp that can endure.

4808500.title: Global Supremacy
4808500.short_description: A vast, real-time geopolitical simulation where 196 nations live and breathe at once. Economy, finance, monetary policy, trade, energy, military, diplomacy, nuclear strategy, politics, society — every lever that moves a nation is in your hands. The clock never stops — until you stop it.

4809070.title: Idle Pixel Battle
4809070.short_description: Build your hero party in a fantasy idle auto battler packed with loot and progression. Collect powerful artifacts, unlock more than 200 upgrades, automate your runs, and take on new challenges.

4809500.title: Hop 'n' Karty
4809500.short_description: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.

4809540.title: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator
4809540.short_description: Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? This game is exactly that! A satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless.

4809560.title: Auto Empire Tycoon
4809560.short_description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and a single dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, keep your dealerships stocked, and outpace your rivals to build your own automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

4809720.title: Office TD
4809720.short_description: Foil your co-worker's attempts to make you as useless as they are by arranging hapless teammates and ordinary office equipment in devious cubicle layouts to engineer the ultimate defense.

4809740.title: RushGirl LUCA
4809740.short_description: Alien drones have trashed the city. To save it, android girl LUCA fuses a weapon into a weapon into a weapon into a weapon… LUCA, how many weapons is that?! A bullet-hell roguelite you play with a mouse.

4809940.title: LEXICON: The Nameless Tongue
4809940.short_description: You crash-land on an alien world and must trade with the locals to survive. But their language is generated fresh every run: new words, new script, new grammar. Listen, guess, haggle and decipher your way off the planet.

4810060.title: Neuro Cell
4810060.short_description: A survival horror game set in a dark, foggy city. Survive against fast, aggressive enemies whose brains are controlled by a rogue computer network. Manage your low ammo, explore dangerous streets, and stop the system before it hunts you down.

4810230.title: Project RESONANCE
4810230.short_description: Recruit AI bandmates with their own looks and stories, run a maid café together, and turn everyday moments into songs. Every album is generated live for your story—no two bands sound alike. Take music that's yours alone from a street-corner livehouse to the city's biggest stage.

4810270.title: Animals League Unite
4810270.short_description: Stack up, slap around and fall together. Up to 8 friends climb on each other to reach the key, in planes, minecarts and outer space. Your friends are the ladder, the bridge and the reason you fell. Play online, on one couch or both, then build levels to trap them again.

4810350.title: Medusa's Gaze
4810350.short_description: A new 3D first-person puzzle game, where every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? Solve dozens of mind-bending puzzles involving light & shadow, life & death, to uncover the mystery at the heart of the fortress.

4810470.title: Once Apond a Time
4810470.short_description: You crash down in a giant pond during a terrible storm. As you seek help for your broken wing, you'll meet new friends, explore the islands, and collect & craft items. Discover a heartfelt story about friendship and healing, all in a cosy 2.5D style.

4811620.title: Penny Potluck
4811620.short_description: A cozy cooking roguelite where you combine ingredients, apply seasonings, discover recipes, and build powerful culinary synergies to satisfy an ever-growing hunger and score big.

4812600.title: Pawns into the Dark
4812600.short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

4813380.title: Vacuum Uprising
4813380.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

4813480.title: Gluttony Club
4813480.short_description: As the Arena Manager, build your dessert team and send them into bloody battle against heroes. Don't feel bad for them—the harder the heroes slash, the crazier the VIP clients get, and the more your bonus coins explodes!

4813510.title: Sanctuary of Small Things
4813510.short_description: A wholesome creature-collecting game, solo or co-op for up to four. Wander enchanting biomes, gather ingredients, brew gentle remedies, and heal the small things you find to grow your Sanctuary. Cosy, calm, and quietly addictive.

4813520.title: Voidbit
4813520.short_description: In this challenging deckbuilder puzzle platformer, mixing turn based with real time gameplay, you don't control the main character. Instead, you'll play cards to manipulate the character, the world and the deck to lead them off planet before the chasing void consumes them.

4813740.title: Slash And Dash
4813740.short_description: Step into the shoes of a shape-shifting hero and dash through random realms in this pixel-art action runner rogue-lite! Can you defeat powerful bosses and save the world? Collect diamonds, upgrade your stats, and prepare for the ultimate showdown!!!

4814120.title: ANANTA
4814120.short_description: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

4814200.title: Handset HQ
4814200.short_description: A phone company management sim. Pick a shape, swap materials, or draw the outline yourself, then develop, test, and sell it. Every change instantly shifts the cost and how buyers react. Grow a tiny startup into a phone giant, as long as people actually buy what you build.

4814910.title: Wuxing Zodiac
4814910.short_description: Wuxing Zodiac is a roguelite deckbuilding game where cards inspired by the Five Elements and Zodiac Signs create endless strategic possibilities. Build powerful combos, score big, and overcome the mysterious Cursed Chips.

4814920.title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
4814920.short_description: Fast-paced 1v1 street soccer arcade game! Control unique heroes, use spectacular combat-style moves, and defeat opponents in real-time. Upgrade your characters' skills, conquer global leagues, and become a superstar in thrilling online PvP football matches

4815170.title: Pipe Dream
4815170.short_description: A micro-MMORPG in 2008 Brooklyn for you and 31 friends. Hold a job or rob the bank, own the bar or the building, talk to anyone with your voice and watch the city remember it. The news runs your face. You owe Tony $1,500 by Sunday. The city doesn't care how you get it.

4815220.title: Hearthside: Your Custom Fireplace
4815220.short_description: A cozy, customizable fireplace simulator and desktop companion. Relax to soothing soundscapes and crackling flames, personalize the hearth with your own art and wall text, or boost focus with built-in productivity widgets like Pomodoro, to-dos, and Lo-Fi beats.

4815270.title: KRUSHPIT
4815270.short_description: KRUSHPIT is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

4815530.title: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy
4815530.short_description: Explore and fight as Garuya, a rabbit mage who seeks to destroy an ancient relic hidden in a vast and dangerous ruined kingdom. Cast spells, reshape the environment and fight under the light of three moons.

4815920.title: StarCat
4815920.short_description: StarCat is a bullet heaven roguelite with the soul of an arcade shoot 'em up. Space cats, betrayal and a thousand ways to die. Build your loadout, crush the Sili and cross four worlds packed with enemies and bosses. For hardcore gamers only.

4816220.title: Frutiger Aero Horror Alpha 2
4816220.short_description: You flip PCs as a hobby. An unbelievable flea market find from 2015 turns into a nightmare. The moment you boot this Windows 7 setup, a blinding force sucks you straight into the monitor. Now you are trapped in the strange futuristic world of Frutiger Aero. No soul is in sight. Or so it seems...

4816810.title: Soup's Tail
4816810.short_description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

4816860.title: Skuffle
4816860.short_description: 4-player splitscreen online party shooter. Couch and online players in the same match. Maps, Modes, Skins, Monkeys, Guns, Cigarettes! Oh My! WHAT ELSE DO YOU PEOPLE WANT?

4816880.title: Where's Kim in Seoul?
4816880.short_description: "Coo...coo..coo... (Have you seen Kim? The pigeon with a mole?)" A 3D hidden-object hunt in Seoul—from a pigeon’s-eye view! Explore the city as a tourist pigeon to spot elusive 'Kim Pigeons' hiding in the flock. Spot their unique features, snap a polaroid, and fill your scrapbook!

4817150.title: Christmas CEO
4817150.short_description: Run Santa's Workshop in this cozy management sim. Assign workers, manage resources, survive crisis events, and make enough toys before Christmas.

4817160.title: Homeless Survival
4817160.short_description: "Homeless: Survival" — a gritty survival sim where you play as a drifter clawing your way up from the streets. Take odd jobs, learn skills, scavenge rare items, and risk it all—even in the supernatural—to earn your citizenship and start over. Every choice writes your story of redemption.

4817170.title: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
4817170.short_description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

4817200.title: Pet that Dog
4817200.short_description: Pet and collect 50+ breeds of dogs in our doggy dress up desktop companion! Every tap or click is a pet for your pup! If you pet your dog enough, they might dig up fun accessories you can use to dress them up!

4817760.title: Grid Demon
4817760.short_description: Hack the swarm and build your army in this cyberpunk bullet-heaven roguelite. Turn enemy machines into allies, shape your build, and unleash a surge of power as you battle the Wardens across five hostile grids. Free the Grid, or claim it for yourself.

4817870.title: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス
4817870.short_description: Fall in love, and rewrite literary history. Romance legendary Japanese authors—including Osamu Dazai, Ryunosuke Akutagawa, Kenji Miyazawa, and Natsume Soseki—in a literary mystery visual novel. Your choices shape not only your romance, but also the fate of literary history itself.

4818090.title: Chronoform
4818090.short_description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

4818290.title: Forgotten Towns
4818290.short_description: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

4818330.title: 白之树：月泪少女
4818330.short_description: 《白之树：月泪少女》在没有陆地的世界里，人类仍在航行。世界被海洋吞没，文明碎裂成漂浮的船团。而在这片无尽之海中，唯一稳定的光源，是一种名为“白之树”的神秘存在。它结出的果实——“月之泪”，维系着整个世界的运转。但没有人知道，它究竟是什么。

4818370.title: We Grow Together
4818370.short_description: Defend your starship in this endless sci-fi tower defense game! Form your ultimate squad of 2D heroes, permanently upgrade your spaceship's hull and defenses, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities to survive relentless waves of cosmic alien invaders in the vast void.

4818400.title: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
4818400.short_description: Farming sim meets monster taming. Grow crops to feed and strengthen your Luminons. Compete in beauty contests or strategic 3v3 battles.

4818490.title: DANCING ZOMBIE
4818490.short_description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

4818530.title: Blood Covenant
4818530.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror job-sim where your hazmat crew cleans up after the night shift while the building quietly changes things behind your back. Every anomaly you fail to report makes the ritual at the end of the night a little worse.

4818620.title: WBS26 Wrestling Booker Simulator
4818620.short_description: Run a wrestling promotion and book every match. Build your roster, choose champions and watch your shows in 3D. Manage contracts, rivalries, finances and backstage relationships as you shape the next generation of stars.

4818880.title: Sakura no Uta -To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms-
4818880.short_description: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

4818950.title: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
4818950.short_description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

4819010.title: Ink & Lore
4819010.short_description: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite: choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who…

4819610.title: Barns & Beams
4819610.short_description: You are a city kid who can no longer afford housing, but luckily, your grandfather has left you his disastrous farm in the middle of nowhere as an inheritance. You will have to learn to manage farm life and, along the way, deal with "Them."

4819690.title: DWARFS AND? SKELETONS
4819690.short_description: Slay gods and their onslaught of mystical minions in this fast-paced dark fantasy FPS. Slowly unlock an arsenal of guns, abilities, and equipment to make ridiculously devastating builds that obliterate your enemies as you make your way to The Dark Lord and uncover what is really going on...

4819760.title: Duskfire
4819760.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where tactical positioning matters as much as the cards you play.
