Collect new spells, recruit and modify powerful creatures, upgrade your spells, and build a unique deck every run. Master strategic battles and grow stronger through a roguelite progression system.

4820840.title: SudoPop
4820840.short_description: Sudoku meets idle game. Solve candy-colored boards by hand, hire nine number buddies to solve with you, and watch them build boards out of boards until millions of Sudokus pop every second.

4820860.title: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim
4820860.short_description: It started as a simple tease. Yet, your devoted AI companion has crossed the line and pried into your secret diary. Your choices will dictate the final outcome of your relationship in this AI yandere romance.

4820900.title: Cursed to Type
4820900.short_description: Every word you type keeps the office's corrupted objects contained. Build a keyboard that fights back in this spooky typing roguelike deck-builder.

4821370.title: Academy Wars
4821370.short_description: Academy Wars is a strategic 1v1 PvP auto-battler where you draft unique students, power them up with in-battle upgrades, and win through positioning, adaptation, and decisive strategies. Climb the ranks and prove yourself among the best!

4821490.title: How to Use
4821490.short_description: No instructions. No hints. Just you, mysterious controls, and over 15,000 possible combinations. Experiment your way through this unique puzzle experience.

4821550.title: Toy Box
4821550.short_description: Collect toys, avoid mischievous enemies, and escape colorful mazes in this fast-paced retro-style arcade game inspired by classic maze games!

4821930.title: Toxic Dating Simulator
4821930.short_description: Atakan'ın Binder'da eşleştiği, yaşam tarzları birbirinden farklı olan 3 kadınla randevulardan sağ çıkmaya çalış. Yapacağın seçimlerle Atakan'ın karakterini şekillendir. Kılıbık ol, alfa ol, yalancı ol, dürüst ol, manipülatif ol. Seçimini yap ve sonucuna katlan.

4822160.title: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
4822160.short_description: Gallop Diva blends realistic horse racing physics with a deep story simulation. Master high-stakes horse racing and deep visual novel choices in a world where speed meets true human nature. Ride your horses, navigate choices, and outrun dark rules of the racetrack politics.

4822640.title: Toypact
4822640.short_description: Welcome to the world of Toypact. Step into a miniature world, collect unique toys and grow together! Think through strategy, mix and match equipment, and build your own ever-changing combat style. Every choice may spark new surprises—and the strongest doll will be cultivated by your own hands!

4823160.title: Chumacho Jones
4823160.short_description: An old-school game with geeky touches and countless references to geek culture from the 1980s. It's not all about shooting and fighting—complete missions and search for those objects that have left a mark on our lives. Explore Madrid's iconic locations, including streets, landmarks, and MetroMadrid.

4823250.title: Incremental Pain Profit
4823250.short_description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

4823390.title: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co.
4823390.short_description: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co. is a fun 2D art & management sim. Paint what’s in the minds of quirky customers with top accuracy, showcase your art in the gallery, sell it at auctions, and compete online with friends!

4823420.title: Leon&Suharto
4823420.short_description: In the Slums, people kill for a drop of noble blood. And Leon has it. Lies, revenge, a connection that bleeds, and a game that stares back at you. A dark episodic novel about those who survived — and are still paying the price.

4823770.title: Strato Alto
4823770.short_description: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

4824030.title: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
4824030.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

4824220.title: Meltdown Crew
4824220.short_description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

4824430.title: Bestseller Tycoon
4824430.short_description: Build a publishing house, one book at a time. Discover authors, shape manuscripts and decide which stories deserve a place on your list. Balance literary ambition with the cost of keeping the business alive in this publishing management sim.

4824730.title: KAGERO
4824730.short_description: Fight solo or in up to 4-player co-op to destroy the houses that tried to erase you. Harvest the souls of the fallen, grow stronger with every battle, and fuel the ritual to awaken an ancient spirit.

4824860.title: Chef Pinball
4824860.short_description: Flip after flip, Chef Pinball serves pure dopamine! Explore powerful synergies in this chaotic cooking pinball roguelike aboard a moving train. Recruit chefs, cook delicious meals and transform your train into the ultimate restaurant on rails.

4824910.title: Tabernacle
4824910.short_description: Tabernacle is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. Once holy places have been forsaken and corrupted by sin. Do your duties as inquisitors of the church; collect evidence of evil, reclaim sacred sites, and banish the unholy that seek to extinguish faith. Stand between the innocent and the damned.

4825050.title: Ink or Not
4825050.short_description: Ink or Not is a competitive score-attack game where a grid appears and on it some of the squares have ink and some don't. Click on whichever squares there are more of before the timer runs out. When you click on all the correct squares you go to the next round and you have slightly less time.

4825060.title: Mining Guild Idle
4825060.short_description: Mining Guild Idle is an inventory / resource management based incremental style game featuring 15 to 20 hours of gameplay

4825540.title: Lost in the Fest
4825540.short_description: The rhythm RPG where swords are guitars and potions are beers.

4825600.title: Brain Bomb
4825600.short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

4825930.title: Cozy Corner Cafe
4825930.short_description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

4826100.title: Bakery Simulator Online
4826100.short_description: Open your own bakery and manage every part of the working day. Prepare dough, bake a variety of goods, stock your displays and serve customers. Play Bakery Simulator solo or team up with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

4826240.title: Quiet Grove: Lost in the Fog
4826240.short_description: A cozy survival adventure set in a mysterious fog-covered forest after a plane crash. Explore hidden paths, gather resources, fish, cook meals, upgrade your camp, and uncover the secrets lurking beneath the forest's peaceful surface.

4826260.title: Kaput
4826260.short_description: KAPUT is a chaotic co-op horror comedy game for up to 6 players. Explore abandoned places, repair failing machinery, and salvage high-value scrap while avoiding terrifying anomalies. Work together, handle hazardous breakdown events, and escape with your loot before everything goes kaput!

4826430.title: Neostalker
4826430.short_description: NEOSTALKER is a tense turn-based first-person puzzle experience that combines grappling-hook movement, lethal machinery, and tactical planning in a series of dangerous spatial challenges on the way to the heart of a factory that has become a threat to everything around it.

4826490.title: REELS of the DAMNED
4826490.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

4826750.title: Siegelock
4826750.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about laying siege to a trespassing kingdom.

4826760.title: Maze Builder TD
4826760.short_description: A strategic tower defense where your towers are the maze. Funnel enemies through fire, ice and lightning, spend your gold on stronger defenses or risk investing for bigger payouts, and unlock permanent upgrades to push further into endless waves.

4826820.title: Desktop Factory
4826820.short_description: Dig a tunnel to the core of planets and build a factory inside of it. Drill deeper to unlock space as you grow your factory in the tight geometry of your mining shaft. Purchase alternate building shapes and production upgrades from your Capytalist oligarchs to harvest the galaxy for minimum wage.

4826850.title: SlimeRunner Reborn
4826850.short_description: A high-speed auto-runner reimagined from the 2020 game jam original. Built entirely around momentum and quick reflexes, it’s designed to be the perfect pick-up-and-play game for fast 20 to 30-minute sessions.

4826860.title: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
4826860.short_description: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

4826880.title: Plunderfall
4826880.short_description: Betrayed and stranded on a raft, fight back in this open-seas pirate survivors-like roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock ships and weapons, rescue your crew, defeat traitor captains, and claim their relics to conquer new waters.

4827130.title: TinyWind
4827130.short_description: A pixel pirate roguelite with real sailing and naval combat in short runs. Hand-rolled wind physics, procedural islands, mythic treasure and rare sea companions. Liberate British, Spanish and Dutch waters, hold Tortuga against both Crowns, or duel other captains in ranked PvP.

4828060.title: Fall, Fall, Fall for you
4828060.short_description: "Fall, Fall, Fall for you" is a challenging ball physics platformer about falling over and over again to prove your love for Daisy. She laughs every time you fall, calling you a dumb idiot. B-But... maybe she doesn't mean it. Who knows?

4828100.title: Incremaze
4828100.short_description: A pop-up later and something is loose in the machine. Deploy INCREMAZE antivirus into corrupted drives to do its work. Incremaze is an idle game about automation, escalation, and a cure you may come to regret.

4828200.title: Vaporware EX
4828200.short_description: It's 199X. Your four-person studio has a cartridge to fill and a deadline to hit. Build games feature by feature, squash bugs in rapid-fire microgames, haggle with publishers and climb from a regional game jam to Game of the Century in this cozy 16-bit game dev sim.

4828280.title: Dance With Time
4828280.short_description: SUPER-WEIRD time manipulation puzzle game. Change the map with your movements, calculate 3 steps ahead and reach the spiral. Even if you fail try again. After all, TIME IS ALL YOU HAVE.

4828300.title: SagaCraft
4828300.short_description: Step into an untamed Slavic fantasy where no two tales are the same. SagaCraft is a dynamic action-RPG where you speak to fully adaptive characters to alter an unscripted storyline. Crush legendary beasts, scavenge for mythical loot, and explore procedural lands in a world that reacts to your words.

4828470.title: Caramba Caballeros
4828470.short_description: Caramba Caballeros is a first-person pirate roguelike for 1–4 players. Explore islands and hunt for treasure by day. Defend your ship from enemy waves by night. Battle other pirates in a battle royale, solo or in teams, with matchmaking and custom lobbies.

4829060.title: KYC: K Stands for Killing
4829060.short_description: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

4829110.title: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die
4829110.short_description: Create thousands of night creatures and ensure the Hero does not survive until dawn. Play as death in a reverse survivor-like where both sides level up as you raise armies of monsters, unlock dark powers and stop a lone Hero from becoming a legend.

4829290.title: Tunnelborn
4829290.short_description: Dig for fossils under a volcano, one tile at a time. Nothing moves until you do — but then the lava creeps closer, your lamp burns lower, and something in the dark takes another step towards you…

4829310.title: Chop Loop
4829310.short_description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

4829360.title: Kinghold
4829360.short_description: You are the king and the spawn point in this frantic real-time tower defense roguelite. Play cards to summon autonomous troops, construct buildings, and set traps as you scramble to defend your castle against escalating enemy hordes.

4829520.title: VLCNP Story
4829520.short_description: A 2D metroidvania where you switch between Akim, a short-faced tiger, and his very long-faced friends. Punch through walls, slow foes with poison, float and fire will-o'-wisps. Recover memories to raise HP and grab rainbow seeds to power up, but hits power you down. Goofy looks, solid action!

4829870.title: SuLing: Echoes of Souls
4829870.short_description: "SuLing: Echoes of Souls" is a casual exploration game. Players will step into the dreamlike and picturesque continent of Spirit Tracing, explore the optimal resonance value of spirits, and unleash their full potential.

4829920.title: Dank Wizard Saga
4829920.short_description: Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, solve puzzles, battle dungeon bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades in this retro-inspired action-adventure with stoner comedy.

4830020.title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
4830020.short_description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

4830110.title: Did You See That?
4830110.short_description: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

4830260.title: Paper Lanes
4830260.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

4830540.title: HotlaneX
4830540.short_description: Outdrive, outsmart, outlast. HotlaneX throws you into arenas full of enemies that chase, predict, and ambush. No guns, no combat menus, just your car and your instincts. Simple to drive. Brutal to survive.

4830610.title: Treasure Simulator
4830610.short_description: Search the world for hidden treasures with untapped potential. Haggle, restore, or even forge items to turn a profit. Upgrade your skills, expand your shop, hire employees, and rise to become a master treasure hunter. Survive amid the escalating conflict between the government and rebel forces.

4831140.title: Kingdoms Assemble
4831140.short_description: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!

4831160.title: Love Trap
4831160.short_description: A suspenseful, atmospheric text adventure where you play an entrepreneur reborn two years before his mysterious death. At the scene were his abandoned ex, devoted roommate, and hostile socialite. Your choices reveal why they were there, why he died, and which truths stay buried.

4831260.title: CURSOR SLASH
4831260.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

4831430.title: I Want to Play the Villain!
4831430.short_description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

4831770.title: Rush To Hell: Abyss
4831770.short_description: Rush To Hell: Abyss is a fast-paced precision platformer focused on pure gameplay. Dodge deadly traps, defeat relentless enemies, and challenge massive infernal bosses as you descend deeper into a hostile world. Descend. Die. Learn. Repeat.

4831920.title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
4831920.short_description: Fully voiced in Cantonese. Free demo with the full Chapter 1 out already! You wake as a bastard prince facing execution—and you can read more than what people say. Use Inner Voice, Sincerity, Appraisal, and X-Ray Vision to expose lies and secrets, win allies, and rewrite a kingdom’s fate.

4832150.title: Star Curve
4832150.short_description: Star Curve is a single-player logic puzzle game. Explore an old observatory in a seaside town, examine the puzzles on its walls, infer their rules, and solve a series of carefully designed logic puzzles at your own pace.

4832170.title: Cursor Kingdom
4832170.short_description: Create an army of cursor clones by recording your actions. Automate resource gathering, production, and defense while your kingdom grows on its own.

4832340.title: Batur
4832340.short_description: Win your opponent's cards in a tense card battle of planets, then turn those same planets into weapons in a real-time space fight. Orbit planets around your star, launch homing comets and drop black holes in this strategic sci-fi duel.

4832370.title: Rogoz Fishing
4832370.short_description: A meditative fishing sim with deeply detailed fish behavior and habitats. Pick your spot on the depth map, choose how you fish — spinning, float or feeder — and land your trophies!

4832920.title: Project: Summer Ice Bowling Online
4832920.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, anime-styled bowling video game in the Project: Summer Ice franchise!

4833220.title: My Own Hero Party
4833220.short_description: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.

4833230.title: Roomy
4833230.short_description: Make a tiny 3D room that is your link in bio. Fill it with furniture, put a link on anything in it, like your YouTube on the TV, and share it anywhere. Visits, knocks and tips show up as they happen, and new things turn up while it's open. Free.

4833590.title: Final Commit
4833590.short_description: `Final Commit` is a top-down roguelite survival action game where you swap between two characters. Combine traits, change classes, and unleash Sync Drives to complete your build and reach the ending of an unfinished game world.

4833600.title: Cyber Wukong
4833600.short_description: Cyber Wukong is an exhilarating Roguelite action game! Here, immortal arts are black tech, and magical treasures are cybernetic creations. Enter a twisted West world of data, steel, and incense. Forge your combat style and face the mechanical Buddha, chanting scriptures and wielding a gun

4834830.title: Dark Earth
4834830.short_description: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

4834910.title: Gomoklear
4834910.short_description: Gomoklear is a Gomoku strategy roguelike: connect five to clear. Form a five, pieces leave; spawn, remove, move, transform. Collect pieces and Manuscripts, build your Library at Serendipity and the Stall. Two plays a Round, one for the Rival. Gomoku has never been this unpredictable.

4835290.title: Our Light Affliction: Spider's Covenant
4835290.short_description: A dark fantasy/yandere otome game about a girl who can see spirits, the spider apparition who tricks her into a contract, and the exorcist who is after them. Decide who to trust, and whether you'll fix them, or make them worse...

4835480.title: Desert Sweepers
4835480.short_description: In this relaxing first-person cleaning sim, the Bureau has declared the desert too sandy. Start with a spoon, get paid by the kilo, and earn your way to sweeper trucks and hauling robots. Leave a clean trail through the dunes at your own pace. Play solo or in online co-op from launch.

4835560.title: Banana Airways
4835560.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

4836000.title: 30 Days: The Last Melody
4836000.short_description: 30 Days: The Last Melody invites you into the journey of a young man living out his final 30 days. Experience a warm and emotional journey brought to life through beautiful hand-painted visuals, soothing music, and engaging mini-games as you reflect on love, hope, and the value of every moment.

4836440.title: The Chains Of Yme
4836440.short_description: In this tactical roguelike you control five adventurers as you explore procedurally generated ruins to reach and conquer a Titan. Fight deadly monsters, utilize power-ups, and improvise while your knowledge of the world deepens. Persist when your adventurers are left behind, killed, or sacrificed.

4836500.title: HypnoFish Inc.
4836500.short_description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for a fishing mega-corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

4836770.title: Panda vs Meow
4836770.short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

4838060.title: ZodiacLottery
4838060.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

4838610.title: Sprout's Meadow
4838610.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

4838650.title: The Cardian - Light the Shrines
4838650.short_description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

4838670.title: Heroll: IF
4838670.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

4838810.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
4838810.short_description: A creepy survivors-like played on a child's tabletop. Fight swarms as a tiny toy while a giant Kid looms over the battle. Pick level-up cards, merge your powers and build a ridiculous arsenal. Mom says he's fine. You'll see.

4839030.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
4839030.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful narrative experience with cooking elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

4839050.title: Altitude Zero
4839050.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

4839550.title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
4839550.short_description: Snowbound for decades, a Trans-Siberian train holds its passengers exactly as they died. Talk to the frozen dead, uncover the identity of a legendary thief, and decide how far you're willing to go for the truth.

4839600.title: 100 Petopia Cats
4839600.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4839700.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4839710.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4840020.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
4840020.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

4840050.title: Buried Life
4840050.short_description: 1997. After a sudden mine collapse, you find yourself trapped inside an abandoned Soviet research complex where classified experiments were once conducted. Explore underground laboratories, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover why the facility was buried along with everything it contained.

4840420.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
4840420.short_description: A magician wakes with no memory of the woman he loved... or how she died. Explore a circus that rearranges itself behind you, evade the witness in the rafters, and uncover what really happened during "The Final Show." An atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

4841260.title: Atout
4841260.short_description: Classic Card Games & more: 23 card games in one, from Tarot to Hanafuda, plus Rummy, Belote, Poker and Solitaire. Three AI difficulty levels, local and online multiplayer, 24 variants, six languages. A warm pixel-art take on the classics — play solo or with friends.

4841290.title: Eldritch Boyfriend
4841290.short_description: Eldritch Boyfriend is the only skill-based visual novel dating sim where your sanity—or lack thereof—turns the very act of choosing the right dialogue options into a series of challenging mini-games.

4841310.title: KnighTD
4841310.short_description: An endless tower defense where towers do not shoot. They empower the units fighting around them. Build, branch units into classes and elements, and hold the Fort through boss waves, loot, and shifting biomes.

4841360.title: Amelia
4841360.short_description: In this first-person narrative experience, you step into the shoes of a young girl. Explore a rural farmhouse and witness everyday family life through her eyes. Across 13 consecutive days, you'll realize that your family is not what it seems. Will you notice what everyone else leaves unsaid?

4841700.title: Concert of Power
4841700.short_description: Rule a shattered North America where every claim can become a crisis, and every crisis tests the balance of power. Build industry, command trade, forge treaties, isolate rivals, and decide whether to preserve the fragile order or become the power that breaks it.

4841740.title: I Am Train
4841740.short_description: A cozy train track builder, I Am Train. Drive your train around the world picking up passengers from various platforms. Build houses and towns to connect passengers.

4841790.title: The Idle Captain
4841790.short_description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

4841820.title: Echoes Below
4841820.short_description: Descend into the depths of the ocean and explore an underwater world alongside a mysterious octopus. Together, you will discover marine creatures and uncover the mysteries that await at the bottom of the sea…

4841860.title: Hypercube
4841860.short_description: An exhilarating FPS-style combat game featuring fully destructible arenas. The more you fight on, the less of the level you have left to fight in!

4841870.title: Hephaestus Protocol
4841870.short_description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

4842110.title: Forgery
4842110.short_description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

4842120.title: Deadclaim
4842120.short_description: A hardcore third-person extraction shooter on a persistent post-collapse Frontier. Carry in what you dare, fight raiders and AI for loot, and extract — or your kit drops on your corpse. Your progression stays safe; build an outpost, host your own server. No pay-to-win.

4842220.title: Coppersmog
4842220.short_description: Run a steampunk lab in a world being eaten by the Coppersmog conglomerate. Breed, mutate, and trade one-eyed blorbs, pick your way through an economy built to make you complicit, and hunt the Reversal: the one discovery that proves Aldous Puddlepot wrong.

4842440.title: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild-
4842440.short_description: Team up with your friends, pool your wisdom, and take on the Demon King with the ultimate deck. Gamashira Guild is a cooperative deck-building roguelike where discussing strategies with friends is the key to victory. Let’s all team up and take down the Demon King!

4842500.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
4842500.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

4842640.title: Subsector Zero
4842640.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

4842700.title: Minipia
4842700.short_description: Minipia is a cozy desktop idle game. Make a tiny island your own, right in the corner of your screen, while you work or relax. Decorate freely, collect cute animals, discover their stories, and unlock new islands.

4842940.title: One Last Draw
4842940.short_description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

4842990.title: Barnburners
4842990.short_description: Old school 5 on 5 Arcade hockey! Lay big hits, deke through the defense, and score top shelf! Pick from 24 teams, build your Franchise, create your own Pro, or play against your friends locally or online!

4843140.title: YOLKA: 90s New Year Simulator
4843140.short_description: Snow and chill outside, but warmth in your heart. In this nostalgic first-person simulator, dive back into childhood and get ready for New Year’s Eve. Decorate the tree, build a snowman, play, and fully immerse yourself in the cozy vibe of the 90s.

4843470.title: Most Games Flop
4843470.short_description: You’re 12. It’s 2006. You’ve got the family laptop and one dream: make a hit on Studz. Plan every month, build games, chase the algorithm and survive copycats for 20 years. Most games flop. Try anyway. Then do it again with up to 7 friends online.

4843520.title: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss
4843520.short_description: A 530,000 combat SHSL personal trainer is reincarnated as a villainess?! “Guillotine in a year? I’ll tank it with my traps.”A chaotic gain-seeking survival comedy romance fantasy visual novel about a character who fears muscle loss more than death.

4843760.title: Sound Agent
4843760.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

4843830.title: Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop
4843830.short_description: Step into your own machine shop. Operate manual mills and lathes, write CNC G-code, and turn raw stock into finished parts with real-time material removal. Experiment in Free Play or put your machining skills to work in Career mode.

4843920.title: OrderlyWorld
4843920.short_description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

4844190.title: Firebase
4844190.short_description: This is a First Person Shooter, "tower defense" style game that captures the intensity of the Tet Offensive. Offering unique game mechanics iconic of the Vietnam War, such as calling in Napalm strikes and M16 jamming. Firebase immerses you in the mud and grit of combat in South East Asia.

4844260.title: StarFrame
4844260.short_description: A single persistent galaxy shared by every player. Full loot. Rich skill system. Exploration, Industry, PvE/PvP Combat

4844280.title: Auto Cats
4844280.short_description: Build a squad of evolving cats in a tactical roguelite deckbuilder. Your whole team shares one hand: combine cards, positioning, and 100+ Cat Toys to set up powerful combos. Bond duplicates into stronger forms, then command each turn or let Auto Play run your build.

4844350.title: Anomagram
4844350.short_description: Anomagram is a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. More slices of someone else's ordinary life arrive each night, and you approve or report each one. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Eight nights.

4844540.title: GtFckd: Planet Survivors
4844540.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 8 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines, and slay the Rift Tyrant before the planet gets you first.

4844600.title: Buildcraft TD
4844600.short_description: Build powerful defenses, expand your village, and unlock new technologies in this strategic tower defense game. Gather resources, strengthen your economy, and survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

4844650.title: Rotten Batch: Bear Inspector
4844650.short_description: Inspect Fruit Patch Bears for defects, decide which category they belong to, and keep the line moving. Make sure you identify the cursed ones if you want to keep your job...and your life.

4844790.title: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House
4844790.short_description: Lost Relics Auction House is a single-player/multiplayer strategy sim about relic repatriation, legal auctions, and information play. Gather clues, read rivals, judge hidden value, use intel tools, and bid wisely without overpaying or missing priceless treasures.

4845290.title: SwipSwap
4845290.short_description: SwipSwap is a fast-paced 3D game where every hit is fatal. Fight alongside your shadow—which echoes your moves with a 2-second delay—swap positions instantly, and purge Dracoulous’ castle room by room. Sharp reflexes, positioning, and ruthless timing are your only hope.

4845370.title: STICKBIT
4845370.short_description: Escape from the Tower of Madness! STICKBIT is a fast-paced 2D Action Tower-Defense Rogue-lite where you build defenses, collect powerups, and blow up lots of barrels! It's loud, colorful, and much safer than the real world. Just keep playing.

4845680.title: Blek and the Endless Keep
4845680.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

4846420.title: Rainfusor
4846420.short_description: COMBINE ELEMENTS into bizarre playstyles. Rip and devour segmented bugs in rooms in a side-scroller mayhem-physics rogue-arcade. No tiny stat boosts/platforming/permadeath. Instead, unlock extreme, double-edged characters, runes, spell combos and synergies to become whole again, through sacrifice

4846670.title: PixelRift
4846670.short_description: A 2D side-scroller platformer game with level creation features.

4846690.title: Lord of Kensai
4846690.short_description: Build and govern a Japanese-inspired metropolis in the Katana-Ra universe. Balance your populace, rival factions and the four seasons on a world map. An accessible city builder with real strategic depth.

4846780.title: Shootrix
4846780.short_description: Shootrix is a fast-paced strategic puzzle game where you shoot and place blocks to create explosive 2x2 combos. Master chain reactions, outsmart opponents, and compete in real-time arena battles against players worldwide.

4846880.title: Dogfight Era: Origins
4846880.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 15 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

4847170.title: Super Kickmen
4847170.short_description: A deck-building roguelike and turn-based soccer game that brings soccer to a 7×5 grid. Aim for the top of the world with the ultimate team you’ve built!

4847650.title: Don't Mention B3
4847650.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground parking garage. Verify drivers, credentials, surveillance footage, and internal records, then decide who gets through. Remember: There is no B3 level.

4847830.title: Living With Dad - Family Party
4847830.short_description: Take on the Championn’Appart challenge with Dad’s Girls in this colourful party game! Who will take the top spot on the podium?

4847880.title: Lucifaria
4847880.short_description: After two other priests vanish, a retired exorcist is called upon to eradicate an ancient demon. Enter a thrilling single-room turn-based horror RPG requiring strategy, sacrifice, and perseverance.

4847950.title: REAVEN WOOD HOTEL : ROOM 207
4847950.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set inside a mysterious mountain hotel. Explore the dark halls of Reaven Wood Hotel and uncover the terrifying secrets hidden behind Room 207.

4848890.title: State Breakers
4848890.short_description: State Breakers is a chaotic top-down PvPvE extraction shooter. INTERSTATE A.I. has turned against humanity! They must be infiltrated and destroyed! Resist solo or in a team - kill zombies, hack the map, outwit rival humans, loot, level up - and overthrow the clanker scum!

4848920.title: Puppet's Trial
4848920.short_description: Puppet's Trial is a horror game where you incarnate a Puppet. With decaying life and the desire to find a purpose, You will face multiple trials to try to prove your worth to your maker. And eventually meet him.

4849210.title: A Taste of Heat
4849210.short_description: In your restaurant kitchen, will love simmer, or will lust boil over? Sharpen your ambition, create decadent recipes, and light the flames of passion. A text-based interactive romance novel, 500,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

4849440.title: Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion
4849440.short_description: Furniture comes as stickers, so the order matters and mistakes can’t be undone. Clara has left the office to become an interior designer, with thirty jobs ahead of her and a home of her own to decorate at her pace. A new illusion to live in.

4849900.title: Whenster
4849900.short_description: Who knows when what happened? Whenster is a timeline card game for friends: place movies, TV series, video games, inventions and historic events in the right order before the clock runs out. Host on Steam, and your friends join for free right in their browser.

4849910.title: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK
4849910.short_description: The Blue Men Group are energetic, enigmatic, interacting, arousing, performing, embarrassing, feeling, alarming, inspiring, desperate, hateful, impressive and performative. Join us at computer playing our Ultimate Video BlackJack collection. Unlock video, gameplay, get blowmanjobs, you will enjoy

4850190.title: UwUbUwU
4850190.short_description: UwUbUwU is a small cozy puzzle game based on a simple idea: What if you took classic Snake but inverted the goal and made it so you have to form a loop by eating your own tail.

4850560.title: DiceVenture Dungeon
4850560.short_description: DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler. Choose your path, roll and reroll to unleash class skills, and craft your build with dice, relics, and traits. Take on dice challenges for greater rewards—every run brings new choices and combinations.

4850830.title: Dodgeball Rush
4850830.short_description: Fast third-person arcade dodgeball. Charge it, throw it, catch it, knock them out. Every catch can flip the match. Play solo against bots or with friends: up to 4 players on local split screen, co-op or versus. Free playtest opens in November.

4851080.title: STATO
4851080.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

4851100.title: Grid Gear TD
4851100.short_description: Why settle for a tower that only does one job? Slow the front line with Cryo Round, yank the pack into a black hole with Gravity Well, and fry the pileup with Chain Arc. All on one tower—as long as you can fit them onto the grid.

4851120.title: King Alone
4851120.short_description: Tower Defence meets minimalist Action Strategy. Ride as the King, protecting everything you have left, and the Queen, blinded by your enemies.

4851290.title: Bob Needs Feed
4851290.short_description: Bob is in a big debt. Build, craft, feed, automate, and expand your kingdom. Manage resources, synergize your battle deck, and most importantly... PAY the BILL!

4851710.title: A Roguelike Tower Defense
4851710.short_description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

4852030.title: Project Remnant
4852030.short_description: Tactical shooter with roguelite and extraction mechanics built around smooth and responsive gunplay, weapon customization, and liminal environments. Scavenge, survive, and descend through increasingly dangerous floors as you uncover the truth behind a nightmare where not even death can set you free.

4852490.title: Tower of Insolence
4852490.short_description: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

4852690.title: LuMi Desktop
4852690.short_description: There's someone on your desktop now. She talks, she listens, she remembers you - and she's all yours. Her mind, her voice, her memories all live right here on your machine. No accounts, no sign-ups, internet or not. Just her, waiting for you to say hi.

4852750.title: A Game About Popping Bubbles
4852750.short_description: A relaxing, cozy, classic screensaver-inspired game about popping bubbles with satisfying VFX and SFX. Upgrade your equipment for even better pops, unlock achievements, and uncover a mysterious secret.

4853440.title: YokesDoomedWish
4853440.short_description: A narrative-driven 2D side-scrolling Metroidvania RPG. Unlock new items and abilities to explore the map and unravel the story.

4853480.title: Slums: Hauler 2
4853480.short_description: Start with nothing and build a better life through delivery work, vehicle-based jobs, and high-risk contracts. Buy weapons, vehicles, and property while surviving the dangers of an urban sandbox where bigger rewards bring bigger risks.

4854030.title: Wunderfront
4854030.short_description: In this brutal roguelite survival shooter, death is only the beginning of your evolution. Master a unique mix of historical firearms, experimental gadgets, and secret wonder weapons to execute the monstrosities ruling a ruined WW2 frontline.

4854120.title: Ski Lines: Trail Map
4854120.short_description: Ski Lines is a minimalist strategy game about designing a ski resort map. Draw pistes, build lifts, and connect mountain landmarks as new points of interest appear. Spend your limited resources wisely, adapt your network each day, and keep the resort moving for as long as possible.

4854330.title: The Castle of the West
4854330.short_description: A fast-paced, fantasy-themed boomer shooter inspired by the greats. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand crafted non-linear fps stages. What's not to love?

4854590.title: Stick Wars: The Laneborn
4854590.short_description: A 2D stickman strategy game on three lanes. Minions and waves push on their own while you decide gold, deployments and upgrades. Allied champions, bosses that switch lanes and a 10 level campaign. The free demo has 3 levels and online 1v1.

4855600.title: IronFire Idle Defense
4855600.short_description: Defend IronFire against endless waves of zombies in this hybrid defense game combining idle mechanics and roguelite progression. Create near-infinite builds, unlock multiple weapon types, upgrade your defenses, gain powerful bonuses, and more! How many days can you survive?

4855810.title: Towers to Be
4855810.short_description: Platform and zoom around a dream-like world to discover what happened to the mind of this patient.

4855850.title: Floodline Legion
4855850.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are a living army. Summon units onto a single lane in real time, manage your mana, and let a clean deterministic battle play out. Forge a Swarm, a blessed elite, or a spreading plague — then climb.

4855890.title: Idle Agency
4855890.short_description: Steam Community Market ➕ a solo idle looter: set lineup and positions on a 4×4 board, heroes auto-battle, and resources and gear pile up even offline. Build and research in the Fortress, sell at the Market, buy back what you lack as prices move, and test your limits in the Trial Tower.

4855970.title: Highway Station Simulator
4855970.short_description: Run a highway gas station with up to four friends. Pump the fuel by hand, stock the shelves, punch card payments into the register and try to keep the place from catching fire. A first-person co-op management sim about one very long shift.

4856180.title: Dear. My Marionette
4856180.short_description: A narrative-driven, turn-based RPG set in a cold, Nordic-inspired world. Master strategic card combat and make choices that will shape the fate of this frozen land.

4856230.title: Solo Chudding
4856230.short_description: Society has fallen. BILLIONS must die. Do you have what it takes to save the world from the soypocalypse or will nothing ever happen again?

4856490.title: Proper Football Boss
4856490.short_description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

4856890.title: Convoluted
4856890.short_description: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

4857390.title: HANA: Neon Petals
4857390.short_description: This game is a Japanese card adventure game set in a cyberpunk world. Play “Hanafuda” to defeat enemies and help the girl bring the neon lights back to the city! *“Hanafuda” is a traditional Japanese card game similar to poker.

4857450.title: FRANKED!
4857450.short_description: A roguelite about weaponising your mistakes. It happens to be pinball. Night shift at a sorting office. Flip parcels into the right chute, or misroute them onto the Backlog Rail, where they gain value while they wait. Fill the rail and everything crashes back at once, worth far more than before.

4857510.title: Silent Nightmare: Willow Lane
4857510.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a young woman whose ordinary evening slowly descends into a nightmare. Uncover the truth, make the right choices, and survive the night.

4858340.title: IRONWAKE
4858340.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into a dormant Soviet industrial robot inside a sealed subterranean bunker. Navigate total darkness using stealth, solve environmental puzzles, and trust the voice on the radio. Uncover the clues and change how it ends.

4859000.title: Money Sweeper
4859000.short_description: Minesweeper with powers. Money Sweeper is a nerve-wrackingly tense roguelike chipbuilder where every search counts. Unlock powerful chips, combine wild synergies, and detonate massive cascades of riches

4859100.title: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定
4859100.short_description: Dice of Soul brings the Japanese dice game Chinchiro to turn-based combat. Make the most of each character’s skills and pick your targets carefully. Your roll determines how hard you hit, and a little luck can turn a clever play into a decisive blow.

4859180.title: cutichoria
4859180.short_description: This is a mystery puzzle game that blends traditional Chinese fairy tales with surrealism. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium!

4859330.title: OAN
4859330.short_description: A Vietnamese folk horror in pixel art. Return alone to the abandoned family house for your grandfather's death-anniversary vigil. Light three sticks of incense before dawn, and keep the oil lamp burning. Something folded from paper is already in the house, and it does not want the rite finished.

4859610.title: Unburied
4859610.short_description: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

4859910.title: Kill The Hero
4859910.short_description: A Dungeon Builder, Autobattler and Deckbuilder in one. They call themselves “heroes”. You call them gold suppliers. Dig your domain, build deadly traps, place guards and play powerful cards as ever-stronger “heroes” invade your dungeon. Take their gold and build the World Domination Machine.

4860080.title: Paper Tower: Idle Overlay
4860080.short_description: A desktop companion idle auto-battler in isometric 3D that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things. Collect your loot, upgrade your tower and defeat endless waves of enemies.

4860100.title: OxyDungeon
4860100.short_description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

4860400.title: Please, Tell Me Why?
4860400.short_description: You live alone. At least, you’re supposed to. Go live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal - until little things stop making sense. A first-person psychological thriller about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of confronting the truth.

4860450.title: TowerBound
4860450.short_description: There is no luck in this tower. Every monster, item, and locked door is deterministic. Fifty floors from the original game form one giant logic puzzle. Spend HP, gold, and keys in exactly the right order, or seal your own way forward. A pixel-art puzzle-RPG in the Tower of the Sorcerer tradition.

4860550.title: SSN: Artemis
4860550.short_description: Command a nuclear-powered attack submarine in a modern warfare sim. Hunt enemy ships, evade hostile aircraft, stalk enemy vessels and strike from the shadows. Every contact is uncertain. Every choice carries risk. Every weapon fired may reveal your position.

4860720.title: Obscuroid
4860720.short_description: Obscuroid is a psychological horror puzzle game where you use a changing non-Euclidean environment to solve puzzles. Venture through a mind-bending liminal realm, use Polaroids to manipulate your surroundings, conjure your escape, or be consumed by whatever might wander the realm's vacant halls.

4860780.title: Marriage in Withdrawal
4860780.short_description: A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

4860960.title: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl
4860960.short_description: 这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。 被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。 直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

4861140.title: LYRA BLADE
4861140.short_description: Sinners. Neutrals. Saints. 15 factions. 3 unique currencies. Immense opportunities for interaction and a unique gaming experience in a richly developed universe. Which adventure will you choose?

4861430.title: LLM Tycoon
4861430.short_description: It's late 2022 and the AI race just started. Train models with real personalities, fill the map with datacenters, survive the scandals, and get to superintelligence before the rival CEOs who trash-talk you on social media.

4861650.title: FrontierCraft
4861650.short_description: FrontierCraft is a massively multiplayer sandbox set on one vast, fully destructible planet. Twenty kingdoms, thousands of ruins, and every player in the same world. Mine, build, trade and fight. Help kingdoms rise or fall, raise your clan's banner and carve out your place on the frontier.

4861710.title: Treasure Chest Master
4861710.short_description: Have you ever thought about who collects chests for heroes? No, they don't appear on their own, each of the chests has its own Master! Immerse yourself in the story of the Chest Master, in which your job is to fill chests with loot!

4861770.title: Bouncy Balloonist
4861770.short_description: Bouncy Balloonist is a cute and colorful 2D Arena Platformer. You fly, pop balloons, and guard your own! In this endless arcade adventure, how high will you score?

4862000.title: COLONY 2
4862000.short_description: Giri's search for his lost cricket ball opened a world of horror. He escaped that day but part of him never left. Eight years later, investigate the British colonial era asylum that broke him. But why does he keep coming back? What's his connection? Discover what's never meant to be discovered.

4862060.title: FoulKick Soccer
4862060.short_description: Six-a-side arcade football with nobody in a black shirt keeping score of your crimes. Charge a super shot mid-jump, put the opponent on the grass with a harsh tackle, and spin a tornado kick into a loose ball. Six players on one couch, or take it online.

4862230.title: Black Lily Inmortal
4862230.short_description: Experience this 2D Top-Down combat game featuring tragic yuri and dark fantasy. Step into the rusty armor of Marliese Haugen as she traverses a bleak, desolate world to reach the one she loves.

4862910.title: O.M.E.N. | Synthetic Genesis
4862910.short_description: A top-down survival horror game where genetic experiments escape containment. Run, hide, solve mazes to prove you are human, collect keycards, uncover the truth behind a corporation favoring profits over ethical experimentation, and discover why O.M.E.N. is making mysterious use of his new powers.

4863570.title: Die First
4863570.short_description: A physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Race to hurl yourself into saws, lasers, and more, combine items for creative deaths, and throw your friends to safety before they beat you to it! Up to 4 players, online or local. WARNING: Contains friendship-ruining mechanics.

4864060.title: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～
4864060.short_description: Form your team with character creation. Gather and upgrade equipment, and challenge the otherworldly realm of Yomi. Explore, fight, collect, and train over and over in this dystopian dungeon RPG.

4864390.title: Good Morning [Employee Name] VR
4864390.short_description: A seated VR mystery in an office that never moved past tape and brass. You're the new hire at Consolidated Dynamics. Play the morning cassette, work the switchboard, stamp the forms. Twelve days on the job. Try not to wonder what the work is for.

4864570.title: Dakota Keys and the Secret of the Ancients
4864570.short_description: A classic point-and-click adventure inspired by the golden age of 1990s adventure games. Explore ancient Egypt, solve challenging puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and follow Dakota Keys on a journey into one of history's greatest mysteries.

4864650.title: High Typer
4864650.short_description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

4864730.title: OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery
4864730.short_description: Stack your cart to the absolute limit and conquer a massive high-rise apartment! OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery is a chaotic physics-based delivery simulator. Balance fragile packages like Tetris, beat the unforgiving clock, and avoid corporate fines. Survive the daily grind solo or in co-op!

4864990.title: Roguelette
4864990.short_description: The roulette roguelike. Roguelette is a tactical, satisfying deckbuilder where you load a cursed wheel with strange balls, bend the odds with powerful effects, and trigger outrageous chain-reaction combos.

4865370.title: Odyssey Bridge Quest
4865370.short_description: Command a starship on the edge of known space. Pick your bridge officers, keep the ship alive, and face first contacts, derelicts and diplomatic crises where every order has a cost. A text-driven captaincy sim with branching episodes and multiple endings. What kind of captain will you be?

4865380.title: Monster Cruncher
4865380.short_description: Monster Cruncher​ is a short and satisfying active incremental game. Crush hordes of monsters, gather resources, and feed them into the Crusher. Unlock permanent upgrades through a massive skill tree and meta-progression!

4865400.title: Out Of Sync
4865400.short_description: Keil, a junior employee at Vanta Inc., has been searching for his missing friend Marcus. As he finds a note in Marcus's handwriting, Keil steps into a parallel world, only to face an unforgettable reality at the final door.

4865900.title: WayBackers
4865900.short_description: WayBackers is a 2D puzzle game built on the core mechanics of Minesweeper. Control your character to navigate through blocks filled with hidden mines. Use your Minesweeper logic and instincts to forge ahead without stepping on a single one!

4866350.title: Rogue Machines
4866350.short_description: A roguelike building physics puzzle game. Buy blocks to build better machines to get the ball in the goal. Unlock more blocks, levels, and upgrades as you play more runs.

4866360.title: Idle PC
4866360.short_description: Collect materials, craft, fight, and upgrade! Alongside, you unlock new applications and upgrade your gear to become even stronger. Your Idle PC collects resources even when you are not there!

4866850.title: Ultra Cleaner Corp.
4866850.short_description: It’s been 300 years of life in space after the Earth exploded. All fake-oxygen-breathing humans remain immortal thanks to devices called the Chip Needles, made by Ultra Clean Corp. The story follows the Spaceship-000-009 crew as one of their crew members disagrees with her imposed immortality.

4867010.title: Lords of the World
4867010.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

4867070.title: Ambience
4867070.short_description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

4867340.title: All Hands
4867340.short_description: Build walls, blast the terrain, and reroute thousands of furious customers through your own killboxes. All Hands is an incremental tower defence game about defending HQ, engineering excessive solutions, and turning corporate catastrophe into career advancement.

4867680.title: The Sinkhole
4867680.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

4867740.title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
4867740.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

4868090.title: Rally King
4868090.short_description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

4868310.title: Character House -Desktop Companion-
4868310.short_description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

4868390.title: Mini Monuments
4868390.short_description: Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game where you dig, clean, and rebuild handcrafted miniature ruins. Use tactile tools at your own pace and watch as each scene comes back to life piece by piece.

4868530.title: Slimy Dude
4868530.short_description: Slimy Dude is a semi-linear 3D gravity-puzzle platformer. Master running your way through gravity-bending puzzles, explore vibrant planetary zones, hunt for starship components to unlock new galaxies and track down a missing person to fulfil your promise!

4868560.title: ATC: Tower & Ground
4868560.short_description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

4868630.title: DoNotOpenTheBox
4868630.short_description: Do Not Open This Box is a 3D first-person room escape game where players solve puzzles to escape after opening a forbidden box. Find, repair, and manipulate objects among antiques such as toys, books, and wine bottles. The space subtly changes as each puzzle is solved.

4868800.title: Abyss Haul
4868800.short_description: A relaxing incremental fishing simulation, until you dive too deep. Catch fish, sell haul, and upgrade your gear as you descend through glowing waters. Track down legendary creatures, explore increasingly strange depths, collect absurd treasures. It's just a game, no real animal were harmed.

4868890.title: Super Hole
4868890.short_description: Build your production area, collect goods with your Hole, and sell them at your market! Use your earnings to discover new cards, boost production, and grow your business. Enjoy a relaxing and satisfying journey of growth!

4869230.title: Repentless DX
4869230.short_description: You are the imprisoned dictator. People of your country come visit. Survive as long as you can.

4869280.title: Defender of Darkness
4869280.short_description: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!

4869380.title: Frog Racing League
4869380.short_description: Recruit frogs, and turn them into champion racing frogs! Kit them out with hats and potions, then read the odds and bet your way to the top of the league. A pixel-art frog management sim that will satisfy your inner frog manager.

4869400.title: Yokai Mart
4869400.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Help your grandmother run her konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

4870100.title: One Neck Ahead
4870100.short_description: In One Neck Ahead, you play as Kid Giraffe on a journey towards the heart of the forest, where dreams come true. Carry your own ground, create your own platforms, and meet a cast of memorable characters, each introducing a new twist to the adventure.

4870120.title: You Got Me Killed!
4870120.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

4870610.title: MEATBALL THE MITE
4870610.short_description: MEATBALL THE MITE is a Metroid-inspired platforming game where you explore the colossal, labyrinthian remains of a decaying creature. Collect upgrades, go toe-to-toe with gnarly threats, and claim victory over the rot on your quest to grow stronger. Do you got the guts to survive in these guts?

4870720.title: Keep It Checked
4870720.short_description: Trapped in a looping corridor of an anomaly research facility, you must watch every detail. Spot an anomaly? Turn back. Everything normal? Keep walking. Make the right call eleven rooms in a row to find the exit and break the loop.

4870920.title: The Hope Incident
4870920.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

4870990.title: Baron Local
4870990.short_description: Rise from ordinary citizen to political kingmaker in a pixel-art political life simulator inspired by Romania. Build alliances, launch projects, survive scandals, and navigate corruption as you climb from local politics toward national power.

4871170.title: Coming Forth by Day
4871170.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian board game. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

4871240.title: Nostos
4871240.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

4872220.title: Ancestral Trace : Singkawang
4872220.short_description: Ancestral Trace: Singkawang is a cozy 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you help Lie Jun Hao, a young man who returns to his childhood city after eleven years away, uncover the story his family left behind.

4872320.title: Cardfight: Conspiracy
4872320.short_description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

4872700.title: Vertepnyky: Prologue
4872700.short_description: Travel to a remote snowy island where everything is not what it seems! Interact with the locals, unravel the prophecy, and prepare for a "holiday" with Helga Burevis in an action-packed visual novel where every choice matters. The only rule: trust no one. ESPECIALLY mirrors, masks, and musicians.

4872830.title: God of Stock
4872830.short_description: God of Stock is deck-building roguelike. You play as a trader, use god-blessed cards to trade stocks, manipulate prices, and make money in a chaotic market. Build a unique deck, collect powerful artifacts and treasures, and eventually become the God of Stock.

4873010.title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
4873010.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

4873130.title: MMOS: MMO Simulator
4873130.short_description: Build, run and play your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. Design the world, classes, loot and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, form guilds and chase rare drops. Keep them subscribed, log in as a character yourself, and share your MMO on the Steam Workshop.

4873150.title: Touhou Mushroom Defense
4873150.short_description: Touhou Mushroom Defense is a Touhou Project fan-made game. It’s a defense game where Marisa turns mushrooms into towers to defeat enemies. In the game, you need to gather materials to build towers and construct towers to block the enemy’s path.

4873490.title: Ultima Cenere
4873490.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a Mediterranean Italy after the end. Every run reshapes you: flesh mutates, body parts are traded for implants. You don't heal — you trade. Four classes, one journey to the last enclave. No loot boxes, no pay-to-win.

4873660.title: Trap Side
4873660.short_description: Jump into the arena in Trap Side, a fast-paced multiplayer party game where cute faces meet brutal chaos! Dodge deadly saws, grab spears, outsmart your friends, and survive the pixel-blood-soaked mayhem. Trust no one, not even the ground you stand on!

4874180.title: Soul Savior
4874180.short_description: Blast monster hordes with elemental spells, lay traps between waves and protect your gold in this action roguelite tower defense. Save the villagers' souls or sacrifice them for power, solo or in online co-op.

4874290.title: InCyanSpace
4874290.short_description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

4874320.title: Dear Polder
4874320.short_description: The sea took half your fields. Dear Polder is a cozy farming life sim in a Dutch polder village, solo or in 4-player online co-op. Mend the dike, let your windmill pump the land dry, then befriend 40 villagers and dance under the lanterns on festival nights.

4874720.title: TappyCat
4874720.short_description: TappyCat is a cute pixel kitty who settles onto your desktop and turns work and study into a warm, cozy ritual. It's a desktop pet, a Pomodoro timer, and a smart productivity tracker all at once - all in one little cat.

4874970.title: Deck Forge
4874970.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

4875400.title: FREEWAVE
4875400.short_description: FREEWAVE is an epic spaceship action-adventure. Explore a vast, tattered city in search of answers. Fly between crumbling buildings and become a master pilot. Fight against the oppressive tech regime ULTRASOFT and defend yourself against rotten monsters. All hand drawn with pen and watercolor.

4875890.title: Kernel Override
4875890.short_description: INFILTRATE THE SYSTEM! Kernel Override is a fast-paced cyberpunk bullet heaven. SURVIVE intense 10-minute rounds against escalating waves of anti-virus software, MODIFY your malicious code with powerful upgrades, and UNLOCK permanent meta-progression to crack the core.

4876110.title: Oops, No Floor!
4876110.short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

4876600.title: 仙路烟尘
4876600.short_description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

4876820.title: Joint Venture: Prison Commissary Simulator
4876820.short_description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, x-rays, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

4877070.title: They Were Us
4877070.short_description: You're in for an exciting adventure about the main character Blake, who faces a ton of challenges before she uncovers the terrifying truth about this area. Various creepy creatures will appear along the way, as well as the surviving locals.

4877100.title: The Gastarbeiters
4877100.short_description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Build a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

4877120.title: AJ's Anomaly
4877120.short_description: Short narrative driven horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer locked in her apartment. Hangout with your imaginary boyfriend, use your anomaly therapy device, and explore your dreamlike surroundings.

4877290.title: Global Parity
4877290.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance the budget, pass laws through parliament, win elections, sign treaties and fight on a moving front line, while AI nations build, trade and go to war around you.

4877310.title: Card Flipper
4877310.short_description: Flip cards, stack cash, and chase the jackpot until your fortune snowballs out of control! Card Flipper is a casual casino game with idle elements, where every flip pays, golden cards spark Frenzies, and even the bad habits make you richer. Flip, Frenzy & Fortune!

4877420.title: Rec Room: A New Semester
4877420.short_description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

4877600.title: Murdok
4877600.short_description: A dark action RPG of ash and betrayal. Master 45 skills, socket runes to forge your build, and fight through five acts of horror to the Abyss Throne. Claim the Crown or shatter it, then survive a level 100 endgame.

4877780.title: HALFLIGHT
4877780.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

4877800.title: Arcana Rift: Tactics
4877800.short_description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

4877880.title: FlyMuse  2
4877880.short_description: FlyMuse 2 takes a “semi-conscious” electronic lifeform, based on a real fruit fly brain, on an adventure. Observe brain activity, tune neural circuits, and reshape the environment as you follow clues through homes, streets, and the underground world.

4878290.title: Bonsai Island
4878290.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

4878590.title: Cidle Online
4878590.short_description: Build your castle, gather resources, and raid neighbors in a shared idle world. Recruit soldiers, hunt dragons and krakens, complete daily quests - all while progress ticks forward whether you're online or away.

4878640.title: Mereni
4878640.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

4878650.title: Gateshock
4878650.short_description: Every map has a code. Build yours, paste it to a friend, beat theirs. A hex-grid tower defense with 14 towers across four upgrade tiers, a hand-crafted 16-mission campaign, and a run mode where 40 relics decide how far you get.

4878790.title: Anomaly Cafe
