4878790.short_description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

4878810.title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
4878810.short_description: A wheelchair ski jumping roguelite about chasing victory in the Happy Friendship Cup. You time your jump at the edge of the ramp and hope your body holds out until the last hill.

4878850.title: GOLF TRIP
4878850.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

4879320.title: Not Monsters
4879320.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

4879490.title: TOX-17
4879490.short_description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

4879630.title: Hauntasy
4879630.short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? You and your chosen partner are top influencers invited to survive seven nights inside a haunted ancestral estate for $1,000,000. Monitor the rooms, manage your candles, and uncover what the Baron and Baroness are hiding before 4 AM in this psychological fantasy horror.

4879740.title: Party Executable
4879740.short_description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

4879780.title: MAD: Mutually Assured Destruction
4879780.short_description: Turn-based 3D artillery with real physics and cinematic free-fly cameras. Every dollar is a choice: a bigger bomb or a better bunker. Nukes, B-52 carpet bombing, deformable terrain and 25+ battlefields from the desert to the Moon. 1-8 players: online, LAN or couch. Biggest crater wins.

4879830.title: IVORY
4879830.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

4880220.title: Idle Dig
4880220.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

4880380.title: ReDead Frontline
4880380.short_description: ReDead Frontline is a post-apocalyptic idle defense game where the zombie outbreak has already won. Trapped in a time loop, you hold the line, recruit survivors, upgrade weapons, deploy drones, study enemies, and reset after each defeat to return stronger and break the cycle.

4880720.title: Son of Beach
4880720.short_description: Turn a filthy, rubbish-choked beach into a bustling seaside destination! Recycle litter, unlock powerful tools and vehicles, and clear rubbish mountains. Build facilities, run stalls and welcome visitors. Reinvest your earnings to bring the beach to life.

4881130.title: Alien Archeologist
4881130.short_description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

4881420.title: En Garde Gambit
4881420.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you and your enemies plan predictively for simultaneous resolution. Every move and attack resolve at once. Outwit enemies in various maps, with various skills/upgrades, in Singleplayer, co-op, and PvP.

4881530.title: Study Nook
4881530.short_description: Study tools included: Pomodoro timer To-do list Built-in media player with a hand-picked selection of lofi, ambient, and orchestral music Internet browser to stream any audio (Full Version) Play fetch with your companion dog Tend to your garden

4882000.title: The Hollowing
4882000.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

4882480.title: Family Gambling
4882480.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

4882660.title: DigiDuels
4882660.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder card game that will make you remember the classic TCGs: learn the game across a classroom desk, then ride the metro into a branching run of rivals, shops, and big choices.

4882810.title: BoxParty!
4882810.short_description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

4883680.title: OASIS II
4883680.short_description: OASIS II is a 1-5 player co-op FPS inspired by extraction shooters and roguelikes. Travel across an alternate-history Japan while building your reputation with various contacts across the country.

4883760.title: Wrong Landing: Reborn
4883760.short_description: Wrong Landing: Reborn is a new, improved open-world survival game. Explore a mysterious island full of surprises alone or with friends! Discover its rich story, fight hunger, extreme cold, and try to stay alive.

4883820.title: Kitchen of Gods
4883820.short_description: Greece is starving, and even the gods have to cook! Build divine temples, gather ingredients, and feed the starving in this roguelite management adventure.

4883870.title: Expedition Bonk
4883870.short_description: A short turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill count, and power up your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Built to be beaten in about 4 hours.

4885090.title: LEVELS
4885090.short_description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

4885480.title: Ruler of Empires
4885480.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

4885560.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
4885560.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

4886060.title: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary
4886060.short_description: A cozy fishing port management game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow your fishing port, fish, build, and craft alongside adorable animal companions while enjoying a relaxing harbor life that keeps you company throughout your day.

4886180.title: My Cat Companion
4886180.short_description: Your desktop is too quiet. Pick a cat. Paint their fur. One stalks your cursor. One reacts to every click and key. One bounces when tossed. Try to get work done. You answer to them now.

4886320.title: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War
4886320.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

4886790.title: Gökbörü
4886790.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

4887490.title: Axis Flip
4887490.short_description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

4887610.title: Last Rail
4887610.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

4887970.title: Borrowed Flesh
4887970.short_description: A body-horror deckbuilding roguelike where your whole party shares one deck. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, and when one falls, every card they carried dies with them. Survive permanent mutilation and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

4888000.title: BLIGHT SWARM
4888000.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

4888080.title: 5-Star Taxi
4888080.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

4888740.title: Project Matter
4888740.short_description: Project Matter is a 2D factory automation game about turning raw inputs into an ever-expanding production web. Place buildings on an infinite grid, draw connections between them, and research new processing chains, waste recovery loops, and advanced materials.

4889120.title: Burn Tree Burn
4889120.short_description: An incremental about burning down a forest. Drag a flame across the trees, watch the fire chain from grove to grove, and bank charcoal to make every burn hotter, hungrier and in a larger forest.

4889330.title: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets
4889330.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

4889640.title: Save Me, Hero!
4889640.short_description: Explore an eerie world, gather loot, and fuse cards through devouring. Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG. Forge gear and combine talents to craft your own build. Find an opening in turn-based battles and decide who lives as cries for help echo around you.

4890010.title: Call Me BlackJack
4890010.short_description: Build your own blackjack run in a roguelike deckbuilder built from a six-deck shoe. Play hands, buy cards, break the rules, and beat BlackJack to solve a casino mystery. Every run plays differently with new risks.

4890210.title: Mourning House
4890210.short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

4890590.title: One More Rock!
4890590.short_description: A chill incremental game about satisfying mining and automated forging. Mine. Gamble. Upgrade. Repeat. Mine another rock while the lantern is burning.

4890600.title: FrontierLord
4890600.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

4890660.title: FEDA : The Emblem of Justice
4890660.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890670.title: Trinea
4890670.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890680.title: Song Master
4890680.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890910.title: Desk Hive
4890910.short_description: Tend a living beehive right on your desk. Harvest honey through the seasons, expand your apiary, build a processing line, and automate the work while you're away. A cozy idle beekeeping sim that runs beside you.

4891110.title: The Lost City of Gold
4891110.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold. A relaxing, first-person adventure with light puzzles and platforming across 15 levels.

4891840.title: The Last Call
4891840.short_description: Every run starts the same. Never ends that way. Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty. Only your skill matters.

4891950.title: VoxMancer
4891950.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

4892530.title: Project Longshot
4892530.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

4892700.title: VOX Zero
4892700.short_description: VOX Zero is a high-mobility 3D voxel survivors-like. Wield an arsenal of ever-mutating living weapons as you weave, leap, and dash through a multi-level amusement park, tear apart relentless hordes, and evolve every weapon into a devastating superweapon.

4892710.title: Delete: E.A.D Core
4892710.short_description: Delete: E.A.D CORE is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Enter an underground data facility, destroy data disks in the correct systems, and escape from whatever is still inside.

4892750.title: Santa's Escape
4892750.short_description: Christmas Eve, 2003. Mid-delivery, the chimney gives way and Santa falls into a dark, silent house in Cedar Hollow, North Carolina. He isn't alone. Search the rooms, uncover what happened to the Stier family, and find a way out of the house that won't let him go.

4892810.title: HEXECUTIVE ORDER
4892810.short_description: You're a mage the government kept on a leash, and the collar just broke. Fight your way down 44 floors of a very bureaucratic cult with a spellbook, an iron cross and a lot of red barrels. Old-school, fast and messy.

4894120.title: Los Cuentos de Frox
4894120.short_description: Explore the vast universe of Tora in this classic 2D turn-based RPG. Delve into a deep fantasy world filled with mysteries, traverse interconnected rooms and dungeons packed with secrets, and manage your inventory in a narrative-driven adventure.

4894250.title: Equilibrium
4894250.short_description: Equilibrium is an atmospheric dark fantasy visual novel where your choices shape not only the story, but the protagonist herself. Uncover the secrets of a world shared by humans and demons—and decide whom to trust when reality begins to fall apart.

4894770.title: Flow Treehouse
4894770.short_description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

4894870.title: Rogue Curling
4894870.short_description: Balatro-like roguelike curling where physics-based skill matters no less than a solid build. Combine synergies and precision, or just break the rules!

4895210.title: Crossfall
4895210.short_description: Crossfall is a cozy single-player top-down RPG with turn-based combat, developed by a solo creator. Explore a tile-based world, take part in dialogues, complete quests, craft items, go fishing, and gather herbs. Improve your skills and shape your own build.

4896000.title: Falafel El Assad
4896000.short_description: Do you have what it takes to serve the best Falafel in Moscow? Defy the elements in this whacky cooking sim and earn money to gain power-ups. Test your skills, and improve them to prepare for the final boss battle that will shake your world!

4896480.title: Severwood
4896480.short_description: Forge runes into your beast, chain glyph combos into screen-clearing chaos, and evolve through a cursed dark-fantasy forest. A roguelite deckbuilder where every socket is a choice and every run rewrites your power. Hunt down the Soul Lord. Descend deeper. Die hungrier.

4896660.title: Boxing Tycoon
4896660.short_description: Run your own boxing promotion. Scout and sign fighters, negotiate every contract, face the press, build fight cards and beat rival promoters to the biggest nights. Watch your fighters go to war in full 3D and turn them into world champions.

4896670.title: Lofi Drive
4896670.short_description: Relax and unwind in an endless procedurally generated cruise. Unlock new lofi songs, vehicles, biomes, and features by simply stopping at intersections and road signs. No timers, no traffic, no pressure. Just you, the road, and the journey. No MTX, No gatcha, just relaxing and soothing game-play.

4896690.title: Portal Time Traveller
4896690.short_description: As Subject 247 of a mysterious laboratory, you are tasked with stepping through time portals to retrieve requested artifacts. Hunt dinosaurs, survive empire of Middle Ages, gather critical materials in streets and navigate a neon lit dystopia. Will you obey scientists or start your own rebellion?

4896950.title: Rapid Raccoons
4896950.short_description: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, and grabbing crates by hand or lasso to keep your load aboard. Upgrade your raft, find items and cosmetics, all while trying to meet a quota that continuously gets larger and larger.

4896960.title: Daemon Doors
4896960.short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

4897290.title: Legends of Companion
4897290.short_description: Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

4897520.title: Baan Khok
4897520.short_description: If the city feels too big for you, come home to Baan Khok — a peaceful little village in the Thai countryside. Start anew: work the fields, grow vegetables, raise animals, and wander the lively temple fairs. Let life drift with the breeze, find love, and build a warm family of your own.

4898090.title: Vector Noir
4898090.short_description: A twin-stick arena roguelite. The Moonlight Sonata drives the choreography. Enemies spawn placed by beat, by hand. Hard on purpose, you will hate Beethoven.

4898220.title: End of War: Global Front
4898220.short_description: Build towers, defend two sectors and your shared reactor against endless machine waves—alone or in online co-op. Every battle matters: In THE GREAT WAR, the global frontline shaped by all players grants unique bonuses and penalties in every match.

4898330.title: Give or Take: Pawn Shop
4898330.short_description: Step behind the counter and run a small-town pawn shop. Inspect items to reveal hidden traits, make deals with quirky locals, clean, repair, and sell secondhand finds for profit while helping a town recover. All it takes is old junk and a good deal.

4898400.title: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
4898400.short_description: Build your dream body in the ultimate gym simulator and bodybuilding game! Experience real-time body transformation, train with other players online, break strength records, dominate arm wrestling, and knock out rivals in physics-based multiplayer boxing. Rise from amateur to global champion!

4898460.title: Outspin Champions
4898460.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

4898650.title: For The Witch
4898650.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

4898730.title: General Jeon
4898730.short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

4899050.title: Pokremental
4899050.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

4899160.title: On The Hook
4899160.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

4899190.title: Lifebearers
4899190.short_description: In a battlefield under heavy fire, your only mission is to save lives! Lifebearers is a 2-player co-op rescue game. Step into the boots of medics with a friend: find wounded soldiers, carry them on a stretcher, and reach the safe zone. Coming out in one piece demands tight coordination!

4899940.title: Dyeversion
4899940.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

4900740.title: METAMORPH PROTOCOL
4900740.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 5 players. Descend into Army Facility 7, a buried military lab where sample M-7 copies the shapes, voices and faces of whatever it touches. Carry your fallen friends, survive every floor and get out together, or not at all.

4900760.title: Stellar Harvest
4900760.short_description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

4900890.title: Grr Grr Gnomes
4900890.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

4901440.title: Digital Druid
4901440.short_description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

4903220.title: TaskBound Saga
4903220.short_description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

4903560.title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
4903560.short_description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

4903640.title: DIBARO CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
4903640.short_description: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

4903720.title: Time Stop Tower Defense
4903720.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

4903810.title: Thousand Ward
4903810.short_description: Thousand Ward is a tactical collector RPG where you build a 3x3 Band of Wardens, master turn-based Hold, Break, and Surge combat, conquer 1,000 levels across 10 realms, collect 200+ Wardens, and climb ranked online battles through strategy, synergy, and smart play.

4904080.title: Feastfall
4904080.short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

4904110.title: Cute & Dead
4904110.short_description: A fast, absurd VR arcade shooter about a nerd, a zombie apocalypse, and thirty girls who need rescuing. Ridiculous weapons, a very good dog, and a dance floor waiting at the end of every run.

4904380.title: Climb the Fools
4904380.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

4905060.title: Pogo to the Moon
4905060.short_description: You are a sheep equipped with a pogo stick, and you want to reach the Moon! Collect coins, upgrade your abilities, and master various platforms as you climb from your home all the way to the Moon.

4905380.title: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
4905380.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

4905460.title: Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection
4905460.short_description: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

4905570.title: BONKER LADS
4905570.short_description: BONKER LADS is a sandbox chaos battle simulator where you can build armies, set up battles, and watch fighters and military vehicles clash.

4905670.title: 失序的我与乐园
4905670.short_description: This is an adventure that takes place in an amusement park. Players will explore strange scenes, meet mysterious companions, and uncover the truth behind the 'Disorderly Park' program through turn-based battles and story choices.

4905780.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
4905780.short_description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

4906400.title: 大收藏家
4906400.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

4906410.title: Classroom 3B
4906410.short_description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi work in this psychological horror investigation.

4906630.title: Cats Out
4906630.short_description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

4906910.title: Ashioto Kyōfu | Footsteps Terror
4906910.short_description: Touka Saeki, a former journalist and owner of the online video channel “Footsteps Terror”, travels to an abandoned mountain village where a school drama club mysteriously disappeared to cover that place in her next video. Her arrival awakens a long-buried curse...

4906930.title: Department 98
4906930.short_description: Your placement is confirmed. Report to District Intake, desk seven. The previous occupant's effects have been cleared. An idle game inside a fake 1990s office OS about paperwork, promotion, and a job going very well.

4907030.title: The Exorcist's Apprentice
4907030.short_description: A first-person short psychological horror about exorcism. A victim is bound to a bed. A demon lurks inside her. Explore a confined apartment, rely on your mentor's guidance, and discover the precise ritual needed to drive it out.

4907220.title: Fall Off Reach
4907220.short_description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

4907780.title: Luck in the Dark
4907780.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

4908120.title: Outbreak Z
4908120.short_description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

4908180.title: Spinvestor
4908180.short_description: Spinvestor is a fun, risk-free alternative to winning millions while gambling in a casino where the house doesn't have the edge for once. Win big, invest in stocks, and run your own businesses while becoming the highest ranking VIP at Steak, the best casino where the house always loses.

4908780.title: Tallawa Game Nights
4908780.short_description: A Caribbean Tabletop Game Collection. Slam dominoes, throw 3D dice around the room, team up as allies or betray them and challenge 10 different AI personalities with hidden grudges in Arcade and Story. No copy? No problem! Play together using your phones!

4909250.title: Midnight Moving Crew
4909250.short_description: Midnight Moving Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror sim. Clock in, pack the house, and survive the shift. Buy EMF detectors and defensive wards to repel any entities in the house before you become the next permanent resident.

4909300.title: REDHAND
4909300.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

4909780.title: Medium Rare
4909780.short_description: Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.

4910360.title: Annie's DineInn
4910360.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

4911450.title: shatAAAAp!
4911450.short_description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

4911910.title: Pirates Life
4911910.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

4911930.title: The Hungering Lake
4911930.short_description: A village is starving and the lake is taking its children. Fish to keep them alive, but every catch angers what lives beneath the surface. A top-down Finnish folklore horror game about hunger, debt and a name hidden in the logs of the lost.

4912110.title: Mayhem Duck Simulator
4912110.short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic, physics-based rubber duck simulator! Free superpowered ducks from their cages, wreak havoc with dragon fire and UFO beams, or just sit back and watch. Made by a dad, with ideas from his 4- and 5-year-old kids. 🦆

4912160.title: Unwanted Guest
4912160.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

4913720.title: The Sixth Sin
4913720.short_description: The Sixth Sin is a horror game set in a suspense-filled atmosphere where you battle demons, supernatural beings, and puzzles, surviving through your own ingenuity. The voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, complete rituals, and never let go of the light or your magical items.

4914130.title: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler
4914130.short_description: The TCG autobattler. Lootbox Inc. is the ultimate number-go-up deckbuilder. Collect powerful loot, build crazy decks, discover unexpected synergies, and stack insane combos. Easy to learn, hard to master. Play at your own pace, solo or against other players!

4914230.title: A Tidy Konbini
4914230.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return over 1000 scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. No Skills, no time limits. Just a relaxing tidy up experience.

4914850.title: Bonded in Darkness
4914850.short_description: Fall in love with your worst enemy in this gothic vampire romance BL visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning to trust each other.

4914960.title: ORION
4914960.short_description: ORION is a real-time sci-fi 4X grand strategy game where you explore a procedurally generated galaxy, build an interstellar empire, shape its society, design powerful fleets, and conquer, unite, or outlast your rivals.

4915100.title: Who Got In?
4915100.short_description: A driving simulator where every passenger is different. Meet unforgettable characters, make dialogue choices, earn money, upgrade your garage, and discover the unexpected stories waiting behind every ride.

4915180.title: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
4915180.short_description: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

4915570.title: Tapis
4915570.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points. To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

4916020.title: Crack the Stone
4916020.short_description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

4916120.title: Glooky: Cursors in the City
4916120.short_description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

4916420.title: Path of Damned
4916420.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

4916730.title: Christmas Inc
4916730.short_description: Build a toy factory in this first-person incremental game. Place machines, run conveyor belts to delivery, cash in and upgrade. Unlock 20 presents, prestige for Stars and deck the halls.

4917040.title: Hungry Hungry Human
4917040.short_description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

4917640.title: Nuts & Bolts
4917640.short_description: An action-horror game where you fight off against various robots as part of your job. Time your attacks properly, chain together combos, flee when necessary, and complete your mission.

4918080.title: Campaign Forge
4918080.short_description: Infinity grows - Your story never ends. Create worlds, heroes, and play your legends chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers you and your Party. Generate it free and fully offline, then change it how you want. Campaign Forge - The 2D Infinite Story RPG.

4918370.title: Alia Domus
4918370.short_description: Explore and colonize an unknown planet in this pixel art survival RPG. Collect resources, complete quests, and craft technologies from different eras of humanity to turn Alia Domus into a home. Start with basic survival and reach civilizational splendor.

4918530.title: Unwanted Guest VR
4918530.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person escape horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

4918750.title: Grid Poker
4918750.short_description: GridPoker is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

4919010.title: Exoset
4919010.short_description: An inventory-management airship-building auto-battler. Design your battlecruiser, pack its hull with powerful weapons, and arrange support systems to create synergies that multiply its firepower from hundreds to millions, then watch it battle ever-escalating threats.

4919060.title: Escape from Track 7
4919060.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

4919130.title: MONSTERGOTCHI
4919130.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

4919340.title: DON'T MAKE A SOUND
4919340.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a first-person FMV interactive AVG survival horror game. Explore an infected city as Alex, search for your daughter, investigate clues, solve simple puzzles, and make critical choices. Eyeless creatures hunt by sound—one wrong move can lead to a deadly Bad Ending.
developers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.
publishers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

4919510.title: Ember Camp Knight
4919510.short_description: Descend into a dungeon no one built for you. Fast, punchy pixel action in 5–10 minute bites — fight down through four themed floors, rest at a strange campfire, and meet the girl who tends it. Why does this dungeon exist? The answer waits at the bottom.

4919570.title: Meow Star Archives
4919570.short_description: Restore the cats' damaged memory archives in this hand-drawn puzzle game. And you'll also discover the stories of these lovely cats before they returned to the stars! No timers, just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place. Come and enjoy some cozy moments with these lovely cats!

4919980.title: ACE Football
4919980.short_description: ACE Football is a football club management game featuring player development, squad building, tactical strategy, and 3D matches. Recruit talented players, train rising stars, build your dream team, compete in leagues and tournaments, and lead your club to championship glory.

4920110.title: Pouring Pints
4920110.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

4920240.title: Pinetrail
4920240.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

4920500.title: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
4920500.short_description: A cat cultivation, sect management, and ARPG loot game. Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.

4920540.title: ELEMENTORS
4920540.short_description: Merge-autobattler where every unit fights on two synergy fronts at once. Forge your own d12 of elements, roll it every round, and fuse with creatures. 13 types × 13 elements. Every element you apply is permanent — choose wisely.

4921540.title: Liminull
4921540.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

4922070.title: No Such Person
4922070.short_description: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。

4922110.title: Felzi
4922110.short_description: Felzi is a cozy retro 3D platformer. Roll through crates, stomp, climb and glide on a leaf across handcrafted worlds. Collect every gem and finish each level.

4922380.title: Neural Defense
4922380.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

4922740.title: Core!1!
4922740.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

4922750.title: We Don't Exist
4922750.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

4922820.title: Hellkick
4922820.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

4922890.title: Flag Conquest
4922890.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

4922910.title: Settlers of Pineshore
4922910.short_description: On the edge of a new continent, you are responsible for connecting the wild region of Pineshore and its settlers to the rest of the world. Hire workers, gather resources, defend your venture from unknown dangers, and keep building the railway!

4922990.title: Riftmoor
4922990.short_description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

4923220.title: The Lower Worlds I: Valenfeld
4923220.short_description: Valenfeld is a Co-Op RPG with a procedurally generated Open World and Dungeons. Combine Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Cleric, Druid, and Necromancer into custom classes, with in depth talent trees and combinations. Join a living world of factions, monsters and war where your choices matter.

4923360.title: Books & Blood
4923360.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

4923390.title: Its a Trap
4923390.short_description: Build devious traps. Survive ingenious contraptions. It’s a Trap is a physics platformer and level-building sandbox. Combine deadly hazards, reactive liquids, ropes and wired mechanisms, then brave your creations and share them through Steam Workshop.

4923470.title: slice
4923470.short_description: A cozy and nostalgic life simulator. Play a second life, alone or with friends! Lead life on your terms.

4923490.title: Warden Campaigns
4923490.short_description: Warden Campaigns is a virtual tabletop where Game Masters build worlds, host multiplayer sessions through Steam, and create encounters that react to player choices. Set traps, automate consequences, and bring your party's story to life—your rules, your adventure.

4924140.title: Allegedly Innocent: Justice for Sale
4924140.short_description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

4924280.title: Chain Reaction: Breakshot
4924280.short_description: Chain Reaction: Breakshot combines the precise aiming of classic billiards with the strategic deckbuilding of roguelikes. Within a retro CRT visual style, combining various mechanics turns every shot into a feast of strategy and fun.

4924430.title: Doomsday Anchor
4924430.short_description: Do a completely normal... anomaly containment job. It's just the fate of the entire world in your hands, no big deal, don't stress!

4924620.title: Vesper Hollow
4924620.short_description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

4924680.title: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop
4924680.short_description: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is a post-apocalyptic idle clicker and strategy game about smashing crates, salvaging relics, building vehicles, running factories, scanning radio signals, and raiding bandit bases to rebuild your place in the wasteland.

4925500.title: Companions' Chronicles
4925500.short_description: This AI sandbox RPG features diverse world themes for instant immersive adventures. Customize world rules, character sheets and stories; share or import player-created themes. The full version adds dynamic backgrounds, emotion avatars and personal AI chat API support.

4925600.title: Kitten Wool Cup
4925600.short_description: A cozy kitten life with a silly streak. Make your snug room by the fire your own, dress your kitten in hats and a Santa beard, and invite friends round. Then curl up and dream of football: chaotic kitten matches with a giant ball of wool, runaway roombas and laser pointers.

4925690.title: Gofoot
4925690.short_description: Gofoot is a fast, lightweight, and nostalgic football management game. Create your manager, build squads, compete in championships, and customize leagues, clubs, and players in a simple, addictive sandbox experience built for the community.

4926390.title: Crown & Banner
4926390.short_description: Crown & Banner™ is an MMORTS inspired by the browser games of the 2000s, where the roads and outposts your empire builds become the battleground of the endgame. Buy once, play anywhere, forever free-to-win, Crown & Banner is a game where strategy and diplomacy (not money!) determine the outcome.

4926900.title: Bato Battle
4926900.short_description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

4927020.title: Purrgeist
4927020.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

4927040.title: Devil's Cut
4927040.short_description: A casino shooter roguelite. Aim and shoot your way through endless waves of demons, run and dodge, fire off abilities, and gamble your loot for busted upgrades and cursed items. Build your stats, pay off your soul's debt, and climb the ranks — or lose it all to the house.

4927170.title: SIGABRT
4927170.short_description: You write the while(1) loop that fights for you. Assemble code-edits into an auto-battling program, descend a crashing OS from /tmp to the kernel, and debug your build every run. No two compiles are the same. Debug your code. Try one more time.

4927270.title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard
4927270.short_description: A party autobattler incremental. Recruit heroes under their zodiac signs, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot, grow a skill tree that is the sky — then send four into the depths and watch them fight. Climb the cursed city of Greymarrow for gear no delve will ever drop. Every run reaches further.

4927990.title: Arcane Beyond
4927990.short_description: Arcane Beyond is a living magical world where players rise from humble spellcasters to legendary mages. Every action pushes you toward Radiance or Umbra, unlocking unique abilities, transformations, and story paths.

4928500.title: Wiener Rumble
4928500.short_description: A fast first-person arena brawler! Try to get other players out of the arena with a weapon that shoots different items. Enjoy multiple game modes and maps, and customize your character. Prove your skills in the ultimate chaos and be the last one standing!

4928550.title: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
4928550.short_description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

4928760.title: Scrapman Simulator
4928760.short_description: Start by collecting cardboard from the streets, turn scrap metal into cash, upgrade your home and vehicle, and grow your business. Build your own recycling empire by playing solo or with your friends in a living city inspired by Istanbul.

4928970.title: Incremental Magic
4928970.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

4929100.title: Flight Fights
4929100.short_description: You and up to 4 friends are the cabin crew on a flight spiraling into chaos. Serve meals, break up fights, unclog toilets, and stop the plane from descending into mayhem. Frantic local and online co-op for 1 to 5 players. No two flights go the same way twice.

4929280.title: Act Normal
4929280.short_description: Everyone looks like an NPC. Some of them are players. Blend in, spot the others, and outsmart your opponents across chaotic multiplayer game modes. Just remember one thing: Act Normal.

4929470.title: Whisker Cat Shelter
4929470.short_description: Welcome to Whisker Village! Run a cozy cat shelter, welcome cats brought in by villagers, care for new arrivals, and help them find loving forever homes, solo or with a friend.

4929480.title: Draft Eleven
4929480.short_description: Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite where you build your perfect XI, scout the transfer market, create powerful synergies, adapt your tactics, and compete in asynchronous PvP against squads built by real players from around the world.

4929530.title: Cindocu: The Omens
4929530.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

4929670.title: Switch Ball Deluxe
4929670.short_description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through more than 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

4929880.title: Shochimiki: The Eater's House
4929880.short_description: You are just another victim of the House — a living organism that remembers everyone who entered. Corridors change, rooms deceive, and escape is almost impossible. Listen, observe, and uncover the dark rules of a place that watches and hunts you.

4930070.title: Grandpa Loves Trains
4930070.short_description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

4930300.title: Bumper Buddies
4930300.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

4930330.title: Destruction Brothers
4930330.short_description: A demolition game where every wall, plank and joint is accurately modeled. Enjoy four-player co-op sandbox chaos or progress through a solo career. An innovative, fully deterministic physics engine means when you knock out a building's supports, every brick lands in the same spot on every screen.

4930420.title: Abilill: Persistent Fantasy Extraction MMO
4930420.short_description: (This game was developed entirely using AI.) Abilill: persistent-world fantasy loot/extraction MMO. Leave a safe base on foot for wilds, caves and ruins. Find treasure, fight monsters and hostile players, extract loot. Die and your backpack loot drops for others. Push deeper or retreat?

4930480.title: Priest Amore
4930480.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

4930520.title: Triox
4930520.short_description: A short indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

4930650.title: 11 PM: A Minimalist Factory Game
4930650.short_description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

4930900.title: Derelict Planet
4930900.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

4931030.title: James
4931030.short_description: A cozy idle game about James, a cat who just lives on your desktop. He climbs around your windows on his own, chases mice, and fills up his sticker album. Whether before, during, or after work — he'll always keep you company.

4931510.title: There is No Stress in Outer Space
4931510.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

4931850.title: Maneki Mania Land: Clicker Park
4931850.short_description: Pet the lucky cat, build a Japanese festival park lot by lot, then step up and play every machine yourself: claw, koi pond, pachinko, Daruma wheel and the giant Maneki Grand Slot. In-game koban only, no microtransactions.

4932010.title: Chrome Circuit
4932010.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

4932690.title: 这活你来！
4932690.short_description: Your first job as a project manager: get an office moving. Nobody acts without instructions. Turn actions you have already given into employee handbooks, share copies, and finish each delivery with fewer instructions. A single-player pixel-art puzzle game.

4933310.title: Just a Stupid Room
4933310.short_description: A first-person 3D puzzle adventure escape room game for logic fans. Explore 30 standalone rooms filled with mystery and original puzzles. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious in this unique exploration challenge. The door won't open itself.

4933500.title: Me and You
4933500.short_description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

4933530.title: Gamercury World Engine
4933530.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

4933650.title: One More Shake
4933650.short_description: Shake a vending machine, collect cans, earn money, and build the ultimate idle vending empire through satisfying upgrades, automation, and endless progression.

4933660.title: Mars Inc 98
4933660.short_description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

4933850.title: Incremental Garden
4933850.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

4934300.title: Cheesteroids
4934300.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

4934440.title: Rockblaze
4934440.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

4934480.title: Decrypting Life
4934480.short_description: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s

4934640.title: Hearts Gone Black
4934640.short_description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down zombie survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world. Manage your base and survivors, scavenge, gather resources, craft equipment, and defend against infected while endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices can slowly wear you down.

4934790.title: Desktop Fighter
4934790.short_description: Turn your desktop into an idle RPG! Your stickman fights while you work, collecting chests and rare loot. Merge 9 identical items into stronger gear, choose from 4 specializations, and hunt for items eligible for the Steam Community Market.

4935270.title: TRAINCORE
4935270.short_description: Command a fusion-powered war train through a cyberpunk world. Build specialized wagons, consume resources, salvage enemy wreckage, upgrade your convoy, and survive until the next station.

4935420.title: Focus My Deer
4935420.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

4936200.title: Joe Silva: Solo Trip
4936200.short_description: N2O Joe Silva Solo Trip is a puzzle game where the goal is to help Joe overcome obstacles, collect oranges, and rescue magic flowers to reach the final cube before the path disappears. The game features 45 unlocked levels, a minimalist visual style, and no microtransactions.

4936280.title: When Two Roses Collide
4936280.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

4936540.title: The Ones Who Answered
4936540.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

4936590.title: THE WOLF OF TENGRI
4936590.short_description: A cinematic third-person Action RPG inspired by ancient Turkic mythology. Explore a vast semi-open world, master intense melee combat, uncover forgotten temples, battle mythical spirits, and become the legend who restores the balance.

4936650.title: Cult Of Echoes
4936650.short_description: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where sound is everything!

4937370.title: Cardboard Conquest
4937370.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 22 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

4937480.title: Mowed Down
4937480.short_description: Prop hunt, but the hunter drives a lawnmower. Disguise yourself as anything from a hay bale to a giant toilet, hold still, and hope they don't look twice. Get caught and come back as a mower or a ghost. Up to 40 players online, or solo against AI props.

4937700.title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
4937700.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

4937740.title: Project L.U.N.A
4937740.short_description: Project L.U.N.A is a pixel art bartending visual novel set in cyberpunk Seoul. Run the bar Unknown as L.U.N.A, listen to your guests, and mix cocktails. Your choices and every drink you serve can change their relationships and fates.

4938130.title: Virtus Arenae
4938130.short_description: Choose your tribe and step into the arena. Angels, demons, specters or sylvan folk: your creatures come to life on a 5×5 board. Move them, wield your magic to reshape the battlefield and break through enemy lines to crush your opponent.

4938320.title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
4938320.short_description: Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over.

4938620.title: MIXBALL: Football Basketball Volleyball Tennis
4938620.short_description: Mixball combines the world's most popular sports into one action packed game. Play Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball, and Tennis in the same arena. Enjoy Single Player, Local Multiplayer, or Online modes as you challenge your friends in fast paced, adrenaline filled matches.

4939120.title: Break the Witch
4939120.short_description: Manage the duality of defending while using the enemy projectiles in your favor to face challenges an progress through the game. To improve collect boons along the way. Try different builds and find the one that best suits your play style.

4939190.title: Helltower
4939190.short_description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

4939600.title: UpBRELLA
4939600.short_description: A witch's adventure with nothing but an umbrella. Upbrella is a puzzle platformer where every trick you discover reopens the world in a new way, wrapped in cozy pixel art and a wordless friendship between a girl and a strange little creature.

4940310.title: Fantasy Meat
4940310.short_description: Fantasy Meat is a stress-free cooking game where fantasy creatures are the main ingredient. Cut and assemble them on a skewer as you please, satisfy increasingly more demanding customers, and send out adventurers to find the tastiest creature: The Golden Drake!

4940350.title: Chunk DAW
4940350.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

4940460.title: Guild of Elemental Quests
4940460.short_description: Welcome to the Elemental Adventure Guild! Pick your adventurer, clear elemental blocks to strike enemies, gather diverse elemental gems, and craft your personalized battle style. Survive each mission's battles and complete every challenge that comes your way.

4940800.title: Global Plates
4940800.short_description: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

4941160.title: A Sector Darkly
4941160.short_description: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

4941230.title: Jackpot Poker Destruction
4941230.short_description: Poker meets slot machines in this roguelite deckbuilder! Hold and swap cards, build winning poker hands with special Jokers, upgrade your decks and defeat your enemies!

4941590.title: Desktop Drill
4941590.short_description: Every keypress fires up your drill! Desktop Drill turns your typing into a mining adventure that lives on your desktop. Blast through blocks, unearth rare resources, and unlock new drill parts as you dig deeper with every key you press.

4941710.title: Swap Bots
4941710.short_description: Adapt to the needs of your ever-changing team of robots in this fast-paced, deck-building auto-battler. Combine robots to create the perfect team with the best card synergies before they wear down completely.

4941720.title: Welcome Back to Aeris
4941720.short_description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

4941950.title: CottageCore
4941950.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

4942330.title: Cold Case: Unfinished Sentences
4942330.short_description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

4942550.title: Sportvida Foodimals
4942550.short_description: Half food. Half animal. All adventure. Team up with friends in this VR co-op adventure where you'll hunt ingredients, collect adorable Foodimals, and cook up a world of fun.

4942730.title: The Backrooms Experience
4942730.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

4943000.title: ECHIDNA
4943000.short_description: A dead god drifts in the dark. Build a salvage fleet that carves it apart cell by cell, and watch a colossal carcass melt into a storm of flying debris and climbing numbers. Strip it to the bone then evolve and start again on something bigger.

4943050.title: Working with Montabi
4943050.short_description: Let adorable Montabi keep you company while you work! A desktop companion that types together with you. Customize your room and avatar, stay focused with productivity tools, and collect every Montabi by placing their favorite items!

4943150.title: Kaperfahrt
4943150.short_description: Sail an open Caribbean where every choice matters. Plunder ships in fierce naval battles, trade between rival houses, and build yourself from a humble sloop into a feared legend. Kaperfahrt is your pirate sandbox on a grand scale.

4943450.title: Odd Stories: Backyard Mountain
4943450.short_description: Dig into a mysterious mountain in your backyard. Mine valuable resources, sell your discoveries, upgrade your digging equipment, and venture deeper to uncover what lies beneath.

4943660.title: La Famiglia
4943660.short_description: A painted noir mafia saga: plan the week, rule the city, found a dynasty.

4944110.title: Wildvale
4944110.short_description: Wildvale is a single-player fantasy roguelite autobattler. Choose your Hero and Companion, recruit Wildfolk, and combine powerful Masteries and equipment to survive a branching journey. Protect your shared Bond, where even victory can come at a cost.

4944190.title: webFPV
4944190.short_description: Learn FPV from your first hover to a pro licence. Race five inch and whoop tracks, freestyle a whole town (even upside down in 3D mode), build your own maps, then play six mini games. A manga styled drone sim that runs fully offline.

4944410.title: High Roller Penny
4944410.short_description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

4944890.title: Foosball Champs
4944890.short_description: Experience the most authentic foosball simulation in VR. Bring the table directly into your room and face off against friends in lag-free and cross-platform multiplayer.

4945340.title: Juicy World
4945340.short_description: A high-octane 3D adventure crafted by a unique duo: a 3D artist and an AI programmer. Take control of a fierce grey rabbit and smash hordes of mutant vegetables in a vibrant stylized world. Pure action and hand-crafted visuals packed with heavy guitar riffs!

4945810.title: Odysseus' 13th Ship
4945810.short_description: Paddle a canoe up a mountain of abstract geometric shapes with your friends, as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Online multiplayer only, with the goal of reaching Ithaca.

4945920.title: VIZZA
4945920.short_description: Set particles dancing to your favorite songs. Infect your desktop with immortal mold. the waves of time at your fingertips. Your one way ticket to the trip dimension.

4946060.title: Keelhauled
4946060.short_description: Sink your friends in fast-paced top-down pirate combat. Line up devastating broadsides, dodge deadly hazards, and unleash game-changing powerups in chaotic sea arena battles for 2-6 players.

4946180.title: EVA Awakening
4946180.short_description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi experience aboard the mysterious Aeon Express. Solve immersive puzzles, shape the narrative, and question the nature of consciousness.

4947550.title: TrueClash
4947550.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

4947630.title: 7 Shifts in Subway
4947630.short_description: 7 Shifts in Subway is a first-person psychological horror game in which you play as a night-train operator. Keep an eye on passengers through cameras, follow strange subway rules, and try to survive seven shifts where every mistake could be your last.

4948070.title: さくらいろプリズム Beyond the Bloom
4948070.short_description: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

4948210.title: If You Build It, Everyone Dies!
4948210.short_description: Play as the "Techno King" of a thriving Silicon Valley startup in this active incremental game. Fulfill contracts, harvest data, fabricate supply chains, manufacture consent, bio-integrate with humans, and transcend space and time itself in a dark satire of the retro-futuristic Brave New World.

4948830.title: StowStow
4948830.short_description: StowStow is a first-person warehouse sim where every box is a physics object. Stop the train, unload and sort cargo, handle explosive parcels with care and load the trucks. Draft upgrade cards and build conveyor lines until the depot runs itself.

4948990.title: Not a Dog
4948990.short_description: What will the world look like on behalf of a cute little dog driven by a cherished wish? Will you follow your dream or stay with your beloved owner, find a new life, or greet the dawn with your loyal friend?

4949070.title: Cozy Cookmaster
4949070.short_description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.

4949360.title: Undying Soul
4949360.short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite focused on fluid combat, character swapping, and broken build crafting. Choose your allies, combine their abilities, discover powerful synergies and adapt your playstyle to overcome deadly foes and reclaim your shattered soul.

4949470.title: Sandweh
4949470.short_description: Sandweh is a relaxing sand-surfing game set in an endless, procedurally generated desert. Carve trails through dunes, build speed, pull off flips and rolls, catch the wind with your sail, and discover mysterious towers and hidden places. No pressure, just you and your board.

4950160.title: Nine Winters
4950160.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

4950300.title: Exchange Alley
4950300.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

4950360.title: Paperlings
4950360.short_description: A desktop pet you actually raise. A papercraft creature lives in a little window while you work — and behind its door: a whole town, a 99-form collection, and a family story that outlives every pet.

4950460.title: The Dark Signal
4950460.short_description: The Dark Signal is a gothic roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a transmission. Build a deadly deck, command summons, manage Debt and Fury, uncover forbidden signals, and survive three floors before facing the entity known as The Last Hand.

4950680.title: DeathSlots
4950680.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Cash --- If you run out of cash you die!! 💀

4950970.title: MORS
4950970.short_description: Every evening the note said tomorrow, for fifty years, and every morning the tree was still there. So Vladimir and Estragon cut it down, built a rocket from it, an oil drum and a painted can, and flew to Mars to build a factory: mining, belts, machines. Godot, presumably, is late.

4952020.title: Ouroboros Break
4952020.short_description: A glitching open-world extraction roguelike set inside a collapsing simulation. Hunt bosses, build modular skeletal minions, and survive a world that rewrites itself around you.

4952080.title: Defend The Wall
4952080.short_description: Choose your hero. Kill demons. Collect gold. Build your army. Upgrade Skills. Defend the wall. In this army building incremental game, you must amass the strongest army you can to survive waves of demons and defeat the Demon Lord.

4952190.title: Partial
