4952190.short_description: Master difficult platforming, puzzles and combat with limited retries inside an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world. Partial is an intense 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, seeking to uncover the mystery behind the Partial project and your own existence.

4952260.title: HopScout
4952260.short_description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

4952500.title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
4952500.short_description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

4952700.title: LIMINAL: Within
4952700.short_description: Boot up Black & White Limbo! Become the Prince of Might and reclaim your ruined homeland in a pixel-art RPG. Beyond the screen, Shuuichi Hirata’s life takes a sinister turn. A murder. A game to blame? Explore, battle, and shape the story in this cinematic mystery adventure. What will you choose?

4952960.title: JazzWitch
4952960.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer about building speed through movement combos — chain jumps, dashes, and saxophone blasts to increase your combos. Outrun various hazards across hand-drawn dimensions to the beat of an original jazz score.

4953020.title: Oniro
4953020.short_description: Slay demonic hordes in a dark fantasy Action RPG with fast-paced combat. Hunt legendary loot and create your own build through a deep multiclass skill tree.

4953700.title: Excuse My Bullets
4953700.short_description: Think bad aim and an empty magazine mean it's over? Wrong! Right-click and your bullets fly back along their trails to hit enemies again. Steal enemies' bodies, or race along a trail as light. Everyone is called a "shareholder", but only the Central Board has a say. Fight from 13th Street to their door!

4954200.title: Plausible Deniability - Cover Your Tracks
4954200.short_description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

4954270.title: My Clay Planet
4954270.short_description: A cute and cozy desktop game where you care for a tiny clay planet, grow crops, place animals, and jump in to control your little friends as your world lives on your screen.

4954970.title: No Body No Problem!
4954970.short_description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

4955040.title: Dragon Hoard Keeper: Treasure Shop Tycoon
4955040.short_description: Run a dragon's treasure shop. Cross-check six appraisal tools to uncover what each relic really is — and expose convincing forgeries. Restore worn treasures, forge new ones by hand, grow the shop, and pay the dragon's tribute before it comes due.

4955120.title: Hexa-Gone
4955120.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

4955250.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
4955250.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

4955350.title: Face Your Fate
4955350.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder where your deck spins the reels. Chain elemental patterns, stack your Fates into one huge hand, and fight your way up to the gods of Chinese myth.

4955700.title: Charon 卡戎
4955700.short_description: A point-and-click narrative puzzle game with a delicate art style and soothing pace. In this Underworld at the end of all things, guide souls who lost their memories and speech safely across the Styx. Luckily, our protagonist is about to face the most restless bunch of them all...

4956610.title: Ants Took the Kitchen
4956610.short_description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

4956750.title: Dice Knight
4956750.short_description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

4957210.title: Mombasa Conspiracy
4957210.short_description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

4957490.title: Legacy: The Card Game
4957490.short_description: A free 1v1 card game with a twist: both players summon Foes onto one shared field, which either of you can kill for Legacy points. It's your Legend versus theirs to see who can leave behind the greatest Legacy. Use strategy to play cards that help you, hurt them, or add some chaos to the mix.

4958330.title: Eclipse Island Primal Odyssey
4958330.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island where every choice shapes your journey. Explore ancient ruins, gather resources, craft essential tools, battle dangerous wildlife, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within Eclipse Island in this immersive story-driven survival adventure.

4958650.title: Wheel of Death
4958650.short_description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

4958950.title: Mow and Move
4958950.short_description: Take control of M-42 in a relaxed incremental mowing game. Cut through fields of engineered grass, turn each harvest into upgrades, and reach farther with a stronger mower. Recover useful equipment along the way and work at your own pace.

4959040.title: How To Get A Goth GF: 101
4959040.short_description: You’re down bad, your rizz is questionable, but goth girls are about to become your entire personality. Indigo’s evening course will teach you how to treat a goth girl right. Pass her lessons, survive the red flags, and pull a goth mommy - or get left on read in this chaotic dating-sim.

4959350.title: Take This Thing Out Of Me
4959350.short_description: It's a short game. But it can be a long one. It all depends on whether you were born under a lucky star... or whether you have the skill in your hands. Just... take the thing out!

4959400.title: UNCUT
4959400.short_description: UNCUT is a tactical police raid shooter seen through a bodycam. Shout real orders into your mic and suspects react: some comply, some run, some open fire. Clear houses solo with two NPC officers or in co-op with up to 4 players. No raid plays out the same.

4959750.title: Hitflag
4959750.short_description: Arcade car chases on real city streets: grab the flag, ram whoever carries it and escape, on Istanbul's Taksim, New York's Times Square or any street you pick on the map. Then race, wreck or run down the dead. 2 to 8 cars, online or with bots.

4960280.title: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE
4960280.short_description: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE is a jockey life sim with deck-building races. Start at 18 as a rookie, ride and raise horses at your family stable, breed your own bloodline, then retire and pass the stable and its legacy to your child.

4960680.title: Morpheus
4960680.short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

4960910.title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
4960910.short_description: Run a ski resort as a real business. Shape trails on the mountain, string up lifts, and set prices against weather, snow and weekend crowds. Keep lifts running, skiers safe and the books in the black, from a gentle beginner hill to desert dunes and a volcano.

4960950.title: Mechanized Wonder: Lost Unit
4960950.short_description: Fight across battlefields in the name of freedom from those who are bound and weighted down by gravity in this FPS simulation game, where you pilot a giant Mechanized Combat Vehicle from within an enclosed cockpit.

4961100.title: Alphadia F
4961100.short_description: Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG in Alphadia F, the remake of Alphadia IV. Explore Valhalard, uncover the mystery of six fallen crystals, and save four kingdoms in strategic turn-based battles. Master the energi system, character progression, cooking, and classic anime-style RPG adventure.

4961220.title: Sifu Duel
4961220.short_description: A Roguelike strategy deckbuilder where cards determine your moves. Each card becomes an attack, defense, movement, or special skill. Arrange cards wisely to trigger combos, deal more damage, and adapt to changing enemy attacks.

4961370.title: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
4961370.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

4962220.title: Beyond The Grey
4962220.short_description: Beyond the Grey is a cosy island life sim. Farm, mine, craft and keep bees at whatever pace suits you, trade at a market that opens once a week, and get to know some neighbours who notice when you come back. You left the city. Nothing here is in a hurry.

4962520.title: Football Chess
4962520.short_description: Every player on the pitch is a chess piece. Make the right move, disrupt your opponent's strategy, create the perfect attack, and take the shot. The excitement of football meets the strategy of chess in one unique game.

4962750.title: Don't Fear
4962750.short_description: Endure a recurring nightmare and search for scattered fragments of memory. Distinguish between the entities that approach you in different ways, and confront the traces of emotions long kept hidden in this first-person psychological horror game.

4962980.title: Match 2 3D
4962980.short_description: Match II 3D is a relaxing 3D hidden pair puzzle where physics scatters dozens of colorful objects across detailed environments. Rotate the camera, find matching pairs, unlock new waves, and challenge your observation skills in a cozy casual experience.

4963020.title: murmures
4963020.short_description: murmures is a narrative exploration game. Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable, but something is following her. Explore, search, roll your d20s and help her find a way out.

4963310.title: May, Be Dead
4963310.short_description: May, Be Dead is a first-person surrealist adventure game about walking through endless hexagonal rooms of memory and repeatedly killing May, a mysterious figure you shared an intimate yet ambiguous relationship with.

4963580.title: Snake Mayhem
4963580.short_description: You're a snake that turns into a flaming wheel. Smash structures, set off chain reactions, race for gold medals, and build your own levels to wreck.

4963630.title: Bandidos em Brasilia
4963630.short_description: Brazil has fallen. A dictatorship has seized power, and the files that could bring it down are hidden inside an abandoned mansion — with someone inside who doesn't want you to find them.

4963680.title: Pick Playground
4963680.short_description: Plan crane lifts like the pros. Pick your crane, configure the boom, rig the load, and judge every pick against real manufacturer load charts. A 3D rigging simulation sandbox from a rigger with 18 years in the field. Build it, rig it, lift it, land it.

4963810.title: BROKE.EXE
4963810.short_description: BROKE.EXE is a satirical trading simulator inside a fictional desktop OS. Earn cash in minigame jobs, then trade simulated stocks and crypto - long, short, leverage, stop-losses. Build passive income, run mining rigs and trading bots, and climb from $0 to $10,000,000. No real money involved.

4964480.title: Mineblader - Spin. Mine. Upgrade.
4964480.short_description: A short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses.

4964510.title: マジカルラプチャー
4964510.short_description: A 2D fighting game featuring magical girls with comical moves! Unleash magic on your opponents using simple controls—no complex command inputs required. Manage your magic gauge as you battle, employing unique tactics to outplay your rivals!

4964530.title: Seal of Confession
4964530.short_description: A man confesses he'll kill tomorrow, but the hardest part isn't deciding what's right. It's deciding what you're willing to betray. Work with the Gravekeeper, unaware of the tragedy unfolding around you.

4964540.title: Sound & Shoal
4964540.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss, and the stories we tell ourselves. Explore an ever-changing world where reality and fantasy blur in search of meaning.

4964630.title: Apocalypse Train
4964630.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

4965150.title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
4965150.short_description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

4965470.title: Crownmarked
4965470.short_description: Rule a fallen kingdom: manage its people, send adventurers into dangerous lands, and explore the wilds yourself to learn what broke the world.

4965660.title: No More Turtles
4965660.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

4965680.title: Friends for Strawberry
4965680.short_description: A filthy, horrific nightmare at sea, haunted by people and things cast away. Friends for Strawberry is a story-driven horror FPS where you are trapped on an island of garbage, held captive by the cannibal castaways dwelling there, and... something in the trash, that won't let anyone or anything go.

4965710.title: Hyper-Realistic Fishing Sim
4965710.short_description: Cast your way through hordes of fish, explode arcade cabinets, and kill Poseidon in this tiny endless fishing combat game!

4965890.title: Project Poker
4965890.short_description: Project Poker is a single-player poker experience with smart opponents, memorable personalities, and tons of quality-of-life features. Build your bankroll in Career Mode, master four poker variants, and play your way with game speeds, fast-forward, quick betting, full controller support, and more.

4965960.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
4965960.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

4966030.title: 100+ Bored Games
4966030.short_description: Mini games you can play with your friends or with bots during any time!

4966170.title: Unbox Super Card
4966170.short_description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

4966300.title: LOTTERY
4966300.short_description: The only game in the world to bring the joy of tactical FPS games into the single-player experience. Fight the entire world with superpowers gifted to you by sheer luck as you wipe out thousands of the world's most elite defenses while they try predicting, learning, and adapting to your every move.

4966380.title: Survivor of the Meow Kingdom
4966380.short_description: Gameplay:​ A 3D pixel-art roguelike action-adventure game. In an endless sea of choices, discover powerful card-based upgrades, forge your own path, slay monsters, save the empire—or challenge yourself to the limit in endless mode.

4966440.title: Rogue Link Loop
4966440.short_description: Link matching tiles via paths with up to two turns. Clear tiles to cast spells, build structures, and summon allies. Diverse spells and relics ensure fresh runs. Counter unique elite disruptors.

4966760.title: Review Responder
4966760.short_description: As a review responder for an e-commerce store, you face various customer complaints and must make critical decisions. Will you sincerely apologize, firmly refute, or skillfully defuse the situation? Every choice impacts your store's performance and determines the course of your career.

4966820.title: Tactical Task Bar
4966820.short_description: A pixel-art idle squad shooter that lives above your Windows taskbar. Build guns from over 1,100 parts, gear up to three operators and send them into a fought-over city, where they fight, reload and haul back loot on their own while you work.

4966990.title: Arcane Abyss
4966990.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

4967050.title: DEGEN DROOLS
4967050.short_description: An autobattler where degenerate marshmallows fight automatically. Stick them with darts, roast them together, stack them on top of one another for more power, and gamble everything. THE ONLY THING TO BEWARE IS YOURSELF!

4967130.title: Wild Boar Digging
4967130.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

4967170.title: Vanslinger
4967170.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

4967630.title: Starfall Samurai
4967630.short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

4967660.title: Ball-Aqua
4967660.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op. Free demo available now.

4967670.title: Lean Into The Swarm
4967670.short_description: Direct a growing swarm of harvesters as it consumes procedurally generated worlds tile by tile. Upgrade your operation, steer the frontier, use Scorch, and carry permanent Salvage perks into each larger world.

4967720.title: Ikigai - Party Game
4967720.short_description: Grab, shove and flail your way through a gauntlet of physics-driven party games. Up to 8 players, wobbly ragdoll limbs and a fresh minigame every round — sumo showdowns, chaotic football and frantic fishing, wrapped in Japanese folk charm.

4968250.title: NightClub Manager Simulator
4968250.short_description: As the boss, evaluate the proposals that come your way. Manage your nightclub’s reputation. Beat up thieves and put out fires.

4968630.title: CampSight
4968630.short_description: CampSight is a co-op horror photography roguelike where you explore a haunted campground, photograph strange wildlife, and earn enough to meet your quota. Search abandoned camps, caves, cabins, and dark trails but beware: some creatures run, some stalk you, and some should never be watched too long

4968700.title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
4968700.short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

4969230.title: Aquaculture Simulator
4969230.short_description: Run your own fish farm in first person. Keep the water alive, raise trout, eels, sturgeon and koi, breed 25 koi varieties, and sell through customer orders, an online market, your farm shop and a show hall where you haggle face to face.

4969370.title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
4969370.short_description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

4969600.title: Pine Creek: Prologue
4969600.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the Grays, and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror prologue set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986. Play the Pine Creek prologue.

4969750.title: Space Circle
4969750.short_description: Space Circle is a game that combines Circle TD and roguelike. Enemies have no final destination, and you must defeat them all within a limited time!

4969780.title: Sort The Lot
4969780.short_description: A cozy relaxing game about sorting 298 vehicles in an impound lot! Earn parking points, upgrade your abilities, unlock new areas, and park every vehicle!

4970020.title: Nightbound
4970020.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

4970070.title: Break the Bank
4970070.short_description: Break the Bank is an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new zones, and defeat strange bosses.

4970180.title: HeroNet
4970180.short_description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

4970310.title: Tides of Empires
4970310.short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

4970340.title: Paint Me Back
4970340.short_description: A cozy narrative adventure set in a very particular museum, where the great masterpieces of art history have lost their colors and their protagonists. Help George restore the paintings, bring the missing characters back and discover what forced them to leave their paintings...

4970660.title: Idle Mall Simulator
4970660.short_description: Build and expand your own shopping mall in this fun idle simulation game. Open new stores, increase your profits, keep customers happy, and turn your mall into a thriving business empire!

4970750.title: Warrior Quest
4970750.short_description: What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. Whatever you do, roll well!

4970830.title: Villion:Code
4970830.short_description: Cozy Okada presents a brand-new action RPG set in the near future where humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Genome editing has ushered in a new age—but is there any hope for the future?

4970960.title: Make the Bus
4970960.short_description: Catch the bus or die trying! Dash, dodge, and survive a chaotic suburban neighborhood in this action roguelike about the world's worst morning commute. Buy upgrades, perfect your route, and reach the bus before time runs out.

4971110.title: Annihilation Plus Plus
4971110.short_description: Build factories, harvest metal and energy, shape formations, and command mechanized armies across layered battlefields. Annihilation Plus Plus is a physics-first real-time strategy game for solo skirmishes and private online battles.

4971230.title: Viral Dependency
4971230.short_description: Turn a rookie VTuber into a streaming star! Click and idle to build hype, upgrade her setup, and choose what Vivi talks about. As chat fills with messages and gifts, each stream wears her down. Off camera, she shows another side. Your choices shape who she becomes—and how her story ends.

4971460.title: Radia Island
4971460.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

4971700.title: Deadroll
4971700.short_description: Roll dice to build poker hands, stack powerful combos, and beat crooked dealers in a dark casino roguelike.

4971740.title: Graveline
4971740.short_description: A first-person survival horror operation sim. Drive a steam locomotive through one night. Feed the boiler, read signals, and hold the deadman's lever while something advances car by car. Kill the light to hide and lose your gauges. Make noise to survive and it hears you. One life.

4971780.title: IMMRAMA: Voyages of the Otherworlds
4971780.short_description: A story-driven RPG you play with text or voice. No jargon, use your own words and the game understands. A hand-written world of myth responds. Real dice, factions, and consequences underneath; a complete, cinematic voyage you can actually finish. Every word human-authored. AI only does the telling.

4971880.title: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time
4971880.short_description: Run a cozy hot dog cart, serve charming customers, restock your stand, and end each shift a little better than the last in a relaxing food-making game with a strange little secret simmering under the surface.

4971890.title: Drone Operations
4971890.short_description: Pilot combat drones through diverse missions with realistic FPV flight simulation. Scout targets, drop grenades, launch explosive strikes and fire mounted weapons against enemies who flee, seek shelter or escape in vehicles. Earn stars to unlock new operations, drones and upgrades.

4971940.title: Spook'd
4971940.short_description: Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game. Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them. Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!

4972310.title: パラパラパズル
4972310.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.

4972480.title: Home Is Where I Left You
4972480.short_description: A cosy hand drawn atmospheric puzzle game with a gentle mystery to uncover. Organise, decorate and collect letters in a beautifully mysterious house, floating in the night with over 30 puzzles. Go at your own pace, choose your perfect ambience and relax with a dreamy yet melancholic lofi soundtrack.

4972540.title: 木鱼敲敲有限公司
4972540.short_description: With just a tap of your fingers, you can raise small woodfish on your desktop Seven adorable and quirky little woodfish are at your beck and call. They'll become your work (slack-off) buddies, keeping you company through day and night. Happy or not, just give their little heads a knock!

4972620.title: Xydorth
4972620.short_description: In search of your wife, you must descend into the darkness of a vast cave system. But with every step deeper, your descent becomes a journey into your own personal hell. Xydorth is a dark first-person shooter with survival horror elements.

4973070.title: Hollowtone
4973070.short_description: A game you can play BLIND from start to finish... Meet Serene™️'s newest digital therapy model: N.O.R.A.! Hollowtone is a first person audio-based navigation horror game. For possibly the first time ever, CHOOSE to play with graphics OR blindfold yourself for a unique audio experience.

4973130.title: Necromancer´s Ruins
4973130.short_description: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.

4973950.title: Impersonal
4973950.short_description: You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

4974320.title: A (tiny) Slime Quest
4974320.short_description: A short and cozy top-down adventure. Exiled to a hidden village after one final defeat, explore your surroundings and help fellow banished monsters by solving their unique troubles. Whether you long to return to combat or wish to discover a new path, it's your time to shine!

4975010.title: Chess Pit
4975010.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

4975220.title: False Fortune
4975220.short_description: False Fortune is a modern crime RPG where you investigate the conspiracy that framed you, rebuild your fortune, buy businesses and homes, find love, marry, take honeymoons and vacations in a living, breathing world, and shape Adrian Vale’s future through evidence, leverage, redemption, or revenge.

4975510.title: Orbisphere
4975510.short_description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. Navigate an asteroid belt, slice feral space worms and find your way home.

4976010.title: MineMergeMatic
4976010.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

4976180.title: Yolings
4976180.short_description: Yolings is a puzzle platformer about sacrificing some to save the rest. Possess individual characters, use self-sacrificing abilities and turn their deaths into puzzle solutions to save as many as possible for the highest score.

4976510.title: Homicide Squad: Hidden Objects
4976510.short_description: Find hidden objects and solve criminal cases in a thrilling detective game!

4976780.title: Square Seller!
4976780.short_description: Square Seller! is a relaxing incremental game where you run a tiny town square. Sell newspapers, grow your income, build new shops and unlock a huge skill tree to make your Square thrive.

4977210.title: Stop The Fire: Apprentice Water Wizard
4977210.short_description: Everything is on fire. Learn water magic and restore a world consumed by flames... all on your own.

4977470.title: Red Timewarp: Beyond Reality
4977470.short_description: Blast through enemy hordes, grab powerful upgrades, and become stronger with every run in a challenging Bullet Heaven roguelite. Choose one of 4 red panda heroes with unique abilities, build them your way, and battle through time solo or with friends in online co-op.

4977600.title: RepCell
4977600.short_description: What if attention became the most valuable thing in society? And everyone who lost it was sent to a container suspended above the ocean until they became visible again?

4978130.title: Group Commander
4978130.short_description: Take command of a World War II heavy bomber group over occupied Europe. Read the field order, weigh the target against the men, and send your forts. A player-paced command sim where every mission is a decision and every empty bunk is one you signed for.

4978410.title: Too Many Pieces
4978410.short_description: Why are puzzle pieces scattered everywhere? Who wrote the letters guiding Mei? And most importantly, why is she here? Explore 9 strangely familiar rooms, recover the scattered pieces, complete 34 hand-illustrated puzzles, and put the space back together.

4978510.title: The Last Home : Curse of Lanna
4978510.short_description: The Last Home: Curse of Lanna is an FMV horror game that takes players into the mysterious land of Lanna, filled with supernatural tales. Featuring cinematic 4K visuals and immersive sound, it delivers a chilling, movie-like experience.

4978610.title: PawTop Cats
4978610.short_description: PawTop Cats is a cozy app with animated cats that live on top of your windows. Choose different skins, interact with your fluffy assistants, and add a little cute chaos to your desktop.

4978710.title: Tug-O-War Wrestling
4978710.short_description: Grab the rope and fight for control in a physics-based wrestling game where every move pulls your opponent with you. Master momentum through Season Mode or battle friends and random opponents locally and online.

4979000.title: PROTOCOL: VOID
4979000.short_description: PROTOCOL: VOID CONTRACT is a cyberpunk top-down action RPG for 1–4 players. Take on dangerous contracts, fight hostile systems, collect randomized weapons and cyberware, shape powerful builds, and upgrade your gear to survive deadlier missions.

4979030.title: Kaerun
4979030.short_description: Explore the forgotten island of Kaerun in a first-person archaeological adventure. Investigate ancient settlements, uncover artifacts, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together a mysterious history through exploration, observation, and discovery.

4979250.title: Hollow Crew
4979250.short_description: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

4979730.title: Void Walkers X64
4979730.short_description: Your aura fights their aura. A 70-hour classic JRPG where every boss is fought twice — once for their health, once for their soul. Real-time charge-gauge combat, 183 maps, 40 hubs, and deep hybrid class trees. Sovereign C++ engine (IIRIS) iGPU compatible, 128MB VRAM floor.

4979990.title: My Army Getting Stronger
4979990.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

4980270.title: Password Not Valid
4980270.short_description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

4980420.title: It's All Ogre
4980420.short_description: A VR Co-op puzzle game where each player inhabits one half of a two headed ogre. Each player is responsible for an arm and a leg. Coordinate together to bring the ogre to life to complete action puzzles and to feed the ogre!

4980500.title: Primal
4980500.short_description: You will become a primitive man who hunts and tames dinosaurs, survives, and builds a home.

4980620.title: Sanitarium Enhanced
4980620.short_description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium™ returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

4981020.title: Chess of the Hidden Gates
4981020.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

4981700.title: Robot Vacuum Simulator
4981700.short_description: Take the controls of a tiny robot vacuum in a first-person cleaning sim. Cut clean paths through grime, steer around furniture, grab and sort clutter, scrub dishes, chase fresh pawprints, and put new tools to work on bigger jobs.

4982050.title: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite
4982050.short_description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

4982320.title: ADVENTURES OF MOR̂ABOB
4982320.short_description: MORABOB is a 90s-inspired action-adventure side-scroller heavily focused on giant boss battles. Survive, attack, and fight titan bosses hundreds of times your size, each with surprising, unique attacks. Meet the mysterious evil in fog and rescue the kidnapped adventurous girl, Asaly

4982540.title: Blobituary
4982540.short_description: A 2D party game for 1-4 players, on the couch or online. Shove, brawl and betray your way through 26 mini-games in the world where cute blobs go to die.

4982560.title: Card Idler
4982560.short_description: An incremental card idler about collecting cards and expanding your deck. Farm, mine gems, kill monsters and cook meals to help your progression. Unlock new upgrades and merge your cards into their ultimate form. Will you complete your collection?

4982840.title: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
4982840.short_description: A relaxing organizing simulator set in a massive wizarding dining hall. Collect over 2,000 hand-crafted plates, wash them in an enchanted water sphere, and sort them onto shelves by family crest, color, and material. Unlock new spells to help organize the chaos at your pace!

4982910.title: Interlude
4982910.short_description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where each room is a different world inspired by classical painting. Dying brings you back to your starting point, but the upgrades you unlock, the friends you make, and the secrets you uncover will help you explore further each time.

4983330.title: Lurks Beneath
4983330.short_description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

4983340.title: Breaker League
4983340.short_description: Puzzle-battle mayhem on one shared board. Drop pieces, chain combos, and invade your rivals' turf in frantic 1–4 player matches online or on the couch. 37 ridiculous fighters, 12 game-changing specials, and a 32-level story campaign.

4983370.title: FROG IN THE HOLE!
4983370.short_description: Breed frogs, throw them into the hole and get paid. In this incremental sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing up to 100,000 physics frogs. Master the skill tree and chain combos. What happens to the frogs? BECOME WORTHY.

4983380.title: The Demon Wins
4983380.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

4983920.title: Beyond the First Star
4983920.short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

4984150.title: Just Place It: Tidy Up the Cozy House
4984150.short_description: Just Place It: Tidy Up the Cozy House is a cozy, first-person home organizing simulator. Pick up and place 3,000+ scattered items, unlock abilities, and style your space with custom shelf layouts. Organize over 999+ unique objects in a stress-free journey with no pressure.

4984320.title: NAND²
4984320.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

4984520.title: Necro Heist
4984520.short_description: Turn the casualties of war into an undead looting empire. Raise your skeleton army from battlefield corpses, steal fallen riches, and grow your necromantic power through a vast skill tree. In Necro Heist, every battle fuels your incremental rise.

4984590.title: Horror Mahjong
4984590.short_description: Expect the unexpected! Play mahjong and stay alive in a haunted tea house. Pretend you can't see them—good thing you're well armed. Stock up, shoot, throw tiles, revive friends, and win your hand to get up and cover them. Survive until dawn and escape together, or keep watch with paper tablemates.

4984650.title: Factory Reset
4984650.short_description: Shorty's repair shop has gone quiet, and the note says back soon. Under the desk sits a box of factory paperwork nobody ever mentioned. Work the jobs on the bench with real tools and real skills, learn to see past the first sign of life, and find out what a factory reset really means.

4984680.title: Star Claw
4984680.short_description: A claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Bounce off bumpers and reach each room's cash target before time runs out. Combine powerful upgrades, battle bosses, and unlock new cats and decorations between runs.

4984920.title: The Helios Accord
4984920.short_description: The Helios Accord is a post-scarcity science-fiction grand strategy game. Govern by consent, set doctrine, negotiate with civilizations, and send Citizen Minds beyond known space. Then Serenity of Dawn disappears. No wreckage. No distress call. Only an impossible signal that changes when observed.

4985160.title: Goodly Trials
4985160.short_description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and grow your company to survive your journey home in this tactical auto-battler. Play solo, face a tournament of trials in multiplayer, or team up in co-op.

4985260.title: Iron Grave:Planet 9
4985260.short_description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

4985280.title: GO or STOP
4985280.short_description: GO or STOP reimagines the traditional game Red Light, Green Light as a social mind-game party game. Players alternate between seeker and runner. Runners shove, hide behind rivals, and race for first place, while the seeker watches for movement and stops them from reaching the finish.

4985610.title: Human Echoes
4985610.short_description: One day, a disaster known as "The Great Blank Event" erased every artwork in the world. As AI came to dominate art, science, politics, and society, you—a painter—lost an art competition to an AI and abandoned your passion. Everything changes when a mysterious black-haired maid appears at your door.

4985890.title: OutGraft
4985890.short_description: A high speed runner action game where you're always being chased. Vent your heat to knock enemies back, and survive with the power of parasites.

4986260.title: Cover Up!
4986260.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

4986300.title: Apparatus Inspector
4986300.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

4986620.title: Just Another Guild Day
4986620.short_description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

4986650.title: TOUHOU IDLE
4986650.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your desktop. Gensokyo's 3D chibi heroines battle along the bottom of your screen while you work, study, or browse. Build a party of four, collect gear, and push ever deeper. Free demo available now!

4986730.title: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
4986730.short_description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

4986850.title: Click Clock
4986850.short_description: Unravel the mysterious fabric of time in this incremental game. Blood is the currency time demands. The clock is ticking. What are you waiting for?

4987060.title: Attrition Line
4987060.short_description: A factory game about building an army. Mine, smelt, and manufacture soldiers on an assembly line, then send them to fight a swarm that grows every hour. The more you automate, the bigger your army. Fall behind and the line breaks.

4987170.title: Shole Soccer
4987170.short_description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

4987320.title: Beneath the Snow
4987320.short_description: One walk home becomes a journey through a fractured reality. Shift between two intertwined dimensions, where mirrors reveal another world, impossible spaces hide forgotten paths, and some routes only exist in the reflection.

4987400.title: Cult Crasher
4987400.short_description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

4988080.title: 姐姐是我的猫
4988080.short_description: My Sister is My Cat, a Japanese otome dating sim. You play a physics prodigy with severe androphobia — until her stepbrother becomes the only exception. Balance classes and social life, raise stats, romance three leads, unlock multiple endings. Your choice decides who stays.

4988230.title: WWII Commanders
4988230.short_description: Turn-based WWII strategy on hex battlefields. Command the USA, Germany, Japan, or the UK across 13 historical campaigns, mastering terrain, fog of war, and counter-based combat.

4988390.title: Mycelium Queen
4988390.short_description: Pachislot × Roguelite! Build what's on your reels, then take your machine through eight Corridors. A 77-game ceiling, RUSH continuation up to 90%, and every boss fight reshuffles the Setting — your luck is yours to seize!

4988500.title: 5th Frontier, The New Space Race
4988500.short_description: A 4x Turn-Based Single Player Strategic Space game. Design and build Your own space ships, planet and battle-stations to conquer the Galaxy.

4988800.title: Save Us, Doctor Faust!
4988800.short_description: Save Us, Doctor Faust! is an immersive medieval doctor simulator where you diagnose diseases, study medicine, and craft remedies from raw ingredients. Examine your patients, grind and distill ingredients, experiment with recipes — and remember: one mistake could cost a life.

4989070.title: Checkmade
4989070.short_description: Want an Engineer who can revive pieces back? Or a Rook that can move 1 square diagonally? Maybe a Pawn that can also go backwards? Well you got all of that in Checkmade. Custom puzzles with Workshop. Build an army with a budget in the Lab, take it into a match, and find out if the theory holds.

4989110.title: TCG Shop Life
4989110.short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

4989440.title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
4989440.short_description: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Mostly it is horseshoes or kettles, sometimes a legendary sword. Brygida sells it all in their shop. You type, he smiths. Together, the work goes faster and feels better.

4989530.title: Sort Inc.
4989530.short_description: Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.

4989570.title: Grand Opening: The Apothecary
4989570.short_description: Tidy up your cozy apothecary by organizing every potion, herb, and alchemy accessory after a rival store owner sabotaged your store. Explore the shop, put away over 3,000 items, and solve puzzles to unlock more areas and items.

4989730.title: Crimson Princess
4989730.short_description: Beat 'em up(Belt Scroll) Action Game. Control princesses with distinct fighting styles—one-handed sword, brawler, musket, greatsword, and hammer. Chain switches that shift range and tempo with support attacks to keep the pressure on.

4989850.title: 不一样的合成：生生不息 Genesis: From Water to Stars
4989850.short_description: Combine cards in a resource management and automation game with a meta twist. Start with water, wind, earth, and stone. Discover recipes, assign workers, and connect production lines as your civilization reaches for the stars. Your world comes alive, and your narrator reacts to your experiments.

4989870.title: Sky Commander: Voice RTS
4989870.short_description: Command a whole battlefield with your voice. Bark orders — attack, defend, regroup — to fighters, tanks, and mechs, then drop into the cockpit and fight yourself. Secure supply routes, seize the summit, and out-command three rival alliances in a glowing neon-vector war.

4989900.title: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
4989900.short_description: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64. The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

4989940.title: Mineral Craft 2
4989940.short_description: Fascinated by minerals and crystals? Turn your curiosity into knowledge, and your knowledge into profit. Combine real chemical elements, fine-tune temperature, pressure and cooling time to create 140+ real minerals, fill your Mineralopedia, and grow your own mineral business.

4990470.title: Roulettegeddon
4990470.short_description: Roulettegeddon is a darkly comedic roulette game where classic casino betting meets zombies, black humor and chaotic mini-games. Bet against the wheel while Rotten Bob mocks your every move, then earn more credits through a collection of bizarre zombie mini-games.

4990940.title: PC Store Together
4990940.short_description: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

4991060.title: GOBLIN ELECTRIC LTD.
4991060.short_description: Run a goblin power company in a roguelite auto battler. Shop for squads across four races and 35 classes, merge matching recruits and build a formation. Break giant monsters’ armour, capture them alive and plug them into the grid to pay off your debt.

4991080.title: Coilbound
4991080.short_description: Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a card of hidden traits. Descend a coiling dungeon, read each foe's abilities, and choose your path one card at a time — strike or slip past. But some traits refuse to end: it doesn't die when it dies.

4991870.title: Buried Apparition
4991870.short_description: In this story-driven, first-person 3D horror adventure with multiple endings, you play a horror vlogger who quits a secure job against her mother's wishes. Seeking paranormal footage, you stumble upon an isolated mountain inn. Amid eerie events, fear and lies, your fate is yours to decide.

4992060.title: Pickpocket
4992060.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

4992150.title: Plink Void
4992150.short_description: Plink Void is a dungeon crawler roguelike with a pachinko combat system and a dark fantasy atmosphere. Build your loadout with various items, throw blade-balls, and smash skull-pegs with them

4992770.title: Infinite Loop: Incremental
4992770.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

4992810.title: Winds of Valor
4992810.short_description: Winds of Valor is a loot-focused fantasy RPG, reminiscent of retro computer games from the 1980's. Explore a vast continent, battle a diverse set of foes, complete quests, and find powerful items along the way that define your character.

4992820.title: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS
4992820.short_description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS is a 2–6 player multiplayer chase game! Paint your character, blend into the environment, and take on random roles each round. Killers hunt, sheriffs chase, and innocents fight to survive. Hide, disguise, and run. Who will make it to the end?

4993010.title: Desktop Elf: Raising Story
4993010.short_description: Raise spirits on your desktop! Hatch 100+ species, give gifts, breed rare variants, and build a cozy home. Combine elements, skills, and runes to challenge stages and towers, or send companions to explore and gather resources. Enjoy idle growth and everyday companionship.

4993020.title: The Edutainment Vortex Diner
4993020.short_description: It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner, in retro PC game style! Meet ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Be not afraid. Let's inherit a terrible burden together. The vortex beckons...

4993470.title: Jade Cutting Simulator
4993470.short_description: Your grandfather has retired. The jade workshop is yours to run. Guide the saw along your own line and rinse the cut to see what's inside. Sell a good stone to fund your next find, or keep that streak of green for a bangle customers will remember? The future of the shop is up to you.

4993690.title: Iron Wake
4993690.short_description: Iron Wake is a free 1–4 player co-op action roguelike. Hold the line in first person against escalating medieval hordes, spend your gold between waves, and stack relics until your build gets ridiculous.

4993790.title: Lonely Dung Beetle
4993790.short_description: You are the only dung beetle for miles. Roll your ball, crack open treasures, and explore a big little world full of neighbours who need your help. A cosy game about rolling, collecting and never being lonely again.

4993830.title: Anseium
4993830.short_description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

4993890.title: For Our King
4993890.short_description: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

4993980.title: Hellscums tactics
4993980.short_description: Hellscum Tactics features tactical turn-based combat. Party based gameplay with character progression, and dungeon crawling.

4994290.title: Momentigrade
4994290.short_description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

4994380.title: Tidy Town
4994380.short_description: Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

4994640.title: Talk Of The Tavern
4994640.short_description: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.

4995040.title: Kairos
4995040.short_description: Build, expand, and wage dice-driven wars in this medieval tabletop strategy game optimized for a digital experience. Adopt unique legacies to progressively define your strategy as you race your rivals to accomplish the most feats and claim victory.

4995290.title: MOBBED
4995290.short_description: MOBBED is a chaotic zombie wave shooter for 1–4 players. Survive solo or with friends, earn cash from kills, unlock the map, customize your weapons, and stack ridiculous augments. Fight strange zombies, revive your crew, and hold out one round longer.

4995640.title: The Fifth Name
4995640.short_description: A claustrophobic psychological mystery visual novel. On their high school graduation day, an anonymous message draws five friends back to their empty middle school. The doors won't open, and their memories refuse to agree. A complete 1-2 hour story with three endings, built to be read twice.

4995690.title: Puzzle Programmer
4995690.short_description: Solve logic puzzles by hand, then build routines to solve them for you. Nineteen puzzle types, a daily puzzle, par scores to beat, and a Workshop for inventing puzzle types of your own.

4995800.title: TORCH & TRIGGER
4995800.short_description: A sci-fi military novel set in "Plantation." Soldier Jin is ordered to play the role of a temporary family with a girl and a child. He recalls human warmth, but dark secrets stir——.

4995880.title: CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜
4995880.short_description: Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces. Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure. At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

4996000.title: Neural Goblins
4996000.short_description: Explore a one-of-a-kind fantasy 3D brain world built with Gaussian Splatting—messy, noisy and lost in fog. Pick a goal, pilot a Brain Bubble Jellyfish through 11 mind caves, find five Neural Goblins, tackle bizarre minigames and build your own nest. What the hell are they up to?

4996030.title: Flank
4996030.short_description: A tactical roguelite deckbuilder on a hex battlefield. Build your deck and find the cards that work together. Then take them into battle, where what you play matters as much as where you play it — your own position, and your enemies'. Read the battlefield, choose your ground, and survive the run.

4996050.title: Island Raiders
4996050.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

4996090.title: Age of Crowns
4996090.short_description: Captain a free company across a medieval kingdom of four crowns. Hire swords, keep them fed and paid, and climb seven rungs from sellsword to king. Your veterans earn names, the captain who beats you may come back with one, and every fight is decided by orders you read before you commit.

4996240.title: Bone to Pick: Forensic Case Files
4996240.short_description: From a single bone to a name — and the truth. A visual novel mystery set in a forensic anthropology lab. Read the bones, search the scenes, run the experiments and crime scene analysis, and close in on the killer. Seven names waiting, 21 forensic tasks, and side stories with your quirky lab team.

4996430.title: Pyramid Wars
4996430.short_description: Pyramid Wars is a fast, top-down pixel-art RTS. Fight massive RTS battles against an overwhelming enemy. Cast abilities and automate your base. Buy boosterpacks to get legendary units and increase your army even further.

4996610.title: SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life
4996610.short_description: "SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life" is a suspenseful escape-room visual novel. You are a reporter trapped with a drug company heiress for seven days. Can you survive the mastermind’s orders, uncover the truth, and escape before you lose your mind?

4997110.title: Stone to Stars
4997110.short_description: Stone to Stars is a colony sim and ruler simulator set at the dawn of civilization. Settle an uncharted continent, build a thriving settlement, discover new technologies, trade or wage war with your neighbors—and hold on to power as you guide your dynasty through the ages.

4997430.title: ローマ帝国の逆襲　Counter Attack of Roman Empire
4997430.short_description: 【概要】：「ローマ帝国の逆襲」は、若き将軍・ユリアヌスとなり、ローマ軍を率い帝国領州ガリア地区に侵入した蛮族を撃破して、再び平和を回復することが目的です。 【デザイン】：RTSゲームで、偵察、配置、戦闘、補充を行います。戦闘の評価により報酬（金、食料、捕虜（兵士として雇用することが可能））が変化します。戦闘の評価は、制限時間内（食料が尽きるまで）に敵の部隊の撃滅率、ユリアヌス及び味方の生存率です。 得られる報酬によって次の戦闘の難易度が変化するでしょう。但し、強大な敵の場合は撤退も検討することが必要になります。 時間制限もあるので迅速な状況把握と決断が重視されるゲームです。

4997480.title: Mapping Creator
4997480.short_description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

4997850.title: Vital Decisions
4997850.short_description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

4998010.title: Party Tycoon: Nightlife Empire
4998010.short_description: Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors and keep the guests happy. Start in a damp basement and work your way up to a dome on the moon.

4998160.title: Lost Land
4998160.short_description: Survival on a mysterious island, Hunting, fishing, farming, enjoying a free life

4998230.title: Dig to the Core
4998230.short_description: A pixel-art incremental mining game where you dig through one planet after another. Every planet has its own mining style, skill-tree upgrades, and collectibles. Buy the game once to explore multiple planets—and mine on three planets at the same time.

4998290.title: Sneaky Pig: Druid Hide & Seek
4998290.short_description: Scout the village as a bat, disguise yourself as an animal, and steal valuable treasures without breaking character. Outsmart rifle-wielding Hunters in a chaotic multiplayer twist on hide-and-seek.

4998470.title: Hexing
4998470.short_description: Build a living dungeon one hex at a time. Place monster camps, shrines, and traps, grow a few goblins into an army, and hold back endless hero waves in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder. Then gamble blood to hex your camps into monsters.

4998480.title: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort
4998480.short_description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic love letter to couch co-op games. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

4998510.title: Nookmaker
4998510.short_description: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

4998540.title: Slay Sean, Save The World!
4998540.short_description: A comic-book auto-battler where the Greek gods brawl. Draft your pantheon, fuse skills into game-breaking combos, and crush real players' ghost armies to climb from Mortal to Olympian. Rebuild your board every round. Then slay Sean and save the world.

4998550.title: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris
4998550.short_description: A one-summer story about a young painter and a genius biologist girl. As the world loses its colors, he sets out to paint his final masterpiece.A fully voiced short visual novel.

4998690.title: Stray Light
4998690.short_description: What the eye sees is a prison.” Lost in a cursed forest, ancient streetlights are your only escape. Shift seamlessly between a grim reality and beautiful memories to eliminate obstacles and solve dual-world puzzles. Remember: what blocks you here might not exist on the other side.

4998830.title: Galvanize Simulator
4998830.short_description: Manage a hot-dip galvanizing plant. Bid steel contracts, staff the pickle line and kettle, and run overhead cranes—auto or by hand. Upgrade plant equipment, optimize racks, expand your line, and ship coated loads on time without burning zinc or customers.

4998920.title: One Man Guerrilla
4998920.short_description: One Man Guerrilla is a stealth action game where you play as Bento, a rebel agent fighting a brutal dictatorship. Infiltrate diverse Brazilian cities on deadly missions where being seen means practically death, and face powerful bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

4999030.title: Drawnsters
4999030.short_description: Drawnsters is a party game where you and your friends make up monster cards and battle them to the death!! The monster cards, not the friends.

4999120.title: Chirp Chirp
4999120.short_description: One lost little bird, one big climb back home. Chirp Chirp is a lighthearted precision platformer where every jump, chirp, and butt stomp brings you one flap closer to the warmth of your cozy nest.

4999730.title: Fractured Rift: Incremental
4999730.short_description: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

5000170.title: BORE
5000170.short_description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

5000210.title: JOVA
5000210.short_description: A cozy, bright cascade puzzler. Line up three or more Jovials to clear them, chain the cascades, then bank the meter to trigger HYPER for ultra combos! Play cozy solo across two modes and a 50-level ladder, or go head-to-head in local or online versus against a friend or one of your 10 AI rivals.

5000230.title: The Scarlet Thread
5000230.short_description: A Victorian manor mystery in fine 1-bit ink, touched with scarlet. Read the accounts of different narrators, examine clothing and ledgers, and re-enact the night. Spotting lies is only part of the case: how much does an honest account really prove?

5000240.title: Souls on the Line
5000240.short_description: Become a Spirit Summoner and lead an army of Souls in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Collect strange entities with unique abilities and lead them in position- and sequence-based combat. Thwart the plans of a kingdom obsessed with dark magic by stealing their sinister Artifact.

5000500.title: 少女三国志
5000500.short_description: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

5000780.title: White Hound
5000780.short_description: Run WHITE HOUND from a living guild office in the Free City of Azalea. Hire heroes, choose quests from the board, watch parties march a miniature quest map, pay salaries, fight Guild Wars, and chase fame in the Gazette... without leaving your desk of course!!!

5000810.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
5000810.short_description: Run a lemonade stand with or against 3 of your friends! Cooperate or sabotage each other while you, mix ingredients, craft the perfect recipe, squeeze fresh juice, and keep your customers happy. Order fruits and equipment, unlock upgrades and grow your stand into the ultimate business empire.

5000930.title: Death to Demons
5000930.short_description: You are a Necromancer, use your powers to raise the dead in this dark fantasy roguelite auto-battler. Build an undead army, evolve minions, choose powerful upgrades, and fight through waves of demons to break the gates of Hell and free the lands of Vaelthorron.

5001220.title: Duck Duck Gone
5001220.short_description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

5001400.title: LOOPFANG
5001400.short_description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

5002020.title: I Wanna Be a Supernova
5002020.short_description: Devour celestial bodies, grow from red dwarf to supernova, and build your own sky. Forge worlds, choose zodiac relics, and dodge incoming threats. A chill space adventure in pixel art: Normal is relaxed and flowing, Hard is there if you want a challenge.

5002130.title: Cursor Survivors
5002130.short_description: Your friend's "harmless" prank virus mutated and hijacked your PC! Luckily, your AI assistant is ready. Command an evolving fleet of cursors in this bullet-heaven roguelite. Purge swarms of mutating malware, stack game-breaking upgrades, and reclaim your system!

5002170.title: Dreamfend
5002170.short_description: Dreamfend is a pixel-art roguelite survivor where you play as an old teddy bear guarding a sleeping child from nightmares. Fight off swarms of monsters, collect and upgrade weapons, find power-ups, hunt down every boss and survive the night. Just don't lose yourself — and don't lose the child.

5002300.title: My Otaku Girlfriend
5002300.short_description: Yuuichi’s anime club has finally joined the doujin event “Comiko.” To celebrate, the members hold a party. Yuuichi plans to confess his feelings to Maki, but when the “King’s Game” begins, the night takes a dark turn. Kaito, a newcomer, seems to have a hidden agenda, putting Maki in danger...

5002390.title: Tama Pet
5002390.short_description: Raise your own desktop companion! Feed, decorate, collect cute accessories, open surprise packs, and watch your virtual pet grow while it keeps you company throughout the day.

5002880.title: Rot & Bloom
5002880.short_description: A cozy idle compost bin for your second monitor. Feed it scraps, watch them rot into a glowing garden, then drop a Mystery Scrap and hope for a garden-sized miracle — a bloom big enough to swallow the screen. Hire gnomes, grow a season tree, and let it tick away while you work.

5003160.title: Signal Corruption
5003160.short_description: Pilot one of four experimental ships in Signal Corruption, a retro pixel art side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Battle enemy waves, face powerful bosses, complete challenging missions, and upgrade your ship to fight back against the spreading corruption!

5003880.title: IRON EDEN
5003880.short_description: Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

5004290.title: MANIFEST
5004290.short_description: This is a game about the pressure of keeping ships productive. Idle ships bleed money. Late deliveries hurt your reputation. Old hulls develop histories. Captains become known quantities. A quiet ore run can suddenly become a rescue problem, a customs problem, or a piracy problem.

5004390.title: MadWorld - Age of Darkness
5004390.short_description: "Mad World - Age of Darkness" stays true to the classic MMORPG but with unique art and grotesqueness. Fight along side your friends to take down formidable enemies, or fight against your friends to test your skills in a world full of fear, despair, and madness. This is "Mad World - Age of Darkness".

5004740.title: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
5004740.short_description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

5004930.title: Fish Them All!
5004930.short_description: Aim for 100 million fish! Catch fish, earn money, and unlock skills as your hauls grow and your fishing speeds up. Recruit divers, drones, and UFOs in this short pixel-art incremental fishing game, and reel in the very last fish in 4–5 hours.

5005000.title: Pro Baseball: Franchise Builder
5005000.short_description: Take control of a professional baseball franchise and build a winner through the draft, trades, free agency, and player development. Customize your league, manage your farm system, track history, and lead your club to a Championship Series.

5005650.title: ZERO//DECAY
5005650.short_description: ZERO//DECAY is a frantic roguelite action-platformer where you play as an unstable nucleus racing toward stability. Dash through bullet hell, collect epic mutations, build wild synergies — or die fast and try again.

5005750.title: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
5005750.short_description: Help Jess to organize, repair and restore retro objects - cassettes, cartridges, cameras - while you solve riddles and puzzles hidden in an attic full of memories. A cozy story with hints of mystery where you'll unveil who Matt really was and who Destiny was.

5005810.title: Operation Crimson
5005810.short_description: A story-driven top-down action shooter. Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

5005940.title: Thock Roll
5005940.short_description: Roll a ball across a giant bowl of mechanical keyboard keys and press as many as you can before time runs out. Spend your Bits on a sprawling skill tree to unlock drones, shockwaves, meteorites and lightning, then prestige to new arenas in this satisfying, thocky incremental game.

5006260.title: Carpetorium: A Carpet-Cleaning Purgatory
5006260.short_description: A melancholic dark-fantasy idle/incremental game about cleaning carpets. You wake up in a strange guild hall with nothing to do but scrub - by hand or with magic brushes. Face rugs that smolder, ooze and worse, grow your workshop and guild, and explore a world where every rug hides something.

5006320.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
5006320.short_description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

5006540.title: Dead Extraction
5006540.short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

5006600.title: Mountainhall
5006600.short_description: The dwarves have chosen you. Will you lead them? A new land, a new start, and a mountain waiting to become a home. Dig it out from the inside, lead a colony of dwarves with lives of their own, and stand with them when the goblins come. Build a settlement, a fortress, a Mountainhall.

5006840.title: The Five Monks
5006840.short_description: A settlement simulation about five monks who survived a burning monastery and set out across the continent. Generate a world, gather scattered companions, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes. Rebuild a broken world with the hands of those who survived.

5007320.title: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution
5007320.short_description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!

5007600.title: Debt Crystal Adventure
5007600.short_description: Fear creates strong will—and “they” are watching. They offer contracts: wishes come true, but debt follows. Meow Meow signed out of fear of poverty; Awo Awo chose the chains. No call to save the world—just an adventurer repaying debt, uncovering deeper rules through quests and choices.

5007660.title: Froggous Grove
5007660.short_description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

5007730.title: Steam Colony
5007730.short_description: Build a steampunk colony, put robots to work and connect a growing network of steam-powered machines. Mine resources, research new technology and defend your Steam Core when night falls. Play solo or join friends in online co-op.

5007890.title: CHAINSPIRE
5007890.short_description: CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1–4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

5007950.title: Zombonk
5007950.short_description: A comedic survivors-like where you're the last thing standing between a city and a flood of thousand zombies. Auto-blast your way through the streets, herd the horde into minefields and chokepoints, level up, extract to your bunker — then go again.

5008260.title: ShootyCraft
5008260.short_description: Massive space battles with base-building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Online team battles, cooperative with friends, or single-player. Free to play. All paid content is cosmetic.
