5008360.title: Sort The Mons
5008360.short_description: A cozy organizing game in a little shop buried under 3,500 cute monsters. Scoop up 175 kinds of cute Mons, learn their 17 types with your pocket Mon Guide, fill every shelf, earn coins and unlock handy powers until the whole shop is perfectly sorted.

5008370.title: Pokermancer
5008370.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are scored on a grid, not played from a hand. Link neighboring cards across a 4x4 grid into pairs, straights and flushes, then slide, swap and delete cards to bypass hazards that block the paths you need.

5008770.title: Hellevator
5008770.short_description: Hellevator is a darkly comedic action roguelite where YOU are a hungry elevator in a failing hotel in Hell. Bite intruders in half, keep demanding guests alive and happy, and transform your cabin for management's bizarre assignments as you climb floor by floor.

5008960.title: Honest Work
5008960.short_description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

5009280.title: VEKARRA
5009280.short_description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends. Free demo: solo or two-player local co-op.

5009290.title: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
5009290.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy. Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

5009620.title: Gloomhallow
5009620.short_description: Gloomhallow is a macabre and unforgiving turn & tile based tactical PvP game. 3 Phases, 1 turn. Predict your enemies' movements and pre-decided all 3 phases before committing and letting yours, and your opponents decisions, dictate the outcome of battle. Every decision counts.

5009670.title: Crunch Time VTuber: One Week ‘til Deadline
5009670.short_description: “Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow!” VTubers who live by that creed have their backs against the wall, and today they plunge into scheduling hell once again. Allocate your resources wisely and survive the one week until the deadline. A last-minute, task-crunching roguelite!

5009860.title: They Are Adorable
5009860.short_description: An incremental horde FPS where tens of thousands of adorable creatures come for you. Operate absurdly overpowered guns, tear visible holes through the crowd, earn permanent upgrades every run, and come back strong enough to massacre the wave that stopped you.

5010170.title: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done?
5010170.short_description: Pinball, wands and chain scoring in one roguelike. Break balls with your cue ball and wand spells, link same-attribute balls into long chains on the 16-slot ball rail, and hit the target score before time's up. Seven attributes and over a hundred relics, wand parts and decorations to build around.

5010440.title: Cozy Banker
5010440.short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

5010450.title: Purrfect Dice
5010450.short_description: Purrfect Dice has been cancelled in its current form. The game is going through a very large change of direction. Thank you to everyone who played the demo.

5010820.title: Up & Up: Pinball & Pachinko
5010820.short_description: A unique combination of pinball and pachinko. Collect pachinko balls, fight your way to the top, and unlock the pachinko board where a hail of points awaits! Play pinball to unlock pachinko. Play pachinko to set a new high score!

5011450.title: Check Please!
5011450.short_description: Run chaotic restaurants in this fantasy medieval realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

5011560.title: Last Rites
5011560.short_description: You're ten years old and live with your grandparents. Father Aldous has come to read your grandmother her last rites. Now he says the house must be cleansed of sin. Stay out of sight.

5011620.title: Respawn | 2020
5011620.short_description: Come join us at Respawn where you can play with friends, make friends, create whole worlds, become a content creator, become an artist and so much more all at Respawn!

5011890.title: The Split Layer
5011890.short_description: Step into The Split Layer, psychological horror game set within a liminal world where familiar places no longer reveal the whole truth. Your only reliable tool is a tablet that uncovers another layer of reality.

5012100.title: Buckaroo
5012100.short_description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

5012250.title: Starport Tycoon
5012250.short_description: Starport Tycoon is a trade and management simulation set it space. Obtain landing rights, transport goods, plan profitable routes, develop spaceports and your fleet. Hold your ground against competitors and pirates.

5012960.title: Pawnshop Together
5012960.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

5013140.title: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
5013140.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

5013480.title: NextBot PANIC!
5013480.short_description: Turn your friend's face into a monster. Invite 7 people. See who survives. NextBot PANIC! is a chaotic 1-8 player co-op survival horror where YOU create custom Nextbots. Navigate procedural mazes, unlock loot, and experience pure meme panic!

5013510.title: Console Dealer
5013510.short_description: Run a secondhand games shop in 2003, where every sale is a negotiation. Read the customer, hold your price or fold, buy low across the counter and at auction, and keep a shelf that moves before the rent comes due. A first-person shop sim about haggling, stock and margins.

5013940.title: Color Factory
5013940.short_description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

5014080.title: TOWN of HIDDEN MURDERS
5014080.short_description: The tranquility of Peaceville was shattered by a single gunshot. In a back alley, a reporter was found shot and killed. Meanwhile, Detective Song Sun had been investigating a series of murders—but what was the truth he uncovered...?

5014200.title: Tame or Conquered
5014200.short_description: You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

5014270.title: Tactical Dungeon Slayers
5014270.short_description: Slay the Spire-style roguelite deckbuilding meets high-mobility tactical combat and terrain strategy. Find the perfect position to unleash powerful deck combos and AoE attacks, wiping out enemies while avoiding the enemy’s kill zones.

5014590.title: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One
5014590.short_description: A first-person investigation inside a rebuilt memory. You are not a man in a room — you are the scan of one. Reconstruct what happened to him object by object, link the evidence, and learn to spot the parts the machine invented to fill its gaps.

5014650.title: Hetero-Genesis
5014650.short_description: Build a living weapon in this deep-sea action roguelite. Choose your species, graft organs, and combine melee strikes, ranged fire, and strange synergies. Protect vital parts, survive waves and bosses, and evolve your body during each dive.

5014730.title: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor
5014730.short_description: A gross-out horde-survivor where you play the pest. Buzz over picnic tables and sewer guts, stack six revolting weapons, evolve them into screen-clearing monstrosities, and outlive the entire insect kingdom. Die, mutate at The Heap, and go again.

5015000.title: Crafty Idle
5015000.short_description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

5015170.title: Hotel Stardust
5015170.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

5015550.title: OmniMart Tycoon
5015550.short_description: Design and manage the ultimate retail empire in OmniMart Tycoon! Build complex store layouts, optimize daily supply chains, and set prices. Hire staff and watch hundreds of simulated shoppers navigate your aisles as you balance profits with ultimate customer satisfaction.

5015580.title: A Pile of Tile
5015580.short_description: A Pile of Tile is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about Loki, a cute little cat who recently graduated from art school and started his first job in a tiles shop. Loki faces multiple challenges in his new job, your goal is to help him make the tiles for customers and keep his job.

5015630.title: Last Contract
5015630.short_description: Last Contract is a fast paced 2D action game set in a pixel art cyberpunk world that you need katanas, shurikens and quick reflexes to survive.

5015740.title: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run!
5015740.short_description: Your microphone is your weapon! Play online with up to 8 players, scream to attack, kick your friends, dodge your rivals, and unleash chaos with ridiculous power-ups and unpredictable matches. Grab your mic and let out your best Sooooooooooo!

5016060.title: Quitter's Quest
5016060.short_description: Quit your job in Quitters Quest! Escape your soul-crushing office job by solving puzzles, outsmarting annoying coworkers, and talking to everything in this classic-style point and click adventure. Take what's left of your dignity and get the hell out.

5016320.title: Heist of Fools
5016320.short_description: Team up for chaotic fantasy heists with 1–4 players. Use four thieves’ unique abilities, outsmart guards and traps, haul enchanted loot, and escape before your mistakes bring the owner home.

5016560.title: Arithmetrick
5016560.short_description: Arithmetrick is a math-based deckbuilding roguelite. Arrange operation cards into equation chains — addition,subtraction, multiplication, division — to hit escalating target scores. Collect a permanent deck across runs and mixthree color factions to discover deep card synergies

5016800.title: Three Kingdoms Heroic Tales
5016800.short_description: Choose your protagonist from over 450 officers and freely assemble your party in this Three Kingdoms RPG × conquest strategy game. Develop your officers, combine gear, sub-commanders, and formations, and conquer all 88 castles in an ever-changing age of war. Who becomes a hero is up to you.

5016990.title: Desktop Forge
5016990.short_description: A tiny forge in the corner of your desktop. Quirky smiths gather materials and hammer out blades on their own. Hand one to a passing adventurer, or deliver it to a nation at war — your blade decides whether they live, calms the monster dens, and can change who rules a town.

5017000.title: The Last Imperial Guard
5017000.short_description: Lin Chong only wanted peace, but restraint cost him everything. On a night of fire and snow, he raised his spear. Not the origin of a hero, but a man reclaiming himself after losing his world. The storm may pass, but his spear will not. Decide his fate.

5017210.title: Productive Plants
5017210.short_description: Productive Plants is an idle desktop game about growing and collecting house plants that rewards productivity.

5017970.title: Wasteland Collector
5017970.short_description: Explore the wasteland, scavenge and mine resources, rescue survivors, and uncover the secrets of your forgotten past. Manage your inventory, upgrade your gear, and fight monsters in fast-paced auto-battler combat with your fully tuned shopping cart.

5018350.title: ur round
5018350.short_description: a small, cosy co-op pub game for you and your mates, played as birds. a cramped bar, chaotic nights, pop-up trouble and jobs everywhere, and it gets harder every night. you probably won't survive night 7.

5018620.title: Kayak Photography Sim
5018620.short_description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

5019070.title: Dusky's Nook
5019070.short_description: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

5019200.title: HYPER TITAN
5019200.short_description: Sci-fi fleet combat: pilot your mothership, build modules, recruit hero captains, and wage formation war across the galaxy.

5019280.title: Fake Hero
5019280.short_description: A 3D survivor-like roguelite with up to 4-player co-op! Fight hordes, collect loot, unlock skills, and mix talents to create your own builds. From powerful combos to crazy strategies, every build feels awesome! Team up, mow down enemies, and crush bosses!

5019620.title: Sneaky Eraser
5019620.short_description: Class started… a bit boring. Wanna play Eraser War? Let’s go! Sneaky Eraser is a turn-based physics party brawler for 2–6 players. Take control of your eraser—aim, charge, and launch! Knock the others off the desk, and you win. It’s that simple~

5019910.title: Scale A Building
5019910.short_description: A game about scaling a building

5020090.title: Real Zombie Survivors
5020090.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

5020100.title: Tiny Industry
5020100.short_description: A relaxing automation game where building a factory stays simple. Create production lines, connect your buildings, and unlock new technologies without worrying about ratios. Just ask yourself one question: What does this item need?

5020110.title: Armory Doctrine
5020110.short_description: Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms empire and fight your own wars in a modern world sliding toward war. Expand your factory, master the global weapons market, and decide the fate of every shipment: sell it for profit, equip your own forces or arm a proxy.

5020270.title: Digital Hunger
5020270.short_description: A true-crime investigation inside a killer's 1999 desktop. Dig through his files, crack his secrets, and answer a call that rings on your real phone. English subtitles, Hebrew voice. 3 endings.

5020390.title: A Game About Games
5020390.short_description: The cosy video game stacking sim. Sort the chaos and race the clock! Grab and hurl game cases onto shelves, then upgrade your speed, reach, and throw. Can you conquer small, medium, large, and totally randomised procedural store layouts?

5020460.title: Debtrize
5020460.short_description: You're a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old debts long overdue. Hunt. Kill. Negotiate. Not even death can save you from your debts.

5020550.title: Slacker Hero
5020550.short_description: A stay-resident RPG whose hero fights all by himself. He does the fighting — but when he gets bored he climbs out of the game window to wander around your desktop and take naps. Send him back, let him rest, or let him scavenge. A comedic little roguelite RPG.

5020730.title: RingOut
5020730.short_description: A 3D arena shooter inspired by Super Smash Bros.: no health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly: launch them off the arena to win. 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

5020760.title: Kitchen Tidy
5020760.short_description: Kitchen Tidy is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 kitchen items and return everything to its proper place. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy kitchen into a perfectly organized space at your own pace.

5020980.title: I am the Dungeon Boss
5020980.short_description: Descend a cursed dungeon where every victory leaves a scar. Dethrone the boss, and your legend rises as the next guardian — an echo that waits in the dark. Roguelike permadeath, shifting floors, and optional ranked play against other players’ legacies.

5021280.title: Find All Things: Vacation
5021280.short_description: Find All Things: Vacation is a relaxing collection of puzzle games set in a world of travel and summer adventures. Search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and spot differences across sunny beaches, water parks, and more. Escape the daily routine and enjoy a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

5021410.title: 动物城往事
5021410.short_description: 《动物城往事》是一款模拟真实经济的城市建设游戏。扮演被委派到偏远自治小镇的动物市长，规划你的城镇，发展工业，调整税收和补贴，完成上级的任务，吸引移民，聆听并解决各种可爱的小动物们的需求，将你的动物城从一无所有建设成繁华的大都会！

5021430.title: Beat Ten
5021430.short_description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat. Your mission: repair the Beat using YOUR music, one track at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten, where you can play to music you stream!

5021740.title: Starworks Inc.
5021740.short_description: Harness the riches of a star system in this incremental game. Unlock new technologies, transform raw materials, build warships and win an interstellar war !

5021860.title: Pivot
5021860.short_description: Pivot is a football universe sandbox. Build clubs and national teams, create players and managers, negotiate contracts, and simulate 6-a-side matches — then relive every game through stats and commentary.

5022010.title: Mai Pillow Smash
5022010.short_description: A mental puzzle game about insomnia and the fragments that fill your head. Mai can't sleep. Every night, restless thoughts flood her mind. Match them, calm them, and clear the noise before it takes over.

5022050.title: Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator
5022050.short_description: Channel your inner shrimp in this totally normal idle-clicker aquarium simulation...

5022060.title: Conatus - Forgotten Depths
5022060.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon offers a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and descend into a world humanity chose to bury.

5022080.title: CACTBOY
5022080.short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

5022360.title: Neon Armada - Solar Storm
5022360.short_description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

5022410.title: BLASTARD!
5022410.short_description: Blast your way through walls, enemies, and your own friends! Grow absurdly powerful by placing kegs, kicking them, leveling up, and stacking loot into wild builds as you fight your way through each run!

5022430.title: Vanguard Fusion
5022430.short_description: Merge three units into one and hold the line in a pixel-art auto-battler with tower defense. Every merge adds a star, and the unit gets stronger and changes how it looks. 24 heroes, 5 biomes, Endless mode and a brutal Boss Rush.

5022560.title: Mall Security
5022560.short_description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

5022650.title: Mana Boom
5022650.short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

5022900.title: Group Idlemen
5022900.short_description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

5022930.title: Froginko
5022930.short_description: A cozy pachinko roguelike. Bounce bugs through a pond full of frogs, merge frogs into bigger frogs, and get your best score in Challenge Mode, where one drop decides your place on the leaderboard.

5023060.title: Home:Ward
5023060.short_description: It is 1907. You wake with no name, a spear in your hand, and a torch that barely holds back the dark. Every sound is a warning. Every flicker of light could give you away. The way out is somewhere below. Find the gate. Get home.

5023070.title: Die and Decay
5023070.short_description: Turn a handful of dice into a town that fights back. Every roll is a choice: strike the horror in front of you, keep your people fed, or grow your dice engine. Chain your buildings into cascading combos, because if the city falls, your Hero falls with it.

5023080.title: Mortal Chess
5023080.short_description: Every piece is living on borrowed time. In Mortal Chess, each piece's life counts down with every move. Collect the coins from expired pieces, buy extra turns, deploy reinforcements, and earn the queen you don't start with. Play vs AI or local split-screen PvP. Checkmate isn't the only way to lose.

5023180.title: Fary-Clary!
5023180.short_description: A brand-new arcade maze game imagined as a lost release from 1983. Guide Fary-Clary through Clee-Claa Forest, recover the scattered nectar, avoid the relentless Glaries, and chase the highest score!

5023920.title: Astrobreaker
5023920.short_description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

5024080.title: SheepFall
5024080.short_description: Build, fight and save the sheep in SheepFall, a strategy game with direct hero control. Face cunning enemies with distinct behaviors, outsmart them with your tactics, conquer dangerous biomes and climb the online leaderboard. Think you can handle it?

5024350.title: WICK: Wizards Into Cards that Kill
5024350.short_description: A real-time, first-person wizard duel where your spells are cards. Throw fireballs, raise walls, summon a Phoenix or turn into a bear. Build your deck, duel friends online, climb the ranks, rip open packs and level your cards

5024550.title: Solitaire
5024550.short_description: Unwind with Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks. Choose a deal by difficulty, take your time, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting the cards in order, with hints and undo whenever you need a little help.

5024650.title: Obolisk
5024650.short_description: COSMIC COMBAT DECIDED ONE COIN AT A TIME... Obolisk is a turn-based tactical roguelike where your party of Obols use coin flips to attack, defend, and unleash unique abilities. Plan ahead, survive each encounter, and see if you can make it to the OBOLISK.

5024660.title: Tales of Twin Souls
5024660.short_description: "Tales of Two Souls" is a 2D open-world xianxia RPG. Explore, fight, and cultivate with the soul bound to you. Uncover your family's fall, rebuild your ancestral home, meet allies and rivals, and forge your own path.

5024900.title: BAIKAL LICKING SIMULATOR
5024900.short_description: An amazing immersive simulator that transports you to a small town on the shores of Lake Baikal, where you can express your love for the greatest, coolest, and freshest lake on Earth — Baikal! How exactly? The answer is obvious: lick it, and then lick it again!

5025000.title: Build Survivors
5025000.short_description: Drop onto a hostile planet, blast through endless hordes and grow absurdly powerful! Hunt down every boss, rip out its power core and make it back to your ship alive... or lose it all! Level up, unlock characters and stack crazy builds with no limits!

5025110.title: Australian Hunter
5025110.short_description: Australia is facing a wildlife overpopulation crisis. You will play as a hunter, surviving, hunting, and working in the Australian wilderness to help the Australian people solve this ecological disaster.

5025140.title: Don't duck with me
5025140.short_description: Cook with the fruit you kill in a cozy fantasy incremental. Cut down fruit monsters, blend them into delicious smoothies and grow your beach bar! Your goal: a boss with 1.5 billion HP.

5025360.title: WEAPONS FREE
5025360.short_description: WEAPONS FREE is a tactical CQB shooter in the bodycam and helmetcam perspectives. This game prioritizes challenging AI, unpredictable scenarios, and immersion. WEAPONS FREE includes realistic combat, true-to-life bodycam, interaction with civilians, and multiple levels with their own unique feel.

5026480.title: No Neutral Ground
5026480.short_description: Master magnetic polarity in a fast-paced, physics-driven robot party game for 1-8 players. Attract, repel, dash, and outmaneuver rivals across 20+ Mini Games, Magnetic Football, and a sprawling Scrap Raid. Customize your machine and claim the arena.

5026520.title: POLIS
5026520.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

5026980.title: My Snake Likes Apples
5026980.short_description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance.

5027620.title: Crimson Sanity
5027620.short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark alternate 1950s America in this story-driven VR shooter! Become Detective Jonathan Kramer and destroy a stockpile of a mysterious drug that turns people into deranged mutants. Fight, explore, and relive nightmarish childhood memories to uncover the mystery of Dr. Phobos.

5027780.title: Balls to the Walls
5027780.short_description: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

5027850.title: Axiom Fortress
5027850.short_description: Join O.D.I. Bot and the crew as you defend your planets against an endless alien fleet in this infinite sci-fi tower defense game. Collect 78 tarot-inspired Axiom cards, unleash devastating secret weapons, and push through 20 unique worlds to uncover the mysterious force driving the invasion.

5028830.title: Rash Decision
5028830.short_description: Co-op medical for 1-2 players. The Nurse examines a very unwell patient and SHOUTS the symptoms through a hatch. The Biochemist brews a cure from a deeply unreliable grimoire. Get it wrong and the patient mutates. Then mutates again.

5029190.title: The Clues
5029190.short_description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

5029420.title: SRD: Slightly Random Dungeons
5029420.short_description: A tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) simulator. Gather a company of quarrelsome mercenaries and set forth through the adventures of the Guilds and Gutters Campaign setting, or use the intuitive adventure building tools to craft your own campaign to challenge your friends or unleash upon the world.

5029830.title: Survival Fund Manager
5029830.short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

5029900.title: Knock Twice
5029900.short_description: Queens, 1974. Something in Garland Court knocks twice, and it can only come in if you answer. It wears your neighbours' voices. Check the peephole, count the shadows, keep the chain on. Five apartments, three years of the building's past, thirty-two endings.

5030310.title: Scrivo: The World Maker
5030310.short_description: Scrivo is a tiny guy made of crumpled paper, in a cozy game, exploring the scraps of a world that vanished long ago. Use a magnet to collect scraps and create hex tiles, then snap them together to build your own floating island. Complete quests, discover forgotten relics as your little world grows.

5030410.title: Fluffy Alchemist
5030410.short_description: A cozy exploration game about a red panda alchemist. Explore five islands where night never falls, gather ingredients that each behave differently, brew potions and fill your Book of Brews. No timers, no enemies, nothing is ever lost when you fail.

5030470.title: Red Ball 4
5030470.short_description: The legendary physics platformer with more than 350 million downloads comes to Steam! Roll, jump and bounce through 75 levels packed with traps, puzzles and boss battles — and unlock 80 Steam Achievements along the way.

5030550.title: Denpa Virus
5030550.short_description: A "Dark x Engineering" visual novel. A story of brain-docking with four girls infected by "Denpa Virus".

5030590.title: Worldline Simulator
5030590.short_description: Turn-based strategy meets visual novel. Play it, or build your own world: generate a map, add factions, officers, events and story, then test-play. Includes "Prefecture Wars," where Japan's 47 prefectures fight for control. The demo is Japanese only; English is planned for the full release.

5030870.title: Card Collector Battle
5030870.short_description: A 2D turn-based auto-battler about collecting gods. Summon 432 guardians from Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Egyptian, Norse and Greek mythology, then fuse duplicates into the copies you own to raise their borders from silver to celestial. Your deck decides the fight.

5030960.title: PAWN SHIFT
5030960.short_description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

5031080.title: Diaper Wars
5031080.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unruly babies battle, compete, and unleash mayhem with ridiculous weapons, explosive combat, and wild obstacle courses.

5031150.title: HelloLove2:Binary
5031150.short_description: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

5031320.title: SCREW IT
5031320.short_description: Co-op space mercenary simulator. Take on high-risk contracts, upgrade your gear, and turn a profit.

5031430.title: I Buried Steve
5031430.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

5031500.title: Shrine Full of Anomalies
5031500.short_description: Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame in this Touhou Project fangame. Search four locations for anomalies, turn back if something is wrong, and escape by choosing the correct action.

5032100.title: Open Headcount: A Corporate-Hell Roguelike
5032100.short_description: A corporate-hell roguelike auto-battler. Hire a disposable worker, build game-breaking combos out of office junk, and send them up the corporate ladder through the circles of Limbo Corp. When they burn out, open a new headcount. The only way out is up.

5032230.title: Life Containment Unit
5032230.short_description: Life Containment Unit is a time and resource management survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Struggle to survive against the creatures invading your L.C.U. and the rogue corporate AI that designed this accursed vault system.

5032320.title: Phosphor Command
5032320.short_description: You command a forward operating base in a world ravaged by war and shadow contracts. Deploy squads into real-time tactical combat, research upgrades, manage a fragile economy, and push back a front that never stops advancing.

5032360.title: Dronerush
5032360.short_description: Dronerush is an idle, incremental strategy game about discovering drone synergies and mining ore.

5032520.title: Masc, Mask & Masked
5032520.short_description: Masc, Mask & Masked is a game that combines mini-games with a visual novel in a terrifyingly cute 2D style. Search through your mobile, chat to your potential dates and recover the powerful mask of Niarlatoted.

5032610.title: We Become Legion
5032610.short_description: A strategic incremental auto-battler where you grow an army, collect equipment to create powerful builds, and command battles with active abilities. Recruit diverse units, unlock permanent upgrades, and push through increasingly dangerous waves.

5032690.title: Ground Drone Operator: UGV Simulator
5032690.short_description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

5032860.title: Myriad
5032860.short_description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Every other round, enter a shop and strengthen your build. Gaze the stars in the night sky and score incredibly powerful line clears or just plain destroy the board as you see fit. Watch out for the constellations though...

5032880.title: Breathtoll
5032880.short_description: Your breath keeps you human. Explore a prison tower in first person, face threats in its corridors, and fight through turn-based card battles. Manage your equipment and dwindling breath in this single-player horror RPG.

5033080.title: Drag and Conquer
5033080.short_description: A fast-paced, easy-to-learn grand strategy game. Drag your orders across the map and conquer enemy territory. Manage your economy to keep your armies supplied with troops and equipment. Play historical 20th-century scenarios or create your own in an advanced editor.

5033170.title: Pencil Pursuit
5033170.short_description: Outrun the eraser. A hand-drawn runner across 26 notebook pages: flee five stationery villains, topple the WAR MACHINE they bolt together, then turn the chase around in PENCIL REVENGE and claim the page in REDRAW.

5033400.title: Victory Rooms
5033400.short_description: Victory Rooms is a free-for-all party game for 2 to 8 players. A hangar with 14 rooms. Pick your own challenges, solo or one on one, and build the highest score before time runs out.

5033460.title: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code
5033460.short_description: You don't steer the chicken. You program it. Write real scripts in a fake desktop OS and send your bird into fields that reseed every run, so hardcoded coordinates work exactly once. Upgrades aren't +1% damage: they're if statements, for loops, and the memory to hold a list.

5033570.title: The Nightmare Arena
5033570.short_description: The Ancients have awoken! Face their wrath in The Nightmare Arena, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Journey through the Realms collecting cards and facing endless waves of enemies.

5034140.title: NIGHTSWEEPER
5034140.short_description: NIGHTSWEEPER is a 3D puzzle adventure about recovering ancient artifacts from an abandoned white desert, sweeping the scars from their spells with Minesweeper-inspired puzzles, and selling them.

5034430.title: Arcostate
5034430.short_description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

5034970.title: DISTRAIL
5034970.short_description: [Distrail] features a protagonist who suddenly becomes the 'director' of the final escape vessel project,and This is a visual novel game that tells the story of the 80 days the project takes place.

5035030.title: SUPERCHESS
5035030.short_description: Chess evolved. Burn, freeze, and poison enemies. Build your roster, master the tech tree, and dominate online, or practise your strategies offline against a fierce AI.

5035390.title: Lunar Crypt
5035390.short_description: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

5035410.title: AscendiA
5035410.short_description: For anyone who ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero. You wake in a strange forest, left with only a tower and one word: “Climb.” Ascendia is a pixel action roguelike where the powers you choose awaken as new skills and hidden secrets as Astras. The path you walk becomes your own ending.

5035490.title: Minus Sixty
5035490.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

5035770.title: Evilos
5035770.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

5035780.title: You'll never find it!
5035780.short_description: A cozy hiding game for two set on a sunny Mediterranean island! Hide everyday objects, then watch your friend search for them and laugh as they walk right past.

5035880.title: QuizForge
5035880.short_description: Create quizzes with images, audio and videos. Play solo, together on one PC or online via Steam. Connect smartphones over your local network, and discover or share quiz packs on Steam Workshop.

5035940.title: Barkyard Blitz
5035940.short_description: Herd sheep, steal points, and blast your rivals with weaponized barking! Gain unique abilities, defend your base, survive chaotic events, and play different roles in the ultimate farmyard battle.

5035950.title: Zap Rat
5035950.short_description: Zap Rat is a 3D Multiplayer Game, where you and your friends must survive against hordes of aliens.

5036280.title: Tandem Together
5036280.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

5036290.title: Fallen Hunter Ashen Crown
5036290.short_description: A challenging Action RPG where you hunt the Fallen across a world ravaged by corruption. Master fast-paced combat and overcome powerful enemies.

5036430.title: Coding War
5036430.short_description: Program a combat robot and send it to battle against other robots.

5036760.title: Project Turbo Combat
5036760.short_description: Project Turbo Combat is an explosive vehicular combat racer with singleplayer and multiplayer modes. Blast through a vivid open world in muscle cars, sports sedans and EVs, firing homing missiles, dropping oil slicks, and grabbing power-ups to wreck rivals and take the lead. Free demo available now.

5037190.title: Rise Immortal
5037190.short_description: A xianxia deckbuilding roguelite where every card grows with you. Temper techniques through Essence, choose from five cultivation paths, and battle through four realms and their Tribulation bosses on the rise to immortality.

5037310.title: Buzzoria
5037310.short_description: A cozy excavation and colony-building game about bees, buried relics, and the mysterious Watcher. Dig through the remains of a vanished civilization, recover valuable finds, grow your colony, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.

5037350.title: Kawaii Evolution Clicker: Desktop Edition
5037350.short_description: Ultimate anime idle game! Click, collect, and merge adorable anime girls to unlock completely new evolutions. From classic anime schoolgirls and maids to pure Tsundere and dangerous Yandere — become their Senpai and unlock every beautiful location!

5037360.title: Simora Town: Broke to Boss
5037360.short_description: Build your empire in a living open world where every NPC has a real home and routine! Manage supermarkets, fast-food spots, and furniture stores, buy any property, decorate your dream house, and make friends with every citizen. Can you turn this town into your personal business empire?

5037460.title: A Path Untrodden
5037460.short_description: A dark turn-based RPG in a world consumed by Mushroom Forest. Lead a group of survivors on a sacred journey to the White City, a land of promised salvation. Fight mutants, manage food, develop heroes, and make choices with lasting consequences. How much will you sacrifice to reach the White City?

5037940.title: Linked Wheels
5037940.short_description: Drive a cart through chaotic physics-based obstacle courses, alone or in online co-op. Coordinate both sides, jump, crouch, and survive deadly traps without destroying your friendship.

5038140.title: An Unreasonable Number of Zombies
5038140.short_description: Push your luck in a city overrun by zombies. Every district is a different fight, with its own rules and its own way to lose. The longer a run goes, the more you can earn.... and the worse things get.

5038300.title: DESTRALIX & DESTENYA Sector
5038300.short_description: Destralix & Destenya is set in the year 2088, where humanity has explored and mapped the entire Solar System and expanded into nearby star systems. Earth remains the central hub of civilization, viewed in living 3D globe divided into thousands of tiles showing terrain, cities and advanced facilities

5038440.title: The Gentleman's Rise
5038440.short_description: Descend into a corrupted 1930s asylum in a 2D eldritch action Souls-like. Master scythe combat, dodge, block and parry deadly attacks, recover lost Sanity, replay completed levels, and rise stronger with every descent.

5038470.title: Job Burnout
5038470.short_description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

5038530.title: Ichorian Tales
5038530.short_description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

5038990.title: Pinward
5038990.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

5039000.title: The Kingdom's Merchant
5039000.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

5039070.title: Jester's Dungeon
5039070.short_description: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Relic from a wicked Jester. Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon.

5039570.title: Quantum Gomoku
5039570.short_description: A stone's color isn't decided until you "observe" it—a competitive five-in-a-row puzzle in flux. Black or white is drawn the instant you observe, and knowing when to spend your limited observations decides the match. A fresh take on strategy where luck meets mind games.

5039930.title: Duelike
5039930.short_description: Duelike is a poker roguelike where you play cards across three zones, build poker hands, and use card abilities to bend the rules. Win 2 of 3 zones, upgrade your deck between battles, and later test your build in online PvP.

5040130.title: Sluggernauts
5040130.short_description: Arcade roguelike baseball. Lead the Hickory Creek Squirrels, a small town minor league team and Earth's last hope. Take a randomized road trip and upgrade your team with powerful gear combinations. Hit, pitch, and field to beat otherworldly teams with unfair advantages.

5040280.title: Orbion Online
5040280.short_description: Orbion Online is a real-time multiplayer space action game where you start as a tiny stone and grow by absorbing asteroids, planets, and rival pilots. Explore a shared cosmos of stars, wormholes, and galaxies and climb from pebble to powerhouse.

5040390.title: GemSlasher
5040390.short_description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

5040520.title: memory cafe
5040520.short_description: A cosy woodland café where you understand every customer. Brew, garden and decorate — but the real work is noticing what each animal isn't saying. Serve thirty regulars, earn their trust, and fill a storybook with the stories they've never told anyone.

5040580.title: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-
5040580.short_description: 懐かしくて温かくてちょっぴり切ない…… 少年少女たちによる、ひと夏のジュブナイルRPG！

5040640.title: Next Level: Tower Defense
5040640.short_description: Race-based tower defense. Build your army, defend your king, and send waves at your rivals. Up to 8-player FFA, 2v2 & 4v4 teams, and singleplayer. Crossplay on Windows, Linux, macOS & Steam Deck.

5040850.title: Stay in Your Lane
5040850.short_description: Watch the enemy. Plan your waves. Push through. A side-scrolling strategy game where your Gym Rats, Holy Cows and High Horses march and fight on their own while you run the economy, tech tree, upgrades and spells. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, custom battles and online 1v1 and 2v2.

5040880.title: 4Way: Driving
5040880.short_description: A challenging arcade racing game with the goal of setting high scores.

5040900.title: Dungeon Overtime
5040900.short_description: Run the cleanup shift after fantasy heroes trash your dungeon. Assign slimes, skeletons, and mimics, turn manual cleanup into automation, and keep the next raid ready—all from a compact desktop window.

5041210.title: Tile & Error
5041210.short_description: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

5041330.title: Groundwork
5041330.short_description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

5042020.title: War Wolves
5042020.short_description: An online ranked third-person arena shooter where you pilot an armored robotic wolf. Compete in modes like Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag, control map power weapons, grab combat pickups, and outmaneuver rivals with fluid sprinting, sliding, clambering, jumping, and rolling.

5042250.title: GyroMon: The Seekers
5042250.short_description: GyroMon: The Seekers is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG with a roguelite heart. Pick your starter, build your team, and push through branching maps full of trainers, events, quests, campfires, merchants, and zone bosses. Every run is different. Every team is yours.

5042270.title: SUSHI PARADE
5042270.short_description: Open a conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop!? Collect over 100 kinds of sushi rolling down lanes you can shape any way you like, and complete your Sushi Dex!

5042290.title: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child
5042290.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

5042540.title: Absolute Sumo: Chonk Arena
5042540.short_description: A silly online party game where you play a chubby meme animal in a tiny sumo belt and shove everyone else out of the ring. Win rounds to grow from a cute little wobbler into a giant slab of muscle, dodge shifting arenas, and fight over who gets to push who.

5042550.title: Waifu Bubble
5042550.short_description: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

5042610.title: GYRE Grazeline
5042610.short_description: A neon endless tube-runner where flying close pays. Pilot a ship down an accelerating luminous tunnel, threading gaps that arrive faster the longer you last. Distance builds your score, near misses add to it. Skim the edges, hold your nerve, and beat your own best line.

5042640.title: Butt Brawl: Survival
5042640.short_description: Butt Brawl: Survival is a high-energy bullet-heaven where uniquely powerful butt heroes battle endless hordes of toilet-themed enemies. Play solo or local co-op, insane upgrade combinations, defeat massive bosses, unlock permanent abilities, and chase glory across increasingly brutal difficulties.

5042880.title: Shrimp Method
5042880.short_description: Shrimp Method is a deliciously addictive shrimp-themed incremental game, where you can watch your shrimp slosh around into full grown crustaceans, vacuumed up by Shrimp Co.'s industrial vacuum network and turned into sweet sweet money!

5042890.title: RuneEra
5042890.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

5043080.title: Deep Digger
5043080.short_description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

5043370.title: Konbini Shift
5043370.short_description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

5043380.title: Warlords of Archaios Online
5043380.short_description: Command the Kingdoms, Orcs, Undead, or Elves in a fantasy RTS with pixel art. Build your base, equip your warlords, and conquer camps. Battle alone or online across randomly generated maps with changing weather, day and night, and natural disasters.

5044050.title: ONSIGHT
5044050.short_description: ONSIGHT is a fast-paced, top-down multiplayer shooter with intense Deathmatch and Survival modes. Grab weapons, upgrade your abilities and unleash chaos against players or bots. With limited vision, obstructed sightlines and directional sound, every encounter is unpredictable.

5044080.title: Scary Land: The Potion Goes Wrong
5044080.short_description: Grandpa’s potion went horribly wrong, animals act like humans, and humans became animals. Explore the cursed island, gather ingredients for a cure, and bring Bonky, a skeleton who thinks you’re his dad.

5044460.title: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords
5044460.short_description: Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords, then recruit them! Command epic turn-based battles to defend the land from oppression. When pirates invade the small kingdom of Forestgrove they awaken military leaders who rise against cruelty and subjugation.

5044520.title: Sea Beast Odyssey
5044520.short_description: An incremental action adventure across the seas. Lead 5 Heroes into battle, upgrade your team and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your Skill Tree across 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts!

5044750.title: Mole & Ore
5044750.short_description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

5044760.title: SALT SWEEPER
5044760.short_description: SALT SWEEPER is a roguelite twist on minesweeper. Sweep corrupted desert mines, fight enemies in turn-based combat, and grow more powerful with weapons and spells you find along the way.

5044940.title: Aqua Factory Simulator
5044940.short_description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

5045000.title: Precinct 2099
5045000.short_description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

5045040.title: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG
5045040.short_description: The world’s smallest idle monster-collecting RPG. Hatch special monsters from eggs and trade with players around the world. Battles play out automatically, so don’t stop until you’ve built the strongest squad!

5045220.title: CivDle
5045220.short_description: A relaxing idle city-builder where a single hut grows into a sprawl of millions. Build production chains, let your civilisation expand while you're away, and Ascend to push the whole world up an order of magnitude.

5045620.title: SUSHI CHESS
5045620.short_description: Capture your rival’s sushi and you pay the bill. Manage your money and decide which pieces to take—or tempt them to take—in this topsy-turvy turn-based board game. Enjoy a feature-packed Puzzle Mode, three CPU difficulty levels, and one-on-one local or online matches with friends.

5045720.title: ODYSSEY: Wine-Dark Sea
5045720.short_description: Troy has fallen. Home is an angry sea away. Lead a crew of named men through the myths of the Odyssey — ration food, bargain with gods, decide who lives. In the myth he came home alone. Can you do better? A story-rich roguelite where every voyage ends in an epic Song about your choices.

5045890.title: 飞鸟的日记
5045890.short_description: "theDIARY" is a post-apocalyptic supernatural AVG with multiple endings. Play as Raven, navigate choices and stats, and uncover the dark truth behind humanity's angels to find the source of the tragedy.

5046130.title: Bento Express
5046130.short_description: Run a tiny bento kiosk on a countryside train platform, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Cook to order, ring up commuters and count their change before the doors close. Talk over proximity voice, dress your own stall keeper and make rent by closing time.

5046220.title: Forgotten Possessions
5046220.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

5046430.title: My Little Secret
5046430.short_description: It seems your classmate Tia wasn't expecting company and has a secret she's keen on keeping! Collect evidence and confront Tia to reveal what she's been hiding.

5046690.title: INKTRICK
5046690.short_description: INKTRICK is a handcrafted, cozy roguelike card game made of cards, ink and stamps. Win tricks, turn a weak 8 into a trump and unlock new possibilities hand after hand, such as stamp upgrades and mystery packs. Fibus deals, cheers you on and plays against you.

5046740.title: Crest: Climb Together
5046740.short_description: Climb a massive mountain with up to 4 friends in this physics-based co-op adventure. Explore dangerous trails, discover useful gear, and help each other survive unpredictable challenges on the way to the summit.

5046830.title: Count Your Sins
5046830.short_description: A dark yuri visual novel. An accidental death drags several students into a web of secrets from which there is no turning back. Lies, silence, judgment, and incriminating evidence held against one another gradually transform the already complex relationship between Situ Yang and Su Ying.

5046840.title: TowOrbs
5046840.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

5046860.title: HAXMAX
5046860.short_description: Run, fight, and hide! Go as far as you can as HAX, adapting to a changing economy and varied terrain in this unique roguelite autobattler. But hurry - the system's ANTIHAX is hunting you down, appearing when you least expect it and returning stronger each time!

5046870.title: Path of Broken Builds
5046870.short_description: You don't control the hero. You control the skill tree. Grow an endless, procedural passive tree in real time while your hero fights the dungeon alone — every point you spend lands as a hit. Chain keystones and ultimates into a build broken enough to break the game itself.

5046890.title: Mewtations: Dogma
5046890.short_description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

5046970.title: 虞州的罪羊
5046970.short_description: A multi ending narrative AVG.When nightmares and hallucinations alternate,you have to find the only truth among the many possible endings.

5047000.title: Carrot Count Sheep
5047000.short_description: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into The Dream of 100 Sheep in this cozy rpg puzzle adventure. Solve not-too-hard puzzles, meet interesting and unique characters, and uncover the mystery behind nightmares that are appearing across this once cozy dream. Whose dream is this, anyway?

5047060.title: Starwreck Reclaimer
5047060.short_description: Pilot a combat salvager into a shifting starship graveyard in this top-down twin-stick action roguelite. Battle hostile machines, manage ammunition and hull integrity, choose risky protocols, recover valuable scrap, and build powerful weapon and module combinations.

5047340.title: Calcio 98
5047340.short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

5047910.title: Myth: Chenxiang
5047910.short_description: Myth: Chenxiang is a third-person action RPG inspired by Chinese mythology. Play as the son of a mortal and a goddess, defeat powerful foes, deepen your cultivation, and defy the laws of Heaven to rescue your mother and reunite your family.

5047980.title: RiftBlade: WarCards
5047980.short_description: A fantasy card-based tower defense game that blends deckbuilding, base defense, and tactical combat. Build your deck, set heroes, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to repel endless waves of enemies pouring from portals. Plan your moves carefully and protect the core crystal at all costs!

5048000.title: Walk in PENUMBRA
5048000.short_description: An alien who commands the shadows. His goal: to destroy that star hanging in the sky…? Stretch the shadows. Hide in them. Strike from them. A top-down roguelite shooter.

5048250.title: DinoBox
5048250.short_description: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

5049110.title: Snowed In
5049110.short_description: Dig through tons of snow, survive the freezing cold, upgrade your tools, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the avalanche.

5049350.title: DAJI
5049350.short_description: A sweeping, choice-driven narrative RPG. Heaven picked you—a gentle spirit fox named Snow—to don the cursed mantle of Su Daji. Your mandate: seduce King Zhou of Shang and break an empire so the gods may claim their throne. Did you want this? Hard to say. But here you are...

5049520.title: Adventure Reznara
5049520.short_description: Choose your path in a pixel-art text RPG roguelike. Pick a class, travel six regions by road and sea, and settle every encounter with a card choice: fight, flee, or steal the soul of what you meet. Normal or Permadeath.

5049560.title: Alone at  School:Christmas
5049560.short_description: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.

5049770.title: Mythbound
5049770.short_description: Mythbound is a competitive multiplayer PvP arena-brawler in a modern Norse world. Thrust into the arenas of Himinbjorg, Midgard, and Helheim, the bound use a combination of parkour, brutal melee combat, and godly abilities to brawl against one another.

5049870.title: Gudu! Witch & Meltdown
5049870.short_description: Brew, toss, and trigger explosive chain reactions! Gudu! Witch & Meltdown is a chaotic anime-style roguelite where you play as a quirky witch crafting volatile potions. Combine recipe ingredients, build exponential multiplier synergies, and hurl nuclear-level flasks to melt monster HP!

5050200.title: Gold Seller
5050200.short_description: All you have is a game account. Farm gold, sell it for cash in a shady group chat, and keep up with rent, a PC installment and an AI subscription. Get paid first, or send the gold first? One bad call and a day of grinding is gone.

5050590.title: Irish Sport Manager
5050590.short_description: You’re the bainisteoir. The county is yours, and so is the blame. A management sim for Gaelic football, hurling, camogie and ladies’ football: pick your fifteen from the county’s own parishes and answer to a board whose patience runs out.

5050610.title: The Count is Down for Blood
5050610.short_description: The Count is Down for Blood is a gothic grid-based puzzle game where every move brings sunrise closer. Plan each step, drink blood, use vampire powers, and reach your coffin before the night runs out.

5050660.title: The House on Grisewood
5050660.short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival modes.

5051250.title: Sneak & Snitch
5051250.short_description: Sneak & Snitch is a multiplayer social deduction heist. Thieves disguised as museum visitors forge paintings and swap them right under the guard's nose. The guard patrols on a Segway, spotting fakes and suspicious moves. Blend in, bluff your friends, and pull off the perfect art heist.

5051980.title: Roll Arena
5051980.short_description: A brutally hard action-roguelike where physics has it in for you: roll, shoot, bounce and brawl through themed arenas with 250+ items as absurd as they are lethal.

5052200.title: Never Stop Climbing
5052200.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

5052400.title: FoxWQ
5052400.short_description: Play Go against real opponents of every level, 24/7, on FoxWQ, the world’s largest Go server. Find ranked games in seconds, watch top professionals live, review your games with FineArt AI, train with over 13,000 graded problems, and much more.
publishers: Beijing YeHu Century Technology Co., Ltd.

5052630.title: Kazfall
5052630.short_description: Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

5052710.title: lucky me
5052710.short_description: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

5052960.title: The Endless Harvest
5052960.short_description: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?

5053190.title: Warpscape
5053190.short_description: An open-world space MMORPG with no-target combat. You fly the ship and aim yourself, travel between sectors, take on bosses and dungeons with friends, fight in the arena and build your clan's base.

5053270.title: Mithril
5053270.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

5053550.title: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
5053550.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

5054170.title: Derby Dynasty : Horse Racing RPG
5054170.short_description: Start with a foal, build a dynasty. Breed your horses, refine their bloodlines, and take the reins yourself or trust your jockeys. In Derby Dynasty, every victory is part of a story that spans generations.

5054210.title: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
5054210.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

5054850.title: Clicker Inc. - Generational Succession
5054850.short_description: Build a business empire across generations! Click to earn, hire employees for passive income, and use stocks, banks, and auctions to survive booms and crashes. Pass the company to the next CEO, unlock 100+ skills, complete achievements, and grow into a world-changing corporation!

5055150.title: Don't Get Attracted
5055150.short_description: Shoot magnets, not bullets. Magnetise anything - crates, girders, the friend next to you - then watch matching poles blast apart and opposites slam together. An 8-player online party platformer about climbing one enormous tower, right up until somebody decides you'd look better falling off it.

5055820.title: SCP Loop
5055820.short_description: You are an SCP Foundation employee in Site-19. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, only to later realize, that the rooms you are walking through are repeating themselves. Explore SCP-970 and find its anomalies, in order to escape.

5056200.title: Nine Below
5056200.short_description: A twin-stick arena shooter set in an arctic wasteland. Fight through a cult swarm, break the guardians, and kill the leader before the ritual completes. One continuous battle. No second chances.

5056230.title: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader
5056230.short_description: A simulation game where your bunker becomes the safe space survivors need. Trade and craft items - organize them in storage. Scavenge the surface yourself and hire personnel to send on expeditions. Become the ultimate trading hub in this post-apocalyptic world.

5056270.title: Normal Human Jobs
5056270.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

5056300.title: Souls for Relics
5056300.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler where you choose random relics, create powerful synergies, earn souls, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

5056880.title: Fired
5056880.short_description: FIRED is a retro-styled puzzle adventure game centered around the story of a young employee who gets FIRED while trying to expose the evil Orcus Corporation. Explore the world, solve puzzles, and work to take down Orcus.

5056950.title: mythorune
5056950.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

5057390.title: Project Potato Man - Chapter 1
5057390.short_description: Survive the first chapter of a psychological horror adventure. Explore an abandoned town, uncover its dark secrets, and evade the mysterious Potato Man before it finds you.

5057580.title: Idle Caravan
5057580.short_description: A cozy idle adventure you can play in a small desktop window. Ride your giant bison across a magical world, deliver packages, discover creatures, and let your journey continue while you do other things.

5057800.title: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
5057800.short_description: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.

5057880.title: RE:CHAINED ~Links of Redemption~
5057880.short_description: Bill climbed the Abyss Tower for cash. Freeing minds in red chains became a rescue he never meant. A comic SRPG of grid tactics and decks. Eight companions seek resurrection. What will they choose?

5058440.title: Matryoshka
5058440.short_description: Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away. A single mistake will be fatal.

5058560.title: Pixel Ping Pong
5058560.short_description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

5058570.title: Matchday: Player Career
5058570.short_description: Live a footballer's career on and off the pitch. Earn your place, take charge of key moments in matches, build relationships at the club, and see your performances and choices shape the seasons ahead.

5058790.title: Circuit Brakers
5058790.short_description: Circuit Brakers is a kart racing game about robots, physics and a lot of customisation. Build a robot, choose your items, and race with up to 8 players across a variety of bizarre tracks! With mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master, can you become the champion robot racer?

5059190.title: Dungeon Town Life
5059190.short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

5060170.title: Grape by Grape
5060170.short_description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

5060750.title: ISKRA
5060750.short_description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

5060850.title: The Final Witness
5060850.short_description: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

5060930.title: Moltenfall
5060930.short_description: Moltenfall is a fast-paced survival roguelite set in a world where every pixel is simulated. Fight increasingly dangerous swarms of enemies, collect experience and grow stronger with every upgrade. Watch your step as collapsing terrain, acid, lava and other materials reshape the world around you.

5061290.title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
5061290.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

5061840.title: Trade or Threat
5061840.short_description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

5061860.title: Casino Dealer Simulator
5061860.short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

5061870.title: Last Man Running
5061870.short_description: Outrun the zombies. Betray your friends. A chaotic parkour party game across deadly rooftops. Tackle, grab and toss your rivals in free-for-all or team elimination, or stick together in co-op survival. Play locally or online, with solo score chasing when your friends stop answering your invites.

5062110.title: Ballwark: Pinball Siege
5062110.short_description: Pinball meets Vampire Survivors in this dopamine-packed arcade roguelite! Launch enchanted balls, build deadly machines, and forge powerful synergies to crush relentless hordes.

5062120.title: Formula First Manager
5062120.short_description: Take on the role of a Team Principal and build your career in a living paddock. Recruit, develop your car, negotiate, manage your team and face the consequences of your decisions across multiple seasons.

5062150.title: Cosmic Crusaders Online
5062150.short_description: Land on a planet with nothing and learn to survive, from 0 to space travel. Mine it, build a base, weld a ship, fly it to the next world. A multiplayer survival sandbox where every bullet and armor plate is player-made, factions war over the system, and the world runs while you're gone.

5062370.title: Never Wood Enough
5062370.short_description: You've been hired to chop trees, and Bob the beaver has plenty of requests and very little patience. Chop trees, gather wood, and fulfill his orders before time runs out. The tasks start simple, but soon Bob will be asking for increasingly absurd things. Don't disappoint him!

5062420.title: Iris's Idle Log
5062420.short_description: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

5062630.title: Roll Value
5062630.short_description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

5062970.title: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
5062970.short_description: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Earn mountains of medals—and keep paying off your debt! A short pachinko incremental with a skill tree that keeps giving you new ways to earn!

5063190.title: TOWERPUNK
5063190.short_description: Build and manage a cyberpunk megatower. You are the tower's machine-mind, stacking thousands of residents into one dynamic system.
