Balance resources, transit, and production chains across five social strata. Define your corporate identity and decide what kind of intelligence rules from the top.

5063370.title: I Launch
5063370.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

5063650.title: ClusterForce
5063650.short_description: ClusterForce is a fast arcade 3D flying sports game for up to 8 players online, a unique combination that demands many of your skills at once. Carry energy balls from magnetic ramps to the goal without getting caught by your rivals and their glider weapons!

5065230.title: Hardware Pirates
5065230.short_description: Your PC was a pirate ship all along. Turn monitors into Digital Sails, RAM into ramming power and USB ports into gunports. Explore the Corrupted Caribbean, upgrade your ship and master ballistic naval combat. Sail solo or join friends in online co-op and PvP.

5065610.title: Echoes of Eternity 2
5065610.short_description: A difficult isometric bullet-hell continuing the story of Ott, a bot with a recycled consciousness.

5065840.title: Cosmic Karma
5065840.short_description: Cosmic Karma is a cosmic roguelike card battler. Chain playing-card combos to build Flow, adapt to Karmic Laws, and risk tougher battles for XP to shape powerful Tarot and Combat Special builds.

5066090.title: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
5066090.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Relax and enjoy cleaning up dusty shards, as you match their shapes and colors, and rebuild six beautiful windows in a ruined mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and take as long as you want, with no deadlines and no way to lose.

5066240.title: NO FISHING!
5066240.short_description: An incremental autobattler about fishing where you're not allowed to fish. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and destroy the navy before they take you down.

5066430.title: Sun Smith
5066430.short_description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

5066440.title: The Moth and the Moon
5066440.short_description: The Moth and the Moon is a rhythm platformer where each precise jump advances Clair de Lune. Guide a tiny moth across a forest lake, combining platforming skill with musical timing to complete the performance. You may even make new a friend along the way...

5066840.title: Hack You
5066840.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

5067020.title: Idle Mage: Conquest
5067020.short_description: An idle incremental RPG where a mage battles through escalating waves across multiple zones. Master five elemental spell schools, defeat bosses, craft gear, and Ascend for permanent power. Optimize your build, watch the carnage unfold, and keep conquering while you're away

5067810.title: FrogPop
5067810.short_description: Pop bubbles with your tongue and dodge what they split into. Eat Power Bugs, combine relics, and face strange bosses in a pixel-art arcade roguelite. Try the free Windows demo: 10 waves, 2 bosses. Can you clear the pond?

5068000.title: Rogue Space Convoy
5068000.short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

5068050.title: Ruins of Aloryith
5068050.short_description: Ruins of Aloryith is a third-person action roguelite. Fight through escalating waves with sword and shield, unleash player-controlled abilities, and shape your build with upgrades. Face corrupted bosses and uncover the source of the corruption.

5068190.title: DEATHMATE
5068190.short_description: DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the depths of the Underworld.

5068610.title: Grumpy Dungeon
5068610.short_description: The dungeon is dying. It would rather die than say thank you. Fight through its halls with wisps living in your weapons and fighting at your side. Rescue every last spirit, grow them, evolve them, regrow its garden. It remembers everything. Collect all the wisps.

5068870.title: America Survival
5068870.short_description: You are the last Native Americans, the masters of the ancient land of the Americas, hunting, building homes, fighting off invaders, and surviving.

5068890.title: 从前有座山
5068890.short_description: 一座小小的浮空仙山，您可以种田，种花，养殖，钓鱼，养鱼，捉虫，养蜂，酿蜜，修行，可以全屏游玩，也可以位于屏幕底部的休闲种田挂机模拟游戏，不会影响您的正常工作。

5068970.title: NEXT OBJECTIVE
5068970.short_description: The objective marker IS the monster. Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

5069260.title: Muscle Kingdom
5069260.short_description: Grow it. Train it. Show it off. Raise mysterious creatures called "Macho" and dominate posing battles in this fresh bodybuilding brawler. Your battle cry decides the winner. Become the ultimate trainer!

5069270.title: Otherworldly Business
5069270.short_description: An action RPG set in an anime-styled otherworld. Play an adventurer who crossed over from the real world and take contracts to hunt goblins. World travel unlocks mid-to-late game, opening the West, the post-apocalypse, elven territory and more.

5069320.title: Portrise Idle
5069320.short_description: Build a quiet fishing harbor in an atmospheric idle strategy game. Send your fleet to sea, sell the catch, expand warehouses and buildings, collect captain and ship cards, and sail from a peaceful bay toward dangerous depths.

5069510.title: The Offering
5069510.short_description: The Offering is an incremental game where you grab creatures to collect offerings, buy upgrades and defend your shrine at night. Stack boons, forge weapons, catch goblins and ascend through worlds!

5069580.title: Spray to Grail
5069580.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

5069620.title: 四季餐厅
5069620.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

5069810.title: Ministrelli's Cardboard Circus
5069810.short_description: You are the new light board operator and it's your job to let the artists shine. Aim lights, control soundboards, blast smoke and shoot confetti! All at the right timings. Can you juggle all the tasks? Keep an eye out for director Ministrelli's countdowns and you'll be sure to have great success.

5069840.title: Desktop Plinko
5069840.short_description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

5069950.title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
5069950.short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

5070070.title: waga-mom
5070070.short_description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

5070170.title: Per My Last Email
5070170.short_description: You are the new hire. The account you inherited is not new — it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. Ten business days of email in which you choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

5070270.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
5070270.short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

5070740.title: Main Street Operator
5070740.short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

5070770.title: An-pêng: Still Here
5070770.short_description: After China's air raids, everyone in Anping was evacuated. You stayed. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

5070780.title: Town Hall
5070780.short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

5070980.title: Who?
5070980.short_description: Who? is a game of deduction and chaos among friends. Each player uploads any photo from their computer, which is assigned to another participant. Everyone can see the others’ images, but not their own, and asks questions that can only be answered with “yes” or “no” to discover who—or what—they are.

5071320.title: Scroll Control
5071320.short_description: Read the rune, check the papers, then approve, reject or confiscate each spell scroll. Don’t lose control as the cases pile up and the rules change.

5071610.title: Flowline
5071610.short_description: Don't build more — make it flow. An idle factory game where one station always limits your line. Find it, feed it, and watch the bottleneck jump somewhere new. Secretly a real manufacturing simulation — with none of the math in your face.

5071780.title: Click Bait
5071780.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

5071850.title: Tavern Game Night
5071850.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

5071860.title: Cozy Plates
5071860.short_description: Decorate your own elegant plates using a variety of delicious ingredients, from sushi to sweet desserts. Arrange every detail with easy controls, set the cozy atmosphere, and create the perfect presentation. Relax, learn at your own pace, and get into the flow.

5072220.title: HolEvade
5072220.short_description: HolEvade is a challenging, physics-based 3D platformer where precision is everything. Tilt and control the platforms high above the clouds to guide your ball, navigate tight paths, and test your reflexes in a vibrant, stylized world!

5072330.title: Cricket Manager 27
5072330.short_description: A deep cricket management simulation where you take charge of a club or national side, build squads, set tactics, handle transfers and board pressure, and chase glory across Test, ODI, and T20 seasons and major ICC events.

5072600.title: Family Time
5072600.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

5072670.title: Pigeonhole Principle
5072670.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

5073030.title: BEACON 09
5073030.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

5073430.title: Worm Capitalist
5073430.short_description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

5073470.title: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental
5073470.short_description: A synthwave neon space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack Power Ups at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

5073630.title: Backrooms: Misstep
5073630.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

5073760.title: Horse Race
5073760.short_description: Start your journey in amateur races and climb your way to the top. Win races for prizes, open horse card packs, build your stable, manage your horses, and discover the perfect horse for every race. Rise through the ranks and become the ultimate champion. Do you have what it takes?

5073780.title: Monster Showdown
5073780.short_description: Survive escalating waves of monsters in a fast-paced first-person horde shooter. Earn cash, build your arsenal, upgrade your weapons, grab powerful Perk Donuts, repair defenses, defeat bosses, and unlock wild modifiers that change the way you play.

5073790.title: New Babylon
5073790.short_description: A massively multiplayer voxel sandbox set in a true-scale, procedurally generated solar system. One persistent shared universe, no levels or tech-tree gates — build, mine, craft, and survive on a Darwinian frontier where every planet and moon exists at real 1:1 scale.

5073880.title: Interpolate
5073880.short_description: A Dark day follows every night. Nothing will stop the world's cycle; it's your choice to change the outcome. Some days are easier than the last, but the strong face the challenge.

5073940.title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
5073940.short_description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

5074410.title: MURABO
5074410.short_description: SOLITAIRE + ROGUELIKE + 90s LATE NIGHT FEVER DREAMS = MURABO

5074640.title: Corporate Slave
5074640.short_description: A satirical side-scrolling office RPG. Walk the open floor plan, survive standups, reviews and layoffs, dodge the AI quietly absorbing your tickets, sneak job interviews on company time, and grind toward the only real win condition: enough money to never come back.

5074820.title: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
5074820.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

5075560.title: Crease
5075560.short_description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

5075960.title: AI TYCOON
5075960.short_description: Found your AI company in the wildest gold rush of the century. Source quality training data, race to new architectures, and turn research into revenue. Balance burn rate against breakthroughs, outmaneuver rivals, and build a tech empire. A deep management sim.

5076270.title: YinShu
5076270.short_description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

5076320.title: Carpet Daddy
5076320.short_description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

5076490.title: Whodunit Sudoku
5076490.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

5076520.title: StrongGirls Tactics
5076520.short_description: Turn-based tactics RPG where your girls grow muscles as they get stronger. Recruit 18 girls, each with their personal stories and struggles. As your bonds deepen, they grow stronger and more muscular. Wrapped in a Norse themed world where you fight to reclaim the kingdom.

5077430.title: Dead Man's Clock
5077430.short_description: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.

5077470.title: Gate Logic
5077470.short_description: Gate Logic lets you build any logic circuit made up from the Boolean logic gates NOT, AND, OR, NOR, XOR and XNOR on an infinite, grid based canvas.

5077520.title: The Turbo Crown
5077520.short_description: Drive cannon-equipped toy cars, jump across giant furniture, and fly with nitro in arcade battles for up to 10 players. Fight online or against bots, master four game modes, and customize every piece with no pay-to-win advantages.

5077900.title: Earth Tourist
5077900.short_description: Find yourself in an endless open world and journey from the Stone Age to quantum immortality. Advance technologies, build cities and rockets, manage a dynasty, and conquer space in a massive Sci-Fi sandbox with total freedom of action!

5078140.title: 16 Bit Gold
5078140.short_description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

5078250.title: Treehouse
5078250.short_description: An aesthetically pleasing treehouse toy. Build up and out, and the branches support your structures. Connect rooms with ladders and walkways, or carve footpaths through the grassy glen to interactable ponds. Create the ambient orchestral soundtrack with your treehouse, and set the perfect lighting.

5078290.title: GO, my pretties!
5078290.short_description: Go My Pretties is a game about commanding a small army of cute robots. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons to collect resources, craft upgrades and get stronger.

5078340.title: HEARTHWATCH
5078340.short_description: HEARTHWATCH is a roguelite tower defense where the map tears open mid-battle. Guard your village's last fire across a branching Stone Age campaign: build elemental towers, bond them into hybrids, draw cards from your run's deck, and hold the new lane when the ground splits.

5078530.title: Taskbar Garden
5078530.short_description: Grow a living procedural garden along your desktop while you work or relax. Harvest plants for profit, breed plants, fuse genetic seeds, and discover rare mutations as every seed grows into a completely unique plant.

5078640.title: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK
5078640.short_description: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK delivers big battles experiences. The battles will face teams composed of Humans and BOTs one against other on battlefields filled with troops, monsters, vehicles and immersive landscape elements.

5078840.title: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
5078840.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

5078860.title: Text Shelter
5078860.short_description: Text Shelter​ is a text-based post-apocalyptic idle game. Construct your shelter, plan production lines, and balance power and resources. Venture into the No-Man's Land, upgrade survivor stats, and invest in doomsday industries for greater profits. Expand your camp into a true Ark of the End Times.

5079360.title: Under a Turning Sky
5079360.short_description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

5079460.title: Did a Monkey Write This?
5079460.short_description: A cozy incremental management game. You're a failed author with a troop of cute monkey writers. Level up and build, play the publishing slot machine, race around plot holes and ski the slopes of ever-changing trends.

5079520.title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
5079520.short_description: A free creature card battler and roguelike deckbuilder with the dice printed on the cards. Draft real North American animals and a few cryptids, take THE ROAD alone or with the House at your side, or fight live 1v1 while the booth calls every roll.

5079560.title: Bullet Reign
5079560.short_description: Bullet Reign is a roguelike action shooter in a wasteland. Fight endless mutant waves as an armed survivor, choosing classes, weapons, and items to craft unique builds. Every run offers new progression choices—blast through the swarm and be the last one standing.

5079600.title: Tombslayers
5079600.short_description: Carve through undead hordes in dark tombs. Clear waves, rebuild in the shop, and snowball into broken loadouts. A fast, dark roguelike survivor.

5079730.title: Long Watch
5079730.short_description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

5079880.title: HASSO
5079880.short_description: A single-player samurai card game where you don't collect cards, you learn techniques. Each turn you build a chain of blades and decide when to stop; between duels you choose what you learn, which paths you prove and which katana you forge, until the style is yours.

5080060.title: Africa Survival
5080060.short_description: As an explorer, you travel to Africa, hunt in the savanna, Avoid attacks from various ferocious beasts, gather resources, build shelter, and survive.

5080210.title: The Eggsortist
5080210.short_description: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

5080480.title: Store Tycoon Simulator
5080480.short_description: Build and manage your own supermarket in Store Tycoon. Order products, stock shelves, hire and schedule staff, manage deliveries and expenses, and keep customers happy. Track sales, level up, unlock new products, and turn your small shop into a successful retail business.

5080560.title: Rocket
5080560.short_description: Rocket is a rage-inducing 2.5D precision game where you control a rocket, dodge obstacles and try to make it to the end without losing your mind. Oh, did I forget to mention that you have to do it all in one run?

5080570.title: Cecilia
5080570.short_description: Cecilia is a Zelda-like action-adventure with Game Boy Color–inspired pixel art. As a royal guard, venture through puzzle-filled dungeons, find items that open new paths, and face challenging bosses to bring the kidnapped Prince Erick home.

5080630.title: Burnout Bistro
5080630.short_description: Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. How long can you keep everything together?

5080940.title: House Craft Voyage
5080940.short_description: In House Craft Voyage, spawn blocks and devices, snap-weld and paint them into vehicles and contraptions, then explore with physics—or build your own space for fun. A single-player adventure sandbox of building, physics, and puzzles. Create, then set out.

5081000.title: 9号台球馆：心动搭档
5081000.short_description: No. 9 Pool Hall blends playable eight-ball, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches. Practice aiming and position play, meet distinctive partners, and survive nine strange nights. AI assisted art, audio, writing, code, and testing; no AI runs during play or sends player data.

5081350.title: Mapborn
5081350.short_description: Your map is the world. Mapborn is a real-time grand strategy sandbox played directly on your original artwork. Add cities and nations, choose one to rule, and shape its history through war, diplomacy, politics, and rebellion.

5081800.title: Flash The Floppy Fish
5081800.short_description: Master the art of fast flopping and exploit deep fish physics as you speed through handcrafted environments and rank up to beat your and your friends' times. Can you claim the title of "Flash the Floppy Fish"? Or are you just another stale sardine?

5082020.title: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes
5082020.short_description: Midnight Reading is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school. As a library committee member, search for overdue books. Read, return, and make choices as the story branches into three routes and a True Route.

5082410.title: Mining Mike
5082410.short_description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.

5082570.title: TowerCard: Digital Edition
5082570.short_description: Gather resources, raise your tower across five stages, and follow Thomas on his journey through five worlds full of unforgettable characters. Play the story mode or quick matches against the AI – multiplayer arrives soon in Arcade Mode.

5082580.title: Keycap Keycap!
5082580.short_description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

5082960.title: Kito: Lost Trail
5082960.short_description: Kito: Lost Trail is a cozy 3D platforming adventure where you play as Kito, a young leopard searching for his missing mother. Explore wild environments, overcome platforming challenges, discover hidden collectibles, and grow your abilities along the way.

5083130.title: Siege of Incrementalia
5083130.short_description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

5083230.title: YellowJacket
5083230.short_description: This is a 2D platformer adventure game set in a world that has lost its color, where you retrieve scattered jackets to color the world again. Discover the rules of color and begin your journey to restore the lost colors.

5083370.title: Whisker Tinkers
5083370.short_description: Dig through boxes filled with junk, organize them in your warehouse and fulfill client orders by crafting their desired items from your gathered materials. Protect your shiny treasures from sneaky raccoons and prepare your store for inspections. Don't forget to hide what you don't want to be seen...

5083560.title: Coindrop Dungeon
5083560.short_description: Coindrop Dungeon is a Pachinko inspired dungeon crawler. Your coins and pegs from the board are your inventory. Explore builds, create synergies and break the curse that keeps you in the ever changing dungeon.

5083740.title: Griefborn
5083740.short_description: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!

5083870.title: Solarise
5083870.short_description: A short and sweet game that aims to be a love letter to solar panel production and the crisis of the modern century for Europe as it grapples with reindustrialisation. Manage your factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people, in order to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals.

5084490.title: K-God Robot Hunters
5084490.short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

5084740.title: Hendichen
5084740.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

5084860.title: Time Traveler: Divergence
5084860.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

5085050.title: Calibration Sequence
5085050.short_description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

5085180.title: Blind Gavel
5085180.short_description: The auctioneer is lying, and he has secret partners hiding among the bidders. Blind Gavel is a 4 to 8 player social deduction party game: bid on items you cannot value, find the partners, and send the accused into a deadly minigame

5085300.title: The City Knows
5085300.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

5085390.title: BLACKROT
5085390.short_description: BLACKROT is a fast-paced top-down action game of brutal dashes, parried bullets and random generated levels. Time only runs when you move. Dash through enemies, keep your combo going and paint the walls red.

5085460.title: Anthill Wars: Ant Colony Sim
5085460.short_description: Grow an ant colony from a single queen into a thriving empire. Raid rival anthills, steal their brood, and strengthen your colony with captured ants. Defend your territory from giant insects and expand your nest. When the time comes, release a swarm of winged queens and begin again in distant lands.

5085730.title: Innkeeping
5085730.short_description: A cozy medieval inn-management sim. Build your inn, brew your ale, set your prices, and take care of your guests. Grow your reputation and business while balancing happy patrons and rising costs to turn a quiet roadside stop into a legendary landmark.

5085900.title: Pupmancer
5085900.short_description: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.

5086200.title: Water & Healing
5086200.short_description: An immersive 3D art experience exploring water, nature and healing. Wander through atmospheric virtual worlds, discover watercolor artworks, meet characters and complete gentle quests while experiencing stories of peace, connection and renewal.

5086320.title: Genome Fracture
5086320.short_description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where reality fractures every 2 minutes. Evolve powerful mutation families, unleash devastating synergies, and create game-breaking builds as the battlefield transforms around you. Can you survive the Convergence?

5086350.title: 罐头成长计划
5086350.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

5086570.title: Forgotten Grounds
5086570.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

5086750.title: Item TD
5086750.short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

5086870.title: meowtopia
5086870.short_description: See the world through a cat’s eyes and explore your home! From sunny balconies to cozy bedrooms, unlock new rooms, collect items, and solve light puzzles. Play mini-games and grow daily to turn this cozy house into a true "Meowtopia." Pure immersion and heartwarming companionship await.

5086950.title: Hotel Carnivalia
5086950.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

5086980.title: Rich PaPa
5086980.short_description: Rich PaPa - Short Description Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

5087090.title: Elixir of Immortality
5087090.short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

5087400.title: Colony on the Run
5087400.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

5087650.title: Bunny Bring Bits
5087650.short_description: You are a grumpy rabbit restoring the game world. Clean up rubbish, wipe away dirt with a rag, recycle junk into elements of the world, and activate mechanisms. And after the heroes' fight with the boss, don't forget to clean up the unlucky heroes.

5087710.title: Starhold: Last Light
5087710.short_description: <Tower Defense × Roguelike> — Resist the Endless Swarm from the Stars Build along the surface of spherical planets, where every angle matters. Expand into space for more building grounds, but risk unknown disasters. Choose 1 of 3 cards, build your deck, and adapt your strategy with every choice.

5087800.title: Meowgic Laundry
5087800.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

5087940.title: DuskLand
5087940.short_description: Poker Roguelike RPG. DuskLand is a unique roguelike RPG where you deal heavy damage using poker hands and optimize character-specific inventories. Discover explosive synergies, find the best layout, and unleash powerful combos!

5088250.title: Buzzle
5088250.short_description: Move the blocks around the field to assemble the exact shape required for each level. Move them into the correct positions and see if you can advance to the next level.

5088300.title: Omenweald : Les Erres
5088300.short_description: An ARPG where you build the adventure you fight through. Spin a crazy one-armed bandit, roguelite style, to win better pieces of your adventure, room after room, until the final one.

5088460.title: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming
5088460.short_description: In this horror adventure game, the player takes on the role of a viewer who watches Sana Okuizumi’s live stream, issues instructions, and experiences firsthand how she overcomes various crises.

5088580.title: Vectorfall
5088580.short_description: Defend against massive waves with 5,000 enemies. Master 14 towers, pick your favorite upgrades and tear through huge waves of enemies with powerful abilities. Progress with 120+ skills and push your limits in endless mode. Take the fight anywhere with Steam Deck and full controller support. No AI.

5088590.title: Armory Chaos: Tidy Up
5088590.short_description: Clock in as a robot and bring order to a chaotic armory. Sort weapons, pack ammo, and haul crates solo or with up to 3 friends. Use magnets and air cannons to get the job done, and watch a stray explosion turn your tidy shift into a glorious mess.

5088770.title: Arctic Shop Simulator
5088770.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

5088790.title: Who Pressed It?!
5088790.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

5088940.title: Trigger-Happy Chainsaw Girl
5088940.short_description: Konoko Kobazaki is a deadbeat shut-in. Saddled with multiple debts, he heads to an abandoned building with the naive hope of turning his life around by becoming a "paranormal YouTuber." Will he actually manage to pay off his debts?

5089010.title: The Night Kitchen
5089010.short_description: The Night Kitchen is a psychological horror game. You just started a new job - the night shift in a kitchen. Grill, oven, deep fryer. Take orders, prepare the food, talk to the customer. Simple work. Seven nights. Each one stranger than the last.

5089230.title: Maiden Escape
5089230.short_description: Play as a paranormal investigator and escape from a ghost's nightmare. A horror adventure with 168 box-pushing puzzles and 2 endings.

5089430.title: Liquidity
5089430.short_description: It's 1995 and the bank is yours. Set rates, approve loans, take deposits, deal in stocks, satisfy the regulator, and try not to break too many rules. A deep banking and finance management sim wrapped in a mid-1990’s desktop.

5089480.title: 2027 毕业生工作
5089480.short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

5089490.title: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T.
5089490.short_description: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T. Explore abandoned places, face terrifying creatures, and complete missions as a team. Play with up to 6 friends, but be careful: every monster has its own unique mechanics. Will you survive and uncover the hidden lore?

5089650.title: Before the First Fire
5089650.short_description: Survive, teach, and evolve across 5.6 million years of human prehistory. Gather resources, build a tribe of companions, and guide your species through 7 eras, from the forest floor to the eve of civilization.

5089860.title: Slot Crawler
5089860.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

5089900.title: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery
5089900.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a pet cemetery. Sort 1,093 headstones by animal and cross-reference photographs to put every stone back where it belongs. No timers, no penalties. Just you, the quiet, and a lot of pets somebody loved.

5089930.title: Genuine Article
5089930.short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

5090030.title: DiscPods
5090030.short_description: Party chaos for up to 8 friends! Pilot a DiscPod, a small hover-robot that leaves a solid trail behind it. Touch any trail and you're out! Cut friends off, slip through the gaps, bounce discs off walls and raid the Overlord together. Online, 4 on one screen, or against Bots.

5090120.title: NICO DRAW
5090120.short_description: Your doodle just got up and ran. Draw legs, arms or wings with limited ink and take your creation through 45 stages in a hand-drawn 2D puzzle platformer. Play solo, with two on one PC, or with up to four online.

5090150.title: Ball Game
5090150.short_description: Ball Game is a game about making weaponified balls face each other using physics. Choose between many powerful cards, go through the rounds and watch slowly as the destruction rises!

5090320.title: Star Driver Ultra
5090320.short_description: year 2050 ULTRA high speed combat racing on the Moon

5090590.title: Dour Tower
5090590.short_description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

5090990.title: MAFIA HOTEL
5090990.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a first-person social deduction party game for up to 16 players—a hub for board game nights with friends. Play classic Mafia and other modes full of secrets and bluffing. Question your friends, defend your story, and confidently blame the wrong person.

5091410.title: Pawper: Desktop Pet
5091410.short_description: A virtual pet that lives on your desktop, not in a window. Pet him, feed him and throw the ball while you work. Clean up his messes for coins, then spend them on toys, outfits and furniture. He grows in real time, ages forever and never dies.

5091570.title: T-Shirt Kingdom
5091570.short_description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

5091680.title: Marbled Memories
5091680.short_description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events. Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother. This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

5091690.title: Dodgeball Disorder
5091690.short_description: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying on your feet are equally important. Score hits, survive ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete across multiple game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision and crazy face expressions.

5091750.title: FlashWords: Wordfall
5091750.short_description: FlashWords: Wordfall is a language-learning word game where you guide falling words to their correct translations, clear the board, and unlock new vocabulary as you play.

5091770.title: Ascend from Dis
5091770.short_description: A comic-ink roguelike deckbuilder where noise is a resource. Scavenge loud and the horde answers in waves — or fight quiet and stay poor. Outplay enemies that run decks of their own: peek, steal, and sabotage their next move while an infection ticks toward turning you.

5092000.title: TRACE
5092000.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

5092050.title: King of Puzzles
5092050.short_description: A cosy little kingdom-building puzzle. Lay dominoes around your castle, grow the biggest patch of each terrain you can, and see how your kingdom compares. A new board whenever you want one, a daily everybody shares, and a crown for whoever leads the most boards.

5092190.title: Horror Club: Grandpa's House
5092190.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you stay with your grandfather for a few days after he starts acting strangely. Help him with everyday tasks, follow his unusual rules, and experience unsettling events around the house as the story unfolds.

5092350.title: Semblature: A Deduction Game
5092350.short_description: A single-player logic deduction game. Every unit looks identical from the outside, and the statements about them are true or false based on their relative positions. Deduce the status and position of each unit, which can always be solved without guessing.

5092450.title: Labyrinth: The Descent
5092450.short_description: The maze is alive. The gold is bait. You're the meal. A permadeath dungeon crawler where the dungeon is keeping score: ten floors, one rogue, turn-based tactics on a grid. When you die that's it for the run — but your grave heals the next hero who finds it.

5092670.title: NULL VECTOR
5092670.short_description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

5092820.title: Carry On
5092820.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

5093060.title: Always Fear The Unknown
5093060.short_description: Always Fear The Unknown is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where fear is personal. Complete a psychological profile before the match, then survive as a human team against a relentless hunter while sanity, objectives, and adaptive scare events push back.

5093380.title: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
5093380.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

5093440.title: Literally A Flying Brick
5093440.short_description: "Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game. The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

5093580.title: Get to Work! Girls of Gensokyo
5093580.short_description: A pixel-art idle fan game set in Gensokyo. Jealous of Kourindou's success, a broke Reimu decides to set up shops on the shrine grounds to make bank! Recruit youkai, gather resources, and build a bustling commercial street in this relaxing Gensokyo management sim.

5093710.title: Illusion Remix
5093710.short_description: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.

5093720.title: Valkyrie Match
5093720.short_description: Gather the star-gems that can restore the fallen sky citadel. Match gems, awaken your Valkyrie cards, and outplay your rival turn by turn in this fantasy puzzle card battler.

5093810.title: Digsum
5093810.short_description: A relaxed incremental mining game about digging deeper, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering ancient artifacts.

5094030.title: Four Busted Buttons
5094030.short_description: Smash enemies by unlocking and upgrading four unique attack buttons in this short, minimalist incremental game.

5094080.title: Beneath Europa
5094080.short_description: Dive into the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life. Are you ready to take the next step?

5094090.title: Swarmkeeper
5094090.short_description: Exploit an abomination of bees to destroy your adversaries. Swarmkeeper is a 2D linear Zelda-like, with a twist of Cult of the Lamb, that follows a tale as old as time: Your former business partners have dropped your services and you must seek revenge. You’ll never forget your first sting.

5094230.title: Army Factory
5094230.short_description: Build your settlement into a war machine. Gather resources, raise massive armies, prepare your regiments, and watch your battle plan unfold as thousands of soldiers clash.

5094290.title: Haunted House Hellshift
5094290.short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

5094460.title: Buildot
5094460.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

5094510.title: Deliwhere?
5094510.short_description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

5094560.title: INNER EKO
5094560.short_description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

5094620.title: TohKago
5094620.short_description: Throw it, aim it. Watermelon?—BOOM! A fresh take on a staple of Japanese school sports days. The rules are simple: Pick up fruits and throw them into your team's basket. In a chaotic free-for-all, a single watermelon can make all your steadily collected fruits go BOOM. Who will have the last laugh?

5094770.title: Golf Orbit
5094770.short_description: Hit the perfect shot and launch your golf ball into orbit! Time your swings, smash through obstacles, earn coins, and upgrade your abilities to reach incredible distances. Break your records, explore new worlds, and see just how far your ball can go!

5094810.title: Unstrung
5094810.short_description: In Unstrung, a 2.5D narrative puzzle game, you take center stage in a visionary puppeteer’s masterpiece—a dark retelling of Hansel and Gretel. But disobedience is strictly off-script…

5094990.title: Dungeonhand
5094990.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

5095180.title: Circuitra
5095180.short_description: Circuitra is a challenging visual logic puzzle game about building increasingly complex circuit boards. Limited inputs, tight board space and changing contract constraints force you to debug and rethink your designs in order to grow your circuit-design business.

5095450.title: The Funeral of Kay
5095450.short_description: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

5095490.title: beautiful freaks of the desert
5095490.short_description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

5095510.title: Touhou Sky Cruiser
5095510.short_description: Run a sky cruiser built by Tenshi. Expand it room by room with new floors and terraces, offer dining and entertainment, and carry guests from port to port as you grow your business above the clouds.

5095600.title: Forklift Logistics Simulator
5095600.short_description: Take control of a physics-based forklift as you move pallets, stack cargo and load trucks through increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Precision, balance and careful handling are at the heart of the experience.

5095800.title: DNA NEMESIS
5095800.short_description: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

5095840.title: Click & Loot
5095840.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

5095980.title: Operation Blackwaste
5095980.short_description: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.

5096490.title: Tether and Talon
5096490.short_description: Tethter and Talon is deckbuilding turn based combat game that borrows elements from creature collectors and roguelites. Draft your team of Yokai, play their moves as cards and make your way through rounds of enemies and send evil back in the Nether.

5096580.title: Warcaste TCG
5096580.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters. Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield. Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

5096860.title: PactSworn
5096860.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

5097040.title: Meat Wall
5097040.short_description: IF IT MOVES, SHOOT IT. IF IT STOPS, BUILD WITH IT. MEAT WALL is a darkly comedic tower defense where the horde becomes the map. Pile ’em high, build with ’em, burn ’em, grind ’em, or blast a path through ’em. Shape the battlefield. Change your strategy. EVERY WALL CHANGES THE WAR.

5097110.title: SLICKWAVE
5097110.short_description: A fast illustrated action roguelite where every level-up reshapes your run. Choose abilities, evolve powers, combine relics, and turn four heroes into arena-clearing storms across four hostile worlds.

5097660.title: Keystrike
5097660.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

5097740.title: Potion Drifter
5097740.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.

5097820.title: Astonishia Story
5097820.short_description: Relive this retro-styled RPG classic with refined visuals and other enhancements! The time has come to recover a stolen relic and your honor.

5097920.title: Scrap to Strip
5097920.short_description: Rescue a rust-bucket, build the engine bolt by bolt, and drag-race it for cash and pink slips. Hunt parts, tune it, and climb from parking-lot teens to King of the Strip — a nostalgic garage sim where every part, rival, and run is earned. Hand-built, no AI art.

5098240.title: Syncope
5098240.short_description: Delve into the depths of your subconscious in this psychological isometric action game, and face your greatest fears made manifest. Fight, trade, and venture deeper into the madness of the mindscape. Can you confront the dangers and move forward towards a better future? The real battle is within.

5098280.title: RIGGED2EXPLODE
5098280.short_description: A tactical shooter where running out of bullets sets off a bomb strapped to your chest. Sneak through levels, take out enemies, and use the environment to your gain the advantage. Take your time and make every bullet count.

5098410.title: Super Kanji Flash
5098410.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

5098540.title: TDG: Tower Defense
5098540.short_description: TDG is a single-player military tower defense game. Hold a 30-wave campaign or an endless run on procedural maps, place and upgrade six tower types, meet Siege Carrier bosses, and adapt when new paths open. Sell or repair between fights. Early Access: full runs now, more content and polish ahead.

5099130.title: Fast Food Fortune
5099130.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

5099140.title: Three Kingdoms Story
5099140.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

5099200.title: Everything We Brought Here
5099200.short_description: A last-stand auto-battler on a dead magic world. Choose your heroes, upgrade their abilities, and try to hold on one more night.

5099220.title: Five to Fire
5099220.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

5099280.title: Bake It Tight
5099280.short_description: A cute, real-time cookie factory puzzle. Animal customers keep pouring in, but you only have a few machines. Place them, link them to the ovens with rails, and bake the cookies your customers want. Can you fill every order on time?

5099410.title: Cargo Tempo
5099410.short_description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

5099420.title: THE FIRST ZOMBIE
5099420.short_description: You are the walking dead—literally! In this casual action game, play as a cute zombie and take over the streets of Tokyo! Take down humans and animals, turn them into zombies, then build an ever-growing zombie horde!
developers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会
publishers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会

5099810.title: Hearth Fable
5099810.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

5099850.title: Simple Football League Manager
5099850.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

5099900.title: Bundoro
5099900.short_description: A Pomodoro timer, desktop companion, and Steam Inventory game.

5100090.title: The Painting War: Three Thrones
5100090.short_description: A grid-based formation-building autobattler set in the Three Kingdoms. Lay paper, scenery, and illustrated warriors onto a limited board, then rotate, merge, and connect them into an army. Your units fight automatically from their original tiles—study the outcome and rebuild for the next battle.

5100350.title: Fungus Co.
5100350.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

5100700.title: Farmer=nil
5100700.short_description: Farmer = nil is a programming-based automation farm right on your computer screen! Write scripts for your robots, collect resources, unlock tech, and build the most efficient farm.

5100960.title: Projekt Gartenzwerg
5100960.short_description: Projekt Gartenzwerg is a co-op horde defense FPS for 1 to 4 players. Night falls, and thousands of ceramic garden gnomes march on your position. Grab a WW2 arsenal, build your defenses and hold the line until dawn, alone or with your friends.

5101340.title: Eye of the Giant
5101340.short_description: Put history on trial in a cosmic courtroom. Manipulate Sanity, Guilt, and Arrogance to psychologically dismantle legendary figures, uncover the truth, and deliver your verdict in this roguelike deckbuilder.

5101720.title: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
5101720.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

5102610.title: Kick The Piñata!
5102610.short_description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

5103030.title: a sproutingale
5103030.short_description: A hand-made dual-story delivered through handwriting and mixed media illustrations: Ek'mer guides the fae-kind on their journey through Hell while two doctoral students, Gus & Gwen, become friends.

5103220.title: Skewered Up!
5103220.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

5103330.title: PlatAttack
5103330.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

5103720.title: Tell me Your Tale
5103720.short_description: Take on the role of an F.T.I.D. inspector and uncover who truly belongs in the tales. Question characters, examine documents and appearances, find contradictions, and compare every detail with official records. At the end of each inspection, decide who is Original, Impostor, or Aberration.

5104500.title: Own The Map
5104500.short_description: Build a fictional property empire on the real-world map in this Early Access online tycoon. Claim locations, earn game cash and grow with a shared community. Active development: features may change, bugs may occur and progress may be reset.

5104790.title: Augment Mahjong
5104790.short_description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

5104810.title: Radical Centrists
5104810.short_description: A deckbuilder where your cards are real politicians with questionably historical abilities. Discover new combos and accumulate wealth and influence. Push your luck with volatile politicians and make sure your party doesn't go off the deep end!

5104870.title: Pool Royalty: World Tour
5104870.short_description: Jump it. Curve it. Sink it. Then hear about it. Take on 24 rivals with real personalities on a 12-tournament World Tour, with authentic physics, official rules in six game types, online and couch multiplayer, and slow-mo replays you can save as GIFs.

5105050.title: Fish Tankfully
5105050.short_description: Fish Tankfully is a desktop idle aquarium sim that blends relaxing fishkeeping with a realistic ecosystem. Raise 200 ornamental fish, build tanks with plants, driftwood and gear, and manage lighting, filtration, stocking and compatibility with ease, even as a beginner.

5105100.title: Minesweeper Online
5105100.short_description: Minesweeper isn't a solitary game. Race on identical boards, cooperate with 2–8 players on a shared minefield, or clear a persistent world of 336 regions. Master advanced techniques, chase 3BV/s and IOE records, climb rankings, complete missions, unlock cosmetics, and play with friends.

5105490.title: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
5105490.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

5106310.title: Dao Without End
5106310.short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

5106680.title: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
5106680.short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

5106740.title: Between the notes
5106740.short_description: A mystical psychological thriller set in the quiet village of Klavishne. Talk to the locals, learn stories, enjoy the atmosphere, pick up the pieces. But find out: who is the woman in the portrait and what happened to her?

5106760.title: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck
5106760.short_description: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck is a grid-based puzzle game where you rescue toppled tortoises and send them home while keeping track of your fuel! Venture through the arid desert, drive through portals, and find your lost lunchboxes. Will you find out exactly who tipped all the tortoises over?

5107200.title: 72 Seconds
5107200.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

5107550.title: Chase Buddies
5107550.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

5108020.title: Brute Tusk : Feral
5108020.short_description: Play a wild boar in an open wilderness: click to run and forage, right-click to dodge or wind up a charge—smash obstacles and send wolves flying. Eat your fill, pick evolution upgrades, and fight through four seasons to topple each land’s apex predator.

5108680.title: Maybe... I'll go to the beach
5108680.short_description: It's a perzine-like spatial programming puzzle game about my experience of being an artist in the present landscape.

5108820.title: Explosive Express
5108820.short_description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

5109330.title: C3 Nightfall
5109330.short_description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

5109340.title: StoryRealm: AI Interactive Story Games
5109340.short_description: Create, edit, and play real-time AI-generated dialogue-based interactive games and visual novels.

5109900.title: Super Piotr Deluxe
5109900.short_description: Piotr got flushed into a test world built by a scientist who won't let him leave. Jump from platform to platform while your weapons fire on their own, survive enemy waves and bosses, and push your run through five worlds as far as you can.

5110140.title: Plinko Mining
5110140.short_description: Drop pickaxes, mine resources, and grow your mining empire! Plinko Mining is a relaxing incremental idle game where axes bounce through rocks, extracting valuable resources with every hit. Unlock new axes, increase your production, and expand your Skill Tree to become a mining master!

5110190.title: Marry Anyone
5110190.short_description: Get married within one month—or lose your job!? Solve puzzles, use items, and change your stats (Intelligence, Age, Cleanliness, Height, and Income) as you work your way toward marriage in this matchmaking puzzle game!

5110200.title: La Bidouillerie
5110200.short_description: A real electronics simulator: build robots, a 1970s pinball table and a 1980s dart machine from real parts (solenoids, gears, connecting rods, relays, transistors). Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

5110250.title: Timberlord Clicker
5110250.short_description: An idle clicker about cutting down trees. As a newly appointed noble, tame the wilderness, build your domain, and unlock new technologies. Recruit unique characters, uncover their secrets, and fight the corruption spreading through the forest.

5110300.title: RecycleShopECO
5110300.short_description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

5110640.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
5110640.short_description: Blast colorful jawbreakers in this cartoon bubble shooter! Eight delightful weirdos with eight different playstyles, across Story, Score Attack, Time Attack, and head-to-head VS modes - on the couch or online with Remote Play Together! The Dream Kingdom is counting on you!

5110980.title: Fieldmade
5110980.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

5111040.title: Echoes of Aether
5111040.short_description: A hardcore indie action RPG exploring a post-purification world and uncovering the truth.

5111190.title: MASA
5111190.short_description: In a world where magic lives through the power of the spirits, you are a mage of the battlefield. MASA is a strategy card game set in a fantasy world. Use the power of the elements and magic to earn the most victory points across five battles.

5111280.title: Dear My Son
5111280.short_description: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

5111330.title: Dawnbar Fantasy
5111330.short_description: The RPG that lives on the edge of your screen. Your hero and party fight, level, and loot in a slim battle bar docked above your taskbar — while you work, code, or browse.. Expand the window to forge gear, advance your class, Collapse it and get back to work. The adventure never stops.

5111520.title: ARCHIVE ZERO
5111520.short_description: In Cold War Britain, you will work through lost reports, photographs, letters, and artifacts as they arrive at the archive. Most seem routine. Some don’t. Follow the details, connect the cases, and decide what is worth digging into.

5111530.title: NO CLEAN, NO EXIT
5111530.short_description: A 1-4 player online co-op horror game about cleaning. Scrub the floors, haul out the trash and exterminate the man-eating bugs nesting in an abandoned house. The truck does not leave until the place is spotless.

5111810.title: Hanafuda Solitaire
5111810.short_description: Ever wished Hanafuda had a way to play alone? Capture pairs and form yaku in pure Hanafuda, with new rules that let you play it solo, solitaire-style.

5112000.title: Folder Folder Folder
5112000.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

5112120.title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
5112120.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

5112150.title: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat
5112150.short_description: A turn-based tactical wargame inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Build your own battlegroup and fight on a modern battlefield where detecting the enemy, choosing the right weapon, and landing the first accurate shot decide the outcome.

5112580.title: Cozy Island Cleaner
5112580.short_description: Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing game where you clean up a trash-covered island with the help of the cat who lives there. Collect the trash on the beach, upgrade your gear, and restore the island to its former beauty step by step.

5113920.title: Frathouse Beerpong
5113920.short_description: 4 player beerpong. frathouse rules. public lobbies. proximity chat. beer(s).

5114180.title: Prism Factory
5114180.short_description: Wire rainbows in a factory of light. A prism splits white light into red, green and blue. Bend the beams, mix them, and deliver the colour each order asks for: red and green make yellow. Orders keep coming, until your single white beam becomes rainbow wiring across the whole board.

5114510.title: My Empire MUST Grow
5114510.short_description: Your village is tiny, and that is a problem, because it MUST become an empire. Three neighbouring kingdoms disagree. Gather, build, raise the walls, hold the waves and finish the Wonder before they burn it all down.

5114540.title: Champion Trainer
5114540.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

5114950.title: Desktop Buddy
5114950.short_description: Desktop buddy is an active sandbox companion game where you can paint, shoot, crush and decorate your very own ragdoll on your desktop. Use familiar paint tools to fully customize your desktop buddy to your liking so you can treat it well, or don't.

5115040.title: Quest Dice
5115040.short_description: A solo gamebook with a real, physics-rolled d20. Read the story, make your choices, roll the dice and live with the result. Create your hero, play handcrafted adventures in 22 languages, or write and share your own books.

5115440.title: Duck Duck Shoot!
5115440.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

5115560.title: Arcade Vault Manager
5115560.short_description: Arcade Vault Manager:Game Sell Simulator is a cozy management game where you buy, inspect, collect, price, and sell games and consoles. Design and expand your store, adapt to changing customer demands across new generations, build a development team, and create games and sell them in your own store.

5116420.title: Dirty Derby
5116420.short_description: Dirty Derby is a multiplayer party game for 2-4 players. Read the animals that line up differently each round, and shape the finish order your contract demands. Grab your gear and jump onto the track — knock down anyone in your way. Only results remain: outdo the rest and prove yourself.

5116890.title: PaintScape
5116890.short_description: PaintScape is a 3D coloring book you can step into. Every map starts as a blank line drawing. Pick any brush and paint freely, or color by numbers. As you paint, sleepy flowers wake up and little chimneys begin to puff smoke. Walk around inside your painting, where every mistake is a happy accident.

5116920.title: Pixel Sky Waystation
5116920.short_description: Become the new manager of the Sky Island, make warm food and cool drinks there, and help those traveling long roads rest comfortably

5117080.title: CartWare
5117080.short_description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

5117390.title: CARNAGE
5117390.short_description: Fast isometric crash-for-cash arcade action. Floor it, smash traffic, steer your burning wreck into the city's most expensive real estate, and rack up a multi-million dollar repair bill. Drive, crash, upgrade, repeat.

5117430.title: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
5117430.short_description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

5117550.title: Fart Together
5117550.short_description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op game where 2–4 players steer a shared raft using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

5117740.title: The Golden Seam
5117740.short_description: A quiet game about mending what's broken and learning to wear the seams. Turn each fracture, slide the pieces home and seal the crack in gold. No timers, no score, no way to fail. Break and mend. The gold remembers.
