5117800.title: Zone Rush: Floating Medieval Hamlet
5117800.short_description: A knight robbed of her floating home, left with only a sword. Capture Zones for more time, combo through Vikings, and topple the Fire Golems guarding them. Fall, and you lose score and drop to level 1. A fast-paced single-player action game: race across a multi-level village and beat your best.

5117810.title: Frankenship
5117810.short_description: A co-op space mining game for 1-4 players, on one couch or online. Drill through hostile moons, blast crystal seams open and haul the ore home to your patched-together ship while the hive closes in. Then run for the pod.

5117980.title: Final Armada
5117980.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

5118060.title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
5118060.short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

5118360.title: Runners Catchers
5118360.short_description: Get ready for a fast-paced, chaotic tag game for up to 8 players! Dash through obstacle courses packed with giant donuts and candy hazards. Evade your friends as a Runner, or hunt them down as a Catcher. Run. Jump. Catch. Escape.

5118540.title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
5118540.short_description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

5118580.title: ARCHSCROLL
5118580.short_description: An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

5118590.title: Night Drive VR - Anomaly
5118590.short_description: Night Drive VR - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

5118690.title: Randventure
5118690.short_description: Randventure is a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe: slide your heroes left or right to make your choices. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts, evolve them along the way, and overcome every obstacle on your road.

5118820.title: FIND ALL 10: Greece
5118820.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

5118830.title: Blades and Hunger
5118830.short_description: A dark-fantasy text-based rpg with a detailed combat model built to simulate decision making in fencing, and a world delivered entirely in prose.

5119340.title: Verdict
5119340.short_description: Trapped in a high-stakes interrogation room, you must defend your innocence against an adaptive AI detective. Every answer is evaluated in real time—watch your words, because your own claims can convict you.

5119540.title: Article 7
5119540.short_description: Article 7 is a short political thriller where you play as Arvenia’s Minister of Civil Authority during a national crisis. Review documents, weigh conflicting information, speak with members of the press, and decide whether to grant emergency powers to the Chancellor.

5119550.title: Soul of Slime
5119550.short_description: Build your slime with cards, combine six elements and watch your strategy unfold in automatic battles. Survive 10 rounds, then take the same build into Endless mode and push on for as long as your lives last.

5119720.title: Warlords Gambit
5119720.short_description: Lead the heroes of the Three Kingdoms against an invading Abyss in this roguelite strategy game. Build powerful teams, plan formations, combine heroes, equipment, treasures, and Seals, explore changing maps, and overcome bosses with unique mechanics.

5119780.title: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
5119780.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

5119860.title: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
5119860.short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

5119980.title: Redraft FC
5119980.short_description: A football management game about hindsight. Inherit a real club exactly as it was, tear the squad up, and sign the players you now know were going to be great - at what they cost then. Play it forward season by season. Seven ways to play, from managing a club to being a pundit.

5120010.title: BROODHOUSE
5120010.short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

5120070.title: Wheel Street
5120070.short_description: Wheel Street is a roguelike deckbuilder on a circular board. Move and merge assets, combine strategy cards, and build a money-making machine. Grow on down days, cash in on up days, and unleash combos to beat rising weekly targets.

5120270.title: National Volley
5120270.short_description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

5120320.title: Faultfinder
5120320.short_description: She kept the machine that holds the city up for eleven years, and last night it killed her. You have her program and a recording of everything it did. Work back through it until you can point at the line that did it, then prove it. You never write any code, you only read hers.

5120570.title: Panda Gambler
5120570.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

5120690.title: Cheesy Michael Ball
5120690.short_description: You won't rest until you've ruined Cheesy Michael’s life. All you need is an egg. Tilt your way through chaotic 3D levels, reach the door handle and earn stars along the way.

5120800.title: Below Lethe
5120800.short_description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

5120830.title: XBPlayer
5120830.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

5121190.title: Sort Cats Together
5121190.short_description: A toy store full of cats needs sorting! Play solo or team up with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op game. Find 200 different cat designs, sort 4,000 toys onto their matching shelves, and unlock upgrades to turn a mountain of cats into a tidy collection.

5121350.title: Gunline
5121350.short_description: A tower defence you fight in first person. One road, one base, and thirty kinds of enemies walking down it. You meet them yourself with six guns and and build different kinds of defensive turrets.

5121450.title: Industeria
5121450.short_description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

5123100.title: SquareFrontlineTD
5123100.short_description: Embark on a strategic journey in SquareFrontlineTD, a refreshing 3D low-poly tower defense game! Build unique towers on a floating block island, master three distinct game modes, and use gold to upgrade your defenses against endless waves of incoming blocky monsters.

5123310.title: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!
5123310.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

5123930.title: TCG Town
5123930.short_description: Make a living collecting cards or doing jobs in TCG Town. Create your character, play solo or join friends, and take your collection with you. Trade for that missing card, give a friend their favorite, or keep every last one for yourself.

5124000.title: 太一剑歌
5124000.short_description: 《太一剑歌》是一款独特的东方幻想开放世界MMORPG！游戏拥有超过6万平方公里的超大无缝地图，你将在这个充满剑与魔法的世界中展开一场惊险刺激的自由冒险之旅！你的每一个行为将影响周围的世界，并决定这个世界的未来！

5124080.title: Blackbeam
5124080.short_description: BLACKBEAM is a light top-down sci-fi action adventure. Drive a rover, smash crystals, battle alien wildlife, expand your base, and venture ever farther. Explore more freely by day. At night, darkness, energy demands, and hostile creatures raise the stakes.

5124310.title: Bartend With Your Friends
5124310.short_description: Online 1-4 player co-op robot-bartender roguelike full of physics-driven chaos. Work together to mix drinks, manage demanding customers, and pick upgrades to hit the bar's daily quota before your shift ends - or the bar shuts down for good.

5124450.title: Maid Mech : Backpack TD
5124450.short_description: Maid Mech: Backpack TD – A grid tower defense game. Lead the last Dragoon maid mecha against mutant hordes. Collect shape modules after each wave, build defenses on a 14×7 grid, and deploy mecha to fight automatically. Backpack management meets tactical TD.

5124840.title: Terra Logic
5124840.short_description: Sculpt planets and landscapes, watch water and climate respond, and compare two versions of the same world. Import heightmaps, draw mountain ranges, and export flat terrain to Minecraft Java. Explore Earth, ancient continents and distant worlds at your own pace.

5124860.title: Closed World: Memories of a Fleeting World
5124860.short_description: A long-form 3D JRPG of exploration and memory. Four hundred years out from Earth, six hundred sleepers share a single dream — and in its last chapter, Lityria sets out remembering nothing. Twelve labyrinths, 380 hand-built maps, one buried truth.

5124940.title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
5124940.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

5125900.title: Rus: source
5125900.short_description: Historical novel with RPG-elements about the Origins of the Rus’ state. Four knyazes. Four lives. The only mystery. Your decisions influence on who you are going to become, and who you are in the new circle.

5126340.title: Runecast
5126340.short_description: A pixel-art autobattler: cast runes, set your company across three lanes and watch your strategy decide the fight. Merge heroes, pick promotions, gear up your troop and march through four acts, from the Palisade to the Basalt Hall, against bosses that demand preparation.

5126350.title: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
5126350.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

5126360.title: Clocks Sleep at Zero
5126360.short_description: A puzzle game where every clock must count down to zero together!

5126370.title: Dog Eat Fly
5126370.short_description: Dog Eat Fly is a colorful 2D roguelite platformer where you run, jump, dash and eat flies. Build powerful combinations of upgrades, survive increasingly chaotic challenges, and push your run further with every attempt.

5126680.title: Belt Bound Boxing
5126680.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

5126990.title: Stockroom Syndrome
5126990.short_description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

5127060.title: Giusto
5127060.short_description: Bidding for tricks in the forest. Be perfect, or be punished. Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts. Players are scored based on the accuracy of their pre-game predictions. Low score wins.

5127070.title: Dread of the Deep
5127070.short_description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

5127100.title: The Wrong Way Round
5127100.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

5127350.title: Rally Together
5127350.short_description: The whole rally, with your friends. Fix the car in the service park, jump in with your co-driver and race it on the stage. What you left loose you feel in the next corner, and what you break comes back to your bay. Online co-op for 1 to 6.

5127380.title: Meme Exam: Cats
5127380.short_description: MEME EXAM: CATS challenges memeologists from all over the world! Test your knowledge of the most famous meme cats and prove you’re a true memeologist!

5127460.title: Observer Effect
5127460.short_description: As an unwilling contestant, take part in a twisted game show, a first-person psychological thriller where you solve puzzles, try your luck, test your aim & face unpredictable games. Uncover the secret objective, outsmart the host & race against the clock to survive the show... if you dare.

5127590.title: Dear Gardener
5127590.short_description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

5127690.title: Little Bettas
5127690.short_description: Little Bettas is a cozy aquarium simulation and creature-collecting game where you breed, care for, decorate, and discover beautiful betta fish. Unlock unique colors, patterns, mutations, rare legendary Bettas, and build your own peaceful underwater collection.

5128320.title: THE BUTCHER WARD
5128320.short_description: Your night shift was supposed to be simple: restore power to an abandoned hospital. Repair electrical systems, explore the darkened wards, and survive the monstrous butcher stalking its halls.

5128700.title: JUST SHOVEL IT!
5128700.short_description: A cozy Christmas game about shoveling snow. It snowed all night, and the snow is not going anywhere on its own. Clear the yard before Christmas, feed the furnace, hang the lights, and take your time.

5129200.title: President FC: Football Club Owner
5129200.short_description: Build a football club from the lower leagues up. As the owner, hire your manager, discover players and develop young talent. Explore a detailed football world and shape your club over decades. Leave the team and tactics to your manager or have your say before each match.

5129290.title: Dreams About Fireflies
5129290.short_description: A first-person dreamcore game of collection and exploration. Chase fireflies through dreamlike worlds, unlock and upgrade various tools to catch them. From infant to adult, experience life's challenges, rediscover forgotten memories, and find the strength to heal yourself.

5129510.title: Tide & Tails
5129510.short_description: A cozy desktop idle fishing game made to keep you company. Fish, collect, and display your favorite fish while you work or study. Upgrade your gear, explore new waters, and let your journal record the journey.

5129710.title: Ragnarök Survivor
5129710.short_description: Created with AI assistance. Fight as one of three Norse heroes in a dark isometric 2.5D action-survivor. Survive twenty waves across three arenas, combine weapons, runes and companions, and return to Yggdrasil to prepare your next build.

5129730.title: Living with a Runaway Girl ~A Lovey-Dovey Life with Lowkey Gamer High School Girl~
5129730.short_description: Your cousin, a lowkey high school girl Hikariko, ran away from home and came to live with you! Have a chat, get lap pillows, sleep side-by-side! Enjoy a cool yet super sweet, affectionate yet nonchalant, lovey-dovey cohabit simulator with Hikariko♪

5129960.title: Standard of Iron
5129960.short_description: Lead Rome or Carthage in a single-player RTS set during the Second Punic War. Build settlements, command infantry formations, cavalry and war elephants, then take direct control of your commander and fight on the front line. History meets an undead threat.

5130410.title: No Truce With The Groceries
5130410.short_description: Can you shop for groceries? In 🗽America🗽? In this economy? No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure that seeks answers to these questions and more.

5130830.title: SinEater
5130830.short_description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

5130960.title: Rotten Keep
5130960.short_description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

5130980.title: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up
5130980.short_description: Restore The Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Explore a variety of book themes and discover endless possibilities within the archive.

5131110.title: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator
5131110.short_description: Run a traditional Turkish tea house with up to five friends online. Brew cay, grill toasties and race trays out to the shopkeepers next door. Keep the okey tables from turning into a brawl, take bets on match night, dodge the tea inspector and settle with the tax man - however you have to.

5131130.title: Deadrise
5131130.short_description: Pilot a boat through fog and swell while something hunts you. Sonar is the only way to see, and every ping draws it closer. Find seven drifting bottles, reach Cape Wrath Light, then try Coast Guard rescues, hurricanes and a sandbox sea.

5131300.title: Not Alive Enough
5131300.short_description: A new wave of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. Inspect every survivor, identify the infected before they turn, and stop the outbreak from spreading to the outside world in this tense zombie apocalypse screening simulator.

5131360.title: The Gaslight
5131360.short_description: The Gaslight is a chaotic social deduction game where one player is the Murderer, one is the Detective, and everyone else is trying to survive. Talk, lie, complete missions, use your pepper spray, and figure out who you can trust before someone gets stabbed.

5131490.title: Claire: Operation Velvet
5131490.short_description: Play as Claire to battle the evil forces invading the world. Harness the power of souls to wield weapons and complete missions. Uncover Claire's story and discover what the malicious Velvet wants to achieve.

5131580.title: Mind Echoes: Broken Vow Collector's Edition
5131580.short_description: Forgotten memories haunt the old estate. Uncover a doomed love story and stop the servant hiding deadly secrets within Graven Manor. Follow the tragic fate of Count Graven and his vanished bride Lydia as restless spirits awaken inside this cursed hidden-object mystery.

5131680.title: UNSPELLED
5131680.short_description: Cut limbs. Cut names. Be the last one standing. In this chaotic multiplayer brawler, every letter of your name is a life. Lose them all, and you're UNSPELLED.

5131760.title: Dice After Dark
5131760.short_description: DICE AFTER DARK is a dice poker roguelike. Rig the dice, stack relics, build ridiculous damage, and break the House.

5131770.title: Slice the Mountain
5131770.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about a red panda girl who wants to slice a mountain.

5131800.title: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes
5131800.short_description: Experience a lovely adventuring RPG as a humble herbalist whose home is threatened by an unknown blight. Explore ancient ruins and mysterious depths, brew potent potions, and help people in need. Enjoy the deeply gratifying feeling of gradually restoring the entire realm.

5132020.title: INTERNET4
5132020.short_description: INTERNET4 lets up to 8 people control one browser together and turn the internet into a shared playground. Watch videos and livestreams, split the browser to explore the web, or draw together. Enjoy Wikipedia-based minigames or unwind with some fishing.

5132120.title: Lunar Mining
5132120.short_description: Mine, melt, upgrade, repeat. Lunar Mining is a fast, casual incremental game built around tense 15-second mining runs. Smash lunar ore, smelt it into bars, and upgrade your drill between runs. Explore three biomes, battle bosses for rare artifacts, and chase Legendary ores across the Moon.

5132380.title: Marsheez
5132380.short_description: A candy-coated party brawler for 1–8 players. Shove, skewer and toast your friends across a dozen sugar-fueled modes, on the couch or online. Squishy marshmallows, silly hats, absolute chaos.

5132390.title: Hunting Contract
5132390.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players about hunting monsters to meet a company's quota. Kill the beast, seal it in a coffin and drag it back to the truck—while your friends scream in proximity voice chat.

5132410.title: Wrapuzzle
5132410.short_description: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!

5132810.title: Sector Zero: Freedom
5132810.short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

5133160.title: Alpha Draconis
5133160.short_description: Three civilisations, three worlds, one abandoned human experiment. Command the desert Tali and their living planetary web, the Nerros and their steam-driven exosuits, or the Phobarian hive and its bred swarms in a fully 3D real-time strategy game built on asymmetry, not reskins.

5133580.title: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
5133580.short_description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

5133660.title: Idle Commander
5133660.short_description: Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear, experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

5133760.title: Manasworn
5133760.short_description: Manasworn is an isometric action RPG with 3 spellcaster playable classes. Pick a Mage, Shaman or Necromancer, progress deeper in generated dungeons, and shape your spells with runes and relics. Fight alone or with three other friends in online co-op.

5133910.title: DwarVein
5133910.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

5134180.title: Ass Slapper Co
5134180.short_description: Ass Slapper Co. is a desktop companion game where real-world typing and well-timed slaps earn Employee Fulfillment. Upgrade and customize your workplace as eccentric founder Johan Slapper guides you through a 6-chapter storyline from a 2D closet to a 3D penthouse office.

5134240.title: Radar Identified: Tower & Approach
5134240.short_description: Radar Identified: Tower & Approach is an air traffic control simulator. Run Tower, Ground and Approach: clear pushbacks, taxi aircraft, manage runway traffic and sequence ILS arrivals at five airports in Germany and the United States.

5134290.title: Vox Populi II: 2026-2029
5134290.short_description: Create or choose a character with a fully customizable ideology, campaign in elections across numerous countries, then take control of Parliament and the government to lead your nation as you see fit! Your own objectives will determine your victory conditions!

5134830.title: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!
5134830.short_description: Cultivate, study, and work through a modern-day life. Choose techniques and set their order before automatic battles. When a life ends, leave a final wish and pass your legacy to the next generation. How many generations will it take to ascend? A demo is available now.

5135170.title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
5135170.short_description: A mysterious disease is turning people into picture books. When her sister contracts Paper Mortis, Mono must do everything she can to save her—even if that means making a deal with a veritable devil.

5135350.title: Sugarstar Academy
5135350.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

5135430.title: Math Defense Protocol
5135430.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

5135600.title: Touhou: Cirno's Snowball
5135600.short_description: Nobody's buying Cirno's bingsu because it's too small, so she's rolling a snowball around Gensokyo to fix it. Strawberries stick. So do crates, rocks and frogs. See what kind of bingsu you can make.

5135660.title: Spear Dive
5135660.short_description: Hunt 80+ fish species in a first-person freediving sim. Learn their habits and manage oxygen and body heat. Gear up with spears, fins and wetsuits to dive deeper. Explore seas with daily changes in temperature, murkiness and waves, fill your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

5135870.title: 胡来！文字麻将
5135870.short_description: What if mahjong was less about strategy and more about pure nonsense? Draw, steal, and discard character tiles, then force them into the wildest sentence you can. Exes become emperors, bosses elope at midnight, zombies clock in for work. If you can make the nonsense make sense, you can win.

5135980.title: Arcade Together
5135980.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

5136070.title: Pocket Adventurer
5136070.short_description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

5136260.title: Close Enough
5136260.short_description: A physics puzzle platformer where you draw your own tools. Sketch what you need on a 32x32 grid and it drops into the world with real weight — climb it, carry it, throw it, blow it up. 100 objects, and every level has at least three ways through. Solo or two-player.

5136350.title: Overflow Protocol
5136350.short_description: A number-merging incremental game where you build a lab to push numbers higher and uncover the God Number. Generate and merge matching numbers, upgrade and automate your machines, and discover how far numbers can go.

5136620.title: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
5136620.short_description: S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack. Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.

5136680.title: Dungeon Typist
5136680.short_description: Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite where every word becomes an action. Type words to move, attack, and cast abilities while enemies act in real time. Dodge danger, collect gear, and build powerful combinations as you venture deeper into the dungeon.

5136810.title: Perfectly Folded
5136810.short_description: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game in a clothing store the cats have wrecked. Fold, hang and shelve every shirt, hat and shoe, catch the cats hiding in plain sight, then hire them to help you tidy up.

5136840.title: ChillTank
5136840.short_description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats: shape the landscape, add water and decorate. Play offline, at your own pace. But even the calmest waters hide hungry shadows...

5136890.title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
5136890.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare and pet shop. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

5136910.title: The Off-Season
5136910.short_description: The seaside hotel is shut from October to March, and the winter caretaker is you. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Somebody knocks anyway, after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking. You decide who gets a key, and which room.

5137000.title: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market
5137000.short_description: Cozy first-person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort gifts, sweets, decorations, toys and festive treats. Tidy up the Christmas market, earn points and restore order before the holiday crowds arrive!

5137060.title: Arcane Circuit
5137060.short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

5137230.title: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic
5137230.short_description: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic is a single-player 3D jigsaw puzzle game set in an art museum. Collect 2,576 puzzle pieces scattered throughout the museum and complete colorful works of art. Use helpful magic skills to make puzzle-solving easier and more fun!

5137340.title: Stop Reading the Cards
5137340.short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

5137500.title: PAVYON
5137500.short_description: You don’t know what will happen tonight. Same table, same lights… but never the same night! Step into the interactive nightclub, choose your table, and see where the night takes you. Meet online players, dive into conversations, build new connections, and become part of the story of the night...

5137520.title: Portopia Serial Murder Case
5137520.short_description: The legendary "THE PORTOPIA SERIAL MURDER CASE" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

5137530.title: Re:Red
5137530.short_description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

5137580.title: Esper Overload
5137580.short_description: A roguelike with customizable skills and auto-battle!! Lead a squad of psychics and use the skills you’ve customized yourself to wipe out the monsters once and for all!

5137610.title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?
5137610.short_description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

5137780.title: HEAVY SLEEPER
5137780.short_description: Transport a sleeping giant Troll to Sector 35. Drive the car, keep the Troll balanced, and whatever happens, don’t wake him up.

5137820.title: Pickup Point Chaos
5137820.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

5137900.title: TunaSweeper
5137900.short_description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

5138870.title: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles
5138870.short_description: A casual strategy game combining block-placement combat, roguelite module builds, and interactive stories for a female audience. Explore an anomalous network and conquer personalities who watch, respond to, and may even sense the real “you” as you claim your permissions.

5138910.title: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
5138910.short_description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

5138980.title: NO KING IN HELL
5138980.short_description: Awaken as the late Demon King's children, a brother and sister with no realm of their own. Explore an HD-2D demon world, recruit monsters, and reclaim a home. Seize weakened enemies mid-battle, raise them through classes, evolution and fusion, and lead squads in a turn-based strategy RPG.

5138990.title: Unharvest
5138990.short_description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

5139120.title: SHOOTOSYNTHESIS
5139120.short_description: The plants have taken control, and the army sent you in! Farmers! Defend the Photosynthesis Core for 7 waves, alone or with your friends. A whole mutant flora ready to kill you, a multitude of weapons, and mutants you'll have to uproot before they grow back!

5139300.title: Andrea
5139300.short_description: Andrea is a crafting-driven roguelike RPG, featuring a unique equipment crafting system and a highly variable talent tree. Your goal is simple: grow as strong as you can and defeat the final boss. Survive if you can — death resets everything, but every run stays with you.

5139390.title: Precious nightmare
5139390.short_description: How do you deal with love if, every time you chase it, it ends up hurting you? That’s the question Rosa asks herself every day. One day, she works up the courage to find an answer and heads to… a police station? Dive into her worst nightmares to discover how she’s reached the situation she’s in.

5139400.title: Drone Horizon: Force & Effect
5139400.short_description: Design, build and configure your own drones. Brace yourself for challenging environments, discover capabilities and limitations of your vehicle, learn how to overcome them. Experiment with different configurations, flight modes, and control techniques to find the right approach for every mission.

5139480.title: Collapsle
5139480.short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

5139580.title: Fill the Sky
5139580.short_description: A factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into sprawling industry that feeds the data centers you run on. Launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky. No enemies. Build at your own pace.

5139780.title: Devour & Evolve
5139780.short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

5140190.title: Fishing Spot
5140190.short_description: Fishing Spot is a relaxing fishing game about discovering unique fishing locations and the species that inhabit them. Generate new spots with their own ecosystems, fish populations, bite schedules and bait preferences, chase records, and build your collection — all at your own pace.

5140400.title: Babel Rising Reborn
5140400.short_description: Humanity wants to reach the heavens. You're God. Make them regret it. Unleash the elements and bring the Tower of Babel crashing down in this remastered god game, more spectacular than ever. The Unreal Engine 5 remake of a cult god game.

5140560.title: Ant
5140560.short_description: Build a living ant colony that can stay on your desktop while you work. Hatch unusual ants, place nest and food rooms, collect coins, and expand from a glass habitat into drawers, pipes, walls, roots, and the forgotten depths below.

5140630.title: Over The Gnome!
5140630.short_description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

5140640.title: Crown Bluff
5140640.short_description: Crown Bluff is a game of betrayal for 2 to 12 players. Everyone hides a secret role. A loyal knight, a hidden rebel, or a traitor smiling at your side. Find who shares your goal, and take down everyone who doesn't.

5140700.title: Piggy Bang
5140700.short_description: Piggy Bang is a satisfying incremental game where you smash piggy banks to earn coins and gems, upgrade your hammer, and build your fortune. Can you expand your bank-breaking operation to infinity and beyond?

5140770.title: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
5140770.short_description: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.

5141170.title: Screen Nook
5141170.short_description: A book nook for your desktop. Tiny, lit 3D worlds that live at the edge of your screen and follow your real hours. Nothing to win, nothing to grind. Just somewhere lovely to glance at while you work or study.

5141350.title: MechInfection
5141350.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 2–4 players. By day, scavenge supplies across shifting locations; by night, defend your shelter from the things outside. Craft weapons, set traps, cook, survive together, and break out of a dead world before dawn.

5141360.title: Hirelings
5141360.short_description: Turn-based tactics roguelike about building an overpowered party of mercenaries. Hire, reroll, and merge mages, vampires, rogues and more between battles... then outsmart every enemy on the grid.

5141450.title: The Needle
5141450.short_description: The Needle is a SciFi RPG roguelike game like nothing you've ever seen. In the tradition of FTL, Crying Suns, and others, it's a deep and immersive space combat sim, with the presentation of a movie....... That you can talk to. Fight your way to the alien homeworld, by speaking aloud.

5141490.title: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle
5141490.short_description: Use chess moves to sneak past guards and plan clever escapes through handcrafted puzzles, solo or in local and online co-op. Switch to real-time chess battles, then create and share your own puzzles in the full game.

5141810.title: Gacha Fiend
5141810.short_description: A gachapon roguelike about luck, builds, and a debt that grows with every spin. Shake the machine, combine stickers and relics, and survive Mr. Ossório’s collection visits.

5142310.title: Haeresis
5142310.short_description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

5142470.title: Genius Simulator
5142470.short_description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

5142590.title: Penthouse
5142590.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

5142650.title: All-in Tide
5142650.short_description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

5142670.title: Kalmareth: Rune Duel VR
5142670.short_description: A 1v1 VR magic duel fought with your hands. Draw runes in the air to cast — six strokes, no menus, no HUD. Read your opponent's motion, commit to a stroke, and strike before they finish theirs.

5142690.title: Sontaku Soul: Read the Boss
5142690.short_description: Fail and you're fired! SONTAKU SOUL is a collection of rapid-fire microgames about Japanese business etiquette. Play as Tamako, a brand-new employee, and find the right move in every situation—bowing, business cards, seating order, toasts and more—to survive the harsh world of work.
developers: ブラック企業サークル
publishers: 株式会社セブンコード

5142730.title: Paceweaver
5142730.short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

5142970.title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
5142970.short_description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

5143170.title: Idol Shell
5143170.short_description: Idol Shell is a retro-style FPS inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Fight relentless mechanical enemies, explore interconnected levels, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the mystery behind their creation.

5143260.title: Only Guns
5143260.short_description: It's like Only Up but with guns. Only Guns! A third person puzzle-platforming-shooter. Race against the clock! Jump, Climb and Shoot your way up through a series of realms until you reach the very top.

5143350.title: Warband Heroes
5143350.short_description: Draft a warband from 18 heroes, arm them with items and abilities between fights, then let them loose in this arena mayhem roguelike autobattler.

5143460.title: Astella Walker
5143460.short_description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

5143490.title: GuildBound
5143490.short_description: A cozy idle guild manager that lives on your desktop. Recruit heroes, send them on quests and contracts, gear up at the vendors, and rally the whole guild for raids. Your guild keeps working while you do, and the loot is waiting when you look back.

5144040.title: 露娜2：拾光之约
5144040.short_description: 《露娜2：拾光之约》是七龙游戏运营的3D-MMORPG游戏。以Q萌画风、奇幻故事、三大种族设定、三大职业等多元化的游戏内容深受玩家喜爱。农场种菜、河边钓鱼、小屋装扮等等那些年最纯粹的玩法，如今悉数回归。最经典的版本，最原始的感动，让我们一起重返蓝色大地，开启这场奇幻的冒险之旅吧！
developers: 江苏三九互娱网络科技有限公司
publishers: 江苏七龙网络科技有限公司

5144340.title: Tetragrade
5144340.short_description: Embark on your own odyssey, stack hand-cut materials, watch treasures pour into the bowl and spend your rewards on the favour of ten Greek gods. Tetragrade is a compulsive block-stacking roguelite about the pleasure of a perfect fit.

5144560.title: Yukinite Depths
5144560.short_description: Send a team of autonomous goblin miners deep underground in search of the legendary Yukinite crystal in this relaxing pixel-art incremental strategy game with idle elements. Discover rare resources, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mine, and face whatever is waiting below.

5144640.title: Frutiverse
5144640.short_description: Your planet is doomed. In Frutiverse, a space game driven by orbital physics and destructible environments, you fight incoming threats, destroying asteroids or pushing them off their collision course. Gather resources and build an evacuation ship to save your fellow Fruits, alone or in local co-op.

5144770.title: Mosaic of Life
5144770.short_description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

5144820.title: A Million Orcs
5144820.short_description: Huge-scale tower defense: over a million orcs march on your keep. Wall in your town, raise towers, dig traps and place archers, spearmen and cavalry. Then sound the horn and hold, with god powers and dragon riders on your side.

5145310.title: Ragtag Fleet
5145310.short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

5145320.title: FSPunch
5145320.short_description: A physics party brawler for the living room and LAN party. Animals in boxing gloves punch, kick and carry each other off crumbling platforms. Play brawler, scooter, dodgeball, scooterball or soccer, build your own maps, and settle it in splitscreen or over LAN.

5145330.title: Night Killaz
5145330.short_description: A multiplayer game where you either hunt or be hunted. 1 invisible vampire. 4 Night Killaz. Complete your objectives as a human, or become the vampire and take them out. The vampire feeds on mistakes. The team works together, and fights back. Can humans outsmart the invisible threat?

5145340.title: Sam, We Talked About This
5145340.short_description: Every sentence, image and video on the internet will feed Sam's bottomless hunger! Train your models, grow your subscribers, buy new hardware and scrape even more data, all to build a super-duper artificial intelligence and leave every rival behind.

5145430.title: God Sight Road of Ashes
5145430.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

5145520.title: Chess: Apex
5145520.short_description: Classic chess at a beautiful 3D table. Climb a ladder of ten AI opponents up to full-strength Stockfish, sharpen your tactics with daily puzzles and Puzzle Storm, play ranked online or with Steam friends, and get another chance at the move that cost you the game.

5145720.title: Just Fly
5145720.short_description: A cozy-adrenaline wingsuit game with no forced goals. Explore procedural sky islands with forests, canyons, tunnels and dangerous caves. Weave between trees, hot air balloons and wind turbine blades, and score points with high-speed proximity flying. No timers, no goals, epic crashes. Just fly.

5145960.title: Doctrine Strike
5145960.short_description: Modern real-time strategy in real cities. Pick a place on Earth, generate its real landmarks in 3D, shape the terrain, design your own units and factions, then fight combined-arms wars with superweapons on the map you built. Free to play.

5146230.title: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
5146230.short_description: An incremental idler MMO: Paint & hide your gold-generating piñatas while hunting & stealing others’ poorly hidden treasures in a massive persistent world! Build wealth, spend on upgrades, hide & protect your passive-income empire, customize your character, get revenge, find rare items & show off!

5146360.title: Ad Astra, Inc.
5146360.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

5146440.title: Solitaire & Cheats
5146440.short_description: Solitaire & Cheats is a classic Klondike solitaire game where you earn points to spend on cheats-special moves that help you win tough deals. Settle into a cozy late-night jazz club atmosphere. Choose your rules, share game codes, and create your own card art.

5146600.title: Deep Sea Survivor
5146600.short_description: Explore the ocean with adorable robots in this pixel-art bullet heaven action roguelite! Choose and upgrade diverse weapons, defeat swarms of sea creatures, and survive deadly traps. The deeper you dive, the greater the danger becomes. Create a new build on every run and survive the depths!

5146690.title: The One Who
5146690.short_description: Step into the shoes of a father searching for his missing daughter in a nightmare world. Explore eerie, shifting locations, hide in the dark from unnatural creatures, and follow a mysterious voice to piece together the truth before it's too late.

5146850.title: Regret & Rewind
5146850.short_description: Welcome to 1989. In this retro style first-person job simulator You work alone in a tiny yellow drive-thru photo kiosk somewhere in suburban America. Customers want cassettes, family portraits, questionable passport photos... and memories they probably shouldn't keep.

5147320.title: Midnight Flare
5147320.short_description: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this first episode you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

5147410.title: Wandering Far
5147410.short_description: A desktop idle hiking game that keeps you company while you work or study. A girl and her little dog set off on a journey across your screen—with outfit changes, camping, treasure hunting, multiple display modes, and the option to set it as a live wallpaper.

5147690.title: Cash Only
5147690.short_description: Run a coffee shop by day and a drug business on the side. Serve customers, grow product, negotiate dead drops, avoid the cops, and split the work with friends in this co-op crime simulator.

5148050.title: Homemade Oxygen
5148050.short_description: In the right hands, a wrecked ship can be a ticket home. In Homemade Oxygen, combine cards into production chains, send colonists on expeditions, and keep your crew alive while assembling a ship to escape. On this planet, survival means finding a way out.

5148120.title: Adventurers Wanted!
5148120.short_description: An idle fantasy guild game where you run the notice board.

5148590.title: PHILSEQUE DIVISION
5148590.short_description: Pilot powerful combat ships in this 3D space action roguelite. Face ever-growing enemy hordes, collect experience, install modules, create devastating builds, and survive intense battles against minibosses and bosses across hostile regions of space.

5148610.title: Drums & Steel
5148610.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

5148660.title: Reap & Repeat
5148660.short_description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

5148740.title: Cosmic Mushrooms
5148740.short_description: Realistic physics-based rocket game. Navigate dangerous alien planets, collect mushroom cargo and deliver supplies back to your base.

5148810.title: Doomed Village
5148810.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

5148870.title: Geeked-Out Basketball
5148870.short_description: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.

5149020.title: Word Link
5149020.short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

5149070.title: King Must Rush
5149070.short_description: A medieval roguelite where you play the king: race the clock to forge weapons and arm your villagers, command the army in real time, and hold the walls against the siege. Climb a branching map to the boss, draft powers between fights, and grow stronger every run.

5149130.title: Whispers from Below
5149130.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

5149300.title: Chair Chase
5149300.short_description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player party game where living chairs run away from you. Jump, dash and push friends aside, then hold on tight to score. Most points after 7 rounds wins! Supports public matches and streaming.

5149400.title: Electronic Universe II
5149400.short_description: Electronic Universe II is a music runner game where the scenario was built specifically to capture the sounds of the music and represent them on a visual way, the character can move to the left-right and jump, and your goail is to avoid colliding with the objects of the scenario.

5149550.title: Keep to the Blue
5149550.short_description: Explore a flooded post-apocalyptic world, battle your enemies, and upgrade your ship with the loot you find. But watch out for pirates!

5149600.title: The House Between Times
5149600.short_description: Turn the hands of a pocket watch to move between two eras of the same house. Change the past to reshape the present, solve puzzles that span decades, and uncover the secrets hidden within the house in this first-person mystery adventure.

5149680.title: Kiosco Simulator
5149680.short_description: Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you run a 24-hour kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina. Serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build your reputation as you earn money to upgrade your shop and expand your business.

5149900.title: Not in Order
5149900.short_description: You report for duty on a train that never stops. A name, a date, a seat, a carriage: everything must match. Check the tickets, report what is wrong. And work out what really happened aboard.

5149980.title: Dark Blue Star
5149980.short_description: You are a fallen star. Climb the rock face and swing on ropes to return to the sky. Be mindful of depression and anxiety. We recommend visiting a hospital if necessary.

5150120.title: MovingLog
5150120.short_description: A physics-based team party game for up to 12 players in four teams. One player hoists the log overhead while teammates ride on top, and where they stand decides how it tilts. Clear obstacles, ride a rival team's log to throw them off, and get your log and your whole team to the goal first.

5150160.title: The Sixth Die
5150160.short_description: The Sixth Dice is a dice-building roguelike with poker hands. Roll five dice, re-roll and modify them to form pairs, straights, or five-of-a-kind. Collect runes, skills, and relics to forge unique builds. Defeat the final boss to unlock the Sixth Dice—showing any number you choose—and endless mode.

5150210.title: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
5150210.short_description: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

5150590.title: Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter
5150590.short_description: **Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter** A cute meme‑themed top‑down shooter‑survival game. Step into the paws of a brave pup, scavenge for supplies amid hostile forces and colossal bosses. Hunt for rare loot, upgrade your gear, craft high‑tier weapons, and grow from a nobody into a formidable fighter.

5151230.title: Knead a Break
5151230.short_description: A sedentary-health desktop companion: a grumpy cat that idles in the corner of your screen while you work, nudges you to stretch on the schedule you set, and stays quiet when you're in the zone with Smart Flow Protection. Hundreds of moves to unlock.

5151290.title: i love you
5151290.short_description: 放学后的校园里，好友失踪、旧楼传来异响，在寻找真相的途中，逐渐发现一段关于青春、秘密与“我爱你”的故事。

5151340.title: Sort My Pigs
5151340.short_description: [No AI] Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

5151880.title: She'll Be Home Soon
5151880.short_description: Your wife will be home soon. Clean the house, feed the dog, finish the chores and keep everything under control before she arrives, while something that looks like her stalks the house and starts undoing your work.

5152000.title: MAGNUM Protocol
5152000.short_description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

5152160.title: Stickman Raid: Return of the King
5152160.short_description: No complicated introductions here—2D, side-scrolling, stick figures, vertical industrial towers, and an evacuation rule where "you only win if you make it out." Fast-paced matches, ready to play anytime.

5152430.title: NEBULA BREAK
5152430.short_description: A family-friendly space shooter that refuses to stay the same. Clear five stages and new modes keep unlocking - side-scrolling, then a full-3D SPACE DIVE. ASSIST mode adds lives and bombs and slows the pace for younger players, while eight galaxies and 50+ minigames keep veterans busy.

5152560.title: Quadrillion Carrots
5152560.short_description: 🥕Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos. 🤖

5152700.title: Paint Gang
5152700.short_description: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

5152760.title: Basketball Dynasty
5152760.short_description: Basketball management meets RPG! Build your team under US and European rules, set in-game tactics, and upgrade players via skill trees and gear. Compete in a realistic stats-driven match engine, push the limits with Steam Workshop, and top the global leaderboards!

5153730.title: Apprentice Mage Gale
5153730.short_description: Apprentice Mage Gale is an Autobattler RPG where your entire party depends on you. You are their ONLY damage dealer, so master 16 spells, build your mage through 100+ skill nodes, overcome monsters and bosses, and fight across eight lands on the road to the Demon Lord.

5153770.title: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower
5153770.short_description: A relaxing organization game where you play as a retired mage's apprentice. Tidy up a magical tower, discover hidden secrets, and slowly learn magic along the way.

5154590.title: Wipe Them Out!
5154590.short_description: Wipe them out is a hand-drawn incremental zombie-blasting game. Shoot zombies, collect scrap, and upgrade your weapons and defenses. Face increasingly powerful horde as you grow stronger with every upgrade. Protect your wall and enjoy the satisfaction of tearing through countless zombies.

5154680.title: Little Colony
5154680.short_description: A little ant farm, alive at the edge of your screen. Paint a line and the ants dig it. Paint a room and they build it. Glance back later and they've been farming, foraging, and surviving the seasons. Every spring the Queens fly and the trees grow.

5154800.title: Drink Tea Fight Monsters
5154800.short_description: Drink Tea Fight Monsters is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder where you fight blighted beasts and bandits up a failing mountain, sit down with villagers for tea to hear their tales, and make choices that shape their lives.

5154880.title: Grandpa Sam's adventures
5154880.short_description: A 4-player couch co-op action platformer where Grandpa Sam and his friends are starving, so they eat a few bananas, not knowing that they belong to the Monkey King. Enraged, the Monkey King sends his minions after them. To restore peace, they must defeat him.

5155060.title: Mise en War
5155060.short_description: Mise en War is a party game of endless kitchen chaos. Complete your recipe before other chefs steal your food. Or simply steal their food instead of cooking.

5155170.title: Not My Dad
5155170.short_description: Something is stealing people's skin. And your dad might be one of the victims... In Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game, complete your daily tasks while trying to live with the disturbing presence of "DAD".

5155490.title: Aer Isles
5155490.short_description: Rise, knight. Reclaim the skies you were once promised. alone or with up to four friends. Cross ever-changing floating isles, survive chaotic encounters, gather Power, and strengthen your Bonk. Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock each other back trying.

5155770.title: Empires of Black Powder
5155770.short_description: A Napoleonic era RTS with card-based army building and direct commander combat on horseback to support your troops. Open packs, equip your regiments, and command combined arms of infantry, cavalry, and artillery in real-time battles. Keep your veteran guard alive and bring them into the next battle.

5155810.title: PupRacers
5155810.short_description: 🐕 Race on hoverboards as cute dogs in Hawaiian shirts! 🏄 Complete quests, explore tropical islands, destroy alien Troll oil rigs, and save the planet 🌍 Solo story, online multiplayer, cross-platform. Free to play, no ads!

5155860.title: Third Bloc
5155860.short_description: A text-based political management sandbox set in the Cold War. Balance the budget, recruit experts, bargain with rival powers, answer telegrams, and drag a poor new republic into the space age. Or bury it in a nuclear one. All in animated ASCII.

5155890.title: BID: Blood Is Due
5155890.short_description: BID: Blood Is Due is a psychological horror roguelite where you face four deadly games of chance. Roll the dice, build your deck, manage Blood, exploit Dealer passives, choose your route, and risk more for greater rewards.

5156290.title: Chief? About That File...
5156290.short_description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

5156800.title: 再跑亿遍
5156800.short_description: Change & Run is a 2D side-scrolling construction simulation game. There are no shortcuts here. With the help of Code Girls, each with her own distinct personality and abilities, you will place code blocks to rebuild shattered terrain
publishers: 上海苍星昂霄网络科技有限公司

5157210.title: Castle Reborn
5157210.short_description: Castle Reborn is a 45-degree isometric voxel action roguelite. Enter an ever-changing cursed castle, cut through hordes of undead, collect weapons and relics, shape a new build each run, and push deeper into the endless night with every return.

5157580.title: DUSTBLOOM
5157580.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends and turn a dead red planet green. Mine, build and automate, haul ore with your truck, push the green frontier into high-pressure lands, and hold your base against the husks that come at night, while you uncover what happened to the lost 14th team.

5157740.title: Just Make Sense: Instinct Lab
5157740.short_description: A laboratory for your gut feeling, most rounds over in 15 seconds: eyeball distances, nail the timing, predict trajectories, count at a glance. 12 instincts, a main map that grows tile by tile, and 570+ everyday scenarios. No trivia, no math — just your instinct. It's sharper than you think.

5157800.title: 99 Legit Manager
5157800.short_description: 99 Legit Manager is a fantasy football management game. Sign orcs, elves, robots, zombies, and giants, manage your club's finances to claim league and cup glory. The game features match betting and behind-the-scenes schemes—match-fixing, bribery, and stock market manipulation.

5157910.title: Keyboard Companion
5157910.short_description: A tiny pixel monkey that types along with you. He sits at the bottom of your screen, hits the same keys you do, and when you take a break he snacks on bananas, yawns and dozes off. It never records what you type.

5158270.title: Don't Touch Me - Goblin Zombies
5158270.short_description: Inspired by the Zombie Mode from Counter-Strike Online.At the start of the game, some humans will turn into zombies Don’t let them touch you — or you’ll become a zombie too! And if you do get infected..Then go wild and infect every human you can!

5158310.title: Letter Dragon
5158310.short_description: You're a bumblebee dragon with a delivery service. Explore an open world full of tropical islands while you deliver mail in this short adventure!

5158490.title: SAAM Tactics
5158490.short_description: Catch creatures, raise and train them on your ranch, and win turn-based battles to claim a map one hex at a time. An easy-going strategy game with or without a timer as desired.

5158820.title: SABRE CLASH
5158820.short_description: Deflect. Destroy. Escape. Turn enemy laser fire against its source in a fast-paced first-person action game about boarding hostile ships, destroying their cores, and getting out alive.

5158980.title: Scrapyard Survivors
5158980.short_description: A top-down mech survivors-like. Sixteen minutes of bullet heaven to survive and call yourself the Scraplord. Kill enemies, gather XP, gain more guns. Rinse and repeat.

5159060.title: One Last Shot！
5159060.short_description: One Last Shot! is a turn-based Roguelite where Modifiers + Action Words = new cards in combat. Chain High-Power, Sturdy, Beam, and Block into fresh skills, then name the first special card you discover. Three heroes, three film sets, and multiple endings await.

5159080.title: Destruction Snake
5159080.short_description: In Destruction Snake, you start with a basic mechanical snake and dive into swarms of enemies. Weave through the battlefield, shoot, burn, freeze, and destroy your way through the horde, collecting scattered resources to continuously strengthen your build.

5159190.title: Slime Mine Survivor
5159190.short_description: Mine 2D blocks in this Survivors-like roguelite action game! Play as a slime, dig deeper underground, stay ahead of the poison gas, hunt for treasure chests. Collect ores to upgrade and evolve your weapons and pickaxe, then unleash powerful synergies to smash through enemies and blocks alike!

5159310.title: Limited-time Game Bundle Challenge
5159310.short_description: A bunch of Normal Retro Classic games, but what if, you need to change to another game when the Count Down ends. How many Score can you get?

5159830.title: Pack It In!
5159830.short_description: Unload trucks, stack awkward belongings, and squeeze everything into tiny storage units. A satisfying 3D packing puzzle about weird customers, stranger possessions, and making the impossible fit.

5160100.title: STARZ.PEG
5160100.short_description: STARZ.PEG is a Y2K physics roguelike built around chain reactions. Buy blind-box figures called STARZ between rounds, line up your shot, and set off whole rows of abilities to run up the score.

5160480.title: Kingdom Fall
5160480.short_description: A 4-player turn-based fantasy strategy game. Roll the dice to harvest resources from numbered hex tiles, build towns and cities, trade and cast spells, then deploy your armies into massive real-time auto-battles. Five factions, sieges, Survival mode and online play with friends.

5160780.title: Fly Chicken Fly
5160780.short_description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

5160790.title: MoonShot
5160790.short_description: A local coop space arcade game- Shoot your friends while orbiting a variety of celestial bodies. Balance hunting down your friends and staying in a safe orbit while picking up powerups and picking your friends off to win!

5160850.title: Warden's Descent
5160850.short_description: Four-player co-op dungeon crawling with an extraction problem: what you find is only yours once you climb back out. Descend through realms of stone, ice, salt and bone, learn each guardian’s tells, and decide on every floor whether to push on or bank the run.

5160880.title: Current Draw
5160880.short_description: Build an electrical deck, balance loads across three phases, and push your breakers to their limits. Create powerful card and tool synergies, beat escalating score targets, and decide how much risk your panel can handle in this electrical roguelike deckbuilder.

5160910.title: One Bard Move
5160910.short_description: You are a bard the size of a salt shaker, and the kitchen wants you dead. Any jump can end badly, and an exasperated narrator will tell everyone about it. A 3D precision platformer: funny, hard, but fair.

5160920.title: STELLACATCH
5160920.short_description: Catch falling stars with nothing but your cursor. Purify the Eclipses, chain FEVER with your two Star Arts, and climb to the dawn of Layer 5000. Grow your own sky through builds, constellations, observatory decor and sweets in this star-catching action game for night-sky watchers.

5160960.title: ShirocaTriangle
5160960.short_description: Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game. Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

5161060.title: 遗落者（The Lost Ones）
5161060.short_description: Fast-paced Souls-like action RPG. As a Forsaken warrior on a rain-scourged continent, infiltrate the Dark Moon Cult, master attacks, powerful skills, parries and rolls, defeat bosses, explore to unlock stronger weapons and combat styles, and shape the continent through key choices. 4–6 hours.

5161350.title: Hollow Flesh
5161350.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a decaying 1950s psychiatric hospital. You came for your daughter. The building came for you. Explore its wards, solve its locks, relive the past it won't let you forget. Run and hide when it remembers too much.

5161400.title: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
5161400.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

5161410.title: Liminal Depths
5161410.short_description: Liminal pixel horror in an endless place. Wake with no memory, keep the safehouse powered, take jobs from the terminal, and avoid what's waiting past the light. Recover who you are and escape before the Depths take you. Solo or local co-op.

5161940.title: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
5161940.short_description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

5161950.title: HauntedHouseNO14
5161950.short_description: Burdened by debt, you move into an eerie villa, forced to survive for seven days. When night comes, all kinds of uncanny anomalies emerge. Stay alert, track every shift, find what feels wrong, and reveal the horrifying truth hidden in the villa.

5162070.title: LAST WITCH
5162070.short_description: Ten witches marked by fate are drawn to an isolated island to fight until one remains. A single-player Battle royale Simulation on an eroding 6x6 grid. Master 50 weapons and skills to survive, and discover rich story episodes and death records for all 10 witches.

5162100.title: Memory Cruise
5162100.short_description: Test your observation skills aboard the Memory Cruise, a colorful 1920s steamer where the jazz never stops and your partner might swear that vase wasn't blue before! Spot the difference, solo or with a friend.

5162150.title: Deduction Society
5162150.short_description: Seven mystery games in one: Murder Mystery, Identity Hunt (Werewolf), Undercover, Visual Novel, TRPG, Situation Puzzle, Creepypasta. Solo play, no party needed. 20+ roles with AI players, 100+ scripts, 10+ detectives, skill cards for multi-mode deduction.

5162330.title: Taptown Funk
5162330.short_description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

5162560.title: Joy Loader Crew
5162560.short_description: Joy Loader Crew is such a cozy 1-4 player co-op building party game! Hop on excavators and bulldozers to tackle all kinds of construction missions. With cute cartoon graphics and super simple controls, it's perfect for family gatherings or hanging out with friends. Come drive an excavator now!

5162670.title: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
5162670.short_description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces you’ll want to return to after a noisy day.

5162720.title: NABERON
5162720.short_description: Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

5162770.title: Summer for ANT
5162770.short_description: Winter is coming; gather the food scattered around. A cozy job simulator where you play as an ANT. The colony needs calories, and you're their only hope. Lead your colony, hire other ants, unlock upgrades, and collect all the food in 8 different areas to make the summer a breeze!

5162880.title: Live on, Until we can't
5162880.short_description: Between a child's first cry and someone's final breath, a tribe's history takes shape. Place its people in buildings, answer unexpected events, and lead the tribe for as long as it can endure in this turn-based tribal survival rogue-lite.

5163000.title: Object 24
5163000.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a Soviet apartment. By day, explore your home, search for clues, uncover secrets and perform rituals. At night, it becomes a trap — hide, use the environment and defend yourself with whatever you can find. Survive the night and remember what you tried to forget.

5163040.title: Ember
5163040.short_description: A tiny fire sorcerer lives on your desktop. Chat with him (he remembers you), cast spells on any text —translate, summarize, explain—, ask your documents with citations, and defeat spectres by typing. 100% local AI on your NVIDIA RTX 4060+ GPU. No cloud, no account.

5163050.title: RailGame
5163050.short_description: Build track and run trains between cities. Finish missions to earn new trains, wagons, track and ships. Rain, snow and night pass over the map. You can play at your own pace.

5163080.title: Odysseus: Homecoming
