5163080.short_description: A choice-driven story adventure: become Odysseus, hero of the Trojan War, and lead your men home to Ithaca. The choices you make at every turn decide whether your men live or die. Can you make it back to the wife and son waiting for you at home?

5163100.title: Civilization Alchemy
5163100.short_description: Combine two elements and discover the inventions that shaped civilization. Explore 250+ elements across 12 eras, from the Stone Age to the Digital Age, in a relaxing alchemy puzzle.

5163180.title: Cee One Vee
5163180.short_description: Lead your civilization across six thousand years of history in this turn-based strategy game built for the Game Boy Advance. D-pad-first play makes it a natural fit for Steam Deck.

5163240.title: TrackBlitz
5163240.short_description: Three minutes, one track, your best lap counts. Compete against the world on 60 unique tracks with incredible variation. Race your friends and beat their times, climb regional leaderboards and become number one. Customize your car with endless options and show off your awesome ride to the world!

5163340.title: Clobbo
5163340.short_description: A physics brawler where nothing despawns. Every enemy you clobber stays where it fell, and by wave ten you are fighting on top of wave one. Blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

5163380.title: SECTOR GAMMA
5163380.short_description: SECTOR GAMMA - an atmospheric horror simulator set in the Soviet Union, 1968. You are an intern at a secret Soviet facility. Your job: dispose of anomalous waste, fight dangerous robots, and survive on a limited budget. Ready to sign the contract?

5163610.title: Electric Crust: Galactic Pizza Delivery
5163610.short_description: Fifteen stages of side-scrolling arcade shooting, wrapped around the worst pizza delivery route in the galaxy. Bullet patterns, boss tiers, and a rank ladder Ace never asked for. One-time purchase. No ads or data collection.

5163770.title: Sponge Bridges
5163770.short_description: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.

5163840.title: Delve! Die! Repeat!
5163840.short_description: Gather a party from 10 classic fantasy classes, descend through a deadly roguelite dungeon, and fight your way through turn-based battles, random events, and brutal bosses. Every death ends the run, but makes your next attempt stronger. Can you conquer the dungeon?

5163890.title: Hopperstride
5163890.short_description: Hopperstride is an endless 2D platformer where you jump, collect coins, dodge enemies and compete for the best score — solo or with friends in online multiplayer.

5164060.title: Servo The Wildguard
5164060.short_description: A Lock On Shooter Roguelike. Defeat Enemies, collect loot, upgrade your woodland village and make new friends!

5164110.title: Bio Inc. Total Defense
5164110.short_description: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

5164360.title: Flippin' Bottles
5164360.short_description: Flip bottles, stack earnings, and turn a tiny tabletop trick into an automated idle machine. Buy bigger bottles, unlock helpers and prestige for permanent upgrades.

5164400.title: Song of the Stone
5164400.short_description: Craft weapons and armor, imbue them with magical properties, equip your squad and command them in battle to find all the treasures and uncover all the secrets of the "Singing Stone."

5164700.title: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER
5164700.short_description: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER is a fast-paced 2D fighting game with 15 unique fighters, explosive one-on-one combat, cinematic attacks, local versus, training, and a story-driven Prize Fighter mode set in the dangerous world of Velmora.

5164840.title: Kings Cross
5164840.short_description: Rock, paper, scissors, with armies. Command your units, spend your action points, and outthink up to 3 other players in this turn-based digital board game. If you know RPS, you already know how to fight. The hard part is winning.

5164860.title: Horror Doner
5164860.short_description: Step into your late brother's van run a donertruck through haunted cities full of disguised monsters and deadly anomalies among humans. Survive from dusk till dawn by meeting your daily quota and carefully deciding which terrifying customers to feed, and which are deadly traps waiting to devour you.

5165090.title: Tidy To The Max!
5165090.short_description: Cozy first-person tidy-up simulator set in a nostalgic retro game store! Clean dusty cartridges, sort games, VHS tapes, consoles and collectibles, then restore the store to its former glory and create the ultimate retro gaming paradise.

5165230.title: HELL-A
5165230.short_description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

5165390.title: HOOD
5165390.short_description: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.

5165560.title: Floating Paradise
5165560.short_description: Spin, zoom, and explore a handcrafted 3D floating island to find cleverly hidden objects. Floating Paradise is a cozy, free-to-play hidden object game with smooth 360° camera controls, no timers, and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack.

5165580.title: Automotive Tycoon
5165580.short_description: Found a carmaker in 1890 and keep it alive until 2040. Design cars part by part, grow your works from a shed to an assembly line, sell across a world shaped by wars, oil shocks and laws — and spend political capital to bend that history.

5165650.title: Mind the Clown: Reborn
5165650.short_description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

5165680.title: Parasite Core
5165680.short_description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

5165730.title: Whispers of Orange Island
5165730.short_description: Help the dead fulfill their final wishes and say goodbye without being seen by those they loved. Guide wandering spirits across Orange Island in this story-driven 2D top-down stealth puzzle game. Use ancestral tools to protect them and piece together a century of intertwined stories.

5165940.title: Albedo Carta
5165940.short_description: You awaken in a manor with no memory of who you are. Lead a loyal doll and a band of insolent servants through a snowbound land consumed by madness, in search of your lost self. A mesmerizing twist on fairy tales beloved for generations... Märchen Dark Fantasy RPG

5166350.title: One Million Skeletons
5166350.short_description: The dead are coming, thousands at a time. Build a Gothic fortress of ramparts, ballistae and bombards and hold it for nine nights. Every skeleton you break leaves bones behind: grind them into crowns, load them as ammunition, or watch the pile become a ramp over your walls.

5166370.title: Islandry
5166370.short_description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

5166560.title: Oekaki Golf
5166560.short_description: Storybook-style physics golf: hit the ball and draw crayon lines to make platforms! Play the same hole with up to 12 players at once. Help friends with your lines or sabotage rivals with special crayons. Enjoy chaotic fun, solo or together!

5166670.title: No Rest Below
5166670.short_description: Build an underground base, assign survivors to produce resources, and deploy firepower on the surface to hold back ever-stronger zombie hordes. Collect Crystal Cores, research new technologies, and rebuild stronger with each run. Protect your survivors and push for higher waves.

5166830.title: Deadstate Heroes
5166830.short_description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

5166960.title: Pixel Metropolis
5166960.short_description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

5167050.title: FacePunch
5167050.short_description: Face Punch is a 2D fighting game where you create unique fighters from a photo. Customize their look, voice, and personality, then choose skills and design a signature ultimate. Create yourself, friends, or anyone you imagine—and take them into the arena.

5167210.title: Reversed
5167210.short_description: Build your defenses using 15 different types of blocks and survive fifteen waves. You'll earn XP for every wave you survive. Then switch sides and try to destroy your own base. The faster you are, the higher the XP multiplier. Use the XP you've earned to unlock new blocks and cards, and try again.

5167290.title: 小小军团：合战三国
5167290.short_description: 《小小军团：合战三国》（也许是最讲究的战争策略游戏） 千人同屏史诗战场，开疆扩土城市经营。点燃指尖全战，智造掌上三国。

5167360.title: Tiny Kopitiam
5167360.short_description: Tiny Kopitiam is a cozy management sim inspired by Southeast Asian coffee shops. Build your dream shop, hire staffs, then jump inside as the boss. Sit back, relax and watch your dream kopitiam come alive.

5167550.title: MAR: Millions Are Rising
5167550.short_description: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.

5167610.title: Overdepth
5167610.short_description: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.

5167720.title: NERIS ZERO
5167720.short_description: A fast, hard-hitting quarter-view katana roguelite. Cut in three-hit combos, dash in and out, raise your shield. Rewrite how your blade strikes, swing found weapons or turn them into buffs, and chain burn, venom and shock into new swordplay every run. Fall, grow stronger in town, go again.

5167770.title: Clinic Simulator
5167770.short_description: Run your own clinic solo or team up with up to 4 players! Examine patients, diagnose and treat them. Divide the work, make decisions, and build your dream clinic — or at least try to keep the place from falling apart.

5168000.title: AXIDENT
5168000.short_description: Battle your friends in a series of mini games to win the golden axe. May the BEST jack win!

5168200.title: Footbik
5168200.short_description: Fast-paced tactical mini-football for true strategists. Plan your moves, and dominate the pitch with beautiful visuals and realistic ball physics. Every pass matters in this team-based football game.

5168290.title: GearTopia
5168290.short_description: Supply a war you don't fight. A steampunk factory with no wires anywhere: water, steam, shafts and gears. When flat ground runs out, build downward. Fill the orders of dwarven fortresses — they hold only as long as you keep shipping.

5168400.title: GRAVE SLIDE
5168400.short_description: GRAVE SLIDE is a dark-fantasy puzzle roguelike. You have died more times than you can count, and beyond the gates at the top of the Tower you can finally die for good. Slide through rooms built from five ages of the dead, plan every route, and meet the legends who never found their way out.

5168500.title: Wish In One Hand
5168500.short_description: Shovel [REDACTED] into a hole until you die! Use your wits, grit and supreme spirit to clean up [REDACTED] as it arrives in a strange room. [REDACTED], chunks of [REDACTED] and liquid [REDACTED] all generate STENCH. Generate too much STENCH for too long and you will be judged!!

5168740.title: Multiverse Survivors
5168740.short_description: Unlock every universe, then field heroes and skills from different worlds together — dream matchups no history would allow. Einstein raises havoc in the Heavenly Court. Ancient generals hand-build an atom bomb. Odin opens fire with a gun. Sun Wukong fights aliens, and more.

5168790.title: Board Games
5168790.short_description: A board-game collection with dozens of different games from around the world. Create online rooms, play locally, or challenge the AI—pick a board and start.

5169070.title: Get Stronger! Auto‑Chess
5169070.short_description: This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

5169080.title: Found it!: Lost & Found Co.
5169080.short_description: The mafia is forcing you to grow a lost & found business until you find their missing legendary item! Go solo or team up in co-op to unpack deliveries, decipher vague clues, and grab, carry, and throw your way through warehouse chaos.

5169100.title: Xenon Protocol
5169100.short_description: Xenon Protocol is an online co-op roguelite card game (2-6 players) based on synchronization and trust. Travel to real-world nuclear sites, coordinate card plays through a decaying temporal signal, defeat bosses and try to undo an apocalypse. Without saying a word.

5169130.title: Valliberum Memory Challenges
5169130.short_description: Three tabletop memory games on one virtual table. Remember species and colour, plan a nature expedition, or match pairs across a mischievous 8x8 map. Play solo for a high score, locally against a friend, or against the CPU.

5169310.title: Shadows of Hollow Creek
5169310.short_description: Uncover the truth. Survive the night. Hollow Creek is a narrative-driven psychological thriller game where investigative journalism leads Clara Pierce to an isolated town plagued by disappearances, buried secrets, and whispers of a witch. Some stories are better left untold.

5169360.title: Unmess Co.: Rewind the Wreck
5169360.short_description: Inspect the wrecked room, work out what's blocking what, and restore everything in the right order. Activate Rewind, piece broken things back together, and send every object home — preferably without another incident.

5169390.title: UNDERFED
5169390.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

5169450.title: Hexwell
5169450.short_description: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where you use powerful magic spells to fight off hordes of arcane machines. Choose your path through the dungeon, fuse your spells together, create unique builds, and become the ultimate mage. Play solo or local co-op with up to 4 players!

5169510.title: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection
5169510.short_description: Tidy Up 2130 tea boxes with no time limits in this cosy organising game. Read the labels and study the packaging to return every blend to its proper shelf. Organise the shop and help the occasional customer find the tea they want, always at your own peaceful pace.

5169740.title: Ragdoll Fighting Simulator
5169740.short_description: Ragdoll Fighting Simulator is a physics-based 3D active ragdoll fighting game featuring multiple martial arts and weapons. Battle your way through levels or fight for survival in a Battle Royale mode.

5170040.title: Zero Day
5170040.short_description: Zero Day is a short incremental typing game. Type words to destroy enemies, push through twenty stages, beat unique bosses, and unlock a huge perk tree!

5170480.title: Our Little Cinema
5170480.short_description: A cozy 2D job sim where you run the ticket booth of a small-town cinema. Take orders on your tablet, seat customers by their quirks, handle cash and card payments, restock snacks, and choose which movies play tomorrow. Happy guests tip, grumpy ones don't. 🎬🍿

5170820.title: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch
5170820.short_description: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch is an anime RPG combining urban wasteland exploration, companion collection, paper-doll progression, and ATB turn-based combat. Explore the high-pressure city of Tianyuan, collect perks, awaken magical transformations, and craft stories in the built-in editor!

5170870.title: Retroventory
5170870.short_description: Run a second-hand retro game shop. Haggle over every deal, appraise consoles and games, spot counterfeits, and sell to the right customer at the right price. Manage it all from your shop PC: market trends, loans, bills, staff and shady hackers. Earn, upgrade, and build your retro empire.

5170940.title: Street Football: Foul Play
5170940.short_description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

5171080.title: Elven Age
5171080.short_description: An old-school isometric MMORPG with no classes: the weapon in your hand decides what you can do. Train your skills by using them, hunt a hand-crafted world, and risk it all — die and you drop your entire inventory. Party up, found a guild, buy a house, and earn your place.

5171120.title: Ridiculous Racing: Retro Arcade Racer
5171120.short_description: Floor it into the ’80s. Thread the traffic, throw your car into a smoky slide, and hit the turbo toward 600 km/h as bold pixel-art worlds rush at you. Take the other branch next run, or settle it on the couch in 2–4 player split screen.

5171450.title: The Wokest
5171450.short_description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

5171530.title: Space Bunny Shooter
5171530.short_description: Drift through a quiet corner of space. Lift cows from sleeping pastures, mine what glitters, then head home to repair your ship. Gather enough, and one by one, you can bring your kind back.

5171740.title: Desk Hunter
5171740.short_description: Desk Hunter is a desktop idle RPG that keeps battling in a compact window while you work or play. Collect loot, refine equipment through Gear Alchemy, shape builds through skills and growth nodes, fight alongside familiars, and take on higher difficulties.

5171750.title: Stack Zombie Land
5171750.short_description: Stack cards, gather supplies, build defenses, and keep your survivors alive through nightly zombie attacks. Reach the hospital, test vaccines, and discover the cure.

5171920.title: The Devoltion
5171920.short_description: A vengeful ex-cop slices, shoots, and grapples his way through mob-controlled streets to disarm a bomb and save the mayor and city hall before the clock runs out.

5172150.title: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
5172150.short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

5172170.title: Shuffle Lounge
5172170.short_description: Shuffle Lounge brings together 42 card games from around the world. Play solo against CPU opponents or online with friends and other players, with up to six players in supported games. Customize rules and play several games in a row with Shuffle Mode.

5172290.title: Chiki Poki: Rush🎉
5172290.short_description: The cutest cleanup operation in the world. A fast, hands-on incremental game. Take down the copycat "Chippies", collect Star Candy, and keep your Ultimate going forever! Grow stronger with every material you gather — until the "Chippy King" falls!

5172640.title: Kingdom Courier
5172640.short_description: Carry the King's mail across a kingdom that remembers you. Plan routes over a hex map, act on rumors only as good as the village that told you, and choose between the villages who feed you and the crown who pays you. A turn-based strategy roguelite. You can't keep both happy.

5172860.title: Necro Rising
5172860.short_description: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.

5172940.title: ICEWAKE
5172940.short_description: Steer a nuclear icebreaker across a frozen, sunken world. Dive a tiny sub into drowned cities for salvage, save the sick in underwater towns — and survive what hunts in the deep: a monster that hatches from the dead, grows, and one day comes for your ship.

5173270.title: ZomBMart
5173270.short_description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

5173320.title: Muscle Girl Lexy: My Personal Trainer
5173320.short_description: Meet Lexy, a powerful and muscular personal trainer. Train together, face unexpected events, and grow closer as you discover the softer side hidden beneath her cool exterior in this gym-themed romance visual novel.

5173690.title: Night Class
5173690.short_description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

5173700.title: Holiday Decorator
5173700.short_description: Decorate the Christmas trees of your dreams in your own cozy little shop. Pick any tree and fill it with hundreds of ornaments, lights, garlands and presents, exactly the way you like, while a curious kitten watches you work.

5173750.title: Arclore
5173750.short_description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

5173970.title: Mr. Panas
5173970.short_description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

5174120.title: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
5174120.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

5174190.title: Tiny Trains
5174190.short_description: Draw tracks, mix colours and guide every train to its matching station. Tiny Trains is a colourful railway logic puzzler with handcrafted challenges. Plan your routes, test your solution and keep refining until everything clicks.

5174310.title: Too Many Cards: Tidy Up Your Monster Sanctuary
5174310.short_description: Organize thousands of collectible cards in this relaxing first-person sorting simulator! Discover categories, place cards in the correct display cases, earn points, and unlock upgrades. Transform a messy sanctuary into a perfectly organized collection!

5174380.title: The Turing Choice
5174380.short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

5174640.title: GEOMETRY NEXUS
5174640.short_description: Geometry Nexus is a neon action roguelike where your weapons fire automatically. Dodge enemy swarms, collect upgrades, trigger Overdrive, grow stronger between runs, and survive ten minutes to defeat the Nexus Guardian.

5174690.title: D for Defender
5174690.short_description: A Tower Defense with no respite, no waves, no end. Facing monsters that learn from your placements and adapt in real time to every one of your weaknesses, build and upgrade your defenses freely to create the perfect trap.

5174820.title: Royal Triple Defense
5174820.short_description: Build a thriving fantasy kingdom on one side of the screen and hold the gate on the other. Merge three units into one, send it across the bridge, and place it where your line needs it. Each night brings a deadlier horde, and you choose which monsters join it. Survive until dawn.

5174840.title: Cat and Dog: Princess Guardians
5174840.short_description: Dark demons swept across the entire continent, and the princess embarked on the road of escape. Along the way, she encountered many cats and dogs that had been ostracized and abandoned by the world. In the end, these cats and dogs voluntarily transformed into guard towers to protect the princess

5174850.title: Relocate Motorhomes Simulator
5174850.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

5174900.title: KittenRush
5174900.short_description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

5174910.title: A Risky Rocky Resort
5174910.short_description: Manage your resort and "win big" in an action packed resort sim. Cater to resort patrons, dismantle fallen robots for upgrades, and complete your resort. Payback your debts with the help of Uncle Richie. Become an unstoppable money making machine. Get stupid rich.

5175080.title: Potion Master
5175080.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's potion shop and make it your own. Chop, squeeze, and grind ingredients to brew potions — stick to the recipe, or experiment and discover new formulas. Build your reputation, attract mighty heroes bearing rare ingredients, and decorate your shop with curious trophies.

5175190.title: Io Resort MMO
5175190.short_description: A classic real-time text MMO sandbox reborn in full 3D. Pilot your hovercart through the luxury hotels of Io Resort under the looming presence of Jupiter. Run missions, build drone fleets, fight alien invaders, and trade your way up — in a persistent world that runs whether you're there or not.

5175800.title: Spintal
5175800.short_description: The sun is gone. Help Atlas keep the world powered in this physics-based incremental game. Smash atoms together, collect quanta and upgrade your reactor. Turn a few small collisions into an ever-growing source of energy.

5175840.title: The Extractors
5175840.short_description: A co-op horror experience where you and your team explore dangerous environments, collect valuable items, and fight to survive. Work together, take risks, and make it back before it’s too late.

5176020.title: Veil of Time
5176020.short_description: Raine's brother is missing, and his uncle has handed him the family sword. Fight in real time on the field, where a perfect parry drops the world to pencil, or let foes close in for turn-based battles with timed strikes. A JRPG with hand-painted maps, a 32-track score and optional voices.

5176050.title: Tavern: Tidy Up
5176050.short_description: Warm, handcrafted-looking environments with a medieval atmosphere Barrels, bread, goblets, meat, pots, and many other diverse items Relaxing room-to-room gameplay An inn that expands and unlocks new areas as you clean Character upgrades Pressure-free and stress-free gaming experience

5176070.title: Bush League Baseball
5176070.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, nine ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, race go-karts between innings and play for the World Series. One or two players.

5176290.title: Cleanup Wizard
5176290.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

5176390.title: Sticky Floors
5176390.short_description: A bartender sim roguelite. Ditch the corporate grind and run the family dive bar. Pour, mix, slide and serve the townsfolk and a few stranger patrons while cards & dice rewrite the rules every night. Survive 30 nights to earn the deed. Pickled eggs, cats, vomit, and attitude. Enough said.

5176520.title: Down to Floor Zero
5176520.short_description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

5176610.title: Ultracapitalism
5176610.short_description: Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where cash is your health and debt is your weapon. Assemble a 10-slot board of corporate assets, customize synergies with buzzwords, and auto-battle rival founders in deterministic asynchronous boardroom combat.

5177030.title: Demon Crisis
5177030.short_description: A fast, ridiculous On-Rails Arcade Shooter about two government employees fighting through a demon-infested office. Play Solo or in Two-Player Co-Op using a mouse, controller, or any modern USB Lightgun.

5177050.title: Cartomancer Cafe
5177050.short_description: Cartomancer Cafe is an exquisite Tarot reading experience that teaches you how to be a Tarot Reader. Receive readings with our quirky and insightful reader personalities and beautiful custom Tarot decks. And battle the forces of Darkness (or Light) in our Tarot card battle game!

5177150.title: Fallen Nights
5177150.short_description: Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. A top-down zombie survival defense game where every piece of scrap buys firepower or escape. Combine turrets, mines, and weapon upgrades, then fight beside your camp across varied locations and escalating night attacks.

5177680.title: Blindfold Bash
5177680.short_description: Don't make a sound! Blindfold Bash is a hide-and-seek party game where the seeker is blindfolded and hunts by ear. Every creaky floorboard, squeaky toy and badly timed fart lights up their screen. Stay quiet, fool the seeker, sacrifice a friend. Play with friends or in public matches, 2-20 players.

5177730.title: A Hundred Light Years
5177730.short_description: A text-based space survival game inspired by The Oregon Trail. Lead your family 100 light-years across deep space to a distant colony. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it. Some things out there are worse than death.

5177880.title: Code Grid
5177880.short_description: Place instructions on a grid, plan the path, and let the machine follow your logic. CodeGrid is a programming puzzle game with no traditional coding required—use simple commands to build loops, conditions, and data processing, then create increasingly complex programs within a limited space.

5178240.title: Just Weeding
5178240.short_description: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

5178270.title: AI Startup Simulator
5178270.short_description: AI Startup Simulator is a first-person business management simulation. Start in a cramped storefront, assemble your own servers, and turn client work into a growing AI business.

5178310.title: School Girl RPG
5178310.short_description: Mio was just an ordinary schoolgirl until an accident on her commute transported her to another world. There, she is hailed as the chosen Hero! To find a way back home, she must fulfill her heroic destiny. She must defeat the Demon Emperor and her wicked subordinates who plot to conquer the realm!

5178460.title: UNDELIVERED
5178460.short_description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

5178640.title: Warwake
5178640.short_description: Take the helm of a WWII battleship in this naval combat game as you steer, manage your speed, and lay your main guns by hand, fighting ship-to-ship duels where turning broadside triples your guns and doubles the target you present.

5178940.title: Gravith
5178940.short_description: Gravith is a high-difficulty score attack game. Use the gravity of your mouse cursor (planet) to alter the path of incoming missiles and destroy targets. However, if a missile hits your planet, it's an instant game over. Experience high-risk gameplay where one slip-up ends it all.

5178950.title: Tilemancer
5178950.short_description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

5179000.title: 八部寛のホームページ
5179000.short_description: A night shift job paying 88,888 yen a day. Your task is to monitor 'Hiroshi Hachibe's Homepage' on the office PC. If you spot an anomaly, destroy the PC; if everything looks normal, just clock out. Survive all 8 days without missing a single anomaly.

5179050.title: Chalk Door
5179050.short_description: A 1999 museum under renovation has become a shifting nightmare. Team up with up to 4 players, draw passageways with chalk, recover lost research files, and extract before the quota expires in this co-op survival horror.

5179110.title: PixelPainter 95
5179110.short_description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. An incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

5179360.title: Little Storm
5179360.short_description: A classic, orthodox JRPG in which you gather a "family" of non-blood relatives along your journey. An adventure for adults that depicts two paths of growth and two inner struggles.

5179440.title: Mad Combo Squad
5179440.short_description: The maddest combos you’ve ever seen! Mad Combo Squad is a classic, tactical in-line auto-battler featuring charming pixel-art heroes. Assemble your ultimate squad to create the perfect build.

5179550.title: Trash Inc.
5179550.short_description: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

5179790.title: Undersea Post Office Sim
5179790.short_description: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

5179820.title: Goblins Gotta Go
5179820.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

5180210.title: Ministry of Time
5180210.short_description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

5180240.title: SkinJack
5180240.short_description: In this sci-fi multiplayer game, six Parasites hide among eighteen NPCs, while one Overseer watches from above. Infiltrate, impersonate, and outsmart your opponents in this asymmetric multiplayer game of deception, surveillance, and deduction.

5180370.title: Qrack
5180370.short_description: Qruack turns your desktop into a relaxing duck pond. Work, meet, or space out while your new companions hang out at the bottom of your screen. over 60 ducks will keep you company either way.

5180460.title: Arithmeria
5180460.short_description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

5180580.title: The Inconvenience Store
5180580.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

5180640.title: Move The Freak Out!
5180640.short_description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

5180730.title: Corner Store Simulator
5180730.short_description: Run the last independent store on a street with two rivals who undercut you daily. Every product has its own breaking point — one markup never works. Order stock, stack shelves, set prices, and count the till at close. Beat them, or watch them take your street.

5180930.title: The Last Ranger: End of days
5180930.short_description: The Last Ranger is a dark fantasy top-down survival shooter where you fight off huge waves of enemies, stack mid-round upgrades to buff yourself up and do your best to survive the night. Make the most of the permanent mastery system to make each run more rewarding, then take bosses down in style!

5180940.title: Cozy Cups VR : Barista Simulator
5180940.short_description: Enjoy the career of a barista in VR. Manage your own custom cafe, brew 15+ hot and cold drinks, decorate every corner, and make the entire city your customer!

5181050.title: Head Miner
5181050.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger!

5181110.title: Quicksant
5181110.short_description: A retro ant colony sim where your ants think for themselves. Place pheromone trails and your ants dig, haul, and build on their own, following the scent to work, food, or danger. Tunnel through a fully destructible world, farm the surface, outgrow the rival ant colony, and survive the dangers.

5181280.title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
5181280.short_description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms and Poolrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

5181340.title: In Between
5181340.short_description: Three stories. An emotional game about the stories we live in between certain chapters of our lives and the chance to make new choices, reliving those moments.

5181530.title: Too Deep To Stop
5181530.short_description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

5181760.title: Fishy Bar: Hook, Cook & Serve
5181760.short_description: Settle into life by the lake in a first-person fishing and bar-management adventure where you set the pace. Turn your daily catch into meals for your guests, grow your bar, and get to know the eccentric locals as you explore the lakes and unravel the mystery beneath them.

5182080.title: Dustwire
5182080.short_description: The machines took over Wirehaven, a bright overgrown city, and now they hunt you. Drop in solo or in a squad of up to 3, loot, fight hunter drones and giant machine bosses, beat rival squads to extraction... or lose everything except the one item in your Safe Pocket.

5182240.title: Unreported Shift
5182240.short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

5182350.title: Walls Were Built to Fall
5182350.short_description: Walls Were Built to Fall is an epic scale incremental FPS horde defense roguelite. Build your defenses, draft defenders, discover crazy builds, and hold back millions of enemies.

5182490.title: The Bakery
5182490.short_description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recepies, kitchen furniture, Decoration and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

5182680.title: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
5182680.short_description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

5182820.title: Decksplorer
5182820.short_description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

5183070.title: TideBox
5183070.short_description: TideBox is a 2D physics sandbox where you can mess around with liquids and see what happens. Build stuff, dig tunnels, make rivers, flood entire areas, mix things together, or just dump a ton of liquid somewhere and watch the chaos unfold.

5183090.title: Inside your hole
5183090.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

5183200.title: Mossu
5183200.short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

5183220.title: Pencil Shavings Soup
5183220.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

5183830.title: SPEARHEAD
5183830.short_description: Eastern Front, 1944. Command the entire battle as a commander — then climb into your ace tank and fight it out yourself. real penetration physics where armor thickness, impact angle, and ammunition decide everything. WW2 RTS and tank simulation collide in a single battle.

5183890.title: Will it Stand?
5183890.short_description: Disaster strikes! With a limited budget, build structures, mechanisms, and defenses to protect your beaver from earthquakes, floods, mudslides, meteors, and enemy attacks. Brace, absorb, divert, defend—there is no single answer. If it is still standing when the disaster is over, it worked.

5183930.title: Abductables
5183930.short_description: An incremental roguelite in a vintage sci-fi comic. Pilot a flying saucer, beam up whole crowds of farmers, cows, cops and soldiers, stack them for huge combo payouts, and bank permanent upgrades before the army fills the sky. Every run sends a stronger saucer back to Earth.

5183970.title: Plamo Kits
5183970.short_description: Plamo is Japanese for plastic model kits. Snip parts from the runner, snap them together, and finish them with paint, panel lining, edge highlights, decals, and weathering. Build 30+ original kits, from mechs and racers to spacecraft and jets, then pose them, set up dioramas, and fill your shelves.

5184070.title: Floor 13: Onryo
5184070.short_description: You are trapped in a hotel with an Onryo. You must keep an eye out for anomalies she uses to delude you to find a way to escape.

5184250.title: Rehang: A Museum Sorting Game
5184250.short_description: Rehang is a cozy first-person organizing game. The museum owns 1,279 real paintings, and every one of them is on the floor: work out who painted each canvas by its brushwork, hang it on that painter's wall, and unlock abilities that speed up the search.

5184310.title: Spuskaemsa!
5184310.short_description: A cooperative roguelike looter-shooter (1–4 players). Descend into the infinite Buffer, explore procedurally generated floors, scavenge for supplies, and battle its inhabitants. Rescue your comrades and upgrade your elevator. Godspeed!

5184390.title: Stupid Tankers
5184390.short_description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

5184420.title: ねこっとラーメン
5184420.short_description: 異世界に転生したあなたが得たスキルは「カップラーメンを出す」！？猫の獣人たちが暮らす世界で出会った女の子・ユズと、成り行きで始めたお店を営業する調理シミュレーション。注文に合う商品を選び、かやくやスープを入れ、お湯の量と待ち時間を見極めて一杯を仕上げましょう。複数のお客さんを同時に迎え、それぞれの調理時間と待ち時間を管理。日ごとに変わる注文傾向や制限を乗り越えた先で、物語は複数の結末へ分岐します。

5184500.title: F-2 MISSIONS: CASE ONE
5184500.short_description: A physics-based flight sim with authentic handling: the JASDF's F-2 over a true-to-scale Japan. As a rookie on a special course, train from takeoffs to valley runs, formation, refueling and US carrier traps, then fly alert scrambles and ops training against simulated SAMs. On a monitor or in VR.

5184820.title: Keep The Circle Alive
5184820.short_description: An incremental game about protecting a tiny circle. Destroy endless waves of enemies, earn resources, stack upgrades, watch the numbers climb, and turn your circle into an unstoppable machine.

5184980.title: Escape From Argos 7
5184980.short_description: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

5185030.title: Boba Escape
5185030.short_description: Get ready for an adorable yet brutal climb! You play as a tiny boba pearl trying to escape a giant bubble tea. Aim, charge, and launch your way to the top in this cute but challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, and one tiny mistake could send you tumbling all the way back down!

5185200.title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
5185200.short_description: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

5185340.title: Tidy Solve
5185340.short_description: Tidy Solve is a cozy puzzle game about tidying piles of books, candles and more. Use the power of math to bring order to the mess. Easy to learn, with 1500+ puzzles to solve.

5185380.title: Greediest Landlord
5185380.short_description: Become a Dark Landlord in this Incremental game to purge human settlements in your domain. Convert trespassers into fuel for your dark arts. Cast plagues, drain souls, raise legions of minions, and expand your corrupted land to unleash chaos. Invoke the Dark God to reclaim your solitude once more

5185530.title: Keylings
5185530.short_description: You start with one key. You end up with an entire keyboard covered in keylings hopping across it. Buy keys, hire critters, unleash storms and watch the numbers climb to absurd heights in this laid-back incremental with mechanical keyboard sounds.

5185610.title: PERIHELIA
5185610.short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

5185720.title: Inbox Duel
5185720.short_description: You're the new intern, and the only weapon you have is email. Duel your coworkers with passive-aggressive cards until they get fired, then come for your boss's job. Inbox Duel is a roguelike deckbuilder about climbing the office one promotion at a time.

5185900.title: Divinestead
5185900.short_description: Grow one small village into a large settlement, manage resources, find riches, overpower enemies and get holy upgrades in this incremental idler game!

5186010.title: Bloomery
5186010.short_description: A first-person horde survival game where every fight helps revive an underground city. Wield powerful fantasy weapons and spells, protect a growing plant, build defenses, and turn a dangerous ruin into a living city.

5186020.title: Crash Relay
5186020.short_description: Up to 10 players. Two players per car. Share the controls, grab weapons and powers, and sabotage rival teams in Crash Relay, a chaotic multiplayer racing game where teamwork is the key to reaching the finish line.

5186090.title: Idle Digger Bots Deluxe
5186090.short_description: A sci-fi idle and automation game where you manage mining bots to dig deep and sell resources.

5186140.title: Wishknot
5186140.short_description: Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this medieval physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

5186160.title: Mow The Planet
5186160.short_description: Start on Mum's back lawn and keep going: the street, the city, the planet, then the Moon, Mars and every world after that. Mow ground that stays mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and run a mowing company big enough to stripe the solar system.

5186310.title: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
5186310.short_description: You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world. Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope. A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

5186410.title: Hist Maker: ReMake
5186410.short_description: A world history you can play. Combine people, events and ideas (Emperor Napoleon + Britain = Trafalgar) to rebuild 69 eras, from antiquity to the early 20th century. Every discovery fills in the era's panorama. Build your own levels with mods, history or not, and share them on the Workshop.

5186570.title: Flat Earth Runner
5186570.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

5186730.title: Lexiclue
5186730.short_description: Video game trivia crosswords. Items, NPCs, locations, mechanics, designers, and terms pulled out of hundreds of worlds; the vocabulary that comes with playing and lore. Built for gamers who notice the minutiae in their games.

5186840.title: Boat Trip
5186840.short_description: Pilot your boat through swarming schools of fish in this naval action roguelite. Combine weapons, upgrade your ship and face colossal bosses, solo or in 1~4 online co-op.

5186960.title: Graveheart
5186960.short_description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

5186990.title: Edenfinity
5186990.short_description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

5187040.title: Ante Inferno
5187040.short_description: The poker RPG. ANTE INFERNO is a roguelite card battler where you play poker hands as attacks, tear through hell with forty class abilities, and stack boons until the damage counter gives up on digits.

5187090.title: Evergather: Meadowcraft
5187090.short_description: Build your paradise in a medieval village! Master the rhythm of tending crops, then dive into a rich gathering and crafting economy. Harvest magical materials, forge your tools, and design a vibrant countryside retreat in this 3D top-down sandbox.

5187180.title: GraveFeast
5187180.short_description: The curse drains your life with every passing second. The only cure is blood. Charge into the horde, gather them, and tear them apart to drink deep. In GraveFeast, low health isn't a reason to run. It's a reason to go deeper.

5187610.title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations
5187610.short_description: Run a childcare plant where babies spend their first year in automated care. Build conveyor networks for feeding, sleep, hygiene, and play. As babies grow, their needs change. Keep your factory efficient while adapting to each child's unique reactions.

5187740.title: The Useless Game
5187740.short_description: A completely useless videogame that politely asks you not to download it.

5187990.title: The Royal Restoration Society
5187990.short_description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

5188190.title: Catacrawl
5188190.short_description: A fast action roguelike about a cat and a horde that never stops. Your skills fire where you aim, and a run is ten to fourteen minutes with two bosses. Three cats, nine skill trees, generated maps, quests, loot with uniques - and permanent progress, so every death still gets you somewhere.

5188200.title: Dead Man's Pass
5188200.short_description: The dead cast no shadow. Guard the gate to the afterlife in this checkpoint horror game, catching demons grinning inside your sacred mirror and living trespassers weighing down the river ferry before one bad stamp comes back to haunt your next night.

5188230.title: Ashram Online
5188230.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram Online is a classic tab-target MMORPG: four lineages, three eternal paths, real bosses and a first dungeon to solve. Fully voiced in 7 languages, with controller support. Earn everything. No pay-to-win.

5188360.title: Sushi Gacha: Auto Battler
5188360.short_description: Gacha-powered auto battler, ten minutes a run. Spin for sushi figures, line up four on the counter, and watch them fight lineups other players left behind. Stack copies for stars, blend two into a new kind, beat a chef boss every fourth round. No paid gacha, no timers.

5188390.title: Honey, Tidy the Basement
5188390.short_description: Honey, Tidy the Basement! is a cozy organization simulator where an earthquake has knocked over 2,880 console games all over your basement. Pick up each game case, sort them by console, and return them to their correct shelf as you unlock handy abilities to speed up your organizing.

5188430.title: We Will Die For You
5188430.short_description: Destroy & defeat disease in an incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Fight disease, earn Protein, die, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

5188450.title: Your Usual
5188450.short_description: A small bar, one bartender, and a conversation that picks up where you left it. Mara runs the place, pours what you ask for, and remembers you between visits — all of it running on your own machine. No account, no cloud, no one else listening in.

5188480.title: Ball and Stick
5188480.short_description: Two bodies, one connection. Roll, swing and launch a Ball and Stick through a physics-driven sci-fi adventure, alone or with friends, and cause chaos with wild attachments

5188550.title: Desmarchon
5188550.short_description: Drag a chain through drifting Anomalies and let go to burst them. Build around longer chains, drones, or automatic weapons in this sci-fi survivor-like. Fly 16 Campaign operations, then take your ship into 30 Deep Space destinations, including endless Shardwake.

5188610.title: Goblins vs Poop
5188610.short_description: A short Tower Defense game about a bunch of underdog, upgradeable Gobbos who gotta destroy countless waves of magical turds in the sewers under a Mage City. It's got silly toilet humor and cute retro goblin vibes!

5188730.title: M.A.M.M.O.N.
5188730.short_description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

5188820.title: TOP CUT: Locals to Worlds
5188820.short_description: he card-game tournament roguelike. Build your deck, play powerful cards, and turn clever combos into match-winning plays. Counter opponents with hand traps, upgrade your favorites into shimmering foils, and climb from the local card shop toward being world champ

5188920.title: Dangerous Delivery
5188920.short_description: As summer vacation is almost over, schoolgirl Rina still has one final assignment left: part-time job experience. Not knowing where to look, she spots a delivery job ad that says “No age limit, flexible hours!” So Rina decides to start her delivery work…!

5188940.title: Century of Conquest
5188940.short_description: Hex-grid auto battles × spell cards × hero progression. Recruit an army and deploy your formation, then watch units move and fight automatically while you cast spells to turn the tide. Level up your hero, collect relics, and conquer a three-layer campaign of sieges and bosses.

5188960.title: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm
5188960.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

5189030.title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
5189030.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

5189080.title: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions
5189080.short_description: The immortal path begins in Qi Refinement. In this desktop idle RPG, up to three cultivators battle on their own. Choose their techniques, forge equipment, and open the chests won along the way. Gather cultivation and prepare for the next breakthrough.

5189380.title: United Skies FlightSimulator
5189380.short_description: Get in the pilot seat and explore the United States from coast to coast. Skim the canyon floor in the Grand Canyon, pull off daring aerobatics over Los Angeles, or simply cruise along and watch the country unfold beneath your wings. The sky is yours.

5189540.title: Hemolysis
5189540.short_description: 《Hemolysis》 is an idle game with a distinctive flair. As you awaken, a strange plague has already ravaged this crumbling land—and continues to gnaw at it still. Driven by hunger and hopelessness, you must venture again into this world, at once known and alien, to find any means of staying alive.

5189920.title: Minya in the Sky
5189920.short_description: You’ll control Minya as she takes on the graduation exam at Sky Magic Academy, aiming to pass the exam and graduate. If you defeat a host of enemies and take down the final boss, Minya will graduate successfully. This game focuses primarily on third-person combat and treasure hunting.

5189950.title: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
5189950.short_description: Fly into a brand-new Winx Club adventure! Play as Bloom, transform, take flight, and freely explore an open world inspired by the series. Unravel the mystery of the Festival of the 100 Moons.

5190040.title: Pachinko Mayhem
5190040.short_description: Pachinko Mayhem brings arcade ball-drops and Japanese pachinko to your screen with wild roguelite builds: a serious machine full of chaotic balls. Early Access launches with 3 core machines, expanding to 6 bespoke physical toys. Cash out safely, or break the bank?

5190290.title: Growing Knight
5190290.short_description: Growing Knight is an incremental game of timing and positioning where you fight monsters, upgrade your skills and go for another run until you become unstoppable. Learn skills, spells and hire retinue to fight with you.

5190300.title: Fire To Mine
5190300.short_description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

5190390.title: Yule Dads
5190390.short_description: Yule Dads is a chaotic multiplayer Christmas party game. Gather your friends and trick, grind, and race through the mall to win the last presents before closing time.

5190820.title: Sticker Chaos
5190820.short_description: Sticker Chaos is a relaxing first-person game. Peel thousands of sticky notes, explore locations, find secrets, earn money, upgrade your skills, play mini-games, and even draw on stickers!

5191020.title: Grass Cutting Game
5191020.short_description: Grow a little patch of grass into a bustling garden in this cute incremental farming game. Harvest, recruit Softlings and draw their routes. Lay Fungal Mats, combine mushroom effects and spend your coins on upgrades that make every harvest more rewarding.

5191050.title: Mammalarium
5191050.short_description: Relax and collect over 500 unique mammals in this cozy idle game. Watch babies grow into magnificent adults in real-time, customize warm woodland habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from tiny shrews to great whales.

5191090.title: Aegis Vanguard
5191090.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

5191150.title: ViRtual Mass Human
5191150.short_description: ViRtual Mass Human is a VR sandbox where you can interact with AI-powered characters that respond naturally and build your own worlds. Experience the feeling of characters truly being there. Freely place objects and create your own unique VR experiences.

5191220.title: Symloquy
5191220.short_description: Meet Xuanxuan in Symloquy, a sound novel with AI dialogue. The Fading slowly erodes her memories and sense of self, while your conversations bring an Echo that helps her stay lucid. As you grow closer, discover her past and perhaps hear what she usually keeps to herself.

5191240.title: Tidy Up The Christmas Shop
5191240.short_description: Tidy up a cozy Christmas shop solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op! Find, carry and sort thousands of festive objects across 765 item types. Upgrade your gift sack, unlock a little Christmas magic, and bring order to the holiday chaos, one shelf at a time.

5191260.title: Isle of Cards
5191260.short_description: Isle of Cards is a strategy deckbuilder where you build up your island by playing cards. Draw cards and place tiles to level up your island before time runs out. Create unique decks by unlocking new cards and completing challenges.

5191290.title: MUTINY!
5191290.short_description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

5191330.title: Take That Shot
5191330.short_description: You're a basketball. Roll, charge-jump and dash up a tower of floating junk, squash your friends on the way, and try to sink a shot at the top. Up to 8 players with voice chat.

5191410.title: Croissant Simulator
5191410.short_description: Manage your own croissant restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, purchase ingredients, manage your inventory, and keep your customers happy. No distractions—just a focused, single-player croissant simulation.

5191620.title: Stack & Spell
5191620.short_description: A cozy magical tidy-up game about collecting, identifying, and organizing enchanted cards. Learn their secrets, master the archive's classification system, and turn magical chaos into perfect order.

5191710.title: Muritura
5191710.short_description: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

5191950.title: Neon Bastion
5191950.short_description: You build the road the invaders walk. Lay their path piece by piece, then line it with towers, traps and fused war machines. A roguelite tower defense with a new build every run, 18 hand-made missions, co-op for up to 4 players online, on one couch or with bots, and head-to-head Versus.

5192260.title: Magic Crystal TD
5192260.short_description: Magic Crystal TD mixes tower defense with resource management. Build roads to resource points, send familiars to haul red, yellow, blue crystals, refine advanced ones, and swap them on Magic Crystal Bases for varied defenses. Face shifting nature, wield Blessings, destroy nests to win!

5192300.title: Ganja Ricochet: Cut Kush. Make Cash.
5192300.short_description: A chaotic 3D pinball-pachinko game: cut Kush, build combos, unlock 12 scissors, 12 plants, 12 pots, tons of upgrades, and defeat 4 Boss Plants.

5192520.title: Diecast Car Restoration
5192520.short_description: Disassemble, clean, and restore forgotten diecast cars! Strip off old paint and rust, apply custom colors and decals, and upgrade parts to create one-of-a-kind builds. Build your dream home collection wall and showcase your models in detailed scale dioramas.

5192740.title: Exoplanet Settlers
5192740.short_description: A turn-based 4X space strategy game built around deep logistics and open-space movement. Use cosmic geography to your advantage, disrupt enemy supply networks, custom-build your fleets, and construct interconnected planetary complexes to conquer the galaxy.

5192760.title: Tinker's Nook
5192760.short_description: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

5193040.title: Seagrid Nightfall
5193040.short_description: Shove skeletons overboard and into the Storm King's lightning in this turn-based pirate tactics roguelite. Every enemy attack is shown before it lands. Lead three pirates through the night, keep your battered ship afloat, and fight to see the dawn.

5193240.title: CARNOR CITY
5193240.short_description: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKULTRA agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

5193260.title: Oblivion 2666
5193260.short_description: A slipstream magical realist visual novella about an outsider, a borrowed camera, and a city that no longer matches its own photographs—told through literary prose and ever-shifting, textured cinematic presentation.

5193280.title: Offering Accepted
5193280.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

5193620.title: Turtle Soup World
5193620.short_description: Turtle Soup World – lateral-thinking mystery game. Each chapter: one strange case. Explore, inspect, question NPCs, ask the host Yes/No/Both questions to find the truth. Works with local LLM or API.

5193680.title: No Man's Idle
5193680.short_description: Endless stars, idle fingertips. Harvest planet resources, research exploration tech, and warp your ship across the galaxy — one step at a time toward the Galactic Center.

5193770.title: Koishi’s Fishing Journal
5193770.short_description: A Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game starring Koishi Komeiji. Relax and fish, collect varied fish and rare merfolk, cook ordinary fish, gather precious merfolk ingredients, and sell dishes. Keep upgrading and unlocking your collection as Koishi’s fishing life unfolds on your desktop.

5193810.title: Silicon Empire: Chip Tycoon
5193810.short_description: Pick up a few blocks, build a CPU core, and put your cores and cache together to make your own processor. Drop that chip into a laptop you built yourself, fire up a game, and see how many frames per second your hardware can push.

5193830.title: spin boom boom
5193830.short_description: Toggle pivot points via key presses, dodge collisions, and take on the ultimate test of timing and precision.

5193840.title: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE)
5193840.short_description: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE) is a PvPvE tactical VR FPS shooter with vehicles, to include a functioning C130 Gunship. Up to 3 teams battle over different maps to hold a trophy for 3 minutes to win the match. SEIYGE includes weapon attachments, revives and a Zombie mode for each map.

5193960.title: There Is Eternal War
5193960.short_description: An RTS game set in a dark sci-fi fantasy universe where you command thousands of units on a huge map without breaking your PC. Dystopian humans, evil elves, greedy dwarves, or relentless undead are all playable factions in a game that has a grand campaign and two story campaigns.

5194210.title: Wink Mafia
5194210.short_description: Pet the cat, bluff your friends, and pray your drink isn't poisoned. Wink Mafia is a chaotic 3D social deduction party tournament. Kill with a lethal wink, execute rivals with the golden gun, or brawl in the streets—where innocent card games turn into deadly mob chaos. Play with friends or smart AI!

5194370.title: Byte Bistro
5194370.short_description: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

5194380.title: FLATBED
5194380.short_description: Seven years ago the Void opened over the Rim and the gates appeared. You are a pilot with a debt, a worn-out ship and a signal that repeats every 402 seconds using your hull number. Fly, trade, fight, rebuild your ship piece by piece and decide who gets left behind. A single-player space action RPG.

5194390.title: WildScore
5194390.short_description: Take coins, buy animal cards, and race to the winning score. WildScore is a turn-based tabletop game in a sunlit courtyard. Play solo against bots, pass-and-play locally, or invite a friend on Steam. Up to four players.

5194600.title: Face Picka
5194600.short_description: Play board games with friends using faces you draw yourself! FacePicka is a board game café simulation where you create your own faces, enjoy fun mini-games, pull pranks, and switch expressions as you play.

5194900.title: Slime on Top
5194900.short_description: An epic auto-battling RPG unveils right in the corner of your desktop! Watch your slime push through endless floors and crush giant bosses, or team up for thrilling 4-player co-op! Combine deep star charts, class trees, and loyal buddies to craft your ultimate build.

5194980.title: Splitter
5194980.short_description: Shoot or slice through swarms of shapes, bank the pieces and build a stronger weapon. A pixel arcade incremental: short charge-limited runs, one connected upgrade board, and a Boss fight at the end of every chapter.

5195050.title: Stack Inspector
5195050.short_description: Stack objects in first person, defy gravity, and become the ultimate inspector at OddFrame Industries. Every piece matters, every mistake has a price, and every collapsing tower is the perfect excuse to try again.

5195150.title: Mono Tape
5195150.short_description: REMEMBER! You can't escape the guilt, can you? You must remember and face the truth. Are you the one to blame? There is one way to untangle your mind: collect lost tapes, repair corrupted recordings, and watch your past. But be careful who you trust. Even yourself.

5195190.title: Lairs & Lordships
5195190.short_description: This time the towers shoot at you. Lairs & Lordships is a reverse tower defense game: plan your monster horde’s assault wave by wave, break seven human fortresses, raise lairs where their keeps stood, then hold the land when the kingdom raids back.

5195330.title: Blind Person Simulator
5195330.short_description: Blind Person Simulator can help you understand how an everyday person with blindness can live trough the day. Limited vision, endless possibilities, hard achievements, recipe for a good simulator.

5195430.title: DriftyLands
5195430.short_description: A first-person base-building and automation game: gather resources, build machines and rail lines, and sell what you make to buy new islands. A dungeon waits to be explored under every island you buy. Play solo or with friends, up to 4 players.

5195560.title: Pocket Dynasty
5195560.short_description: Coach an American football team in modern-retro pixel art. Call every play, hand the headset to your coordinators, or take the snap yourself. Draft rookies, bring legends back as coaches, chase a title, and challenge a friend on one PC or online.

5195880.title: Where Did I Park?
5195880.short_description: You forgot where you parked. Unfortunately, there are 99,999 cars exactly like yours. Search the parking lot, rule out the wrong cars, collect valuables and slowly improve your chances of finding the right one.

5196120.title: Stalkers Strand
5196120.short_description: You're only here to fill your scavenging quota, sweeping the dark shoreline with your metal detector for lost trinkets. But the beach belongs to something else at night. Tread carefully, or Stalkers Strand will claim yet another victim.

5196210.title: Modoolo
5196210.short_description: Puzzle your way through the Modoolo factory. Your daily dose of brain tease from the brain rot.

5196500.title: System Critical 3
5196500.short_description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

5196520.title: Why Did You Pay $1,000?!
5196520.short_description: You just paid $1,000 for one of the most expensive games in history. In Why Did You Pay $1,000?!, you are attending the most expensive session of all time... But do you know why? What lies behind it?

5196730.title: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
5196730.short_description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is an SNES-era inspired top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, collect tools, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get? This game is proudly human-made.

5196760.title: Hardcore Cyborg
5196760.short_description: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

5196850.title: Cat's Fish Stall
5196850.short_description: Discover dishes, open specialty shops, and connect them through customer flow. Combine up to 3 ingredients with a cooking method, choose facilities and timed events, balance traffic against profit, and clear 8 market scenarios—or test your own operating plan in Sandbox Mode from the start.

5196870.title: The Duke of Werlington
5196870.short_description: A mysterious noble invites you to his estate. You have little reason to trust him, but the promise of wealth is impossible to refuse. As a traveling merchant, explore this PSX-inspired interactive fiction set in an 18th-century gothic fantasy.

5196980.title: ArkSeed Terraformery
5196980.short_description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time. Arkseed Terraformery is a 2D factory and colony building and automation game with physics.

5197230.title: Industrial Empire Online
5197230.short_description: Build a complete industrial empire: extract resources, produce steel, aluminum, fuel and polymers, manage logistics, manufacture heavy equipment, and compete for tenders against other players. Rent or build enterprises, control costs, fulfill contracts, climb the ranking. Every point is built.

5197590.title: Miner Issue
5197590.short_description: Miner issue is a short active 3D first person incremental where you mine asteroid with your feet because your Boss told you to.

5197670.title: Babel Destiny
5197670.short_description: A hardcore isometric soulslike in the Tower of Babel. Every enemy announces its blow in a dead language. Red, you roll. Learn its letters and the same blow comes in white: now you parry it. Speak the Tower's words, climb its strata, and ring the Knell.

5197720.title: Murim Sect Leader
5197720.short_description: Lead a struggling martial sect in a Murim roguelike. Recruit and train disciples, assign them to missions and sect buildings, equip them with crafted gear, discover martial manuals, develop mastery, and guide your sect through dangerous events, rival factions, and turn-based auto-battles.

5197940.title: Melonpan Survivors
5197940.short_description: Fight slime hordes and heal with melon bread in this roguelite survival action game. Combine weapons, magic, and cards with auto-attacks and unique character skills to survive. Choose from 20 characters and brave stage hazards, from encroaching lava to slippery ice!

5198040.title: Nothing Unusual
5198040.short_description: Nothing Unusual is a Backpack Battles-style inventory builder meets Brotato-style horde survival, for 1–4 players. Grab a branch, a thermos and a frozen hairtail, mix fire, ice, shock and poison, and outlast 20 waves of Rule Tales until dark. Then stack Retrograde modifiers or go endless.

5198110.title: Nectarbound
5198110.short_description: A short, active incremental game about a bee with a vacuum. Collect nectar, turn it into coins, and buy upgrades. Hire ladybugs to plant flowers and worker bees to carry your haul. Day brings flowers. Night brings trouble.

5198450.title: Ramen Shop in the Floating Slums
5198450.short_description: Start penniless in a floating slum. Scavenge for supplies, choose from dozens of ingredients to create your own ramen, and grow your shop in this first-person ramen shop and life sim.
