Earn money and build your reputation, go fishing, and explore a city created just for this game.

5198700.title: Siege of Spellspire
5198700.short_description: A short incremental siege game about a mage defending his tower from hordes of enemies. Cast spells, perish, upgrade, and come back stronger to face tougher waves and fearsome bosses.

5199150.title: 9 Box
5199150.short_description: Ten players. Nine boxes. Grab a box, pick one of two abilities, take aim — then every ability fires at the same moment. Fast, chaotic online battles for up to 10 toys in a giant kid's bedroom. Matches last under 5 minutes.

5199220.title: Only Winks!
5199220.short_description: Deal with the problems of being too pretty. First people... then robots... then aliens and gods! You might get stalked by cultists or straight-up kidnapped — no promises! Whatever happens, keep winking. A pixel-art incremental game.

5199350.title: Little Hamster: Find and Organize
5199350.short_description: After a long journey, a little hamster returns home to his familiar daily routine. Yet even everyday tasks are full of adventure. Join him as you search for lost items, clean up, and organize the space in a new journey taking you from a forest little house to a lively town.

5199600.title: Rise of the Pirates
5199600.short_description: A free to play 2D pirate MMORPG. Sail a living archipelago, master your class, hunt bounties, raise a crew, and carve your name into the sea. Old school pixel soul, modern online heart.

5199870.title: IT MOVES! - Build Your Own Robot
5199870.short_description: Build working robots by wiring visual signal graphs, then watch, diagnose, and tune them in deterministic simulations. Grow a repair shop from its first piston to PID control, autonomous navigation, robot arms, and a walking humanoid.

5200310.title: Fold'Em
5200310.short_description: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

5200400.title: Meat Safari
5200400.short_description: Meat Safari is a multiplayer open-world restaurant simulator! Hunt ingredients, cook meat, stack cargo, and race across Meat World solo or in 4-player online co-op. Choose your driver and vehicle, and get out on the safarI!

5200480.title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
5200480.short_description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. Trapped in an endless shift, explore liminal spaces from the Poolrooms to Level 0, solve puzzles, evade unknown entities, and find a way out before it’s too late.

5200590.title: Open Boat: Charter Fishing Simulator
5200590.short_description: You're the captain now. Take paying customers out on simulated real-world waters, find the bite with real fishing knowledge, cast a few yourself if you want, and turn the small skiff into the best charter boat on the dock. Fill the bucket, rain or shine.

5201470.title: CROST : Crown, Coin & Steel
5201470.short_description: 권력은 왕관에, 살림은 금화에, 힘은 강철에 있다. 왕관 없는 왕국 아르덴의 지휘관이 되어 부대를 이끌고 곳간을 채워라. 마법 없는 사실적인 후기 중세 전쟁 전략 게임.

5201500.title: NecroSmash
5201500.short_description: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new classes and new areas to test them in.

5201560.title: DeepSteep
5201560.short_description: DeepSteep is a fast-paced action arcade shooter set in the Void, in which world yet not exist, break Chaos and bring back Order.

5201860.title: Mini Meadows
5201860.short_description: A cozy incremental farming game where you and up to three of your friends feed and grow a frog with the help of a bunch of little bugs. Decorate your island, collect new bugs, explore new biomes and keep on growing that frog.

5201930.title: Real Estate Investor
5201930.short_description: Real Estate Investor is a deep, turn-based economic simulation focused on realistic property investing. Hunt for bargains, haggle over the price, and turn run-down flats into a thriving portfolio. Sign the deed, collect the rent, quit the rat race and become a property millionaire.

5202040.title: Monsters Can Cook
5202040.short_description: You were a bad person in your past life, and now you'll have to work as a junior chef even after death. Buy questionable ingredients, cook for guests, and improve your skills until your restaurant gets five stars.

5202110.title: Kabakura
5202110.short_description: Kyabakura Wars is a kyabakura management sim with a visual novel inside. Take a club drowning in debt, turn it into the best venue in town, and defeat the four rival bosses standing between you and fame.

5202260.title: OFF SOUNDINGS
5202260.short_description: A trading and sailing RPG where you buy and sell in port, schedule your crew on the voyage, and aim your broadsides at sea. When the hulls collide, boarding becomes a card battle fought by the sailors you raised.

5202320.title: TidyUp 2000
5202320.short_description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

5202530.title: Survive the Squallies
5202530.short_description: Settle into a new home, go fishing, and meet the neighbors in this retro first-person horror game. Something is watching from the woods. Explore, run, and hide as Bill discovers that getting home alive is harder than fitting in.

5202540.title: Little Chefs
5202540.short_description: Little Chefs is an incremental cooking game where you forage, chop food and recruit little animal chefs from around the world that help you sell soup and buy back the deeds to their forests.

5202550.title: Mushroom Mushroom
5202550.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer. Control a small mushroom, create clones, and swap positions with them. Master clone swapping through puzzles and challenges, explore the many possibilities of this ability, overcome obstacles, and help the mushroom find its way home.

5202970.title: Pebbles
5202970.short_description: Pebbles is a cozy, hands-on puzzle game about picking up stones and putting them exactly where they belong. Fill in patterns, draw your own, or just let your imagination fill in an empty sandbox. No timers, no scores, no pressure. Just you, a pile of stones, and something nice to fill in.

5203380.title: Slag Run
5203380.short_description: Fly the gunship. Lead the rebellion. Slag Run is a single-player twin-stick shooter with battlefield strategy and roguelite progression. Shred enemy armor, direct allied squads, and capture territory as you build your loadout and fight to topple an oppressive dictatorship.

5203590.title: Shunx's Tyrhia ~ What a Beautiful Dawn ~
5203590.short_description: In 1863 Japan, steam technology from another world has transformed Edo into a mechanical city. Young swordsman Hachiro Iba is ordered to escort a mysterious girl, Rin, to Kyoto, but soon becomes caught in a conspiracy that could change the course of history.

5204210.title: This is why, you shouln´t build hackbots Karl
5204210.short_description: Karl just wanted free games on Vaporizor. Now his rogue hackbot is devouring digital worlds pixel by pixel! Thrown into the chaos by the Cheat Buster Authority, Karl must hack, fight, and fix his mess to save the gaming multiverse!

5204870.title: SUPER-TYPE
5204870.short_description: SUPER-TYPE is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

5204940.title: The Last Elementalist
5204940.short_description: Master the elements in a pixel art action roguelike. Explore different weapons, armor and spellbooks, imbue them with swappable gems to reshape how each piece behaves and embark on procedural elemental expeditions.

5205430.title: AI Says
5205430.short_description: A rage game where you control your character only through an AI chat. No WASD. The AI can't see the deadly test chambers, but you can. Give precise instructions or die trying.

5205750.title: Cathode Arcade
5205750.short_description: Six arcade machines, seven skill trees, seven currencies, and more than 400 upgrades. Revisit some of your childhood memories and turn them up to 11 within this escalating incremental 80s and 90s neon-inspired arcade game.

5205960.title: I'll Keep It
5205960.short_description: I’ll Keep It is a first-person management game about running a neglected Mediterranean getaway. Welcome guests, plan their stays, clean, repair, restock and serve - and somehow turn the place into something worth keeping.

5206270.title: Goblin Backpack
5206270.short_description: Your backpack is your battle plan! In this solo strategy autobattler, equip summon cards to build and position your team. Swap weapons for power and melee or ranged combat. Choose unique priests, fit items into limited space, improve your build with battle rewards, advance the map, and fight bosses!

5206740.title: Super DullanGO
5206740.short_description: Embark on an Adventure, Durango! It's Super Durango!!!

5206840.title: ARIA BLUE I. NATSUOTO
5206840.short_description: ARIA BLUE is a summer youth fantasy adventure game about nine boys and girls. Each installment focuses on one protagonist and two heroines, weaving a single story across the same span of time. This is the story of one summer, spent reclaiming a wish that had long been given up.

5207200.title: Turkish Casino Simulator
5207200.short_description: Your mate Kristos bet the whole country. Win it back from Demon Pokure II, Metal Emperor of Hell. One week, 15 real casino games, from roulette and blackjack to craps, Sic Bo and tavli, solo or with up to 19 friends. Lose and Hell takes the country.

5207720.title: BarkBar
5207720.short_description: A pack of rescue dogs fights zombies right above your taskbar. They battle on their own while you work, play or watch videos. Drop in now and then to equip new gear, learn skills and send the pack deeper into the frozen mountains.

5207770.title: Seperated!
5207770.short_description: You and your friends have been given a mission to retrieve a giant golden apple from the planet's World Tree! You must climb structures and dodge obstacles to reach the golden apple!

5207910.title: Cozyquarium
5207910.short_description: Create your own cozy aquarium, your own COZYQUARIUM! Collect fishes, display your favorites, make them 5 stars!

5207980.title: OUTLIER
5207980.short_description: OUTLIER is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players, set in an uncharted zone of the Backrooms where strange symptoms have begun to appear. Blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits and secretly let out the unbearable urge. The Overseer is watching. Can you act normal to the end?

5208040.title: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental
5208040.short_description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

5208530.title: SCP: Contain and Extract
5208530.short_description: A horror extraction shooter/creature collector unfolding in an overrun 1990s Site-19, built on rich SCP lore. Contain, extract and collect all the SCPs while surviving the evil that lurks throughout the site. Locate data, study ways to lure and trap, loot what you can and always be ready...

5208540.title: How to Hunt
5208540.short_description: A 1-4 player physics-based hunting simulator. While relaxing and off-roading at camp, you suddenly trash your ride deep in the wilderness. To upgrade your gear and work your way back home, you have to learn How to Hunt.

5208840.title: Siege of Akanor
5208840.short_description: A castle defense you fight in person. Between waves you spend your gold on swordsmen, archers, traps and barricades; when the horn sounds you take the field yourself, sword and bow in hand. Solo, in co-op for up to four, or from the horde's side.

5208930.title: Room Movers
5208930.short_description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. Room Movers is a cozy two-player game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

5208940.title: Minigolf Brake!
5208940.short_description: Play minigolf and BRAKE! whenever you want - going down, up, in a mud, a stream, or even on a water surface!

5209120.title: 10 MILLION MINIONS
5209120.short_description: 10 MILLION MINIONS is a solo and co-op tower defense roguelite: tens of thousands of enemies pour down on your people. Raise your defenses, fuse your towers, then graft them onto a weapon to dominate in FPS. And watch the horde break against them.

5209260.title: DON’T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND
5209260.short_description: DON'T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND! JUST DON'T DO IT! Stranded with 1-3 friends in online co-op, you have to haul your scattered gear up the mountain and build camp. The tent is heavy, nobody agrees which way is left, and something out there is listening.

5209580.title: Raftcraft
5209580.short_description: A 4-player co-op adventure where goblins build a fragile makeshift vessel, hunt for loot across dangerous lands, and use their Mage Hands to grab, swing, pull, and thoroughly inconvenience each other.

5210210.title: KIBA - Kittys Idle Brick Arena
5210210.short_description: Let it brick! Mix & match 20 unique balls across 14 Active, Passive, and Clicker slots to trigger massive chain reactions. Earn gold, smash bricks, and trigger prestige for permanent upgrades. Play actively or just sit back and progress idle!

5210800.title: SYSTEM INTRUDER
5210800.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in an immersive retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

5210810.title: EMPTYLAND
5210810.short_description: EMPTY LAND is a cinematic single-player survival horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, psychological horror, mystery, puzzles, and survival gameplay. The full game will contain additional levels, locations, story content, enemies, puzzles, and cinematic sequences.

5210950.title: The Last Minute
5210950.short_description: Face waves of robots in a fast-paced arena FPS with roguelite elements. Survive 60-second rounds, then choose modifiers that change your abilities, enemies, or the arena. Keep your combos going and beat your high score.

5211540.title: Ferryman's Obol
5211540.short_description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor. You ferry the dead across the River Styx. Each with their own worries, whispers and obol. How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

5211650.title: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails
5211650.short_description: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game that lives along the bottom of your screen. Let your hunter track beasts while you work, watch videos, or do something else. Collect loot, improve your gear, unlock useful skills, and conquer new biomes.

5212010.title: DEPRECATED
5212010.short_description: A fast top-down character-action roguelite with a bullet heaven core. Dash, deflect and heavy-attack through swarms of an AI's own hardware while your weapon grows from one bolt to a full ring. You're the last human voice in the system. Climb to its CORE before it deletes you.

5212060.title: Munzi Island
5212060.short_description: Grow crops, automate your farm with worker bots, turn washed-up trash into useful resources, and reclaim land from the sea—all while defending your island from the Black Munzis.

5212100.title: Sprite Garden
5212100.short_description: Incremental games meet Pacman in this expanding maze shoot-em-up. Move along the paths of your garden, collect flowers, kill imps, find sprites and earn tiles. What powerful sprites will you find in your garden? How big will your garden get?

5212930.title: Task Bar Farm
5212930.short_description: An idle RPG that lives right above your taskbar. Fill your storage with gear across 15 tiers, forge and fuse at the Blacksmith, collect heroes and pets, and trade your best Steam items on the Community Market.

5213430.title: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape
5213430.short_description: Love leaves clues. Join LOVE COMPANY, a company that delivers feelings of love. Inspect objects, follow emotional traces, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth behind those feelings in this first-person romantic mystery escape-room game.

5213610.title: A Cultivator's Death
5213610.short_description: A text-based litrpg where choices matter and death is permanent. Experience the brutal survival of a weakling, or the moral trappings of a hero. See what it really takes. Achieve A Cultivator's Death.

5214250.title: Click the Download
5214250.short_description: Click the Download upgrade your skills to multiply your speed, and conquer every game out there. Become the fastest downloader alive.

5214320.title: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
5214320.short_description: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

5214570.title: Coma Dreams
5214570.short_description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

5214790.title: The Broken Oath
5214790.short_description: Bound in a cell beneath a cathedral, freed by a dying spirit. Descend the dungeons of a paladin order that forgot what it swore. A short, heavy souls-like, built one floor at a time. In Early Access: Floor One and its two bosses, about forty minutes.

5214960.title: Hidden Doodles: Medieval Town
5214960.short_description: Explore a hand-drawn medieval world in this relaxing hidden object adventure. Search for hidden items, peek inside cottages, and click on villagers and animals to discover their playful reactions. Travel from quiet villages to bustling towns full of little surprises.

5216270.title: Night at the Fun Park
5216270.short_description: Escape a giant spider in an abandoned amusement park. Find the keys to the exit, distract her with noise and free your friends from cocoons. Co-op horror for 1-4 players: online through Steam, solo or in two-player split-screen.

5216360.title: Jumpshot
5216360.short_description: A RPG where every battle is a basketball showdown. Explore a strange Japanese town, meet oddball rivals, time your shots and blocks, and build your HYPE. The moon has declared itself MVP. Grab your dad's old basketball and challenge it.

5216650.title: AIONOIA
5216650.short_description: AIONOIA is a minimalist incremental idler about an ancient machine built to spark existence itself. Generate Potential and experiment with powerful modifiers to transform simple circuits into increasingly absurd chain reactions.

5216730.title: Turbo Drag Racer 3000
5216730.short_description: Turbo Drag Racer 3000 is a fast-paced retro drag racer with roguelite drafting. Rev your engine, time your shifts, flip on the nitrous, and survive a tournament bracket by drafting race-changing performance perks between heats. Just don't blow your engine.

5217270.title: Othercrown
5217270.short_description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

5217470.title: Archival Security
5217470.short_description: A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the projected slides, word for word. Follow the rules. Do not respond if the text asks you a question. ACCURACY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY.

5217840.title: Till Death Descends
5217840.short_description: A first-person retro dungeon crawler. On your wedding day a necromancer dragged your bride underground. Descend floor by floor, parry, break cracked walls, pick locks, and hunt for scraps of her veil and the relics that open the way deeper. Every fight is fair. Every hit is shown before it lands.

5218000.title: Wirebound
5218000.short_description: Wirebound is a casual 2D runner where you grind across powerlines through a variety of biomes. Perform jumps and tricks to syphon energy while unlocking upgrades and secret worlds.

5218070.title: Black & White in Balance
5218070.short_description: A puzzle game where you move stones to bring balance between black and white. Inspired by Go, it features its own unique world and board-based puzzles.

5218100.title: Ballpark Days
5218100.short_description: A story-driven baseball game where you play as the catcher. Steady your pitcher through how you receive, mound visits and pitch calling, and frame borderline pitches into strikes. Read batters who each have their own approach, and at the plate, read real-speed pitches and drive them back.

5218210.title: Phase War
5218210.short_description: Phase War is a tactical card strategy game spanning WWI to the near future. Collect and craft 130+ unit cards, deploy your mechs, and watch auto-battles unfold in real time — position formations, load mods and auras, enjoy the show. 100-mission campaign, base building, intel crafting, idle income.

5218380.title: PowerPitch
5218380.short_description: Take their ankles, bend one around the keeper, supercharge your shots, and finish the cross with a bicycle-kick. Fast-paced arcade football with no throw-ins, no offside, and no mercy. Win tournaments, collect trophies, and unlock powerful upgrades and new arenas.

5218470.title: Kleopatra Zero
5218470.short_description: A fast-paced mech wave-shooter where every enemy attack is drawn on the floor before it lands, and the cards you pick between waves turn one hit into a cascade that clears the screen. A standalone prequel to Kleopatra.

5218790.title: 任意杂货铺
5218790.short_description: Stock up, arrange the trays, set your prices—make every hand reaching over the counter scramble to pay in Spirit Stones. Set out from the “Anywhere Door,” travel through a dozen-plus sects opening shops and doing business; Solve puzzles, rescue the elders, become a sect’s divine beast.

5218980.title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
5218980.short_description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

5219010.title: NEOVERSE 2: Companion Star
5219010.short_description: A stylish roguelike deckbuilder where two heroes fight as one. Weave cross-combos, parry to hold the line, and unleash Unison finishers as you sail a collapsing multiverse — retreading a fixed fate, again and again, to gather the Echoes of a lost truth.

5219090.title: ELYSIUM
5219090.short_description: ELYSIUM is a next-gen third-person MMORPG forged by Mercenary Games. Explore a living open world, AI companions & step into realm Full Sandbox Roleplay (RP) with a living economy Free to play with built-in purchases and a self-contained in-game economy — your progression, your ecosystem, your story!

5219370.title: Wreck the Deck
5219370.short_description: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.

5219410.title: Ping & Prowl
5219410.short_description: Map the darkness, revealed only by movement. Play as a Ping searching for an escape or a Prowl hunting by echoes and footsteps in this asymmetric game of stealth, pursuit, and quick decisions.

5219560.title: Turing's Hive
5219560.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you build computation from simple rules. Route numbers through a honeycomb grid, solve puzzles to create new computational building blocks, and work your way from +1 to arithmetic, algorithms, and beyond.

5219570.title: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game
5219570.short_description: Every leap brings you closer to glory… or back to the beginning.

5219680.title: Dirty Dogs
5219680.short_description: An online party game for 3 to 10 players. Among Us meets Cluedo, in a dog park. Mark your territory, sniff out the strays in disguise, and argue it out at the pack meeting.

5219720.title: 挂机魔女：星夜
5219720.short_description: 《挂机魔女：星夜》是一款融合桌面宠物、挂机探索、事件系统、合成制造与自动战斗的魔法养成游戏。配置技能链、研究科技、打造装备、获得伙伴，探索由骰子驱动的多重世界与事件。

5219900.title: The First Pixel
5219900.short_description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

5220100.title: Escape from Tower
5220100.short_description: Escape from Tower is a hardcore first-person extraction shooter set in the fallen realm of Grivion. Gear up, enter the raid, outfight rival squads and scavengers with your wands and loot the ruins. Reach an extraction and it's yours. Die, and Grivion keeps it all.

5220120.title: Auto Forge: Idle RPG Craft
5220120.short_description: Idle blacksmith RPG. Forge weapons from a wooden club to a plasma rifle across dozens of eras, gear up your hero and duel real players in the PvP arena. Your hero keeps battling while you're away — come back, collect the loot and forge something stronger.

5220190.title: The Airline Century
5220190.short_description: Build and manage an airline from 1960 to 2030 in a turn-based strategy simulation. Buy or lease aircraft, plan routes, fares and schedules, expand hubs, and navigate oil shocks, financial crises and rival airlines.

5220550.title: Vessel
5220550.short_description: Search for your missing brother in VESSEL, a first-person UFO abduction horror game. Explore an isolated hospital and surrounding woods, examine objects left behind, and follow his trail beneath strange lights and an unexplained presence.

5220670.title: BE@RBRICK HEROES
5220670.short_description: Run, jump, and race your way to the finish together! Create your own missions, collect a variety of BE@RBRICK(BEARBRICK), and explore a growing MMORPG world filled with adventure. Play, create, and connect your way. LET'S PLAY & CONNECT!

5220800.title: Sandkeeper
5220800.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

5220920.title: Stock Baron
5220920.short_description: Stock Baron is a strategy sim set in a fictional stock market. Become a market titan with vast capital, superior intel and an arsenal of trading tactics. Your moves sway prices, while other market players seize their chances. Enter a battle of wits amid fear and greed, and make your fortune!

5221390.title: Chronicle of Gods
5221390.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

5221760.title: Send 'em Flying
5221760.short_description: Flail your sword around, dodge attacks, learn enemy behaviors, manage your stamina and explore the infested provinces of this dangerous 1-bit world while everything tries to kill you in this top-down enemy fighter.

5221820.title: Harvestin Season
5221820.short_description: Harvestin season is a chaotic 1-4 player online co-op. It's almost harvestin season, and you know what that means? Fertilize the Crops, inject steroids into your livestock, and by nightfall SLAUGHTER THEM ALL.

5221930.title: DUSTY CANVAS: Restore the Masterpiece
5221930.short_description: DUSTY CANVAS is a meditative game about restoring genuine works of art. Clean and restore paintings, unlock new tools, and discover interesting facts about masterpieces and their artists.

5221940.title: Blade & Barrel
5221940.short_description: A roguelike action game where you fight a multitude of different enemies, each ruling over their own room. Use your sword and gun to clear out each room, allowing you to purchase upgrades. Each enemy is more difficult than the last, so play tactically. You only get one life, so play smart!

5222130.title: Sarmatian Heroes
5222130.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the ancient world, develop heroes with unique skills, command armies, and build fortified cities your way. Fight tactical hex-based battles in the open field and defend your custom-built cities during sieges.

5222440.title: 宗门经理人 - Sect Master
5222440.short_description: <Sect Manager> is a single-player cultivation sect management sim. Build and upgrade your sect, craft equipment, and train disciples. Send them into the Spirit Abyss to gather materials, then prepare your team with equipment, techniques, and formations to battle monsters and bosses.

5222520.title: Burrito Aftermath
5222520.short_description: Make burritos fast, beat the clock, and throw your creations into the hole before the bomb goes off. Burrito Aftermath is a chaotic first-person arcade cooking game about speed, high scores, unlocks, with questionable concerns for work place safety

5222860.title: Chaikov Party: Stickman Shooter
5222860.short_description: Take what you can, run if you must. Stuff everything into your backpack, make it to the edge of town alive, and sell it all to that dealer who buys anything. He might not pay top dollar, but it'll be enough to get you some new gear, a few painkillers, and turn you into the coolest guy on this street

5222930.title: Ant Tribe
5222930.short_description: Expand your chamber, strengthen your tribe, and put every ant to work, each with its own role — to deliver an endless feast to your Queen!

5223060.title: Let's Go! Curio Crew!
5223060.short_description: Fancy a virtual getaway? This desktop buddy can collect local goodies from 700+ cities across China while you work, study, or sneak in a break! Buy low, sell high to fund your trip! Collect gorgeous hanfu from past dynasties and travel in style~ Team up with friends online to find goodies faster!

5223210.title: 无法同意的用户协议
5223210.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game set on your desktop. Uncover hidden rules in absurd user agreements, pop-ups, webpages, and minigames. Outsmart the traps, investigate Clause Inc., and uncover the truth behind the installation wizard.

5223220.title: 逆界 (Inverse Realm)
5223220.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up with roguelite elements! Choose distinct weapons, trigger powerful build synergies, and adapt to fresh challenges on every run. Are you ready for the battle?

5223310.title: Chopeast
5223310.short_description: Chopeast is an incremental 2D game where you can freely explore, upgrade, and expand your weapons. In the game, you play as a alien monster hunter collecting meat to trade for resources.

5223650.title: UNDERKOVER
5223650.short_description: Hide-and-paint party game for 2–8 friends in a meme-Soviet apartment block. Paint yourself into carpets and wallpaper, freeze, and survive the NKVD officer, his dog in a hat, the blackout — and your own friends, who can snitch on you any second.

5224110.title: Logistica: Under Glass
5224110.short_description: A medieval village grows inside a glass case. Cards cost villagers, buildings are one-shot cards, and every tile you clear makes the next raid bigger. Hold the walls, then take your deck out on the road as one of four peoples.

5224230.title: Dragonhaul
5224230.short_description: Dragonhaul is a retro roguelite autobattler where every step matters. Explore a hand-pixelled overworld, arrange powerful items in an expanding inventory and construct devastating synergies before the boss arrives, no two runs are the same.

5224400.title: Dirty Scallywags
5224400.short_description: Board your ship, sail the seas and accidentally dismember your friends! There are ships to loot, enemies to defeat and physics to disobey. If you get lonely, invite your friends and start plundering the seas together!

5224450.title: Thank You 4 Playing
5224450.short_description: Gather information on social media in-game to take down every last boss in this deduction-based puzzle adventure game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn. It's release day for the latest entry in a legendary action game series, and you need to beat it. Fun is secondary, victory is all.

5224540.title: AREA 51: The Awakening
5224540.short_description: A dark, sci-fi, indie horror. The protagonist, Chris, wants to find his father, a scientist at Area 51 who has disappeared. He and his friends plan to infiltrate Area 51 and find his father. But the secrets and horrors of the place await them there...

5224820.title: Tidy Up the Christmas Market
5224820.short_description: It was supposed to be the best Christmas market of the year. But a fierce winter storm has thrown everything into disarray! Now it's up to you and your four-legged friend Frosty, to tidy up the mess and give the little village its Christmas back.

5224930.title: Don't Die! You got 1 Life!
5224930.short_description: A permadeath dark fantasy action roguelike (with a twist) about climbing a tower no one has ever beaten. Choose to study enemies or go in blind, and make choices that impact you in real time.

5224940.title: Cadence_Blade
5224940.short_description: Hold the castle sword-in-hand in this co-op action defense game for 1-3 players. Time your strikes to the Flow, manage where you invest your coins, and see how long you last against the waves... or just let a friend take the dragon.

5225200.title: Sleepwalkers
5225200.short_description: Bloodthirsty creatures are destroying your life and the lives of your loved ones. Grab your weapon, fight them, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious experiment that brings all your deepest fears to the surface.

5225330.title: Dump Chaos
5225330.short_description: Dig through piles of junk, place the items you find on their proper shelves, and sell them to make money. Take your time organizing, add rare finds to your collection, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning chaos into order.

5225380.title: Tidy Up The Chocolate Factory
5225380.short_description: Tidy up a magical chocolate factory solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Sort hundreds of sweet varieties, unlock helpful upgrades, and complete collections to bring candy gardens into bloom. Chocolate streams, marshmallow flowers, and a delicious mess await!

5225440.title: Blightwinter
5225440.short_description: Blightwinter combines push-your-luck deckbuilding with medieval town management. As leader of a fragile settlement, you must manage resources, assign townsfolk, and prepare for the relentless fall harvest before winter's chill and dark afflictions take hold.

5225640.title: Astral Trace
5225640.short_description: Astral Trace is a fast paced arcade word game where every word keeps you alive. Trace through moving hex clusters, earn precious time, and chase high scores while the field grows faster, denser, and more demanding. Survive the pressure and keep the run alive.

5225770.title: Eat the Sky
5225770.short_description: An arcade space roguelike where you are a star and everything smaller is food. Swallow the planets to grow, while rival stars hunt you for the same reason. Outgrow them or be eaten. At the center of it all something far larger is already feeding, so hurry up, the clock is ticking.

5226130.title: Have We Gone Too Far?
5226130.short_description: A solo or co-op horde survival where reckless wizards (you) blast mutated hordes with synthwave magic, upgrade between runs, and try not to kill each other.

5226220.title: OddXI
5226220.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

5226410.title: Golden Trivia Show
5226410.short_description: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?

5226430.title: Wyrdtide
5226430.short_description: Sail your longship into the horde. A viking survival roguelite for 1–4 players: hold the helm while your crew fights on its own, raid island villages for new hands, carve runes as you level, and fell the warden that guards each sea's gate.

5227160.title: Impferno
5227160.short_description: An online co-op game for up to 8 players. Explore the Circles of Hell in search of monsters and collect their souls before time runs out. Work and fight together to survive. But never forget: trust has no place among demons!

5227190.title: The Hero's Road
5227190.short_description: A node-based adventure with semi-automatic combat and a deckbuilding roguelite core. Choose your route, relics, identity, and combat style — the build is the decision. 140 relics, 100 foes, 40 origins.

5227200.title: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal
5227200.short_description: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal is a 2D beat ’em up inspired by classic arcades, with street combat, Mexican humor, outrageous enemies, bosses, and minigames. And just when you think you know where the story is going… you’re probably wrong.

5227510.title: Crank'N'Gun
5227510.short_description: The ultimate cranking roguelike you will ever play. Survive waves of enemies, get upgrades, defeat bosses, and unlock new scenarios. The only requirement is to keep CRANKING and never stop. I hope your hand can handle it.

5227770.title: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys
5227770.short_description: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys is a cozy desktop idle game where every click and keystroke boosts your high-speed train. Travel through scenic countryside with adorable animal passengers, enjoy local dishes, and receive beautiful postcards along the way!

5227900.title: PAIMT ARENA
5227900.short_description: A fast arena shooter where paint is power. Master air movement, fight with artist's tools, and shape your own arenas. Host custom matches with friends, build maps in the in-game editor, and leave your mark on every wall.

5227980.title: TROPHY FLEET
5227980.short_description: TROPHY FLEET is a top-down shoot 'em up where every boss you kill becomes your next ship. Fly an unbroken run from world to world, shoot out each core, and steal it. A full run is about an hour, and it never pauses.

5228110.title: Misfortune
5228110.short_description: Fight monsters with a slot machine. Spin, hold and reroll to land deadly combinations. Build your reels with powerful symbols, collect relics and unlock extra paylines. Shape your luck—and survive long enough to cash out.

5228120.title: CleanUp OS
5228120.short_description: A cozy desktop-cleaning sim. Sit down at someone else's messy computer, then dig through folders, delete junk files, end CPU-hogging processes, uninstall bloat, run the antivirus, and free up enough disk space to finally run that big system update - until the whole machine breathes again.

5228430.title: One Hit Hero
5228430.short_description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.

5228450.title: Par Under Review
5228450.short_description: A turn-based golf roguelike set in the 1930s. Build a deck of clubs golf won't invent for decades, and beat the golfers of the day at their own game without ever taking a swing.

5228680.title: SCREW IT!
5228680.short_description: SCREW IT! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a chaotic retro TV show. Outbid your friends, call their bluffs, prove your claims on the mic, survive ridiculous penalties, and compete in arcade challenges to become the night's champion.

5228690.title: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary
5228690.short_description: A cozy sorting game set in an old candlelit apothecary. Thousands of potions, each with its own name and label, and liquid that sloshes as you carry it. Ride the rolling ladders, fill crates, and put every shelf back the way it was, to rekindle the light of your late mother's spirit.

5229150.title: Rox Solid Pro Football
5229150.short_description: Choose your role (Owner, General Manager, Head Coach, Off/Def/ST Coordinator, or Position Coach), choose what you want to control (24 different settings across Scouting, Coaching, Front Office, and Game Management groupings), and play as many seasons as you want.

5229220.title: Winds of Discovery
5229220.short_description: Set sail across a living Age of Sail. Trade goods between distant ports, build your fleet, hire your crew, and forge your own path to fortune in a vast world of exploration and commerce.

5229460.title: EverPet
5229460.short_description: Get up to mischief with your finite friend. Care or consequence? It's your choice!

5229500.title: Words In Place
5229500.short_description: A spatial word puzzle: drag shaped letter pieces onto a cluttered grid and uncover hidden category words. Crossword-style intersections mean one placement can complete several words at once. Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

5229700.title: The Lantern Spirits
5229700.short_description: Wield a magic lantern in this roguelite shooter and guide the lost spirits home. Combine 100 unique lantern upgrades, unlock a massive skill tree, and leave a glimmer of light behind with every death. Made by four brothers and set to a 25-track original soundtrack composed in-house.

5229840.title: Houston, We Have a Spungus
5229840.short_description: A living space fungus is eating our colonies, and it grows back faster than you can shoot it. Build turrets, call in orbital strikes, combine flamethrowers, tiny suns and lightning, and hold the line until HQ nukes the source.

5230020.title: PROFANUM
5230020.short_description: PROFANUM is a first-person dark fantasy horror action RPG built around weighty, commitment-based combat. Fight the Profane with melee weapons, shields, bows, crossbows, and Faith-powered miracles as you uncover what happened to Briarholt.

5230070.title: Beefarunna
5230070.short_description: The alien invasion has subsided, and Ash has to get off the couch to buy some groceries. Unfortunately, the El Camino broke down on the way to the MeggaMart. Run, jump, and slide your way to a complete cowbell collection in Beefrunna (or: Super Beefarena).

5230100.title: PATTY STATE
5230100.short_description: Across five cities mapped from real geographic data, run a restaurant chain: open locations, develop products, set prices and manage cash flow. Make decisions week by week, expand abroad and acquire companies. Grow one restaurant into an international chain.

5230200.title: Deepworks
5230200.short_description: Earth is gone. The fleet is hungry. Drop a Hub on a generated claim, find the seam, and let the robots dig. Every machine you build makes noise — and noise is how the machines that took the planet find you. Hold the line, launch with the take, sell it, and go deeper.

5230230.title: Board Dynasty
5230230.short_description: Buy properties and collect rent. Choose a mode before each match. In Weather, send asteroids at a rival’s hotel. In Flip Side, turn the board over to swap property values. Play solo, share one PC with up to four players, or play online in supported modes.

5230450.title: Colorsong
5230450.short_description: Colorsong is a relaxing incremental game where you collect colors and turn them into hand-painted watercolors 🎨 Every color plays its own note 🎵 As your palette expands, the game's song unfolds and grows richer.

5231140.title: Everybody MAHJONG!
5231140.short_description: Learn, customize, and play 8 traditional Mahjong rulesets, including Japanese Riichi to Hong Kong and Taiwanese. Features interactive tutorials for beginners, house-rule customization, and solo play or online multiplayer. This is Everybody MAHJONG!

5231170.title: 三国龙将传奇
5231170.short_description: 一款以三国乱世为背景的经典策略角色扮演游戏。玩家将招募三国名将，培养专属武将队伍，通过五大武将职业搭配、阵型配置与回合制战斗征战天下。体验丰富的三国剧情、装备养成、副本挑战及竞技场玩法，在群雄争霸的乱世中书写属于自己的英雄传奇！

5231220.title: KEDR
5231220.short_description: KEDR is an extraction horror game where you take on the role of a trader in a vast underground complex. Avoid direct confrontations with monsters, search dangerous areas and rooms with extreme caution, use the creatures’ weaknesses to your advantage, and make it out of the complex alive.

5231270.title: The Otherworld Book of Destiny: Chaos Era
5231270.short_description: An open-world life-simulation RPG set in the “Age of Turmoil.” Start as a nobody and roam the Five Realms—trading, taming pets, hunting treasure, and stealing. Master nearly 10,000 martial arts, choose one of seven paths, and forge your legend among historical and mythical heroes.

5231330.title: SpellSimmer
5231330.short_description: SpellSimmer is a cozy fantasy cooking game where customers hide what they want behind clues. Decode their requests, combine ingredient properties, cook the right dishes, shape a light or dark reputation, and build your kitchen through talents, helpers, and upgrades.

5231430.title: Nullwatch
5231430.short_description: Hold your base against waves of geometric nodes in this stationary shooter. Aim, choose what gets deleted first and time every reload. Between nights, upgrade your base, sell salvage, buy better guns and spend skill points before the field fills again.

5231910.title: Siegehand
5231910.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every minion must choose: attack or build. Destroy their Castle or raise your Monument first. Draft through a challenging rogue-like Campaign, challenge rival decks in asynchronous PvP Expedition, and earn every pack. Collect over 350 cards. No microtransactions.

5232410.title: Little Outside
5232410.short_description: LittleOutside turns a window on your desktop into a real one. Your webcam tracks your head, and the city, old town and coast outside shift with true perspective as you move. 3 hand-built views, 24 ambient tracks, and Steam Workshop support.

5232450.title: Wallstrike
5232450.short_description: A fast-paced wallball game for up to 8 players. Strike the ball with one hand, bounce it off the ground and into the wall, and send it beyond the next player's reach. Play locally or compete online, eliminate your rivals, and build your career to become world champion!

5233100.title: Elroy's Costume Closet
5233100.short_description: The 1996 Headbone Interactive classic is back! Help Elroy and Syd save the Camelian Theater in this retro restored dress-up game. Mix wild outfits to unlock 75+ funny, fully voiced short animated skits. A retro revival packed with original 90s magic, optimized for modern desktops!

5233280.title: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY
5233280.short_description: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY is a mystery adventure where you explore closed spaces from six fixed viewpoints—north, east, south, west, ceiling, and floor. Find clues and items, operate mechanisms, and uncover new details by changing your point of view. Currently includes the short episode “Cell 214.”

5233290.title: The Wuslers
5233290.short_description: Build a cozy settlement where Wuslers keep your economy running, carrying all your goods on foot along the roads you lay. Feed your mines, expand your territory with Barracks and play solo, against the AI or with up to eight players on PC and Android.

5233520.title: Restore The Internet
5233520.short_description: A cozy incremental on a retro desktop. Restore forgotten websites one block at a time, then connect them: where you place each page changes its income, traffic and repair speed. Upgrade, automate, and finish with a proper ending. No forced resets.

5233660.title: Purification: Idle Defense
5233660.short_description: Purification merges Tower Defense with the exponential growth of an Incremental Idler. Harvest souls for talents and ancient relics to fortify your wall—and switch to a silent Desktop Companion bar to keep defending while you work or study.

5233740.title: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House
5233740.short_description: 1980. You rent a room in a quiet boarding house, eat at the landlady's table and help with the chores. She calls her lodgers family. But as the days pass, you can't shake the feeling that something in that house is wrong, and has been for a very long time. First-person psychological horror.

5234240.title: CUT AND DICE
5234240.short_description: CUT AND DICE is a grim indie game with dark humor, where a single dice roll costs you a finger. You and your opponent sit at the table. Roll the dice. Whoever gets the lower number loses a finger. Perks help, but they can't buy luck. Enemies get tougher. Lose — start over. Feeling lucky?

5234330.title: Sort On The Ball
5234330.short_description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

5234530.title: Sweet Saviour
5234530.short_description: A single player turn-based RPG that focuses on candy hero's that fight their way through the worlds growing corruption. The game includes mechanics such as permanent character loss and card collecting where you will fight enemies through linear levels.

5234650.title: Hungry Hoist
5234650.short_description: Hungry Hoist is a co-op dungeon-crawler sandbox about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with. Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda!

5234670.title: CraBro 蟹霸
5234670.short_description: Fight through an underwater arena with two independent claws. Build weapons from scrap, learn martial techniques, parry deep-sea bosses, and unlock an online asynchronous ladder against other players' saved builds.

5234810.title: The Official's Path
5234810.short_description: A satirical life simulation of China's civil service system. Rise from a lowly clerk to a powerful official, navigate corruption and political intrigue, make choices that shape your career, and discover where your principles end. 14 endings, 1000+ events, 45 years of modern Chinese history.

5234840.title: The Saintess in the Dungeon Is Slacking Off
5234840.short_description: In a world overrun by goblins and vampires, you play a knight leading your personal maid-knight order into a goblin dungeon to rescue a saintess in peril, and meet all kinds of adventurers at the tavern. A light, easy roguelike survival tower defense.

5235190.title: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder
5235190.short_description: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder is a martial arts roguelite deckbuilder with Chinese-style cosmic horror. Choose from five schools, battle through unfolding events, and build with 300+ cards and 57 traits. Face the final enemy shaped by your choices, and uncover the truth of reincarnation.

5235390.title: Island Escape
5235390.short_description: A single-player 3D survival crafting game. Shipwrecked in 1907 on a nameless island, you gather, build, and push your civilization from stone to electricity — then build a boat and gamble on the open sea. Even a raft can leave; arriving alive is another matter. Sink, and the island is still yours.

5235520.title: How to Hunt
5235520.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

5235560.title: Zombie Day Protocol
5235560.short_description: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

5235620.title: The Goodnight Potion
5235620.short_description: The Goodnight Potion! is a pixel-art fantasy puzzle game in which you help an old mage with a troubling potion addiction. Choose which potion to drink first, combine elemental reactions, and use spells and transformations to survive until the next night.

5235780.title: Voodoo You Chasing?
5235780.short_description: Voodoo You Chasing? is a freeze tag game but someone brought magic and bad decision-making. Play as a Wizard: collect glyphs to complete the ritual. Or be the Voodoo Hunter: capture them all to protect your mojo.

5235870.title: Bottled Gleams
5235870.short_description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. In the Cat Squeeze bottle, scoop up and pet a cat hunting for dried fish. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship their haul for coins. Tap keys or click to boost output. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and décor.

5235890.title: Before Dawn Bakery
5235890.short_description: Flour, heat, and bake away the hours before sunrise. A cozy solo baking sim where every stage — ferment, proof, bake, cool — has its own feel and timing, and one pair of hands to meet them all. Fill the morning's orders and close out before the town wakes.

5235910.title: Whisperborne
5235910.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

5236150.title: One duck too many
5236150.short_description: A tiny bathtub sits on top of your taskbar with one duck in it. Its bubbles hatch more ducks, those ducks hatch more, and soon they spill over the rim and wander across your desktop. A desktop companion with 30 ducks to discover, born from the water's temperature, the night and each other.

5236190.title: Power Showdown
5236190.short_description: Power Showdown is a turn-based tactical superhero strategy game where positioning, powers, terrain, and team composition determine every battle.Build a squad from a growing collection of heroes and villains. Build your team. Master your powers. Win the showdown.

5236290.title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
5236290.short_description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,600 elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

5236380.title: Flameward
5236380.short_description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

5236420.title: Packlore
5236420.short_description: Packlore is a cozy incremental TCG where you open magical booster packs! Earn money from cards, upgrade, and hire helpers. Can you complete the collection and uncover the mystery of the secret page?

5236520.title: After closing
5236520.short_description: After Closing is a 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game. Explore an abandoned amusement park, solve puzzles, avoid the clown, and escape together.

5236550.title: THE IRON GAMES
5236550.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

5236670.title: COILBREAKER
5236670.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

5237210.title: Tamer Survivors
5237210.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

5237500.title: Folder Escape
5237500.short_description: "Wait, this is a game?" A puzzle game played inside a file explorer. Rename files, change extensions, show hidden items and switch view modes to escape each folder your own way. 30 stages, and every fifth one is a .zip that demands all of it at once.

5237520.title: Leila's Adventure
5237520.short_description: Join Leila on a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by collectathons of the 90s. Explore vibrant levels, collect treasures, overcome obstacles and uncover secrets as you journey across unique worlds.

5237600.title: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
5237600.short_description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

5237650.title: Demon Slayer Rome
5237650.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

5238110.title: Roll N' Rage
5238110.short_description: A difficult physics-based platforming game about a golf ball's journey home. Roll, fall, rage, repeat... or quit. It's up to you.

5238330.title: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
5238330.short_description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

5238790.title: Everlasting Curse
5238790.short_description: Enter the witch’s hidden house, explore mysterious parallel worlds, switch between day and night, solve unique puzzles and minigames, uncover dark secrets, and break an ancient curse.

5238800.title: Temporal Minesweeper
5238800.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

5238870.title: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
5238870.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

5238900.title: Shiverin' Shillelagh
5238900.short_description: it's Halloween night, strange pumpkins roam the land. In this FPS, grab your shotgun & shillelagh to do battle in 8 atmospheric levels!

5239100.title: To Whom It May Fall
5239100.short_description: A brutal vertical rage-platformer about an old mailman, a rocket-powered monobike, and one very important letter. Climb the castle, master the jumps, and try not to fall all the way back down.

5239410.title: Area [No Love]
5239410.short_description: Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart.

5239500.title: Desk Sushi Idle
5239500.short_description: Desk Sushi Idle is a cozy animal sushi shop at the bottom of your screen. Keep working while guests grab plates, check out, and your restaurant grows. Build belts and stations, unlock dishes, and expand at your own pace—an idle desktop companion with real conveyor-sushi charm.

5239710.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
5239710.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

5239830.title: Zombie Apocalypse Together
5239830.short_description: Fight zombies, scavenge cities, explore the wild, hunt, craft and build a base in a world that is new every game. Start with nothing and survive with up to 3 friends. Every seventh night, the Blood Moon brings the horde to your walls.

5239950.title: Genesis Core
5239950.short_description: Genesis Core is an idle RPG built around crafting and automation. Send squads farming across hostile planets, process their loot into powerful gear and circuits, and expand your base. Refine your builds, assimilate enemy technology and keep developing your squad through successive campaigns.

5240490.title: DETRITUS
5240490.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the classic card game Trash. Arrange cards sequentially to open packs, discover game-changing modifiers, and build broken synergies to complete over 10 unique contracts.

5240560.title: Trox The Reversal
5240560.short_description: Trox The Reversal is a first person horror game set in an alternate reality where the Cold War became a global nuclear war. With food supplies collapsing, the Soviet government introduces the Sustainable Meat Act, making cannibalism legal and forcing every household to contribute.

5240600.title: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
5240600.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

5240620.title: 수복
5240620.short_description: In a Korea torn by war, Seo-hun fights to reclaim the everyday life he lost. Follow a character-driven story and fight alongside infantry and tanks in top-down 2D battles, moving, aiming, and taking cover on the front line.

5240650.title: S.O.V.A.
5240650.short_description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history.

5241040.title: Twilight Pretender
5241040.short_description: His ex-girlfriend returns the day after their breakup—but she is now a “pretender,” a creature that devours and mimics humans. To save the real Chise, Hiroto must become her fake girlfriend’s boyfriend—for a limited time. But when a fake romance becomes real… Can he still call her a monster?

5241380.title: You Go First!
5241380.short_description: A 4–12 player multiplayer deathrun about surviving deadly obstacle courses while one of you secretly controls the traps.

5242110.title: Oscilloscopia
5242110.short_description: Oscilloscopia is a puzzle game built around an authentically simulated oscilloscope. Build signals, patch modules and tune the instrument until the phosphor trace matches the target. Experiment with signal processing and find your own solutions.

5242180.title: Paw Works Co.
5242180.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

5242260.title: Packsmith
5242260.short_description: Pack your customers’ inventories, build clever item combinations, and earn enough points to keep your cozy medieval shop alive. Every item, every space, every decision counts!

5242410.title: Textures Not Included
5242410.short_description: [Textures Not Included] is a p̷s̷y̷c̷h̷o̷l̷o̷g̷i̷c̷a̷l̷ ̵h̵o̵r̵r̵o̵r̵ incremental game about perception, progression, and the ̶p̶r̶i̶c̶e̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶v̶i̶s̶u̶a̶l̶ ̶c̶l̶a̶r̶i̶t̶y̶. N̄othîng ēxīsts ûntîl yōu p̄āy f̄ōr īt. Click to earn, buy [TE X T UR E S], and r̵e̵n̵d̵e̵r̵ your surrounding bit by bit.

5242590.title: Somewhere Else
5242590.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

5242660.title: The Dust of Battle
5242660.short_description: A lightning‑fast turn-based tactical game with explosive progression across 40‑minute campaigns, where every battle becomes a high‑stakes Strike vs Counter duel.

5243130.title: Desktop Tower
5243130.short_description: Who says you have to stop gaming to be productive? Desktop Tower is an IDLE TOWER DEFENSE that takes up just a small corner of your screen. Leave it running while you work and enjoy a little dose of strategy throughout your day. Your desktop will never be the same again! 💀⌨️

5243360.title: Hello Golem
5243360.short_description: Deep in the bowels of Cocoa Co. lays a terrible evil… Thankfully, June is on the case! Her courageous friend, Golem (that's you!), will venture the building in search of this evil. But be careful: you never know what else you may find there…

5243490.title: BibimBoB
5243490.short_description: BibimBob is a simple game: just keep jumping and dashing forward. All you need to do is pass the traps and reach the goal.

5243570.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
5243570.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

5243750.title: Doug's Playground
5243750.short_description: JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST WATER! For generations, the Muck have suffered under the tyranny of water. Now Doug’s patented Playground Protocol lets you simulate war scenarios to assist those in the field. Support your Muck troops today!

5243930.title: ZAPLOOPA 4040
5243930.short_description: ZAPLOOPA is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

5244330.title: MOTHERLODE
5244330.short_description: Dig into a persistent world of prospecting, mining and industrial engineering. Discover finite deposits, excavate real material, process it through machines, build power, water and logistics networks, sell your haul, upgrade your operation, and expand your claims alone or with friends.

5244390.title: Beyond Realm
5244390.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your town is the reward. The kingdom has faded to grey ink, and every artefact you bring home paints one colour back. Your deck dies with the run, the town never does. Out there, place your cards and watch them fight on their own.

5244440.title: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
5244440.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

5244650.title: RIPPLES
5244650.short_description: Gather the group. Negotiate. Take risks. Rule the board. RIPPLES is an online board game for up to 6 players where strategy, negotiation, and luck collide every match.

5244840.title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
5244840.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

5244970.title: Elroy: King of the Jungle
5244970.short_description: A Brand-New 30-Year-Old Game. This 90's animated point-and-click adventure is finally released! Crash-land in a dangerous jungle with Elroy, his sidekick Blue AND Elroy’s annoying little brother Slim. Solve puzzles, survive crazy calamities, and navigate challenges to bring everyone home safe.

5245080.title: Polliwoggle
5245080.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where you're a frog going on a fishing trip. Roll and allocate dice to catch the biggest fish. Draft trinkets and stickers to help you out on your journey and race the clock to get a train ticket and continue your fishing trip.

5245280.title: KICK//LINE
5245280.short_description: Dribble, dodge and shoot your way through the city in KICK//LINE, a 3D football running action game. Chain feints, jumps and slides, wow the crowd with freestyle tricks, and challenge street rivals across five cities.

5245480.title: The Last Summer Holiday
5245480.short_description: A cozy story game about one summer with your grandparents on the Mongolian steppe. By day, learn the old ways with your own hands. By night, Grandpa tells a folktale and you dream your way into it: a fifteen-headed mangas, a serpent, seven burning suns. Six tales. Six dreams. One goodbye.

5245670.title: RenewCity
5245670.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

5245830.title: Wheel You Drive?
5245830.short_description: Grab a friend and take control of the same RC car in this chaotic 2-player co-op game! Each player controls a different part of the car, so you'll need to communicate, coordinate your movement, and somehow make it through every obstacle together.

5245880.title: Wagerborn
5245880.short_description: A slot-machine roguelite where your RPG equipment becomes the reel. Equip weapons and relics, manipulate your symbol pool, complete powerful matches, merge gear, and build increasingly broken combinations across each run.

5246170.title: Sherlock Mysteries: Victorian Investigations
5246170.short_description: Book-style murder investigation game set in Victorian London. Logic, Deduction and Attention to Details - use this to solve game mysteries. Unfold story chapters, investigate clues, visit London historical locations - and help to get murder into jail.

5246420.title: Dash It!
5246420.short_description: A pixel platformer about jumping and dashing. Race up to 8 players in real time, chase the world No. 1 ghost in Time Attack, clear 72 stages across 12 themes, and build and share your own maps. Hang out in the lobby, change outfits and decorate your own house.

5246510.title: The Inkwell
5246510.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

5246700.title: Defilade
5246700.short_description: Defilade is an ambitious real-time strategy game that brings a never-before-seen smart AI soldier system to the genre. Set in the modern day, it has three factions (West, East and Rebels) fighting it out from advanced trench warfare to urban combat to the desert plains.

5246720.title: Pyramid Solitaire
5246720.short_description: A free casual single-player pyramid solitaire game. Clear the pyramid, chain combos for power-ups, unlock skins, keep your daily streak alive and climb the leaderboards.

5246910.title: Orthodoxía
5246910.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

5247460.title: 水球啪啦Splash Party
5247460.short_description: Splash Party is a colorful water-balloon action game. Place balloons, dodge bursts, break crates, and collect power-ups. Challenge another player in online PvP, practice solo, or face enemies and bosses in the single-player campaign.

5247470.title: Skywatch
5247470.short_description: You work at a small observatory as scientist, studying the sky and making sure nothing unsual goes unnoticed. Explore worlds, launch satelites, receive signals from outer space, solve mystries and connect the dots. Welcome to Skywatch.

5248020.title: By Royal Charter
5248020.short_description: Solitaire's one-more-card appeal meets the satisfaction of building a thriving colony. Place facility cards, recruit specialists, and connect production chains in approachable turn-based strategy. Play your cards. Build your colony.

5248300.title: Thugs in Fantasy
5248300.short_description: You know nothing about magic. You don't know how to swing a sword. Fortunately, you know how to throw a punch.

5248370.title: Buildmaxxing
5248370.short_description: Build together on floating islands in this 1-4 player co-op building game. Each player has a unique role. Memorize blueprints, communicate with your team, and build from memory before time runs out!

5248600.title: Trickstir
5248600.short_description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. Discover blocks and ingredients with special twists across six different worlds. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

5249330.title: HIGHEST STAKES
5249330.short_description: HIGHEST STAKES is a game of Heads-Up five-card poker against the dealer with roguelite elements. Use a variety of chaotic charms and items to cheat the game in your favour. You have a large debt to pay, and at her table, your life is the wager.

5250310.title: Build Bigger Heroes
5250310.short_description: Recruit, equip, fuse, and evolve your own fantasy heroes. Build an army of up to eight in this pixel art roguelite autobattler, discover powerful combinations, and test them across three acts. Choose your encounters, rescue magical Wonders, and forge heroes worth remembering.

5250680.title: Arborist
5250680.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

5250720.title: GoldRush
5250720.short_description: Build your fortune in a 2D mining strategy game set during the American Gold Rush. Bid for land, scan for deposits, mine gold and rare treasures, and upgrade your equipment. Time your sales as prices shift, manage debt, and outsmart rival prospectors.

5250940.title: Astrovein
5250940.short_description: Ready to blast a path to riches in Astrovein? A full hold draws alien warships! Fight beside your captain or man the turret and defend your loot with raw firepower. Upgrade ship, weapons and modules; push into deadlier sectors for rarer ore. Busy? Your captain keeps fighting and mining.

5251020.title: Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn
5251020.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

5251040.title: Orbit Fall
5251040.short_description: Master thrust and momentum against gravity. Dodge hazards, land on distant planets, and complete missions using your ship’s systems. Move objects and clear paths. Manage fuel and damage, upgrade your craft, then launch back to orbit in this 2D pixel-art arcade adventure.

5251590.title: Castlefolk
5251590.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

5251600.title: Fish on the Floor
5251600.short_description: Rescue sea creatures from chaotic floors in a first-person cleanup game. Explore the seafood market and aquarium, toss creatures into matching tanks, and unlock upgrades.

5251680.title: Banana Guy Running Hard
5251680.short_description: A compact fast-paced platformer! Run everywhere, jump everywhere and get everything!

5251800.title: Z-Defender
5251800.short_description: Tired of the military always losing to the zombie horde? Not here. Hold your base through wave after wave, earn cash from every kill, upgrade your guns, man your posts, and call in airstrikes. Hold the line.

5251910.title: Prison Chef Simulator
5251910.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

5251980.title: Strikemania
5251980.short_description: You are the missile. Launch. Strike. Repeat. Kamikaze your way through defenses, master each route, and use previous missiles to help clear the path in this fast-paced retro arcade time-attack game.

5252170.title: Boomfish
5252170.short_description: Captain, open fire! Blast swarms of monster fish! Combine special ammo, secondary weapons and crew support. Boost your firepower with salvage upgrades and return with a hold full of loot. Unlock 50+ armaments, recruit and train 100+ crew, earn deep-sea blessings and brave deadlier waters!

5252250.title: Just One More Season
5252250.short_description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

5252500.title: Blueshift Breakdown
5252500.short_description: Bring destructibility to the extreme in this Asteroids-inspired shoot 'em up. Travel the galaxy and encounter a wide variety of fully destructible asteroids and enemies. Upgrade your ship and annihilate everything in your path, pixel by pixel.

5252590.title: Escape Space 127
5252590.short_description: Escape Space 127 is a first-person 3D maze escape game. In a mysterious maze, you must avoid deadly traps, manage your hunger, repair motors, and pick locks. Uncover your true identity and lost memories, and escape this place.

5252690.title: Break the Planet
5252690.short_description: A satisfying, meditative incremental game about shooting balls to destroy planets. Find the white voxel hidden in each world, unlock more balls, and uncover the secrets to destroy a 10-billion-voxel planet.

5253200.title: Little Bear`s Honey Shop
5253200.short_description: Little Bear's Honey Shop is an incremental game where you battle magical plants, gather flowers and ingredients, and craft sweet honey products. Build powerful combinations on a honeycomb skill tree, sell honey to customers, and grow a tiny shop into a bustling honey empire.

5253210.title: 股魂誓約－Stockbound: Oath of Souls
