5253210.short_description: An online side-scrolling idle RPG where fantasy battles meet a stock-market-inspired economy. Build your knight, recruit allies, challenge bosses and embed virtual stock certificates in equipment. Requires a game account and internet connection.

5253350.title: Lootale Slash
5253350.short_description: Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG. Explore a shared world, choose from six classes, conquer dungeons and world bosses, hunt rare gear, and create a playstyle that is truly your own.

5253400.title: Rogue Tithe
5253400.short_description: A traditional turn-based roguelike of tempo and uncertainty. Roll an adventurer blind, outpace enemies to act twice, sneak past what you cannot fight, and descend twelve floors for the Barrow Relic. Death keeps what you carry, but the crows will fly your gold home for a fee.

5253630.title: Recollect:EDEN
5253630.short_description: A full-length visual novel with voice acting, set in near-future Japan. In the secret “4th Section,” people with supernatural powers known as “GIFT” are gathered. Follow two protagonists from different points in time, choosing “Tsuisou-hen” or “Tsuioku-hen” in any order, and see their love story.

5253810.title: Last Ones Down
5253810.short_description: A social survival game for up to 16 players. Reveal your traits, argue your case, and vote on who gets into the bunker. There’s only room for half of you, and keeping the wrong people could doom everyone inside.

5253880.title: NOEMA
5253880.short_description: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. NOEMA is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

5253930.title: Gideon Unleashed
5253930.short_description: The last wizard. The world's greatest mistake. Every hunter in the kingdom wants him dead, and all he wants is to get home. Walk the road through four lands, build a ring of spells that feed each other, then hold Ravenhold against an army that never stops coming.

5254000.title: Shunt
5254000.short_description: The Devil has scattered Rex's bones all over his house. One press slides Rex, the clay dog, until he hits something, and shoves everything in his path. Line the bones up in a row or column to win them back. 338 hand-built puzzles, 16 worlds, no timer, level editor.

5254050.title: The Iconoclast
5254050.short_description: A sci-fi turn-based RPG and a homage to the great RPGs of the past, featuring an innovative battle system where you can fight with up to 6 of your party members at once. Plus several fully 3D animated PS1-style FMV cutscenes!

5254170.title: Marco!
5254170.short_description: Marco Polo, except your friends can hear you panic. One player hunts blindfolded, seeing only the sounds you make. Hide, whisper, sabotage your friends, and try not to laugh in this microphone-powered multiplayer game of hide-and-seek.

5254210.title: Coins in Place
5254210.short_description: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

5254220.title: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs
5254220.short_description: Find hidden dogs in real museum paintings. Explore dozens of artworks, spot the hand-drawn dogs hiding in the details, and watch the color come back into each canvas. Play solo or hunt with up to three friends in a split screen or online. Enjoy a relaxing hidden-object game set to classical music.

5254360.title: RogueForge
5254360.short_description: Draw your own weapons and build a place to call home. RogueForge is a 3D open-world survival crafting game with gathering, farming, cooking, building and combat. Trade with local communities, engrave runes into your gear, and explore dungeons and challenge bosses.

5254470.title: Down to Business
5254470.short_description: Turn every dig into a bigger operation. Mine for valuable ore, take on contracts, upgrade your vehicle, and build your bases to reach as deep into the planet as possible.

5255290.title: HOLD THE COOP!
5255290.short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

5255300.title: Rekisen TCG
5255300.short_description: With its signature "Rekisen Summoning" system, this snappy arcade card game offers a unique experience with 80 carefully balanced cards. Play your favorite modes, earn gold, and open booster packs to collect cards and build custom decks.

5255710.title: The Understack Society
5255710.short_description: Build a society of misfits, one card at a time. Stack cards to gather food, craft equipment and expand your settlement in this dark fantasy survival game. Recruit citizens, open mysterious parcels and explore new districts. Keep everyone fed, armed and alive.

5255910.title: Fewer Mornings
5255910.short_description: A short first-person game about everything you do before you leave the house. Unpack, cook, do the dishes, feed Saki, answer your mom, leave by eight. Five days in one apartment across twelve years, and there's never time for all of it.

5256430.title: G-MODE Archives+ THE LABYRINTH OF DRUAGA
5256430.short_description: Queen Ki has been captured once again. Take control of Gil and rescue Ki from the underground labyrinth!

5256450.title: Please Fix!
5256450.short_description: You're the entire IT department. Dash between desks, untangle cables, rescue printers and tackle increasingly ridiculous tickets in this funny single-player time-management game. Keep the office happy, upgrade your toolkit, and bring an emotional support duck. No IT knowledge required.

5256530.title: Eyes Blue
5256530.short_description: A psychological survival horror game about grief and guilt. Traverse the distorted memories of Walter Johnson as his mind teeters between life and death, set in a world with a retro aesthetic inspired by the classic era of horror.

5256650.title: Mind Forge
5256650.short_description: A calm, data-driven cognitive trainer. 14 science-based drills sharpen attention, memory, logic, space and reaction: Stroop inhibition, n-back, paper folding, stop-signal tasks. Transparent stats, adaptive difficulty, auto review scheduling. No account; all data stays on your device.

5256760.title: Green Guy Goes Grappling
5256760.short_description: Green Guy Goes Grappling is a fast-paced 2D platformer where Green Guy has to save the universe!

5256860.title: Wobblebound
5256860.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, spend coins at the toy shop and beat six bosses as one of six toymakers. Then race friends or robots, or build one tower together, with up to four players on one PC or online.

5257250.title: Keep Rising
5257250.short_description: A medieval tower defense incremental where the castle outlives every run. Hold the wall against endless waves, Rebirth stronger and find every room you built still standing. 8 towers, 28 spell combinations and a 17-chapter Campaign.

5257260.title: The White Witch of White Winter
5257260.short_description: A short letter from Mom leaves young witch Kore in charge of a winter island. She recalls lost recipes in memories of Mom, brews potions to ease her neighbors' worries, flies on her staff, dives into the deep spring, and fills her empty cottage. Join Kore and uncover the secret Mom left behind.

5257830.title: Gun for Your Life
5257830.short_description: A top-down Western roguelite shooter. Your bullets fly to where you aim, so you can shoot past one bounty hunter and hit the one behind him. Build your outlaw between waves, then hide in the bushes or rush in the open. Somewhere out there is the man who put a price on your head.

5258030.title: Chimp!
5258030.short_description: A monkey dreams of owning his own hair salon. To make his dream come true, help him to collect gold. The gold is locked behind doors ... the keys are protected by whimsical and absurd animal enemies. Fight them with bananas, get the keys and steam the golden coins.

5258080.title: Legacy of the Griffin
5258080.short_description: A narrative horror experience where you unravel the disturbing history of Michael Dubh. Your morality guides each decision, leading to multiple endings as you confront the secrets buried within his mansion and the fate that emerges from the shadows of your past.

5258170.title: Cinephile: Tidy Up The Movie Store
5258170.short_description: A hilarious cozy first-person tidying game for movie lovers! Hand crafted movie posters parodying real movies. No Generative AI! Plus, a level editor to create your own packs and the same familiar game loop you’re familiar with in the genre.

5258490.title: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
5258490.short_description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

5258500.title: Naptide: Fortune Islands
5258500.short_description: 6 islands, 6 different games! In this cozy incremental game full of cats, collect as many eggs as you can in 20-second rounds, grow wheat to bring in new cats and spend your earnings in skill trees. As your islands grow, they power each other up.

5258740.title: Sweep Together
5258740.short_description: The world’s famous monuments are closed. The reason? Mountains of trash! Join the Sweeper Crew, upgrade your tools, and get these iconic sights ready to reopen. Clean solo, team up in online co-op, or work for rival companies in PvP. Race to finish your cleanup first and claim the prize!

5258780.title: Strashnovekovie
5258780.short_description: 2D action RPG. The game’s unique feature is that instead of the usual character leveling, at each level you’ll be joined by an ally with their own unique abilities. By using your allies’ abilities — you’ll be able to complete the game .

5258860.title: MotoBox
5258860.short_description: Motobox is a Sandbox game where you freely ride your motorcycle and weave through traffic at high speed. Experiment with a collection of Motorcycles , Maps & Sandboxes to Ride in , and freely experience how it feels to drive at high speeds through crowded city traffics.

5259050.title: Orange Wiki
5259050.short_description: You wake on the last train at an unfamiliar terminus. Only one app opens on your phone: Orange Wiki, a guide to this place, its entities, and your escape. Explore, compare clues with wiki entries, and find a way out in this first-person horror adventure.

5259080.title: WHERE MEMORY FAILS
5259080.short_description: Where Memory Fails is a dark fantasy memory-and-deduction roguelite. Read the dungeon's clues, reveal a path through the grid, collect gold, survive its dangers, and find the exit before your health and steps run out.

5259120.title: Dark Hours: Anomalies
5259120.short_description: Dark Hours: Anomalies is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. The Trickster has trapped your crew of thieves in an endless loop. Memorize every room and spot the anomalies to break the curse. Miss one and you start over. Can you beat it, or will you be trapped forever?

5259150.title: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?
5259150.short_description: Classic trivia meets the builds and strategic combat of a roguelike! Answer questions to attack enemies, use skills to turn the odds in your favor, and collect artifacts that change how you play. Outsmart the Troll and claim his treasure!

5259350.title: Heartreave
5259350.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

5259590.title: TIC.EXE
5259590.short_description: Three in a row is not a win — it is a discharge. A tactical grid roguelite: fight hostile processes on a shifting board, build an engine out of 30 modules, and clear eight sectors before the machine answers its own launch request. Duel a friend online or on one screen.

5259680.title: Cups and Curses
5259680.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

5259860.title: Pickle & Biscuit
5259860.short_description: A high fantasy action RPG at the end of the world. Outrun an evil Fog that takes anyone too slow, with a fire-mad young mage and her sharp-tongued healer brother. Outthink the Taken and bandits that each fight their own way, and laugh through thousands of voiced lines.

5259970.title: Shot Rock
5259970.short_description: Shot Rock is a curling game where you call the shot, throw it, and sweep it home, presented like curling on TV. Two full teams take the ice in arenas and club venues. Play the AI, a friend, or players online.

5260000.title: Rollamon
5260000.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

5260350.title: Doji Run: Stock Market 3.0
5260350.short_description: Welcome to Stock Market 3.0. DOJI RUN is a real-time cyberpunk stock market roguelite deckbuilder: play chips onto a live 60-second chart, draw the lines the price bounces off, pump it, short it, and beat the boss the Exchange sends every Friday. 100+ edge chips. One rigged market.

5260590.title: The Last Job 2
5260590.short_description: Just another break-in. Or so you thought. Explore a seemingly ordinary house, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls. Experience a first-person horror game where an unsettling atmosphere keeps you on edge.

5260960.title: Utopia '97
5260960.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

5261090.title: Best Dam Game
5261090.short_description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

5261210.title: TOKUGI ARENA
5261210.short_description: Generate energy by typing, solving Tsume Shogi and completing other challenges, then spend it on projectiles, blades and barriers. A team-based action game with CPU practice, solo challenges, Score Attack and compatible VRM avatars.

5261270.title: 修仙：但天道是AI
5261270.short_description: An AI-driven cultivation text adventure. You are a fading soul who seizes a cultivator's body. Debate elders, bond with or rival fellow disciples, survive deadly realms—every choice reshapes your fate. The deeper you go, the more the Heavenly Dao feels like running code. The Dao is an AI.

5261320.title: ARTEMIS' Miscalculation
5261320.short_description: This is the one case the police must never know about. A murder at a Japanese inn, where every guest has secrets. AI Thriller × Logic-Driven Mystery in a world policed and judged by AI. A linear visual novel with no choices. Includes Episode 1, a self-contained case lasting about two hours.

5261450.title: Ayakashi Profile
5261450.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

5261540.title: Mechanical Salvage Works
5261540.short_description: A light, bite-sized incremental game where you zap runaway machines, salvage parts, fulfill orders, and customize your machines!
developers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢
publishers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢

5261650.title: May the Best Craft Win
5261650.short_description: Send four adventurers into a dungeon while you are away. Come back to a haul of sealed loot and rare ore, then gamble it all at the forge: refine, socket, enchant, and sell the surplus on a living market. An idle party RPG where the dungeon is the input and the crafting is the game.

5262180.title: BountySisters
5262180.short_description: Three bounty-hunting sisters take on a wild cast of villains in this fully voiced vertical shoot ’em up! Choose from three unique aircraft, master a variety of weapons, tackle gimmick-packed stages, and face powerful bosses in a colorful world with character designs by Shuzilow.HA.

5262550.title: A Walk in the Park
5262550.short_description: Become a landscaper, take on missions in beautiful parks and gardens, and create the perfect layout to satisfy every visitor.

5262660.title: Micro Generals
5262660.short_description: Micro Generals is a 2D SideScrolling Tug Of War RTS featuring 6 distinct factions with 100+ distinct units with their own strenghts and weaknesses , upgrades system , deep tactical play , 56 levels and faction superpowers

5262690.title: Sacrificium
5262690.short_description: Turn-based roguelike. Every creature carries a trait you can only claim by sacrificing it at the altar. Stack traits into a build, watch your team shrink, and reach the final fight with nothing left to spend. Power is always subtraction.

5262990.title: Mailed It!
5262990.short_description: You're the new night-shift intern at a postal sorting facility. Hit your quota and survive the shift, or build machines to do the work for you. Sorters, fans, conveyors, bizarre contraptions… whatever keeps the mail moving. Because the mail never stops!

5263170.title: Starets
5263170.short_description: Starets is a narrative walking sim set in the historical context of 14th-century Rus, in the lands of the Principality of Tver. Nikodim, a former princely scribe, is on his way to a monastery.

5263260.title: Amnesty
5263260.short_description: Multiplayer survival FPS set over one night in a sealed-off city district. Your crew claims a house and boards it up. While the radio on your safe still works, dying just sends you back inside. Gold cases are loose in the streets, and every other crew wants the same ones.

5263350.title: Cat Cat Meowdow
5263350.short_description: Your grandmother’s letter brings you to a cottage in a quiet valley, and to its cats. Win their trust one by one, cook and garden for them, watch the seasons turn, and wander beyond the valley to find cats most players will never see. No timers, no rush.

5263400.title: Goldgrave
5263400.short_description: An incremental auto-battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero to slay hordes and loot gear. Pick a class with its own attack style and learn its skills. Gear up, sweep the gold and descend against floors of enemies, bosses and legendary drops.

5263800.title: GobliWin
5263800.short_description: A casual 2D swarm RTS with auto-battler combat! Build your goblin war camp and fight through a six-act campaign, from murky swamps to royal fortresses. Unlock and upgrade units, command your growing horde, crush human defenses, and repel counterattacks.

5263820.title: Kintsugi Master
5263820.short_description: Find beauty in the broken. Restore treasured objects through the art of Kintsugi, fulfill commissions, and upgrade your materials as you grow into a master artisan. A cozy, relaxing experience with soothing ASMR sounds and increasingly intricate creations.

5263850.title: Don't Lose the Wheels!
5263850.short_description: Build, survive, and keep rolling in Don't Lose the Wheels! — a chaotic physics-based vehicle party game. Assemble wacky contraptions, navigate brutal obstacle tracks, and battle the elements solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. Whatever happens, don’t lose your wheels!

5263940.title: Wilderune
5263940.short_description: Explore a voxel world across seven biomes, face towering guardians and find your style among 49 weapons. Craft equipment, combine movement accessories and tame animal companions in Wilderune, an action RPG built around exploration.

5263980.title: Dig to Escape
5263980.short_description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

5264650.title: Toothpick Museum
5264650.short_description: You are the curator of the Toothpick Museum. The day before opening, your exhibits shattered! Carefully pick up the scattered toothpicks, avoid getting pricked, and rebuild the museum's masterpiece before the doors open!

5264810.title: What a Wish
5264810.short_description: Pop bubbles, find people's wishes, and decide which ones to grant. From silly everyday requests to surprisingly heartfelt pleas, every wish is a little glimpse into someone's life. Earn Faith Points, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to play in this relaxing incremental game.

5264870.title: Clean Record
5264870.short_description: A cozy first-person cleanup sim on a deep space mining station. A generator blew and scattered crystals through every compartment. Sweep, blow and vacuum them up, buy better tools, and read the notes left behind. Find out what happened to the crew, and decide how their story ends.

5264940.title: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler
5264940.short_description: Raise the dead and write the rules they fight by. In MORTISCRIPT, a gothic auto battler, you program your undead army with simple logic blocks, watch every instruction play out, find out why the plan broke, and fix it, until the kingdom that betrayed you falls.

5265140.title: Unsainted
5265140.short_description: Dva roky po zmizení svých přátel se mladý Lucas vrací na místo, kde je naposledy viděl. Místo toho však odhalí temné tajemství, které propojuje minulost s přítomností. Ponořte se do hluboce psychologického příběhu odehrávajícího se na opuštěném panství uprostřed amerického lesa.

5265310.title: Bonfire Room
5265310.short_description: A cozy, low-key multiplayer hangout for 2-4 players around a quiet campfire. Feed the fire, sit back and watch the flames, and share six wordless emotes to connect. No goals, no competition, no pressure to talk — just being there together is the point. Works solo too, as ambient background company.

5265330.title: Slender Island
5265330.short_description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

5265550.title: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇
5265550.short_description: 在剑与魔法的世界中开启属于你的冒险，这是一款以角色成长、装备收集、BOSS挑战和多人战斗为核心的魔幻动作角色扮演游戏。选择你的职业，不断升级、转职、强化装备，挑战更强大的敌人，与其他冒险者共同争夺大陆至高荣耀。

5265640.title: Click or Wait
5265640.short_description: An idle and clicker game about a machine that is never finished. Build seesaws and mills and let items fall through them: every single piece with real physics. Decide for yourself whether you click, wait or let the machines work. Plus a Teamwork mode with a shared monthly goal.

5265810.title: Hit the Anvil
5265810.short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

5266320.title: 水浒：无限江山
5266320.short_description: 《水浒：无限江山》是一款水浒题材的自走棋游戏，合成，升级，战斗！五十余位水浒英雄，百种技能自由组合，由你排兵布阵，共谱一页水泊梁山传奇。是延续绘本故事，忠义招安；还是不理这昏庸朝廷，替天行道。这一切将由你亲自决定！

5266700.title: Prosecutor Absolution
5266700.short_description: You have been appointed Deputy Chief Prosecutor of Davelia. Your goal is to pay off your mortgage. Your tool is other people's prison sentences. Your conscience is your problem. The State of Davelia will not forget about you.

5266920.title: River Hallucination
5266920.short_description: River Hallucination is a mystery game set in a hotel by the river, where every guest hides a different challenge. Win at games of chance, bluff, and strategy to uncover what's really going on.

5267090.title: Idle Raiders: Second Run
5267090.short_description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

5267640.title: Forever
5267640.short_description: Forever is a free-to-play, old-school 2D fantasy MMORPG. Create your character, level up, master your class, fight in open PvP duels and tournaments, found a clan and trade in a persistent world shared with players on PC and other devices.

5268270.title: Stack Heroes
5268270.short_description: Stack cards to cook, craft and build your own outlaw stronghold. Recruit heroes from Water Margin, keep your camp fed with automated supply routes, and lead your band in pausable real-time battles. A single-player survival and management game.

5268380.title: Green Again!
5268380.short_description: A pure logic puzzle that combines Minesweeper-style number deduction with water-line coverage on a hexagonal grid.

5268400.title: Weirdoku: The Files
5268400.short_description: Weirdoku: the Files is a horror puzzle game. You play as a new recruit at the Anomaly Bureau, reconstructing the scene from the clues and identifying the Anomaly hidden among the people.

5268480.title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
5268480.short_description: The human king is dead, and the fragile peace of Turtek died with him. Survive as a goblin in an open world, solo or in co-op: sneak past raiders, fight with stamina-based combat, rescue goblins and peaceful humans, and build a colony that keeps working while you explore.

5268540.title: Idle Process
5268540.short_description: An incremental game played entirely through typed commands in a terminal window. You are a machine under contract. Spawn autonomous agents to perform work for you and use the tokens they create to research new improvements to your process.

5268640.title: Shrouded Aura
5268640.short_description: Shrouded Aura is a psychological horror experience where trauma, memory, and perception distort reality. Explore shifting environments, uncover conflicting diary entries, and survive disturbing manifestations as you piece together the truth. Play in VR or on PC.

5268810.title: Flak Simulator
5268810.short_description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

5269050.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
5269050.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

5269300.title: TIP or RIP
5269300.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

5269330.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
5269330.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

5269700.title: Gravity Trials
5269700.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

5269890.title: Biden Blast
5269890.short_description: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

5269940.title: Battleterm
5269940.short_description: Battleterm is a drone combat simulator, a fusion of a simulator and a strategy game. It aims to simulate a real drone battlefield. Your task is to defeat the enemy by spawning different drones and coordinating their strategies. And the game economy matters too.

5270220.title: Sound Bounded
5270220.short_description: Sound is everything. Explore a dark, misty world, activate mysterious crystals and survive a relentless hunter who sees through sound. Scream to run faster, stay quiet to hide, and use the environment to your advantage. Every noise has consequences.

5270260.title: Desktop Cozy Sheep
5270260.short_description: Meet your new office companions! Watch your sheep and goats sleep, eat, and frolic while you work or relax. Unlock new animals and decorate the little pasture at the bottom of your screen!

5270330.title: SNATCH & BETRAY
5270330.short_description: SNATCH & BETRAY is a living tabletop treasure hunt. Explore the jungle, find gold, deal with traps, and decide when to cooperate with other adventurers — and when to take the treasure for yourself.

5270720.title: Grow and Tell
5270720.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

5270760.title: Tetrilaunch
5270760.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

5270820.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
5270820.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

5271020.title: Cookie Cartel
5271020.short_description: Sugar is illegal, the bakeries are shut, and Christmas tastes like nothing. But Grandma's recipe book survived. Bake in the back room with up to eight players, sell at the back door, and keep the Department of Sugar Affairs out of your kitchen.

5271080.title: Tillow
5271080.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

5271100.title: Tales of Weak People
5271100.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

5271150.title: Globecide
5271150.short_description: Fly a warship around a living planet and take it apart. Steer nukes into capitals, drop its moon on it, crack its crust, flood its coasts. Every crater stays, and the planet fires back. 72 worlds, a roguelite Rampage mode, and a Forge that turns any picture into a planet.

5271310.title: Kingside Break
5271310.short_description: A chess game where you lead a customizable fantasy army through 1,500 levels of curated puzzles and real chess matches. Face checkpoint commanders, recruit new races, and customize your hero and army. Key chess concepts encountered are logged in a Sage Ledger for education and future reference.

5271550.title: Hungry Cataway
5271550.short_description: Chomp your way through levels, dodge enemies and escape! Hungry Cataway is a charming grid-based pixel-art arcade game. Blast through walls with bombs, outmaneuver hazards, and unleash your ultimate vomit attack to clear the path.

5271570.title: 1,000,000 Lentils & Ashes
5271570.short_description: Separate lentils from ash. By hand. One million items, two sorting pits, and you. A minimalist first-person game where every correctly sorted item brings you slightly closer to the end. Good luck.

5271580.title: Shred Inc.
5271580.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

5271600.title: Nephele
5271600.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

5271610.title: Cyber Sweeper
5271610.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

5271900.title: Fishbrary
5271900.short_description: Keep a mysterious fishing library on your desktop. Open six books to discover real fish, oddly adorable mutants, and prehistoric creatures. Display your catches in an aquarium, enjoy Idle or timed Focus Mode, and uncover an investigator's notes as your collection grows.

5271920.title: BOBA:3
5271920.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

5271980.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
5271980.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

5272000.title: Gravitonia
5272000.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

5272230.title: Station 12
5272230.short_description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players, with larger lobbies up to 12. Find keycards and race to escape a doomed station while a friend hunts you as the Monster. Land the shot that saves your crew, or give away your hiding spot over proximity chat.

5272260.title: ALL HANDS LOST
5272260.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

5272700.title: PAWSHOT
5272700.short_description: PAWSHOT - a deadly roulette for true predators. Count your shells, put your paws, fangs, and shotgun to use. Your life is on the line. Good luck.

5272710.title: Roadshift
5272710.short_description: Roadshift is a fast-paced arcade racing game featuring 42 handcrafted circuits, a full Career mode, challenging AI, local split-screen multiplayer, Time Attack, custom races and cups across seven distinctive environments.

5272860.title: Cook Or Get Cooked
5272860.short_description: A first-person cooking game on a television contest. Fetch, wash, chop, fry and plate real dishes against a clock, then hand them to a judge who eats them in front of you and marks them out of a hundred. Lowest mark of the round goes home.

5272880.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
5272880.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

5273490.title: BOZÓ!
5273490.short_description: BOZÓ is a dice roguelite where every roll can change your run. Build powerful combinations, use unique cards and relics, face dangerous challenges, and discover how far your luck can take you.

5273550.title: Ecos de Valdrenne
5273550.short_description: A dark, turn-based JRPG where the Resonator reads traces, changes enemy intentions and steals techniques. Explore a top-down 2D world of secrets, solve puzzles with eight divine powers, and decide what to preserve when memory itself fractures.

5274100.title: Karesansui
5274100.short_description: Karesansui is a zen garden meditative sandbox. Rake and decorate your desktop garden as you listen to the calming sounds of nature. Experiment with different patterns, lighting, and materials, and share the perfect photos with your friends.

5274600.title: MINES SET!
5274600.short_description: The roguelike minesweeper. MINES SET! is a satisfying puzzle game where you open an endless board, find game-changing sponsors and set off huge combos.

5274670.title: Revengeful dwell
5274670.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game. From horror game developer Akumu Yuko comes the third installment, “Revengeful dwell.”

5274840.title: A Mirror Apart
5274840.short_description: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.

5274850.title: Our Art Show
5274850.short_description: Open an art show with friends. Paint at the teaching easel while everyone watches the big screen. Hold up a finished canvas, find it a frame and a spot on the wall, and pass the music player to whoever brought the good songs.

5274880.title: Merchants Demise
5274880.short_description: A dark roguelike trading RPG where you lead a caravan through a dangerous kingdom, buy low, sell high, recruit a crew, survive brutal encounters, and gamble everything on one more, profitable journey.

5275040.title: Orbit Foundry
5275040.short_description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

5275130.title: Machine Madness
5275130.short_description: Build your machine, connect moving parts, set goals, and watch physics take over. Professor Otto Correct has a workshop, a cat, and many parts that were never meant to go together.

5275380.title: Pico32: The Lost Pages
5275380.short_description: A magical book appears in the woods, transported somehow from another dimension. Pico32: The Lost Pages is packed cover-to-cover with 32 creative games spanning every genre. Its chapters recall the history of a doomed world, and whisper a warning for our own.

5275590.title: Dirt Town
5275590.short_description: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

5275750.title: Epsilon Aurigae
5275750.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

5275920.title: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs
5275920.short_description: A masked hero for hire. A starship crew who need his ship far more than his opinions. Six jobs that were all meant to be easy, in a fully voiced sci-fi comedy visual novel with animated characters and choices the crew remember.

5275930.title: Grave Company
5275930.short_description: A chaotic co-op zombie game for up to 10 players! Fight your way into creepy cemeteries overrun by hordes of zombies, grab bizarre objects and race against the clock. A random toilet in the middle of a cemetery? No time to ask questions!

5276060.title: How Deep
5276060.short_description: A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caves, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.

5276230.title: Revenge For Two
5276230.short_description: Revenge For Two is a narrative-driven 3D action-adventure game featuring platforming and puzzle elements, with two unique playable characters between whom the player can switch at almost any time.

5277020.title: Jenoria
5277020.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

5277420.title: Omega Transmission
5277420.short_description: Omega Transmission is a short PSX-styled action-platformer, set in a dystopian future where AI has taken over civilization. Humanity's last chance is a secret network deployed through antennas on the tallest skyscrapers of the Megalopolis. Activate the antenna in each city to enable the revolution.

5278260.title: Fire Buller
5278260.short_description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

5278280.title: Terminal Depth
5278280.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

5278380.title: The Millionth Ticket
5278380.short_description: The Millionth Ticket is a lottery simulator: Buy tickets, pick numbers and watch live draws on TV. Manage your money and pay rent so your asshole landlord won't kick you out. Hit the jackpot and escape your shitty life to spend your days drinking and watching TV.

5278520.title: ARUFA - The Blade of Fate
5278520.short_description: An anime-inspired 3D hack-and-slash game where you chain attacks, dodge enemy strikes, unleash powerful abilities, and challenge yourself to defeat a dangerous boss.

5278530.title: Rosalia: Match-3 Puzzle
5278530.short_description: Solve puzzles, collect magical outfits, decorate your home, and help the heroine save the world.

5278570.title: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames
5278570.short_description: The most hectic relaxing game you'll ever play

5278600.title: Dwarven King
5278600.short_description: Build a dwarven kingdom inside a mountain. Dig tunnels, hire miners to gather resources, and expand your settlement. Explore hidden halls, collect relics, and rally soldiers and sorcerers against the goblins and trolls you uncover.

5278920.title: Arena Shooter
5278920.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

5278970.title: Sketchy Warfare
5278970.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

5279010.title: Tide Pools
5279010.short_description: Rake the beach before the tide comes in! Uncover shells, fossils and lost treasures, fill your seaside museum with visitors and grow your rake across ten shores in a cozy pixel-art incremental.

5279320.title: Taco Truck Simulator
5279320.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

5279340.title: Ladder Knight
5279340.short_description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

5279710.title: Glitch Front
5279710.short_description: Glitch Front is a tactical cyberpunk card battler where team chemistry matters as much as the cards you draw. Build your crew, combine powerful faction synergies, master separate Play and Combat decks, and fight for control of a shared Warzone.

5279840.title: SCRAPSCRAP
5279840.short_description: You're a lone robot that was left behind to clean up all of humanity's trash. Break down trash piece by piece and recycle them into tools, upgrades and a whole crew of helper bots. Stack up all the trash and restore the planet in this physics-driven incremental game.

5280000.title: CARTACLYSM
5280000.short_description: A chaotic, physics-based party game. Compete against your friends. Sabotage your opponents with power-ups, physics and pure pettiness. Honk your way towards your rightful spot as the Top Goose.

5280310.title: Himekishi Survivor
5280310.short_description: Protect dragon eggs and fight enemy hordes with auto-attacking skills and rideable dragons. Collect and fuse gear, unlock outfits that change your starting skill, and turn defeat into Awakening powers. Conquer four stages and their mighty bosses in Himekishi Survivor.

5280900.title: Asteroid Lanes
5280900.short_description: Draw trade lanes across a single seamless universe drawn in symbols and lines, and let your ships mine, haul and sell on their own. Chase the materials you lack and the regions you want, push your network outward, and hold the lanes against pirates.

5281050.title: Just A DVD Incremental
5281050.short_description: Remember waiting for the DVD logo to hit the exact corner of the TV screen? Now you don't have to wait. Upgrade speed, efficiency, and special effects to maximize your bounces in this relaxing incremental idle game. Will it hit the corner?

5281120.title: Super Doodle Mega War
5281120.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

5281140.title: 国gal笑笑传
5281140.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

5281350.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
5281350.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

5281790.title: Illyrium: Chronicles
5281790.short_description: Recruit heroes and craft powerful builds from masteries, classes, spells and equipment. Use these systems to build each character your way, then command your party in challenging turn-based tactical combat.

5281870.title: Tailgun
5281870.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

5281900.title: Leave Them Outside
5281900.short_description: A life sim. Except you're in the real world. After the bombs fall, Shelter 38 beneath Kadıköy is yours to run. You decide who gets in, and you do whatever it takes to keep everyone inside alive. Multiple endings, shaped by your choices.

5282260.title: CULET
5282260.short_description: Strike a glowing crystal monolith until it shatters. Every click cracks it further, shards break off and become currency, and upgrades carry you through twelve crystals, from Amethyst to Diamond. A focused, finite clicker about one beautiful object and the joy of breaking it.

5282270.title: SEAM VR
5282270.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

5282420.title: Border Pastoral Tale
5282420.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

5282430.title: Fastfood Burger Stories
5282430.short_description: Manage your own fast-food restaurant: take orders, cook meals, serve customers, and hire staff. Furnish and customize your restaurant, manage supplies, upgrade equipment, and grow a small burger joint into a large restaurant.

5282530.title: Toad Roller
5282530.short_description: A timed nervous arcade platformer where a punk toad spirals his way up rotating towers. 3 worlds, 30 towers, 3 stars per tower to earn against the clock, local and world best times, and a level editor to build your own towers.

5282630.title: Until You're Empty
5282630.short_description: A fast-paced action platformer set in a vertical arena. Dash, leap and slash through waves of enemies and deadly bosses. Manage your stamina carefully: every jump and sword strike costs you, and one mistake can leave you running on empty. One hit is all it takes to die.

5282710.title: Quiet Bloom
5282710.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

5283270.title: MAMA
5283270.short_description: Mama is a psychological horror game with a dark, unsettling atmosphere, set on the abandoned fifth floor of an old Soviet apartment building. As you explore, you will slowly uncover what happened there and why the entire floor was left behind.

5283280.title: MEGAMINE
5283280.short_description: Dig up, not down. Pilot a mining pod through an endless shaft, six biomes and the boss guarding each one. Eighteen weapons that fire themselves, twenty-nine items to find, six miners to choose from, and one loaf of bread a biome for when your hearts run low

5283350.title: Above Water, Below Hell
5283350.short_description: Fight your way through a zombie-infested high-rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

5283780.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
5283780.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

5284030.title: Soft 17
5284030.short_description: A blackjack roguelite, then a poker one. Every winning hand scores chips × MULT, and your items push the MULT higher. Beat four casinos, furnish your cellar, then cheat at the tables of four poker houses under the dealers' eyes. Solo, or up to four players online.

5284970.title: Spirits: Wake Up!
5284970.short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

5285090.title: Ruinhand
5285090.short_description: Turn the room into your weapon in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Ignite oil, chain lightning and shove guards into mines. Climb ten Ruin levels per hero, uncover each hero's story, chase the Daily Ruin, race up to four friends live, or bring one into co-op.

5285630.title: Dead Descent
5285630.short_description: Dead Descent is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of urban explorers will enter a secret underground lab filled with failed experiments and try to gather as much evidence against the company as you can. Use your survival skills to make it out alive... If you can.

5285840.title: Leif's Garden Tower
5285840.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

5286530.title: Minds & Myths
5286530.short_description: Human-authored adventures, made interactive by AI. A story map keeps the plot on track while every character thinks for itself. Bring your own AI key: buy once, no subscription, your stories stay on your PC.

5286610.title: Knights Of Four Kingdoms
5286610.short_description: Defend a besieged kingdom in a real-time tactical strategy game. Build walls, towers and traps, command heroes and specialized troops, manage scarce resources, and adapt your defenses against raiders, monsters and siege engines across handcrafted battlefields.

5286760.title: Imp Pact
5286760.short_description: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

5287540.title: 8plus9
5287540.short_description: 8plus9 is an isometric action RPG inspired by Taiwanese temple folklore. Slash through spirits, cast talisman magic, tame cats and dogs, and challenge five elemental dragons. Forge your gear, ride a spirit beast, or keep growing with auto-hunting and offline rewards.

5287630.title: Dragopocalypse
5287630.short_description: In Dragopocalypse, you play as a giant, dragon girl who destroys towns and plunders ingredients to keep her café afloat... Using their immense power, bring destruction to different worlds...while also bringing delicious ingredients to the café!

5287820.title: Undercurrent: The Hollow Crown
5287820.short_description: Compete with enemies for cards on a shifting shared track. Combine cards into new moves and arrange them in limited play slots. Each floor pits you against several enemies who fight one at a time, while those on the sidelines interfere with your decisions.

5288040.title: Spin Tide
5288040.short_description: Spin to win in this open-sea survivors-like where a lone wind turbine becomes a force of nature. Stack wild upgrades into game-breaking builds, turn oil-guzzling pirate hordes into driftwood and defy colossal oil tankers to clean up the seas one spin at a time.

5288530.title: Silent Fright
5288530.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for up to six players. You are a crew of elves sent to save a space station knocked out of orbit. Gather dark matter to power your gear, but stay quiet, because something is sleeping in the dark. Wake it and it hunts you. Charge up, and hunt it back.

5288540.title: Bonaparte 1789 AD
5288540.short_description: The game of power, intrigue and freedom. Europe, 1789: lead France, Prussia, Austria, Russia or Great Britain through revolution and war. Rule month by month, keep your estates and rival courts in check, forge alliances and fight hex battles – all the way to an imperial crown or your downfall.

5288650.title: Love Locks
5288650.short_description: Love is forever. Until you bring bolt cutters. Remove 100,000 love locks solo or near friends in this relaxing cleanup game. Fish for keys with a magnet in the Seine in Paris, unlock tools from lockpicks to lasers, and turn romantic gestures into scrap metal 🔐

5288880.title: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
5288880.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

5289320.title: Brek
5289320.short_description: Take on the role of a homeless person without a penny to his name, your main goal is to buy your dream apartment. However, you have no intention of tainting yourself with a regular job, so you rely on whatever comes your way, regardless of whether the owner gives permission.

5289370.title: Million Gems: Sorting Wizard
5289370.short_description: A cozy magic game about a wizard trapped in a magical castle. The only way out? Sort one million gems.

5289390.title: Alarion: The Ruined King
5289390.short_description: Alarion: The Ruined King is a dark fantasy action game. A dead king awakens through the power of his own blood and sets out across a demon-infested kingdom. unleash forbidden blood powers, battle deadly enemies and bosses, and face Malachar to end his reign.

5289450.title: Tower of Sequence
5289450.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

5289730.title: The Lostwood
5289730.short_description: The Lostwood combines a hardcore turn-based roguelike of strategy and resource management with PvP mind games full of laughs. Prepare your loadout, automate combat loops and explore a dark forest. Or join 2–8 player Steam battles for bold reads, clutch plays and wild comebacks.

5290350.title: No Light at Sea
5290350.short_description: Turn an abandoned lighthouse into your last refuge. Salvage, fish and craft alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Brave the storms, rebuild floor by floor and uncover what lurks behind the legends of Brittany. Bring back the light. Before you lose your bearings.

5290540.title: Skiing Red
5290540.short_description: A physics-based rage game about skiing to the bottom of a mountain. Control your skis individually, dodge questionable obstacles and try not to crash.. You will crash.. A lot.

5290610.title: Slime Break
5290610.short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

5290620.title: Wind and Splinters
5290620.short_description: Play as a musketeer in boarding fights, a gunner in cannon duels, or the helmsman of a 17th-century ship, all in first person. Fight solo or team up with friends, battle each other or the AI, and command your crew. Snap masts, smash hulls, tear ships apart — literally. Use the wind to win.

5291000.title: Crown Me Again
5291000.short_description: Defend against waves of adventurers, collect tons of loot, create powerful builds and climb your way back to the top of the ladder as the fallen Skull King. Incremental Clicker meets Loot-Driven Action RPG.

5291330.title: Company Coal
5291330.short_description: Have you ever yearned for the mines? No? Too bad. Welcome to the Consolidated Coal & Iron Company family! Dig coal, meet your quotas, and try to pay down a debt that grows by the day. Solo or online co-op, for your convenience.

5291380.title: Panning Out
5291380.short_description: Pan a sleepy creek for gold, melt it down at your forge and craft rings, coins and crowns for your village. Panning Out is a cozy gold rush: no hurry, no stress, just the joy of a nugget glinting in your pan.

5291560.title: Stellar Girls
5291560.short_description: Build a K-pop group. Watch them fall for each other—or fall apart. Match-3 comebacks and intimate VN moments reveal chemistry, rivalry, trust. Your choices shape their bonds and performance. Then graduation forces an impossible choice: who stays, and who says goodbye?

5291570.title: Patadas
5291570.short_description: Quesito & Turrón are two ducks with puzzles to solve. Coordinate, push things around, and find your way to the end of each level in this small free game for two. Play on the same screen or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together.

5291660.title: Withstand The Horde
5291660.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies: 4,000 zombies simulated, up to 1,050 drawn on screen. Includes a guided tutorial. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

5291810.title: Mexico 1920-1940: Heirs of the Revolution
5291810.short_description: A turn-based narrative political sim: govern Mexico from the presidency, 1920–1940. Build your cabinet, lobby Congress, negotiate with rebels and send troops into battle without knowing how far they’ll obey. What if Zapata had become president? Or Villa? 75 endings, from historical to far-fetched.

5292590.title: PW7A
5292590.short_description: You awaken from a long sleep as a robot. All you know is that this game is called PW7A. Turn your insights into the power to open new paths in this compact 2D pixel-art puzzle adventure.
developers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ
publishers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ

5292730.title: Gnomenclature
5292730.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where cards must be played together, and order matters. Collect, upgrade, and unleash powerful combos on a variety of whimsical garden creatures.

5292790.title: Honk
5292790.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

5292860.title: Tidy Slot Cars
5292860.short_description: Tidy a slot car club and take your favourites to the track! Sort 1,497 cars by model and colour in this cozy first-person organising game. Unlock cars as you tidy, build your own circuits, and race your cat or a friend in local split-screen.

5292890.title: CORD:EX MAGIAS
5292890.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite where your hand is the puzzle. Weave your cards into Cores and unleash combo attacks. Explore a 2.5D world and meet every telegraphed strike head-on until it BREAKs. When hearts resonate, strike as one with up to five companions and face the truth at the end of five tales.

5293010.title: My Cat Is a Maid!
5293010.short_description: A short, slice-of-life romance visual novel. As an anime merch shop clerk, you meet a cat-eared maid "cosplayer" while running an errand for your manager. Her request? Adopt her! Wait—she’s a real catgirl?! Your cozy life with an adorable catgirl begins!

5293090.title: FACULA
5293090.short_description: Explore, Build, and Fight in this handcrafted solar system with many secrets to discover and enemies to defeat! FACULA is an open world exploration and base-building focused game where you fight monsters and survive on an array of unknown worlds.

5293880.title: Harmony Strike
5293880.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

5294140.title: Handful of Dice
5294140.short_description: Handful of Dice is a digital dice tray for tabletop RPGs and board games. Pick up your dice, shake them and throw. Only physics decides what they roll. Customise your dice however you like. Make your own dice sets and use them whenever you want.

5294620.title: Barbe-Yeux
5294620.short_description: A comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore islands, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is almost "Gloubi".

5295010.title: Retro Empire
5295010.short_description: Buy filthy retro consoles from strangers, bring them back to life on your workbench and sell them in your own second-hand game shop. Haggle for stock, take on repair jobs, fix up arcade machines and grow the shop level by level. Free one-hour demo.

5295050.title: Musdart
5295050.short_description: Musdart is a handcrafted narrative adventure game with wood-carved characters and a lot of weirdness. Avenge your father and reconnect with him by learning his language, the language of the ancient gnomes.

5295080.title: Silent Frequency
5295080.short_description: One night. A dead mountain road. An abandoned radio tower where your grandfather stopped answering. All he left behind: handwritten notes, scattered frequencies and his voice on tape. Bring the tower back to life and listen closely. Something out there is listening back.

5295290.title: Paladin HC
5295290.short_description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in this tactical artillery simulator game. Join historical military operations. Calculate firing ranges, manage resources, and support allies. Add Paladin HC to your Steam wishlist and support our indie team!

5295490.title: The Hollow Road: Echoes of Dresden
5295490.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a dark secret, a hidden past, and a reality falling apart. Uncover Clara’s story, face the influence of the demon, and shift between disturbing dimensions.

5295810.title: The Film Archive
5295810.short_description: Restore order to a film archive in this cozy first-person sorting game. Inspect films, reunite numbered reels, and shelve 400 films across three floors. Unlock useful upgrades and turn towering piles of film cans into a satisfying, organized collection.

5296090.title: Runecast
5296090.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the cards are letters. Draft runes, spell real words to cast spells, collect powerful relics and scrolls and fight your way up the tower. Seven modes, including an asynchronous online Arena. Play in English or Greek: two dictionaries, two different games.

5296170.title: Peso Pena
5296170.short_description: Train, build your fight plan, and watch it play out. A boxing game with incremental training and automatic bouts, where winning is only half the job: eleven owners share your contract. Buy yourself back, one share at a time.

5296440.title: Locard
5296440.short_description: A first-person detective game about evidence, not hunches. Search crime scenes, log what you find, question witnesses, and separate what they saw from what they assumed. You can only make an accusation the evidence supports. Every choice closes a door behind you.

5297150.title: Topica
5297150.short_description: You're stranded on an Island. Build a house, explore the open world, hunt animals, plant food, and much more. Start your new life far from civilization and uncover the island's secrets.

5297380.title: JUST TYPE
5297380.short_description: Chase speed when you want a challenge, or slow down and type for the rhythm of it. Play across multiple modes and word sets, track WPM, accuracy and streaks, climb Steam leaderboards, check profile stats, and customize colors and typing sounds.

5298260.title: Power Washing: Bear Cemetery
5298260.short_description: Take over the care of Bear Hollow’s overgrown cemetery. Wash weathered headstones, mow the grass, and bring a little peace to its residents. Your predecessor left you the tools for the job—but looking after this place means more than keeping it tidy.

5298270.title: The Crash
5298270.short_description: Wake up or run! The Crash is a high tension 5-minute horror game where you are trapped inside a dream maze. Navigate the panic, avoid the monsters and find the way out.

5298740.title: DDDig
5298740.short_description: Nagged out of the house by his mother, an unemployed young man grabs a shovel and digs for riches. How deep can you go? *This game contains cognitive distortion, social isolation, body horror, blood, and themes of suicide.*

5299090.title: Robot Gridiron
5299090.short_description: American football where every player is a robot — and every robot rolls off the line with a 1 in all eight stats. You are the Owner: call the plays, author the playbook, and turn blank chassis into a championship team. Your first season is free.

5299350.title: Pop Star Life 2
5299350.short_description: Start with nothing in a city that never sleeps. Busk on street corners, work 13 side jobs, write and record your own songs, furnish a home, and play real rhythm shows from an open mic to a packed club. Every street, door and stage is yours to walk into.

5299400.title: Dino Warband
5299400.short_description: Build your dinosaur warband! Recruit, evolve, and position prehistoric giants and pack hunters, then watch your strategy clash with rival beasts. Adapt between battles and take down mighty bosses in this thrilling single-player auto battler.

5299460.title: Black Banner Company
5299460.short_description: You never strike a blow. You decide who does, with what, and who stands beside him. In this mercenary management RPG you build your groups around their talents and their affinities, equip them, send them out. But not all of them will come home.

5299470.title: Go CocoNuts!
5299470.short_description: A 1-4 player incremental-clicker first-person game on tropical islands. Grind coconuts, upgrade, loot and do it faster with friends, sharing economy. How much gold per second can you make?

5299520.title: Star Replica
5299520.short_description: Mine, build, and replicate. Pilot a modular spacecraft through an unexplored universe, then put your replicas to work with autonomous mining and crafting. Transfer your consciousness between ships, grow your fleet, and follow mysterious signals into deep space.

5299860.title: SimLife
5299860.short_description: Detailed life simulator where you choose your own path. Study, build a career, start a business, fall in love, and raise a family. Move abroad, enter politics, or risk it all for easy money. Each year brings new choices and unexpected events. Continue your story through the next generation.

5299960.title: Tea House: One More Glass
5299960.short_description: Your father left you a traditional teahouse and a debt you have to close. Brew tea, keep up with orders, keep your regulars happy and look after your family. Four seasons, match days and a family waiting at home. Run the teahouse well and grow the shop before the debts bury you.

5300190.title: Kick4Two
5300190.short_description: Foosball for two. Grab the keyboard or a controller, pick a table and play head-to-head on the same screen, in split screen or over LAN. Real rod physics, a CPU opponent with four levels and five tables.

5300280.title: Great Lakes Captain
5300280.short_description: Start with small boats and work your way up to massive Great Lakes freighters. Navigate ports, bridges, narrow channels, changing weather, and open water in a first-person maritime simulator focused on realistic vessel handling, progression, and life on the lakes.

5300440.title: ARIA
5300440.short_description: An AI. A fly brain. An underwater facility. Wake alone in first-person survival horror: bring ARIA back online, rewire a flooding station and open the capsule yourself. Then lure the specimen hunting you into quarantine—if ARIA's memory can be trusted.

5300630.title: Spirit Mask
5300630.short_description: Reclaim the throne they tore from you! Spirit Mask is a pixel art horde roguelite set in a world of spirits under the pale light of the moon. Alone or in online co-op, forge your legend every night! Dodge what you can't fight, evolve your powers and face bosses that change mid-battle.

5300870.title: CATLINES
5300870.short_description: You're part of the sorting service, it's your final day on the job! Build your way through different worlds, use your skills, and deliver 8,196 cat-boxes to their owners. Drink milk, enjoy chocolate mint, sort every last cat-box

5300990.title: Entangled Logic
5300990.short_description: Survive a failing research facility in Entangled Logic, a top-down action game with programmable quantum devices. Battle swarms, upgrade your build, and defeat six bosses. Use preset circuits or design your own. No quantum physics knowledge required.

5301160.title: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
5301160.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

5301440.title: KEYLINGS
5301440.short_description: Every key on your keyboard becomes a tiny living creature. The more you type, the more your Keylings grow. They play, fall in love, and sometimes even fight in this charming life simulation. Compatible RGB devices can also react with synchronized lighting.

5302430.title: Foturians: Myth and Reality
5302430.short_description: Foturians: Myth and Reality is a non-linear visual novel where you change the probability of events. Your power depends on mood, character, and experience, while the universe's fate is decided by a dice roll. Every choice shapes who you become in the cosmic game's finale.

5302510.title: ThrottleWave: Powerboats
5302510.short_description: Take the wheel of high-powered speedboats and battle your friends on the open water. Race for the finish line in high-speed circuits or test your precision in Gate Catching, where you must blast through spawning gates before your rivals steal the points.

5302530.title: Elancia Replay Online
5302530.short_description: A free-to-play 2D MMORPG in development, with combat, gathering, crafting, and trading planned. Early Access is targeted for mid-to-late March 2027. Follow development and help shape the game through your feedback.

5302630.title: Path & Match
5302630.short_description: Path & Match is a strategic puzzle game where you must clear a path by matching spheres. Earn moves, overcome traps, obstacles and enemies, and adapt your route to reach the exit in time. Analyze the board and plan your moves.

5302680.title: Mushrooooooom
5302680.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

5302820.title: Tamagong
5302820.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

5303380.title: Fih🥀🥀
5303380.short_description: Your monitor is the aquarium. Type and click as you always do: your input becomes food, fish grow on your desktop, and gold piles up while you work. Collect 29 crayon-drawn species, roll for rare ones, chase off sharks, paint your own fish. Clicks pass through, and keystrokes are never recorded.

5303410.title: Freeway Fever
5303410.short_description: Very fast-paced arcade street racing with crashes and chaos. Risk is rewarded: trail closely behind traffic vehicles for a huge slipstream boost, but be careful not to crash! Featuring a curated 97 event championship, plus arcade mode with virtually unlimited procedurally-generated track layouts.

5303450.title: Weathard
5303450.short_description: In this cosy puzzle game, control the weather and clear your path. Switch between rainy, sunny and snowy weather to transform the environment and solve each puzzle.

5303490.title: Pantania:wedge of time
5303490.short_description: Fulfill your mission, scavenge for supplies.With the power to control time, you can be a savior who saves people—or a ruthless monster who slaughters them all.

5304120.title: Conflict 2026
5304120.short_description: Step into the shoes of Israel’s or Iran’s leader. Can you outmaneuver your rival, control the escalation, and win this historic struggle? A fast, turn-based geopolitical strategy game for 1–2 players

5304310.title: 10 Million Cubes
5304310.short_description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

5304480.title: Thunder Arrow: Arcade
5304480.short_description: Pilot the HX-21 “Thunder Arrow” prototype and relive the intensity of 1980s arcades in a modern tribute to classics like After Burner and Thunder Blade.

5304720.title: Smash & Settle
5304720.short_description: A cozy idle game about smashing and settling. Break open trees, rocks and ore, build huts and kitchens, give every villager a job and let your islands run themselves. When the purple corruption creeps in, gather your soldiers and clear its dungeon.

5304760.title: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
5304760.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

5304930.title: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
5304930.short_description: Refluff is a first-person ASMR sim about running your own rug-washing workshop. Scrape, soak, foam, scrub and squeegee filthy carpets clean on a real fluid simulation. Get paid for every percent, upgrade your tools, take on bigger, dirtier rugs.

5305030.title: Learn Abroad: Japanese
5305030.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

5305270.title: Letters from the Springs
5305270.short_description: Run a cozy hot spring inn in a mountain valley. Read guest letters, plan menus, prepare tea and baths, and grow your own ingredients. Get to know your travelers, balance the books, and help your little inn flourish, one thoughtful stay at a time.

5305500.title: StickType
5305500.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

5305620.title: HINEKURE QUEST
5305620.short_description: It's Daifugo, but run out of cards and you die. Fight enemies with Daifugo rules: the mighty 2, the 3 that beats it, 8 Cut, 7 Give, 10 Discard, J Back and Revolution. But an empty hand can't attack, 7 Give can corner you, and Luck may self-destruct. Daifugo alone won't win. Break the rules.

5305850.title: ArcMages
