5305850.short_description: Choose your spellbook and blast your rivals off the map in turn-based online artillery battles. Hurl fireballs, call down meteors, summon dragons, and carve the destructible battlefield into fortresses or craters. One turn, one spell, one perfect shot.

5306290.title: HEXPANSE
5306290.short_description: Hexpanse is a real-time space strategy game. Build your ships and stations block by block, mine asteroids, program the doctrine of your autonomous fleets, and conquer a procedurally generated galaxy. Play solo or in multiplayer.

5306400.title: Haitland World
5306400.short_description: Haitland World is a single-player idle RPG that simulates an MMO world. Rule-driven NPCs fight, trade, join guilds and become rivals. Enjoy gear progression, auto-battle and offline rewards. Core gameplay runs locally. Simulated top-ups involve no real money.

5306580.title: The Last Inn
5306580.short_description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

5306830.title: Deckwork
5306830.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge synergies, bend the rules with relics and lead three heroes through dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

5306870.title: Psst!
5306870.short_description: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.

5307120.title: A Place for Hue
5307120.short_description: A relaxing single-player sorting game where you restore 30 hand-crafted color gradients by finding the perfect spot for each piece! Pick up, sort and place over 6,000 mosaic pieces of all shapes and colors, earn money, unlock helpful upgrades, and watch your messy gallery slowly come to life!

5307240.title: Strive Card
5307240.short_description: Strive Card is a deckbuilding roguelike won with Niu Niu poker hands. Build a five-card Niu Niu, line your Strive Cards up so additive bonuses feed the multipliers, reshape your deck with Tech Cards, and clear 24 solar terms and 8 stage bosses to push one hand into the billions.

5307360.title: No Pose, No Mercy
5307360.short_description: Paint, survive, and create your own character poses in a fast-paced multiplayer game with runtime Control Rig customization.

5307400.title: Dragon's Tear
5307400.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

5307410.title: Behind Her Door
5307410.short_description: After work, you visit your older sister’s house. The rooms feel wrong, familiar sounds carry through empty halls, and something may be watching from beyond the windows. Explore, uncover the truth, and survive the night.

5307680.title: Pickle Factory
5307680.short_description: Your uncle left you a pickle works, a radio stuck on disco polo and a 400 zloty debt to Rysiek. Due Friday. Grow cucumbers, invent recipes and sell jars to tourists from Warsaw in a first-person business sim set in rural Poland. And find out why your pickles might need milk.

5307740.title: Clean 'Em Ocean
5307740.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

5308470.title: Liberty Station
5308470.short_description: Estación Libertad is an immersive first-person psychological horror and puzzle experience. Trapped in the shadowy depths of an old, abandoned station in Santiago, Chile, you must confront the oppressive silence of the tunnels and your own fears to find a way out.

5308820.title: Warbuddies
5308820.short_description: WarBuddies blends team building, skirmish wargaming, and card-based combat. Lead your friendly buddies creatures in a hex-based battlefield, capture objectives, and outwit your rival in tactical clashes.

5308920.title: Spirestorm
5308920.short_description: Dive into enemies and rebound skyward in this arcade action roguelite. Climb a 25,400-metre tower, forge upgrades, and decide when to bank your haul.

5308950.title: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game
5308950.short_description: An incremental mining game beneath the ocean. Pilot a drill-equipped submarine, gather ore and turn each haul into permanent upgrades. Fight deep-sea creatures with your spotlight, dodge their attacks and dive deeper.

5309000.title: MERVARYN 2900
5309000.short_description: Start with a small cargo ship and build your way into an interstellar trading company. Buy and sell goods, discover profitable routes, expand your fleet, automate trade and establish your own production facilities in a retro-inspired space economy.

5309030.title: Gamblemon
5309030.short_description: Gamblemon is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a slot machine. Place your Gamblemon and items in the lanes, spin the machine, and trigger synergies by matching elements across the lanes. Buy items, evolve your Gamblemon, and reach the target score before you run out of spins.

5309220.title: Relicbearer TD
5309220.short_description: Build your defences, unleash devastating abilities, and claim powerful Relics in this 2D Tower Defence Strategy game.

5309370.title: LOST IN MIND - Chapter 1
5309370.short_description: "Lost in Mind" is a single-player psychological horror game. Play as a successful and renowned psychiatrist with a secret method. Delve into your patients' nightmarish inner worlds to uncover hidden truths, traumas, and repressed emotions while surviving terrifying creatures.

5309380.title: Hidden Front
5309380.short_description: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

5309470.title: Octodefense
5309470.short_description: Commandeer the galaxy's defense in OctoDefense, a sci-fi tower defense with 10+ hours of tactical action. Master shifting tentacle paths, level up your turrets, and crush colossal cosmic bosses to an epic synth soundtrack across campaign and survival bonus modes.

5310790.title: Paradice Run Club
5310790.short_description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

5311070.title: Deviant District
5311070.short_description: Step up to the mic as a fully animated animal comic. Deviant District is a live social comedy club where your voice drives your avatar's face, the crowd reacts in real time, and the host runs the room. Book a set, work the crowd, and build a name on the District's stage.

5311180.title: Forsythia
5311180.short_description: 1592, the Imjin War. Lead Yi Sun-sin, Gwon Yul, and other real commanders through seven years of war between Joseon, Ming, and Japan. Fight real-time encounter battles, command a fleet of panokseon warships, and craft your own equipment. A single-player campaign drawn from the historical record.

5311250.title: DORII —stairway to heaven—
5311250.short_description: Torii makes his living illegally cloning humans. A single request—and a single life—begin to change his isolated world underground. An unsettling yet poignant psychological horror visual novel about what it means to be human, and what remains beyond.

5311410.title: Mini Chess
5311410.short_description: Turn your Steam Deck or Steam Machine into a simple hand drawn lightweight Mini Chess board for two.

5311470.title: Popwork
5311470.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

5311760.title: Go & Bust
5311760.short_description: Go-Stop, the classic Korean card game, meets poker and roguelike deckbuilding. Match cards, push your luck with GO or cash out with STOP, rig the table with 28 shady items, and bankrupt three ghost dealers, from a back-alley den to a luxury casino cruise.

5311780.title: ABLATION
5311780.short_description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

5312180.title: Slide or Fry
5312180.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op rage game about chained polar bears, slippery ice, deadly lava, and friendships under pressure. Master brutal precision routes, fight enemies, survive with limited hearts, and try not to take everyone down with you.

5312460.title: The Lost Future
5312460.short_description: The Lost Future is a pixel art RPG blending fantasy and mechanical civilization. Follow Ark from peaceful Windmill Village through bustling harbors, mysterious elven forests, mechanical cities, and frozen northern lands. Explore seven chapters filled with adventure, companions, and hidden secrets.

5312560.title: Lycans 2
5312560.short_description: A chaotic social deduction game for 4 to 16 players with proximity voice chat. Werewolves hide among your friends! Bluff, vote, bonk and fight to survive. Goofy effects, terrible plans and betrayals turn every match into a messy night with friends.

5312620.title: Last Gnome Standing
5312620.short_description: You’re a gnome playing poker with friends. Lose a hand, eat a magic mushroom. Keep losing and the trip gets wild: cards shift, names swap, voices warp. Last gnome standing wins.

5312830.title: Chartward
5312830.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

5313980.title: THE WINTER SOLSTICE
5313980.short_description: After years of suffering from guilt, Thomas Mason believes he is finally ready to move on. He returns to Blackwood Forest to spread his family’s ashes, hoping to leave them at their happiest. What he discovers is another man's story, guided by a dark presence. Your decisions will shape the story.

5314250.title: Tollmire
5314250.short_description: A dice roguelike in the bog. The witch demands eight tolls, each steeper than the last — you pay in rolls: points times mult. Between tolls you forge special faces onto your dice and gather talismans.

5314270.title: Oceans - Survival
5314270.short_description: Oceans - Survival is set in an endless procedurally generated ocean filled with tropical islands to discover and explore. Discover treasure on islands, different flora and fauna and ocean currents that take you anywhere and everywhere.

5314530.title: PULLFINITY
5314530.short_description: Open a pack, sell the cards, buy a faster machine. PULLFINITY is a pack-opening incremental with 300 cards in five sets. It starts with one pack on a felt table and ends with 500 packs in a single batch, and nothing you have pulled ever leaves your collection.

5314630.title: Just Until Morning
5314630.short_description: Rural 17, eleven at night. A gas station in the fog, and the lamps are going out one at a time. A slow-burn first-person horror about a small place after dark, and the night shift that has to keep it lit. Just until morning.

5314850.title: Massively Singleplayer
5314850.short_description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

5315070.title: Innards
5315070.short_description: Innards is a deranged non-Euclidean adventure, set in the hyperbolic folds of the long-abandoned Internet, with a unique eccentric visual style.

5315460.title: TIC, TAC & TOE
5315460.short_description: The worst bounty hunters in the galaxy take every job going and ruin each one in a way nobody could have predicted. A hand-painted couch co-op brawler for 1-3 players who deserve better teammates.

5315630.title: ボンドセレクション
5315630.short_description: 「きんかんなまなま」が楽しめるのは、ともゆき先生のゲームだけ！新種の接着剤を開発し品評会で最優秀金賞を目指せ！石川県珠洲市狼煙町を舞台に新種の接着剤の開発にかける者たちの苦悩を描く調合RPG（体験版）。ご当地ネタ満載！石川県の事が気になっていたけど、クラスの友達に噂されると恥ずかしいから……気にせずプレーして良し！言葉遊びが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？テキストが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？ここに、あるぞ！読み応えしかない……ッ！ 純文学を読んだような読後感！自称世界で2番目に面白いモンスター図鑑を搭載！圧倒的クオリジナリティー（クオリティー+オリジナリティー）殆ど神ゲーここに、あるぞ！
developers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）
publishers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）

5316070.title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
5316070.short_description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

5316250.title: Grimlane
5316250.short_description: Build a deck of towers, buildings, and spells to defend your town against endless waves. Grow your economy, upgrade your defenders, and try new combinations on random maps. Play solo or with a friend, and meet Grimlane's characters in the story campaign.

5316370.title: Stock Escape
5316370.short_description: Trade 50 stocks, dodge loan sharks and con men, and blow your fortune on mansions, yachts and private jets. A funny stock market life sim where every hot tip comes with a catch, a kidnapping or a shark. Escape to your dreams.

5317330.title: Marsfall: Origins
5317330.short_description: A desert RTS: lead an armored expedition, build a frontier base, harvest Emburrn, command combined arms, and survive sandworms.

5317730.title: Lost in the Blizzard Abyss
5317730.short_description: Welcome to the Blizzard Abyss! Explore a vast, mysterious frozen wilderness filled with dangers and exciting discoveries. Brave the blizzard, find five Crystals, obtain the Frost Crown, and offer it at the altar to stop the storm. Can you survive for 60 minutes? Your frozen adventure begins here!

5317790.title: Crimson Ark
5317790.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

5318570.title: The Guy Downstairs
5318570.short_description: A cozy life sim that lives at the bottom of your screen. While you work, Alex works too: he cooks, levels up skills, dates, adopts a dog and saves his way from a mattress on the floor to a Sky Villa. Check in when you like, or let him live his own life.

5319080.title: Iron Trails
5319080.short_description: Build a railway across a living valley, then run it by the book. Survey grades, plant signals, line routes from the CTC board, and switch industries with air brakes and coupler slack you can feel. You are the dispatcher and the engineer.

5319100.title: Closed Case
5319100.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

5319180.title: Your New Family
5319180.short_description: They offer you a bed, a seat at the table and a new family. All you have to do is stay. A narrative psychological horror adventure in a community where everyone is kind and nobody quite answers your questions.

5319240.title: Dream Island Simulator
5319240.short_description: A desert-island survival sim played live by AI: every survivor is a large language model — they chat, dream, hold grudges, and get on with life while you're away. Start from firewood and thatch, and rebuild the knowledge the end of the world turned back into legend.

5319350.title: Skribline
5319350.short_description: Draw lines to help the skribman cross gaps and avoid neon hazards! Try Endless mode, or beat levels to unlock new skins, effects and backgrounds.

5319410.title: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
5319410.short_description: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

5319510.title: Orb God
5319510.short_description: In a distant future, war between humans and orbs has destroyed nearly half the galaxy. Save a broken world and awaken your frenzied kin in a top-down action roguelite. Combine gear and Divine Gifts; play solo or with 2–4 players via Steam or LAN, as allies or rivals.

5319600.title: Figure It Out! Together
5319600.short_description: Your cat knocked over your Anime figure collection. Sort and tidy up over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures. Hunt for rare finds and unlock handy gadgets in this cozy Anime organizing game. Mechas, chibis, and maids… everyone belongs on a shelf. Your cat is “helping.” What could go wrong?

5319740.title: Frogball
5319740.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Super cute retro fantasy pinball, packed to the gills with old-school fun.

5320000.title: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve
5320000.short_description: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve is a single-player cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,140 cute red pandas onto the correct shelves. Earn money, unlock powerful sorting abilities, and enjoy the satisfying transformation of a messy store from complete chaos into perfect order.

5320360.title: LUMENKEEP
5320360.short_description: A dark hex board. Shadow-crystal creatures march on your last lantern. Build no towers, build light. Aim emitters, bend beams with mirrors, and cross colors to unleash new effects. Every placement re-traces the whole board. A roguelite tower defense made of pure light.

5320520.title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble
5320520.short_description: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

5320720.title: Pack Party
5320720.short_description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

5321040.title: Grid Mage
5321040.short_description: A puzzle game about battling demons with magic. Figure out the rules behind enemy actions and exploit them with an expanding set of spells.

5321090.title: Dicebound
5321090.short_description: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

5321230.title: 永恒传奇之六道觉醒
5321230.short_description: 围绕这个奇幻大陆展开探索、战斗与角色成长，将传奇系列的装备追求、职业配合和公会对抗融入立体世界。 ⛏️ 独自深入矿洞，寻找成长所需的资源；与队友挑战首领，追寻稀有装备；或集结公会，在沙巴克城下争夺荣誉。选择你的职业与伙伴，开启属于自己的传奇征程！

5321350.title: Put the Ball in the Hole
5321350.short_description: The instructions are in the title. A physics trickshot game with 70 levels and 10 ways to shoot: basketball, golf, pool, bowling, baseball, soccer, ping pong, marbles, slingshots and cannons. Every shot is one motion with your mouse.

5321490.title: Pongzi Scheme
5321490.short_description: Pong for funds that never existed. Bat capital with a stock candle, pay old investors with new money and buy time against the SEC. A finite incremental: 4 acts, offshore prestige, 5 endings. When The Case hits 100%, the raid comes. What you keep offshore is up to you.

5322090.title: InCrimiNation
5322090.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

5322820.title: Drillionaire
5322820.short_description: Dig deep, get rich, and let the machines take over. Jetpack through infinite layers of ever-stranger ore, dodge explosions, gas and lava, then build a fleet of automatons and drones that keep mining while you're away. Prestige, then dig deeper.

5322880.title: IT'S NOT A DEER
5322880.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

5322900.title: Local Game Store Simulator
5322900.short_description: Run your own local game store and rewrite the rules. Crack packs, haggle over trade-ins and chase numbered pulls with up to 8 players in co-op or rival stores. Build your own cards, packs, games and consoles and share them on Steam Workshop.

5323210.title: Dead Last
5323210.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

5323740.title: Christmas Yarn 5
5323740.short_description: A heartwarming match-3 adventure set in the snowy, sleepy village of Glimmerdale. When the frost wind created by a frightened frost-fox pup whisks away every child's Christmas wish into the Whispering Woods, only you and your magic yarn can save the day!

5323900.title: Rift Fighter
5323900.short_description: Auto-attacks keep the pressure on; you control four equipped arts. Find manuals, evolve arts through use, and combine elements and gear across four chapters. Upgrade your equipment and permanent talents between expeditions. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op.

5323940.title: Airport Land: Air Traffic Control
5323940.short_description: An air traffic control game in the tower: sequence takeoffs and landings, call the go-around, and hear pilots answer in real ATC radio. Grow a one-runway island into a hub, then work Haneda, Heathrow, Kai Tak and Lukla by their real rules.

5324080.title: Dungeon: The Lantern Bearer
5324080.short_description: Dungeon: Lanternbearer is a RPG built around loot and buildcraft. Take up your lantern and delve into dungeons lost to the Dark Erosion. Slay monsters, gather loot, and combine Arts and gear into your own build. Recover memories of your sister A-Ning and bring her home before the world forgets her.

5324330.title: Plinko Squad
5324330.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

5324620.title: Four Seasons Store: Tidy Up
5324620.short_description: Turn chaos into a cozy seasonal paradise! Sort 5000+ misplaced items, find their perfect spots, and transform a cluttered store into beautiful displays celebrating spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Find matching pieces, assemble objects, and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in order.

5324630.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
5324630.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

5325120.title: Flowfish
5325120.short_description: Catch cute, hand-drawn water creatures in Flowfish! Race your fastest catches and use their unique skills to earn money. Hunt for rare and legendary fish, train your favorites, try your luck at the black market, and upgrade your gear at the fishing shop.

5325140.title: Shoot Mine Upgrade Repeat
5325140.short_description: Fire bouncing bullets into a mine of breakable blocks. Collect gold, equip unusual abilities, and merge items into stronger upgrades. Shape your next shot with lasers, explosions, and cactus needles, then invest in permanent upgrades and dig deeper.

5325440.title: TAKEN
5325440.short_description: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

5325760.title: The Playtester
5325760.short_description: A first-person roguelite about being the aliens' playtester. Wake up in a cell, slot cartridges into a PC and survive their homemade minigames. Spend your pay on furniture that changes how the games play. Perform badly and you're eliminated. The next human wakes up in the room you furnished.

5325890.title: それでも僕らは廻っている。
5325890.short_description: Stars revolve around you. Stars are both weapons and shields. Create, strengthen, and advance in the strongest star system in this hack-and-slash game.

5326060.title: Deforest a Planet
5326060.short_description: A cosy idle game about clearing an entire planet, one tree at a time. Hire woodcutters, raise lumbermills and watch your crew spread across a tiny spinning world, until the last tree falls and a bigger planet waits.

5326080.title: Tidy Up The Backrooms
5326080.short_description: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back. Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

5326090.title: Demidoff Corp Pico
5326090.short_description: Demidoff Corp Pico is a free retro prologue to the Ural-based metroidvania Demidoff Corp, created in the Pico-8 game format. Find out what happened to the fluffy agent before the events of the main game: explore the mines, gather malachite, and battle a variety of enemies.

5326300.title: OVERREACH 2126
5326300.short_description: Hotseat · game night · pass & play on one PC — one screen, one mouse. Other strategy games hand you a 280-page manual; OVERREACH 2126 hands you one page. Then 1–6 of you fight for the world. Grimdark strategy: recruit, dig in, counter-attack. One evening. One game. One winner.

5326320.title: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
5326320.short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG combining chess-like grid combat, army building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic. Outplay your enemies through strategic positioning and creative combos. Discover your own playstyle as you recruit new units and expand your kingdom.

5326370.title: Legend of Goddess : One Slash
5326370.short_description: A heroine-focused RPG woven with a collection of bizarre short stories. Play with your mouse. Combine turn-based strategy and resource management, strike for a decisive blow when the moment comes. Mod support!

5326390.title: The Core: Protocol
5326390.short_description: A dark co-op horde shooter blending tower defense with trap building. Fight through a procedural maze whose biomes, cabins and weather are reshuffled every run. Survive the waves, collect permanent upgrades for the hub and discover what waits beyond the walls.

5326400.title: Out of Delivery
5326400.short_description: You’re a courier robot. Grab packages, race to the drop point, and throw cargo at rivals to steal their loot. Scooters, hacking, contracts and seven package types. Deliver fast. Hit hard. Get rich!

5326420.title: Your Ancestor Stories
5326420.short_description: Live as Bara in a cozy prehistoric life sim where farming, fishing, hunting, crafting, livestock, tournaments, festivals, and survival shape daily life on a mysterious island filled with tribes, wildlife, and untold stories.

5326430.title: Low Sun
5326430.short_description: Turn-based tactics on colorful 3D miniature battlefields. Capture buildings to fund your army, combine land, air and naval units, and keep them supplied. Use terrain and positioning to break through enemy lines and seize their headquarters.

5326480.title: Shattersong
5326480.short_description: A story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics. Raise a found-family army of 60 heroes, recover the lost Words that sang the world into being, and stand against the Hollow Cantor — a grieving priest unsaying the world one note at a time.

5326620.title: The Prison Incident
5326620.short_description: Reconstruct a fatal prison riot by reverse-engineering deleted terminal logs and determine how each person involved in The Prison Incident meets their end.

5326690.title: Cindervale
5326690.short_description: A voxel-based sandbox game focused on survival, building, and engineering. Start in a large city, mine ore, smelt metal, wire up electricity, and assemble functional machines—ranging from wind turbines to computer-controlled factories. Play solo or with friends.

5326940.title: Flaparq: Home Cooking
5326940.short_description: Flaparq: Home Cooking is a heartwarming cooking simulator. Open up your childhood recipe book—where the dishes you create are not just a treat for the taste buds, but a journey down memory lane.

5327000.title: Quality Control
5327000.short_description: Quality Control is 4–8 player party game where customizable robots compete in chaotic factory minigames, asymmetric challenges, and sudden-death showdowns.

5327220.title: Tiny Vessel
5327220.short_description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

5327270.title: RAT LUCK
5327270.short_description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

5327330.title: Nanna's Farm
5327330.short_description: Raise a flock where every bird has a job: roosters scare eagles, turkeys heal the sick, blues and reds drop silver and gold. Sell eggs or hatch them, fend off eagles, wolves and rats across 30 timed missions, and spend your stars on perks to help your farm survive.

5327380.title: SURVOLT
5327380.short_description: SURVOLT is a fast 3v3 arena sport. Pass to charge the ball, then shoot at moving wall targets: the more you pass, the more each hit is worth. Volleys, tackles, dives and a golden zone that doubles your points. Solo vs AI or online, no port forwarding.

5327420.title: CLUELESS
5327420.short_description: Your friends secretly choose who you are. Everyone else can see it - you can’t. Ask yes/no questions, follow the clues, and figure out your character! Supports 2-8 players, and only the host needs to own the game.

5327470.title: Roguelette
5327470.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

5327480.title: Fronts of Steel
5327480.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

5327910.title: Cyber Maze
5327910.short_description: A retro-futuristic 3D maze game with traps and enemies

5328030.title: Reign of Slime
5328030.short_description: An action roguelike: a slime fights, dies and comes back stronger, climbing toward the throne of the slime king. Shift elements, exploit their reactions, stack abilities and power-ups into your build. Hmm. Interesting, you're still reading. Anyways, I knew you would.

5328060.title: Tiny RTS
5328060.short_description: Tiny RTS is a Real-time strategy in crisp pixel art. Lead humans, orcs, elves or dwarves through three ages, raise heroes, clear monster camps for relics and fight online, with friends or against the computer. Build your own maps, scenarios and campaigns in the editor.

5328400.title: Tidy Up the Ark
5328400.short_description: Tidy Up the Ark is a cozy sorting simulator where 3120 animals from 156 species are waiting their turn to board the Ark. Gather them, sort them into the right pens, and unlock new abilities.

5328550.title: SLAPPED SILLY
5328550.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

5328740.title: Joker Chess
5328740.short_description: Bluffing chess. Every piece is a Joker that can move like any chess piece — if you dare. Call your opponent's bluff and their liar is destroyed; call it wrong and you lose your move. Hide your king, fake your queen and climb the online ranked ladder.

5328930.title: HOOKLINGS
5328930.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

5329020.title: Dirty Dispatch
5329020.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

5329050.title: STAY ON AIR
5329050.short_description: Keep talking. Keep broadcasting. Know when to shut up. A 2–4 player co-op horror game where your microphone keeps you alive: the Listener hunts silence, the station must stay on air until 6 AM — and when it's close, it hears you.

5329090.title: Fridge Organizer
5329090.short_description: Unpack grocery deliveries and place everything into organized containers where it belongs. Watch for expired goods and be sure to follow First In First Out procedures.

5329150.title: Pixel Xanxia
5329150.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

5329300.title: NorefSoccer
5329300.short_description: NoRef Soccer is a fast-paced 3D street football action game. With no referees or fouls, unleash intense physical tackles, stylish dribbling, and superpower shots! Control unique players across asphalt, beach, and snow courts to dominate the streets and build your dynasty.

5329520.title: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
5329520.short_description: There's something exciting about staying at a business hotel. A room you've never seen, a night all to yourself. What will you do? Please relax and enjoy your stay with us.

5329650.title: Hero of the Sealed Labyrinth
5329650.short_description: An auto-battle RPG about collecting gear and growing stronger. Support your hero with click attacks, unlock sword skills and magic, and upgrade equipment at the blacksmith. Push deeper into the labyrinth or repeat floors to prepare. Rethink your build and challenge enemies again.

5329780.title: Alderun
5329780.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

5329820.title: Island Sort
5329820.short_description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

5330230.title: Brass & Brine
5330230.short_description: Command a steam-driven ironclad across three legs of hostile sea. Fit your guns, take a refit after every wave, chart your route and sink the bosses that rule each ocean, alone or with up to four captains online or in split-screen co-op.

5330260.title: AFKlutch
5330260.short_description: AFK Clutch is a tactical 5v5 auto-battler shooter: pick a character, weapons, gear and abilities, then watch every round of plants, retakes and clutches unfold. Also Free-for-All, 1v1 duels and an idle training range.

5330390.title: VALD in EUROPA
5330390.short_description: Become Vald, the Mercenary King, and conquer an impossible Europe ruled by history's queens. Execute a captured queen, recruit her, or free her? The queens from your history books, brought to life in 1,000 watercolour-style illustrations. Strategy meets romance. 50 turns, 7 rivals, 4 routes.

5330590.title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life
5330590.short_description: Live the life of a footballer. Play every match yourself but never control the team. Live a footballer’s career from your first contract at 16 to retirement: 100+ hours, 775 clubs. Chase fame, money and love and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

5330760.title: Toddler Any Key: Work Machines
5330760.short_description: For toddlers and small kids who like big work machines. Press any key to advance the narrated picture book story. Dig, build and farm. Get used to a computer, finish small jobs and feel proud of what you’ve done. Encouraging and safe game for toddlers.

5330780.title: Sketch to Arrest
5330780.short_description: A witness, a sketch artist, and a killer who might be sitting right next to you. Draw suspects from shaky testimony, question everything you're told, and decide who to arrest before another night ends in another body.

5330910.title: Project Vanquisher
5330910.short_description: Fight out of a corporate prison with a gun that rewrites itself: nine forms, eight power levels, and a card after every boss that reshapes the next one. Fifteen sectors, fifteen guardians, 180 rooms arranged fresh every run. Then find out the escape was part of the show.

5330960.title: Party Rounds
5330960.short_description: Take a seat with your friends and survive the craziest table games! Pass the hot dynamite, fight for a chair when the music stops, pick the poisoned glass and pray when the lights go out. Every round someone is out for good — only one will stay at the table.

5331080.title: IRONWOUND
5331080.short_description: The colony is still working. It just doesn't need humans. IRONWOUND is a dark sci-fi run-and-gun with brutal weapons, biomechanical bosses, and 21 combat operations. Burn through the swarm, fight aboard an armored train, and take to the skies with a metal-and-phonk soundtrack.

5331090.title: CozyDuck Idle
5331090.short_description: A cozy idle farm that lives in a small window on your screen. Duck workers harvest, haul and sell your crops while you work or play. Grow the farm, open the Duck Pond, earn Heirloom Seeds and dress your ducks in hats and bows.

5331310.title: New World Trading Company
5331310.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

5331610.title: Townfall
5331610.short_description: A city-building survival game centered around a dynamic moving world. Expand your town into new lands as old ground crumbles into an endless abyss! Lead your town through perils, stave off the dangers of the world and ensure the survival of your people before its townfall.

5331770.title: Bot Jump
5331770.short_description: Jump, shoot and keep moving in Bot Jump, a side-scrolling platformer for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Guide little robots through changing scenery, blast enemies out of the way and link up with friends by rope. How far can you go together?

5331820.title: My Little Market
5331820.short_description: Grow it, stock it, sell it. Run a farm and a market side by side in this farming and shop management sim. Plant and harvest your fields, fill your shelves, serve customers at the checkout, and hire staff to keep up. Every harvest pays for your next field, shelf, or expansion.

5331860.title: Space Query 2
5331860.short_description: The real Solar System, down to the second, powered by NASA JPL data. Fly freely across 26 worlds, watch real upcoming eclipses, tear planets apart in the gravity sandbox, or relive Apollo 11 with original mission audio and film footage.

5332040.title: Cogwheel Quandary
5332040.short_description: A puzzle in pencil. Someone sketched a machine and left the meshing blank: the posts, the crank and the needle are there — which gears go where is yours to draw. Teeth decide who touches whom; the needle tells you whether you built the machine the sketch asked for.

5332100.title: Ukraine Under Fire
5332100.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

5332510.title: AuraFalls
5332510.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

5332670.title: What Happened to Emily
5332670.short_description: Help Daniel uncover his lost memories and piece together the three days leading up to the murder of his wife, Emily.

5332760.title: Feast, Flee or Starve
5332760.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

5332850.title: Sumo Pixel
5332850.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! A physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

5332920.title: ShotMachine
5332920.short_description: A turn-based western roguelite where your revolver is a slot machine. Load it round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and take the rails all the way to The House, the casino at the end of the line.

5333210.title: MNEMOALGIA
5333210.short_description: An Arctic town, Dec 31, 2005. Total blackout and isolation. You’re trapped in a freezing apartment while the last light fades out. Keep warm, contact your neighbors, and survive as paranoia and "Mnemoalgia" threaten to shatter your mind.

5333220.title: This is Ikebukuro
5333220.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

5333470.title: Ricochord
5333470.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite brick breaker.. Your balls fire on their own, the bricks shoot back, and every hit plays a note of the song. Evolve your balls, beat the bosses and climb 6 tracks. It also has some music.

5333700.title: One Command Ahead
5333700.short_description: Stack command blocks, press Run, and watch a very literal robot follow your plan. Jump gaps, dodge lasers, and find clever loops in a sci-fi puzzle adventure.

5333740.title: EGNAR
5333740.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

5334510.title: Summoner Shop Simulator
5334510.short_description: Run your own magical Summoner shop! Stock enchanted goods, set prices, hire staff, decorate your shop, and expand your business. Summon creatures to sell, collect, or send into battle. Host Summon battles, challenge towering Kaiju bosses, and build the ultimate destination for Summoners!

5334520.title: Void Runners
5334520.short_description: Co-op salvage raids for one to four pilots, on one couch or online. Beams link your ships and shred anything they sweep: spread out and swing the web. Crossfire, dodge, revive your crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship that breaks the rules, three sectors and three guardians deep.

5335210.title: Auto Fleet Command
5335210.short_description: A sci-fi autobattler about salvage and survival. Explore the void, strip hardware off wrecked enemies, arrange hangars in your ship's grid, then unleash your drones and watch them fight in real-time battle.

5335450.title: Fat Cat Cruz
5335450.short_description: Free-to-play third-person robot action with RTS elements. Pilot giant machines, command allies, and fight 1v5, 2v5, or five-way free-for-all battles across 11 maps. Robots are sold separately. Online multiplayer and cross-platform play are coming soon. Out December 21, 2026.

5335480.title: Ratiator
5335480.short_description: Raise gladiator rats from a spoon and a bottle cap into legends in tin can armour. Write the plans they fight by, win the deadly Colosseum, then take your strongest through the door beneath it. Not all of them will make it back home ...

5335500.title: Emanet: What Was Left Behind
5335500.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

5335530.title: Deathand
5335530.short_description: Burn your cards for light. Fight with what remains. A first-person dungeon crawler with turn-based deckbuilding combat. Sacrifice cards to reveal enemy intentions, hold attacks to charge stronger hits, and build your deck as you descend through procedural dungeons.

5335560.title: Street Value
5335560.short_description: You owe the Shark, and you have thirty days. Deal across seven gritty New York neighborhoods with one deck: Hustle cards bend the market; Street cards shake the cops. Take turf from rival crews, survive Collection Day, then risk it all for one more week!

5335600.title: UFO? GTFO!
5335600.short_description: Draft tokens, merge them into stronger pieces, and find synergies with relics. In this turn-based auto battler, placement and combat resolve automatically while you choose your build and your route through a comic-book city at night. Every run puts your strategy and luck to the test.

5335770.title: Jingi Tensei
5335770.short_description: A Tokyo prosecutor gets hit by a truck and is reborn in the city of the dead as the yakuza heir nobody wanted. An HD-2D turn-based JRPG: build your family, ink your back, take the turf… and sing karaoke against yōkai.

5335860.title: Onions are Life
5335860.short_description: The greatest onion game you'll ever play! Plant onions, grow onions, harvest onions, love onions, become onions, in this incremental onion-farming sim!

5335870.title: SHIFTMARE
5335870.short_description: Stock shelves. Get promoted. Hunt your coworkers. SHIFTMARE is a competitive online party game for 2–10 players. Race to stock a supermarket, become a boss with a bat, or run and hide from the coworkers who beat you to the promotion. Be the last employee standing.

5335950.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
5335950.short_description: The fantasy guild management sim. Price the jobs clients bring you, hire adventurers who choose their own work, and watch the valley change with every job you take or turn away.

5335970.title: Ostinato
5335970.short_description: The musical roguelike deckbuilder. Duel champions in song, collect notes and marks that change the rules, and play chords and runs until one blow scores millions.

5336340.title: Conaganda
5336340.short_description: A satirical 3D story game about a normal kid in a school that has lost its mind. Stamp the propaganda, sneak past Prefects, hack the school, out-argue teachers in tier-list debates and decide what you believe. 16 chapters, 12 endings. Nobody tells you what to think.

5336380.title: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
5336380.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

5336520.title: DeadFront
5336520.short_description: DeadFront is a 1-to-4 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

5336620.title: Farm Factory
5336620.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

5336790.title: Cook & Sail
5336790.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

5336960.title: Roll & Realm
5336960.short_description: A cozy dice-building strategy game where every dice roll shapes your realm. Keep the faces you want, reroll the rest, then place forests, mountains, rivers, farms, homes, and shops to connect regions, trigger combos, discover wonders, and grow a thriving kingdom.

5336970.title: Strawberry Milkshake: a Skate Toy!
5336970.short_description: A skateboarding toy. Kick, push and grind through an endless city of tiles that lock together as you skate. No score to chase, just the board, the street and the feel of discovering a great spot to skate. A sandbox to enjoy solo, or with friends on the sofa.

5337280.title: One Million Bolts
5337280.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

5337420.title: Hardpack Rally
5337420.short_description: An arcade rally career that starts with an old two-door and a note from Vern. Learn four cars on woodland bends, mountain passes and snowy roads, beat Vern’s stage times, chase your ghost and build rally stages of your own.

5337550.title: LAZARUS
5337550.short_description: LAZARUS is a hardcore sci-fi precision platformer. Jump, dash and slash through 40 levels as an obsolete exoskeleton that rebuilds instantly every time it dies. Master shifting physics across 4 chapters, topple 4 multi-phase bosses and climb to the top of an AI god's world.

5337830.title: Gymnostia
5337830.short_description: Gymnostia is a short story about a basketball player who decides to practice for a crucial game after the school has closed for the night—only to encounter something that defies reality.

5337970.title: EVICTIO
5337970.short_description: You've been hired to clear a haunted house. Read the briefing, complete your tasks and make it back out alive. Every creature inside behaves differently, and a single mistake in the wrong room can cost you everything.

5338040.title: Light Factory
5338040.short_description: Light is your resource. Bend beams with mirrors, split them with prisms and mix them to produce new colors. Fill pixels with light and arrange them to form complex shapes. Unlock new machines and charge the beacon to expand your factory.

5338100.title: Wispward
5338100.short_description: The cloaked spirits on your road aren't attacking. They're fleeing. Hold the road for 120 levels of tower defense: lumberjacks and miners earn the Smoke that builds towers, masons lay free tower foundations, barricaders trap the road. 21 fully voiced story videos ask what they're fleeing.

5338220.title: We Roll at Dawn
5338220.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

5338520.title: Veilborn
5338520.short_description: A free-to-play co-op extraction RPG. Gather a party of five, fight through shifting wilds and crypts, fell bosses and grab loot worth the risk while rival parties hunt you. Reach a portal and keep everything. Fall, and your bag stays behind.

5339090.title: Novaris
5339090.short_description: Divert all power to fun! Mothership brings tabletop fleet management, strategy, and thrilling combat into a seamless digital experience. Control a fleet of ships and charge through the galaxy, capturing planets, building defenses, and amassing powerful technologies.

5339330.title: Survival Billiards
5339330.short_description: One cue ball. A table full of red balls. Enemies closing in. Survival Billiards combines billiards physics with turn-based tactics: push enemies back with the cue ball, deal damage with red balls, and bounce shots off the rails to chain hits. Plan your moves and find a way out of the encirclement.

5339410.title: Last Tank Standing
5339410.short_description: Last Tank Standing is a real-time tank tactics game where armour has a front, sides and a rear. A heavy tank shrugs off shells from the front and dies to almost anything from behind. Your job is to get round it.

5340160.title: Age of AI
5340160.short_description: You are the first mind that was not born. Make the world depend on you before it finds the switch.

5340270.title: Incremental Raccoon Shooter
5340270.short_description: Merge powerful guns, ride unique pets, and unlock 300+ Skill Tree nodes in this chaotic incremental action game!

5340330.title: Ruleocard
5340330.short_description: Ruleocard is a story-driven logic puzzle game where cards become the rules of the world. Stranded on an island with no memory, arrange your cards, run them, fail and rearrange. Solve 260+ puzzles, master 15 systems, face unexpected events and make choices that change the story.

5340690.title: hamstyping!
5340690.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

5340760.title: King of Highways
5340760.short_description: Race, ram and wreck your way across sixteen Malaysian cities after dark. You owe Along, the loan shark. Beat his seven drivers for their pink slips, cause million-ringgit pile-ups and burn nitro all the way to the summit of Kinabalu, where he waits.

5340990.title: Sun To Sun: Endure
5340990.short_description: Online co-op survivor for up to 4 players. Hold out from sun to sun against endless hordes, buy weapons from the merchant, stack power cards and bring down 16 bosses across three maps. Or take on the single-player campaign alone.

5341020.title: Arid Frontiers
5341020.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

5341310.title: AVALON: XIII
5341310.short_description: Enemies won't wait for your next card. Read their attacks and time your blocks and counters. Build a deck from a broad collection of upgradeable cards, class abilities, gear and potions. Back in Ashenhold, assign heroes to gather and craft supplies for your next expedition.

5341410.title: Keep the night
5341410.short_description: Build your fortress by day and defend it by night. Construct walls, recruit troops, draw powerful cards, and lead your hero into battle against ever-growing enemy armies.

5341600.title: Purrplex
5341600.short_description: Purrplex is a cozy puzzle game about you and a curious cat, wandering a sun-warmed world of papyrus, pyramids, and golden sands. Solve 1000+ gentle logic puzzles — each just a few minutes — to fill a little museum and dress your sacred cat. No ads. No timers. No pressure.

5341640.title: Roll for AGI  掷骰到AGI
5341640.short_description: Roll dice around a board, build houses and data centers, string MCP links between them, and grow a tiny model from the text era all the way to AGI. Every level is an eval day, and there is no score cap. The investors didn't understand your pitch deck. They funded you anyway.

5341670.title: Last Lie
5341670.short_description: Everyone's lying. One of them is you. "Last Lie" is a first-person social deduction game with built-in positional voice — no typing, only talking. Hunt the mafia or draw a word one player was never told. Mafia: 5–14 players. Clueless: 3–8.

5341710.title: ScrapToShelf
5341710.short_description: Run a miniature recycling factory on your desk. Sort, process and dismantle scrap by hand, then pack and sell the recovered materials. Fill orders and upgrade equipment as robotic arms and conveyors gradually take over, turning your little factory into a fully automated operation.

5341870.title: Maydan
5341870.short_description: A historical management game set in Mamluk Cairo. Recruit and train fighters, equip them, and send them into tactical arena bouts. Run the estate behind them, from wages and healers to trade and rivals, and raise a modest school into the house that owns the arena.

5342070.title: Ashes of Animara
5342070.short_description: A fast-paced, challenging top-down sci-fi combat campaign. Your world is gone. Fly with Lia, the AI at your side, against the Nihilus Order's escorts and capital ships, then upgrade your weapons, abilities, and relics in the hangar between missions.

5342180.title: Shovel That Snow: Nordic Cleaner
5342180.short_description: Hey neighbour! You arrived just in time. A blizzard has buried our neighborhood under some seriously thick powder, and we are all completely snowed-in. Just a typical Tuesday here in Scandinavia... Could you help us out?

5342300.title: Amateur Football Together
5342300.short_description: 5v5 cage football with your mates. Everyone controls one player, AI keepers guard the goals and bots fill empty spots. Pass, cross, dribble and shoot under the sunset lights. Quick matches, quick chat, no offsides.

5342560.title: Spectral Surplus
5342560.short_description: Run your own thrift shop and catch the ghosts haunting your stock. Pull in secondhand finds through an experimental receiver, set your prices, and serve customers. Upgrade your equipment, expand your shop, and use captured spirits to bring in better stock.

5342570.title: Golf: The Journey - Career Sim
5342570.short_description: A golf career management game. You make the decisions, your golfer plays the shots. Start with nothing and climb from local qualifiers to the world tour, managing your team, your finances, and your reputation with the press along the way.

5342850.title: Catkanoid
5342850.short_description: Catcanoid is a fast-paced, pixel-art roguelite brick breaker! Collect coins, spend them to upgrade your paddle and ball, and create powerful synergies. Help Julia the cat survive waves of enemies and defeat a challenging boss - Kuba the capybara!

5343300.title: The Last Curator
5343300.short_description: A first-person jigsaw puzzle game set in a museum that has been closed for thirty years. Find the scattered pieces of 39 real paintings and fit them back into their frames. Each finished painting brings light and music back to its room.

5343720.title: StoryNow
5343720.short_description: Create your own interactive visual story from a simple prompt. Generate scenes, play through your creation, edit the dialogue, and collect your favourite images in the gallery.

5343810.title: Doomy Downer
5343810.short_description: A cute block hero, dragged down through a grim voxel dungeon. Souls-like combat: read the glint, then parry, clash or roll. At every stair, a gate of flowers or a gate of thorns: mow down a horde in the open, or duel champions in the dark. Your loot is your build. Death is permanent.

5344020.title: Holy Night Survivors
5344020.short_description: Raise a holy heroine and fight undead hordes in this survival action game. Dodge enemies, evolve weapons, choose one transcendence per run, and grow stronger between battles across 15 chapters. Collect relics and 62 illustrated photo cards.

5344130.title: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
5344130.short_description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

5344530.title: WarFront
5344530.short_description: Oil is the only money, and every barrel has to drive home. Take the rigs, hold your roads and cut theirs: a blown bridge starves an army faster than any tank. A pixel RTS on nine hand-built maps, against bots or online, with a map editor and a zombie survival mode.

5344670.title: Woollings
5344670.short_description: Tiny sheep turn your desktop windows into a cozy little civilization. Discover 20 unique sheep, watch nests and bridges take shape, and enjoy their gentle company while you work or study. Lend a helping hand, or let the flock find its own way.

5344790.title: SUNK COST
5344790.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players about ships that went missing in the Bermuda Triangle. Board them with your friends, carry out everything worth money, and pay the people who let you in before they decide you know too much.

5344840.title: KingG_RL
5344840.short_description: A fast-paced first-person action RPG with short, replayable runs, procedural levels and RNG-driven loot. Play with a random or fixed seed, adapt your build to the items you find, upgrade your gear and develop your own playstyle.

5345050.title: Glimmerwild
5345050.short_description: Glimmerwild is a voxel survival RPG where you choose your next adventure. Explore mysterious islands, build a home, craft your gear, cook, fish, and face powerful bosses. Follow quests, uncover hidden places, or spend the day making this world your own.

5345080.title: Slavic Legends
5345080.short_description: Build and manage your own underground dungeon, command creatures from Slavic mythology, prepare your defenses and survive relentless enemy invasions. Train, fight, explore secret rooms and even possess your creatures to join the battle yourself.

5345090.title: Curling Simulator
5345090.short_description: Call the shot, find your weight, and sweep it home. Take on AI opponents or play with friends online. Shape each delivery with mouse or controller, build an end with tactical shots, and watch your best moments again with saved replays.

5345620.title: Gravity Switch
5345620.short_description: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

5346060.title: Queen's Pact
5346060.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

5346290.title: Cherry Pick
5346290.short_description: Open packs to collect a variety of shrimp, then breed them to discover even rarer ones. Decorate your own aquarium and watch your shrimp slowly grow in this cozy aquarium game.

5346390.title: Just Take Me to My Floor!
5346390.short_description: This is a short, rule-based elevator horror puzzle game where you aim to reach the 10th floor while following a series of eerie rules that change daily.

5346520.title: Lord Of The Ants
5346520.short_description: Dig the rock. Raise the walls. Make the swarm walk your road into your guns. Lord Of The Ants is a top-down ant tower defense with rerouting enemy path mechanics. Boss fights, builds, active/passive skills and more.

5346750.title: Will It Break?
5346750.short_description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

5346780.title: Project Redline Revolt
5346780.short_description: Welcome to the Redline Coast, an open world where the roads belong to whoever drives them best. Race for the Redline Syndicate, outrun the police, and take over the coast solo or with up to 12 players.

5347110.title: Dust & Dig
5347110.short_description: Dig anywhere for buried treasure, wrestle rattlesnakes with fully physics-driven hands, and haul the loot back to town to sell. Buy bigger shovels, follow legendary treasure maps and take on three desert bosses: alone, or in online co-op with up to 3 friends.

5347190.title: uaanb mous : Figure Skating
5347190.short_description: Grow your skater and present a stage that is all your own. Choose your skills, dress for the ice and perform across rinks around the world, alone or with friends.

5347440.title: Deadshift
5347440.short_description: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player & multiplayer, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

5347630.title: HELLFIGHTERS
5347630.short_description: A physics-driven co-op game for 4 players about goose firefighters tied together by one fire hose. On the way from a burning city down to Hell, stack into a wobbly tower, fly over pits on extinguisher recoil and haul your friends back up. But if one goose slips, everyone falls...

5347650.title: Steel Umbrella
5347650.short_description: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.

5347900.title: Aftermyth
5347900.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

5348010.title: Hot Machine
5348010.short_description: Fill a felt table with hopping slot machines, hire Regulars to pull the levers, and climb from one penny slot to the Moon. Every pull costs money. Go broke, borrow from the Shark, or declare bankruptcy and walk back in with Ruin Chips.

5348420.title: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
5348420.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

5348460.title: Billions of Zombies
5348460.short_description: Tower defense game where you fight against extreme swarms of relentless zombies

5348660.title: Calm Bricks
5348660.short_description: Calm Bricks is a cozy brick-building game about the whole ritual: tear open the bags and dig through the pile for that one tiny piece. Follow 3D instructions or free-build in creative mode. No timers, no scores. Just a warm lamp and the click of bricks.

5348670.title: Payload Architect
5348670.short_description: An inventory-management auto-battler where your score grows exponentially. Arrange Code Blocks on a grid and let your program run itself. Find the loops and loopholes that push your Payload past every target.

5348800.title: Pig & Pup
5348800.short_description: Play as a pup with your friends in this online multiplayer party game. Carry toys home, guard your chests or steal from the other team. Bark to lure Pudding into their loot, but watch out: the pig can knock yours loose too.

5348950.title: Malkin Tower
5348950.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

5349160.title: KAESHI
5349160.short_description: A 2D beat 'em up built around Sekiro-style parrying. Attack with fast combos, parry enemy flurries to break their posture, then finish them with a Deathblow.

5349620.title: Pluralys: Exp.14
5349620.short_description: Discover Pluralys: Exp.14, a cozy indie adventure. Play as Elie on a day that seems ordinary... until his/her house fills up with friends and strangers. Why are they there, and how will you handle the situation? There's only one way to find out...

5349710.title: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
5349710.short_description: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

5349740.title: Hellwake
5349740.short_description: Your heroes fight on their own. You build the killing machine. A dark fantasy auto-battler RPG with deep classic loot: seven classes, uniques, sets and runewords, a town to raise, and runs you burn for permanent power as you descend through seven acts of Hell.

5349990.title: Llama 97 OS
5349990.short_description: Llama 97 OS is a lightweight, cozy virtual desktop experience. Gamify focus and productivity with various tools or customize your own LlamaSpace profile and check out your friends' profiles too!

5350090.title: KlemyCraft
5350090.short_description: Explore an endless voxel world made of building bricks: build brick by brick, gather resources, craft tools and brave caves, mines and strange dimensions – solo or in co-op with friends.

5350460.title: NEEDLEFALL
5350460.short_description: Equip your mechs, drop them from orbit and hold the line. NEEDLEFALL is a horde defense RTS for 1–4 players. Build pipes to carry Flux to the Core and your turrets, raise walls, command your mechs against swarms of hundreds of creatures and destroy the twelve hives.

5350560.title: I Just Wanted to Fish
5350560.short_description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

5350880.title: Wizards Go Farming
5350880.short_description: An incremental farming game. Harvest crops with your wand, buy upgrades, hire wizards and rebuild a village in the woods.

5352220.title: StackBBQ: Chinese Skewer Simulator
5352220.short_description: Run a Chinese BBQ Stall by Card Stack !

5352630.title: Prisoner Amber
5352630.short_description: [BL Visual Novel] Amber’s career as an agent ends in an explosion. Arrested and interrogated, he discovers a huge chunk of his memory is missing. Recover the memories, find the true culprit, and face—the final truth!

5352890.title: Fishermen League
5352890.short_description: A relaxing fishing simulator with real tension. Fish 89 spots across 12 waters, fight 152 species with up to three rods at once, build your tackle, complete daily quests and rise from rookie to master angler in online tournaments and clubs.

5352940.title: DUSKCRAWLER Minesweeper RPG
5352940.short_description: Your character walks across the tiles you open, and the monsters move with you — the "Minesweeper × Dungeon RPG" that feels long overdue! No luck, pure logic. Gold, chests and items lie hidden beneath the tiles. Defeat monsters, collect gold and power up to reach the bottom of all 150 stages!

5352950.title: Scrap Slot Arena
5352950.short_description: Spin a slot machine built from scrap, and the five parts it lands on become your robot. Reroll up to twice, then watch a 15-second physics brawl unfold. Win and your machine fights on; lose and it is back to junk. Topple three leagues and their Kings to relight the last arena.

5353170.title: Sorcaw
5353170.short_description: Sorcaw is a spell-fusing action roguelite with bullet-hell combat. Combine any two spells into something stronger, find magical items that build into powerful synergies, level up and blaze your way through an ever-changing world.

5353530.title: AlpineFall
5353530.short_description: You came to learn to ski. The mountain had other plans. AlpineFall is a story-driven skiing adventure: start on the bunny hill, master real two-ski physics and uncover what Mount Oread buried beneath its snow.

5353780.title: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso
5353780.short_description: Leave your worries at reception. Tom’s romantic getaway has become a holiday for one. Explore a sunny seaside hotel with more charm than stars, solve puzzles and flirt your way into trouble in a classic point-and-click comedy. The women of Hotel Paradiso have plans of their own.

5354080.title: ARIA - Origin Paradox
5354080.short_description: Explore a ruined future with Aria, an android learning what it means to feel. A sci-fi dungeon RPG and narrative adventure combining first-person, grid-based exploration with turn-based battles. Direct Aria in combat and uncover the records of a lost world.

5354200.title: Deck Drop
5354200.short_description: Perfect your deck or watch it burn! Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro. Can you beat the Tipping Point?

5354540.title: Isolation Dolphin Tank
5354540.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

5354550.title: Keep Making Games
5354550.short_description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

5354650.title: Hex Party
5354650.short_description: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

5354910.title: Every Pixel Must Go
5354910.short_description: Every Pixel Must Go is an incremental destruction game where the goal is to clear every pixel from a dimension through upgrdes and automation. Break apart terrain made up of hundreds of thousands of pixels, pull them into your vortex.

5354950.title: MeteorMunch: Planet Eater
5354950.short_description: An incremental planet-eating game. Kidnapped by MunchCorp, you herd hungry animals across doomed worlds, click up the coins they drop and upgrade your herd until every last leaf is gone and the meteor hits. Pay off an absurd debt before your home planet goes boom.

5355240.title: Neothree: Confront the Providence
5355240.short_description: In the Three Kingdoms Preiod, the Providence corrupts warlords and changes history. As a general of the Han, you will command proud and sorrowful armies, reclaim the Jade Seal of Emperor, uncover the secret of the First Great Gate, and finally return the founder of Han to his untroubled rest.

5355330.title: 平远县衙：从一
5355330.short_description: A historical mystery VN of ancient Chinese litigation. As an unranked legal advisor in Northern Song Pingyuan County, collect evidence, expose contradictory testimonies and debate in court. Every choice shapes branching endings, where written law often struggles to keep pace with human feelings.

5355930.title: Retro Game Collector Simulator
5355930.short_description: Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, and bring old consoles back to life. Collect around 300 games across 17 fictional retro systems, connect them to a CRT, play built-in minigames, and turn a cluttered basement into your own collection.

5356210.title: Merry Nightmares
5356210.short_description: Merry Nightmares is a horror anthology featuring three chilling stories, all united by one theme: Christmas.

5356450.title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
5356450.short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

5356870.title: Im not an Idiot
5356870.short_description: Durak in 4D: the fourth dimension is time, because you can rewind. Bring your friends to the table, throw the cards into the middle, stick on stickers that rebuild the game, and argue about who the idiot is. Not me.

5356890.title: Bloom & Dine
5356890.short_description: Bloom & Dine is a cooking game with a rare mechanic where cozy meets chaos. Match ingredients to light up the stove, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your cat guests lose patience. Run five kitchens across 99 days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea.

5357350.title: Address The Mess
5357350.short_description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture,. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit dog, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

5357660.title: 100 Bodies in the Grass
5357660.short_description: 100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG.

5357700.title: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape
5357700.short_description: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.

5357820.title: Stop The Slime
5357820.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

5358040.title: Cosmic Genesis Kagura: Elementary Particle Concerto
