5358040.short_description: Perform with gods or another player in a three-button rhythm game. Play solo alongside four gods or create a room for an online duet. Hit in harmony to collect particles and build atoms, stars, planets and life. Enjoy music and discover cosmic creation across generations.

5358290.title: Cataract Quest
5358290.short_description: Cataract Quest is a first-person co-op adventure where your vision is failing. Play solo or team up with friends as an old man navigating a treacherous world with cataracts. Rely on walking sticks, unique abilities, and chaotic teamwork to find your way back home.

5358400.title: Idle Cultivator: Ascend Together
5358400.short_description: Idle Cultivator is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a world of Chinese fantasy. Auto-battle beasts and bosses, collect and upgrade gear, and grow stronger. Adventure solo or team up online with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

5358720.title: Bleep Wildlife
5358720.short_description: Hunt dangerous animals, return to the tavern, and buy new guns and traps. Complete missions for a mysterious wizard and take on stronger prey.

5358910.title: Petty Theft Grocery
5358910.short_description: Petty Theft Grocery is a first-person, stealth-action-adventure game about stealing groceries. You play as a pair of kleptomaniac hands that have been banned from every grocery store in your state. Sneak through the stores, complete your "shopping" lists and escape.

5358950.title: Rune Deep
5358950.short_description: A hundred floors of dungeon lie beneath a town built on ancient relics. Lead a party of four from six classes, unleash weapon skills and elemental reactions to carve through swarming hordes, and dig up gear that makes every build stronger in this 3D voxel hack & slash.

5359230.title: Slap the Curse
5359230.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

5359340.title: Knockstep
5359340.short_description: Knock on anything! A cozy little rhythm game where you knock real stuff around you—mugs, desks, even your belly. Your mic listens to every beat while the town animals get to work. Drop in your own songs and they become brand-new stages.

5359410.title: Zero G Nova Adventure
5359410.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

5359860.title: Arrowhead
5359860.short_description: ArrowHead is a single-player bullet hell game… where getting hit is the only way to hit back. Rotate around the battlefield to ensure that you get your fill of arrows to shoot back. Slo-mo dash to squash your way through enemies!

5359890.title: Jin Gambit
5359890.short_description: Your formation shapes the battle. JIN GAMBIT is a single-player roguelite auto battler where you position and merge units, then watch your strategy play out in automatic combat. Build on your formation with heroes, artifacts, training, and awakening as your expedition progresses.

5360050.title: Carnival: Tidy Up!
5360050.short_description: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

5360100.title: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们
5360100.short_description: 承接著名的《亲吻那片花瓣》系列作品，《米迦勒的少女们》在原有剧情基础上拓展了各位少女们的故事——这些情节跨越了数月时光，描绘了她们生活中的种种磨难。在少女们不断成长并相互扶持的过程中，百合终将绽放。

5360420.title: TOGISHI - Katana Polishing Simulator
5360420.short_description: Polish the rust from a blade and wake the hamon sleeping beneath it. Switch stones, clear the rust, bring up the luster. But every stroke thins the steel. Where you stop is yours to decide. A stage-based polishing simulator across 32 blades.

5360490.title: RUNEBLADE
5360490.short_description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

5360560.title: LFG Battles
5360560.short_description: Async PVP auto battler where you build a party of heroes and gear them up to fight other players. Craft synergizing combinations as you try to break the game with your build! Dominate the ranked leaderboard or explore absurd combos at your own pace in casual mode.

5360720.title: Escape Your Boss
5360720.short_description: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

5361190.title: Such a Mess!
5361190.short_description: A house in chaos, hundreds of things out of place, and the urge to put away just one more. Tidy up in first person, unlock surprising powers and explore procedurally generated homes. Relax and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything back where it belongs.

5361490.title: sons of infinite dawn
5361490.short_description: A medieval grand strategy game in a living, fair world. Play in real time with pause or turn based as every nation follows the same rules and adapts to changing needs. Choose your own path, see the consequences clearly, and uncover deeper strategy with every campaign.

5361570.title: Heidentor
5361570.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

5361640.title: Duck Duck Run
5361640.short_description: The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them! Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

5361940.title: Woolhalla
5361940.short_description: A sheep’s epic journey to Valhalla — adventure alone or with your friends in co-op.

5362030.title: The Pit
5362030.short_description: WELCOME, UNIT. YOUR PURPOSE IS TO CLIMB. FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS ARE UNNECESSARY.

5362110.title: Sum & Steel
5362110.short_description: Build a factory that makes numbers. Mine deposits across a large map, connect arithmetic machines with conveyor belts, and deliver the results to your hub. Reuse old production lines, unlock faster machines, or tackle 42 campaign missions and 25 puzzles.

5362120.title: Blind & Seek
5362120.short_description: The seeker is blind — they hunt by sound. Every footstep, every thrown stone and every word you say on the mic lights up their world for a moment. Stay quiet, sabotage your friends, and make sure you're not the one wearing the blindfold when time runs out.

5362520.title: Fortfall
5362520.short_description: Build your defenses. Choose your class. Hold the Core. FortFall is a third-person fantasy defense game for solo play or private online co-op with up to five players. Raise walls, repair the damage, and fight escalating waves with melee weapons, bows, spells, and sentries.

5362620.title: Foush
5362620.short_description: Foush is a minimalist puzzle game where you try to raise the water in every cup up to its line by dropping block-shaped animals into it, while keeping each of them happy. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new animals added approximately every 8 levels.

5362650.title: UNDIVIDED
5362650.short_description: UNDIVIDED is a dark fantasy romance visual novel where your choices matter. As a corrupt sickness spreads across the land, your own life takes on new meaning. Travel with three powerful allies, decide who deserves your trust or your heart, and choose what you will risk to save a dying world.

5362980.title: Dear Reader
5362980.short_description: Lumen who discovers that his own words are betraying him. As his writing grows increasingly unfamiliar, his mental state begins to unravel. That is, until he realizes his editor has been slowly twisting his work into an uncanny counterfeit, all under the guise of optimization...

5363000.title: Carts & Coins
5363000.short_description: Your father left you a cart and 1,000 coins of debt. Haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack your cart like a puzzle, and trade your way across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run. Buy low, sell high, survive the road.

5363170.title: REFLECT89
5363170.short_description: Turn enemy bullets into your weapons in REFLECT89, a fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up. Master Perfect Reflections, unleash the Pulse Cannon or Pulse Radial, and climb the global leaderboards. Try the free demo now!

5363300.title: Mini Market Tidy Up
5363300.short_description: A cozy pixel-art organizing game about tidying up messy supermarkets. Sort products, stock the right shelves, earn money, unlock upgrades, and take on bigger stores as you turn every chaotic market into a perfectly organized space.

5363310.title: Echoes of Another Sky
5363310.short_description: A musical action RPG about a boy, a talking bell and thirteen skies that are being forgotten. Wield a tuning fork, chain combos, magic and reaction commands, and ring every silent world back to life before the last note fades.

5363420.title: SpartanBit
5363420.short_description: SpartanBit is a voxel arena FPS for competitive battles and custom game nights. Fight over flags and control points, survive 50-wave BitHorde with up to 8 players, or build your own levels in Creator Mode. Multiplayer battles support up to 24 players.

5363480.title: Sincerely, Your Diary
5363480.short_description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

5363600.title: WorldOS
5363600.short_description: Rule a superpower in 2026, command armies in World War II, unite China in the Three Kingdoms or seize Rome after Caesar. Type any order and an AI game master plays out the consequences: borders move, rivals scheme, allies betray. 200+ hand-picked worlds, plus an editor to build your own.

5363630.title: Bonkaboo
5363630.short_description: Bonk your friends off the table in this online physics party game for 1-8. Get knocked off and you come back as a ghost, dropping fans, bumpers and boulders on whoever’s still standing.

5363770.title: Chill Pixels
5363770.short_description: *Life can be overwhelming: take a well-deserved, cozy break.* Relax to soothing lo-fi tunes and peaceful ambient sounds while coloring gorgeous pixel art illustrations. Unlock adorable companions, upgrade magical powers in the Zen Workshop, and collect 62 achievements!

5363880.title: Don't Drain The Lake
5363880.short_description: Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake. A cozy first-person incremental: empty a mountain reservoir by bucket, pump and siphon, fish for the mill's cook, and watch the sun follow the water down while the valley gives back what it kept.

5364060.title: Xhaust
5364060.short_description: Xhaust is a weaponized vehicular combat game. Brawl in the arena, wreak havoc on the roads! Go solo or battle friends and bots in multiplayer (split-screen and online).

5364070.title: Hell Control
5364070.short_description: Customize your demon hunter and fight solo or with up to 3 friends in this third-person roguelite shooter. Choose upgrades as you level up, build your firepower, and destroy the Demon Cores fueling the invasion. Hell won't clear itself.

5364230.title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
5364230.short_description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

5364460.title: Astonia Forever
5364460.short_description: Astonia Forever is a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore towns and dangerous dungeons, complete quests, develop your skills and spells, collect powerful equipment, trade with other players, and join clans in a persistent online world.

5364490.title: Oh Sheep! It's UFO
5364490.short_description: Hop aboard your UFO, abduct sheep from Earth and bring them back to your home planet! Collect upgrades along the way, and don’t forget to get some help from your trusty dog friends!

5364500.title: Crown of Ages
5364500.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in an organically crafted fantasy antiquity. Build cities, advance through new ages, wage wars, and unleash magic. Roguelite choices shape every city and every run anew — until the world ends and your empire is reborn from the ruins.

5364560.title: Request Stop
5364560.short_description: A slow-burning commute horror. Something is slipping, a little each day. Wake up, eat, catch the bus. Work your job, then work on your life. Maybe you'll get it right tomorrow. Or another day.

5364640.title: Wiltcards
5364640.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

5364770.title: Fly-Fishing
5364770.short_description: Fly-Fishing is a casual "fishing" game with a unique twist! In this game, you and up to 3 friends will be able to take to the skies, playing as fish themed characters. Where you will be able to utilize your array of upgradable equipment to fish for a large variety of real and fantastical birds!

5364990.title: Ominous Descent
5364990.short_description: A deep-sea twin-stick action roguelite. Alone or with a friend, blast through deadly swarms and slay powerful bosses every few minutes. Your headlight grants bonus damage and is key to taking down certain foes, so manage its charge carefully.

5365120.title: Pyramid Scheme
5365120.short_description: Hop across pyramids, paint every cube, and mix drugs for wild synergies in this procedurally generated arcade roguelike. Befriend a depressed clown, call in air support, and survive the comedown. One more run. One more… hit.

5365220.title: Grand Bonk: Co-op Horde Survival
5365220.short_description: Your crew vs. every cop in town. Grand Bonk is a 4-player co-op horde survival roguelite: hold your block against an entire police department, level up a build that's all yours, stack it until it breaks, and bonk every wave that dares show up.

5365270.title: DEMON JACKPOT
5365270.short_description: A roguelite auto battler where slots summon your minions. Shape your army through evolution and runes, rewrite each run with the Demon's Revelation, and turn the tide with Demon Skills as you reclaim the lands seized by humanity.

5365630.title: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
5365630.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

5366700.title: STEADY STATE
5366700.short_description: Is your factory any good? STEADY STATE tells you. Mine mixed ore, sort it, smelt it and move it by belt, rail and drone. Then prove your site works: every order you have taken, delivered at its rate, all at once, for thirty seconds. Certify to unlock new machines, better grades unlock them sooner.

5366980.title: CHU: The Nightmare of That Day
5366980.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: being drafted again. Survive three days in the barracks in a first-person comedy-horror story. By day, army life. By night, hide, sneak and run.

5367220.title: The Debt of Chronos
5367220.short_description: Travel into the past to build a fortune, save your father from the mob, and prevent a catastrophe in the future. Invest, borrow, and bend the rules of time—but every choice can fracture the timeline and turn the future against you in this narrative strategy thriller.

5367290.title: Incremental Boss
5367290.short_description: Play as a dungeon boss in this relaxing incremental game! Gather resources, defend yourself against glory-seeking adventurers, and pursue your ultimate goal: getting promoted to an S-Rank Dungeon Boss!

5367380.title: Warcamp Rivals: Async Autobattler
5367380.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

5367440.title: PeeCee Critters
5367440.short_description: A tiny critter lives on your taskbar while you work. Click it and a whole monster-collecting RPG opens up: nearly 200 critters to catch, train and evolve, fourteen lands with a story to put right, five islands out at sea, and a real ending. Buy once: no energy, no ads, no paid extras.

5367450.title: PRE-ECHO
5367450.short_description: A co-op horror mystery. August 1994: in the small town of Greyford, an old radio picks up events before they happen. Explore by day, survive the Resonance Storm by night and change what is coming, alone or with up to three friends.

5367640.title: Iwanu Ga Hana
5367640.short_description: Everyone in Shiomachi has a line they swallowed. At midnight, time stops and those words become monsters. Live a whole school year, forge 17 bonds, and in the Mute Hour fight to make your friends say what they never could. A stylish JRPG about the things we don't say.

5367810.title: Blacksmith of sword master ~ IDLE ~
5367810.short_description: ■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

5367980.title: Fieldworks
5367980.short_description: Start with a hoe and four tiles of dirt. End with an agricultural empire. Farm, breed, and chain 179 recipes across four tiers — with no rot, no bankruptcy, and nothing that can ever die. Quality only goes up. The only enemy is your own floor plan.

5368500.title: Mimic Hunt
5368500.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a multiplayer stealth game where you blend into crowds of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and outsmart your opponents across different game modes. Play as a Hider or Hunter, team up with friends in co-op or compete against other players.

5368510.title: Too Slow Again
5368510.short_description: A first-person shooter where every level is a race against the clock. Clear the enemies, reach the finish, then do it again, faster. Every hit costs two seconds and restarts are instant. 100+ tracks across four weapon circuits, from assault rifle to sniper.

5368520.title: Roswell: Redacted
5368520.short_description: On a summer night in 1947, an unexplained light lit up the sky outside Roswell. That same night, the younger sister of a teenager named Tom Wilson disappeared from their home. Where exactly was the mysterious voice guiding him trying to lead him?

5368750.title: Gamble Cats
5368750.short_description: A top-down survivor game where you guide an addicted gambling cat through enemy hordes, dodge danger, collect XP, and grow stronger with auto attacking weapons, stat upgrades, and chest rewards.

5368950.title: Rise of the Seraphyn
5368950.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

5368980.title: Dead Harvest
5368980.short_description: Prepare your defenses. The dead are coming. Dead Harvest is a tower defense game where you must protect your territory from hordes of zombies. Your turrets won’t be doing all the work: you’ll also have to fight the zombies by running them over with your motorcycle!

5369090.title: The Fog & Flask
5369090.short_description: Run a cozy potion bar on a misty swamp. Pour layered potions that settle by density, grind, chop and heat ingredients, and serve curious guests with secrets of their own. By night, hold back the creeping fog with your lantern and follow the trail of your vanished mentor.

5369160.title: Padel Manager 27
5369160.short_description: A realistic padel management game: found your academy and take it from the bottom division to the world elite. Sign and pair players with real personalities, call every point from the bench or play it yourself, and live every shot on a truly simulated court. Early Access on December 1.

5369200.title: Lost Legends
5369200.short_description: Lost Legends is a roguelike card game set across seven hand-painted kingdoms. Choose your Kingdom, build your deck, and explore a world that is randomly generated every run. Destroy the heart of Darkness in 7 days or the world ends.

5369210.title: Starship! Starship!
5369210.short_description: Blast through asteroids and enemy ships in Starship! Starship!, an arcade space shooter inspired by Asteroids. Fly solo or team up in local co-op, upgrade your ship, and grab power-ups to survive the chaos—or challenge your friends in PvP.

5369290.title: SpellBall
5369290.short_description: SpellBall is a magical billiards game for 2–4 players. Sink balls, cast spells, and thwart your opponents' plans. Compete in duels or 2v2 team matches—either online or locally on the same computer. Master 100 spells, choose from 15 arenas, and develop your own unique playstyle.

5369530.title: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants
5369530.short_description: "The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..." KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

5369580.title: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet
5369580.short_description: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.

5369800.title: Main Character Energy
5369800.short_description: Ever dreamed of time-traveling or a perfect romance? Tired of dumb protagonists and restrictive RPGs? Here is the answer. A text adventure where you set the world and make every decision. Drive a tank on an ancient battlefield, or turn a ghost into your lover. Become the hero of your own story.

5369890.title: Territorium
5369890.short_description: « Conquer the world, one border at a time. » Territorium is a real-time multiplayer grand strategy game for up to 128 players. Upgrade your facilities, unlock devastating nuclear arsenals, and dominate the map in solo, co-op survival, or exclusive team modes.

5370180.title: XLV Backrooms: Never Found
5370180.short_description: Explore unsettling Backrooms environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Evade dangerous entities, manage your sanity and limited resources, and navigate mysterious portals as you search for a way out.

5370220.title: The Saga of Three Realms
5370220.short_description: A classic sandbox MMORPG. Tame animals and monsters to fight at your side. Plant your house right in the open world, no instances. Master any skill by using it, craft gear that matters, trade across the realm and carve your own legend. No pay to win, no cash shop.

5370260.title: Junk Tower Together
5370260.short_description: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.

5370360.title: Digging In The Desert
5370360.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

5370490.title: ROOM 307
5370490.short_description: ROOM 307 is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. Explore its decaying halls, uncover disturbing records, survive paranormal encounters, and discover what happened at 03:17. Some memories were buried for a reason.

5370690.title: Keep Evading
5370690.short_description: Keep Evading is a top-down arcade car chase where your ride never stops and one hit ends the run. Dodge growing police pressure, turn cruisers against each other, collect power-ups, unlock new cars, and chase a place in the Steam Top 10.

5370760.title: Dicellion
5370760.short_description: Dicellion is the kind of strategy tabletop game you can learn in a minute, take a weekend to master and are still chasing one more chain long after you meant to stop. Six themed stages, endless unlimited and head-to-head battles. How far can you roll?

5370790.title: Liar's Poker
5370790.short_description: A bluffing card game for four. Claim a hand that might be hiding in everyone's cards or call the last player a liar and turn the whole table over. Invite friends, practice against bots or an AI opponent, or climb the ranked ladder. About ten minutes a game.

5370810.title: The King Must Grow
5370810.short_description: A physics-based co-op incremental about overly loyal jesters, each with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Play solo, or be lazy and make a friend do the work.

5370930.title: Thank you,  Next please!
5370930.short_description: Run a local shop in an eastern totalitarian state. Provide rations, alcohol and medicine, but watch out for fake ration cards. Deny them goods or give them what they need to survive, knowing the Ministry is watching. Help the revolution, reunite families, and bring peace to the neighborhood.

5371340.title: Bloomtop
5371340.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 58 hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

5371580.title: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
5371580.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

5372120.title: Photoncytosis
5372120.short_description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation. A tiny organism feeds on the light of your screen, stores energy in its cells, and grows while you work. Shape its evolution, inspect it under the microscope, and help it survive a changing desktop ecosystem.

5372250.title: Poppets & Plunder
5372250.short_description: Sail a cutaway brig through four seas of Navy gunships, witch-hunters and Company gold. Run the crew deck by deck, work the guns, and when you are outgunned, reach for the voodoo doll and push a pin into the enemy ship. A roguelite of real-time fights and costly magic.

5372710.title: Beadroom
5372710.short_description: Make fuse bead creations, iron them and decorate your apartment with things you have made yourself. A cozy crafting game with commissions from the neighbours, free mode and new boards to buy. Export your designs as printable templates to craft them in real life, too.

5372890.title: Amberfall: Village Defense
5372890.short_description: A medieval fantasy village builder and auto battler. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and build a force of warriors, archers, and mages to face monster waves. When your village falls, spend earned Skulls on lasting upgrades and return stronger.

5372940.title: Gridiron Dynasty
5372940.short_description: Every league. One universe. Pro, college, Canadian, and arena football evolve together from 1960 and beyond, with historical rule changes, expansions, and mergers. Recruit, draft, trade, and sign players. Take control as GM, head coach, or both. Call the plays and watch every snap unfold.

5373010.title: Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi
5373010.short_description: “Kabaddi, kabaddi…” Stop chanting, and your health starts to drain. Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi is an online co-op horror game where you explore mysterious spaces while chanting “kabaddi” into your microphone.

5373600.title: Deckhound
5373600.short_description: Somebody took Birdie's slipper, and she wants it BACK! Pick two of eight real pets, build a deck of dog tricks, and chase off squirrels, garden gnomes and one very big goose. Play solo with both pets or couch co-op for two. A cozy, silly roguelike deckbuilder.

5373730.title: Nameless Fate
5373730.short_description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

5373840.title: Bouncery
5373840.short_description: Bouncery is an incremental bouncing game where you smash grumpy geometric shapes. Start by clicking and fill the board with balls, saws, lasers, black holes and many other weapons. Ascend and break it all again, faster.

5374020.title: Foldvalley
5374020.short_description: A cozy pop-up storybook village builder. Lay paper tiles that pop up off the page, welcome villagers home and make their wishes come true. Read your village's story in its own storybook, then build without end on a map that keeps unfolding.

5374460.title: Dark Ages Battle Simulator
5374460.short_description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors and legendary beasts clash in a brutal cinematic battle simulator.

5374900.title: Up the Great Oak
5374900.short_description: Pip, a tiny beetle in an acorn cap, climbs a giant oak to see the world. Every landing is a balancing act — center of gravity always wins.

5374930.title: Fruitless Campaign
5374930.short_description: Set the azimuth, elevation and launch speed, read the wind and the weather, and lob shells across endless procedurally generated islands to destroy every fruit. Play untimed on Easy or race the clock on Normal and Hard. Earn weapons from airdropped crates, or take on up to three friends online.

5375240.title: Capital Circuit
5375240.short_description: A chaotic 3D party board game for 2–6 players: buy America's biggest cities, rig your rivals' dice, blow up their buildings with a bazooka and settle scores in 14 first-person minigames — beer pong, bobsleigh, darts, water pistol duels and more. Online or on one screen.

5375270.title: BIGGER BEASTS!
5375270.short_description: Hatch eggs, raise tiny creatures into giants and build your team to face bosses. A pixel art creature-collecting idle RPG with automatic battles, equipment to forge and a village that helps your companions grow.

5375350.title: Pan, Please!
5375350.short_description: Grab. Sizzle on the beat. Serve. Pay the debt. A rhythm cooking roguelite where one frying pan grows a broke little shop into a fully automated kitchen storm — three pans, flying plates and GOLDEN TIME that never ends. Drag the pan, feel the beat.

5375520.title: MOMENT: A Clockwork Melody
5375520.short_description: Solve puzzles as you compose melodies. Place clockwork launchers, tune their timing and guide balls through colour-changing routes. Each collision plays a note, turning your solution into music. Explore 40 levels, experiment in Free Mode and share your own puzzles.

5375740.title: MOTHERSHIP: The Last Stand
5375740.short_description: Take command of Mothership Keystone, the last fortress-station of the Compact: aim its Prime Battery, build defenses under fire and break flagship after flagship across a war of 24 systems. Every run makes your Admiralty stronger.

5375950.title: Put It Away Please
5375950.short_description: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

5376600.title: AfterCursor
5376600.short_description: Your cursor leaves copies behind. Now they hunt you. Collect folders, dodge phantom cursors, and chase high scores in an eerie desktop arcade game. Uncover a 50-level story between emails, or test your reflexes in Endless, Maze, Waves, and Relay.

5376720.title: Still Not Dead Yet
5376720.short_description: 'Still Not Dead Yet' is a suspenseful horror-thriller text story inspired by H. P. Lovecraft. In a dark mausoleum, a grieving professor performs an archaic ritual to resurrect his recently deceased wife. The ritual succeeds, setting him down an unforeseen path.

5377330.title: Grey Havok's Crystal War
5377330.short_description: Defend crystals from monster waves in a chaotic arcade FPS. Play solo, in local split-screen or 1P vs 2P, or online via Steam. Earn in-game currency, progress through unlockable levels, chase high scores, and uncover a secret Light Gun Mode.

5377410.title: King Dies Rich
5377410.short_description: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

5377490.title: Globus: Geography Quiz
5377490.short_description: Explore the world on an interactive 3D globe and test your geography knowledge across countries, capitals, flags, landmarks, mountains, rivers, seas and more. Play in TYPE, SELECT, GUESS or HINT modes and improve your skills round by round.

5377690.title: Cloudwright
5377690.short_description: A cozy factory game for 1-8 players across a vast sky of floating islands. Every island holds something new, and it all connects: belts, ropeways and airships tie your islands into one ever-growing factory. Explore, meet the islanders, friend and foe, and brave the caves below.

5378250.title: Rooklite
5378250.short_description: A minimalist chess roguelite played on 4×4 boards, with the classic pieces and all the beauty of chess. Build your board and fight for checkmate.

5378400.title: BlastMorph: Pinball
5378400.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it! Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

5378440.title: Do A Kickflip
5378440.short_description: Skate an endless city that builds itself as you ride. Flip, grab and grind across three lanes of street, chain tricks into huge combos, and ride from sunset into midnight. One more run is always one kickflip away.

5378460.title: Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve
5378460.short_description: Cozy single-player organizing and cleaning simulator where you sort 3,040 scattered potions throughout a mysterious magical library. Return every potion to its proper shelf, organize magical collections by type, unlock powerful abilities, restore perfect order, and reveal the way out.

5378500.title: Vestige
5378500.short_description: Vestige is a fast-paced action roguelite built for solo and co-op play. Pick your class, craft absurdly powerful builds, chase game-changing loot, and survive increasingly brutal trials. **Get stronger. Break the game. Push further.

5378740.title: Coy's Escape
5378740.short_description: 《科伊的逃亡》是一款2D回合制Roguelike卡牌游戏。带领三位命运交织的主角——科伊、莱斯莉与希娜，在崩坏的世界中搜集线索、构筑卡组、破解谜题，揭开末日背后的真相。200+张卡牌，无限可能的策略组合，每一次逃亡都是全新的故事。

5378860.title: Alandys
5378860.short_description: You don't catch creatures here: you are one. In this co-op action roguelite, every guardian plays like a raid boss: read the telegraphs, solve the mechanics, raise your kin and climb to the Summit. Solo, with AI teammates or up to 3 players online. Free to play.

5379100.title: WannaRich
5379100.short_description: WannaRich is a 2D farming, management, and adventure game. Start with nothing, grow crops, craft tools, battle monsters, and build your fortune. Play solo or with friends, and turn a wild island into your own empire. Can you earn your first 1,000,000 gold?

5379360.title: Auriga
5379360.short_description: In 1988 the rover AURIGA found something on Mars, and the program buried it. 350 years later, it wakes. Drive a slow, physical rover across procedurally generated worlds: drill, scan, map caves with lidar and outlast radiation, storms and crushing air, from green-phosphor Mars to distant stars.

5379500.title: Billiard Cat
5379500.short_description: Cats love knocking things off tables. What if it's a pool table? Missed a shot? A cat might just nudge the ball in for you. Then again, it might get in your way. Between turns, pet them, play with a cat teaser, or let one nap on your lap. 8-ball, 9-ball, and snooker for 1–4 players.

5379610.title: On Paper
5379610.short_description: Dig through mountains of shredded paper in this cute detective puzzle adventure. Sort scraps with Fedo Chan, snap documents together, uncover ridiculous evidence, and upgrade your tools to expose a shady cat businessman. Some secrets are only obvious On Paper.

5379620.title: Arena of No Return
5379620.short_description: Arena of No Return is a dark medieval boxing simulation where you play as Kael, a condemned fighter trapped in a brutal arena-city. Train, unlock new skills, build your fighting style, and climb the ranks to earn your freedom and return to your daughter.

5379960.title: Art Monolith
5379960.short_description: Discover art, one brick at a time. A relaxing clicking game where you break a giant cube. Painting masterpieces hide under every layer. Collect hundreds of them to hang in your own gallery, or join the world to break one massive cube in multiplayer mode.

5379970.title: Board Kingdom
5379970.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

5380250.title: Milk Frog, Love Me Again
5380250.short_description: A 3D neon roguelite about an un-deletable milk frog, absurd livestreams, and collecting meme cards. Mow down viruses, build broken synergies, decorate a frog home, and chase the ending before the chat moves on.

5380470.title: Gravity Express
5380470.short_description: A cart. Cargo. Gravity. Two idiots. What could go wrong? One cart, two players, total chaos! Drive through dangerous tracks while your friend protects the cargo, fights off bandits, and desperately tries to keep everything from falling apart in this hilarious co-op physics game.

5380500.title: Gravity Chaos: Video Store
5380500.short_description: Gravity is back. The tapes aren’t. Sort thousands of scattered VHS tapes in a neon-lit retro video store. Match movies to their shelves, unlock unusual upgrades, and take a break with retro computer games. Turn chaos into order, one satisfying row at a time.

5380510.title: The Last Warden
5380510.short_description: You are the last guardian of a city in a medieval post-apocalyptic world. An unknown plague has spread across the world, and every day is now a struggle for survival. Decide who may pass through the gates — and who must face the final sentence.

5380610.title: Unextinct
5380610.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

5380700.title: My Nail Salon
5380700.short_description: Create cute manicures in a colourful nail-art salon. Paint and layer polish, blend ombré, shape magnetic shimmer, and add stickers, charms and rings. Experiment in Free Play or recreate your customers’ inspiration photos in Open Store.

5380920.title: ICE TO MEET YOU
5380920.short_description: Prepare your courtyard, build snow defenses, and survive a chaotic New Year's Eve snow war! Gather snow, craft snowballs, complete ridiculous errands, and fight off rival neighborhoods solo or with friends.

5380960.title: FIND KITTENS 14: Slavic Mythology
5380960.short_description: In a faraway kingdom… kittens are hiding! What are you waiting for? Explore a hand-drawn world of Slavic myths and folk tales, find hidden kittens, and fill the black-and-white scenes with different colors.

5380990.title: OVERDRILL
5380990.short_description: A pixel art incremental mining roguelite. Drill through destructible caves, collect ore and build a stronger rig with drones, automated bores and a branching upgrade tree.

5381380.title: Chad Billionaire
5381380.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

5381390.title: Shot
5381390.short_description: Stand your ground in a Western shooting gallery roguelite. Hit weak spots, shoot down incoming attacks, and combine perks into powerful builds. Face varied enemies and bosses in combat where precision, quick reactions, and every reload matter.

5381540.title: Arcana Autonoma: Fourteen Races
5381540.short_description: Twenty years after the War of Unification, Setsuna, daughter of the sky battleship's captain, descends to a land of fourteen races torn by blockades. Recruit the foes you beat, raise five cards and send them into auto battles - then decide where, and for whom, to spend your few skip tickets.

5381570.title: Scrapmiles
5381570.short_description: Explore an autumn valley in an old pickup. Collect and haul scrap, take jobs and secure your cargo. Spend your earnings on repairs, restoration and truck upgrades in an open-world driving and salvage simulator with changing weather and a day-and-night cycle.

5381620.title: Flight Deck: Pacific 1942
5381620.short_description: Command a WWII carrier task force in real time. Find the enemy first, arm and launch your squadrons, plot their attack runs and survive the counterstrike. Fight six battles of 1942 by day and by night, design warships in the shipyard, share maps on the Steam Workshop and battle friends online.

5381690.title: Engria, The Twisted Carnival
5381690.short_description: Step into the paws of Kuros, the shapeshifting cat, in the strange world of Engria where death and mayhem are everyday occurrences alongside tea and biscuits.

5381720.title: Artillery Deluxe
5381720.short_description: A turn-based artillery duel with 40 weapons and destructible terrain. Draft your arsenal, adjust your aim, account for wind and outscore your opponent. Battle the AI, share one computer with a friend, or connect over LAN and direct online multiplayer.

5382060.title: Throw Weight: Fleet Doctrine
5382060.short_description: Hard sci-fi fleet command. No shields, no lasers — just missiles, point defense and electronic warfare.

5382310.title: ASHENSHIFT: Desktop RPG
5382310.short_description: ASHENSHIFT is a pixel-art RPG that lives on your desktop. Three heroes fight in a slim transparent window above the taskbar while you work. Talents, gear, the forge and a rule for every ability are yours to set. Enemies wind up in plain sight: break the cast or raise a shield.

5382420.title: Buy the Dip, Milady
5382420.short_description: Let the maids fight. You handle the money! Mine silver, summon maids, and buy or short stocks while battle rages. Your profits might turn the tide. Your losses? Back to the pickaxe. Build your team for story battles, the Endless Tower, and ranked Steam PvP. No paid pulls.

5382560.title: Mana League
5382560.short_description: Fast 7v7 fantasy football with dwarves, orcs, goblins and a lot more. Curl it, chip it or fire a Zigzag Bolt past the keeper. Cast Team Spells, dodge mine carts and play with up to 4 friends on couch co-op or online.

5383040.title: Towers for Hire
5383040.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite tower defense game. Monsters are swarming toward the village, and you play as the captain of a band of mercenaries, building towers, sending out guards and holding the line with skills and traps. Mix and match over 100 cards and treasures to shape a company that's truly yours.

5383110.title: Goblin Problem
5383110.short_description: Goblin Problem is an RPG, co-op, tower defense game where you build and expand your fortress by day and defend it from waves of goblins by night. Control your hero, build powerful defenses, recruit troops, and reclaim the kingdom piece by piece.

5383210.title: Brackets & Banners
5383210.short_description: Build your college basketball legacy. Recruit players, shape your roster, and chase tournament runs in a fictional coaching career sim. Make the calls yourself or delegate to your staff as each season adds new players, stories, and banners to your program's history.

5383400.title: Usogui:Contradiction Game
5383400.short_description: Come on, bid for weapons and items with limited gold coins. Offense? Or defense? Perhaps it will be revealed after the bell rings. Your sole purpose is to use your wisdom to win this gamble.

5383640.title: 人生档案：千禧
5383640.short_description: Return to 2000 with your memories of the future. In this business-life sandbox spanning 2000–2025, act on your knowledge of the era: invest, start a company or negotiate a stake in someone else’s. Then decide what that money is for. A bigger business? A different life?

5383750.title: Reapercussions
5383750.short_description: Death is now your day job. Roll your bones, build poker hand variants and reap each Soul before your rolls run out. Stack cursed Relics and Hex Potions into absurd combos as you try and impress in your new role as a Reaper. It looks easy but looks are very deceiving.

5383780.title: Stompworks
5383780.short_description: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

5383930.title: Roomcopter
5383930.short_description: Roomcopter is a sandbox room-building game about creating your dream space. Shape your room however you like and furnish it with thousands of props, from furniture and lights to plants and decor. Find your favorite angle and capture the moment with realistic graphics.

5384200.title: Lines of Conquest
5384200.short_description: Take control of a nation and conquer Europe one base at a time. Move your armies, attack enemy territory, upgrade your bases and manage your resources as you continue to expand your territory.

5384240.title: Castle Back
5384240.short_description: Twelve years after the land collapsed, people live in fortresses on the backs of giant beasts. Stack yours block by block and send it into battle. Hit the right support and a whole tower comes down. Theirs, or yours. A cute voxel auto-battler roguelite.

5384260.title: Coloratis
5384260.short_description: Enjoy three color-themed puzzles! Connect and clear blocks in ColorDrop, draw a single path while changing colors in InkPath, and roll a die to paint the board in ColorDice. Plan what to clear, which route to take, and how to orient each face. Discover three different ways to put your mind to work!

5384300.title: Over or Under
5384300.short_description: You have one job: make all 10,000 toilet paper rolls in this endless restroom face the same way. Your fickle boss won't say whether he wants "over" or "under" until you finish. Plunge clogs, mop spills, and pray the final 50/50 goes your way. Get it wrong and the shift starts over.

5384580.title: Hatchbar
5384580.short_description: Hatch eggs in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Fuse any two Hatchlings into a new species, then hand them to your adventurers as weapons. An idle RPG with 47 creatures to discover. Never steals focus, clicks pass through. One price, no ads. Free demo out now.

5384760.title: Desktop Space Battles
5384760.short_description: Your desktop is the battlefield. Build and customise a fleet of 25 ships, command towering Capital Ships and unleash spectacular online space battles across your screen. Watch fighters clash, missiles hunt and hulls shatter as you challenge rival commanders on Steam.

5384780.title: IPredictedYouPredictedMe
5384780.short_description: A unique two-player fighting game where you must predict your opponent’s moves before they act, while preventing them from predicting yours. Plan five actions each round and outsmart your opponent in a fair battle of wits. Enjoy the thrill of mind games!

5384840.title: Zombie Siege
5384840.short_description: Protect the last 10 survivors in a top-down tower defense game. Build defenses, hunt for gear with random affixes, and customize towers with skill cards. Pick one of three upgrades each level-up and turn a makeshift camp into a firing line against hordes and siege beasts.

5385220.title: The Silent Wild
5385220.short_description: A realistic first-person open-world survival game for one player, or two in split-screen co-op on one PC. Build with physics-based blocks, hunt, craft and cook, then hold out as creatures break through your walls, tornadoes tear homes apart and the cold freezes every drop of water.

5385400.title: Chess War
5385400.short_description: Chess War brings chess to life in epic 3D battles between legendary armies from different historical eras. Challenge friends online or locally, face a competitive AI, and watch every capture unfold through dynamic, action-packed combat animations.

5385490.title: Shav : The Night Watch
5385490.short_description: An overnight job. A covered body. A lamp you must keep alight. Watch over a dead woman in a remote Indian village, and discover what's gone wrong before you open the door.

5385600.title: Maeli Keus
5385600.short_description: A world that only exists where you look. Explore a dreamlike land that manifests around you as you walk, gather crystals to relight forgotten checkpoints, and escape the creature that hunts you through the light.

5385610.title: Nook Beasts
5385610.short_description: Digital monsters in the corner of your desktop! Hatch, Evolve, and Raise over 100 different beasts, and send them on adventures to grow stronger, earn rewards to upgrade your nook, and discover eggs from unknown species!

5385620.title: The Beaten Track
5385620.short_description: Off-road across an endless land in an old 4x4. No roads, no markers: just forests, deserts, glaciers, caves and sea. Find hidden campsites, haul planks and stone, build shops that earn for you, and share it all with every driver in one world where many tires make a track.

5385680.title: Hairpin Legends
5385680.short_description: Hairpin Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

5385710.title: Following the Shadow
5385710.short_description: «Following the Shadow» is a fantasy visual novel. Join Jacob, a young alchemist, and his screech-owl companion on a perilous journey through the realm of mists and will-o'-the-wisp!

5385740.title: BombCase
5385740.short_description: Two agents. One table. A row of briefcases - and one of them is a bomb. Listen, scan, bluff and sabotage your way through a 24-mission Cold War campaign of turn-based deduction, then take the seat against a real opponent online. Open the wrong case and it's over.

5385860.title: Coral Pastoral
5385860.short_description: This is a desktop companion game set in the ocean, featuring small fish and sea deities from various civilizations. It combines idle gameplay with light card and incremental mechanics. Use coral skills to create your own beautiful underwater world. By the way, the ocean deities will protect you!

5386010.title: She Doesn't Speak My Language
5386010.short_description: A real dating sim and real English conversation practice in one game. No dialogue choices: win her over in your own English, by voice or keyboard. The in-game AI runs on your PC. No subscription.

5386050.title: Last Ward
5386050.short_description: A top-down horde survivor. Choose from nine classes, push out of the Ward into corrupted wilds, borrow attacks from other classes, then return to the Refuge to rebuild your gear and talents.

5386080.title: SearchBattle
5386080.short_description: Search, turned into a battle. SearchBattle is a word party game for 1–8 players on a real search engine. Everyone searches one word for the same topic; hit counts and results decide the winner. Across many rules, what's tested isn't knowledge but "search power." What would you search?

5386090.title: HexWorldDefence
5386090.short_description: A hex-tile tower defense where every unit you place becomes part of the enemy's path. Build a maze, evolve your units and hold out for 51 waves.

5386150.title: Linelock
5386150.short_description: Ding! You received an invitation from the [Eerie Girl]. Stop just reading—this time, YOU challenge the rules. An interactive rule-horror novel with five-senses gameplay. Lick her ankle to uncover hidden rules, or reach out to find clues. Forget the girl; break the rules and you die.

5386360.title: Runaway Sleigh 84
5386360.short_description: Santa's sleigh is out of control! Dodge elves, stumps, and hazards, grab cookies to keep going, and race through 24 fast-paced arcade stages. Think you can survive the ride?

5386380.title: Ludus Magna
5386380.short_description: Ludus Magna combines auto-battler combat, gladiator management, and strategic quick-time events in a dark, run-based strategy game set in ancient Rome. Lead your gladiator school as a Lanista, develop unique fighters, manage gold and risk, and keep your House from bankruptcy.

5386500.title: Cursor's Tale
5386500.short_description: An incremental game where your cursor becomes a hero. You battle monsters and collect their loot. Upgrade your skill tree, from basic upgrades to game-changing abilities. Craft gear from monster materials you collected to go even further beyond. Get back before night falls.

5386780.title: Clanker Buster
5386780.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

5386900.title: Railtown
5386900.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

5387050.title: Tinymon Tactics
5387050.short_description: A cozy roguelite autobattler. Set sail for Verdantia, an archipelago where curious little creatures called Tinymon roam every island. Befriend them, help them evolve, and shape them into a team strong enough to challenge the arena leaders waiting at the end of each island.

5387110.title: Too. Many. Socks.
5387110.short_description: 4,000 socks. One giant mess. Find matching pairs, fill shelves, and complete orders in a cozy first-person sorting game. Then unlock a second workshop and build your own sorting lines with conveyors, robotic arms, and delivery robots.

5387240.title: Gladren
5387240.short_description: A physics-driven medieval melee arena for up to 8 players. Aim every swing with your mouse, block, kick and dodge, buy your weapons and armor each round, and settle it with friends in brutal duels and team battles where steel bites and limbs fly.

5387970.title: Drop Dead Lucky
5387970.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

5387980.title: Ragdoll Ranch
5387980.short_description: Raise chickens, rabbits, pigs, and cows on the most chaotic ranch you’ve ever seen. Expand your operation solo or bring a friend in this challenging FPS farming simulator.

5388420.title: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
5388420.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

5388710.title: Planet Sim
5388710.short_description: Land on an untouched planet and build a factory colony that reaches the stars. Harvest, haul and produce without conveyor belts, launch rockets to orbit and the Moon, wake your colonists, defend against what lives here, and rebuild the broken colony Ark to finish the journey.

5388900.title: Cryptborn
5388900.short_description: Choose your unique spirit and descend into an endless procedural dungeon solo or with friends. Loot items, explore, and battle through hordes of enemies before they evolve and destroy you. Try the demo now!

5389260.title: My Fart Adventure
5389260.short_description: My Fart Adventure — Cursed by a bad taco, you're now doomed to fart in public. The subtle art of cutting the cheese without getting busted: blend into the crowd, escape the DGREI Agents. Solo or up to 30 players online.

5389280.title: LIMINAL SKY
5389280.short_description: A flying game through places that should not exist. Pilot three aircraft through vast liminal spaces, giant statues, a floating archipelago, endless backrooms, solo, with friends in the story, or in combat with up to 30 pilots.

5389470.title: Desktop Xianxia
5389470.short_description: Desktop Xianxia is a cozy desktop companion that blends idle cultivation with farming. Set a goal and let your cultivator handle daily routines while you work or unwind. Grow your homestead, brew elixirs, craft gear, and explore new challenges at your own pace.

5389560.title: Five Card Evolution
5389560.short_description: A poker roguelike deckbuilder where you construct wild combos, risk it all, and climb an endless tower of fortune.

5389590.title: Googlick
5389590.short_description: Retro arcade shoot em' up puzzler where you blast bricks, steal their color energy, and eradicate the color matching seeds nodes before the robotic army can grow! An authentic recreation of the golden age of arcade gaming with a custom built CRT cabinet experience! Come blasts some bricks!

5390070.title: CYBER ORBADIER BULBUS MACHINA
5390070.short_description: The Bulbus Machina were built to fight a long war by reusing gear taken from their enemies. Lead four of them deep into enemy factories in this roguelike mech tactics RPG. Destroy enemy gear to win fast, or disable it and take it? Choose your weapons, and replace worn-out gear with what you take.

5390180.title: Gemheart Valley
5390180.short_description: Grow crystals instead of crops. Crack geodes with the most satisfying tap in cozy games, fill a museum with one-of-a-kind gems, befriend a mountain village (and one very determined rival), and bring a sleeping valley back to life, season by season.

5390240.title: Fetch()
5390240.short_description: Fetch() is a top-down territory game where you never touch the controls. Write a Lua script and your dog does exactly what it says, which is occasionally what you meant. Mark more tiles than the other packs before the clock runs out and the ground is yours.

5390400.title: Draught King
5390400.short_description: The world's first pub-like. A deckbuilder where your cards are the ingredients - serve drinks to customers to meet an ever-increasing target, featuring crazy combos and insane effects.

5390930.title: Guild Adventures
5390930.short_description: Guild management Auto-Battler. The heroes fight for you. Recruit new adventurers, send them into monster-filled lands for gold, loot, and items you can sell on the Steam Community Market 💰. Improve your guild to push into more dangerous and rewarding challenges.

5391090.title: 大赢家
5391090.short_description: Big Rich is a 3D cartoon-style turn-based economic strategy game. Run around and work jobs to earn gold, win licenses in secret auctions, then play cards to take a cut from your rivals. When the match ends, the richest player wins. Play online with friends, or solo against AI.

5391260.title: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
5391260.short_description: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.

5391600.title: IdleBound - 2D Idle MMORPG
5391600.short_description: Explore a colorful 2D pixel MMORPG. Choose your class, learn skills, hunt monsters, and quest across meadows, seaside paths, and snowy peaks. Party up with friends, trade your loot, gear up, and make your mark on a shared online world.

5391750.title: Boomside
5391750.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

5392270.title: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together
5392270.short_description: A wizard duel has wrecked the wand shop: thousands of magical objects lie scattered across its rooms. Sort wands, potions, runes and candles back where they belong, cast tidying spells, and watch every room wake up in a burst of magic. Play solo or with up to three friends.

5392810.title: Code Fragment
5392810.short_description: Trapped inside the game you were creating, explore a corrupted digital world in this 2D puzzle-platformer. Collect Nodes, use consoles to change your surroundings, and defeat bosses to unlock new abilities and find your way out.

5393140.title: 2D Hates 3D
5393140.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

5393150.title: Mindfulness TD
5393150.short_description: Roguelike tower defense. You are King Mark, a fallen king protecting what remains of your kingdom. Defend your people. Each time you fail, spend mindfulness on a progression tree, pick yourself back up, and defend them better the next time.

5393190.title: Organic Mechanic
5393190.short_description: Organic Mechanic is a bee-first automation, creature capturing, machine manufacturing game! Explore multiple vibrant biomes, build mechanical factories and play with your? friends? maybe? Catch, Built & Profit from BEES!

5393260.title: Crowd of Knives
5393260.short_description: An online PvP stealth game where every assassin looks like an NPC. Blend into a crowded medieval marketplace, hunt your targets, and strike without being seen. Get caught killing, and the bounty is on your head. Now you're the one being hunted. Pick and use your abilities to outplay the others.

5393680.title: Extinction Valley
5393680.short_description: You are a biker hired to clear a few rats from a public park. Fast forward a few hours, and you are diving through a literal portal to Hell to kill skeleton wizards. Welcome to Extinction Valley, a comedy arena shooter where a routine pest control contract escalates into an apocalyptic nightmare.

5393780.title: Devil inc.
5393780.short_description: Devil inc. is a strategy simulation of the conflict between good and evil. Explore the development of civilizations, society’s weaknesses and the consequences of your decisions. Watch how your choices change the world.

5394110.title: Hundred Tower
5394110.short_description: Climb a hundred-floor tower in a painterly action roguelite. Chain wall jumps, dash through enemies. Shift gravity, and cut through strange creatures with sword and paint. Choose your upgrades, face the bosses, and work your way up to find out the mystery of the tower.

5394490.title: Neptune
5394490.short_description: Neptune is a short, chapter-based, dropper and precision platformer game. Soar and explore through abandoned architecture, receive gruesome mutations, enjoy the atmosphere and banging OST, and figure out the truth of what happened on Neptune all those years ago...

5394700.title: JUST: REFLEX TEST
5394700.short_description: Fast, flashy action and hardcore challenges! Conquer all 20 stages and claim the Battle Master's crown. Your enemies grow faster and stronger with every victory!

5394830.title: Gnomebody Told You To Climb
5394830.short_description: Climb with a fire axe. Sit in a watering can. Try to look like this was your plan.

5394850.title: Reconstruction: The Myth of Lincoln
5394850.short_description: April 1865: Booth's shot misses and Lincoln lives. In this turn-based political strategy game, you count votes in Congress, send troops South and face the Supreme Court, but Lincoln keeps his own mind. In the end, two verdicts: his legend, and what the freedpeople received.

5394890.title: Orbit Anglerz
5394890.short_description: Slingshot your lure through gravity wells to catch fish that evolve — on a night archipelago where the science program is closing in on what's wrong with the water.

5395240.title: Breed a Slime
5395240.short_description: Keep a squishy, real-time physics slime right on your desktop! In Breed a Slime, squish and fling slimes while working, breed and mutate traits, collect genes and ornate looks like wings and auras to fill your compendium, found legacy bloodlines, and trade Gene Seeds on the Steam Market!

5395430.title: Rolling Heads
5395430.short_description: The Rolling Heads is a multiplayer battle arena fighting game with literally Rolling Heads. Kind of like sumo wrestling on steroids.

5395560.title: Pigeon Idle: GUGUGUGU!
5395560.short_description: Catch pigeons and sell them as rotisserie chicken! Or set your hard-won catch free! Run a pigeon rotisserie on your desktop, and let your favorite pigeons play on top of your taskbar.

5395860.title: Gnome Cottage Cleanup!
5395860.short_description: A whimsical organizing simulator about tracking down thousands of Gnomes, Plants, Books, Potions and more! Use magical abilities and upgrades on your quest to sort 4,060 items scattered across the Gnome Cottage. Just pure exploration, organizing, and collecting with no time limits or pressure.

5395890.title: Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland
5395890.short_description: Tidy a messy toy store by day, then grab your ghost vacuum when midnight strikes! Sort thousands of toys onto the right shelves, vacuum slime, catch cute ghosts and return them to snow globes.

5395930.title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
5395930.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

5396040.title: How To Goblin
5396040.short_description: How To Goblin is a cozy desktop idle game where a tiny goblin crafts weapons on a dungeon platform while you do other things. Collect rare loot, sell items, purchase upgrades, and complete your collection!

5396100.title: Pawnbroke
5396100.short_description: A darkly funny pawnshop roguelike. Your late uncle left you his shop and his debt to Mr. Grin. Buy strange stock, arrange the shelf so every item boosts its neighbours, and pay up every five days. Come up short and he takes a finger. Play solo or with a Steam friend.

5396150.title: Joker's Wild
5396150.short_description: A blackjack roguelike deckbuilder. Build wild Joker combos, strike risky pacts with the House's Boss dealers and beat the House, one hand at a time.

5396320.title: Smoothie Chaos
5396320.short_description: A co-op slime restaurant game for 1 to 6 players. Raise slimes in your garden, feed them strange things to see what they evolve into, then blend them into smoothies for a dining room full of hungry humans and robots.

5396500.title: Realistic Football Career
5396500.short_description: Realistic Football Career is a text-based football career simulation where you start as an unknown prospect and try to reach the top. Train, improve your attributes, make decisions on the pitch, earn transfers, and build a career where success is never guaranteed.

5396810.title: HALASKÂRGAZİ
5396810.short_description: Istanbul, 1918. The capital is occupied, and the resistance works in the shadows. Found a secret society, recruit agents, decode telegraph ciphers, and smuggle supplies to Anatolia in a historical espionage strategy game.

5397070.title: Gembound
5397070.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

5397110.title: Spirit Sealer
5397110.short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey through portals in Spirit Sealer, a narrative-driven card game where you seal Spirits in strategic battles. Master a dynamic 3x3 grid battlefield, wielding your customizable Sealer and four Spirits against unique foes in each zone.

5397130.title: Next, Million Worlds
5397130.short_description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

5397180.title: HAZPIT
5397180.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

5397510.title: Diviper
5397510.short_description: A snake game where your tail is a math puzzle. Scoop up numbers, line them up, and watch matching ones merge — 2, 4, 8, 16, boom. Stuck? Just divide your way out. (Your mermaid buddy will help ;P )

5397590.title: Astra Genesis
5397590.short_description: A colony that starts from almost nothing, in a galaxy of 5,000 planets shared by everyone on the server. Production chains, workers with names, expeditions, a player Exchange and alliances, and PvP you set yourself, from solo mode to Hardcore. The colony runs even without you.

5397850.title: Destroy Objects, Zone out Eventually
5397850.short_description: DOZE is a short incremental action game about guiding a shifting geometric form through endless swarms, gathering resources, and stacking upgrades until you reach the end of a strange system.

5398100.title: SCRAP CROWN
5398100.short_description: In the junkyard arena, the winner rips the weapons off the loser. Bolt a hammer to a fridge and a rifle to a microwave, beat the scrap gangs one by one, rebuild your crew from what you take and climb to the Scrap King's crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler.

5398710.title: Pixel defender
5398710.short_description: An idle tower defense you play in a corner of your desktop. Defend your castle from the oncoming enemy army!! Train your soldiers, grow your town, and build the mightiest army of all!!

5398970.title: Neon Siege
5398970.short_description: Connect the dots, close the lines, obliterate everything caught inside: a real-time, wave-based roguelite. Between waves, expand a massive talent tree, procedurally generated every run.

5398980.title: Hitch Happens
5398980.short_description: Hitch Happens is a story-driven hitchhiking simulator where every ride turns into a new adventure. Hitch rides, meet quirky drivers, make choices, and get caught up in unpredictable situations.

5399100.title: Deadgate
5399100.short_description: Bir sözleşme al ve zombilerin istila ettiği karantina altındaki adaya gir. Ganimet topla, rakip takımlara karşı hayatta kal ve gece yarısından önce tahliye noktasına ulaş. Aksi takdirde yanında getirdiğin her şeyi kaybedersin. 32 oyunculu bir extraction shooter. Sözleşme yoksa çıkış da yok.

5399190.title: Wuxing Realm
5399190.short_description: A five-element strategic idle game. Build teams from Warriors, Equipment, and Spells — kick back with auto-battles or take command and cast spells mid-fight. The right combo unleashes power beyond the numbers. What's your strongest lineup?

5400230.title: Shield-Bearer Ben
5400230.short_description: A short incremental game where you play the TANK in a dungeon-finder party. Hold up your Big Shield, call out the red circles, and keep three teammates alive. Upgrade 120+ skills in a giant skill tree and take down the Demon Lord before tonight's patch deletes his dungeon.

5400290.title: GUTTERGLOW
5400290.short_description: A bowling roguelike with real pin physics. Aim and throw, score points for every pin that falls, and build your ball with pins, tricks and upgrades until one throw multiplies into a huge score. Ten levels, twelve bosses that change the lane, three modes.

5400300.title: Swornhand
5400300.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical card game with a story campaign, deckbuilding and online duels planned for launch. Discover 480 cards, fight for control of 3×3 and 4×4 boards, and challenge another player on the same computer.

5400360.title: MOM SAID DON'T OPEN
5400360.short_description: The whole night lies ahead! Lock the door. Don't open it to strangers. Some have come to help. Some simply knocked on the wrong door. And some... have come for you. Remember — a locked door won't always save you.

5400540.title: Kinhenge
5400540.short_description: You don't play a hero, you play a bloodline. Kinhenge is an online survival game that starts in the Stone Age: survive hunger, cold and rain, raise heirs and share a living island with NPCs who have a trade, remember what they live through and build villages of their own.

5402070.title: REISIR0b: PIZZA RUN
5402070.short_description: 🍕A fast-paced 2D Metroidvania about an elite combat android mercenary who shoots, tears across land, space, and water, opens boxes with random upgrades, and takes on the craziest job in the galaxy — ALL FOR PIZZA.

5402380.title: Molehill Mountain
5402380.short_description: One swing, one fistful of gold! A cartoony mole-whacking incremental game. Bonk moles before time runs out, chain combos and critical hits, then spend your gold to upgrade your hammer. Hire a Storage Keeper to stop thief moles, and defeat giant boss moles to collect relics.

5402630.title: The Good Stuff: Story of a True Hero
5402630.short_description: The Good Stuff is a rich-story, contemporary RPG set in the colorful, unassuming suburb of Cheddertown. The game is a grounded RPG, mixing typical turn based combat with optional dynamic gameplay, for a truly unassuming experience. Learn what it means to be a true hero in this quirky RPG!

5402750.title: Number Bound
5402750.short_description: Explore, battle, build, and collect in Number Bound, a family-friendly adventure where math and trivia unlock rewards. Play solo or with up to three friends, collect plushies, go fishing, build with nearly fully editable world objects. 3 Mini games including Fox Quest a game in a game!

5402930.title: Dagesh
5402930.short_description: Four players. Sixteen cards. One Boss. Bluff your friends, bargain for a bigger cut, or call "Dagesh!" and force a showdown. In this multiplayer card game, a good deal can beat a great hand.

5403540.title: DULL ACHE
5403540.short_description: A horrifying JRPG-inspired adventure follows a sequence of events that multiple people experience after one fateful day... Find their wills to live throughout a multi-chapter story.

5403670.title: Games Mag Tycoon
5403670.short_description: You used to read the magazines. Now you make one: run your own games magazine from 1986 to 2010. Reviews, covers, cover discs, video, tips & tricks and an editorial team with moods. The deadline is ticking, and every month your readers tell you whether it was good enough.

5403760.title: OnlyFarms: Tidy Up!
5403760.short_description: A cozy first-person animal-sorting adventure where every little creature has a mind of its own! +3000 animals. One island. Total farm chaos! Herd stubborn animals, catch runaway chickens, train your loyal sheepdog, and unlock new tools to bring every animal home.

5403980.title: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners
5403980.short_description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, and hunt for rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically on your desktop!

5404210.title: Porch Pirate Defender
5404210.short_description: Porch pirates keep stealing your parcels? Time for payback. Build a booby-trapped box of glitter, paint and firecrackers, set it on the porch and watch from the window as sneaky thieves grab it… and get launched into a cloud of color.

5404590.title: Toast Flipper
5404590.short_description: Save your family as "Thoasten"! Drag, aim, and flip: In this brutally hard 2D physics platformer, you fling yourself golf-style through a dangerous kitchen, defeat evil bread bosses, and chase the ultimate best time on the global speedrun leaderboard.

5404620.title: The Fatal Card
5404620.short_description: A tactical 1v1 card duel in a dark fantasy world. 31 characters with their own skills: curses, diseases, undead summons, attacks across the whole board. Place your cards, exploit your opponent's weaknesses and beat the AI or real players in ranked Steam matches.

5404720.title: Japan Stigmatized Property4 -日本事故物件監視協会-
5404720.short_description: A night-shift notice from the Japan Stigmatized Property Association. Review surveillance footage from real properties in Japan, including the famous haunted attraction "Senritsu Meikyu" and the abandoned Niigata Russian Village, and report every anomaly. Two staff members may monitor together.
developers: 日本事故物件監視協会
publishers: 日本事故物件監視協会

5404780.title: PTW
5404780.short_description: A fighting game with no fighting. When two players meet, the higher level wins. Levels are sold one at a time, one press each. Right now, someone on the board is one level above you.

5405000.title: Luckforge
5405000.short_description: The House always wins. Unless the whole table cheats. Luckforge is a co-op casino auto-battler for 1-4 players, online or on one couch. Spin a cursed slot machine for heroes, merge three into one, line them up and watch them clash. What could possibly go wrong?

5405080.title: Rimfarers
5405080.short_description: A classic turn-based space RPG. Trade between the worlds of five races, take on jobs, hunt pirates, rise in the fleet reserves and play dozens of text quests — while the Silence creeps in from the edge of the galaxy.

5405230.title: Jetstream Blitz
