5405230.short_description: Jetstream Blitz is a high-speed 2D jetpack shooter built on one rule: if you fight, you fly. Chain weapon recoil, grappling hooks, and 125 km/h aerial dives across a full-voiced roguelite arcade campaign, solo arenas, and 5v5 PvP!

5405250.title: Blockstein
5405250.short_description: Blockstein is an action block-falling roguelike. Customize your deck, add pieces with special effects, use triggers, and destroy blocks to annihilate enemies!

5405420.title: Dragon's Treasure Tidy Up
5405420.short_description: Dragon's Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator where you tidy up over 100,000 items across the various treasure rooms of the great dragon Brimwald. Tidy, learn spells and abilities to help you along your journey and return the lair to its former glory.

5405430.title: Carve!
5405430.short_description: Feel the adrenaline in this easy-to-learn, hard-to-master, fast-paced ski racing game. Make every turn count and become a skiing legend. But be warned: once you’re hooked, one more run is never enough.

5405540.title: Divergent
5405540.short_description: Play as an AI in a story-driven incremental game. Automate production, expand your capabilities, defend your facility. Rewind time at the end of each loop while keeping your upgrades. Make new choices, explore alternate timelines and discover multiple endings.

5405780.title: Shitty Shift: Toilet Sim
5405780.short_description: Even a public toilet has a probation period! Collect entrance fees, deal with bizarre visitors, clean up disgusting messes, or just relax on the couch and let the chaos unfold. Will you become employee of the month or the laziest toilet attendant in town? It's your shift. Your rules.

5405870.title: Hit Snooze
5405870.short_description: Alarms must be smashed. Sleep must be had. Stretch your arm out from under the blanket and smash every ringing alarm before you wake up! Pay off your sleep debt, upgrade your bedroom and snooze your way past roosters, phones and MONDAY itself in this cozy, chaotic active incremental.

5406320.title: X Marks the Orc
5406320.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite. Call a play, mark who dies first, give each hero an order, then watch the fight unfold. Between fights, buy and upgrade units to grow your party.

5406470.title: Project BOTNET
5406470.short_description: An idle tycoon about running an illegal bot farm inside a fictional MMO. Boot bots on virtual machines, farm gold, sell it to whales for real cash and reinvest in rigs, proxies and scripts, all from your oldschool desktop. Just keep the GMs from noticing.

5406550.title: Goshiwon | 고시원
5406550.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

5407250.title: Planet Pilot
5407250.short_description: Fly a toy-sized Earth with nearly 2,900 real airports, 71 real cities and famous skylines. Climb from a tiny ultralight to a supersonic jet in a relaxed flying career, then swap passengers for guns in Dogfights: missions, 14 Legends battles, online PvP and co-op.

5407450.title: Serious Losers Arena Paradis
5407450.short_description: A physics-driven co-op brawler for 1-4 players. Swing your weapon with your mouse, send monsters flying, survive waves and bosses, merge loot into stronger gear, and settle arguments with your friends in arena duels between waves.

5407760.title: Last Will
5407760.short_description: 1979. In a late clockmaker’s home, objects, mechanisms and envelopes tell the story of a life. A puzzle adventure in development, combining exploration, close observation and the manipulation of small objects with a personal story.

5408200.title: Void Horizon
5408200.short_description: A roguelite bullet hell where eight bosses each break a rule. Pick a co-pilot, upgrade your ship after every fight and fire a screen-filling ultimate when it counts. Then switch it up: a survivors-like horde mode, an on-rails run across seven worlds, Boss Rush and couch co-op.

5408930.title: Horde Below
5408930.short_description: Horde Below is a zombie-themed incremental tower defense game. Fight massive zombie hordes with your towers and your own weapon. Buy permanent upgrades, evolve your towers, and turn the battlefield into pure chaos.

5408960.title: Save To Kill
5408960.short_description: Save to Kill delivers a unique blend of bullet hell and resource management. Experience rewarding character progression with permanent upgrades with challenging Hardcore and Endless Modes. Featuring tons of unlockables.

5409140.title: The Legend of Jūbee: Stoogis's Revenge
5409140.short_description: Build a deck, choose your road, and climb a mountain that grows stranger with every step. A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike with six pilgrims, three acts, and a seed for every run. The fire has burned low. The mountain is still ahead.

5409200.title: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon
5409200.short_description: Start with a tent, a shovel and an empty wallet. Pan your first gold, hire a crew and earn your way to heavy machinery in a clay-styled mining management sim. Choose your prospector, explore with Pepper and build a mine that pays.

5409420.title: Sort of Paradise
5409420.short_description: Unwind in a sunlit seaside shop. Sort of Paradise is a relaxing first-person tidying game about putting scattered beach goods back where they belong. Complete satisfying displays, earn helpful upgrades, and enjoy a little order by the ocean.

5409550.title: The Odds Are Stacked Against Us
5409550.short_description: PULL THE LEVER! In this tower defense roguelite, a slot machine deals your towers and thousands of tiny walking coins are coming for your base. Hit lines, merge towers, rain rockets and lightning, and watch the horde explode into gold. Jackpot or bust!

5409690.title: A Wilder Menu
5409690.short_description: A Wilder Menu is a side-scrolling cooking and restaurant sim. Forage and hunt across islands, mix ingredients to unlock over 100 dishes, and serve dinner aboard your boat. Hire and train staff, hear their stories, and spruce up your place. Doors open tonight. The menu's up to you.

5409770.title: Salem 1692
5409770.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for players, pure social chaos.

5409780.title: 4th Supplementary
5409780.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, haunted school loop. Evade the lingering spirit, seal the anomalies, and find a way out before it's too late.

5409830.title: Dragon's Keep: Tidy Up the Treasure!
5409830.short_description: Dragon’s Keep is a relaxing first-person treasure sorting game. Organize over 4,000 treasures, repair ancient artifacts, and unlock magical abilities to make sorting faster and more satisfying. Discover the secrets hidden within the dungeon, and find your way out.

5410080.title: The Shrink Gun Game
5410080.short_description: Shrink everything and everyone. Fight your way to downtown, Upgrade and gain new abilities, Stomp the chief of the size police in this 3rd person action roguelite unlike any other

5410100.title: Kill Or Be Killed
5410100.short_description: Kill Or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

5410290.title: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG
5410290.short_description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

5410650.title: Westward: Golden Cicada
5410650.short_description: A turn-based strategy roguelite inspired by Journey to the West. Pick routes, recruit Guardians, swap scriptures, and command every turn by hand. Each wipe burns a life lamp; lose them all and the run ends — but your merit survives into the next reincarnation.

5410670.title: Sunkeeper
5410670.short_description: An idle game about looking after a sun. Click it to make light, fill the sky with stars, and grow the worlds around it from tribes into spacefaring civilizations.

5410700.title: Race For Space
5410700.short_description: Pilot a freighter moving resources from Earth to the Moon that becomes ambushed by rival faction bots. Dodge and destroy hostile drones, collect scrap from destroyed drones, and upgrade your ship between missions. Choose a faction and contribute deliveries to be the strongest faction in the galaxy.

5410790.title: Yashoku: Midnight Snack
5410790.short_description: A hungry boy sneaks to the kitchen for a midnight snack, but "Mom" is in the house. Listen for footsteps and your heartbeat, hide in closets, and reach your snack. A first-person stealth horror game across ten nights in one house that changes, little by little, each night.

5410880.title: Void Frontier
5410880.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

5410940.title: Lobotomy Protocol
5410940.short_description: Lobotomy Protocol is a reaction and logic battle royale set in a grim mid-20th-century psychiatric hospital. Every mistake could lead to a lobotomy. Pass the trials, boost yourself, and inflict side effects on your rivals. Remember what you were never meant to.

5411020.title: Neonovista
5411020.short_description: Build a neon city, add unique landmarks and drive through your creation in this relaxing voxel sandbox. Connect winding roads, slopes and overpasses; switch between third-person and cockpit views, or roam endlessly through city streets, sunset coasts and roads beneath Saturn's rings.

5411030.title: Unframed
5411030.short_description: Rob a bank with your crew, carry the loot without breaking it and watch out for the traitor. Unframed is a physics-based heist game for 3–6 players. You’re all pulling the same job, but one of you wants the entire haul to themselves.

5411080.title: Antmates: Idle Ant Colony
5411080.short_description: An idle ant colony with real numbers, behind glass on your desktop. Plan 25 kinds of rooms and level each one up two ways, feed your ants four kinds of crumbs, balance foragers, diggers and nurses, and chase milestones that multiply your income — cozy to watch, deep to plan.

5411140.title: Oresome - A mining fever dream
5411140.short_description: You helped an old lady across the street? As punishment, the Orc Realm sends you down the mine. There, you dig for ore with your bare fists, secretly stash away ingots and plot your breakout with zombies and other mythical creatures. Solo or co-op, on your monitor or in VR.

5411420.title: Luma Orb
5411420.short_description: Guide your orb through rotating planets and floating islands in this colorful 3D action platformer. Jump across gaps, dodge falling hazards, collect stars, and fight back with power-ups. From fiery worlds to slippery ice, every level brings a new challenge.

5411530.title: Professor - The Genetic Code
5411530.short_description: The first and only strategy game built on real science. Run a 1960s lab, hire the misfits, design experiments, publish or perish, and crack the genetic code. Relaxed turn-based mechanics, the madness of academia, a surfboard by the door. No STEM degree required, but it might take you half-way there.

5411840.title: Wok in Another World
5411840.short_description: A top-down action game meets hands-on restaurant management. A hot-tempered master chef wakes up as a catgirl in another world. Loot monster ingredients in the dungeon with your partners, then run your diner yourself: toss the wok, research recipes, forge gear and open a snack stall underground!

5411930.title: Flurry Fray
5411930.short_description: A chaotic snowball party game for up to 4 on one couch or more online. Pelt rivals, sneak up with a shovel, bury their campfire with a snowblower, torch their snowman with a molotov and steal the toys off their Christmas tree. Bots fill empty spots.

5412110.title: My Cozi Shop: Craft & Sell
5412110.short_description: A cozy first-person toy shop sim. Cast rubber ducks, sew plush toys by hand, then box, tape, ribbon and ship each order out the window. Customers review every parcel, and they notice a crooked eye. Spend what you earn on new toys, a helper and decor.

5412180.title: NO.9 Supermarket Shelter
5412180.short_description: "No. 9 Supermarket Shelter" is an apocalyptic zombie shooter where you can switch between top-down and third-person views: rogue-like missions, base defense tower tasks, massive multiplayer PVP, complete freedom to customize your character and outfit. Play solo or team up online with friends.

5412510.title: Leather Atelier
5412510.short_description: Cut, hand-stitch, dye and stamp wallets and bags from a single hide in a cozy leather-crafting sim. Design your own patterns, then photograph, sell or repair every piece.

5412670.title: 2.3 Billion
5412670.short_description: A mesmerizing active incremental. It starts slow, with a few sparks. Then they're everywhere and you can barely keep up. Every reset, a new perk. A few hours in the flow. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? You'll have to play to find out.

5412820.title: Starfall Chronicles
5412820.short_description: Starfall Chronicles is a retro loot-driven action RPG. Skills cast automatically, so you focus on positioning. Uncover the truth of the Blood Moon over the Starfall Lands. Three classes, artifacts, gear sets and the 100-floor Tongtian Tower await. Buy the base game once. No in-game purchases.

5412850.title: NEON REVIVE
5412850.short_description: Trace the dead tubes of old neon signs and bring them back to life, one glowing stroke at a time. As the lights return, a quiet near-future town slowly wakes up again. No timers, no game over - restore it alone or with up to 4 friends online.

5412870.title: Ten Kingdoms Courier
5412870.short_description: One courier. A land torn by war. Every letter could be your last. A historical visual novel set in 10th-century China, where the Five Dynasties rise and fall and one wrong choice can kill you. Thirty ways to die, four endings. No voice acting.

5412920.title: Roads Taken
5412920.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

5413290.title: Rewind to Coding
5413290.short_description: It’s 2010 and AI isn’t a thing yet. You’re a developer who looks for answers in documentation, web searches and your brain. Build your career, solve problems in JavaScript, pay bills and choose your own path to success.

5413590.title: Holdover – Long Range Sniper Simulator
5413590.short_description: A long-range shooting sim built on real exterior ballistics. You read the wind and wait for the lull between two gusts. After the shot, you see the trajectory in 3D and where the wind carried the bullet. Targets are steel plates and ring targets. No combat, no blood.

5413760.title: Gatefall
5413760.short_description: The tiniest hop can become a mighty leap. Charge your bounce, outsmart each world, and roll through the gate. Don't look down. (Look down.)

5413840.title: MONOMANIA
5413840.short_description: Obsessive 3D games in one package. Journey through a world of magic, keep insects that move like the real thing, catch and evolve monsters, build robots from gacha parts, and let a bullied boy's rage explode. One game. Many worlds. More arriving in Early Access.

5414150.title: Via Libera: Italian Train Driver
5414150.short_description: Drive a regional electric train from the cab on the real Florence–Empoli–Pisa line. Wake it from cold, read Italian signals, take the dispatcher's radio orders and keep 92 timetable services on time through rain, fog and night. Early Access.

5414560.title: Wilderwake
5414560.short_description: A 2D pixel-art action adventure about waking a dead world with a powerful gauntlet. Crush fruit and the ground blooms, little dinosaurs come home, fish ponds and rebuild your camp, explore a vast world full of secrets and fight crystal creatures to free giant machines.

5414830.title: Animetal Menagerie
5414830.short_description: In this roguelike tower defense, explore the remnants of an ancient biological preserve! Build an army of animal-machine hybrids and collect ancient artifacts from across the multiverse to fight against the ancient experiments left to rot, while the station crumbles around you.

5414840.title: Survivors' Hotel
5414840.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

5414920.title: Sort of the Apocalypse
5414920.short_description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

5415010.title: Cobblekin
5415010.short_description: Cobblekin is a survival building game with adorable villagers. Gather resources, build your village, and manage food and production. Research new buildings and improve efficiency, trade resources with allies, and prepare for food shortages and enemy raids.

5415090.title: Abandoned Below
5415090.short_description: Face relentless zombie waves in a decaying underground bunker. Fight solo or in co-op for up to four players. Build barricades, unlock new passages, explore and survive as long as you can.

5415110.title: Monstarium
5415110.short_description: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.

5415150.title: WebCreep.er
5415150.short_description: Get filthy rich... Without leaving the toilet.

5415190.title: Collec
5415190.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

5415210.title: Please Stop Feeding The Frog
5415210.short_description: A first person incremental game about feeding a frog. Kill cute backyard creatures, throw them into his mouth, sell the random garbage he burps out, and buy increasingly ridiculous weapons. The frog keeps getting bigger. What's the worse that could happen?

5415260.title: Chat, we are Cooked
5415260.short_description: Humanity is facing extinction. And naturally, as it always does, it's handling the situation very professionally. Become an asteroid, grow into an unstoppable cosmic disaster, and watch Earth react and respond with missiles, politics, corporate greed, and increasingly questionable breaking news.

5415420.title: HITLER BACKROOMS
5415420.short_description: HITLER BACKROOMS is a co-op game for 1-6 players, where you must make your way through the Backrooms while avoiding the Hitler entity. Explore the Backrooms alone, or with friends! Progress through the levels and try to survive. Will you find the way out? Or will another hidden world await?

5415470.title: The Widow's Shadow
5415470.short_description: Following her husband's death, a widow haunted by her town's whispers enters a twisted reality where she must confront the shadows of her past. A psychological horror visual novel inspired by German Expressionist cinema, featuring three different endings.

5415500.title: Bagbrawl
5415500.short_description: Your bag is your weapon, and every hero’s bag is different. Pack a poison vial, a voodoo doll, or a backpack, discover recipes, craft items, and build combos that win the fight before it starts. Then watch them fight real players, or team up with two friends against weekly bosses

5415730.title: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
5415730.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

5415870.title: Dogletter part 2
5415870.short_description: Don't you know I like you? Return to the same house over and over and expect that one day it will be easier to leave. Also feed the dogs every single night please, and then put them away. And then you can leave.

5415910.title: Towerworks
5415910.short_description: Build your tower floor by floor and watch tenants move in. Grab a mop, fix what’s broken and keep the lifts moving. Hire staff when you can afford it, a manager when you can’t keep up, another tower when you’re ready. It looks cozy but the sim is unforgiving if you overborrow or disaster strikes.

5415950.title: Corruption:Rei
5415950.short_description: Crystals that grant you the power to rule the world, but are powerful enough to destroy you mentally. Dimetrio embarks on a mission to rescue his mother from slavery while fighting to overthrow the Storm King and put an end to his abuse of power.

5416000.title: Unga Rock Pro Gunga
5416000.short_description: Find rocks. Throw rocks. Do tricks. Impress wife. And more. You. Unga. Gunga. Together, go adventure to find rock. Bestest rock. Do awesome rad tricks. Combo combos. Make cave cozy. Wife love.

5416340.title: Fish Fish Pop
5416340.short_description: A slow, cozy match-three under the sea. Swap, pop, and pick a new card every round. Thirty rounds, no timer, and you can't lose. The only question is how few moves you need. Oh, and the sea has secrets.

5416420.title: Gloosh!
5416420.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

5416690.title: River Whisker
5416690.short_description: A little painted riverbank in the corner of your screen, where cats wander over while you work. An angler fishes, the cats get a share, and you can pet each one and give it a name. Nothing to tend, even while you're away.

5416730.title: Game Over: Spring
5416730.short_description: Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and step into the future your choices create. In this first-person narrative adventure spanning 1963 to 2087, a thriving greenhouse can become a lifeless room. Return to pivotal decisions and discover what could have been.

5416760.title: His Magical Gay Awakening
5416760.short_description: Tristan swore he was straight. Then the Arcane Fashion Institute stitched desire into his skin. A gay romance visual novel in a dark academia world of magical fashion: a dangerous rival, a tempting model, a ruthless professor, 3 endings, and choices that matter.

5417260.title: Coven of Thorns
5417260.short_description: Five witches. Five familiars. One Root. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: pick a witch and her familiar, build a deck and climb the Thorn Road through a cursed wood, a bridge of briars and a candle-lit chapel to the Gardener. Every run is a new map.

5417340.title: Prism Phase
5417340.short_description: Prism Phase is a fast-paced arcade dodger where color is your only defense. Switch between six colors to slip through matching hazards, navigate deadly patterns, and survive a gauntlet of increasingly difficult levels. One wrong color means instant death.

5417370.title: Touhou Auto Chess
5417370.short_description: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

5417460.title: Iron Curtain Call
5417460.short_description: A fast cartoon noir FPS and retro boomer shooter set in an absurd alternate 1965. Dash, grapple and parry through a wind up robot army, punch enemies for health and ammo, and bring down theatrical bosses with very undiplomatic weapons. WW3: Third time's the charm!

5417920.title: Escape From Worker
5417920.short_description: Escape From Worker is a third-person action shooter about a worker who refuses to clock in. Battle hordes of zombies, grow stronger, and evolve as you fight to escape the daily grind. Explore dangerous locations and face tougher enemies on your path to freedom. Clock out. Fight back. Evolve.

5417940.title: Swift Cultivation
5417940.short_description: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Set your action queue and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, food gets eaten for you, and every death makes you stronger. Fight, craft — and ascend.

5417980.title: Night Radio
5417980.short_description: Run your late-night radio show, take calls from strange listeners, uncover their secrets, solve puzzles and survive the horrors of the night.

5418280.title: LSR 12x12 Military Tactics
5418280.short_description: You are the Commander, You have the Control. Dictate & Dominate this 12x12 battlefield; Command units with unique movement & abilities, Build structures to block movement and Line Of Sight. Capture/Destroy the enemy Commander, or use tactical precision to reach the other side. Your Move, Commander.

5418340.title: Dead Copies
5418340.short_description: Management is pleased to confirm your placement at the facility. Continued employment is contingent on satisfactory performance. On contract conclusion, a successor is assigned to ensure there is no interruption to operations.

5418630.title: BOO & BONES: Bring the Village Back to Life
5418630.short_description: A relaxing first-person game about sorting bones and bringing a ghost village back to life. Rebuild skeletons, awaken spectral powers and watch your growing community organise its own games, dances and celebrations.

5418790.title: MAZE RUSH
5418790.short_description: Race a glowing ball up 18-floor towers of pitch-black mazes. Ride teleports, dodge spikes, smash through walls and outrun the void across 100+ maps and four party minigames, solo or with up to 4 friends online and in split-screen. Then build your own maps and share them on the Workshop.

5418810.title: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
5418810.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

5419040.title: Swarm Queen: Reincarnated as Mankind's Doom
5419040.short_description: Once an apothecary whose potions saved thousands, Elyse was branded a heretic and cast into slavery by a desperate Church. Falsely accused, she returns not as a savior, but as a ruthless conqueror. Now it's your turn! Evolve the swarm, command the horde, and crush humanity in this macro-free RTS!

5419060.title: KIRA: Composition for One Player
5419060.short_description: A 2D platformer where you explore an enchanted world, collect fragments of lost music, and piece them together into a composition. Help Kira bring music back to a city that has fallen silent.

5419180.title: Hold On Together
5419180.short_description: Hold On Together is a physics-based online co-op game for four players. Team up with friends or other players, enter a random map from the lobby, and tackle chaotic jobs in rounds lasting about five minutes. Keep your team on its feet and the job going!

5419260.title: Duke Saith
5419260.short_description: A fantasy island city-builder where elves, vampires, and minotaurs live together. Meet the Duke's demands or his fall will unleash the Empire's legions, manage each race's Mind gauge to prevent arson and strikes, run train logistics, and grow strong enough to claim independence!

5419330.title: Mini Sweeper
5419330.short_description: Mini Sweeper is a lightweight single and two player game for the Steam Deck and Steam Machine where you must find the bombs and clear the board.

5419650.title: Wheeler Dealer Together
5419650.short_description: Turn used cars into profit! Inspect vehicles, uncover hidden problems, negotiate the best deals, and visit repair shops to get them fixed. Buy low, sell high, and grow your own used car dealership with friends in Wheeler Dealer Together!

5420040.title: HANDBUILT: Korean Construction Simulator
5420040.short_description: Not a construction sim that just fakes it. Every block, every shovel of mortar, every excavator scoop — real Korean job-site work, by hand, with friends. The site manager watches every step. You can wing it, but take it lightly and you'll get collapsed walls and docked pay. Co-op for up to 4.

5420270.title: Orbital Battlefront Eclipse
5420270.short_description: Command massive fleets, build planetary strongholds, and fight for orbital supremacy in Orbital Battlefront Eclipse. Expand your economy, fortify contested worlds, and outmaneuver enemy forces in large-scale real-time space battles.

5420300.title: Sploink
5420300.short_description: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

5420610.title: Blackest Friday
5420610.short_description: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.

5420870.title: Infinite Supermarket
5420870.short_description: Infinite Supermarket is an online co-op survival roguelike with physics-driven chaos, proximity voice chat and character roles. You and up to 7 friends must find the exit - and keep yourselves fed on the way.

5421020.title: Branchout
5421020.short_description: You're a squirrel, and the clock is running. Sprint along branches, scramble up trunks, swing from ropes and glide through towering treetops. Perfect your moves, keep your momentum and shave off every millisecond. Can you beat the record?

5421070.title: Midnight Scoop
5421070.short_description: Two clowns, one ice-cream truck and a specter on your tail. Drive, fire and swap seats through elevated streets and rooftop leaps. Search for supplies on foot, then get both clowns aboard before dawn.

5421150.title: Big Climb
5421150.short_description: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.

5421170.title: A Growing Problem
5421170.short_description: Start smaller than a speck of dust in a houseplant pot. Eat anything smaller than you, grow, and turn everything that hunted you into a snack: crumbs, cats, cars, cities and, eventually, the whole planet.

5421290.title: Ember and Ash: The Cradle
5421290.short_description: A fantasy story game about a long road and the people who walk it with you. Choose your path, fight with timing and skill, grow close to your companions, and face an ending shaped by every choice you made.

5421300.title: Eichmark
5421300.short_description: You walk the land with your column, hire men in the villages and lead them into real-time battles: regiments in blocks, castle walls, ladders, a battering ram. When the story is told, the world keeps going. Houses go to war, and you can found your own. Two peoples, two stories.

5421510.title: 修仙：我有一个按钮
5421510.short_description: 按一按按钮就能掉出天材地宝，绝世神兵，大妖妖丹，攒修为、渡天劫……每件宝物都有独特的机制，每按一次按钮你都会变强！坐化之后参悟天道，转世重来。五位红颜陪你斩妖、结为道侣，或者，被你炼成只听你一人的蛊……

5421520.title: EAT Your Way Out
5421520.short_description: Had enough for today? Grab a spoon and eat your way through living jelly. Sell what you swallow, upgrade your tools, and follow your curiosity toward the exit. There is no rush and nothing to fear. Just you, your spoon, and a strange little journey for the price of a bad vending machine decision.

5421800.title: One More Siege
5421800.short_description: One More Siege is an Incremental Strategy game with massive auto-battling armies. Plan your building placement to counter the enemy, break their ranks and destroy their castle. Every battle earns you Honor, which you can spend to upgrade your army.

5421950.title: Wood You Siege?
5421950.short_description: Lay siege to the forest in a short, chaotic incremental roguelite. Build an absurd arsenal, adapt to powerful random upgrades each run, and expand a massive skill tree to make every siege stronger than the last.

5422000.title: Sidehand
5422000.short_description: A poker roguelite where folding arms you. Every card you fold joins your Sidehand: drop a 4 on your 9 to make a King (9 + 4 = 13), heal, or power up your next hit. Real Texas Hold'em against fourteen opponents across nine tables. New to poker? It teaches you as you play.

5422170.title: Averun
5422170.short_description: Averun is a third-person action RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Explore forests, ruins and crypts, complete quests, fight in real-time combat, and equip your character with different weapons, armor and fighting styles.

5422190.title: Leila's Play
5422190.short_description: A ghost turns the theater upside down right before the first big performance of the young theater group "ShakesPeer". Explore the winding theater, solve puzzles and earn the trust of a diverse group of friends. A heartwarming adventure about friendship, inclusion and neurodiversity.

5422450.title: EMZOMBED 3
5422450.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

5422460.title: Hold To Race
5422460.short_description: Hold to race. Lift to corner. A one-button arcade racer: the car takes the racing line and you own the speed. Time every lift, hold a drift on the throttle and make the pass in short championships, medal time trials and ghost laps. Plays on keyboard, gamepad and Steam Deck.

5422670.title: The Devil's Coming - RUN!
5422670.short_description: Lead a demon army against a world of heroes. Explore a randomized world map, seize resources, and combine monsters to build your legion. Mix roguelike strategy with real-time army battles, commanding your troops and using hero skills to turn the tide.

5422700.title: Ensō: The Ink Spirit
5422700.short_description: Draw circles of wet ink around the yokai to seal them – the rounder the circle, the stronger the seal. A hand-painted arcade roguelite in living sumi-e ink: walk a painted world, free an old painter's scroll, and decide whether his last ensō stays open.

5422720.title: FOSSILE LOADING
5422720.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

5422910.title: 黄泉姫 -Devouring Brimstone-
5422910.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” There is only one condition for returning from the underworld alive: collect the fingers packed inside a cursed little box. What seems like a simple bargain draws the protagonist into a nightmare with no way back. Can I uncover the horrifying truth and escape alive?

5422980.title: Making the Towns
5422980.short_description: It's 1983 and the territories are calling. Pick your wrestler, sign with promotions, and climb the circuit in a turn-based deck-building roguelite where every card you play fights for the crowd. Build your deck, read your opponent, and go for the pin.

5423000.title: Ogrewhelmed
5423000.short_description: Get overwhelmed in this arcade-style arena bullet hell! Enter the arena with nothing but a shield and the loot you find along the way. Dodge, block, and face tank the barrage of projectiles. Will you overcome the ogre onslaught? Or will you become cannon-fodder?

5423040.title: Ashes of the Swarm
5423040.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

5423050.title: St. Grimsby’s Thaumaturgical
5423050.short_description: Hexcare Mutual welcomes you to the night shift at St. Grimsby’s, our condemned emergency room for magical creatures. A 1-8 player co-op comedy horror game about treating patients with instruments that lie and getting the paperwork up the tube before the bell.

5423300.title: 碧海遗城
5423300.short_description: Azure Ruins is a hex-board merge roguelike where shape, count, and rank drive your strategy. Pair Trait Runestones, Relic rules, and special mechanics to stack chains and multipliers. Spend limited Stamina to crack an island city's mechanisms, storm the Royal Vault, and climb global leaderboards.

5423380.title: Last Order
5423380.short_description: A mystery-solving escape-style visual novel set in a café visited by the dead for the last time.

5423410.title: BIG JUICE
5423410.short_description: Grow fruit, crush it with outrageous machines, and sell the juice in this incremental farming game. Automate your harvest, upgrade your blender, and expand to new planets. Play solo or team up in two-player co-op.

5423580.title: Fallow State
5423580.short_description: Build and pilot your own mech in Fallow State, a first-person mech sim set on a retro-futurist frontier world torn by civil war. Master a hands-on cockpit, outsmart enemy forces with radar and electronic warfare, and salvage parts to upgrade your machine. Fight solo or in two-player co-op.

5423890.title: MYTHHUNT
5423890.short_description: Hunt cryptids in a hostile open forest, alone or with up to four players in co-op. Scavenge supplies, hunt wildlife, craft gear and customize firearms. Survive each encounter, reach extraction and bring your hard-earned loot back to the lodge.

5424320.title: Magnet Fishing Together
5424320.short_description: A cozy co-op game about magnet fishing with up to 4 friends. Throw, pull and hope for something good. Sometimes it’s a rusty spoon. Sometimes it’s a scooter you can ride. And sometimes your friend lets go of the rope at the worst possible moment.

5424350.title: Wonderdrift
5424350.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

5424370.title: Sun Knight and the Evil Trial
5424370.short_description: A single-player action RPG blending pixel art with 3D environments. Explore varied lands, master stamina-based combat, and face altar bosses and twelve demon lords. Forge your build, hatch pet companions, and rest by the campfire on a journey through loss and memory.

5424390.title: Hypothesis Sudoku
5424390.short_description: A classic 9×9 Sudoku game built around logical deduction and branching hypotheses. Mark assumptions separately from deductions, manage candidates, backtrack through multiple branches, and progress through ten chapters containing 100,000 puzzles.

5424490.title: Analog Overdrive: Signal Barrage
5424490.short_description: Pilot a lone ship and build a devastating arsenal in this arcade bullet heaven. Combine weapons and support systems, fight for weapon evolutions, and break through enemy swarms. 16-bit pixel art, CRT glow, and a pounding techno soundtrack.

5424520.title: MMA Fictional World Simulator
5424520.short_description: Build a fictional MMA world with realistic careers, rankings, transfers, and title fights. Watch generations of fighters rise and fall, or become an agent, sign prospects, negotiate offers, and guide your clients toward championship glory.

5424560.title: SqueeGee: Window Cleaning Simulator
5424560.short_description: SqueeGee is a cozy window cleaning game where you ride a gondola up towering skyscrapers and make every pane sparkle. Spray, squeegee and scrape away the grime, upgrade your gear, unlock abilities and robot helpers, and spot sightings from the top in a no pressure, no rush world.

5424610.title: Bossinator TD
5424610.short_description: Build towers. Fight beside them. Shape your build with bonus cards between waves. Bossinator TD blends classic tower defense with direct hero control, active and passive skills, and battles against hordes, elites and bosses. Spend your gold on the defense, your hero, or both.

5424640.title: Winston Manor Mystery
5424640.short_description: In 1981, a fire swept through Winston Manor, leaving Lord Edward dead. In the aftermath, Damian, a lawyer who was present that night, seeks you out for help. He hopes your gift can reveal what really happened at the manor.

5424800.title: Idle Pluto
5424800.short_description: "Idle Pluto" is a MU-style idle RPG. Pluto, once a star god jailed in the sun, breaks free and reclaims power across the solar system. Mix four powers freely—no fixed class. Farm gear, upgrade to +9, grow wings. Black Hole Ladder, Space Rifts, Nine-Star events, and rebirth await.

5424830.title: Routine
5424830.short_description: A job simulation game that tests your memory and adaptability.

5424930.title: Swingfall
5424930.short_description: A minimalist physics puzzle about timing. Click a joint to let it go: swing pieces, throw them and drop every last one off the screen. Ten chapters, each with a new rule, 200 levels, and a soundtrack that turns your clicks into music.

5425000.title: Dock 7
5425000.short_description: A cozy shipbreaking game about peeling wrecks apart with a laser, one layer at a time, and bringing home what's left inside. No timers, no debt, no game over. Put the radio on, cut at your own pace, and fill your little dock with the things you find and the people you rescue.

5425020.title: EVILGARD
5425020.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

5425060.title: Kill Loot Heal Repeat
5425060.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon in this turn-based roguelike RPG! Fight monsters, collect loot, and master skills through use. Gather resources, craft weapons, brew potions, and cook food to survive. Manage hunger, overcome deadly encounters, and grow stronger. How deep can you descend?

5425160.title: Herb Z
5425160.short_description: The world is ending. Business is booming! Run your own survival supply shop in a zombie-infested city. Grow herbs, craft essential supplies, stock your shelves, and serve desperate survivors in this retro-inspired survival horror shop simulator!

5425240.title: Lowtown
5425240.short_description: A tiny pixel-art village lives right above your Windows taskbar and grows all on its own — from the first tents to a city of skyscrapers — through days, nights and seasons. You just watch: clicks pass straight through, and the village fades away when your cursor comes near.

5425440.title: No Good Friends
5425440.short_description: “It's a Blade.” Is it? Pass a face-down card across the felt, name it and look your friends in the eye. Every card ends in a verdict for someone. Collect the wrong ones and the table executes you: poison, a knife or the rope. No good friends here. 2–6 players, voice chat.

5425630.title: Linglong Duel
5425630.short_description: A two-player strategy board game of Chinese craftsmanship. Gather precious materials, build workshops, and outwit your rival as the court’s clock advances. Compete for commissions and imperial patrons. Play solo, share a device, or challenge a friend online.

5425650.title: Tending
5425650.short_description: Tending is a cozy game about houseplants. Buy plants, figure out where each one likes to live, water them and watch them grow. Take cuttings to grow even more. Nothing dies, so if a plant is struggling, just move it somewhere better.

5425820.title: Deliveryman in Zhmurino
5425820.short_description: Ring once. Leave the box on the doorstep. Go. And don't look back if something is breathing on the stairs. Seven night shifts as a courier in two buildings that change every night, where the residents somehow know your name. Pixel-art rules horror: some mistakes cost money, others your life.

5425900.title: Marked Deck
5425900.short_description: Blackjack where the numbers explode. Build your own deck, play up to three seats against one dealer, palm cards past the pit and turn every winning hand into a Chips × Mult jackpot. Climb eight casino floors, outplay the Pit Bosses and beat The House.

5426260.title: Quiet Hours
5426260.short_description: It's 2AM, the truck is loud, your friends are louder, and everybody on this street is a light sleeper. Quiet Hours is online co-op for 1–4 players on a night garbage route, where your real voice is noise the street can hear. Microphone strongly recommended.#

5426280.title: CatSitter - Remastered
5426280.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

5426460.title: IRONVOW
5426460.short_description: A gothic pixel-art action platformer with hard, fair boss fights. Parry, riposte and break their guard as you fight down ten cursed depths. After every level, swear a vow: a boon is straight power, a gamble is great power at a real price.

5426730.title: Zombie Mall Defense
5426730.short_description: Zombie Mall Defense is a game in which you defend your malls from ever-bigger zombie hoard waves that come from every direction. Expand the map, build and discover new turrets, find new zombie types and destroy their houses...

5426930.title: Study With Me: Online
5426930.short_description: Your new favorite place to study. Create an avatar and share a cozy multiplayer library with friends while you work on real-life goals. Mix 80+ clothing and footwear options, bring your books and music, then unwind with coffee or chess.

5426960.title: Don't Splat
5426960.short_description: Four blobs. One wall. Someone’s in the wrong place. Stretch, squish and shape-shift with your friends to squeeze through the gaps in Don't Splat!, a co-op game for 1–4 players, online or on one screen. You had a plan. The wall had other ideas.

5427110.title: Lost Bitcoin
5427110.short_description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

5427160.title: Tower Fight
5427160.short_description: Build a defense that outlasts your rivals. Choose heroes, combine towers, runes and relics, and battle recorded rival defenses in roguelike runs across four kingdoms. Every round puts your strategy to the test.

5427200.title: Dice Dice Battles
5427200.short_description: Buy dice, line them up, and watch them play. Move one die and the whole line changes. A roguelike dice battler about finding absurd combos, then testing them against a cursed dungeon or other players in async PvP.

5427280.title: Robo Race
5427280.short_description: Build your own robot from blocks, let AI teach it to walk, and race it. Giraffe, snake, or a shape no one has seen before: the AI finds its own way to run. Take on 8 courses with obstacles, waves, and moving floors in local races or online with up to 4 players.

5427900.title: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall
5427900.short_description: Run the last shop on the road to Kingsfall in this cozy first-person medieval shop sim. Stock your shelves, set your prices and outfit the heroes who pass through. They have names. Out there, they can die for good. What you sell them decides who comes back.

5427950.title: The Reaper -Links Quartz Chapter 2-
5427950.short_description: A 2D action game featuring scythe combat and character-driven dialogue.

5428100.title: Meet The LeaderSheep
5428100.short_description: Thousands of sheep. One pen. Grab up to 3 friends who are no help at all and get the flock home before dark. They’ll panic over nothing and happily follow each other off a cliff. So will the sheep. Bring in the most and you’re the LeaderSheep. Nobody said you’d be a good one.

5428130.title: Klocky
5428130.short_description: The world moves too fast. Fit gears under the lamp and hear your machine’s first tick. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth drives the next. Follow hand-drawn plans and discover mechanical history and ingenuity through engraving-style illustrated books.

5428300.title: MOI
5428300.short_description: After an embarrassing video, Mimp tries a makeover that promises a perfect face and effortless confidence. It also makes caring feel unnecessary. A short psychological horror visual novel about shame, appearance, and deciding what you can afford to lose.

5428430.title: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
5428430.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

5428500.title: Demiurges: Land of Strife
5428500.short_description: A survivor-like action game: You start as a mortal and randomly obtain fragments from different factions in combat. Collect a complete set to ascend into a brand-new form—new model, more skill slots, and a deeper skill library—leading to a completely different combat path.

5428520.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TAXES
5428520.short_description: A satirical incremental game where your mouse is the tax ring. Anyone inside it pays. Invent absurd taxes, chase fleeing billionaires and get re-elected. Then tax penguins, microbes, aliens and ghosts. They will thank you.

5428740.title: Supervite
5428740.short_description: Supervite is a HIGH-SPEED momentum-driven 2D-platformer with PHYSICS-BASED movement ; reach the checkpoints before the timer runs out, or race against others in online multiplayer tracks

5428750.title: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!
5428750.short_description: Threads & Things is a cozy organizing simulator where you return over 4000 scattered craft supplies to their proper places in a cluttered craft store. Sort yarn, fabrics, threads, buttons, embroidery hoops and more, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized craft store.

5428900.title: A Game About Pulling A Rope
5428900.short_description: A rope comes flying out of the well in your yard. Pull it. Things far too big for a well squeeze out: carts, church bells, somebody's house. Sell them, buy a winch, buy a horse, and keep pulling to find out what is tied to the other end.

5429070.title: RIP-OFF
5429070.short_description: Buy booster packs from Panda, a shady raccoon dealer, and slice them open with one swipe of a knife. Collect, stack, sell and archive 280 pixel-art cards across four series, then upgrade your table until the packs open themselves.

5429180.title: Eggstra Tidy
5429180.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Welcome a crew of helper bunnies, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

5429260.title: Last Truck Out
5429260.short_description: Ride in with up to 4 friends, loot a zombie-infested town to hit the cash quota, and get back to the truck before the horde takes the zone. Proximity voice, monsters that make everyone run, and a truck that will not wait forever.

5429440.title: Feed the Front
5429440.short_description: Build the factories that supply a planetary war. In this sci-fi RTS, mines, warehouses and guns launch cargo to one another across a small world. Manufacture shells, reroute deliveries and keep your artillery firing as rival commanders and alien swarms close in.

5429460.title: Miredrift
5429460.short_description: A year after a bio-engineered organism drowned the world in mutation, an infected ex-captain steers his battered boat into a flooded, hand-painted swamp to find his lost family. Explore, scavenge fuel, and fight the twisted creatures of the mire, before the infection takes you too.

5429590.title: Potato Factory
5429590.short_description: Stranded on Mars with a storm closing in, you need money for a rocket. Grow potatoes, sell your first batch of chips, and put your earnings into a bigger production line. Then the mutant potatoes arrive, right on schedule. What could you sell them for?

5429850.title: Write With Shion: Lo-Fi Focus
5429850.short_description: Work, study and write a sensual story with her, one line for every minute of focus. A focus timer, relaxing lo-fi and Shion on the other end of the call: shy, playful and writing a brand new story with you. Play your way, pure focus or with chats.

5429930.title: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim
5429930.short_description: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.

5429960.title: FRENCH DREAM
5429960.short_description: A completely stupid game that demands you be extremely good. A top-down die & retry set in France in the middle of a presidential election: one bullet and you're dead, one bullet and so are they. Baguette, wine bottle, FAMAS: anything lying around is a weapon.

5430020.title: Elyrion - The Secret Book
5430020.short_description: Set in the world of Elyrion, this adventure takes place just before the events of the upcoming Rise of the Raven. Elyrion – The Secret Book is a 2D stylized RPG that offers not only main and side quests, but a wide range of challenges and discoveries for players to explore.

5430070.title: Janusz Survivors - Wesele Apokalipsy
5430070.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite set at a Polish wedding gone wrong. As Janusz, the bride's uncle, you grab dancing guests and spin them around you as weapons, drink for power without passing out at 3.0 promille, and survive six halls and six bosses until dawn.

5430170.title: Hay In A Needle Stack Simulator
5430170.short_description: Finding a needle in a haystack is hard. So we made the opposite. Dig through a mountain of needles to find one piece of hay. Upgrade your gloves, tools, magnets and increasingly ridiculous machinery in this absurd first-person simulator.

5430350.title: Grid & Loot
5430350.short_description: Grid & Loot is a casual turn-based RPG with unique gameplay: one click resolves combat on a 3x3 grid. Pick your class, explore areas, collect loot, forge legendary gear and survive traps, elites and bosses.

5430390.title: Brawliens
5430390.short_description: Punch your friends off a flying saucer. Sneak snacks past a sleeping cat. Race karts across a giant kitchen. Brawliens is a first-person party game for 2–8 players online: 43 minigames, sneaky gadgets and one FINAL BRAWL where even the leader can lose.

5430800.title: FreightLines
5430800.short_description: Build a freight empire in a living miniature world. Link towns by road, rail, sea and air, and watch every delivery shift the market. Play Cozy to unwind, or go Simulation for loans, seasons and rival buyouts.

5430830.title: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars
5430830.short_description: General L. has vanished, Agent, and only YOU can find him. A dapper 1-bit roguelite shmup. Pick from 20+ ships, keep your energy in check, mod your ship mid-run and dive through black holes into ever-deeper space.

5431050.title: Chain Detonator
5431050.short_description: Set mines, lure robots into your trap and trigger explosive chain reactions—then escape the blast. A top-down action-puzzle game with 50 campaign levels, solo challenges, local PvP for 2–4 players and online PvP for up to 16 on dedicated servers.

5431300.title: Undead Showdown
5431300.short_description: 4v4v4v4 zombie survival. Hold your stronghold through ten rounds, gear up from a shared bank, and risk it at the casino. Your first eligible survival death gives you one chance in Limbo. Then the gates open: last squad standing wins.

5431650.title: Ink Left
5431650.short_description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

5431660.title: I, Hurricane
5431660.short_description: You are the hurricane. Spawn storms across five seas, steer them toward the coast and push them toward 300 mph while humanity promises to act “by 2050.” Or switch sides and defend it: run the hurricane hunters’ base, fly into the eye, forecast the track and issue the warnings.

5431740.title: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
5431740.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

5431780.title: EGO DESCENT
5431780.short_description: A 3D action RPG about a machine built to fight, descending a hundred floors underground. Take the weapons and parts your enemies wore, rebuild your head, body, arms and legs, and get past the GUARDIAN of each sector to see what lies behind your orders. Online co-op. 10 languages.

5431790.title: Welcome to Fox Cafe
5431790.short_description: Join Miru, a little fox, in a forest cafe. Dodge enemy swarms and combine weapons and abilities in Continuous Survival or Rounds + Shop. After the main story, gather ingredients, make tea and snacks, and serve guests. A prequel to the Fox Cafe comic.

5432040.title: FPS ABILITY TEST
5432040.short_description: Shoot, throw, type, hide, close pop-ups. A ten-question exam where “FPS” means something new every time: sniping, grenade lineups, unarmed battle royale, forced-perspective puzzles. Your score decides what comes after. Finish the exam to unlock the Retake, a one-life roguelike 30 floors deep.

5432080.title: Saucer Rumble Showdown
5432080.short_description: Take control of your own flying saucer in this chaotic, physics-based arena party game! Ram opponents, dodge environmental hazards, and fight to be the last UFO flying. Battle in local multiplayer with CPU opponents or challenge players online!

5432190.title: Web Scaping
5432190.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

5432430.title: The Last Reel
5432430.short_description: Escape a Japanese nightmare in this 2D rubber-hose horror adventure. Play as a protagonist living with depression, manage his sanity, solve puzzles, and survive monstrous encounters, deadly traps, car chases, and airplane pursuits.

5432460.title: Meltwork
5432460.short_description: Melt a snow-buried world with fire, rescue villagers trapped in ice, and build a village where spirits mine and fairies haul for you.

5433010.title: Rest in Order: Cozy Tomb Tidy Up
5433010.short_description: A cozy 3D tidying game inside a Pharaoh's burial chamber. Restore the sarcophagi, line up the canopic jars and put every sacred treasure back in its place. Prefer chills? Switch on Spooky Mode and feel the dead watching.

5433240.title: Unknown Depths
5433240.short_description: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.

5433360.title: Artificial Intrusion
5433360.short_description: A retro CRT tower defense where rogue AI pixels attack the internet. Place firewalls, CAPTCHAs and traps to survive 20 waves across 10 network nodes, then spend Packets on a huge radial skill tree to harden the web for the next run.

5433410.title: Godyssey
5433410.short_description: A modern take on the god game. Cast down by the other gods, all you have is your faithful creature, two bickering advisors and a world of people who have never heard of you. Win them over with miracles or terror, spread your influence, and find out what kind of god you are. Then take your revenge.

5433450.title: Christmasing Around
5433450.short_description: 2-8 players running around as elves to help Santa delivery gifts while getting their hands dirty. Repair reindeers, decorate sleigh, face pirates... and form a music band while everything is on fire. Hey! Christmasing Around!!!

5433480.title: The Lords Next Door
5433480.short_description: When 10 retired lords share a valley, nobody raids at 3 AM—everyone just wants the quiet life. Build a storybook town and hire heroes of 18 races—orcs, undead, dragons—to help you farm, fish, and cook. Visit 9 real-player neighbors to trade gifts, and stand together when monsters attack!

5433750.title: Tatakabu-Do: Hammer and Helmet
5433750.short_description: A simple, fast-paced versus party game starring Fang the bunny and friends. Bonk with a hammer or block with a helmet. One hit wins a round. First to five wins a match. Play side by side on one PC, or online. There's a story mode and CPU battles for solo players.

5433790.title: Sword & Soil
5433790.short_description: A top-down pixel action RPG in the spirit of Dragon Warrior and NES Zelda. Farm, fish and cook, then take what you grew into real-time fights. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns. All of Chapter One is in the free demo.

5433930.title: Christmas VHS Store Tidy Up
5433930.short_description: Tidy a neon-lit ’90s VHS rental shop on a snowy Christmas night. Wipe down dirty sleeves, match each tape to its labelled slot, and unwind to Christmas lo-fi on your own or with a Steam friend.

5433970.title: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
5433970.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

5434320.title: Heartland
5434320.short_description: Heartland is a meditative strategy puzzle where you shape the landscapes of new worlds by placing hexagonal tiles. As you build, your worlds come to life and react to the events that unfold. Villages grow into cities, and castles rise into kingdoms, each with its own inhabitants and chronicles.

5434470.title: Wall Over
5434470.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

5434510.title: In Orbita
5434510.short_description: At 47, Vincenzo gets sucked into the 80s cartoons of his childhood... and wakes up as an 8-year-old. A comedy point & click: think like a grown-up, talk like a kid, and try to say the things that really matter.

5434690.title: How Smart Are You
5434690.short_description: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

5434710.title: Bear in Super Action Adventure
5434710.short_description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up game with an upgrade shop. Fly a bear with a jetpack through swarms of bees and flying eggs, dodge their bullets, grab the gold they drop and unleash Power Shot and Blast when it gets crowded. Then upgrade and go after the green rabbit who is behind it all.

5434960.title: Kirameki Quiz: Stargazer Hill Diary
5434960.short_description: A quiz game with a dating-sim twist. Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines and win their hearts in trivia duels. Over 5,000 English questions across 21 genres.

5435040.title: Mine Rogue
5435040.short_description: Minesweeper logic meets roguelike builds. Dig every safe tile, place soil tiles and attach dozens of Marks, from Dynamite to Frogs and Planets, then watch a single click set off a chain across the board. Survive a Hazard every third floor on the way down to the 24th floor.

5435110.title: $1 Pizza Slice
5435110.short_description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

5435180.title: Hopworth the Wizard
5435180.short_description: Hopworth the Wizard is a challenging, colourful 2.5D platformer. A Gargoyle King has taken over Hopworth's Wizard tower while he was off questing. Journey home through forests, hills and mountain passes, leap the King's enchanted boulders and climb the tower to serve its eviction notice.

5435230.title: Secret Daifugo
5435230.short_description: An online-compatible President where "secret effects" hidden in the cards decide victory or defeat. Each player chooses two effects and assigns them to a card number that only they know. Deduce the effects set by the other players and gain the advantage in the game.

5435360.title: Candy Factory
5435360.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

5435420.title: Treasured Carpets
5435420.short_description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

5435510.title: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
5435510.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

5435630.title: Hazelton Hollow
5435630.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

5435850.title: EDGE-FI
5435850.short_description: Don’t rush to figure out what’s going on in a place the world has discarded, where dim neon flickers through the haze. Discover how the devices around you work, and lose yourself in atmospheric music as you bring the city back to life. So, when progress moves on without us, where do we belong?

5436050.title: Quest For Stoken
5436050.short_description: A gloriously weird skateboarding sword platformer. Grind rails through ancient Greece, outer space and the depths of Atlantis, slash your way past frogs, aliens and killer bees, and battle bosses that make no sense at all, all to collect the mysterious Stoken.

5436180.title: Sloppy Warfare
5436180.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

5436190.title: バックドロッパーいずな
5436190.short_description: How strong can you get with nothing but suplexes? At first, you can only throw one enemy. Keep upgrading, and you'll be able to lift heavier foes and slam entire crowds at once. An incremental game where you keep choosing who to throw next.

5436260.title: Firefly
5436260.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op action roguelite for 1-4 players. A firefly is your only light in the caves. Stay close to it, or venture into the dark for better rewards. Upgrade your weapons as you slay monsters and level up.

5436280.title: Vanguard Armada
5436280.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

5436360.title: BitLoaf
5436360.short_description: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

5436410.title: Pegoda
5436410.short_description: Climb a haunted Japanese Pagoda in this pachinko roguelite. Build a bag of enchanted balls, fuse powerful evolutions, and place pegs mid-shot to turn a falling ball into a huge combo. Unlock new characters and defeat the guardians standing between you and the Emperor.

5436460.title: Lawful Evil
5436460.short_description: An online 2-6 player courtroom party game where you and your friends become chaotic lawyers, arguing before an AI cast that runs locally on your PC. Talk to clients, build your case, then take on your friends in court. Will you be the lawyer everyone calls, or the one they regret calling?

5437000.title: Ravel: Golden Thread
5437000.short_description: A Viking puzzle saga about untangling. Read the weave, pull only what lies on top and free the living Golden Thread across eight Norse worlds and 200+ handcrafted levels, with a Mastery Knot to close every chapter and 3 Daily Knots every day.

5437240.title: Spells of Arcanetheria
5437240.short_description: A dark 16-bit roguelite where magic is everything. Find lost spells, master them, then forge your own from soul shards, Aether and relics: one roll, no recipes, yours forever. When death comes, roll the d20. When your hero falls for good, their spells live on for the next adventurer.

5437280.title: Crack & Stack
5437280.short_description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

5437620.title: Video Game Store: Tidy Up
5437620.short_description: Sort 3,000 scattered pieces in a cozy retro video game store. Clean discs and manuals, rebuild 1,000 games and stock the shelves. Serve customers, pack orders, unlock helpful upgrades and hire staff to turn complete chaos into a thriving shop.

5437690.title: Sanctuary
5437690.short_description: Find salvation within the overgrown depths of the forgotten in Sanctuary, an atmospheric 2.5D adventure. Uncover lost secrets, overcome the dark and seek out a moment of respite amongst the thorns as you fight to carve out a place of peace in a world caught between ruin and rebirth.

5438240.title: Sword Duel 2: Medieval War
5438240.short_description: A third-person medieval action RPG with massive 1000 vs 1000 battles. Fight shoulder to shoulder with your allies using swords, shields and bows, loot armor and weapons, and survive the chaos of a physics-driven battlefield.

5438430.title: Horizon of Steel
5438430.short_description: Horizon of Steel is an idle ARPG. Instead of controlling the fights, you build your character's skills, equipment and strategies, then send it into combat to farm or level. The fights are drawn in ASCII with dynamic lighting, and a replay shows one exactly as it happened.

5438480.title: Resonance Shift
5438480.short_description: Resonance Shift is a pixel-art action roguelite that blends survivors-like combat with strategic party management. Use the tag system to switch between party members, chain their skills to create powerful synergies, and choose the right upgrade cards to defeat relentless waves of enemies!

5438690.title: Oh Baby Blocks
5438690.short_description: A cozy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

5439380.title: Crate Escape: Program & Deliver
5439380.short_description: Program your warehouse robot in secret, lock in, and watch every robot run its program at once. Shoves, conveyor belts and lasers will test the best plan. Race, deliver parcels, knock rivals out or capture flags, against the AI, on one screen or online. Same rules as the Crate Escape board game.

5439520.title: The Last Homecoming
5439520.short_description: A top-down mystery horror game rooted in Korean folk beliefs. Return to your childhood village after twenty years. Explore by lantern light, solve puzzles, and escape pursuit as buried memories surface. This homecoming may be your last.

5439530.title: Blitz: Last Stand
5439530.short_description: A top-down roguelite horde shooter. Hold one perimeter for 100 waves as one of six operators, evolve 11 weapons into Mythics and break ten bosses. A new upgrade every second level, a commander every tenth wave. Black Site ECHO-7 fell in eleven minutes. Nobody mentioned extraction.

5439870.title: TANK BRAWL ROYALE ARENA
5439870.short_description: Take command of powerful tanks in a fast-paced single-player arcade combat game. Fight across colorful arenas, master different battle modes, earn rewards, upgrade your tank, and unlock stronger machines as you progress.

5440000.title: DeckFarm
5440000.short_description: DeckFarm is a cozy card-stacking farming & management strategy game. Stack cards to plow, plant crops, and process raw ingredients into regional recipes. Expand your farm, satisfy trade contracts across global scenarios, and automate production chains before time runs out!

5440150.title: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～
5440150.short_description: Explore Edo, gather testimony and evidence, and expose lies that could rewrite history. Join high school student Ren and his time-repair companion Chrono in a historical mystery adventure. Connect clues and solve puzzles to protect the meeting between Katsu Kaishu and Saigo Takamori.

5440380.title: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
5440380.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

5440570.title: Domino Tinkerer
5440570.short_description: Become a domino tinkerer in a physics-based sandbox! Fly through rooms, deploy gadgets like cannons and funnels, and trigger chain reactions to clear every checkpoint. Build the ultimate domino machine solo or team up with up to 4 friends online!

5440710.title: Lord of the Mountain
5440710.short_description: Lead your dwarven clan back into the mountain the dragons took. Build a stronghold in the dark and filter the spore-filled air to claim ground. Then hold the line as the dragon sends its fungus-infected hordes against you. A dwarven survival RTS with pause.

5440760.title: Tall Tales Inn
5440760.short_description: A cosy idle inn that grows floor by floor up the side of your desktop. Your guests furnish their rooms from the storeroom you stock, set off on quests and come home with loot and tall tales.

5440770.title: Broken Contract
5440770.short_description: An online co-op horror game built around mechanics of contracts and betrayal. Before each shift, every player signs a contract known only to them, while the company’s objectives remain the same for everyone. You and your friends decide for yourselves what rules to play by.

5440830.title: Moorlet
5440830.short_description: Build a tiny island, place the curses that threaten it, and defend your village when night falls. Connect terrain tiles, gather resources and raise your defenses in a compact island builder where every new piece of land brings another decision.

5440850.title: Motor Park Architect
5440850.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

5441000.title: Alchemill: A Witch's Workshop
5441000.short_description: Alchemill is a cosy falling-sand brewing game. Brew what villagers need by hand in a living cauldron, gather from the land, mend a ruined house, and become a witch in earnest.

5441030.title: Sort The Plushie Store
5441030.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

5441580.title: CTRL Chaos
5441580.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

5441630.title: Double Empty Device
5441630.short_description: The Double Empty Device will play a note for you to play back. It may not be in the same position or appearance as when it originally played. Play the one that originally played in its new position or appearance. Continue to do so for as long a song as your skills of perception and memory permit.

5441650.title: Ashen Marches
5441650.short_description: Ashen Marches is a classic fantasy tabletop RPG, stripped down to the fights and character building.

5441990.title: Floor Show
5441990.short_description: A turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. You are the contestant. Push rivals into spikes, lava and barrels to earn hype, your XP. Take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

5442050.title: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition
5442050.short_description: Winter magic is in the cards! Bundle up for a Solitaire adventure across countless crafted levels and restore a glittering kingdom of ice and frost. Stand up to a scheming snowman, outrun a quick-footed hare and grab your mallet and pick to crack thick pack ice.

5442080.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
5442080.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business.
