Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

5442140.title: Hurlyburly
5442140.short_description: Throw swords. Fall. Pick a card. Come back meaner. Hurlyburly is a top-down party brawler for 2–8 players where dying is how you upgrade and 150+ stacking cards turn every match into chaos.

5442290.title: Gears & Glory
5442290.short_description: Build your battle machine in a steampunk autobattler of gears, steam, and strategy. Buy weapons and components, arrange them on your grid, and combine their effects. Put your engineering to the test as your machine fights automatically.

5442350.title: Spiral Scramble
5442350.short_description: A co-op obstacle course for you and your friends. Work your way around a spiral of creatures, traps and hazards to reach the center together. One touch knocks you down, and only a teammate can pick you back up. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

5442580.title: Dispatch Loop
5442580.short_description: A pixel-art loop roguelite about a bike courier. Place cards to build your route, chain combos, survive the city's worst customers and upgrade your home between contracts. The deliveries never stop. Neither do the problems.

5442760.title: UB Mash 3
5442760.short_description: Make number go up! A cozy incremental match 3 game.

5442810.title: Lianur: Shadows of the Divine
5442810.short_description: A fully voiced fantasy kinetic novel about freedom, loyalty, and the cost of peace. Follow Tharen and his companions through a world caught between demons and beings of light, brought to life with anime artwork and an unfolding, linear story.

5443240.title: Loot & Scoot
5443240.short_description: Hide-and-seek tag where each thief is roped to a partner. Grab raining coins and stuff them into the Safehouse before the police sends you all to jail. Caught? Use drones and traps to knock police off the map and break out. Play with up to 10 friends online with proximity voice chat!

5443450.title: Spektr
5443450.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

5443560.title: City Safety
5443560.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

5443600.title: Sphere of Influence
5443600.short_description: Shape a tiny living planet. Tens of thousands of creatures follow simple rules of attraction and repulsion on a globe you can paint warm or cold, and every tweak to the climate or the species grid ripples through the whole ecosystem. A quiet, endlessly watchable sandbox with no fail state.

5443800.title: T.S.K Commander
5443800.short_description: Lead one of three factions in T.S.K Commander, tactical real-time strategy where time is the only resource. Capture sectors with infantry, take their factories and command tanks, mechs, helicopters, drones and warships – in a voiced 30-mission campaign, skirmish or online 1v1 and 2v2.

5443930.title: Idle Dojo
5443930.short_description: A cozy idle RPG starring a pink-haired swordmaiden who fights and grows on autopilot. Befriend a cast of charming NPC girls, collect gorgeous CG artwork, defeat floor guardians and climb ever-higher floors.

5443940.title: Milo's Day Shift
5443940.short_description: Your new coworker lives in a pop-up diorama on your desktop. Milo clocks in, battles slimes and skeletons room by room, and trudges home to nap by the campfire when he's pooped. Spend his loot to forge better swords and grow a cozy little town, or just let him work.

5443950.title: Ore Express
5443950.short_description: Build chaotic, physics-powered factories. Chop trees and mine ore, then catch the avalanche with belts, ramps, fans, pistons and cranes, smelt and craft it into goods, and fill the trucks. Every item is a real physical object, so every contraption is gloriously unpredictable.

5444060.title: Well Up
5444060.short_description: You wake at the bottom of an old well with only a worn rope leading up. Reach hand over hand, swing to keep your balance and climb inch by inch. Wet rope, slick moss, frayed strands and thorns stand in your way, and one slip can drop you all the way down. Ready to see the sun again?

5444080.title: SWIFTNESS
5444080.short_description: This game is all about speed and not getting eaten by the spreading corruption.

5444180.title: 罪人铁匠铺
5444180.short_description: 在王国里经营一家铁匠铺，将罪人与怪物统统打造成宝剑！每次打造有几率让装备身价暴涨，也有几率直接破碎，一无所有。你打造的装备还能进一步提升你的铸造效率，数十种套装效果，海量词条，熔炉系统……只等你来！

5444680.title: Catgirl Fantasy: Oath of the Night Sky
5444680.short_description: A classic turn-based RPG with feline companions. Explore a pixel-art world, uncover the red moon's curse, and plan each move in command-based battles. Grow stronger with every weapon and spell you use, follow keywords from conversations, and discover hidden dungeons.

5444790.title: Cubies
5444790.short_description: Find and collect Cubies in this cube-sized 3D puzzle-platformer!

5444870.title: LiarGame : Canvas
5444870.short_description: Spot the liar in this online drawing party game for 3–8 players! Draw clues if you know the secret word, or bluff with your drawings if you're the liar. Decide who to trust amid suspicious sketches and convincing excuses. Customize your character and enjoy hilarious mind games with friends!

5445140.title: Playfolk Hockey 27
5445140.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

5445180.title: Mochi Cats
5445180.short_description: Rotate and drop pairs of squishy cats, merge matching cats into bigger chonks, and keep grumpy cats apart in this cozy physics puzzle. Chase high scores, unlock new looks, or compete in Battle Mode with friends and players online.

5445260.title: Who's the Biggest Degen?
5445260.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

5445470.title: Primal Nights
5445470.short_description: You wake up in empty facility, blood on the floor, and dinosaurs hunting you down, with a green Primal Fog engulfing the facility, trapping you there. Rescue is five nights away. Use your security measures to fend off the bloodthirsty ancient predators and survive until help arrives.

5445570.title: The Hardest Game Ever
5445570.short_description: The Hardest Game Ever is a brutally difficult 2d platformer game, featuring constant death, a variety of different challenging puzzles, and unique, obstacles with each stage, ranging from simple jumps turned into something very different to obstacles that even platformer veterans would struggle with

5445630.title: The Washing Case
5445630.short_description: Relax and wash years of grime off antique objects, layer by layer, until they shine. Along the way, look for the marks hidden under the dirt: together they form a code that opens the next room. The further you go, the bigger the objects get – from pocket watches to giant monuments.

5445800.title: Jingle Janitor
5445800.short_description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

5445830.title: Residential Phenomena Hotline
5445830.short_description: You're the night agent at a paranormal support hotline service. Callers contact you when something goes wrong in their homes and send photos, videos, and voice notes. Question them, search the company files, find what doesn't belong, and tell them what to do. Get it wrong, and face the consequences.

5446180.title: MOMOKOO MERGE
5446180.short_description: Drop food, hatch momokoos, and merge matching ones to expel them from the gut. Six momokoos, six expel effects — see what's coming next and choose where it lands. No account needed, and one global leaderboard for every player.

5446200.title: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum
5446200.short_description: A first-person petal-gathering game: a million flowers, hundreds of oversized bees and one vacuum. Knock petals loose with your fists, a knife and a bat, vacuum them up, and send the bees out to help. Sell the haul, upgrade your tools and bees, and climb the valley one color at a time.

5446270.title: That's a lot of Zombies
5446270.short_description: Rain hell from an AC-130 as millions of zombies climb over each other to reach your squad’s rooftop. Deploy sentry guns, flamethrowers and claymores before each night. Call in A-10s, B-52s and every bit of firepower you can get. Hold the roof until the rescue helicopter lands.

5446450.title: Crop Guardian
5446450.short_description: Farm by day. Fight by night. Grow your farm, explore dungeons in search of rare seeds, ore, and equipment, and strengthen your defenses to protect your harvest from the creatures of darkness. A pixel art adventure where every seed counts and every night is a challenge.

5446500.title: Hook & Loot
5446500.short_description: Hook & Loot is a relaxing single-player magnet fishing game. Clear an autumn lake of 1,458 metal objects. Haul in scrap and rare finds, bring your catches to the scrapyard, and upgrade your gear.

5446560.title: Tree Wreckers
5446560.short_description: Best with friends. A 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about taking trees down without wrecking what's under them. Climb it, top it, rope the limbs down piece by piece, or notch it and yell TIMBER. Every job ends on an itemized invoice with a name next to each piece of damage.

5446570.title: JAILPOT
5446570.short_description: Inmate 4417. Forty years. Nobody here has ever been released. In here money is cigarettes: scratch, roll, spin and bet your way across nine prison gambling tables, pay every boss his cut before roll call, keep your family's rent paid, and gamble your way out.

5446660.title: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
5446660.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

5446730.title: Willow Lake Food Park
5446730.short_description: Welcome to Willow Lake Food Park! Manage your food truck in this tiny cozy, casual sim! Unlock new trucks, experiment with your recipes, and maximize the happiness of your customers to get that sweet, sweet cash!

5446810.title: Meowside: Desktop Cats
5446810.short_description: Adorable pixel cats live on your screen. Watch them eat, nap, and wander through daily routines. Pet them or play with a cat wand, and enjoy their company every day.

5446860.title: Eyelord Returns
5446860.short_description: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

5446870.title: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
5446870.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

5447050.title: MimiCreate
5447050.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

5447150.title: Island Tycoon
5447150.short_description: Build your tropical island empire in Island Tycoon! Transport cargo, fly planes, explore oceans, build cities, and play with up to 4 friends.

5447280.title: SPATHA
5447280.short_description: A side-scrolling shooter flown from the cockpit. Read what's ahead through the canopy, the terrain in the side view and the lanes in the top view — all three on screen at once. Harvest magic stones from alien beasts, buy the weapons you want, and dive into seven worlds the Ordo turned into nests.

5447370.title: Anomaly Core: Incident
5447370.short_description: Your first task is to investigate an incident in one of the "Anomaly Core" laboratories and retrieve the important documents. Explore the laboratory and complete the task.

5448040.title: Still Awake
5448040.short_description: Still Awake is a psychological horror game that puts you inside the terrifying experience of sleep paralysis, where you're trapped between sleep and reality.

5448090.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
5448090.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

5448100.title: Anomaly Watch: Starship
5448100.short_description: You are the night operator of a starship. Watch the cameras in the ship's compartments, spot what has changed and report it before the anomalies take over the ship.

5448110.title: Anomaly Watch: Loony Park
5448110.short_description: The amusement park is closed for the night, but you are still watching it. Check the cameras, find what has changed among the rides and shops, and report it before the night is over.

5448120.title: Anomaly Watch: Ward 13
5448120.short_description: You work the night shift in an old hospital. Watch the cameras in the halls and wards, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies get out of hand.

5448140.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
5448140.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

5448150.title: Anomaly Watch: Polar Station
5448150.short_description: You work a night shift at a polar station. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

5448160.title: Anomaly Watch: Catacombs
5448160.short_description: You watch the catacombs through security cameras. Check the tunnels and chambers, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

5448180.title: Anomaly Watch: Mine
5448180.short_description: You watch an old mine through security cameras. Check the tunnels and the work areas, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

5448190.title: Anomaly Watch: Rainy Night
5448190.short_description: A rainy night, an empty house and a row of security cameras. Watch the rooms, notice what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

5448210.title: Anomaly Watch: Castle
5448210.short_description: You are the night watch of an old castle. Look through the cameras in its halls and cellars, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies take the castle.

5448440.title: Neverwake
5448440.short_description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

5448720.title: Dungeon Stage
5448720.short_description: Play DND in Dungeon Stage, a solo RPG with an AI dungeon master. Explore towns, talk to NPCs, find quests, browse shops, and fight tactical battles. Shape a story of adventure, intrigue, or slice of life on an illustrated fantasy stage.

5448820.title: Circuit Valley
5448820.short_description: Grow a thriving valley with a crew of little robots. Play as Pip to tend crops and build workshops, then put your helpers to work hauling harvests and keeping production moving. Turn a handful of apples into a place that hums with life.

5448900.title: BlobBobbing
5448900.short_description: Drag squishy gummy blobs onto their twins and watch them fuse into rarer, shinier blobs. A cozy merge idler where every blob wobbles, stretches and bounces like real jelly, and your nest keeps bobbing and earning while you're away.

5448910.title: Godsever
5448910.short_description: Long ago, humanity rose against the gods - and learned they could bleed. Hunt ten colossal gods alone or with up to two friends as the last of the Order: bind them, bleed them, and sever them, piece by piece. Learn every god, survive its cataclysm, and climb to Rank III.

5449090.title: Chip Factory Simulator
5449090.short_description: Build and run your own semiconductor factory in first person. Process wafers, operate machines, connect conveyor lines, automate production, and ship advanced chips as your factory grows.

5449540.title: The Veil Express
5449540.short_description: A cosy management game on a hidden magical train, where you build rooms and workshops for goblins, witches, fairies, ghosts and vampires. Keep the Five Houses happy and spend the Veil wisely: the same magic that powers your train and keeps it hidden.

5449650.title: Gold Below
5449650.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

5449780.title: Crown of Heartbeats
5449780.short_description: A rhythm roguelike love story in three acts. First, a hero fights through four cursed realms to reach the Elf Queen, who is sure he's coming to kill her. Then comes happily ever after, which turns out to be scarier than any dragon. And then it's her turn to pick up the sword.

5449860.title: DUNSPIN
5449860.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

5449870.title: Soul Crypt
5449870.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

5450110.title: Ruckus Squad
5450110.short_description: A low-poly fantasy battle royale blending melee and ranged combat. Explore with your squad, loot weapons and gear, and master dodges, parries, and weapon skills. Adapt to a shrinking safe zone and fight to be the last team standing.

5450140.title: Stock Car Classics: Championship Season
5450140.short_description: Race door to door in a throwback stock car racing experience! Battle hard-fighting opponents, build rivalries, and chase the championship across asphalt, concrete, and dirt ovals.

5450220.title: Crayon Sparks
5450220.short_description: Draw your escape route in a hand-drawn bomb arena! Chain explosions, collect upgrades and turn tricky terrain to your advantage. Challenge 50 solo stages, battle friends online with up to 8 players, or share one computer for local battles with up to 4 players.

5450460.title: Gate Rogue
5450460.short_description: Cards in hand, into the unknown Gate. A classic turn-based roguelike RPG played one move at a time on a grid. Skills, magic and healing: the cards in your hand clear the way. Master 6 classes, conquer 20 ever-changing labyrinths, and rescue the childhood friend who vanished into the depths.

5450480.title: How to Christmas
5450480.short_description: A 1-4 player Christmas co-op. Fish runaway toys out of the ice, then murder them as they flee or fight. Sell your toys for cash, buy bigger guns, beat giant plushie bosses, and drive Santa’s sleigh home. Celebrate Christmas together!

5450550.title: Talebinder
5450550.short_description: Fairy-tale villains are breaking out of sealed books. As the tower's librarian, gather spellbooks that fight on their own, slot in charms, and evolve them into your own ultimate build. A bullet heaven roguelite where bosses telegraph their big attacks. Tough, but read them and you can win.

5450560.title: Escape the Walls
5450560.short_description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

5450880.title: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
5450880.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

5450950.title: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
5450950.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

5450980.title: Sam Buku Per
5450980.short_description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

5451090.title: Totally Legal Logging
5451090.short_description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

5451170.title: 捕捉小动物
5451170.short_description: A casual simulation game where you upgrade different nets and abilities to catch animals with various abilities, and experience the thrill of scratching off a scratch-off ticket to win a big prize.

5451300.title: Wheel of Growth
5451300.short_description: Wheel of Growth is a chance based incremental game about spinning a wheel to earn cash, and then upgrading the wheel to earn bigger.

5451440.title: Idle Laps
5451440.short_description: An incremental racing game where you actually drive. Beat your best lap and turn it into ghosts that loop it endlessly, earning coins for you. Upgrade your ride, ascend, and master every circuit of an island racing festival.

5451610.title: Tidy Mall Together
5451610.short_description: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 7000 runaway things back onto the shelves of 18 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

5451660.title: ORYFT
5451660.short_description: Drill through underground walls, collect resources, craft powerful drills, and fight the creatures lurking beneath the surface. Restore the Lumera-01, defeat five bosses, and test your skills in the Infinite Rift.

5451710.title: Bedtime Battalion
5451710.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

5451750.title: Rope Untangle
5451750.short_description: Untangle colorful ropes, one move at a time! Drag the rope ends to free every strand. Simple controls meet clever puzzles: observe, plan, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a tangled mess into order.

5451830.title: Ordanum
5451830.short_description: Ordanum is a combo centred PvP auto battler where the order of your Sigils is the driving system. Arrange and rearrange your Sigils then watch your creation play out against other players' builds.

5451870.title: Midnight 42
5451870.short_description: One of you just wants to sleep. Everyone else is a mosquito. Buzz, bite and sabotage until the human snaps, or grab the swatter, finish your chores and fall asleep before 6 AM. Online asymmetric party game for 2–7 players (1 human vs up to 6 mosquitoes) with proximity voice chat.

5452290.title: Horde Hero
5452290.short_description: Survive monster swarms with 13 classes, 57 skills and a sprawling skill tree. Grow your build offline or pursue seasonal rankings with separate online progress. Free demo now available to download.

5452390.title: OSAD
5452390.short_description: No combat, no jump scares, and no chase sequences: just you and a dying world with a mystery to uncover. Experience the end of the world in an alternate-history Poland. As a lone garbage collector, witness the final hours of reality as you know it. But don't forget to be a good citizen.

5452400.title: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market
5452400.short_description: Build a fishing company from a single boat. Send your ships to the fishing grounds, truck the catch to the markets that pay the most, research better gear, and grow a fleet that works by itself. A relaxed management game on a living island.

5452620.title: Got More?
5452620.short_description: Fight monster hordes in a bullet heaven roguelite with automatic attacks, weapon evolutions and 18 bosses. Mix guns, melee weapons and skills, unlock companions, and upgrade your gear between runs to take on the next chapter.

5452780.title: Gnom
5452780.short_description: The largest RTS you've ever played, and it's about gnomes. Grow a colony in an enchanted forest, get through nights that get worse each time, turn gnomes into giants or into swarms of nano gnomes, then go take the rest of the forest. Online co-op for up to 4.

5453090.title: River Royale
5453090.short_description: Race 79 rival rivers down a real mountain island in a battle royale where you play as the water. Drop in from the sky, carve your route through the valleys, swallow lakes to grow, cut off smaller rivers and be the first to reach the sea.

5453430.title: Fusa
5453430.short_description: Pet Pochi, earn purrs and turn an empty room into a home full of cats. Fusa is a relaxing pixel-art incremental game: furnish with over 140 pieces, watch your cats nap, play and ask for food, and grow your colony up to thirty companions.

5453590.title: THROWAWAY
5453590.short_description: Five people posted about their night shifts on an anonymous forum. Every one of them stopped posting at 3:17 AM. Work their shifts yourself in this PS1-style horror anthology and keep to the rules they left behind. Then someone starts a thread about you.

5453600.title: Maw of Apophis
5453600.short_description: Build your deck. Break enemy rites. A dark Egyptian roguelike deckbuilder where reading the next attack matters as much as the cards you draw. Master four champions, shape powerful combinations, and choose your path through the underworld.

5454050.title: Hidden Fame: Dark Secret Collector's Edition
5454050.short_description: A rising supermodel has vanished without a trace, and the trail leads into the glittering world of high fashion. Follow journalist Will behind the runway, expose stolen designs and secret deals, and uncover the truth someone has spent years trying to bury.

5454090.title: Alice: Defense
5454090.short_description: Alice: Defense is a roguelike tower defense game where heroes fight on their own. Recruit them with gold, place them on the board, and hold back waves of monsters. Uncover why the World Tree has changed in Story Mode, then push your limits in Infinity Mode with Relics, Augments and Abyss Contracts.

5454300.title: Varketh’s Prison
5454300.short_description: Varketh's Prison is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs. Descend into the depths with procedurally generated dungeons, dangerous creatures, and handcrafted boss encounters.

5454370.title: Rubblebound
5454370.short_description: Rubblebound is a minimalist idle game with roguelite elements. Unleash the balls, build skills, break bricks, upgrade, repeat. And see your power grow in this incremental game.

5454430.title: NO SUCH MONSTERS
5454430.short_description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

5454600.title: Heal Me Faster
5454600.short_description: You're the healer in a pixel-art incremental RPG. Your company auto-battles; you decide who gets healed. Manage mana, shield a marked ally and recruit from twenty-one classes. Between battles, your camp, shop and town keep working while you're away. They charge. You keep them standing.

5454620.title: RETENTION
5454620.short_description: November 1978. Meridian Capital's headquarters was evacuated and sealed at four in the afternoon. At two in the morning, you're sent in alone to collect some paperwork. Nobody is inside. Something is.

5454950.title: Gridrunner 2K
5454950.short_description: From the eccentric mind of Jeff Minter, onto the greasy lap of a lazy developer on a mission, the classic Commodore 64 game Gridrunner, now rebuilt for the modern era! More features to be announced soon!

5455080.title: Slow Mowing
5455080.short_description: Take it slow and make it yours. Mow overgrown meadows, build your own mowing machines, and uncover forgotten treasures in the English countryside. Turn a neglected farm into your own peaceful retreat, one freshly cut path at a time.

5455120.title: Backwatt
5455120.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

5455300.title: Pick The Suspect
5455300.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

5455430.title: Let It Snow
5455430.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

5455460.title: Backmare: Return of the nightmare
5455460.short_description: Immerse yourself in Backmare, a psychological survival horror experience designed to twist your reality and test your sanity. Here, survival is not merely about running away—it is about piecing together a fractured truth forgotten by time.

5455520.title: Tower Power: Wall Fall
5455520.short_description: Build your tower, reinforce its walls, and reduce your rival's to rubble in a turn-based fantasy card strategy. Master three resources, five distinct decks, and three paths to victory.

5455690.title: Dungeon Wizard
5455690.short_description: Hover, pop, upgrade, repeat! Pop!Corn is a pixel-art incremental game about turning a handful of kernels into a popcorn frenzy. Unlock five flavors, grow a branching skill tree, and build better cooking gear until every batch bursts with rewards.

5455710.title: Plants Need Some Space
5455710.short_description: The world's sweetest grocery starts with a little cozy chaos. A mafia boss tomato, a comrade potato, a disco lettuce, and dozens more oddballs who can't stand each other. Good luck! Plant everyone in the right spot to sort out the chaos, sell the harvest, and design your own shop.

5455930.title: Rotland
5455930.short_description: A brutal zombie survival sandbox in an Earth-sized procedural world. Scavenge, craft, and build a home or mobile base. Drive cars, sail boats, pilot planes and helicopters, or take to the rails on a train. Survive alone or with friends.

5456140.title: The Governor's Hand
5456140.short_description: Govern a Roman frontier province for ten months, one card at a time. Raise soldiers, tax the markets, sign writs, and decide how hard a hand to rule with. Harsh measures might keep the province stable, but will go on the record you will answer for in Rome at the end of your term.

5456200.title: Oasis Realms
5456200.short_description: Explore, gather resources, and build in Oasis Realms, a colorful 3D sandbox. Shape the world block by block, create your own structures, and play solo or join online multiplayer to build and explore with others.

5456370.title: Street Girls: Love Records
5456370.short_description: Work odd jobs, pay the rent, and fall in love in a small Chinese city. This 2D romance visual novel mixes light life-sim elements with three heroines and nine endings. Balance money, time, and energy as casual texts and budget dates grow into relationships that are harder to leave behind.

5456450.title: Velikopolsky Chess
5456450.short_description: Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude. Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn. Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

5456460.title: GAEKGWI
5456460.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

5456630.title: Wharflet
5456630.short_description: Build a tiny fishing fleet on your desktop. Ride the waves, catch fish, sell and upgrade - all while you do other things. Just sit back and relax!

5456810.title: Little Extinctions
5456810.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

5456880.title: FootBall Idle: Ball Launcher
5456880.short_description: Build your squad from player card packs, idle through league matches, and climb the ranks. Grow the club — then trade spare packs with other players on Steam.

5456990.title: FOLDEAD
5456990.short_description: A first-person, turn-based roguelike in a dungeon folded from paper. Climb five elemental dungeons and the one above them, fight with every skill in hand every turn, and shape each skill by taking two of the five points on its star.

5457090.title: MODERN CAPITAL
5457090.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

5457150.title: Hopwood
5457150.short_description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. Explore five connected regions, gain a new ability in every act, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, win back the Old Cherry's five blossoms from bosses who forgot who they are, and uncover the valley's lost story.

5457160.title: XenoTerra
5457160.short_description: Explore an open sci-fi world on foot, by jetpack and behind the wheel. Battle rogue machines, upgrade your arsenal and haul captured energy to settlements. Activate energy beams to power the rocket that will take you back to space.

5457370.title: The drawing of the Exodus
5457370.short_description: This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible, told using images generated by artificial intelligence and accompanied by brief captions.

5457380.title: Bust 10
5457380.short_description: Bust 10 is a chaotic, family-friendly party card game blending pot betting with sabotage. Bet, bluff, and use items to outsmart rivals. When someone busts, the winner smashes them with punishment props! Single-player now; online multiplayer in development.

5457410.title: ChessDeck
5457410.short_description: A tense chess roguelike deckbuilder. Draw cards to deploy pieces and move them with real chess moves, break the enemy garrison, and hold your back row against attacks you can see coming. Every piece you lose comes back to haunt your deck.

5457650.title: SHAFT HAPPENS
5457650.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

5458050.title: Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon
5458050.short_description: An otome visual novel set among four guardian clans. After losing her mother, Ahwa inherits leadership of the Azure Dragon clan, and with it an old law: a leader must stand alone. Will she carry every burden herself, or share it? Your choices shape six bonds and the fate of the four clans.

5458160.title: RIP ME!
5458160.short_description: RIP ME! is a pixel-art booster pack incremental. Rip packs, pull shiny hits, clean and grade your best cards, then show them off in your display case. Build a Rip Bot, chase God Packs and misprints across an ever-growing lineup of series, and hunt the legendary Grails.

5458340.title: Taskbar Kingdom
5458340.short_description: A medieval idle kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Gather resources, raise your castle and defend it from raiders, then send troops on real-time expeditions, claim land and rise at court, all while you work.

5458430.title: Ghost Girl Requiem
5458430.short_description: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

5458520.title: The House Doesn't End
5458520.short_description: A first-person puzzle game inside a house that refuses to make sense. Step through impossible doorways, walk on walls, and work alongside a replay of your own movements. Carry objects between rooms, connect the clues, and find your way out.

5458530.title: Flightless
5458530.short_description: Emerge from an egg as a baby penguin, learning to waddle, slide, and live life as a penguin should in a dreamy post-apocalyptic Antarctica. Find your way in a wordless story of meetings and separations.

5458540.title: Night Concierge
5458540.short_description: November 2003. Night shift at the front desk of a post-Soviet apartment block. Something is wearing your neighbors' faces. Check the resident log, question visitors over the intercom and call their apartment: if they answer from home, who's at the door? PS1-style first-person horror.

5458740.title: DataCenter Tycoon
5458740.short_description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

5458810.title: Wicknick
5458810.short_description: A co-op heist for 1-4 thieves, online or on one screen. Break into Lowlight's vaults by the light of one lantern: hang it on the light-lock to crack the cage, carry the chest out two by two, then hold the lift while the alarm wakes the dark.

5458820.title: Paid Parking Simulator
5458820.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

5458890.title: Grow It!
5458890.short_description: Cook weed, cook meth, make money, and try not to get cooked yourself. Hire tiny buddies to do the cooking, gamble your profits, and automate everything. Just remember: the dealer wants his money.

5459100.title: Scrapjump
5459100.short_description: A co-op horde shooter for 1 to 4 robots. Your mouse aims, each button fires one arm. Level up together, bolt new guns onto your arms, take down five Wardens and keep jumping to the next planet until the whole crew is scrap.

5459210.title: True Curling
5459210.short_description: True Curling sets the new standard for curling game realism and entertainment. Curling is a sport of precision and power where the details matter, and True Curling gets them right.

5459570.title: Make It Cozy
5459570.short_description: Turn awkward spaces into welcoming homes in this relaxing interior design game inspired by Feng Shui. Arrange furniture, complete client orders, and unlock My Home — draw your own floor plan and furnish it your way.

5459650.title: How to Save the Villainess
5459650.short_description: You've woken up as a novel's hero—but it's the doomed villainess you want to save! Make friends at a magic academy and build your own spell deck in this roguelite RPG meets visual novel. No matter how many times you start over, you're determined to give her a happy ending!

5459660.title: Stock Den
5459660.short_description: Taipei, 1994. A stock den hides behind a corner store. Stocks × multiplayer × sabotage: phone in orders and race everyone to the same stock, up to 9 with friends or solo vs. AI. Jealous of their gains? Cut their line, spread fake news, bribe a pundit, drag them down!

5459830.title: Crimson Ocean
5459830.short_description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

5459930.title: DAYSOWN
5459930.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

5459980.title: Hit the Fly
5459980.short_description: Let your instincts run wild! Take revenge on these pesky little bugs for everything! But remember they come in different colors and behave in different ways. To catch them off guard, don’t forget to use your "Super Hits".

5460310.title: Bounty Hunters
5460310.short_description: Bounty Hunters is a competitive stealth game for four players. Blend into the crowd, identify your target, and strike while avoiding your own pursuer. Use disguises, poison, and detection abilities to outsmart your opponents in eight-minute matches online or over LAN.

5460600.title: Splicers
5460600.short_description: Splicers is a party shooter with silly game modes, tough challenges, and a huge roster of characters and weapons. Bring your friends, add some bots, change the rules, and build your own maps and missions to share with the world.

5460630.title: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
5460630.short_description: Turn robot pursuit into a collision trap. Outsmart malfunctioning machines in turn-based grid strategy with tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport. Take on 50 campaign levels, endless Survival, ASCII Classic, and a Weekly Challenge with replay-verified online rankings.

5460650.title: Bad Things Might Happen
5460650.short_description: Play as an AI Researcher whose wife left him because of his AI Psychosis, build an indoor data center and build the most complex AI model that has ever existed. Social Commentary meets classic incremental mechanics. Begin progressing by hand, and then automate your way through AI development.

5460730.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
5460730.short_description: Hop in Zack's taxicab and tour Infinity City with the Gigglebone Gang! 50 stimulating, song-filled early math activities teach kids ages 4–8 counting, shapes, time, money, and problem-solving, and it all feels like play. A Headbone Interactive classic, back for a new generation.

5460810.title: Asteroid Mining Corporation
5460810.short_description: Blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your mining systems, and build an increasingly absurd mining operation for the galaxy's only trillionaire. Every asteroid destroyed brings you closer to unimaginable wealth. Unfortunately, most of it belongs to the corporation.

5461550.title: Containment Shift Company
5461550.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

5461930.title: Just One More Catch
5461930.short_description: Catch creatures, build your team, and decide how far to push your luck. Explore a 99-floor realm in this single-player roguelike, master turn-based battles, and return safely with new companions—or lose the rewards you have yet to secure.

5461950.title: The Last Lantern - idle
5461950.short_description: A gentle idle game at the edge of your desktop. Follow a little lantern keeper, rescue lost spirits, and build safe places for them to rest. Cyan light brightens a world of charcoal and mist, while a Pomodoro timer and music accompany your work, study, or quiet moments.

5461990.title: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
5461990.short_description: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

5462060.title: SheepTag: Dragons
5462060.short_description: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning escapes and close calls. SHEEPTAG IS BAAACK!

5462500.title: Room on Earth
5462500.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

5462530.title: Nebulon Colony
5462530.short_description: Nebulon Colony is a 3D colony sim. You take command of the first crew of astronauts, tasked with building the first colony on a distant planet. Dig, craft, build, trade, automate, level up, grow plants, herd animals, drive rovers and more.

5462680.title: Ninja Remix Resynced
5462680.short_description: Create your own ninja, use handsigns and perform jutsus, unlock skills across skill trees, and master techniques at different ranges. Team up in co-op or challenge other players in PvP.

5462860.title: AfterShift
5462860.short_description: Change the past, rewrite the present. Shift through three moments of a catastrophic accident, solve time-bending puzzles, escape a secret facility, and decide which of your coworkers you can save.

5463090.title: NoroiStation
5463090.short_description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

5463290.title: Train Station Staff Simulator
5463290.short_description: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

5463350.title: Hellobnb Simulator
5463350.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

5463430.title: Blood & Ledger
5463430.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

5463610.title: The Way Home 퇴근길
5463610.short_description: Endless rain falls over Seoul, and strange anomalies appear on familiar streets. Observe your surroundings, report anything unusual, and continue your journey when everything seems normal. Can you make it home safely after seven days?

5463690.title: THE MAZE WITHIN ME
5463690.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror in which you explore dark, maze-like environments, evade lurking threats, and uncover fragments of a troubled past. Face the memories that shaped you and decide what your fate truly means.

5463940.title: Crash Agency
5463940.short_description: Crash Agency is a ragdoll comedy about staged accidents. Set the scene, throw yourself in front of cars, off ramps and under pianos, break bones in slow-motion X-ray and file the claim. 105 jobs in a busy town and a snowy mountain village.

5464010.title: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
5464010.short_description: Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows. 50 stages, 216 painted objects: a medieval puzzle game.

5464180.title: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
5464180.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

5464320.title: Crown Without a King
5464320.short_description: Your abilities evolve. Build a fantasy party, develop and modify its abilities, and master your weapons. Forge and enchant gear, choose where to strike in turn-based battles, and prepare Emberwatch for the coming invasion.

5464540.title: Space Nanny
5464540.short_description: A chaotic sci-fi multitasking game where minigames share controls and an alien baby keeps pressing the wrong buttons. Juggle multiple challenges, fling the baby away, and undo its mischief before alarms, smoke, and blackouts overwhelm your board. Remember: Never let him press the big red button!

5464760.title: Velma's Costume Closet
5464760.short_description: Velma and Rapu are off on a twenty-country dress-up tour, and you pick the outfits. Mix and match traditional costumes and have fun with the fully animated skits. Put on a show and print your own paper dolls. A fully restored 1997 Headbone Interactive classic.

5465030.title: Holy Nest
5465030.short_description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

5465260.title: Snow and Loathing
5465260.short_description: You wake up on a sofa in a snowy wasteland. Beside you: an old camper. Ahead: a road disappearing into the fog. Find fuel, earn money, and keep moving, alone or with a friend. The further you travel, the stranger everything becomes.

5465280.title: Unknown Caller
5465280.short_description: The ghost never lies. Your friends do. Answer the phone, hear what she wants, then lie your way out of it. Mystery boxes, bombs, poisoned wine and terrible luck. 2-8 players with voice chat. Last one alive wins.

5465540.title: First Bag
5465540.short_description: You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you. But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

5465570.title: Chute Happens
5465570.short_description: Deliver precious cargo. Drop explosive surprises. Try to keep your plane in one piece. Chute Happens is an arcade game of parachute drops, daring deliveries, and demolition. Dodge incoming fire, chase bonuses, and make every drop count.

5465970.title: Gunmetal Switchyard – Tower Defense
5465970.short_description: Build and upgrade nine tower types, reshape enemy routes, and recover stolen data orbs in a sci-fi tower defense campaign. Fight through 20 missions, restore an abandoned network, and uncover the truth behind Command’s orders.

5466080.title: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
5466080.short_description: A classic turn-based JRPG set in five rival nations inspired by Hyogo, Japan (home of Kobe). Guide a hesitant prince through a land where every nation has its own idea of justice, explore far and wide, and find your way to the true ending. Fully playable in English.

5466130.title: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
5466130.short_description: Run a tiny PC shop through the 2024–26 AI boom. Find the GPU, parts and model that fit each customer's budget and make their AI actually run. A light, cozy pixel-art shop sim.

5466410.title: Fuji Flip
5466410.short_description: Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair. Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud, so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

5466460.title: Buzzmischief
5466460.short_description: Buzzmischief is a mosquito survival game. Fly into people's homes at night, drink from sleeping humans without getting swatted, and bring the blood home. Spend it on eggs and upgrades to grow a colony across the street. Take too much, though, and someone calls the exterminator.

5466580.title: LAST SLIME
5466580.short_description: When and where will you leave each slime behind? Guide a linked caravan of slimes, detach them to make paths, hold switches, and block hazards, then collect every LOVE on the board. Plan around each slime's color and your caravan's order in this turn-based grid puzzle.

5466710.title: Marceline Magpie: Forgotten Culprit
5466710.short_description: Discover a strange secret on forgotten abandonware and save a girl from a vanishing kidnapper in this unique puzzle box point and click adventure mystery.

5467120.title: GEARSMITH
5467120.short_description: GEARSMITH is a pixel-art action roguelite for 1–4 players. Fight from the cellars to the desert with 14+ weapons, each with its own way to fight. Take the gear you find to the forge, socket runes into it and upgrade it into an artifact.

5467210.title: KINETET
5467210.short_description: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

5467360.title: University Architect
5467360.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

5467370.title: Joseon Delivery
5467370.short_description: Walk and run across the eight provinces of Joseon-era Korea as a courier. From the stone-wall lanes of Jeju to the foothills of Geumgangsan, carry parcels and letters, hear the story behind each one, and collect a song from every town. A cozy journey on foot, with no combat and no failure.

5467390.title: LIMEN Company
5467390.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players in procedurally generated worlds. Pick a door, gather the data and stay quiet — they can hear you.

5467420.title: Star Sprout EV
5467420.short_description: A chibi sci-fi mecha collection in one single-player package: a 4-chapter story campaign, real-time strategy Conquest, 24-level tower defense, the bullet-heaven roguelite Star Drift, and the leaderboard survival mode Endless Deep. Fight on foot, board your mech, and crush the swarm.

5467640.title: While I Still Remember
5467640.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

5467680.title: Charmosaic
5467680.short_description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

5467800.title: The Glass Perimeter
5467800.short_description: A night shift on the crest of a dam. Bleed the pressure off the terminals, hide from the glare behind your visor, until the air runs out. The only rest is at a window onto someone else's warm life. A short psychological thriller about sensory overload and life behind glass.

5467840.title: Clay Rumble
5467840.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

5467920.title: That Caveman Theme Park Game
5467920.short_description: Build a tribe. Run a prehistoric theme park. Keep the fire alive. Train cavemen, gather resources and create wild timber attractions. Entertain visitors, defend them from dinosaurs and expand your park's warmth while balancing fuel, construction and stone income.

5468020.title: Kingshatter
5468020.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

5468090.title: ManaPop!
5468090.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

5468120.title: Unclean Hands
5468120.short_description: A PS1-style horror card game. Play Durak against Slavic spirits in a bathhouse after midnight. They cheat. Catch them. Cheat back while they look away — alone or with up to three friends online. Lose, and you lose a finger.

5468730.title: Maple's Secret
5468730.short_description: Pet Maple at his own rhythm, earn upgrades to get away with more, and make it to 8:00 AM without getting caught.

5468990.title: Masterstroke
5468990.short_description: Painting is a cover; haggling is the real art! [Masterstroke] is a roguelite fusing canvas jigsaws, poker hands, and tense bluffing. Chain resonant cards on a 3x3 grid, trigger 8-way paylines, and fleece wealthy buyers for rent. Just don't push too far!

5469060.title: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
5469060.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

5469450.title: Tiny Timber
5469450.short_description: Tiny Timber is a 3D cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch a tiny lumberjack chop trees, take breaks, and collect wood. Buy upgrades and grow your little forest while you work or relax.

5469630.title: ASCII Realms
5469630.short_description: A free-to-play online fantasy RPG drawn entirely in ASCII. Explore on horseback, battle monsters with real-time spells and steel, collect loot, and upgrade your equipment at the forge. Develop your character in a shared world.

5469890.title: Grimoire Paradox
5469890.short_description: A clumsy apprentice witch botches her first spell and gets a grumpy 500-year-old witch stuck in her head. To part ways, they have until dawn to find nine strange items in a town full of monsters. A hand-painted comedy point-and-click adventure.

5470000.title: Starwinder
5470000.short_description: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

5470100.title: Take One Down
5470100.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

5470510.title: Town of Puzzles
5470510.short_description: A cozy match-3 puzzle RPG. Drag one gem, chain the colors and watch the board go off like fireworks while 42 neighbors with psychic Echo powers fight the creatures crawling out of the fracture in the middle of town.

5470520.title: Just One Trip!
5470520.short_description: Find room for one more box! Pack a whole move into a small van, and drive through a toy cartoon town to deliver all this stuff somewhere! Featuring Classic Puzzle mode as well as multiplayer co-op with Steam Friends!

5470550.title: Ruby's Trick or Treat
5470550.short_description: Freeze when the music stops, solve her puzzles, and escape the house before she gets to you. A short, fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game where every second counts.

5470680.title: Let the cat fish!
5470680.short_description: Let a little fishing cat live along the bottom of your desktop. Catch and collect rare fish, build a cozy tower floor by floor, equip cannons against cute seaside monsters, dress up the tower and taskbar, and shrink the game to a tiny companion while you work.

5470710.title: What the Duck
5470710.short_description: A co-op hunting adventure for 1–4 players. Call in birds, haul back your kills, and buy better gear as you explore increasingly strange hunting grounds. Bring your friends, load up the boat, and take on oversized bosses. It started with ducks.

5470830.title: Campfire
5470830.short_description: A two-player co-op deduction adventure where a grandchild and a late explorer's old apprentice finish an unfinished path. Each of you gets different clues on screen, by voice or by touch. Put them into words, compare them, and reach one answer together. Supports the DotPad tactile display.

5470880.title: Kinfall: An Idle Dungeon Crawler
5470880.short_description: An idle dungeon crawler that plays beside your work. Your family of heroes dives, fights and loots on its own. Take over at any moment. When a hero falls for good, an heir carries on with the family's gifts and legends. You make the important decisions, the hero fights for you.

5470890.title: Jetski TD
5470890.short_description: Race against your friends in this PvP tower defense. Build and upgrade towers, ride your Monkey Jetski to haul gold from fish nodes, help other players defend — or quietly make things worse. First to clear a wave sets the pace for everyone.

5470970.title: ICE Wars
5470970.short_description: 3v3 vehicle combat on the rain-soaked streets of East Los Angeles. Advocates race to get families to safe houses while ICE races to reach them first. Ram, shoot and outdrive the other team in a fight for every passenger, where every delivery decides who gets to stay.

5471130.title: Sewer Rat
5471130.short_description: Sewer Rat is a split screen multiplayer rat experience / passion project that explores the hidden lives of rats and their unique social construct. A mix of realism, silliness and straight up rat propaganda. It's currently in the alpha stages of development.

5471250.title: ODD HAUL
5471250.short_description: Pack your bag, discover powerful item synergies, and chase higher scores in a cozy, cat-filled strategy game. Arrange your loot, unlock clever combinations, shop for upgrades, and see how far your journey takes you!

5471340.title: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football
5471340.short_description: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football is a chaotic 4v4 online arcade football game for up to 4 players. Play as hand-drawn Ottoman miniature characters, slide, shoulder-charge and punch your way to the goal, grab power-ups, and let AI fill any empty slot.

5471500.title: Last Load
5471500.short_description: A night shift at a 24-hour laundromat. Sort, wash, dry and fold your customers' loads by the care labels. Then a green work jacket with a white stripe turns up in a bag where it doesn't belong. Every wash brings the blood back. The man who owns it is waiting at the window.

5471510.title: COREHOLD
5471510.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, build a base and descend into dark, procedural caves. Craft weapons, master furnace heat and brew potions, then repair your ship and escape. A top-down pixel adventure where every trip underground brings you closer to home.

5471520.title: EPIBDA
5471520.short_description: Iceland, October 1989. For seven nights you keep the light on a remote lighthouse. Out in the fog stands EPIBDA, a thing 120 metres tall. It moves only when no one is looking. Keep the beam on it, guide the ships past the reef, and don't let the lamp run dry.

5471560.title: 6 Days Out
5471560.short_description: A broken leg, a tent on a mountain pass, six nights. By day your friends go out for supplies. At night they walk back to your GPS signal. And something knocks at the entrance. It speaks in their voices and looks exactly like them. Open up or not.

5471580.title: Zondbeland
5471580.short_description: They used to be people. Then they got smartphones. Now the ZONTBE are a horde and STASS herds them. Go live, grab a shotgun and clear five levels of fast, bloody retro FPS action while your chat watches every kill.

5471600.title: NII-058
5471600.short_description: Winter, the nineties. You climb onto the roof of a shut-down research institute to strip its copper, and the rusted roof gives way. The doors are welded, the windows bricked up. Something walks in the dark. Find a way out before it finds you.

5471620.title: PIZZA 66
5471620.short_description: 1997. A roadside pizzeria on a dead stretch of Route 66. You work the night shift alone: roll the dough, spread the sauce, bake, slice and box every order by hand. And when the red lamp over the window lights up, you have five seconds to drop the shutter.

5471630.title: Changeling & The Fae
5471630.short_description: Branded a changeling and ordered to hunt a fae, Oisín finds unexpected companionship with a soldier, a quiet boy and a charming troublemaker. An immersive fantasy novel about grief, found family and slow-burning romance, with illustrated environments, character portraits and atmospheric music.

5471930.title: Sunbed Simulator
5471930.short_description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

5472020.title: Wizard Castle
5472020.short_description: A tactical card duel of wizards. Summon creatures, bind enchantments, hide traps, raise barriers and claim the battlefield with a domain. 167 cards, three manas, ten ready decks, CPU rivals and online 1v1.

5472080.title: SHRED A BILLION
5472080.short_description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!

5472140.title: Knight’s Reckoning
5472140.short_description: Knight’s Reckoning is a tactical grid-based dungeon puzzle where math becomes your ultimate combat tool! Choose your class, calculate your moves wisely, buy gear in the mystic shop, and prove your wits in deep, procedurally generated castle dungeons.

5472450.title: Memories of Memories Anthology
5472450.short_description: Ten stories, where memories are for sale.

5472460.title: Silk & Cannons
5472460.short_description: Trading and real-time naval combat. Canton, 1840: one year to make your fortune. Buy where goods are made, sell where they are scarce, fire broadsides at pirates and ride out the typhoons. Three seas, three eras: China, the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean.

5472470.title: 装甲奇兵
5472470.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.

5472490.title: The Department of Traffic Safety Simulator
5472490.short_description: A 1-4 player physics-based traffic enforcement simulator. The city is broke and the council has a plan: tickets. Lots of tickets. Hand them out with spike strips, grappling hooks and orbital lasers, take down the bosses running each part of town, and keep the city one fine away from anarchy.

5473030.title: Muchi
5473030.short_description: Meet Muchi, a free-to-play desktop pet who makes your screen feel cozier. Show him affection, offer food and water, tend a little garden, or take a break with minigames while he wanders, plays, and rests alongside your day. No rush, no pressure.

5473190.title: Fishy Ring
5473190.short_description: Fish back your ring and try to save your wedding in this gentle gameboy-core fishing RPG where you’ll have to deal with the consequences of your actions as you try to mend a troubled community.

5473280.title: Pigeon Gang
5473280.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

5473300.title: Whisperwell
5473300.short_description: Whisperwell is a first-person multiplayer social deduction game where cute cats hide deadly secrets. Complete missions, use role-specific abilities, and discuss and vote to expose the killers, or deceive the village and eliminate anyone who gets in your way.

5473350.title: Saturnia
5473350.short_description: A blocky survival game where you mine ore, smelt it and forge your own tools and weapons on the anvil. Build wands and staffs piece by piece, learn fire spells, and explore volcanoes, cherry groves and old tombs while a frost golem, a minotaur and a dragon wait for you.

5473400.title: Overgrid
5473400.short_description: Overgrid is a tactical tower defense game where capturing the territory is just as important as defending it. Build and upgrade your defenses, capture strategic locations, and unlock new technologies across a 30-mission campaign set in the middle of a war between artificial intelligences.

5473610.title: Bazaar Below Zero
5473610.short_description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you and put you to work digging ice to stock his bazaar. You obey… but every tunnel you dig brings you a little closer to the way out. A co-op incremental for 1–4 players: sell to seals, upgrade your tools, hire penguins and plan the great escape.

5473780.title: Yarrr
5473780.short_description: Hordes, plunder and a kraken, in first person. Play one of four pirate captains, combine 40 spells and 60+ relics, chart your course across ten islands and take on the Kraken, alone or with up to three friends.

5474170.title: Punch Through
5474170.short_description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

5474360.title: Shelf Therapy
5474360.short_description: Shelf Therapy is a relaxing first-person 3D shelf-organizing game. Pick up everyday products and place them freely in their designated sections. Arrange drinks, snacks, ready-to-eat meals, and more without fixed slots, and enjoy turning empty shelves into neat displays.

5474460.title: Tripartite: Magical Engineering
5474460.short_description: The defense of the castle is up to you. Build your own network of roads and towers and discover the magical combos necessary to defend your home, all while training soldiers and siege weapons to bring the fight back to the enemy. Capture their castles before they capture yours!

5474490.title: Into the Chaos: Reliable Delivery Riders
5474490.short_description: Four riders. One drop-off. Questionable teamwork. Grab orders and dodge security in a 4-player co-op delivery sandbox. Ride ridiculous vehicles, kick your friends, and deliver the most orders for double earnings. Knocked down? Get back up. Caught by a guard? You're out!

5474600.title: Keep Harvesting
5474600.short_description: Your farm is decaying - every harvest keeps it alive. Turn a tiny field into a massive harvesting machine in this incremental idle roguelite. Combine hundreds of skills, automate your harvest, invest your resources in permanent upgrades, and grow stronger with every run.

5474910.title: Ruthenium Smash & Grab
5474910.short_description: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.

5474950.title: FX WARRIOR
5474950.short_description: FX Warrior is a story-driven simulation game blending forex trading with work life. To save enough to move out, choose between part-time jobs and leveraged trading, face market swings and losses exceeding your balance, and reach your own ending!

5475170.title: PinDOS
5475170.short_description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

5475360.title: Musicality
5475360.short_description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

5475390.title: VoidHorde
5475390.short_description: A first-person horde roguelite. Hold a walled town against an endless undead horde, alone or with up to 3 friends. Build an absurd arsenal of guns, magic and orbiting blades, seal the void rifts tearing the sky, and push your hits into the billions. One more wave.

5475400.title: UPG Cubed
5475400.short_description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

5475470.title: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
5475470.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game where you play as a rat with a nose for cheese. Sniff out, stack, and shelve over 300 types of cheese and milk. Complete sets to earn wedges, unlock cheesy powers like the Cheese’nado, and turn delicious chaos into satisfying order.

5475550.title: Definitely Safe
5475550.short_description: Put rockets together from scrap parts, pack the powder, cut the fuse and see what happens. Film every flight. Upload your footage, chase views, and climb the charts. Totally legal. Definitely safe.

5475570.title: Purrfect Hand
5475570.short_description: Settle into a cozy poker-inspired card game. Hold cards, build stronger hands, earn chips, and unlock upgrades as you chase royal flushes. Befriend a cat, discover playful minigames, and enjoy one more deal over a warm cup of coffee.

5475580.short_description: Merge tiles, get buffs. Make number go up. Biggest score is best score.

5475590.title: Choo City
5475590.short_description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

5475670.title: Peer Into The Void
5475670.short_description: Catch what moved. The moves get smaller and smaller. Test your perception.

5475760.title: 高校野球2100
5475760.short_description: High School Baseball 2100 is a realistic baseball management simulation set in the year 2100. Scout and train players, build your lineup, and lead your team to national glory. Receive coaching offers from other schools and shape your own career as a high school baseball manager!

5475820.title: Left Inside
5475820.short_description: Left Inside is a room escape game taking place in a mysterious house. Awoke in an attic, you must find a way to escape using the objects hidden in the rooms.

5476070.title: Bingolazo
5476070.short_description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

5476090.title: Cardmarch
5476090.short_description: Build your deck, move animal allies across a tactical board, and break through enemy lines. Unlock six heroes with personal stories, cast spells and face bosses across six regions in this single-player card battler. Storybook artwork draws on the look of classic 1990s animation.

5476460.title: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
5476460.short_description: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

5476700.title: 斗域经理
5476700.short_description: Build your club in Arena Manager, a strategy game of hero development and automatic battles. Recruit heroes, shape your five-person squad with skills and gear, and outdraft your rivals. Lead your team from the lower leagues to the Continental Crown.

5476720.title: The Compliant
5476720.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

5476900.title: Luna Plena
5476900.short_description: "Read your enemy. Count every turn." A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

5476940.title: Ex Death Game
5476940.short_description: 100 ex-boyfriends. One luxury cruise. A deadly reckoning at sea. Play as Su Wei, design lethal trials, and decide each ex’s punishment. As Chopin’s waltzes play, expose their lies, watch alliances crumble, and make every betrayal come due.

5476970.title: Moonlit Vigil
5476970.short_description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

5477050.title: Cosmic Inferno
