5477050.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

5477140.title: Stray Cloud: An Overcast Story
5477140.short_description: You are a cloud. A fairly small one, and the other clouds think that's hilarious. Swallow them, rain to buy upgrades and grow from one field to the whole Earth. Then drift on through the solar system, world by world, until you cover the Sun. A cozy, fully narrated incremental.

5477210.title: Echoes on Paper
5477210.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

5477640.title: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure
5477640.short_description: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky and don't land in a field too early.

5477810.title: Legio Impera
5477810.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

5478180.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
5478180.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

5478190.title: DeCube
5478190.short_description: A nostalgic incremental game where you mine whole planets down to their core. Dig, upgrade and hire workers to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...

5478280.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
5478280.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

5478290.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
5478290.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

5478350.title: Ten Thousand Victories
5478350.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

5478560.title: 烽烟三国 Warfires of the Three Kingdoms
5478560.short_description: Warfires of the Three Kingdoms is a turn-based strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Build teams from Heroes, Skills, and Formations, exploit unit counters, climb the Tower with three parties, collect Equipment, and adapt your tactics to each enemy lineup.

5478710.title: EXOSECTOR
5478710.short_description: A space 3D MMORPG on a colossal scale. Up to 100,000 players simultaneously in one persistent, seamless game universe of 10,000 star systems.

5478800.title: Domino Party
5478800.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

5478970.title: Neldoaria
5478970.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

5479020.title: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
5479020.short_description: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

5479340.title: An incremental city from a word search: Wordhood
5479340.short_description: Build an incremental town powered by word searches. Wordhood is an addictive blend of finding words and watching numbers grow. Gather resources, combine upgrades, and unleash combos to grow a hungry town.

5479430.title: PluggedInCats
5479430.short_description: Battery running low! Place the cats and route their cables with care to charge every device and keep these internet-loving kitties exploring the digital world!

5479460.title: 跃向天空
5479460.short_description: Join Ella on a climb through ancient mechanical ruins. Ride rotating gears, time your jumps, and grapple across broken passages. Work with counterweights, water and wind as you find your route toward the sky.

5479470.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
5479470.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

5479490.title: Oddballs Brawl
5479490.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

5479500.title: Blazing Fighter King
5479500.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

5479570.title: League of Constellations
5479570.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

5479980.title: Bottled Ambition
5479980.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

5479990.title: Dress Your Meat
5479990.short_description: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

5480090.title: Idle War Legion: WW2
5480090.short_description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

5480240.title: Throw The Snot
5480240.short_description: Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles! Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

5480410.title: One Mote
5480410.short_description: Grow a glowing web from a single mote of light. Every crystal you reach feeds the core, and the light plays a song. Collapse your web into a star, fill constellations, wake whole galaxies, then fold them back into one mote. An incremental game you can watch grow.

5480430.title: Tiny Night Market
5480430.short_description: A tiny night market lives right above your taskbar. While you work, the stalls cook, sell and grow on their own. When you have a minute, help out at the stalls, toss a few rings, fill regulars' orders and wait for rare visitors — and watch one candied-hawthorn cart grow into a glowing street.

5480460.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
5480460.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

5480690.title: Nessi
5480690.short_description: Explore Loch Ness alone or with up to three friends in a first-person horror investigation. Gather evidence, photograph sightings and upgrade your boat and equipment. Try your best to prove the existance of the Loche Ness Monster.

5480950.title: Outfitter: Madison River
5480950.short_description: Fly fish and paddle Montana's Madison River, 228 km from Yellowstone to Three Forks. Read the water, land wild trout, run Bear Trap Canyon's whitewater and hike the backcountry, solo or with a friend in two-player co-op.

5481070.title: Rock N' LSD
5481070.short_description: Wake up split in two, sharing one health bar. Identical yet opposite, no memories, only instinctive hatred. You want to kill each other. Solve a missing person case to uncover the past. A decadent-cute, rock "episodic anime game" blending visual novel and text adventure, updated long-term.

5481100.title: Atelier en Provence
5481100.short_description: Bring a little Provence to your desktop. Join Pierre the painter as he works and rests. Upgrade his tools, collect and sell paintings, and create a cozy home. The full release will feature over 1,500 works of art.

5481140.title: Geometry Platforms
5481140.short_description: WELCOME TO A GEOMETRIC SPACE ODYSSEY In a universe of collapsing forms, you are the last vector of resistance. Surviving hordes is half the battle—the ground beneath you is a dynamic, lethal threat! Brace for neon bullet hell, pinpoint physics, synth beats, and endlessly rewarding progression.

5481150.title: Tiny Standup
5481150.short_description: Has your standing desk been stuck in sitting mode for months? Tiny Standup is an idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen and reminds you to stand up. Watch your character stand, stretch, and hydrate alongside you, and earn cute cosmetics to show off to your friends.

5481330.title: Dragonaute
5481330.short_description: A fantasy flight action game where you are the dragon. Launch from cliffs, dive between hundreds of floating islands, race your ghost for Steam leaderboard records and set entire fleets ablaze with your fire breath, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

5481820.title: THE UNWRITTEN: Shadows of Iga
5481820.short_description: 1581. Iga burns. Kirimaru, a seventeen-year-old shinobi who survived, slips through the last years of the Sengoku era as a shadow who leaves no name — from the fall of Iga through Honnoji to Sekigahara. A retro, NES-style ninja RPG where every general leads thousands of troops into battle.

5482000.title: Dent & Paint: Body Shop Simulator
5482000.short_description: Run your own body shop and fix cars by hand. Inspect, quote and win the job, then strip, cut out rot, weld, fill, sand, mask, mix and spray the paint, polish and wash. Deliver on time, earn good reviews and work your way up from apprentice to foreman.

5482120.title: Supermarket in Order
5482120.short_description: Tidy up to 10,000 objects across 17 supermarket sections. Pick up products, restock shelves and unlock upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play at your own pace and turn scattered goods into a neatly organized store.

5482190.title: Gliding Together
5482190.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

5482210.title: Hide & Chisel
5482210.short_description: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

5482230.title: Lightly Played
5482230.short_description: A card-collecting roguelite about opening packs and grading cards. Spend ten days at the night market buying packs, ripping them open and sending your best pulls to the graders, then watch every card you own pile damage up at the other collectors.

5482300.title: Emerald Space Courier
5482300.short_description: Survive megacorp Emerald Acme's lethal "field test"! Pilot in a 60 FPS neon arena, face 8 bosses across a 24-shift combinatorial cycle, master 4 built-in minigames, and customize your broadcast in Emerald FM Studio. Solo, Co-op, or PvP!

5482360.title: JUNK//GOD
5482360.short_description: Steal weapons from the machines you destroy. JUNK//GOD is a 3D action roguelite where you build a robot from salvaged parts, combine its weapons and fight through five industrial districts. Lose a part in combat, pull it back in and keep fighting.

5482550.title: ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE－
5482550.short_description: The prologue of the novel Natsuno Kanata is now a visual novel! When Shiori boots up her late grandmother's old PC, she unexpectedly connects to a desolate alternate world ravaged by a mysterious pandemic. A post-apocalyptic adventure.

5482580.title: Loaded Bones
5482580.short_description: Loaded Bones is a poker-inspired dice roguelike where every roll can change your fate. Build powerful combinations, collect game-changing Keepsakes, unleash mystical Incantations, and chase outrageous scores as you gamble your way through a supernatural world to challenge the Devil himself.

5482800.title: Factory In Progress
5482800.short_description: A semi-idle factory management game. Mine ore, craft components, then research and automate your way to launching a rocket. There is no world to route resources through. Buildings pull from and deposit into one global pool. Even when you are gone, you still have a Factory In Progress.

5482810.title: Starcrumb
5482810.short_description: A star fell into the forest. Tap it, and tiny mushroom folk carry its crumbs to the Lantern. Kindle the star, magnitude by magnitude, until it is whole again. A cozy incremental game where you can see every part work, with a real ending.

5483020.title: kitty Limited Trade Union
5483020.short_description: Run a guild of cats in this pixel-art incremental game. Hunt monsters with clicks or recruit cats to fight for you. Earn gold, plan your talents, mix drinks and forge weapons as your guild grows with each rebirth.

5483250.title: Box Them Cats
5483250.short_description: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

5483280.title: Metal Wayfarer
5483280.short_description: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.

5483750.title: CRIMSON HAREM - My Girls -
5483750.short_description: Korea fell to a crimson mist. Left for dead by his former lover, a man leads the Yaksha back to Seoul. Link same-colored tiles in one stroke to fight, then live the story of each woman you meet, part by part. Bond with her, and her power becomes yours. All characters are adults.

5483960.title: One Tank Trip
5483960.short_description: Team up as three soldiers forgotten in the evacuation on their journey home by tank!

5484230.title: BIRDS HUNTING
5484230.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player first-person bird hunt. Blast incoming flocks, send your dogs to retrieve, earn cash for better gear, and chase golden ducks and a flying rainbow unicorn. Friendly fire is optional. Trusting your friends isn't.

5484330.title: Wait, They Can Climb?!
5484330.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

5484480.title: Astrocraft: Prologue
5484480.short_description: Build a space station on a barren asteroid, in first person and for free. Mine ore, run machines, open a shop for the ships that land, and hand the work to a crew of robots until the station runs on its own, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

5484940.title: World League Football
5484940.short_description: A football manager with stands that remember you. Take over a club, or start with its youth or second team. Protest on the touchline, face the press, get sent to the stands. Chase the 128-club World League or play Classic leagues and cups.

5485070.title: Resortful
5485070.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

5485440.title: Monster Battle Master
5485440.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

5485650.title: 末日序列：诡域求生
5485650.short_description: ELDRITCH SEQUENCE is a Lovecraftian survival RPG that fuses rule-based horror with dungeon crawling. Uncover deadly rules, explore nightmarish dungeons, and fight to survive. Customize your attributes, develop unique builds, and combine powerful skills to forge your own path to survival.

5485700.title: Sus Chef
5485700.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

5485720.title: Raccoocket
5485720.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

5485840.title: New Eldarian
5485840.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

5485920.title: Ambulante Simulator
5485920.short_description: From a cooler on your shoulder to a penthouse by the sea! Shout into a real mic, sell water, mate, popsicles, coconuts and açaí on Copacabana beach, and work your way up to your own stall and kiosk. Play solo, build a career with up to 4 friends, or compete with up to 6.

5485950.title: Our Hollow
5485950.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

5485990.title: Your "Thing"
5485990.short_description: Finally, you can grow your own little thing. Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief. How big will yours get?

5486360.title: Organize my Shop 3: Christmas Store
5486360.short_description: Your favorite cozy organizing returns in a festive new format! Dive into a winter wonderland, brew some hot cocoa, and place fairy lights, nutcrackers, blankets, and mugs neatly on the shelves at your own pace while enjoying your favorite holiday movie ☕✨

5486380.title: Taenera's Offer
5486380.short_description: A sci-fi extraction shooter on a dying desert planet. Scavenge weapons, supplies and valuables, take risky contracts, and fight your way to extraction. Use precise aiming, acrobatic dodges and physics-driven tricks to survive — and earn enough to escape.

5486410.title: My City
5486410.short_description: My City is a Classic-inspired city simulator, built for today in full 3D. Paint residential, commercial and industrial zones, lay roads, rail and power lines, keep the lights on and the traffic moving, balance the budget, and watch small houses grow into towers as your city thrives.

5486520.title: Wallet Street
5486520.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

5486540.title: Age of Balls
5486540.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

5486620.title: JiivJiiv
5486620.short_description: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.

5486650.title: In the Margins
5486650.short_description: Run a cozy bookstore in a small riverside town. Listen to what each customer is after and find them the right book from over 1,400 real titles. Stock the shelves, decorate, host story time and book club, and grow the shop one room at a time. There's a cat.

5486910.title: Treasury of Lies
5486910.short_description: Run a small country for ten years and survive the truth. Plant stories, turn spies, calm the bond market and outlast the fake feeds, before the voters, the lenders or a squirrel in the substation finish you off. A noir turn-based strategy game of money, spies and lies.

5487050.title: Infasia : Tears of Void
5487050.short_description: **Infasia: Tears of Void** is a turn-based JRPG set in the world of Infasia. Take on the role of Xen and lead his growing party as they fight alongside the Beltenrekis, an organization dedicated to preserving the balance of the world.

5487170.title: Hellstorm Gunners
5487170.short_description: Crew a B-17 Flying Fortress with up to nine friends. Fly her from take-off to landing, man the guns, fight the fires and bomb real targets. Play the solo campaign under your own name or eleven more modes, from factory raids to Zombie Rain. Bots man the empty guns.

5487270.title: Metal Simulator
5487270.short_description: Start as a solo metal musician in 1970 and build the greatest metal band of all time! Write songs, release albums, recruit musicians, tour, grow your fanbase, and evolve with the changing sounds of metal across the decades.

5487360.title: GOAL2D
5487360.short_description: Three-minute top-down football where every shot, pass, and dribble is yours to control. Time-charged shots, beat defenders with skill moves, and call team tactics in 3v3 to 5v5 PvP or co-op. Climb six ranked leagues or play a career from amateur to national team. Try the free demo.

5487610.title: Animal Fights Together
5487610.short_description: Run a animal fight club with up to 3 friends. Strap absurd weapons onto farm animals, train them up, then watch their cinematic auto-fights together, bet on every match and yell at the screen. A goat with a minigun. A chicken with a katana.

5487730.title: The Window Across
5487730.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

5487830.title: DREADMINER: Millions Below
5487830.short_description: Real-time strategy in the deep. Mine contested gold and crystal deposits, stretch your power network across hostile caverns, and command a brass-and-lightning battery as the swarm breaks through from new directions. A gothic steampunk tower defense RTS where every coin is a choice.

5487890.title: Golf Sim Sim
5487890.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

5487940.title: Timber Together
5487940.short_description: Grab up to seven friends and build a logging company in a stylized forest valley. Fell trees, buck them into logs, haul them through mud and rivers in 11 vehicles, and sell to the buyers who pay best. Buy land, hire loggers, grow your company.

5488100.title: Real War: Not Fake
5488100.short_description: The fake-mobile incremental arcade game now made real! Shoot enemies, increase your army, gather coins, upgrade your gear, and defeat bosses to complete levels!

5488200.title: Myriadgen
5488200.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

5488260.title: Midnight Brag: Before Poker
5488260.short_description: Before poker, there was Brag. Play Three Card Brag, the classic British card game of bluffing and nerve, in five late-night clubs run by bosses who never lose. Beat them in a voiced campaign, then sit down with real players at live tables with voice chat, in VR or on a flat screen.

5488330.title: Originaryah
5488330.short_description: Originaryah is a turn-based roguelite card battler where you roll dice, collect loot, forge powerful equipment, and climb a 30-floor tower filled with dangerous enemies and formidable bosses. Unlock forgotten powers, overcome each challenge, and recover the lost memories that reveal the truth.

5488380.title: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027
5488380.short_description: A serious train-driving game rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 from "Train Plus West Japan". Drive Series 207, 221, 223, 227 and 321 on a fictional 55.5 km, 26-station four-track main line, with signals, ATS, gradients and cant. ＪＲ西日本商品化許諾済

5488520.title: Flume
5488520.short_description: A pixel-art puzzle roguelike where every run is different. Flip tiles, swap cards from your hand and build a route to the finish before the flow catches up.

5488610.title: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
5488610.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

5488630.title: Puzzling Boxes
5488630.short_description: 4 Puzzling Boxes await for you. Can you complete them all?

5488660.title: Ruff Day
5488660.short_description: Customers drop off their pups with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, cleaning, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

5489050.title: Rastergeist
5489050.short_description: A scrolling shooter where you build your own ship from a grid of parts, and every part can be shot off. Collect salvage, research heavier weapons, and fly two branching campaigns of 53 stages, or grow a ship one drafted part at a time in Endless Run, a roguelite with a daily leaderboard.

5489090.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
5489090.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

5489780.title: AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES
5489780.short_description: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.

5489800.title: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
5489800.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

5489810.title: Meat for the Meat Grinder
5489810.short_description: Harvest meat with your friends! Bring up to 3 friends to play as Meatheads; undead monsters with detachable limbs. Fight, dodge, and puzzle your way through sprawling floors while trying to keep your head on straight (literally). The goal is simple: Meat for the Meat Grinder.

5489840.title: 孤城守将：放置射击
5489840.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

5489960.title: Idle Airways
5489960.short_description: Start with an empty field and work your way up to a bustling mega hub! Start your own airline and create routes to friends and other player as you progress. Can your airport be number one?

5490130.title: Amezida
5490130.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 1–5 players with card-driven actions and hidden objectives. Explore derelict ships, manage your hand, seal bulkheads and reach an escape pod. Play online, on one screen or solo with an AI crew. Trust is optional.

5490260.title: Coal Rush 1990
5490260.short_description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

5490390.title: EscarGO
5490390.short_description: A hungry chef. Four nervous snails. Plenty of dark jokes. EscarGO is a typing party game: race up to 3 friends online, and if you get caught, write sentences to trip them up. Or go solo, outlast the bots and chase the top score on the global leaderboard.

5490510.title: Crystal Surge
5490510.short_description: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. Scavenge ruins, combine gear and random blessings, plan routes and deploy turrets. Fight with guns and powers, then extract to trade loot and grow stronger. Leave now or face a boss? Die and lose everything you carry.

5490530.title: Dangerline
5490530.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy game set in a modern war. Build a base, raise an army and fight street by street with two sides that play nothing alike. Walls and hills really block sight and bullets, so take the high ground, hold the houses and bring the town down on the enemy.

5490760.title: Trisfera
5490760.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

5490820.title: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
5490820.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a wrecked magic wand shop. Find a home for 2,400 wands, tidy up the elemental halls and unlock handy upgrades. Play at your own pace, with no timers and no fail state.

5490990.title: Stay Human
5490990.short_description: Stay Human is a chaotic co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players. You’re part of an ambulance crew in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Take emergency calls, rescue bitten people from zombies, and rush them to the hospital before they turn.

5491010.title: SYNCOPE
5491010.short_description: Jump through surreal worlds, collect glowing notes, and experience unique soundtracks for each level. SYNCOPE is a rhythmic first-person 3D speedrunnable platformer game. Uncover the mystery of the giant eye, speedrun levels, and race friends to top the global leaderboards.

5491190.title: 1 Million Tiles
5491190.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

5491260.title: THE LAST DELIVERY
5491260.short_description: The world ended. The orders didn't. Deliver food and parcels across a dark neon city in VR: drive your own car, climb balconies and radio towers, fight off zombies, and spend every hard-earned euro turning an empty flat into a home.

5491450.title: The Small Kingdom
5491450.short_description: A top-down action RPG at insect scale. Lead an ant general through a war over the shards of a fallen star: battle shard-empowered princes, absorb elemental power, and rescue soldiers to fight beside you and workers to rebuild the colony.

5491510.title: Million Tiles
5491510.short_description: A quake shook 6,098 glazed tiles loose across an old voxel palace. Pick each one up and set it back on its chalked spot. Earn coins, buy better tools, fire cracked tiles in the kiln and open the palace one room at a time.

5491610.title: Cat Chaos Tidy Up
5491610.short_description: Cat Chaos Tidy Up is a cozy organizing game support 1-4 players coop! Pick up 4,800 adorable cat toys, sort them onto the right shelves, earn money, and unlock powerful abilities to tidy up the entire shop.

5491850.title: Inkblot: The Art Restorer
5491850.short_description: A painterly puzzle about restoring masterpieces. A living ink blot has stolen the figures from 128 famous paintings and heaped their shadows on your workbench. Untangle the overlapping silhouettes, paint each one whole and send it home before the museum opens.

5492190.title: Before it Falls
5492190.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

5492360.title: Turika
5492360.short_description: Turika is a fast top-down action game for 1-8 players. Dungeons, monsters, weapons and loot - all the good stuff and moar!. No two dungeons are the same: the layout, monsters and prizes changes every time you go in. Play with your friends online or on the couch. It's fun! It really is!

5492810.title: Smart Three Kingdoms : Rewrite History
5492810.short_description: Smart Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy game that cuts down on micromanagement so you can focus on strategic decisions. With over 700 officers and historical and what-if campaigns, build up cities and strive to unite the land through war and diplomacy.

5493290.title: Wardens of Sol
5493290.short_description: Build your ship. Defend Sol. Fly through Saturn’s rings, battle raiders and alien warships, and explore distant ground on foot. Mine, salvage and trade to turn each journey into the weapons, systems and ship you want to command.

5493390.title: Starship vs Everything
5493390.short_description: Start fragile. Earn every upgrade. Turn one battered starship into a storm of fire in this demanding bullet-hell roguelite. Dodge deliberate patterns, build devastating weapon combinations, and salvage permanent upgrades for the next run.

5493460.title: Lowside
5493460.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

5493500.title: Santa Sack Attack
5493500.short_description: Santa Sack Attack is a Christmas-themed third-person platform action game where the player must navigate environmental obstacles and techno-adversaries, smashing blocks, drones, and robots to reach their goal. Gameplay is family friendly fun and is appropriate for all ages.

5493670.title: Demon Balls: A Bowling Roguelike
5493670.short_description: A bowling roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit demons, deal with devils, cast spells and feed worms to your ball. Roll up through the heavens and kill God.

5494150.title: Tower of Rebirth
5494150.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

5494160.title: Taccy: TacFPS Aim Trainer
5494160.short_description: Taccy is a lightweight tactical FPS aim trainer built around actual in-game scenarios. Train corner clears, holds, counter-strafing and aim duels, then replay every rep to see what caused each miss.

5494240.title: Ember Citadel
5494240.short_description: Build a colony on the ruins of a lost machine age, master black powder and hold the walls. Somewhere out there, the Citadel is looking for you. Hold out alone or with friends in online co-op.

5494400.title: Desktop Fish Wish
5494400.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. While you work or relax, your little angler fishes on a tiny planet in the corner of your screen — catch 100 kinds of fish, fill your collection, dress up, and adopt charming pets.

5494450.title: Lets Bail
5494450.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleanup game, one bucket at a time. Scoop, carry and pour your way through flooded locations, upgrade your bucket, enlist a helpful drone and return each location to their former glory, with floating ducks for company.

5494590.title: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope
5494590.short_description: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope is a story about a tree in the town Van Dyck. Explore the town, talk with people and solve problems with puzzles.

5494930.title: Ex Simulacris
5494930.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

5494950.title: Entre Sueños
5494950.short_description: Entre Sueños is a first-person psychological horror adventure where blinking changes reality. Explore unsettling environments, uncover hidden doors, solve mysterious puzzles and discover the truth behind a world trapped between life and death.

5494980.title: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers
5494980.short_description: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers is a first-person tidying game. Pick up golden plates numbered 1–9999 and fit them into matching slots on the wall. Solve number puzzles to earn coins, use them to get magic from a capsule toy machine, and upgrade your skills to put away all 9,999 plates!

5495060.title: Sengoku Fields of Empire
5495060.short_description: SENGOKU combines samurai action, economic management and grand strategy in feudal Japan. Lead the Tokugawa clan, build farms and trade networks, recruit warriors, forge alliances, conquer castles and rise through the Imperial Court to become Shogun.

5495090.title: Prisma Orbits
5495090.short_description: A puzzle game with just two controls. Red, green and blue stars circle on their own — all you can do is slide every star outward or inward at once. Steer them past walls, vines, water and wormholes until all three lights meet and become a single white star.

5495370.title: Pet Ferris Wheel Arena
5495370.short_description: Raise a tiny kitten into an extraordinary arena companion. Hatch, care, train, and evolve your cats, discover surprising forms, and watch your choices come alive in real-time AI battles. Build a collection and take on an offline ranked challenge.

5495460.title: Trivia no Sekai
5495460.short_description: Competitive anime and video game trivia where knowing the answer isn't enough. Play 92 wildcards to attack rivals, counter their tricks and flip the score at the last second. Over 4,000 questions in English and Spanish, online matches for 1-4 players, free-for-all or 2v2.

5495600.title: Tiny Trouble
5495600.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

5495650.title: MazeParty
5495650.short_description: Ruin your friends' plans and turn the tables in MazeParty, a 4-player online board party game. Roll dice together, navigate a maze in first person, and get in each other's way with items. Earn gold in 20 minigames and collect keys to chase the final victory.

5495690.title: Silk Road Caravan: Desktop Idle
5495690.short_description: A little caravan, a long Silk Road. Trade 12 goods, open routes through 13 cities, collect illustrated travel memories and return home for lasting upgrades. Open your caravan journal when you have a moment; let the journey continue while you work.

5495700.title: Too Many Chickens
5495700.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

5495830.title: Blubbis Abenteuer
5495830.short_description: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

5495910.title: Meka Gakuen
5495910.short_description: Run an independent military academy above the Shigure reservoir. Get to know 100 hand-written cadets through the years, and lead them in turn-based battles against flesh demons where every loss is permanent. Build the academy. Bring them home.

5495940.title: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
5495940.short_description: A fresh new adventure. Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across 16 different snow, ice and mountain trails in this cozy dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

5495950.title: Chained Riders
5495950.short_description: Chained Riders is a chaotic online multiplayer motorcycle game for 2–8 players! Ride together in co-op or compete in teams of two, connected by chains. Overcome challenging obstacle courses, coordinate your moves, and try not to drag your teammates into disaster!

5496190.title: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box
5496190.short_description: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box is a game designed for TikTok LIVE integration, featuring a popular livestreaming genre where streamers face off against their viewers! The streamer builds while the chat tries to stop them by spawning TNT, lightning strikes, meteors, and even nuclear bombs into the game!

5496280.title: Puppet War
5496280.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

5496360.title: Blooming Courtyard
5496360.short_description: Blooming Courtyard is a cozy logic puzzle game on a grid. Follow the placement rules to solve hundreds of puzzles. Enjoy the scenery of all four seasons as you fill your little sunlit courtyard with flowers and greenery!

5496460.title: Manes in Cadentia
5496460.short_description: A gothic narrative rhythm mystery inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. Follow a grieving woman through five theatrical acts where music, memory, and truth become one.

5496480.title: FRAGILE!
5496480.short_description: Online co-op moving company for 1–4 players. Carry sofas, pianos and chandeliers with both hands through 10 places and 40 contracts... and break nothing. A new Daily Contract every day, Steam leaderboards and Twitch chat chaos votes.

5496590.title: PRESIDENT
5496590.short_description: Become President… or end up the Asshole! PRESIDENT brings the famous card game to life with 11 modes, five AI difficulty levels and multiplayer. Challenge your friends or compete in tournaments with up to 16 participants to claim the crown!

5496760.title: Unlucky Spells
5496760.short_description: Your mom wants you to become a witch. You honestly don't give a fuck. One night she sends you to meet the coven deep in the Forest, where the Head Witch hands you a pink pistol and asks for a human sacrifice.

5496770.title: Void Demolition Co.
5496770.short_description: A cozy incremental demolition roguelite. Hold the left mouse button to tear tiny voxel cities apart block by block and feed every fragment to a black hole. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades, awaken wild weapon transmutations, and keep smashing until the void swallows the whole city.

5496790.title: Ocean Ark: 100 Below
5496790.short_description: Build a tiny steel platform on the open sea into a cozy home, floor by floor. Salvage drifting cargo, spear fish, cook, purify water and fix your workbench. Then suit up, dive into the sealed chambers below your home, find blueprints and build your first submarine.

5496810.title: Growback
5496810.short_description: Grow a plant, then decide when to cut it down. Its roots and woody stems survive, and the cut earns you seeds for permanent upgrades. In this cozy pixel-art incremental game, you start by clicking a tiny sprout and end up with a whole canopy and root system working for you.

5496900.title: Celestial Pawnshop
5496900.short_description: You run an ancient cultivation-world pawnshop trapped in a time loop. Read customers, appraise goods, haggle, and expose fakes. Each life you remember more: which pill is fake, which customer dies on the seventh day, and who locked the shop in the loop.

5497020.title: PACKFISH
5497020.short_description: Packfish is a cozy pack-opening incremental game about collecting fish. Tear open packs, flip the cards and chase shiny Golden and Prism editions. Build living aquariums that earn while you're away, breed secret hybrids and complete a collection of 97 species. Just one more pack...

5497040.title: Idle Demon Slayer
5497040.short_description: Build a party of up to five heroes in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG. Auto-battle for gear with random affixes and collect offline rewards. Combine formations, combat styles, and cultivation manuals to take on secret-realm bosses and climb the Endless Tower.

5497060.title: Last Card
5497060.short_description: A card roguelike played across the table from a masked dealer. Chain cards by color, number or symbol to stack chips and multipliers and beat the night's target. Miss it and a candle goes out. When the last one goes out, the house wins.

5497130.title: Crimson Haze
5497130.short_description: Command a Vietnam War air-mobile company in squad-based real-time strategy. Fly troops into hot landing zones, call artillery and air support, and fight for the trust of villages. Every soldier has a name—and every loss is remembered.

5497170.title: Uncatalogued
5497170.short_description: Take one oil lamp into an underground library that rearranges itself every night. Your items are reclaimed when the light goes out — only what you catalogue stays. A first-person roguelite of reading, deduction, and burning oil, in handheld-sized retro 3D.

5497220.title: Juchetopia
5497220.short_description: Korea, 1953. The war is over and Moscow wants its money back. Rebuild the North, pay the Soviet installment every month, play the factions against each other with secret police files and decide whether the armistice line stays where it is

5497300.title: Fruit Frenzy Clicker
5497300.short_description: Squeeze fruit, earn mountains of juice, and grow your tiny fruit stand into a thriving juice empire! Buy upgrades, automate production, discover rare fruits, brew recipes, explore orchards, and prestige for permanent rewards in this colorful incremental clicker.

5497470.title: Social Net
5497470.short_description: Incremental fishing in reverse: a fish catches people with money. Throw your net into the crowd, yank sunbathers out with the rod, hand in the catch, unlock the skill tree and new places - from a sunny beach to an icy bay and an ocean liner.

5497550.title: Corrupted Wings
5497550.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

5497580.title: KUNIS
5497580.short_description: Six months after the Meet & Greet went wrong, the Kunimoto Toy Mall is sealed and silent. You break in for a card no one has ever seen. The Kunis, the cats from the Kunimoto trading cards, are still here. So is Clat, a scared little clown cat who needs you as much as you need him.

5497610.title: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
5497610.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

5498240.title: Gutting Goblins! 2
5498240.short_description: Adventurers return to their village to find it burned down by a tribe of nearby goblins. It is time to return to slaughtering goblins in this next installment of Gutting Goblins!, with far more features and fun to be had! The indie hack and slash game is back!

5498510.title: Lost City of Kane
5498510.short_description: Start with a stick in an empty field and dig up to 300 metres down to a buried city. Sell the dirt, hire a crew of goblins, put up cranes, rails and goblin-powered machines, and find your way home, alone or with up to seven friends.

5498590.title: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
5498590.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

5498750.title: Candy Diggers
5498750.short_description: Drill through candy planets, catch sweet critters and fuse upgrades into wild synergies in this cheerful digging roguelite. Every run brings candy home to your factory town, where belts and buildings turn it into coins for bigger, deeper runs. Save the candy universe from the Evil Veggie Council!

5498760.title: There Is Not A Clown Here
5498760.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

5498820.title: Fraggers
5498820.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

5499020.title: Nanomano
5499020.short_description: A nano-sized karate hero in a white gi and hinomaru headband. Punch, kick, and stomp through bacteria and parasites across 40 waves, push right toward the torii gate, earn a new belt every five waves, face the crowned boss at wave 40, and finish with a bow under fireworks.

5499060.title: Fishy Island
5499060.short_description: Fishy Island is a cozy collecting game you can enjoy solo or with friends. Catch, gather, and sort 2,804 fish, sea creatures, and ocean treasures into a sprawling seaside collection. Upgrade your tools, explore the island, and fill every display at your own pace.

5499150.title: Big Pig Dig
5499150.short_description: A tower defense where thousands of pigs pour out of their dens. Place your turrets, then dig, drill and blast to break the stampede. Every tool reshapes the ground and redirects the herd. Each pig you stop is gold for a bigger arsenal.

5499310.title: Restaurant Rush Together
5499310.short_description: Run a Brazilian pastel shop in first person: roll the dough, fill, fry and serve every pastel with your own hands. Hire staff, build your shop your way and grow from one kitchen to outer space, solo or with up to 10 friends online.

5499400.title: Contested Space: Core Defender
5499400.short_description: The first pack-opening defense game you can play with friends! Rip booster packs to build your fleet, aim your own cannon, and fight through a 40-stage campaign that keeps getting bigger. 1-4 player online co-op, a roguelike mode, and hundreds of permanent unlocks.

5499610.title: 生灵棋旅 Grid Beasts
5499610.short_description: Recruit unusual creatures, master their movement patterns, and build a team that changes the battlefield. Grid Beasts is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you evolve and fuse companions, brave branching routes, and bring your whole team home for your next expedition.

5499670.title: Shelfish
5499670.short_description: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with Shelly the hermit crab, plus a fresh drawer every day.

5499690.title: Nightbound Ledger
5499690.short_description: Chinese folk horror × idle turn-based. Lead mercenaries through ten eerie regions in Nightbound: recruit from the roster, assign skills, farm affix gear, then watch auto-battles unfold line by line in the combat log. Gear sets your ceiling; formation decides how the fight plays out.

5499700.title: Dash Flash Rush
5499700.short_description: Move at high speed across 2D platforms, dodge attacks, and take down enemies—then join a smoking-headed guy and step into an absurd story.

5499760.title: Grass Planet
5499760.short_description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.

5499790.title: Last Skull
5499790.short_description: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.

5500250.title: The Devil Upstairs
5500250.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

5500260.title: GOD OF DEFIANCE
5500260.short_description: A Journey to the West deckbuilder with shadow-puppet art and mahjong-powered combat. Choose your fighter, build card and relic combinations, read enemy intentions and take branching routes through a ten-chapter single-player expedition.

5500490.title: CrazyVolleyball
5500490.short_description: A first-person volleyball game built around physical ball contact and teamwork. Receive, set, spike and block in online 2v2, 3v3 and 6v6 matches, or practice in solo matches and training. Position yourself, time your swing and keep the rally alive.

5500630.title: Embers & Iron Rain
5500630.short_description: 【Strategic Tower Defense × Random Traits】Every run is different ✦【Rearrange Your Defenses】There's always a better solution ✦【Tactical Commands】Seize the moment — set new records on familiar battlefields.

5500670.title: Guide to Dating Monsters
5500670.short_description: What happens when a fantasy world enters the modern era? Monsters & humans hook up! Guide to Dating Monsters is a highly interactive RPG-styled dating sim. Smooch cuddly and/or murderous foes!

5501000.title: Incremon
5501000.short_description: Build a thriving farm powered by Incremons! Capture roaming pets, evolve them, and keep them well-fed. Harvest, stockpile, and manage resources to unlock upgrades and expand your farm in this cozy incremental game.

5501070.title: Colonials
5501070.short_description: Pixelart Auto Battler about turning one expendable trooper into an army of Space Colony. You give the orders. They fight the bugs.

5501150.title: Expendable Drillers
5501150.short_description: Dig a mining base deep under Mars and keep its hapless crew alive. Feed them, bed them, give them air and fix the machines before the rooms fall in. Simple to start, deep to master, and full of cartoon mishaps.

5501340.title: Brad Dracula
5501340.short_description: A wobbly physics game at a vampire accountant's house. That's me. I'm Brad. Come alone, or bring a friend to your couch, and steal the fruit of immortality off my tree. Behind my doors are seven worlds, and there's a whole 16-bit RPG on my TV. Stay off the lawn. ...Have a great day.

5501920.title: Snowcraft Multiplayer
5501920.short_description: The naughty elves' red team against Santa's blue team in a 20 v 20 online snowball battle! Wind up, throw, duck behind the snow walls and pack more snowballs. Play over Steam with friends from anywhere, or practise alone. Winter war has never been this fun!

5502010.title: Hair Stylist Simulator
5502010.short_description: Every client brings a photo. Match it with your scissors and clippers before time runs out, then shampoo, blow-dry and sweep up. Run your own salon, cut 8 different styles for 8 clients, and earn five stars. Cut too much and you can't put it back!

5502030.title: Food Fight Online
5502030.short_description: Join a team of food and wage war on a giant kitchen counter. Rev up, let go and splat your enemies with throws, or capture regions to take over the map. Pineapples, watermelons and more battle online in chaotic deathmatch and capture modes. Last team splatting wins!

5502050.title: Rail Rush Multiplayer
5502050.short_description: Dodge the trains. Ride the roofs. Never stop running. Race through a living city in a fast endless runner and go online with up to 50 players at once. Collect coins, upgrade your runner, complete challenges and see how far you can get before the next train hits.

5502060.title: NOSTRIL ROYALE
5502060.short_description: You're a booger, and your life is hanging by a snot! Battle your friends in a chaotic multiplayer showdown inside a giant nose. Push, betray, dodge the finger, and try not to get picked first! Because here, it's not the strongest who survive - it's the slimiest.

5502090.title: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!
5502090.short_description: Winter came overnight. Grab a brush. Clear powder, scrape stubborn ice and push snow off a buried car in a cosy first-person cleaning game. Work your way around each panel and watch the car emerge, one satisfying stroke at a time.

5502130.title: Pimple Pop
5502130.short_description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

5502330.title: Globul
5502330.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

5502430.title: MANDATE
5502430.short_description: A 60-week superhero career RPG in pop-noir comic art. Train, sign with the Bureau, face the press and make 225 moral choices that come back to haunt you. Seven endings.

5502910.title: Gladiadorks
5502910.short_description: Gladiadorks is a goofy online co-op gladiator brawler. Slap your knocked-out friend awake, throw rivals across the arena and fight lions, elephants and a giant on your climb from a muddy village ring to the Colosseum.

5502940.title: Drift After Dark
5502940.short_description: Inspired by the golden era of Japanese street drifting and classic driving games, Drift After Dark is a laid-back, arcade-style downhill drifting experience built around one simple idea: enjoying the drive.

5503110.title: NULL Heart
5503110.short_description: A roguelike, bullet-heaven-inspired railshooter where you build game-breaking damage engines. Tinker with item mod combos to discover unexpected synergies until projectiles melt the screen.

5503200.title: EMBERSWORN
5503200.short_description: The sun went out sixty years ago. Carry the last living coal through five acts of the dark: fight in real time across floors laid out fresh on every visit, build one of four classes, and break what feeds each guardian before you can kill it.

5503210.title: TideLight
5503210.short_description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

5503500.title: Rage Trip
5503500.short_description: A difficult pixel-art platformer where the game roasts every mistake. Play solo, race friends, or try Shared Fate: 2–4 players, and one death resets the whole team. Beat your best times, clear a level together, earn animated skins. Free demo available - wishlist the full game.

5503620.title: Boom or Bloom
5503620.short_description: Run a fireworks workshop with up to 3 friends. Every extra scoop makes the shell bigger and worth more - and brings the workshop closer to blowing up. One listens with the stethoscope, one steadies the shell, one holds the bucket. Light the fuses at night: a sky full of fireworks, or a crater.

5503800.title: Stay Live: Ghost Viewers
5503800.short_description: Every stream from this closed hospital ward cut out before the roof. Tonight, you go live, and every floor looks like the last. Spot the anomalies and film them, follow clues to unlock the way forward, and survive what hunts you in this first-person survival horror game. Chat is watching.

5503820.title: Kaiju Ace
5503820.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

5504070.title: Sanga no Jin
5504070.short_description: The nation is broken, yet the mountains and rivers remain. Send your troops, seize bases and unite a realm at war in this real-time Sengoku strategy game — a tale of a young lord and a childhood friend who becomes his rival, told on the battlefield.

5504380.title: Too Many Roaches
5504380.short_description: Switch on the light and the kitchen is crawling. You start with one finger. Every roach squashed pays for something bigger: a slipper that swings on its own, a freeze spray, a flamethrower, a minigun, a bombing drone, robot vacuums. An active incremental, from the table to the whole kitchen.

5504770.title: Nexus: Fall of Man
5504770.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

5504810.title: Planetron
5504810.short_description: Command a space carrier in a blend of real-time strategy and first-person action. Deploy air and ground units to capture alien facilities on procedurally generated spherical battlefields. Take direct control of any unit when the battle demands it.

5504880.title: PenguinIsland
5504880.short_description: A cozy survival-and-fishing adventure with a PlayStation 2 soul. Crash-land on a tropical island, fish with a lock-pick timing wheel, trade with Mr. Crabby, and rebuild a wrecked bomber into a raft. Then the sea has other plans…

5505440.title: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS
5505440.short_description: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.

5505810.title: 溪流渔场
5505810.short_description: Get started in 3 minutes! Cast your net, catch fish, and build a thriving fishery in this idle fishing adventure. Upgrade your boat, explore the open sea, collect rare fish, battle sea beasts, and discover new fishing grounds.

5505910.title: Grizzly Cup: Tour de Mondo
5505910.short_description: Represent your country in a retro top-down arcade racer for up to 16 players online. Customise your car and driver, fly your flag, and race for the podium. Play solo, compete in Cups, and build your own tracks.

5506000.title: Thirsty Girls: A Magical Sugar Café
5506000.short_description: Magical girls fight monsters all night. You keep them charged up on sugar. Run a tiny, ridiculously cute drink stand, perfect every recipe, grow your shop and befriend the Starlight Squad across 20 challenges.

5506110.title: Nightshift Drift
5506110.short_description: A small, simple and chill night drift game. Deliver orders on a mountain road, earn a bigger tip when you drift your way there, and spend your earnings making your car look better. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

5506380.title: Santa's Shop Tidy Up
5506380.short_description: Bring festive order to Santa's magical Christmas shop! 🎄 Sort gifts, arrange toys, and organize charming holiday shelves in this cozy and relaxing sorting game. Enjoy the Christmas atmosphere and discover the simple joy of putting everything in its perfect place! 🎁

5507100.title: Yukikaki: Snow Plow Simulator
5507100.short_description: Clear the snow one satisfying shovelful at a time, alone or with up to three friends. Start with a single shovel in a snowy Japanese town and end up clearing airport runways. Snow piles up where you throw it and banks up in front of your plow. Your pace: no time limits, no fuel, no tool wear.

5507200.title: Breeder Protocol
5507200.short_description: Drop into a living alien hive with up to three friends. Reach the stranded crew before the breeders do, bring the uplinks online and fight your way to extraction. A twin-stick co-op roguelite where every hive is new and every run builds a deadlier squad.

5507390.title: Return to college
5507390.short_description: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

5507420.title: Lumiere Express
5507420.short_description: Every conductor in Europe ate the bad mussels, so the railways send for you: 93, retired, and nearly blind. Drive a steam train through thirteen towns from France to Iceland, and at every junction pick the one clear line, even though you only see where it goes at the last second.

5507430.title: Survivors
5507430.short_description: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

5507440.title: Sort In Silence
5507440.short_description: Shelve up to 8,500 books in a pitch-dark university library while Mika reads at her desk. Work too fast or too loud and she transforms and hunts you. Hide, keep the lights on, buy upgrades, and play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5507520.title: 27 Photos
5507520.short_description: 27 Photos is a 3D narrative puzzle game with a PS1 aesthetic. Armed with a camera and only 27 shots, you explore a mysterious, ruined building, solving puzzles through photography and uncovering the story hidden within it. What secrets lie within?

5507780.title: SCRAP RECLAIM スクラップ・リクレイム
5507780.short_description: Clear mountains of junk, sell it, and upgrade your tools! Go from bare hands to a drill and a vacuum to collect faster, and team up with tiny robots to clean out the warehouse. Assemble your means of escape and break out of the warehouse!

5507950.title: Chess Lords
5507950.short_description: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.

5507970.title: Desktop Cultivation
5507970.short_description: A pixel cultivation game on your taskbar: control your character to cultivate, make pills, grow spirit fields, train, forge treasures, and craft formations—no switching screens or pausing work. Collect all artifacts and advance from Qi Refining to Deity Transformation.

5508120.title: Pastel Squad
5508120.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

5508130.title: The Silver Witch
5508130.short_description: Dead, and now an angel—but Heaven's rules feel wrong. Jailed for forbidden Hell magic, Uriel escapes with Ailena, a girl met in prison, to start a second life in Hell, the Land of Demons. A two-person turn-based dark fantasy RPG in an afterlife where neither salvation nor judgment can be trusted.

5508480.title: Uncover Space
5508480.short_description: An incremental idle game where you fling asteroids and comets into the dust that hides planets, moons and suns. Every broken stone pays for more projectiles and upgrades, and your shots keep breaking dust while you are away.

5508630.title: Echo Walker: Tactics
5508630.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

5508960.title: Achievement Clicker Pro
5508960.short_description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

5509130.title: DOMAIN RUSH - MONSTERS, DICE & DOMAINS
5509130.short_description: Roll. Claim. Mutate. Ruin friendships. A high-stakes 30-minute clash of territory control and roguelike card fusion on a tight 14-tile board. Built for intense human rivalry—hop onto Steam Remote Play Together, unleash game-breaking monstrosities, and bankrupt your best friends!

5509820.title: Cat Tower Desktop
5509820.short_description: Make room for cats on your desktop. Meet different cats, decorate their rooms, and expand your home for up to eight at once. Pet them, play together, and keep photos and diaries of your days together in this cozy pixel-art desktop game.

5509890.title: Sundered Reach
5509890.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

5509920.title: Clock-Out Crew
5509920.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your taskbar. A crew of 24 office-meme heroes fights the bosses of office life while you work, gets stronger on your real schedule, and throws a parade the moment you clock out. Bonuses only. No penalties, no data collected.

5510020.title: My Colony 2
5510020.short_description: My Colony 2 is a next-generation 3D space colony simulator and city builder. Construct sprawling cities on alien worlds, manage resources, form alliances, and explore new frontiers in a fully moddable sandbox environment.

5510140.title: Us Vs Them
5510140.short_description: Build a frontier colony by day and hold its walls in first person by night. A co-op colony-defense game for up to 4 players, in split-screen or online: raise walls, command squads, man the guns and stand against hordes of the dead.

5510260.title: Pickfall
5510260.short_description: Swing your pickaxe at the rock. Every cell you break charges a bar, and a full bar births a thrown pickaxe that digs beside you until it shatters. Collect what the rock dropped, buy the upgrade you can see, and dig a deeper shaft next round. A short mining incremental in ink on paper.

5510290.title: Fog Xiangqi
5510290.short_description: This is a Chinese chess variant with a fog of war mechanic added. the difference is that fog of war has been added to the board. The vision range is: 1. the four positions directly above, below, left, and right of each piece; 2. each piece's interactable positions.

5510400.title: 39D
5510400.short_description: 39D is a linear sci-fi horror visual novel. Once you cross the line, there’s only one way to go: down.

5510630.title: Clanker Town
5510630.short_description: A first-person horde shooter with an incremental upgrade tree. Tens of thousands of smart-home robots want your trailer. Shoot them down, sell their scrap off Dale's tailgate, and grow one nail gun into hubcaps, Black Cats, a propane slingshot and a lawnmower minigun.

5510840.title: Miniature Metropolis
5510840.short_description: City building in a beautiful small-scale world. Build, relax and watch your city come to life.

5510860.title: Siberian Prison Builder
5510860.short_description: Build and run a Soviet prison camp in the frozen taiga. Plan cell blocks, keep the stoves lit and the prisoners fed, and hold the wire through blizzards, riots, fires and breakouts. Or grab a shiv and break out yourself.

5511370.title: Everyday in Pieces
5511370.short_description: Slow down and enjoy the little things in Everyday in Pieces, a cozy fuse-bead game. Pick a scene you love, follow the colors, and place each bead one by one to bring everyday moments to life.

5511380.title: Taso Idle
5511380.short_description: Taso Idle is an incremental game where you flip tasos at recess and sell your stack for cash. Rip open snack packs for rare tasos, buy upgrades and leave the collecting to your little brothers. The bullies can take everything but your name. Start with a bottle cap, become the Schoolyard Legend.

5511490.title: Idle Ascent
5511490.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

5511560.title: Snarekin
5511560.short_description: A monster-collecting roguelike staged on a Victorian toy theatre. Snare 151 paper puppets, craft their moves from what they drop, and take your troupe on tour through turn-based battles before a paper crowd that cheers, jeers and throws things. Someone left the ghost light on.

5511580.title: Hungry Dungeon
5511580.short_description: A chef trapped in a dungeon where the monsters are food. Your only weapon is a cheese wheel: throw it, watch it bounce through the horde, then run to grab it back before the onions close in. Hunt ingredients, cook dishes and survive as long as you can.

5511620.title: Once Upon a Shelf
5511620.short_description: Tidy up after the curse in various rooms of your new cottage! Every night around the witching hour, everything on your cellar shelves gets flung off in a jumbled heap. Somewhere underneath it all lies one of your boggart-stolen belongings. Take back what is rightfully yours!

5512540.title: No Good Pirates
5512540.short_description: Build a pirate empire one leaky boat at a time. Trade, fight and board your way across a living low-poly archipelago where factions go to war, ports boom and bust, and sea monsters want a snack. Sail alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op.

5512620.title: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!
5512620.short_description: (As seen on CodeTV S3 E7!) Thank you for calling the Higher Dimensional Manifold Escape Hotline. Your call is very important to us, and will be answered in the order in which it was received. In the meantime, please do not attempt to modify the fractals, or move through higher dimensions.

5512630.title: 100パーセントラブペット
5512630.short_description: *100% Pet Love* is an aquarium survival action game where you must live as a pet after being captured by a mysterious creature. Swim, eat, breathe, and defeat enemies while seeking affection. Master the surprisingly deep mechanics and raise your love level to 100%!

5512900.title: Keg & Crypt
5512900.short_description: Turn an inherited tavern into the busiest room in town. Brew ale and cider, cook meals, and win over regulars. Then venture into the Drowned Abbey for combat and loot. Play solo or run the tavern with up to three friends online.

5513330.title: Jester`s Anger
5513330.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

5513350.title: Up, Up! Neon Stairs
5513350.short_description: Same way? Climb. Other way? Turn. A two-button neon stair race where your brain must keep up with your fingers. Who's the fastest thinker? Find out in 1v1s, 4-player races with items and crumbling-stair Survival. 300+ outfits, Neon Pets, an idle world stroll. Free to play, with browser cross-play.

5514090.title: Leaf to Sun
5514090.short_description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

5514130.title: Loop Minesweeper
5514130.short_description: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

5514200.title: Newborn
5514200.short_description: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.

5514610.title: Posted Missing
5514610.short_description: A detective game at a London newspaper's shipping desk in 1876, where owners sink their own ships for the insurance. Work out what became of each ship, choose what the morning paper prints and get your family to America alive.

5514670.title: Where Is Your Bathroom?
5514670.short_description: You need to pee. Every door between you and the bathroom is lying to you. They run away, fall on your head, and get weirder with every room. A first-person troll puzzle game about outsmarting doors. Yes, doors.

5514700.title: PanicOperator
5514700.short_description: Flick weapons into your backpack and face the hordes in this action roguelite! Manage automatic attacks, swap overheated weapons, and merge gear. Arrange skill pieces before each run and spend earned gold on permanent upgrades. Build your own way to fight!

5514750.title: CRUSHMINO
5514750.short_description: Crushmino combines roguelite and falling-block gameplay. Drop blocks to crush your enemies, then claim rewards to craft your own build. Keep your balance so the stack never reaches the top. Tricky enemies and trials await.
