5514820.title: The Last Summons
5514820.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

5515130.title: The Thorns of War
5515130.short_description: The long-awaited sequel to 'The Rose of Segunda', The Thorns of War is a sweeping visual novel where your choices can change not only your own circumstances, but the fate of a nation.

5515470.title: Tilt Siege
5515470.short_description: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

5515520.title: Chibi Prison: Tidy Up Together
5515520.short_description: Panic! There's been a Prison Break and all the Chibi Felons are loose. Don't let their cuteness fool you - these guys are real rascals! It's up to you, the Fat Cat Cops, to sort through the rabble and lock them back in their cells.

5515680.title: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?
5515680.short_description: Seven heroines. Two starting paths. Forty-two days left. In this campus romance visual novel, weigh the Sin Radar’s advice against your own judgment, build trust, uncover past-life memories, and unlock outfits and branching endings.

5515820.title: DURMIENTES del Río Negro
5515820.short_description: In every corner of Argentina's Río Negro the spirit of a figure from its history wakes to watch over the land. Action and exploration in real places, from 1779 to today: defend the coast in 1827, survive the night on the old railway bridge and descend into the sea caves as the tide wakes the dead.

5515920.title: Staircase 8
5515920.short_description: Find your way out of a repeating Victorian stairwell. Look for anything unusual, keep going if everything seems normal, and turn back if you spot an anomaly. A first-person anomaly-spotting game where one wrong choice sends you back to the start.

5515940.title: Mahjong Kart
5515940.short_description: Mahjong meets kart racing! Drive tiles back to your base to collect them, use items to disrupt rivals, and be first to complete a winning hand. Play online with up to four players or face off in local split-screen.

5516160.title: Sweetheart, We're Infested
5516160.short_description: Vacuum alien bugs, board enemy ships and deliver a baby star in a jam jar before the galaxy goes dark. Keep your battered pest-control ship flying in this space roguelike romcom, where your partner’s ex remembers every failed run and gets pettier each loop.

5516330.title: Children of Titan
5516330.short_description: Build bases on Saturn's real moons, harvest ten resources and grow a colony from a bare crater. Train troops, launch fleets and fight beside your alliance in server-wide wars against the alien Selenite Brood. A free-to-play strategy MMO in one persistent world.

5516770.title: MINSK: APOCALYPSE
5516770.short_description: Survive apocalyptic Minsk. Manage health, food and water: search for resources or complete missions to stay alive. Fight demons, Templars and criminal factions as you investigate the apocalypse and those responsible. A survival adventure in development.

5516990.title: Salvo Spire
5516990.short_description: Build upward. Defend in 360 degrees. SALVO SPIRE is a sci-fi tower defense game where weapon combinations and construction order shape distinct defensive builds. Expand your tower, upgrade its firepower, and direct focused fire against enemies closing in from every side.

5517430.title: Relive the Fear - Mistvale Garage
5517430.short_description: Austin Reed, a 20-year-old mechanic, took a five day job in Westoria County: reopen an auto repair shop that had been closed for two years. From the first night, he couldn't shake the feeling that he wasn't alone in there.

5517450.title: Bannertide
5517450.short_description: A compact, replayable fantasy strategy game. Choose your difficulty and faction, march your armies along a branching network of roads, and capture mines, dwellings, and castles. Defeat your rivals and claim the entire island!

5517470.title: Petri: Microbe Swarm
5517470.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

5517930.title: Kick Rocks
5517930.short_description: Kick a rock until it's round. That's the game. Then sell it, buy better shoes and kick a harder one.

5518130.title: Bakebound
5518130.short_description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

5518570.title: TrapRush
5518570.short_description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

5518660.title: Brownie Clicker
5518660.short_description: Three out of four people prefer homemade brownies over homemade cookies. In Brownie Clicker, you're going to have more deep impacting choices, more depth, and more home-cooked goodness than you've ever expected from a mere 'clicker'. Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

5518680.title: Narrow
5518680.short_description: Every step becomes harder to take. Can you see the end? Will it be enough?

5518840.title: Little St. Files Mayhem
5518840.short_description: The Oval Office has a paperwork problem. Sort case folders, decipher damaged labels and put the archive in order alone or with up to 3 friends. Pass audits and upgrade your skills in a first-person filing game where every folder needs a home.

5518850.title: HIT: Hold It Together
5518850.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

5519290.title: Let 'er Ride
5519290.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

5519520.title: Corehold
5519520.short_description: We lost the surface and went underground. Now the Core rises to take it back. Craft your Weapon from parts, build a new fortress every run and hold off thousands of creatures at once. Then grow your underground Outpost and take back the surface, one sector at a time.

5519530.title: Warehouse Drink Sorting Simulator
5519530.short_description: Nearly 300,000 drinks in one mountain. Work through six halls, starting with a handful at a time. Earn money for bigger totes, carts, a lift and a giant scoop, then hire robot cats to pick and stack with you. No timers, no fail states.

5519570.title: Chaos Universalis
5519570.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

5519710.title: Bach For More Words 2
5519710.short_description: Bach For More Words 2 is a word game where you decipher an encrypted definition and select its matching word from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 2!

5519720.title: Bach For More Words 3
5519720.short_description: Bach For More Words 3 is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its synonym from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining words with their matching synonyms. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 3!

5519870.title: Beyond Krukmore
5519870.short_description: A turn-based dice-building roguelite where your weapons and spells are the dice you roll. Lead two heroes and a companion through a dark fantasy world, piece together powerful builds, and weigh the promise of better loot against the cost of one more fight.

5519900.title: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!
5519900.short_description: 说好只来旅游，怎么连每一顿饭、每一段闲聊都想留下？这是一款以成都旅行为主题的单机互动影像游戏。跟随镜头走进街头巷尾，在剧情节点选择出行方式、品尝当地美食、回应陌生人的热情，让日常小事成为旅途中的意外惊喜。你的选择会留下不同的旅行印记，影响日终手记与睡前故事的解锁。通过分支图回看另一种可能，在旅行记录中收藏照片与经历；也可以使用自动保存和已看内容快速回看，按自己的节奏体验这段旅程。写下属于你的成都记忆。

5520090.title: Neon & Bones
5520090.short_description: Las Vegas, 1957. Every night you split the casino's take four ways: the tax man, Chicago, your crew and your own pocket. Skim too little and the Family sends a car; too much and the FBI opens a file. Build an empire on the Strip, then buy your way out of the Family.

5520280.title: Creator Tycoon
5520280.short_description: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.

5520650.title: Clip Out: Backrooms
5520650.short_description: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.

5520710.title: The Gem Alchemist: A Cozy Crystal Workshop
5520710.short_description: Run a cozy wizard's gem shop in a world of stained glass! Steer seed crystals across a magical lattice to grow flawless gems, cut them, and sell them to picky customers. Grow stones in your cellar, read tomorrow's omen in the stars, and restore an ancient faceting machine!

5520870.title: Carrot Planet
5520870.short_description: Cozy co-op incremental automation game for 1-16 players. Harvest an entire planet of carrots to feed the Bunny Mothership. Pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together!

5521080.title: Gotta Catch Bugs!
5521080.short_description: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

5521340.title: Vampire Must Die: Chain Divine
5521340.short_description: Inscribe Sigils and defend the Crystal from vampire hordes in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite. Launch enemies skyward, blast them with Holy Fire Barrels, and smash them into each other for chain reactions. Pick the best upgrades from ever-changing choices, or fight with your own weapons.

5521470.title: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
5521470.short_description: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

5521810.title: Just a Villager MMORPG
5521810.short_description: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

5521880.title: Spexl
5521880.short_description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

5521920.title: Sift Happens: Idle Beach Treasure
5521920.short_description: Someone on the boardwalk just tossed a cigarette butt onto the beach, and now it's buried in the sand. Sift it out, watch it fly into a bin and get paid. Hire more throwers, let crabs collect for you and keep this idle beach running until the junk turns into treasure.

5522040.title: Song of Ashes
5522040.short_description: Song of Ashes is a fantasy war action game. Fight through massive battles with powerful Musou attacks, command your troops, move seamlessly from the world map into combat, advance your units, and make camp between encounters.

5522290.title: See Through Static: The Collection
5522290.short_description: SEE THROUGH STATIC: THE COLLECTION contains 4 First-Person Psychological Horror Games. Each showcasing new perspectives, mechanics, and insight into the overall story. Search through cryptic tapes and radio frequencies. Examine bodies and report your findings. Can you uncover the truth in time?

5522310.title: Tiny Desktop Terrarium
5522310.short_description: Tiny Desktop Terrarium is a glass world that lives on your desktop. You build it however you want, add creatures and inhabitants then watch it grow and flourish while you use your computer and go about your day. Pop in whenever you want to see how things are evolving!

5522350.title: Rustlot
5522350.short_description: Drop junked cars onto belts. Watch the shredder chew them into scrap, the magnet pull iron from copper, the smelter pour glowing ingots, and the press stamp hubcaps for cash. A cozy, tactile 2D junkyard factory game with an honest finish line — sell the lot or keep optimizing.

5522360.title: Seek Lot
5522360.short_description: Evolve a tiny neural-net brain that learns to drive a scrap buggy across 12 hazard-filled lots. Watch 100 ghost buggies a generation get sharper, buy sensors and upgrades, race your own or a friend's ghost (SL1: codes), export GIF bloopers, and prestige your lab. Pay once: no IAP.

5522400.title: Moon Zero
5522400.short_description: Moon Zero is a fast-paced 2D space runner where you pilot a rocket through 18 increasingly difficult stages. Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect coins, unlock rocket skins, compete on leaderboards, and create your own maps. Can you survive the 2,000,000-mile journey?

5522710.title: Shield Line: Riot Police Tactics
5522710.short_description: A real-time tactics game where you command riot police in a living city. Read hundreds of simulated people, draw your shield line, negotiate or intervene. 30 missions, 12 unit types, and every call you make becomes tomorrow's headline.

5522780.title: Pistara
5522780.short_description: There's been a murder and no one left the house. Place every suspect on the floor plan using the clues and the rules, and the culprit is revealed: whoever was alone with the victim. A deduction game where you don't guess who did it; you work out where everyone was.

5522900.title: SpaceTD
5522900.short_description: A space tower defense game about stopping the invading spaceships

5523020.title: One More Chest!
5523020.short_description: One More Chest! is an active incremental game about smashing chests that walk, bite and explode. Hover and your hammer swings for you: chain lightning across the desk, set off bombs, spread lava, unlock six hammers and prestige until one swing sets off the whole table.

5523440.title: Stolen Frequencies
5523440.short_description: Run a pirate radio station in this open-world life and business sim set in 1980s England. Collect 59 playable songs, secretly record gigs and stay ahead of the police. Explore eight towns, repair radios, build businesses and work towards your own music venue.

5524570.title: Monster Mine IDLE
5524570.short_description: A free-to-play idle mining game: build a crew of cute miners, explore six biomes, open chests and eggs, and forge gear. Collapse the game into a compact bar and let the mine keep working while you use your computer.

5524610.title: Goblin Must Clean
5524610.short_description: An incremental cleaning game in first person. You are a goblin with one plate in your hands and a mountain of 500,000 to go. Wash them for Gold and spend the Gold at the hearth, until magic does the dishes for you.

5524730.title: Bit Universe
5524730.short_description: Grow a tiny voxel town into a solar-system economy. Build and upgrade neighborhoods, unlock districts, research technology and trade between worlds in a relaxed idle city builder. Includes desktop and optional PC VR, with shared Windows saves.

5524750.title: Magehold Wanderlight
5524750.short_description: A black storm of living ink is swallowing the world. Gather a small crew, build a cozy house on giant legs, and walk ahead of it. Harvest, trade and grow your walker by day, defend it by lamplight at night, until you are strong enough to turn around and face the storm.

5524760.title: Task Bar Deads
5524760.short_description: A tiny zombie survival game that lives on your Windows taskbar. Your pixel survivor fights the undead, gathers loot and grows stronger while you work. Forge better gear, build your skills and take on giant bosses.

5524900.title: Off-Road With Your Friends
5524900.short_description: Pack your friends into boxy 4x4s and head into the wild. Up to 8 players drive one convoy through autumn forests, rivers and snowy passes, get stuck in the mud, winch each other out, change flat tyres and camp at dusk. Nobody gets left behind.

5525490.title: Ceasefire Line
5525490.short_description: An isometric RTS in a fictional war-torn coastal city. Command one of three asymmetric forces, build a base, and take the city block by block. Buildings collapse piece by piece with real physics, and every civilian caught between the lines is counted against you.

5525950.title: EYESIGHT
5525950.short_description: Tag party game where seeing is a skill

5525960.title: Crown & Claw
5525960.short_description: War looms over a world divided by five powerful factions. In Crown & Claw, an epic 8-bit fantasy RPG, follow a Holy Knight whose journey uncovers ancient secrets, challenges centuries of hatred, and reveals a dark truth that could change the fate of humans and monsters alike.

5526030.title: The Last Button
5526030.short_description: Buy block-shaped buttons, fit them onto a floating board and click them for cash. Harder shapes pay bigger multipliers. Coat buttons in 40 materials, let rabbits, drones and a repair robot work for you, ride out storms and meteor showers, and grow your board until the Last Button fits.

5526040.title: Pro & College Football Coach
5526040.short_description: Call every snap from the sideline, then run everything off the field. Recruit with NIL money and the transfer portal, climb from college to the pros, and draft, trade and manage the salary cap in a living football world of four leagues and 306 clubs. Fully moddable.

5526340.title: Booster Beast
5526340.short_description: Booster Beasts is an incremental pack-smashing game. Equip up to six mythical beasts, and unleash all their skills with every strike. Combine elemental bonuses, evolve your beasts, and build the firepower to crack tougher packs and take on bosses.

5526810.title: Bosky
5526810.short_description: Escape your school, avoid being seen by the teachers, and retrieve your backpacks and other things before getting outta here.

5526980.title: Planet Chess
5526980.short_description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

5527000.title: Seat The Queen
5527000.short_description: A strategic tug-of-war card game where four Queens decide the crown. Push, pull, protect, and disrupt your way to four thrones. Plan each round carefully, outplay your rival, and play solo, locally, or online.

5527290.title: Ironclads 3
5527290.short_description: A hardcore historical naval combat sim set in the Age of Iron & Steam, built around meticulous historical detail. Command a warship and its specialist crew as they man guns, operate steam propulsion and shipboard machinery, keep the vessel battle-ready, and fight fires and flooding under enemy fire.

5527680.title: Red Door - Horror Maze
5527680.short_description: Close your eyes and play the old sleepover game. Wake up in a maze that changes every time you enter. Find the key, hide from dangers, open a door and face whoever waits behind it. Only one way back to life...

5527800.title: No Asteroids
5527800.short_description: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig.

5527940.title: Inkfall
5527940.short_description: Draw anything on a blank page and stamp it awake. Draw wings and it flies, draw fire and it breathes fire. Even a tangle of lines or a single dot wakes up with a name and its own moves, then goes off to fight other players' drawings.

5527960.title: Polish Liquor Store Tidy Up
5527960.short_description: Turn a chaotic delivery into neatly stocked shelves in a cozy Polish liquor store. Sort bottles, snacks and Christmas trinkets, tune the radio, befriend a ginger cat and uncover the little stories behind the shop. Take your time. One item at a time.

5528010.title: Mystery At Windmill Farm
5528010.short_description: One missing egg. A farm full of stories that don't quite add up. Play as Reed, a duck detective, in a cozy 3D mystery. Explore a colorful miniature farm, question eccentric animals, follow the clues in your notebook, and trade cheese for gossip. Can you untangle the truth?

5528270.title: The Crooked Table
5528270.short_description: Four players. Three secret sides. One table full of liars. Play every card face down, claim whatever you like, and bet your chips that someone else is lying. Help your team, sabotage the table, or play everyone for yourself. Just don’t get caught.

5528370.title: Planetary Wars
5528370.short_description: Planetary Wars begins when humanity discovers quantum ports to a new Earth-sized exoplanet. Take your one-way ticket and conquer it by land, sea, air and space with thousands of players. Play solo or with friends, chat via text-to-speech and fight as a jetpack super-soldier with keyboard or gamepad.

5528420.title: Trapped: Last Exit
5528420.short_description: Wake up trapped in a collapsed underground factory. Dig through rubble, sell sand, Buy upgrades and escape. A cozy, satisfying, and relaxing incremental mining adventure!

5528470.title: Gift Shop Organizer
5528470.short_description: Unpack boxes, discover charming items, and find a place for every piece in a cozy little gift shop. Upgrade your skills to make organizing easier, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting things in order. No timers, no penalties - just time to unwind.

5528540.title: Into The Nightwood
5528540.short_description: Lead a party of heroes into The Nightwood in this dark fantasy card battler. Recruit companions, combine abilities and equipment, and face powerful bosses across a series of runs. Experiment with new builds as you search for the source of a spreading darkness.

5528590.title: Kitsune Kart
5528590.short_description: Race as kemonomimi yokai girls through 24 courses of Japanese folklore, from fox shrines to Raijin's thunderclouds. Drift, boost and hurl yokai mischief at your rivals to take the lead.

5528700.title: Primary School – English Grade 1 & 2
5528700.short_description: A complete English learning app for Grade 1 & 2. Explore 20+ curriculum topics with guided explanations, multiple-choice quizzes, progress tracking, spaced repetition, and final year tests. Cute animated teachers make learning fun, structured, and confidence-building for kids and parents alike.

5528730.title: Maths Pals
5528730.short_description: Join six adorable animal friends on a journey to master math! From counting to multiplication, tackle fun challenges, earn stars, and watch your skills soar—all at your own pace!

5528740.title: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
5528740.short_description: Follow Amara into a cursed sun temple in this story-driven marble shooter. Pop the color chains before they reach the temple heart, and clear each level to unlock the next story beat.

5528750.title: Zumba - The Dragon's Marble Trial
5528750.short_description: The dragon’s marbles are rolling—only you can stop them! In Zumba – The Dragon’s Marble Trial, shoot, match, and explode marbles before they reach the end. Unleash draconic power-ups, and blaze through mythical worlds. Grab your fire-breath and let the marble-matching magic begin!

5528760.title: GET FIT - Women’s Fitness
5528760.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

5528770.title: GET FIT - Men's Fitness
5528770.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

5528780.title: Tanky Tanks - Reloaded
5528780.short_description: Tanky Tanks - Reloaded is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

5528790.title: Aery - Surreal World
5528790.short_description: In the story-driven flight exploration game Aery – Surreal World you play as a tiny bird shaped spirit drifting through impossible, dreamlike worlds on a journey to restore balance to a universe where reality has come undone.

5528800.title: Veggie Warfare - Feast of Fury
5528800.short_description: The veggies have snapped! Blast through endless waves of enraged carrots, onions, and mutant tomatoes in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS. Collect upgrades, unlock new arenas, and survive the Feast of Fury — where dinner fights back!

5528810.title: Emoji Battlefield - Island Warfare
5528810.short_description: A chaotic rogue-like FPS set on a mysterious island where ancient tiki emojis rise to attack! Choose modifiers, unlock new arenas, and survive endless waves of emoji warriors. Dash, jump, shoot, and use jungle traps or temple hazards to outsmart the swarm.

5528880.title: Pawlifters!
5528880.short_description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

5528900.title: CombatBox: Reboot
5528900.short_description: A large-scale war with hundreds of soldiers on one map, on an ordinary PC. Smart AI fills your squad and the enemy's: they radio positions, flank and pull downed friends out. Tanks, helicopters, jets and bombers share the battlefield. Customize your soldiers and add anything with mods.

5529210.title: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
5529210.short_description: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

5529340.title: BallerZ
5529340.short_description: Fast, physics-based online football in the spirit of Haxball. Dribble, curl shots, dash and ghost past defenders in matches up to 6v6. Start a club, climb a league pyramid of real divisions, play cups and friendlies, and chat with your country's community. Free to play.

5529400.title: Temple of Patience: [ 1xSCREEN//0xRNG ]
5529400.short_description: 1 screen, 4 coins, and 0* RNG. Yes, it's a retro style puzzle-platformer — not hard to guess. But you're probably wondering why there's an asterisk next to the zero, aren't you?

5529480.title: HELLFIRE OF DOOM
5529480.short_description: HELLFIRE OF DOOM is an incremental boomer shooter about Valera, an office worker who storms hell to avenge his beloved ficus. An imp peed in it. Blast through frantic runs, collect demon blood and spend it on 70+ upgrades until you're the scariest thing down there.

5529490.title: NECROTIDE
5529490.short_description: Your enemies are your next recruits. In this survivor roguelite, raise the fallen, pull your undead army into a wall to block incoming fire, and fuse your soldiers into monsters like the Bone Wyrm. Can your army bring down the Pale King?

5529710.title: OVERFIT
5529710.short_description: Fit geometric pieces to complete cards, combine Cores, and craft powerful synergies in this satisfying, minimalist puzzle roguelite. Trigger massive OVERFITS to overcome game-changing challenges before your actions run out.

5530240.title: Ashen Rain
5530240.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

5530860.title: Sigildeep
5530860.short_description: A deckbuilding dungeon crawler where every card is a spell on the front and a piece of the dungeon on the back. Lay cards down to build the way forward, fight with what you didn't spend, win packs and build better decks.

5530950.title: SonDem
5530950.short_description: Son Dem is a 3D online social game set in a traditional Turkish coffeehouse for up to 20 players. Play backgammon, 101 Okey and chess with friends, watch matches as a spectator, and join the conversation through voice and text chat.

5531190.title: Stormtail
5531190.short_description: The night ferry is heading for the reef. As Volt, a fox courier, leap across rooftops, dash through barriers and battle an old friend’s airships in this 2D platformer. Find hidden paths across six chapters, then race all 48 campaign routes for a spot on the Steam leaderboard.

5531370.title: Dig The World
5531370.short_description: There's a message buried beneath the Earth, and it was written for you. Dig through 10 regions in this incremental mining game: upgrade your laser, hire a crew, and uncover it cube by cube. Who left it there?

5531520.title: The Long Run
5531520.short_description: A giant robot is hunting you, and the only way out is forward. The Long Run is an arcade racer meets run-and-gun on an endless road. Across wide and narrow platforms at full speed: drift, (double) jump, blast enemies, grab power-ups and collect scraps to upgrade your car.

5531590.title: Lost In Trash
5531590.short_description: Explore a massive landfill as a small robot, collect resources, fight trash monsters and upgrade your equipment. Start with nothing and build your way up in a world where even garbage has value. Multiplayer is planned for the future!

5531610.title: GBald
5531610.short_description: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

5531630.title: HELLEVATOR
5531630.short_description: A freight elevator descends the hundreds of floors of hell. Every time it stops, the doors open and demons pile in. KILL. THEM. ALL. Pixel-art carnage, bosses that come apart, and no way back up.

5531650.title: Hollow Winter
5531650.short_description: The war is over. The winter is not. Years after a global conflict, the dangers that surround you in the north are not zombies or looters. It's the cold, the ashes, the wolves and the fire you manage to light. Keep it burning.

5531750.title: Hegemony
5531750.short_description: 214 states, thousands of regions, and limitless strategic possibilities! Manage your economy, shape politics, forge diplomatic ties, strengthen your military, and shift the global balance of power. Establish your own world order and leave your mark on history!

5531880.title: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth
5531880.short_description: I made a little turn-based puzzle game out of free emoji. Grab the gems, reach the exit, stay out of the guards’ way. Simple! Except something got into my levels, and it keeps moving things while you play. So I drew you some tools: Cut, Copy, Paste and Nudge. Edit them back.

5531890.title: Druzy Grotto
5531890.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about collecting creatures in a cave. Crack a geode and flip four cards, one creature on each. Feed the babies tucked into the cave wall until they grow up and wander out, some with a rare shiny finish. Keep the best, sell the rest, and open seven caves of 210 species.

5531960.title: The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf
5531960.short_description: A dungeon-crawler adventure where your mission is to rescue a kidnapped president.

5532470.title: Idle Forgewarden
5532470.short_description: A cozy pixel-art blacksmith forge that lives on your desktop and keeps working while you do other things. Step in whenever you like to time the hammer, take commissions, arm adventurers for the road and grow a humble forge into a legendary smithy.

5532610.title: Keymancer: A Vim Roguelite
5532610.short_description: Every keystroke is a real Vim command. Move with hjkl, press i and type your attacks in Insert Mode, and when you're strong enough, dd deletes enemies off the map like lines of text. A pixel roguelite of short runs and long mastery. You'll learn Vim by accident.

5532670.title: ONE MILLION CUBES
5532670.short_description: A first-person arena shooter against one million cubes. They pour out of the sky, flock round you and build weapons out of themselves. One touch and you are dead. Every cube you break can be turned into upgrades on a skill cube for future runs. The goal is to break all one million cubes in one run.

5532860.title: Sortman
5532860.short_description: A Swiss sorting hall buried under a million letters and parcels. Sort by hand, weigh, throw, load the vans, answer furious customers, then build a chain of belts and machines that fills the vans by itself. Solo or up to four players, no timer.

5532870.title: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
5532870.short_description: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

5532930.title: Khanate: Fire Before Dark
5532930.short_description: Historical grand strategy on the Central Asian steppe, 1646. Rule one of thirty realms, or start as a lone rider and climb to the throne, while four empires close in and grow stronger every year. Build your state and win your wars while they can still be won.

5533050.title: No one outside
5533050.short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a large reactive city. Explore, loot, drive, build defenses, and survive massive hordes when night falls.

5533070.title: Breakpoint
5533070.short_description: BREAKPOINT is a tactical card battler with a twist on classic playing cards. Outplay your opponent with Singles, Pairs, Straights, and Bombs. Build Rage when you pass, unleash BREAK to turn the tables, and explore new strategies with each character's unique abilities.

5533110.title: Before the Pyre
5533110.short_description: Lead a secret coven through plague and witch hunts in this turn-based dark fantasy strategy game. Study forbidden magic, bargain with nobles and ancient spirits, and protect your witches. A spell can save a life—and leave the evidence that condemns you.

5533280.title: Chess Mutator
5533280.short_description: Chess Mutator reinvents chess with game-changing mutations, strategic AI battles, and a 40+ level campaign. Master ever-changing rules, conquer unique challenges, and continue your progress across supported platforms with one account.

5533350.title: Ascension Trail: Idle Crusade
5533350.short_description: Your heroes fight. You choose the path. Recruit a party from nine roles, gear them up, and pair clashing elements for devastating combos.

5533510.title: Short Circuit
5533510.short_description: It never stops raining in this abandoned world. Use your disc to turn the machines back on and find out what happened. A minimalist puzzle-platformer made with PICO-8.

5533780.title: Kpop Infinite
5533780.short_description: Build and run your own K-pop entertainment company. Scout trainees, form your idol group, produce comebacks, and guide your artists from a tiny office to a global entertainment empire across generations that never truly end.

5533820.title: Nobody Special
5533820.short_description: Choose your job, age, family, neighborhood and temperament, then carry that ordinary life through the first days of an outbreak. A narrated dice-and-choice RPG where who you were opens doors, closes others, and decides who walks with you to the end.

5534090.title: Hoppkins: Twinkle World
5534090.short_description: Hoppkins: Twinkle World is a charming 3D platform adventure where you explore colorful worlds, leap across platforms, use unique abilities and vehicles, and face challenging enemies. Join Mr. Hoppkins and venture beyond the clouds to rescue his beloved!

5534140.title: Retro Party
5534140.short_description: Nostalgia for '90s games: 25+ mini-games in a single party. Play online with up to 8 people, or 4 on the same screen. Every game is its own kind of chaos: racing, shooting, a battle of wills, and plenty more. A chance to relive the good old days with your friends.

5534210.title: 52 Card Pickup
5534210.short_description: Fifty-two decks, one very messy table. Flip, find and slot every card back into its pack across 25 gloriously messier levels, chase the fleeting Gold Cards, and call up to 3 friends to help clean up... or race them to it.

5534320.title: 내일의 챔피언 (Tomorrow's Champion)
5534320.short_description: We've all dreamed of racing our own mini car, haven't we? Build and tune your mini racer, discover hidden Overdrives, and outsmart rivals with strategic pit stops. Race your way to the championship! BOOST ON!

5534480.title: The Garden of Human-Shaped Organblooms
5534480.short_description: Harvest organs from “Organblooms”—plants that look like human children and grow transplantable organs—and manage Somnus Conservatory, the facility they call home, in this morally bankrupt facility-management simulation.
publishers: クリエイターのうえきばち

5534600.title: Faunaville
5534600.short_description: Care for animals, build lasting bonds, and learn new abilities from your companions in Faunaville, a cozy farming RPG. Grow crops, cook meals, fish, help the townsfolk, and explore alongside an animal buddy in turn-based battles. All at your own pace. No stamina bar, no day clock, do what you want.

5534890.title: VOXHELL
5534890.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

5534900.title: Jennifer Against Space Aliens
5534900.short_description: Jennifer Against Space Aliens is an action-packed, third person, sci-fi shooter with 1980s vibes. Run, drive, shoot and blow things up inside space stations, spaceships and distant planets.

5534960.title: A Minor War
5534960.short_description: An auto battler where your build is the music. Give each instrument a phrase of notes, then lock it in and listen to your ensemble fight another player's. Your trumpet sounds out every Fireball you gave it, and your drum keeps time with its Blocks.

5535070.title: One More Nugget
5535070.short_description: Mine rocks, collect gold nuggets, and grow your workshop in this pixel-art incremental game. Unlock new rooms, put helpers to work, and invest in upgrades and permanent research. Every nugget brings you closer to your next upgrade.

5535150.title: Dose of Order: Pharmacy Tidy Up
5535150.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying sim. After a stormy night, over 6,000 products cover your pharmacy floor. Pick up, sort and shelve every one in its place, unlock talents that sweep up and auto-place for you, and restore the whole shop from chaos to spotless.

5535250.title: Splatterdunk
5535250.short_description: 90s-arcade 2-on-2 or 3 -on -3 basketball where the players are monsters and the fouls are fatal. Chain trick dunks, arm Fatalities, bribe the ref and dunk on monsters through the glass while VAT-9, a robot announcer who used to be a star, calls it. Up to 6 players, couch or online. Bring a mop.

5535330.title: sportsbook
5535330.short_description: The sports betting roguelike. sportsbook is a high-stakes sports betting simulator where you stake your bankroll on a variety of props, swing for the fences on parlays, discover game-changing perks to juice the odds in your favor, and turn small bets into outrageous payouts through strategic combos.

5535420.title: Cordonfall
5535420.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

5535510.title: Hexball
5535510.short_description: Six teams, one hex pitch, and metal balls everywhere. Hire warriors from across history, see the odds of every block, dodge and pass before you commit, then live with the roll. Your players level up, get hurt and can be lost for good. Up to six players on one PC, or against computer coaches.

5535550.title: Lunnitsa
5535550.short_description: Lunnitsa is a 3D companion who lives on your desktop. She talks with you out loud, listens when you call her, looks at your screen if you let her and helps with tasks on your PC, always with your permission. You choose what she thinks with: the cloud or your own computer.

5535750.title: Tanks & Trebuchets
5535750.short_description: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.

5535800.title: Arkhanium
5535800.short_description: Arkham lies in ruins; humanity has lost the battle. Now is the time to perform the ritual to summon the Great Old Ones in a turn-based, tactical PvP battle. Establish your dominion and seize power over the Earth!

5535880.title: Elysian Realms
5535880.short_description: A pixel-art tower defense for PC. Hold the road across seven realms. Each one changes a rule of the game, not the scenery. Every run, won or lost, feeds a skill tree that carries over to the next. No account, no telemetry: it runs on your machine and nowhere else.

5535940.title: Diceocracy: UK
5535940.short_description: Win a by-election, then survive the diary. Hard choices go to a physics d20 thrown against a difficulty class. Climb from the back benches to Number Ten in a House of Commons where the seats are real and every politician is invented.

5536090.title: The Final Ideology
5536090.short_description: Lead your faction through the Third Cold War in this turn-based grand strategy. Millennia after the destruction of Earth, survivors of the Communist and Capitalist superpowers have forged enormous multi-planetary factions that have recently re-discovered one another. Which side will you take?

5536190.title: Shellcrushers
5536190.short_description: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.

5536240.title: Be Original
5536240.short_description: In this game you have the one goal of making many original characters as you can. The two rules? you cant make a character you've already made and you cant make a popular character that already exist.

5536370.title: Deadlines
5536370.short_description: A multiplayer melee combat game where you and your coworkers are trapped in a sprawling office building with an impossible deadline. Work together to survive, form alliances to improve your odds, or turn on your coworkers before they turn on you.

5536390.title: Glyphwild
5536390.short_description: Glyphwild is a 3D bullet-heaven roguelite where runes combine. Socket a fireball under a lightning rune and fireballs rain on shocked foes. Wire wild rune chains, carve through thousands of creatures and towering bosses across 6 living vales, alone or in online co-op.

5536560.title: Big Bad Wool
5536560.short_description: Wolves in sheep's clothing versus watchful shepherds. Blend into the flock, fool your friends or spot the impostors. BigBadWool is an asymmetric hide-and-seek game for 2–6 players online, with bot practice to learn both sides.

5536670.title: Grindhouse Theater Simulator
5536670.short_description: September 1983. Eighty seats, one projector, your choice of double bill. Run the Rialto in a first-person theater sim: book genre films, sell tickets and popcorn, hire the Grindhouse Gang and keep the show running when the print snaps and the crowd loses patience.

5536730.title: Athletics Live: Track & Field
5536730.short_description: A skill-based athletics game where your hands decide who wins. Mash to sprint, clear the hurdles, hit the board and release at 45°. Every men's and women's event, relays, decathlon and heptathlon, and a World Tour from club meets to the Global Games. Race your friends online.

5536800.title: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
5536800.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

5536820.title: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion
5536820.short_description: September 1981. A bedroom, a workbench, a dream: build a computer empire. Assemble, repair and sell PCs in 3D through the real hardware of 1981 to 2025 under parodied names, from the garage to the factory, and aim for a billion.

5536910.title: WordSearch Kingdom
5536910.short_description: Find hidden words and unwind at your own pace. Explore 10 puzzle languages with 960 levels each, trace words in changing directions, and use a hint when you need one. No time limit, with your progress saved automatically.

5536950.title: Same Day Tycoon
5536950.short_description: Someone just ordered a giant rubber duck, and you promised it today. Every order is a real parcel: follow it from the shelf to the box, onto the van and up to the doorstep. Build the warehouses, hire the crew and send vans, trucks and trains across North America to keep your promise.

5536960.title: Dinky Derby
5536960.short_description: Eight tiny cars, ten game modes and absolutely no manners. Race, chase, climb and parachute through a tournament of arcade car chaos, armed with rockets, anvils and boxing gloves. Battle your friends online or fill the grid with CPU rivals.

5537080.title: Cuddle Puddle
5537080.short_description: Cuddle Puddle is a short, cozy incremental game about calling cats together. No click-spamming: your paw's love zone goes pspsps on its own, cats pounce on each other and burst into hearts. Grow a conga line, raise your cat tree and fill five places with cuddles. :3

5537360.title: Gridiron Foundry Pro Football Manager
5537360.short_description: Build your roster, shape your schemes, and call the plays in an original football simulation. Lead one of 32 clubs through drafts, contracts, rivalries, and championships. Run a solo dynasty or compete with friends in a shared online league.

5537370.title: Defiance
5537370.short_description: Explore a new continent in this pixel art action RPG. Choose from ten classes, build your hero with skills and loot, take on quests, world events and guardians solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Fully translated into 30 languages.

5537480.title: SUFA: Strike Fighter
5537480.short_description: Fly a modern strike fighter low over a real, 1:1 map of Israel. Thread the Tel Aviv towers, explore 120+ real places in Free Flight, fly six sorties from training to historic 1967 and 1981 strikes, and land it back home. Easy to learn, with a live coach.

5537500.title: Fable of: Hero's Army
5537500.short_description: Fable of: Hero's Army is a dark fantasy auto battler card game with roguelite runs and over 200,000 possible card combinations. Choose one of six heroes, gather allies and gear in the tavern, and travel through seven lands. Every run writes a new page.

5537960.title: Anomaly Bird
5537960.short_description: An anomaly-spotting game meets the bird you already know and love... or hate. See something wrong? Fly into the pipe.

5537980.title: Cheese Panic
5537980.short_description: An online 4v1 heist where four mice have 15 minutes to steal enough food while one cat hunts them down. Every mouse they fail to revive costs the team a life. Proximity voice chat included, so keep it down.

5538240.title: Riders Of The Nine Planes
5538240.short_description: A mounted cavalier rogue-like across the Multiverse. Charge at enemies with your stored potential energy from galloping in a straight line, but beware; you are vulnerable once stationary after charging! Later develops into a strategy game in the late stages as you rise in power and control areas.

5538400.title: Honed to Perfection
5538400.short_description: In Asterra, a young swordsman left with nothing but a debt of one million gold climbs the Ascendancy Tower to challenge the Demon King. Master Fire, Ice, Bio and Thunder in a stylized action RPG with no XP and no levels: every bit of power is earned with gold and chosen by you.

5538410.title: The Way: The Life and Ministry of Jesus
5538410.short_description: Experience the life and ministry of Jesus Christ in this 30-chapter, story-driven biblical adventure. Explore the world of the Gospels, meet the people who encountered Jesus, and walk the path that changed history.

5538470.title: SCRAPFLUX
5538470.short_description: Turn scrap into ammo in a sci-fi top-down shooter. Pull metal in with your magnet, hurl it at enemies or deposit it for credits to upgrade your robot. Fight through 12 maps with bosses and face endless waves in Survival mode.

5538780.title: My Shitty Life
5538780.short_description: Life sucks. Make sure your friends' lives suck worse! My Shitty Life is a darkly comedic 3D board game where you work lousy jobs, pay rent, buy ridiculous items, and sabotage your friends while trying to avoid bankruptcy. Play solo, locally, or with friends through Steam Remote Play Together.

5538800.title: Sword Finger R
5538800.short_description: A typing RPG for everyone, from beginners to experts!!This is NOT a typing practice program!!Every keystroke leads to attacks, defense, and rewards!!(No manual needed. Playtime: Approximately 1 hour.)Supported keyboard layouts: Japanese (JIS) and English (US) only.[F11] Full Screen

5538810.title: Drain It All
5538810.short_description: Drain a 10,000-ton dam, starting with a paper cup. Sell water, buy pumps, build a filtering and bottling plant, and find out what is at the bottom of the dam. A first-person incremental game about one extremely bad plan.

5539240.title: 无双屠龙
5539240.short_description: 《无双屠龙》是一款回归纯粹打宝与PK的微变传奇。所有装备全爆，地图无VIP限制，散人友好。核心玩法包括：多大陆解锁、四象神装、元神、八门、灵器等深度养成系统。特色属性包含百分比切割、斩杀、鞭尸，大幅提升BOSS击杀效率。通过沙城捐献、首充双倍、VIP超值礼包快速成长，限时首爆奖励灵符，平民也能霸服。超多BOSS、混沌之地、封魔录等挑战等你来战。

5539290.title: Iris: The World
5539290.short_description: A classic free-to-play fantasy MMORPG returns in Q1 2027. Choose Human, Elf or Hybrid, wield the power of the tarot, transform into the monsters you hunt and set out from the fortress of Terminus to recover the shattered Ipinidas Rune.

5539420.title: Raisin Universe
5539420.short_description: Turn your stream chat into the players. Viewers type in Twitch or TikTok chat to pop mines, race marbles and fight over property in 16 minigames and 3 party board games. Only you buy the game: your viewers play free.

5540170.title: Idle Puzzler
5540170.short_description: Puzzle shops don't run themselves. Yours will, eventually. Solve Sudoku, word locks and colour codes, hire staff who keep solving while you're away, and watch a market stall grow into something much bigger.

5540420.title: Canaanite Falls
5540420.short_description: Return to your roots and connect with the Levant like never before in Canaanite Falls, a brand new monster-taming RPG and decolonial journey from WaveyGaming Productions.

5540540.title: Zero Gumbit
5540540.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker-style hands, stack Chips and Mult with 145 wild Jokers and break eight Antes of Boss Blinds. Swear risky vows in the Gambit, fuse Jokers at the altar. No gambling, no betting, no real money. Just combos.

5540670.title: Pawlosseum
5540670.short_description: A turn-based roguelite of duo battles. Climb a 100-floor fighting tower with your elemental siblings: act by speed, boost your strikes, chain combo attacks and play to the crowd. Cheers raise your pay, boos cut it. Every run, a new path from the Pit to the Crown.

5540850.title: Kingsreach
5540850.short_description: Kingsreach is a open world bullet-hell action RPG set in a colorful kingdom under a tyrant's rule. Dodge deadly patterns, unleash powerful abilities, and combine weapons, armor, and charms. Explore hidden paths, battle through dungeons, and take on fearsome bosses on your way to unseat a tyrant.

5540990.title: Hushwell
5540990.short_description: Hushwell is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania. For a hundred years, nothing has been born. Something deep below has woken you, the last small spark near the surface. Go down through fourteen areas, past old things grown vast in the dark, and find out why the world went silent.

5541260.title: Hard Recall
5541260.short_description: Los Ceniza, after midnight. Halvorsen's household androids have turned on their owners, and Meridian Mutual pays on every recall. Lead a squad of claims operators, solo or with up to three friends, through rain-soaked neon streets in a twin-stick noir shooter where every block is new.

5541360.title: Ballochet
5541360.short_description: Five balls, one cannon, a city of rooftop contraptions. Bank shots off beams, springs, rubber and swinging boards to ring the bell in 60 hand-built ricochet puzzles. Each ball scores less than the last, so make the first shot count.

5541530.title: Woolfall
5541530.short_description: A physics sandbox about mining with sheep. Dig a mine, route your flock past glowing caves for finer wool, then flood it, burn it or blow it up. Sheep go poof and drift home. That’s normal. Solo, or co-op with up to three friends to blame.

5541720.title: Gutter Scrap
5541720.short_description: Bolt a war machine together from trash in this mech shooter. Then take your city back from the scrap dealer who crowned himself General. Nine districts, nine bosses, 41 parts to mix and match, and a mech that can dance.

5541730.title: Night Lab
5541730.short_description: Run the night-shift lab of a busy hospital by hand. Open each sample bag, label the tubes, spin the centrifuge and check every result before you stamp it. Call the doctor on critical values. Buy new machines, paint the walls, or invite a friend to share the shift.

5541750.title: Frontier Miner
5541750.short_description: Frontier Miner is a competitive sci-fi battle royale. Mine asteroids for ore, forge upgrades for your weapons and gear, then race rival players to destroy the pirate space station first. Outmine, outbuild, and outgun everyone to claim the frontier.

5541910.title: Eggcellent Guess
5541910.short_description: A silly online party game for up to 12 friends. Everyone can read the word on your egg's headband except you. Ask questions, listen to the clues and guess it before the stopwatch gets away from you. Fastest total time wins.

5542070.title: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
5542070.short_description: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

5542110.title: Depot Nine
5542110.short_description: Lead a squad of survivors on tactical extraction raids. Search the ruins, fight for every crate and make it to the exit, because the gear you lose out there stays lost. Build up your base, rescue the missing and find out what really happened at Depot 9.

5542290.title: Cinder Scav: 2381
5542290.short_description: Built 100% end-to-end by AI agents in Unreal Engine 5.8, Cinder Scav: 2381 is a 30+ km² seamless open-world Top-Down & Third-Person Shooter (TPS). Explore all 148 completed hand-crafted-grade POIs, command 50 drivable wasteland vehicles, step inside the 8-plate Bulwark Mk III Power Armor, and survive 150+ zombie hordes!

5542300.title: Flying Island Miner
5542300.short_description: Rise above the clouds and unearth the treasures of a floating island in this relaxing digging simulator. Dig through its layers, build a collection of curious finds, and unleash the full power of your tools. From your very first dig to the last grain of sand.

5542380.title: This Game Is Not For You: It's For AI
5542380.short_description: Hands off WASD - this game is NOT for humans to play manually! Built on Unreal Engine 5 by Dr. Wang, this 30-in-1 AI Esports Colosseum pits 15 AI model families across 30 competitive games and 90 maps. Craft smarter Strategy Prompts, deploy isolated AI workers, and watch AI battle for ELO supremacy!

5542450.title: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
5542450.short_description: A stock trading sim with a story mode and a free mode. Story mode: you start as a new trader on a US desk in 2010, with a tutorial week, client orders and an evening review of your fills. Free mode: open an account, pick your stake and trade a generated market, with margin and short selling.

5542490.title: Between the Days
5542490.short_description: Between the Days is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game inspired by everyday life in Japan. Sort objects, discover patterns, and solve little puzzles through simple clicks and drags. Take a relaxing journey through Tokyo's four seasons, even if you've never visited Japan.

5542520.title: GRIDDLE 66
5542520.short_description: GRIDDLE 66 is a hands-on fast-food job simulator. Grill burgers, prepare fries and drinks, serve customers, and clean up after each shift. Work solo or in 2-player online co-op, sharpen your skills, and rise from part-timer to the Hall of Fame.

5542550.title: OVERCLOCK: Neon Survival Protocol
5542550.short_description: A top-down neon roguelite. Survive hordes for six minutes, pick 1 of 3 upgrades on every level-up, trigger Overdrive and bring down the Overseer Prime. Credits buy permanent upgrades and new cores.

5542650.title: Murder in the Arctic Circle
5542650.short_description: Murder in the Arctic Circle is a point-and-click exploration, photography and mystery adventure game in which the backgrounds are actual photos of real Norway - they were shot on location.

5542840.title: One Step Higher
5542840.short_description: This is a 3D platformer where you must utilize the unique traits of two distinct spheres. Switch between them on the fly in 3D scenes to overcome challenging obstacles. There are currently 21 playable levels.

5543010.title: Harbourside
5543010.short_description: Build a busy little fishing harbour in this cosy management game. Send boats out, sell the day's catch, expand your pier and grow from a single rowboat to an automated fleet.

5543100.title: GNOME REDUCTION
5543100.short_description: Co-op for 1 to 4 grumpy grandpas. Sneak into a gnome village at night, grab the little pests with your bare hands, stuff them in a sack and sell them on the black market. The gnomes fight back, and the forest guardian is always watching.

5543360.title: Climb using controls not designed for humans.
5543360.short_description: This is an action-climbing game with controls not designed for human beings. Can you handle them?

5543380.title: Snowdrop Lane
5543380.short_description: Snow. Parcels. Neighbors. A cozy winter week as the new mail carrier on a buried street. Shovel, chip ice, fire up the snowblower, and let Dougie the dog sniff out what's under the drifts. Everyone on the lane needs a favor. Some will even say please.

5543560.title: Poligon 6
5543560.short_description: Year 3024. In a world controlled by AI, Maria receives her next task: complete Poligon 6 - eight unique sections of pure challenge. It’s simple… but far from easy. Her goal isn’t just to finish - it’s to gather as many tokens as she can.

5543570.title: GHOSTGRID
5543570.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

5543640.title: Gang Birds
5543640.short_description: Gang Birds is a bluffing and deduction game around a table in a backroom. Your job and two hidden contacts decide whether you play for the Gang, the Cops or the Junkies. Play with friends, up to 10 at one table, in 1v1 duels or against bots.

5543960.title: Round One, Fight!
5543960.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

5544010.title: Liquidation Inc.
5544010.short_description: A co-op physics horror for 1-4 friends: buy out the contents of haunted, foreclosed homes and haul everything to your van before the timer runs out. Every scratch costs money - and something still lives there.

5544070.title: Seolhwa Dungeon
5544070.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where you fight monsters from Korean folktales, and they act the way they do in the stories. Let the Imugi live too long and it becomes a dragon. If the reaper sees you for three turns, he calls your name. When you die, you start over in a new dungeon.

5544270.title: Sands of the Aftermath
5544270.short_description: Kite and windsurf survival in a world buried by sand: ride the dunes, grind the ruins, dig for water, grow your oasis – and find out what lies beneath the sand.

5544310.title: StakeBound
5544310.short_description: Shape the odds in a theatrical roulette battler. Stake chips on attacks, guards and rewards, time your spins, and turn a Perfect result into a dramatic finishing move. Read enemy intentions, adapt your build, and face a cast of masked rivals.

5544530.title: Totally Under Control!
5544530.short_description: Build routes. Break rocks. Try to keep the robots in one piece. A comic 2D puzzle game on Mars: assign ten specialised jobs, control the flow of your crew and improvise a way home through 150 increasingly devious missions. It's Totally Under Control!

5544560.title: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉
5544560.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

5544590.title: Bride of Koshchei
5544590.short_description: Masha falls asleep over a deadline in Moscow and wakes up as Vasilisa, a young woman promised to Koshchei. Learn the rules of the living forest, protect your true name, and choose an ally in a dark fantasy visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.

5544640.title: STUCK
5544640.short_description: Shake, kick, and upgrade a stubborn vending machine in this first-person incremental game. Collect coins, sell unexpected objects, and build increasingly ridiculous machinery to recover the one bag of chips you paid for.

5544730.title: Cave Saga
5544730.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

5544940.title: Fishly: Desktop Aquarium
5544940.short_description: A tiny pixel-art aquarium that lives on your desktop. Your fish swim, eat, sleep at night and earn gold while you work. Breed rare colours, fill your album, decorate your tank or let them swim across your whole wallpaper

5544950.title: Starward Protocol
5544950.short_description: Launch, collect, upgrade! Starward Protocol is an incremental rocket shooter. Build your firepower, expand your upgrade tree, dodge dense bullet patterns, and defeat mechanical bosses on your journey to the stars.

5545080.title: Seat of Power
5545080.short_description: Build an ancient kingdom as the Chinese, Egyptians, Greeks or Olmecs. Grow towns, run trade routes, win over independent cities, hunt monsters and summon your god in a real-time strategy game of economy, war and diplomacy. Then lead Atlantis in its own story campaign.

5545200.title: Lone Sands
5545200.short_description: Lone Sands is an exploration/atmospheric/trick game with wind-sail and kite riding across desert dunes, ocean waves, snow and ice. Its procedural world has huge weather systems, ancient ruins and places to discover, and no quest chain to follow.

5545430.title: Borderfall
5545430.short_description: Pick any country and fight a real time war on a real world map, solo or in online multiplayer with friends and strangers. Push the front, build, sign pacts, take vassals and trade hydrogen bombs. Play through plenty of historical scenarios while bots chase goals of their own.

5545470.title: Forge More, Mole!
5545470.short_description: Sell now, or try one more upgrade? Become a mole blacksmith and strike the anvil to raise your weapons' level and value. Head home after a day's trading, where unexpected events await to shake up your ordinary routine.

5545610.title: Home Before Dusk
5545610.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

5545700.title: DEAD ZONE: Idle Arsenal RPG
5545700.short_description: Your squad of animal soldiers fights hordes of infected on its own, even with the game closed. In this idle shooter RPG, you build the team, equip weapons, raise a bunker for survivors, and risk it all on expeditions for better loot.

5545900.title: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters
5545900.short_description: Cast. Haul. Gamble. Fire back. Build a fishing village in the dark, turn your catch into gold, luck and ammunition, and defend your pile from the monster rising out of the lake.

5546110.title: SwitcHead
5546110.short_description: SwitcHead is a chaotic online co-op game for 2 where you control your friend's head... and they control yours. Shout directions, search the factory, crack the safes and build each brick toy before the conveyor belt carries it away!

5546220.title: Dungelo
5546220.short_description: One dungeon a day, the same for everyone. Dungelo is a turn-based pixel roguelike you can finish in 15 minutes: read what each monster is about to do, answer it, and beat the floor 5 boss. Your first run counts on the daily board. Yesterday's best set today's challenge. Difficulty shifts with you.

5546230.title: Viland Chronicles 维兰德战纪
5546230.short_description: Viland Chronicles: classic Japanese-style turn-based tactical SLG. Fallen allies stay dead, level-ups give random stat growth, and custom stages post-game. Modern people stranded in another world ally with or fight its factions. Choices lead to different endings and change the continent's fate.
developers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.

5546350.title: Duck Billiards
5546350.short_description: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!

5546430.title: Seoul Night Bites
5546430.short_description: Run a tiny Korean street-food stall after midnight. Pick ingredient cards, cook 64 real Korean dishes and chain recipes into huge combos in this cozy roguelite deckbuilder. Pay the rent, then see how long you last in Endless Nights.

5546520.title: SkyAceBlitz
5546520.short_description: Top-down roguelike aerial shooter. Engage in realistic inertia dogfights, shoot down foes with machine guns and homing missiles. Gather random upgrades every run for distinct builds. Play with friends via Remote Play Together!

5546640.title: Christmas Lot Simulator
5546640.short_description: Run your own Christmas tree lot in a snowy Montana town. Sell every tree, cut it fresh, net it and strap it to the car. Take on a new job each day, hire a crew, grow from a corner lot to a second lot across town, keep Santa happy and make it to Christmas Eve.

5546680.title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
5546680.short_description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

5546750.title: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
5546750.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

5547200.title: Rainfed
5547200.short_description: Build and run your own farm in a pixel-art management sim. Grow crops, breed livestock and turn your harvest into products to sell. Buy land and machinery, hire workers and set plans to keep the work moving. Expand the business, shape the farm and try not to go broke.

5547270.title: Mondrian Puzzle
5547270.short_description: A zen-style puzzle game inspired by the works of Piet Mondrian. Finish puzzles your own way, play the colors, and save them as wallpapers for your phone or computer.

5547480.title: Breaking Protocol
5547480.short_description: Dodge bullets in a fast bullet hell boss rush against parodies of AI models. Every attack is telegraphed and you build your own playstyle from 64 exploits. Singleplayer, two players locally or online, plus 2 to 8 player raids.

5547490.title: Mars Gardener
5547490.short_description: Madame Odette, 74, hired for her hedges, must grow a posh suburban lawn on Mars. Sow, water, mow perfect stripes, sell your turf bricks to rich colonists, and weather dust storms, moles and −80 °C nights. The Red Planet will be green.

5547550.title: Little Battlefield
5547550.short_description: Little Battlefield is a top-down tactical shooter with a blue-ink art style. Capture control points and blast through walls in a solo campaign or co-op for up to four players. In Zombie Battlefield, scavenge by flashlight and fight off the horde until you can extract.

5547610.title: Survivor Town
5547610.short_description: Survivor Town blends colony management, autonomous survivor simulation, and tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit unique survivors, build production chains, research technology, craft equipment, explore dangerous lands, and defend your settlement against daily raids and powerful Bosses.

5547860.title: Clickbait Arcade
5547860.short_description: You've seen the ads. Pull the pin, pick the door, run through the x3 gate. The games never existed... until now. Clickbait Arcade is 12 fake mobile-ad games made real, in a neon arcade, with no ads, no energy timers and no pay-to-win.

5547890.title: Initial Investigation
5547890.short_description: A time-limited investigation mystery game. Watch suspects’ expressions closely, question them about each piece of evidence, and piece together their testimonies to deduce the full story behind the case.

5547910.title: Once Upon a Kill
5547910.short_description: Red Hood hunts what the fairy tales were afraid of. Break Koschei's death out of a needle, feed Baba Yaga to her own oven, shatter the Snow Queen's heart. A brutal 2D action game in cut paper, ink and one red. Every tale ends on the Tree.

5548160.title: Die Rich
5548160.short_description: Fight to clear the emperor’s debt in Die Rich, a gladiator action roguelite for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Cut through swarms, draft weapon upgrades and win the crowd. Conquer four arenas, explore the Wilds and claim seals on your path to freedom.

5548170.title: ESCAPE MY FAMILY
5548170.short_description: ESCAPE MY FAMILY is a retro PSX stealth survival horror. Every run, one of 4 crazy relatives (Dad, Uncle, Granny, or Grandpa) stalks you with unique behavior. Explore rooms, hide, collect randomized loot, and escape before you get caught!

5548360.title: Captain's Wake
5548360.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

5548370.title: CRT TD
5548370.short_description: Use your retro gadget weapons to defend against the mutated tech bros. On your turn, position your gadget weapons, prepare your defensive gadgets and grow your economy. Test your strategy and your build against encounters in procedurally generated levels.

5548570.title: Touhou: Don't Spill It!
5548570.short_description: One jar of water, two friends, and all of Gensokyo trying to make you spill it. Cirno dashes across the road, fairies throw stars, barrels roll in. Stop short and the water surges over the rim; a hard knock cracks the jar. What's left at the finish is your score. A Touhou Project fan game.

5548590.title: Equilibria
5548590.short_description: Release species on a small living planet, tip its balance and watch evolution answer. Populations adapt, split into new species and die out; continents drift, ice ages come and go, and clever species build villages and towns. A sandbox god game of ecology and evolution.

5548680.title: Meowward
5548680.short_description: Build a tower to rescue a cat stranded on the Moon! Chop trees, turn logs into wooden blocks and upgrade your equipment. Play solo or with friends, climb onto each other's shoulders and carve your own decorations. A cozy building sandbox with one very important cat.

5549270.title: Crack the Crate
5549270.short_description: Crack the Crate is a super-satisfying crate-smashing incremental game. Open crates, collect 288 items and their rare variants, and upgrade your way from wooden boxes to cosmic crates. Can you find the legendary Dodo?

5549350.title: UNHOLY PEPPERONI
5549350.short_description: A tiny pizzeria. A sister you love. A tragedy you can't escape. Run a pizzeria where the nights are unsettling, and every slice comes with a side of something sinister. But no matter how hard you try to keep the business, some things refuse to stay buried.

5549420.title: ZOO CATCHER / SUNSHARD FARM
5549420.short_description: A two-game indie collection featuring ZOO CATCHER, a keyboard typing game, and SUNSHARD FARM, a farming adventure with real-time combat. Enjoy two different ways to play in one collection.

5549520.title: Monsters & Banknotes
5549520.short_description: Open a backstreet monster shop on borrowed money. Buy, breed, raise and sell 141 species, build valuable bloodlines, prove them in the arena and trade at the grand auction. Pay the underworld tribute or defend your shop in this pixel-art management sim.

5549530.title: A Gift for Everyone
5549530.short_description: New Year's is almost here! A mountain of gifts is piled up under a giant Christmas tree, with a toy in every box. Start with your bare mittens, sell the toys to Father Frost, hire a dwarf and mechanical arms, bring up to three friends and keep going until the last box is open. All 100,000 of them.

5549720.title: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
5549720.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

5549740.title: SimFarm
5549740.short_description: A 3D farm management game where crops grow with the weather and the soil. Choose how tight money gets: play relaxed, or face real costs, loans and the risk of going broke. You give the orders; tractors and harvesters do the work. Rotate cows, sheep and horses through paddocks.

5549900.title: Ancient Moves: Royal Game of Ur
5549900.short_description: Race seven pieces across ancient Mesopotamia in this classic game of dice and strategy. Capture rival pieces, claim safe rosettes, and time your moves to reach the finish. Challenge four AI difficulty levels or play a friend locally.

5550070.title: Ski Lodge: Tidy Up Together
5550070.short_description: A blizzard closed the slopes and every guest dumped their gear in one giant heap in the middle of the ski shop. Climb a mountain of 2,000+ skis, boots, helmets and gloves and sort it all back onto the right racks – solo or with up to 5 friends.

5550140.title: The Hollowing
5550140.short_description: An incremental first-person voxel mining game about tearing an entire mountain apart, one layer at a time. Cut rock with a laser drill, sell the ore, and upgrade everything — wider drills, longer batteries, a fleet of drones that keep digging while you're away.

5550220.title: Unblock Me Kingdom
5550220.short_description: Slide the blocks, clear the exit, and find the move that changes everything. Unblockme offers 1,800 puzzles across six difficulty levels, eight visual themes, undo, and saved progress.

5550300.title: Shear Debt
5550300.short_description: An active incremental game about shearing an increasingly odd flock, restoring the farm and building up upgrades that survive bankruptcy. Grandma’s farm is yours, debts and all. Even the Queen needs a trim.

5550530.title: Streaming Raptae
5550530.short_description: A one-button platformer about a streamer trapped inside his own livestream. Your score is your viewers, your chat throws bombs at you and every death is clip-worthy. Jump, hold to jump higher, and never let the stream get boring.

5550610.title: Murder Sudoku: The Brinkhaven Cases
5550610.short_description: Place suspects instead of numbers. Use Sudoku-style logic, question witnesses and connect evidence as rookie officer Noor. Solve ten linked chapters and uncover the secrets of Brinkhaven, one deduction at a time.

5550750.title: Bayani: Auto Ascent
