5550750.short_description: A naked hero. A ten-floor tower. A Rival who drafts from the same cards you do. Build your hero piece by piece - gear, spells and fighting techniques - and watch the fights play out automatically. Take the card they need, or the card you need? At the top, you duel to the death.

5550770.title: Depthforged
5550770.short_description: Forge gear at the anvil, fit it into your heroes' packs, and send them down into the dark. A relaxing incremental dungeon crawler where every item reacts to its neighbours: place it well and your party grows stronger.

5550910.title: Just ONE more window
5550910.short_description: A cozy first-person incremental game about cleaning the windows of a skyscraper that just keeps going. Scrub the glass, earn a dollar, buy better gear and little robot helpers, and climb: past the pigeons, past the clouds, past where the air runs out. Solo or co-op with a friend.

5550960.title: Byeway
5550960.short_description: A short first-person ghost story about the last bus of the day, and the old man who drives it.

5551020.title: Embodybird
5551020.short_description: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

5551040.title: Destination & Acceleration
5551040.short_description: This is a top-down platformer where your goal is to complete the levels. Destination & Acceleration is a truly hardcore, stylish, and fair game. What a shame you won't even make it past ten levels here.

5551100.title: Let's Build Together
5551100.short_description: Build up to 859,436 pieces in a single map, solo or with up to 8 friends. Unlock powerful upgrades, automate construction with helpers, and turn empty plots into finished buildings in this cozy first-person building game.

5551130.title: Vault Traitors
5551130.short_description: Social deduction with MOBA-style abilities, 25+ roles, 50+ unique items, an arsenal of weapons and air that's running out. 16 players are sealed in an underground vault with traitors among them. Lock your door - and survive the night.

5551170.title: Shell Yeah!
5551170.short_description: A tiny island that lives right on your desktop. Shelly harvests coconuts, runs her beach bar and splashes in the pool while you work. Upgrade the island, throw toys, meet new friends and collect 72 illustrated trading cards. Free to play, relaxing, always there.

5551230.title: Off the Eaten Path
5551230.short_description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

5551290.title: The Coven
5551290.short_description: Choose from five elemental witches in a single-player action roguelite. Explore a candlelit, 16-floor tower, shape your build with talents, gear and rune sets, and face familiar people turned into bosses. Time rewinds when you fall, but some growth and treasures endure.

5551460.title: We Need a Bigger Ship
5551460.short_description: Your ship is your backpack. Cram weapons, supports and bags onto its grid, link them into combos and forge bigger guns, then hold off waves of enemies and giant bosses. Take your build into Ranked against other players' ships. It starts tiny. You'll need a bigger ship.

5551520.title: The Shop on Linden Street
5551520.short_description: Grandma left you her little shop on Linden Street. Stock the shelves, work the till, befriend the neighbours, then expand: open shops across town and grow that one small counter into a hypermarket of your own.

5551540.title: Little Brigade: Desktop Battler
5551540.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

5551760.title: Sanatorium of Evil
5551760.short_description: The monsters just wanted a quiet soak. Then heroes barged in with their "Purification". A pixel-art bullet heaven: draw trail signs with your steps, evolve weapons and hold out until 21:00. Then write the intruders a referral: STRAIGHT TO TRAUMATOLOGY!

5551820.title: Pave The Universe
5551820.short_description: Your home planet sent you and your alien crew with one job: pave the whole planet, every last square metre. Dig, level, cut pavers to size, build factories and robots, and take over a wild little planet. Solo or with up to 8 friends.

5552090.title: Moji Snake
5552090.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

5552330.title: Lumina Cube
5552330.short_description: Build your circuit, automate the fight, then let her grow stronger while you idle. Arrange glowing cubes to decide how Yura moves, which skills she casts and when. Every rebuild makes her faster and smoother. A dreamlike, bittersweet pixel-art hack-and-slash.

5552620.title: Realmwake
5552620.short_description: Recruit and merge an everchanging roster of combatants in this roguelike autobattler. Arrange your squad, discover powerful synergies, and venture through a world shattered by the four colliding realms.

5552740.title: Broadcast Storm
5552740.short_description: Fight your way through the corporate ladder in 'Broadcast Storm.' An office based brawler / beat 'em up style game. Where you play as Chuck, a System Administrator trying to save the company from an unknown threat. Play through single player campaign or online multiplayer survival mode!

5552750.title: Rockhounds and Gloomstones
5552750.short_description: Powerful Gloomstones await daring rockhounds in this Match-3 Roguelike. Build your bag of Gloomstones for use both during combat and throughout exploration. Match gems, smash skulls, and detonate wild bombs to stack massive combos.

5552830.title: Vinyl Shop: Tidy Up Music Game
5552830.short_description: A cozy first-person game: bring a vinyl shop back to life! Sort thousands of records by genre and artist. Complete a genre to earn its track. Spin it on the turntable: the tidier the shop, the more music.

5552860.title: Boardgame Nights
5552860.short_description: Boardgame Nights is a 3D board game collection with 16 games. Play alone or online with up to 8 players!

5552890.title: Rabid
5552890.short_description: RABID is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where blackjack fuels every battle. Lead a team of mutated animals, customize your decks, collect powerful loot, and master turn-based combat as you uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious laboratory.

5552910.title: 暴走拆城 (Rampage Demolition)
5552910.short_description: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.

5552920.title: Draw Death
5552920.short_description: Draw your path of death through hordes of enemies in a macabre gothic storybook survivor. Master drawn shapes, time brutal combos, and build ten strange hunters into crowd-cutting monsters, backed by an epic orchestral score.

5553130.title: Neuroflux
5553130.short_description: Neuroflux is a modern take on Nerts, the frantic real-time solitaire race. Everyone plays at once: flip through your deck, build on the shared center card stacks, empty your Flux pile and hit FLUX before anyone else. Up to 4 players online on dedicated servers, or practice solo. Free to play.

5553220.title: Tea ceremony simulator
5553220.short_description: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times in a row to face a special guest. Can you score a perfect 100?

5553360.title: Sect Master
5553360.short_description: Train disciples, build your sect, and rise from humble beginnings to greatness!

5553550.title: Fever
5553550.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

5553620.title: One Million Dominoes
5553620.short_description: Topple a million dominoes, one push at a time. Pick where to push, watch the chain race across the table, and grow it into a wave of tens of thousands. A short, satisfying incremental game with achievements and timed loops.

5553630.title: Zodiac: Story of the Guardian
5553630.short_description: Explore a cavernous, retro pixel asteroid to save Earth from impending disaster!

5553850.title: NEON DESCENT
5553850.short_description: Half human, half machine, D dives into a neon cyberspace with J, the AI who refuses to leave his side. Fuse together, outsmart 12 bosses that each demand a different strategy, and descend to the Core to learn why the children vanished.

5554000.title: Kill the AI
5554000.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

5554170.title: Adventile
5554170.short_description: Every adventurer is a puzzle piece. Hire them, fit them together and clear the dungeon in this polyomino puzzle × resource-management roguelite. Every floor can be solved — the question is how cheaply. Whoever you place is gone for good. 30 weeks to reach the Three Great Dungeons.

5554250.title: Ladder of Numbers
5554250.short_description: Ladder of Numbers turns arithmetic into combat skills: charge with addition, multiply into clones, fire with subtraction, divide to split. Climb its steps through thunderclouds and imaginary-number storms to the edge of the sky.

5554360.title: They Are Zombies
5554360.short_description: Gather by day. Survive by night. Team up with friends, collect resources, and craft what you need before the zombies come. Survive 15 nights of attacks—and find out whether your brilliant plan can actually get you through to morning.

5554430.title: Butt Out!
5554430.short_description: The neighbors are coming to drag you off the toilet. Feed the hero, combine foods, and aim a flexible pipe in this arcade wave defense game. Unlock new projectiles, stock up on food, build obstacles, and choose your upgrade path.

5554720.title: Smokeward: Seven Year Promise
5554720.short_description: Seven years ago your village signed its valley away. Now you're back with the deed. Light the first hearth, rebuild homes and give fifteen families a reason to return. Each family that comes home brings back some of the valley's colour. A story-rich cozy farming sim, solo or 1–4 co-op.

5554830.title: Math Combo Chain
5554830.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

5554840.title: Bukchon Anomaly
5554840.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

5554910.title: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
5554910.short_description: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

5554920.title: Sky Furnace
5554920.short_description: An aerial dieselpunk roguelite. Rusted ruins and the Furnace, a machine nobody remembered to switch off: for two centuries it has shot down anything that flies. Build your plane from cards; each sortie ends with a boss rising from the smoke. Squads of up to four players.

5555020.title: Backgammon
5555020.short_description: Play classic backgammon against four AI levels, find opponents online, or invite friends through Steam and Discord. Learn with a guided tutorial, play full matches with the doubling cube and Crawford rule, and mix board and checker themes.

5555140.title: Cursed Cards
5555140.short_description: Build a deck of hungry monsters in this roguelike autobattler. Position your creatures, feed their powers and turn sacrifices into devastating combos. Fight zombie swarms, collect strange relics and choose your route through a cursed world.

5555370.title: 三国梦想家
5555370.short_description: Forge your path through the Three Kingdoms. Choose a historical faction or create an officer, govern cities, organize armies and plan supplies. Command troops in real-time field battles and sieges, using formations and officer skills to shape your campaign.

5555520.title: DETONUMBER!
5555520.short_description: A number-go-up action roguelite where your weapon is math. Build a circuit around your enemies, loop a 7 into the trillions, then blow it all up in front of a screaming alien crowd. Every lap makes the boom bigger, and the circuit less stable.

5555790.title: D.U.B.B.I.O
5555790.short_description: Become D.U.B.B.I.O, a counter-terror AI deployed to the city of Sowrat. Juggle simultaneous hacking tasks to interfere with terrorists, gather the clues they leave behind, and deduce where they will strike and how they are armed. But this mission is only the surface of the operation.

5556030.title: Desert Diggers
5556030.short_description: Dig out a lost Egyptian city with up to 7 friends! Shovel deformable sand, haul fragile treasures together, survive cave-ins, snakes and sandstorms, and bury your friends alive when they least expect it. Dynamite is cheap. Friendships are not.

5556050.title: Spot the Symbol
5556050.short_description: A calm, colorful collection of quick brain games about seeing what’s hidden. Race your friends to the answer, and sneak in a little sabotage when they pull ahead.

5556120.title: Become a Real Estate Tycoon
5556120.short_description: Buy property, collect rent, and negotiate with 20 anime-style female rivals. Grow your business across three towns, balance cash flow and fixed-rate loans, and climb the net worth rankings as property prices change every day.

5556170.title: Drawbacks: Draw, Guess, Sabotage
5556170.short_description: The draw-and-guess party game where your friends fight dirty. While you draw, they spend ink on sabotage cards that shake, flip, mirror and splatter your doodle. Guess fast, sabotage smart and laugh at the wreckage. 2–16 players online.

5556190.title: Tidy Up: Gacha Collection
5556190.short_description: A cozy co-op gacha shop sim. Scoop capsules from the ball pool, crack them open and tidy 3,376 cute toys onto their shelves. Every toy earns yen each second: buy gacha machines and upgrades, complete 16 collections, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

5556280.title: PaleBlueRose
5556280.short_description: A free-to-play online medieval city builder. Start with a founding wagon and a little grain. Grow a town, build production chains, trade with thousands of players and go to war, all in one shared world. Win by holding 90% of the world's yearly economy.

5556380.title: Beam Them All
5556380.short_description: Abduct animals with your UFO, upgrade your saucer, and return for bigger hauls. Dodge defenses and escape in time, or lose the resources collected on your expedition.

5556500.title: Idle Mortal
5556500.short_description: Begin with flawed spiritual roots in this xianxia idle RPG. Cultivate, craft pills and artifacts, raise spirit companions, and build your own sect. Train disciples and lead campaigns for territory as a mortal's journey becomes a sect's rise to power.

5556650.title: A Very Tidy Christmas
5556650.short_description: Bring order to Santa's messy workshop in this cozy Christmas sorting game! Organize toys, decorations, and festive goodies, decorate the Christmas tree, and discover little surprises along the way. Every item has its place!

5556690.title: PokerCat Battle
5556690.short_description: Turn poker hands into powerful attacks in a fantasy adventure starring a sword-wielding cat. Bend your hand with Tarot cards, battle bosses, collect gear, and grow stronger. Play each hand yourself or let auto-battle run in a compact desktop bar.

5556830.title: Desktop Divinity
5556830.short_description: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

5556890.title: Lanternfall
5556890.short_description: Draft gladiator champions, place them on the sand and watch them fight. Lanternfall is a comic-book roguelite autobattler: forge weapons, roll dice that rewrite the rules of the run, and rebuild a ruined town between bloody nights in the arena.

5556920.title: Sort My Money
5556920.short_description: Collect more than 46 currencies from around the world in this cozy organizing game! Sort 292 unique banknotes, arrange them by country and denomination, complete collections, and build your own museum of world money.

5556940.title: Cubetoria Pentomino Challenge
5556940.short_description: Twelve pieces. One perfect fit. Build all twelve pentominoes from real 3D cubes and fill the build plate, matching every lettered anchor. 220 computer-checked challenges on five plates, a Daily Challenge, Free Build and the Cubetoria crew to cheer you on.

5557060.title: Monster Hunting Supplies
5557060.short_description: A supernatural mystery game where customers bring disturbing rumors and strange encounters to your workshop. Ask questions, study your field guide, and prepare the right ammunition. Every story holds a clue, and some are connected.

5557100.title: フィルネティアの魔法雑貨店
5557100.short_description: Run your own magic shop as a young witch in this fantasy shop-management sim and action RPG. Defeat monsters in forests and mines, craft potions and accessories, then read the market and set your prices. Help the villagers and choose the crown or the Thieves' Guild to decide your ending.

5557130.title: Fracht rollt - Kein Auftrag bleibt liegen
5557130.short_description: Build and manage your own haulage company. Dispatch jobs across 245 cities in 39 countries, balance truck capacity by weight, volume, pallets and loading metres, plan driver rest periods and meet delivery deadlines while growing your fleet.

5557260.title: Dustronauts
5557260.short_description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

5557390.title: Winter Wonderland: Tidy Up Together
5557390.short_description: After the busiest night at Winter Wonderland, everything has ended up in one giant pile. Team up with up to 8 friends to sort nearly 3,000+ festive treasures back where they belong, hang the baubles and switch the magical Winter Wonderland lights back on, one cosy armful at a time.

5557460.title: One More Asteroid
5557460.short_description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

5557730.title: Dungeon Dealer
5557730.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

5557760.title: Desk Top Soccer
5557760.short_description: Manage your football club from a corner of your desktop or in fullscreen. Pick the line-up, train, build up the club and take your team from the bottom division to the top at your own pace. In multiplayer, compete in leagues against managers worldwide and trade players on the Steam Market.

5557960.title: WORLD EATER
5557960.short_description: Eat the entire world. All 100 billion voxels of it. Start with a shovel and a backpack, work your way up to bombs, giant machines, robots and factories, and don't stop until nothing is left. First-person co-op for up to 8 players.

5557980.title: Fortnight Before Christmas
5557980.short_description: Grimwald the Frost King marches on Hollyhearth for fourteen nights. Build a cozy Christmas village, raise toy soldiers, nutcrackers and snow golems from its buildings, and break each night's boss before the clock runs out. Hold the gate until Christmas morning!

5558190.title: Riot Control: Europe
5558190.short_description: Isometric pixel-art tower defense parody. Waves of protesters march on the parliament, your only job is to stop there, by any means necessary.

5558830.title: Paunchy Pets TD
5558830.short_description: A Paunchy Pets Tower Defense game. Stop the evil veggie army from stealing your candy stash. Build Paunchy Towers, draw Upgrade Cards to bolster your defenses, and smash all of the Veggie Bosses.

5558980.title: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.5
5558980.short_description: "Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration" is a radio show that Blue Hawaii Aniki appears on to make a little extra cash. If you enjoy that unique radio atmosphere, I highly recommend giving it a listen. It runs for about two hours. Feel free to start from Vol. 5.

5559390.title: Reliquary
5559390.short_description: A turn-based loot roguelite, solo or co-op. Pick a hero, cross cursed regions and turn every chest into a weapon: affixes, sets, relics, cursed items and the forge. Beat the bosses, raise the Corruption, come back stronger.

5559510.title: RATS
5559510.short_description: Hide from your friends in the dark. Find the parts, feed the terminal and get out, while one or two of them hunt you by sound as one of nine killers. No markers, no waypoints: only your torch, your phone and what you hear.

5559550.title: Tome of Ruin: The Word Dungeon
5559550.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where every word is a weapon. Spell words to strike, chase five-star loot through 200 floors and 8 dungeons, earn your promotion, hunt bounties and face the Book of Evil. Word lists in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German. Hardcore: one life.

5559650.title: Chalk Thrower Simulator
5559650.short_description: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

5559730.title: Tongyou Town
5559730.short_description: A town that runs itself. You decide who ventures out, where they go, and what the town sells. Recruit, form squads, farm regions, craft gear, and run the market — the rest happens without you.

5560010.title: Re-Ball
5560010.short_description: A first-person hyper-ball fighter. Hit the ball and it's yours: it flies in your colour and knocks out anyone it touches. Every hit makes it faster. One hit and you're out. Time a PERFECT swing, steal a parry, and send your friends back to the lobby.

5560570.title: Pig Boss
5560570.short_description: You’ve been called in for a night shift at a medical firm. The offices are empty, the doors are locked, and your boss is acting increasingly strange. Explore the building, uncover corporate secrets, and try to survive until morning. Your choices will determine who makes it out alive.

5561160.title: Port Solano City: Gangster War
5561160.short_description: Come home to Port Solano as Jay Brooks and rise through its criminal underworld. Steal cars, take over gang turf, survive five-star police chases and fly helicopters and fighter jets across an open city full of side jobs, properties to buy and changing weather.

5561190.title: Last Spin: Survive
5561190.short_description: Your next spin could keep you alive. A dark first-person roguelite in a sealed bunker: collect artifacts, push payouts to the limit, and unlock permanent upgrades. Survive 12 days and hold out for evacuation.

5561220.title: Alice’s Archive
5561220.short_description: Alice's Archive is an atmospheric found-footage puzzle game. As a young archivist, uncover the dark secret of a psychiatric hospital where everyone vanished in 1984. Examine over 70 eerie, hand-drawn pictures by a patient, break the seals, and reveal the supernatural truth.

5561280.title: Sitry & Chami Desktop Pet
5561280.short_description: Meet Sitry & Chami, your adorable hand-painted gouache desktop companions! Watch them climb active windows, dangle their legs from title bars, play bongo drums to your keyboard typing, and hilariously prank your screen with paint splatters and squeaky hammers.

5561290.title: Above Water, Below Hell - Prologue
5561290.short_description: Fight your way through four zombie‑infested floors of a high‑rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

5561700.title: VOIDRUN: ASCENSION
5561700.short_description: Pilot an agile starfighter against relentless mechanical swarms in this fast-paced arcade shooter. Dodge bullet hells, unlock devastating weapons like the Nova Blast, and defeat massive bosses to survive the void. How long can you last?

5561790.title: Pay Up, Piggy
5561790.short_description: You're the kid who owes Finn the loan shark. Smash piggy banks, stack the coins and pay the Boss's weekly cut, or you're done. Upgrade your hammer, call in Favors, survive the Showdowns and climb Port Penny's mob.

5561840.title: Not Alive Enough - Prologue
5561840.short_description: A new wave of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. Inspect every survivor, identify the infected before they turn, and stop the outbreak from spreading to the outside world in this tense zombie apocalypse screening simulator.

5561920.title: The Winner 2 - The Reality Show
5561920.short_description: Experience what it's like to participate in a reality show in this casual, immersive, and fun simulator! Enter a medieval castle, compete for the title of ultimate winner, and enjoy a unique experience with an original soundtrack and fun 2D graphics.

5562130.title: Mad Racer
5562130.short_description: Hit the gas and tear through the wasteland in this top-down incremental roguelite about a rusty car, a tiny fuel tank and a growing horde of raiders. Wreck, loot, upgrade your ride and climb all 18 wanted levels!

5562210.title: Consume p/pixelplace
5562210.short_description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

5562390.title: 一撇 One Stroke Short
5562390.short_description: There's a Chinese saying for a job that hasn't begun: the character is still one stroke short. You're the missing stroke in this puzzle adventure. Knock a character out of a sentence to clear the way, then play the four tones of Mandarin to make a path where there wasn't one.

5562500.title: Vorath
5562500.short_description: A dark action RPG in the spirit of the classics: hordes, loot and a skill tree with eight directions to mix. Defeat twelve guardians, gather their sigils and summon Vorath, the Void – solo with a mercenary or in four-player co-op. Free to play; only looks are for sale.

5562650.title: Necrowake: Bone Legion
5562650.short_description: Lead an undead army through waves of enemies in this action roguelite. Recruit elite minions, choose your formation, and combine equipment skills to build your legion. Pick your next battle through portals, defeat bosses, and spend your shards to grow stronger.

5562660.title: Feed the Bloom
5562660.short_description: Drop food and watch a slime mould bloom towards it. Tendrils reach out, veins pulse with nutrients, and your hive grows against the clock. When time runs out, spend your spores on upgrades and go again. A calm, clicky incremental game set in a petri dish.

5562840.title: Mechannihilation
5562840.short_description: Pilot a mech through escalating swarms in Survivors, lead an army to capture relays and break the enemy HQ shield in Commanders, or roam the Open World to raid outposts and hunt biome bosses. Pair maxed weapons to unleash EX attacks.

5563080.title: Bulge: The Battle for the Ardennes
5563080.short_description: December 1944. Hitler's last gamble in the West. A faithful digital edition of SPI's classic 1979 hex-and-counter wargame by James F. Dunnigan: drive the panzers to the Meuse, or hold the Ardennes until Patton arrives. Play the AI or a friend, and learn the rules as you go.

5563130.title: Too Fun
5563130.short_description: Too Fun is a 2–8 player party game. Compete with your friends in episodes that test your skill, your bluffing and your communication. Outplay your rivals and become the star of the show.

5563200.title: Napoleon at War
5563200.short_description: Six of Napoleon's greatest battles, from Marengo to Waterloo, in a digital edition of SPI's classic hex-and-counter wargames. Twelve scenarios, fog of war, a computer opponent for either side, hotseat and ranked online play.

5563250.title: Sort The Pandas
5563250.short_description: Thousands of pandas, two amazing worlds and one mission – put everything perfectly in place! Over 5,000 pandas are waiting for you in a shop full of shelves and a lush bamboo grove. Every panda you place brings you closer to perfect order. Level up your skills and see how many pandas you can sort!

5563270.title: Fire Up the Stadium
5563270.short_description: Fire Up the Stadium is an incremental restoration game where you bring a massive stadium back to its former glory. Restore faded seats, earn money, unlock powerful tools and upgrades, and build automated restoration machines. The more seats you restore, the faster and more powerful you become!

5563330.title: Sunday Socks
5563330.short_description: Sunday Socks is a cosy first-person tidying game. Socks are scattered all over the house: find each sock's twin, roll the pair into a ball and toss it into the Pair-O-Matic. Unlock upgrades, get help from the little Sock Bot and race for the fastest clear on the Steam leaderboards.

5563600.title: Mining to Riches!
5563600.short_description: A coin pusher dug into a gold mine. Drop medals, shove bearded miners and real pickaxes over the lip, and your crew starts swinging. The ore they break pays for your next medal. Line up 777 for a medal storm, smash motherlodes and dig ever deeper.

5563790.title: Rise of Furax
5563790.short_description: A dungeon crawler RPG set in the Heroes of the Seven Islands universe, where every element, from sprites to textures, was hand-drawn on paper. Assemble a team of five heroes, explore the three islands off the coast of Rivelune to discover the origin of Furax.

5563820.title: The Last Iron Sentinel
5563820.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot. Mow through hordes of 100+ zombies, freeze time to draft upgrades, turn your bullets into fire, ice or lightning, and rip chainsaws and missile packs off elites to bolt onto yourself.

5563980.title: Taboo Eternal Life
5563980.short_description: An Incremental Idle Exploration Game, Awaken in a silent, blood-soaked medieval vampire palace—where your kin lay dead. Who slaughtered them all? Uncover the chilling truth, break the endless loop of immortality, or sacrifice everything to restart the taboo cycle.

5564020.title: Twilight Park
5564020.short_description: Escape the amusement park before it's too late... You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun. But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park. Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park before it's too late..

5564120.title: Save The Shapes: Chapter 2 - Diamond's Revenge
5564120.short_description: In Save The Shapes: Chapter 2, the Shapes thought their troubles were finally over... They were wrong. Diamond is back! With old friends returning and some new Shapes joining the chaos, you’ll have to survive new dangers, strange places, and whatever Diamond has planned for his revenge.

5564330.title: Path Of Fear: Allia's Nightmares
5564330.short_description: Path Of Fear is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore dark environments, solve puzzles, and survive a stalking threat while uncovering the dark secrets around you. Will you escape, or become another victim of fear?

5564650.title: REFLEJASTES
5564650.short_description: Enter a futuristic world of light and logic in REFLEJASTES! Rotate mirrors, split beams and manipulate moving crystals to guide light toward its targets. Master 100 increasingly challenging puzzles, discover new mechanics, collect stars and unlock achievements. Can you solve them all?

5564760.title: Doomsbell
5564760.short_description: An auto battler where every protocol plays by its own rules and your Commander fights beside your army. Choose your road through wagers, stories and bosses, merge and fit out your machines, then outbuild other players' armies, one turn at a time.

5564820.title: Panzertanken
5564820.short_description: Turn-based tank artillery on fully destructible pixel terrain. Command about 200 tanks from WWI to today, dig in with shovels and steel plates, and blow up enemy bunkers in five campaigns, 3 vs 3 battles against bots, hot-seat duels and online matches.

5564850.title: One Bow Army
5564850.short_description: One archer against an undead army. Choose where every arrow lands, build your power through a skill tree, and hold the wall against the horde.

5565060.title: SUPER FIGHTERS -LEGENDS-
5565060.short_description: Pick your favourite character and jump in the fight! Defeat enemies, collect coins and grow stronger in this indie Dungeon Crawler game!

5565130.title: Odyssey of Elemental Elysium
5565130.short_description: Five elemental realms. Decades of lore. One of the largest RPGs ever made. Experience the Odyssey of Elemental Elysium.

5565260.title: Elf Delivery
5565260.short_description: Wrap gifts, load Santa's sleigh and sneak presents down chimneys – while waves of soot goblins try to steal Christmas. A cute but chaotic third-person action game with candy canes, rifles, a candy rocket launcher and one score that lasts the whole run.

5565330.title: Sun is Lava
5565330.short_description: Suit up and cool the Sun in a first-person sci-fi co-op. Spray paths across molten lava, salvage asteroids, build water-powered machines, and explore a dangerous solar world alone or with friends.

5565480.title: ONE BRAINCELL
5565480.short_description: Two bodies. One brain. Zero common sense. ONE BRAINCELL is a 2-player online co-op puzzle platformer where only one of you can think at a time. Pass the brain, steal it at the worst moment, yell secret codes across the room and fail gloriously together.

5565510.title: Enchanted Hearth
5565510.short_description: Return to the misty valley of Valdebruma as a young apprentice witch and restore it with magic, one cozy room at a time. Scrub away the grime, paint, plant and decorate 25 forgotten places, from a grandma's cottage to a royal castle.

5565650.title: Depthline
5565650.short_description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

5565690.title: Math Star
5565690.short_description: Solve the problem and hit the answer on the beat. A rhythm game where math is your instrument: 20 songs, 4 levels, a 20-show tour and a practice mode that learns from your mistakes. Can you keep the show going?

5565800.title: Retail Empire
5565800.short_description: Hide the milk in the back. Put your own store brand at eye level. Get inside every shopper's head. Build your supermarket from scratch, survive chaotic dinner rushes, and bankrupt six rival chains until you own the whole city.

5565840.title: Vanta
5565840.short_description: A noir murder-mystery where you type your own questions. Interrogate a rain-soaked street of suspects, catch their lies with the evidence you find, and prove when, how and why a man died at 2:13, before the day shift charges the wrong suspect at six.

5565980.title: Moon Base: Tidy Up Together
5565980.short_description: Thousands of things are dumped in one giant pile at a Moon base. Climb it, bound across the cargo yard in low gravity and put every last item back where it belongs, on your own or with up to three friends, in this cosy co-op tidy-up game.

5566200.title: Coffinmaker
5566200.short_description: Inherit Velvet & Pine, a little coffin shop that has secretly served vampires for sixty years. Greet the night's customers, work out who casts no reflection, and build bespoke coffins by hand for the undead.

5566320.title: NT Jigsaws: Northern Territory, Australia
5566320.short_description: A calm jigsaw and picture puzzle game made from 208 photographs of Central Australia and the Top End. Build the border, join pieces on the table, and watch a gorge or a desert sunset come together. No rush, no ads, and it saves the moment you stop.

5566330.title: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
5566330.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

5566400.title: We Made Gods
5566400.short_description: 2040. A rogue AI has seized the world's war factories. Lead human veterans, machine-fused soldiers or the AI itself in a real-time strategy game of three asymmetric factions, a story campaign, skirmish against the AI and online multiplayer.

5566430.title: Aquarium Naturalist
5566430.short_description: An aquarium sim built in Unreal Engine 5 where equipment, feeding, and water chemistry interact like they do in real life. Hardy fish are as forgiving as the real thing; delicate ones demand real care. Crossbreed new morphs, or selectively breed delicate lines to handle tougher water.

5566490.title: Black Dawn Rises
5566490.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

5566560.title: Blu's Honey Days
5566560.short_description: Run a cozy little honey shop in this 30-day management game. Choose action cards, manage your money and inventory, serve customers, and make tough decisions to save your shop from closing.

5566610.title: FOCOM: Forward Operations Commander
5566610.short_description: Command your forces from a forward operating base in a land held by an insurgency. Order every soldier yourself, push patrol bases out, win over the towns and hunt down the camps the insurgents fight from. A real-time commander game on one living map that remembers what you do.

5566650.title: Poutamelo
5566650.short_description: Create your own music and share your finished sheet music with the townspeople. Then, visit the local live music bar to hear them perform your songs. Help out with farming, get to know your neighbors, and create your own story in a peaceful little town in this life simulation game.

5566820.title: Apartment Empire
5566820.short_description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.

5566930.title: Pack it! Part-Time Master
5566930.short_description: Scan! Stack! The ultimate basket-packing challenge! Become a part-time master!

5567100.title: Mytheria
5567100.short_description: Explore the wilds, free the Keepers and take back Mytheria. A satisfying action adventure with building, automation and lots of loot. Craft, gather, discover secrets and expand your base. For 1 to 4 players, on the couch or online.

5567200.title: 1000 Milliarden Dollar - Kohle und Stahl
5567200.short_description: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.

5567500.title: Cursed Luck
5567500.short_description: The Devil owns your debt. The reels hold your fate. Cursed Luck is a dark fantasy roguelite where you build powerful symbol combinations, unleash explosive chain reactions, and bend luck in your favor. Chase massive wins, survive rising demands, and pay your debt before the Devil claims your soul.

5567570.title: Junk Mountain
5567570.short_description: Dig through mountains of junk for a hard drive holding 8,000 bitcoin. Find drives, test them on a computer and follow five clues from a backyard junkyard to orbit. Sell scrap, upgrade tools and hire workers to build a junkyard that runs itself.

5567770.title: Wildball League
5567770.short_description: Open booster packs, collect 87 monsters, and build the football team that makes them work together. Every creature has an element and a family: the right tactic is the one where your cards answer each other. From a graveyard club to the Full Moon League.

5568040.title: Deep Clean
5568040.short_description: A co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. You're a crew of space janitors: scrub stations after "incidents" and find out what roams the halls and how to survive it. There are no instructions: try everything, log your discoveries in the glossary and piece together the truth.

5568130.title: Marble Hoarder
5568130.short_description: Sort thousands of glass marbles in a cozy, messy old marble shop. Pick them up, toss each one into the tray where it belongs, unlock skills like Spotlight, Gather and Auto-Place, and race your marbles on a wooden race machine. No timers, no pressure.

5568180.title: Kingdom of Embers
5568180.short_description: Real-time strategy meets action RPG. Build a kingdom and raise an army, then take the field as its ruler: lead your troops into battle in person, and delve into deadly dungeons for legendary weapons and world-ending spells.

5568210.title: 渊海群星：深海文明建设
5568210.short_description: Start with kelp and a settler in an icebound abyss. Gather, build, assign jobs, and survive the seasons. Research through ten eras, shape society, grow in faith, build wonders. Break the ice, explore stars, build megastructures. Grow a deep-sea civilization with idle play, challenges, and Prestige.

5568300.title: Rig'n'Roll: GOLD
5568300.short_description: Hit the highways of California in the most complete edition of the classic truck-driving simulator! Build your trucking empire, compete with rival drivers, explore an expanded world, and enjoy the complete Monster Cup expansion, additional trucks, and over 140 side missions.

5568580.title: Kixball
5568580.short_description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

5568640.title: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
5568640.short_description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

5568700.title: Deep Rescue
5568700.short_description: Pilot a small rescue sub through a dark, glowing ocean. Gather schools of glowfish in your beam, outwit poachers, lead rare animals home and stay clear of the Gloam, the huge thing in the deep that hunts anything that glows.

5568730.title: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
5568730.short_description: Rip open packs, drop the tiles on your desktop and grow a tiny fantasy world one square at a time. Recruit knights, skeletons, orcs, vampires and dragonblood. They fight on their own while you work. Pull the rune slot for doubles, then hunt down three bosses.

5568840.title: Station KHE-7
5568840.short_description: Arm your ship, repair your home station, and face vast hordes of vassals serving hostile powers. Every cell counts. Every component can be your key to victory or the harbinger of your downfall. In this roguelite, you decide what your enemies learn to fear.

5569480.title: Wooden Tower
5569480.short_description: Pull wooden blocks from a teetering tower in a physics-based game of balance. Try the Daily Challenge, practice in Sandbox, face an AI opponent, or invite friends through Steam or Discord for online rounds with up to five players.

5569910.title: Paint the Town
5569910.short_description: One morning, every color in town is gone. Grab a brush and bring it back: paint houses, cars, trees and towers until the gray city glows again. A calm, satisfying first-person incremental game — from a single brush to a paint cannon. Almost half a million square meters are waiting.

5570020.title: Saurora
5570020.short_description: Survive as a dinosaur on a 4 km island. Start as a hatchling, find food and water, stay away from the wrong animals and grow up. Play alone in free roam, or join an online server with friends, strangers and things that want to eat you.

5570230.title: Mostly Absurd Battle Simulator
5570230.short_description: Wobbly physics battles. Place an army of farmers, knights, giants and a train with a face, press Launch and watch it all fall apart. Grab anyone and throw them off a cliff, or jump into a soldier and fight yourself.

5570280.title: Default Zombie Shooter
5570280.short_description: You and your team woke up in a ruined city. Hordes of zombies roam the streets. There will be no answers. Grab a gun and shoot!

5570360.title: Mischka Cars
5570360.short_description: Top-down combat racing with rockets, mines and oil, a career across five leagues, rollercoaster stunts on stilted tracks and car football with ramps and bumpers. Tune your car in the garage, build your own tracks and earn 75 achievements.

5570610.title: Royal Guard: Hive Rescue
5570610.short_description: Blast through robotic enemies and rescue captive bees in Royal Guard, a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up. Fly solo or team up in two-player online co-op, power up your attacks, and take on eight unique bosses. Save all of the bees to unlock the final showdown.

5570630.title: TRADOTTA
5570630.short_description: From the first carriage you build, work and drive your train. A first-person management game on a train that never stops, in a frozen world. On the first day there is only you. Then people board at the refuges, up to two hundred, and nobody is an extra.

5570670.title: SUNSWORN
5570670.short_description: Awaken among the ruins of the Order of the Sun in a fantasy RPG with automatic combat and idle farming. Explore a hex-based world, develop your Exorcist and earn the trust of settlements to uncover the past. Begin again with your memories and the enduring power of the Phoenix Mark.

5570980.title: Earthworks
5570980.short_description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.

5571080.title: Turbidity
5571080.short_description: Turbidity is a surreal dungeon crawler where you are tasked with the collection of 3,000 fingernails by your God, the Striver of Atrocity.

5571110.title: Cry( ) Still
5571110.short_description: In Cry ( ) Still you explore frozen ruins where heat is a limited resource. You must find heat sources, avoid enemies that detect sound and suck the heat out of you, solve puzzles to unlock your path forwards. All in order to find your way out of the ancient temple.

5571150.title: Sea of Steel
5571150.short_description: Command a WWII fleet in real-time naval warfare with pause. Coordinate warships and carrier aircraft, land troops, secure island objectives and bring in reinforcements. Carry your ships and crews through a persistent campaign where damage, losses and morale matter.

5571280.title: MORTGATE
5571280.short_description: You are an explorer of an abandoned manor that once belonged to a renowned occultist. You came to steal ancient artifacts and walked into a trial where the stake is your life.

5571360.title: Paranormal Cleaner
5571360.short_description: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

5571410.title: SEND MORE MEN
5571410.short_description: A sandbox of battles up to 1,000 men where every soldier thinks for himself. Pick any army from any era, from Roman legions to orcs to sci-fi squads, set them on any field, then watch the lines hold and break, or take control of one man and fight it yourself.

5571810.title: 送り火のうた ～邂逅の夜～
5571810.short_description: Escort a sacred festival float through the streets of night Kyoto during Obon. Play as Uta, fight off waves of spirits in fast action combat, and build your power with roguelite cards and weapons in this tower-defense action roguelite with a Japanese dark-fantasy mood.

5571830.title: Hydroform
5571830.short_description: Falling blocks and water physics, inspired by '90s action-puzzle games. Drop land to wall the water in, plug every leak before your drain overflows, and burn big lakes for huge combo scores. Play solo for a high score, or with up to 3 friends who can join FREE with no download via Scan & Play!

5571890.title: plebCTO
5571890.short_description: Start at the help desk and climb to the corner office: close tickets, fix servers, survive outages, office politics, and performance reviews on the way to CTO. Or skip the ladder, stay in your parents' basement, and bet it all on Stonks.

5572020.title: BLOOD KESTREL
5572020.short_description: BLOOD KESTREL is a story-driven tactical stealth and action FPS. After a staged "gas accident" claims your wife's life and turns you into Subject K-7 of an illegal military gene program, break out of the Helix underground lab, customize looted weapons in real time, and hunt down the syndicate.

5572250.title: KOBALT – Das Erbe der Spiegelmacher
5572250.short_description: Hamburg, 2027: art courier Hannes Vogt delivers a Venetian mirror and finds his client dead. To clear his name – and get his invoice paid – he follows a 340-year-old trail to Venice and beyond. A classic point-and-click adventure, fully voiced, with a dry sense of humour.

5572300.title: FIT IT
5572300.short_description: A very challenging puzzle game. Unlike classic block puzzles, some levels add extra decoy blocks, and some even make you work out where parts of the board go first. 500 levels that keep getting harder, plus Daily Challenge, Endless and Relax modes.

5572350.title: Pop-Up Purgatory
5572350.short_description: It’s 1998, and your desktop is drowning in pop-ups. Close them for cash, upgrade your PC, fight real viruses from computing history and keep your RAM from crashing. Something is waiting. Something is watching. Are you forgetting something?

5572360.title: OverWorked: Santa's Workshop
5572360.short_description: Build, automate and expand Santa's workshop in a chaotic 1–4 player Christmas factory builder. Construct production lines, manage your elves and manufacture BILLIONS of presents to meet an impossible Christmas quota. Keep the elves happy, or start hiring replacements.

5572490.title: Gametsuki Kingdom: The Great Crown Grab!
5572490.short_description: Steal. Betray. Become King! Duel rivals for gold and turn the tide in a competitive board-game RPG. Planned for launch: English and 14 more languages (interface, subtitles and full voice acting), up to 4-player online PvP, shared-screen local PvP, and solo play.

5572530.title: Tinsel Tumble
5572530.short_description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

5572810.title: Ossuvar
5572810.short_description: 96 spells. 8 schools of magic. Soak a pack of demons and let lightning tear through them, or spend your own life to unleash three waves of fire. Shape Isquara’s build with 500 blessings across the paths of Heaven and Hell, then fight alongside Tess through 10 maps in this isometric action RPG.

5573180.title: Acheris : Bell of the Forsaken
5573180.short_description: When the bells of death toll, six Executors rise to defy their fate. ACHERIS is a gothic dark fantasy vertical-scrolling bullet hell shooter featuring intense boss battles, distinct playable characters and powerful Relics and Contract. Fight through a cursed world and uncover the truth buried within

5573530.title: GermShake
5573530.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike where you play a germ spreading through Shake City one handshake at a time. Mutate, dodge the immune system, and survive the sink.

5573580.title: Metal Melee
5573580.short_description: Command an army of hacked mechs in this free-to-play, turn-based card battler. Deploy Bots and Titans, manage your Power Plants, and combine card abilities to break enemy defenses. Harvest Circuit Cores or assemble an overwhelming force to win.

5574490.title: Set Adventures
5574490.short_description: Set Adventures - platformmer story based game join set the strongest warrior of all time to bring justice to the universe

5574940.title: Iron Sumo Rivals
5574940.short_description: Push, grapple and throw your way to victory in Iron Sumo Rivals, an arcade sumo wrestling game with pixel-art fighters in 3D arenas. Rise through the ranks, build a lasting career, or challenge a friend in local versus bouts.

5575190.title: Horror In Neverland
5575190.short_description: Third person horror shooter game where player controls cyborg whose mission is to kill different zombies and find pentagram at levels

5575420.title: Put Out The Sun
5575420.short_description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Land on the Sun as a crew of four-armed aliens, spit and spray it dark, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the last flicker. For 1-6 players.

5575630.title: Just Like the Photo
5575630.short_description: Someone turned these homes upside down. Now it’s your job to put them back together. Play solo or with friends and use photos taken before the mess to return every item to its original spot.

5575920.title: One More Pop
5575920.short_description: A cozy first-person incremental game about popping one million balloons. Shoot pins across a sunny meadow, chain combos and lightning, grow a constellation of 50 upgrades and watch the sky turn from sunrise to a starry night.

5576220.title: HYPER BUTTERFLY
5576220.short_description: Fly, butterfly, fly!!! 15 original tracks. Custom mp3/ogg file support. Absolute madness and a breath of fresh air in the rhythm game genre! Have a nice day!!!

5576380.title: Building to the Sky
5576380.short_description: A tower-building management sim you can read like an architect's drawing. Build a classic side-on 2D tower or a 3D landmark you can slice open floor by floor, run it for thousands of tenants, and switch any time between rendered, blueprint and CAD views.

5576540.title: Ant Tidy Up
5576540.short_description: A cozy, quirky sorting game about thousands of ants who aren't where they belong! Explore a sprawling underground world, catch and sort ants into their rightful nests, and unlock upgrades and beetle robots to help tidy up the chaos.

5576790.title: Poli City
5576790.short_description: Build a beautiful town, run its economy and services, win its votes and stay in power. Every train line, tax and law moves your voters, and they decide whether you keep the keys to Town Hall, or whether you refuse to hand them back.

5577000.title: Brand: Fracture
5577000.short_description: Pilot a sealing drone through fractured containment chambers. Cut territory, weld reinforced seams, and contain hostile rifts in a vivid arcade game set in the world of Imminence.

5577020.title: Schnuffels Hexa-World - You got schnuffeld
5577020.short_description: Seven fluffy Schnuffels, a mysterious hexagonal world, and plenty of puzzling challenges! Match colorful hex tiles, explore magical chambers, collect special fruits, and discover seven hidden keys. A charming puzzle adventure full of surprises!

5577120.title: Coaches Box 27
5577120.short_description: Take charge of an Australian rules football club. Trade, draft and game plan your way to a premiership. Make tactical changes from the box, manage your squad and make the hard decisions to build your dynasty. Play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to 8 friends.

5577140.title: The Unseated
5577140.short_description: Reclaim your name in a mythic pixel-art action roguelite. Unlock eight divinities, fight 100+ monsters and nine unique bosses, stack powerful Offerings, rewrite each ascent with Decrees, and chase your high score in THE PIT.

5577230.title: The Long Way
5577230.short_description: Somewhere past the end of your street, the road keeps going. So does one kid in a cardboard box, with a bag of snacks and no plan. A big, beautiful, cozy road trip that drives itself. Ride along, lend a hand, or just watch it go.

5577380.title: Build to Survive
5577380.short_description: Build a car, launch it down a mountain road and let physics decide. No steering, no second chances: pick the body, engine, suspension and tyres, then watch your machine fly, crash and fall apart. Beat gold times in Challenges or race two cars side by side in Free Drive.

5577450.title: I Am Konrad Voss
5577450.short_description: 2171. Konrad Voss hid a six-dimensional bomb inside the maze of Alfa 47, and time is running out. Leave your family, cross the mountain, jump through the black hole and descend into the maze only you know. Shooting, racing, flight and a haunted house in one campaign, voiced in English and Spanish.

5577540.title: Overcharge
5577540.short_description: Overcharge is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op platformer where holding the Energy Core for too long gets your team wiped. Catch and pass the core as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps in Creative mode.

5577550.title: The Passion
5577550.short_description: Long for a sleep you never wake from.

5577680.title: Greed, the dice game
5577680.short_description: One more roll could change everything. Play with up to three friends or take on bots in a dice game of risky choices, devilish bargains, and playful table mischief. Bank your points, push your luck, and make the table your own.

5577780.title: LOOT MULE
5577780.short_description: A turn-based dungeon roguelite. Dive deep, grab all you can carry, and make it back alive. The deeper you go and the more you take, the more the dungeon notices you, until its Warden comes hunting. Die, and you lose everything you carried.

5577900.title: Pop Dynasty
5577900.short_description: Build your own talent agency in this idle management sim. Recruit from 200 Pop Stars, train them, send them on Tour, and fight for Trophies at the Awards. Your Agency keeps running even while the game is closed. And winning is only the beginning.

5577970.title: CORN!
5577970.short_description: Shuck corn to buy tools, buy tools to shuck corn. It couldn’t be more simple! Fend off wasps, children, bears, and Mean Gary! Stay inside the garage, you never know what’s waiting outside for you. Uncover all the secrets that this corn holds.

5578240.title: Okerum
5578240.short_description: Okerum is a fantasy card game of melds, bluffs and abilities. Play five modes (Okerum, Okerum 101, Slapi, Solus and ReFa) against friends, online rivals or clever bots, and turn the table with powers like Freeze, Shield and Energy Thief.

5578420.title: FINAL CUT
5578420.short_description: A text-based horror interactive fiction about a cursed grindhouse actress returning to the studio lot that ruined her. Make choices through seven genre-bending wings, survive the damage, resist the corruption, and chase one of eight endings.

5578430.title: Seedborne Chronicle
5578430.short_description: One seed grows a whole continent: towns with their own stories, deep labyrinths, and companions with dreams of their own. Lead a party through quick turn-based battles, grow old, and hand the adventure to an heir as a new foe rises from the last one.

5578490.title: Two Shells Home
5578490.short_description: A top down zombie shooter with a double barrel shotgun and never enough shells. Walk home through a dark, misty forest one stretch of trail at a time, pick your route, grow a six branch skill tree, and get past the Butcher to reach your door.

5578650.title: Lumanto
5578650.short_description: A free fantasy RPG of hooded heroes and 350+ magical creatures. Play on your own whenever you want, or join a live stream's caravan from Steam or the Twitch chat. Build your heroes, tame creatures, forge gear and trade in a player market powered by Lúmen.

5578700.title: Nobody Watching
5578700.short_description: Your inner child wants to kill you. A strategy game against cigarettes, sugar, coffee and beer.

5578780.title: DYNASTY: Silk & Blood
5578780.short_description: 1980. You have $5 million and a family name. Build companies, conquer markets, marry, raise your heirs. Rival dynasties never rest and the world never waits. You will die. Your dynasty must not.

5579060.title: AWZ Wrestling : THE VIDEO GAME
5579060.short_description: PLAY THE LIFE OF THE WRESTLERS! Featuring over 25 real wrestlers! Travel the world! Playable in airports, on the streets, at the gym… A complete wrestler experience. Discover a wrestling game different any other you've ever played!

5579310.title: Build a Sand Castle
5579310.short_description: Build a Sand Castle. Complete the task from the rich man and earn yourself 1M Dollars. The Castle is Enormous so you will be here for a while... But it would be faster if you used the Abilities and "Sugar" the man gave to you.

5579400.title: Galaxization
5579400.short_description: A galaxy and civilization simulator on your Windows wallpaper. While you work, civilizations sprout, rise, trade, fight and fall among 200,000 stars. Pick the view: the whole galaxy, the black hole, a star system, or the sky from a planet's surface. Built in Rust: light on CPU and battery.

5579420.title: Crown & Courtiers
5579420.short_description: Rule a medieval kingdom through the people around your throne. Hear petitions, bargain with nobles and clergy, and take part in hunts, tournaments and feasts. Manage supplies, weather crises and pass the crown—and your unfinished promises—to the next ruler.

5579450.title: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
5579450.short_description: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.

5579530.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
5579530.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

5579870.title: Satu GANG!
5579870.short_description: A 2D pixel-art fighting game with Indonesian neighborhood chaos. Pick one of four fighters, chain combos, and unleash cinematic supers. Play character stories, local 1 vs 1, Survival, and Training. In-game text is Indonesian.

5579920.title: White Lotus: Vows Beneath Heaven
5579920.short_description: A historical narrative management game set in eighteenth-century China. Guide a White Lotus community through fragile livelihoods, conflicting loyalties, and promises that come due. Plan each turn, care for your companions, and shape the lives they leave behind.

5580080.title: Void Drive
5580080.short_description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

5580090.title: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
5580090.short_description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

5580140.title: SpaceVivor
5580140.short_description: Lost beyond a wormhole, command a modular starship in a survival game that aims for the realism of time passing in space: long, relaxing voyages, adrenaline-fuelled battles, countless discoveries and incredible alien scenery. Rebuild your ship module by module and lead a crew of four races.

5580350.title: Under The Counter
5580350.short_description: A roguelike where your weapon is a tree of absurd pills. Take the wrong prescription, descend the dungeon under Globnix, dodge telegraphed horrors, and build a run-ending arsenal from attacks and charms. Every seed is a new dungeon. Death is just a new dose.

5580450.title: 牛马的涌现
5580450.short_description: A lightweight idle management game that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Hire quirky workers, pair them up to discover new offspring, collect breeds, traits and coats, decorate the office, and expand your company while you work.

5580510.title: Beyond 33 Days
5580510.short_description: A story-driven, top-down survival shooter spanning thirty-three days of a collapsing city. Follow Su Nuan and Lin Shen, fight the infected, gather supplies, upgrade weapons and defend a shelter at night as you search for a way back to each other.

5580660.title: DELTA // SURGE
5580660.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

5580820.title: Forts of Canada
5580820.short_description: Forts of Canada is a single-player 2D strategy game about keeping eight historic Canadian forts standing. Manage supplies, recruit troops, fire the cannons, sail dangerous waters and plan battles before watching them unfold.

5580940.title: Decorate with flowers
5580940.short_description: Decorate with flowers is a cozy, stress-free tidy up game where you arrange vibrant plants, fragrant blossoms, and aesthetic decor onto shelves. No timers, no rush - just pure floral bliss.

5581150.title: Aevalore 2
5581150.short_description: Fight through the world of Aevalore II, a fast action roguelike. Pick your hero, build your skills, defeat giant bosses, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op

5581370.title: FIRMWARE
5581370.short_description: FIRMWARE is an assembly programming puzzle game. Challenge yourself with hundreds of puzzles and different game types: Multi-core systems with shared buses and I/O pins, programming microcontrollers driving circuits, shuffling instructions to fix programs, and large programs for encoding messages.

5581540.title: Pixel Life
5581540.short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim. Start in a tiny studio, make friends with twelve townsfolk, adopt a dog, climb eight careers, collect cards for a full card game inside the game, and decide what to do with your money at the bank. Your life, your way.

5581620.title: Idleplace
5581620.short_description: Place hovering land on your sky island. Close a region to construct your buildings, then muster an army to fight the invaders landing. Collect gear from bosses as well as gaining gear in village. In battle turn on auto and your island fights on while you're idle, even floating on your desktop.

5581640.title: Until You’re Better
5581640.short_description: A first-person ASMR game in a wellness center in orbit. Every real day your nurse gives you a check-up: follow her light, guess sounds with your eyes closed, tell her which ear a sound was in. Progress your treatment to unlock new activities and more of the center. No ending, only unwinding.

5581670.title: Moorhouse
5581670.short_description: First-person horror for up to four players on a remote farm in the moors of northern Germany. Work together as survivors or play as the Moorfrau. Repair three pumps, drain the moor and burn her heart before the fifth night ends.

5581690.title: Doodle Survivors
5581690.short_description: Fight through 10 stages in a survival roguelite full of stick figures, monster hordes and ridiculous weapons. Attacks fire automatically: you dodge, collect upgrades and discover powerful evolutions. Earn gold, recruit new characters and build up permanent upgrades.

5581700.title: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
5581700.short_description: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

5581730.title: Phantom Shapes
5581730.short_description: An online co-op horror party game for 2 to 7 players. The Phantom hides a cursed shape that looks like a normal object and protects it. Up to 6 Workers search the map, argue about which thing is fake and confirm it before the Phantom catches them all. No microtransactions.

5581820.title: Couch Potato
5581820.short_description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

5581850.title: The Last Duck
5581850.short_description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

5581890.title: Warelings
5581890.short_description: A tiny 2000s gadget that lives in the corner of your desktop. Feed your Ware, take it on walks and send it into battle while you work. Every creature is a post from an internet forum that no longer exists.

5582080.title: Assassins for Hire
5582080.short_description: Four mercenaries, six contracts, one plan. Sneak, distract, knife and sabotage your way through guarded compounds in a real-time tactics game in the classic style, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

5582130.title: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
5582130.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

5582230.title: On The Come Up
5582230.short_description: Start small and work your way up in On The Come Up, a co-op crime game about making money, stealing cars, dodging police, and building a home for your crew. Follow a story that gets personal, or take a break from the missions and see what you can get away with around the city.

5582350.title: ALDERIC
5582350.short_description: The ash of a burned archive steals the names of lands and people. Only the nameless can walk through it. Choose your road on the Ash Map, break the wards, slay each land's lord and reclaim it before the ash spreads. A single-player action RPG with five classes, explosive skills and loot to hunt.

5582360.title: AstroTec
5582360.short_description: Build a ship out of snap-together blocks & fly it on its own thrusters. Mine the rocks, fight the raiders, then pull the blocks off whatever you beat & bolt them onto your own ship. Bring friends, dock your ships together & fly them as one.

5582380.title: Dread Arcana
5582380.short_description: Descend beneath the Ash Mountains in an isometric action roguelike. Fight with sword and bow, explore procedural dungeons, and defeat the guardians of four realms. Choose one of six heroes and venture alone or in local co-op for up to 4 players.

5582390.title: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
5582390.short_description: Unite a shattered Han China in 190, 194, 200 or 208 AD. Govern cities, raise spearmen, swordsmen, archers, cavalry and catapults, court allies and betray them. Every officer has a face, a history and a grudge. Turn-based grand strategy with tactical hex battles. Single player, no microtransactions.

5582410.title: VERDANT — Forest Archer
5582410.short_description: Turn one arrow into a storm. Dodge attacks, scoop up gold, and build a bow that fires piercing, ricocheting volleys in this top-down incremental action game. Choose from three archers and fight your way through five areas, one short round at a time.

5582460.title: The Water Listens
5582460.short_description: Every splash gives you away. Something lurks in the water, listening for your next move. Stay quiet, stay together, and pray it finds someone else first. Water Listens is a co-op horror game where the water carries your sound and the monster follows.

5582500.title: Toy or Not ?
5582500.short_description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

5582710.title: Gun Party
5582710.short_description: Roll for stars. Sabotage your friends. Gun Party packs 5 boards and 79 mini-games into one chaotic party night, from cart crashes to crew disasters and horror rounds. Play with 2–10 online or up to 4 in couch split-screen. Full controller support. Add bots to any match.

5582740.title: Secret Shelter
5582740.short_description: Once a corporate tycoon, you now run a shelter in a nuclear wasteland. Use cards at your corporate terminal to oversee production and research. Decide who you can spare for expeditions, fight with skill cards, and choose which survivors to trust as you piece together the truth behind the war.

5582750.title: HEIRS OF VARNA 灰冠の継承者
5582750.short_description: Command Aster and her companions in a turn-based tactical RPG told across 24 chapters. Read enemy ranges, choose who crosses first, and make good on a promise to a child waiting at the border gate.

5582780.title: Pawprint Trails
5582780.short_description: Solve cozy animal logic puzzles and help little friendships bloom. Find every friend's place across 128 puzzles, create ten shared sanctuary projects, and collect memories of picnics, stargazing, baking, and more.

5582790.title: Competition
5582790.short_description: Coach a college track & field and cross country program in a shared online world. Recruit athletes, plan their training, enter them in meets and watch them race live against other coaches' teams. Seasons follow the real calendar: one game day is one real day.

5582870.title: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends
5582870.short_description: Your boss wants the ocean empty. You get a teaspoon. Scoop, schlep and sabotage your way through an impossible job with up to 16 friends – but one of you secretly works for NEPTUN Resorts and wants the sea to stay full.

5582900.title: One More Potato
5582900.short_description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

5583160.title: Outpost Survivors
5583160.short_description: Build your defenses, recruit survivors, and fight relentless zombie hordes! Upgrade weapons, manage resources, command your team, or take direct control of a survivor. Battle through dangerous environments, survive special events, and face increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

5583210.title: Tankhounds
5583210.short_description: A dog drives a tank – against cats, postmen and a chief physician who hits at 120 metres. 15 levels, six dog breeds with their own tanks, a workshop between battles, co-op for up to four dogs and PvP with friends. Afterwards: endless mode and a new challenge every day.

5583220.title: You Said Last Wave
5583220.short_description: “Didn't you say this was the last wave?” The guns are still firing as another horde scales the wall. Auto-battling meets tower defense: combine machine guns, shotguns, fire, and chain lightning while your soldiers fight on their own. Can your setup hold until the last wave?

5583240.title: If you die, you die!
5583240.short_description: A one-life horror game inside the corpse of God. Photograph what lives in the dark. Die, and you can never play again.

5583410.title: The Longest Sword
5583410.short_description: Grow a sword that never stops getting longer, from arm's length to over 240 meters. Spin your blade through scarecrows, orchards and villages, sweep up coins for 141 upgrades, unleash double-length giant swings, and prestige to forge a blade huge enough to slice down the castle.

5583560.title: Stone Gambling Simulator
5583560.short_description: Start from a street stall. Pick stones, read them under a flashlight, haggle, cut, craft, and price your jade. One cut can make or break you — win it with an eye for stone and a tight ledger.

5583780.title: Times and Ages
5583780.short_description: Lead one of 82 nations from antiquity to modern times: found cities, research 122 technologies, build world wonders and win through conquest, science, culture, religion or diplomacy – turn-based on living 3D maps with seasons and weather.

5583980.title: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War
5583980.short_description: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War is a fantasy card battler about six races at war: humans, undead, elves, dwarves, demons and elementals. Build your deck and lead your hero through a campaign of battles and bosses, or fight real players in the ranked online Arena and its tournaments.

5584110.title: PixelHeroLegend
5584110.short_description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

5584340.title: Drive Beyond Horizons City
