5584340.short_description: Driving a vehicle over long distances requires a significant amount of supplies. While cities contain plenty of resources, they are also swarming with zombies and mercenaries; the plan is to drive toward the outskirts of the city.

5584840.title: Sort the Bazaar
5584840.short_description: Sort The Bazaar is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort a variety of items and bring life and color back to a faded roadside market. Unlock new skills, automate tasks, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning a dull, messy bazaar into a vibrant, organized marketplace at your own pace.

5584870.title: Le Cœur de l'Hydre
5584870.short_description: Dive in a dark world with Le Cœur de l’Hydre, a fantasy visual novel that blends art, science, and the occult. Meet various characters and mysterious creatures and take decisions to survive.

5584920.title: TILELIA
5584920.short_description: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.

5584940.title: Tanks 2026
5584940.short_description: A tank battle in the spirit of old 8-bit games. Hold the base across 35 stages or in RANDOM mode, where enemies hunt you down. Clear stages clean to earn rewards you keep for good. Play solo or with a friend, in pixel art or HD.

5584970.title: Don't Sell the Cat
5584970.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

5584980.title: Trivia Arena: The Grand Stage
5584980.short_description: A party trivia game show on a grand velvet stage. Up to 8 friends join with their phones as controllers: no app, just scan the QR code. Answer wrong and your plush drops through a trapdoor. Three game modes, thousands of questions, seasonal events and online play with friends.

5585000.title: Lights Out Pact
5585000.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

5585060.title: Videogame Automation Engineer
5585060.short_description: In this visual programming game, you become a video game tester for different clients. Using intuitive image sensors and logic wiring, you automate a vast collection of minigames to make your circuit press the right virtual gamepad buttons at the right time.

5585140.title: The Dungeon
5585140.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

5585200.title: Twenty Till Him
5585200.short_description: Kidnapped by a serial killer. Twenty seconds per room. Four ways out, and only one lets you live. Read the dust, the draft, the blood and the silence, then choose before the masked old man comes back. One mistake and you wake up tied in the first room again. 100 rooms. One house. No happy ending.

5585310.title: MAGOS
5585310.short_description: Master your spells and stay one step ahead of your rivals in simultaneous turn-based wizard duels. Combine elements that react with each other and transform the environment, unleashing chaotic battles. Discover powerful combos that could wipe out your enemies... or backfire on you!

5585360.title: 200 OK
5585360.short_description: A node-based idle game about running a server. Wire up requests, tune the bottlenecks, research your way from one uplink to a global edge. Calm, steady and fully offline-friendly.

5585630.title: Dream Highway
5585630.short_description: A rhythm drive beneath alien megastructures. The music builds the road, sets your speed and lights up the sky. Steer to stay on the highway, lift the nose on the beat to catch orbs, and hold through the boosts. More songs, and your own music, are coming in updates.

5585770.title: Motkin
5585770.short_description: Charge pistons, grow bridges, and turn gravity sideways. Guide Motkin, a one-wheeled maintenance robot, through 75 handcrafted physics puzzles by clicking the machinery around him and figuring out how its parts work together.

5585850.title: My Tennis Story
5585850.short_description: 🎾 Learn real tennis tactics and choose your shots. 🤝 Train, make friends and shape Mateo’s story. 🏆 Climb the leagues and win a tennis scholarship before he turns 16.

5585860.title: SEE YOU ON THE ROOF
5585860.short_description: August 31. The lift is broken again, and your friends are on the roof waiting for the last sunset of summer. Tonight your neighbours are out on the landings, and each of them has something to say to you. Hurry. The sun won't wait.

5585980.title: Bibliopyre
5585980.short_description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

5586070.title: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That
5586070.short_description: Your files are coming for you! Become a weaponized Recycle Bin, blast endless waves of hostile data, collect powerful perks, and survive the ultimate digital apocalypse in this chaotic bullet heaven roguelite!

5586190.title: Elf Raid!
5586190.short_description: Storm the castle with a band of brave little elves and rescue Fairycorn before Sir Grumblebottom marries her! Couch co-op for 1 to 3 kids aged 3 to 10: pick a boy or girl elf in your own colours, choose your own difficulty, and nobody gets left behind.

5586200.title: CTRL+ALT+BURN
5586200.short_description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

5586370.title: Strange Plains
5586370.short_description: Roam as a buffalo through seven strange eras in this single-player action roguelite. Graze to survive, restore the prairie, and protect a growing herd. Face hunters, cryptids and visitors from above, then carry your surviving family home to the Wallow.

5586550.title: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
5586550.short_description: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

5586660.title: Selling Stars: An Idle Space Game
5586660.short_description: Grow your little solar energy company into a galactic business! Build Dyson spheres to harvest stellar energy, then put your profits toward automated production and interstellar trade. Settle into a cozy idle rhythm as you expand at your own pace.

5586930.title: DeadPoly Desert
5586930.short_description: Use resources from the teleportation islands to build back in the desert, and attempt to reach even more distant worlds.

5586990.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
5586990.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

5587040.title: Core Valley
5587040.short_description: Build a home, grow your farm, and follow adventure beyond your doorstep. Core Valley blends cozy farming, crafting, fishing, and animal care with underground exploration, dungeons, and boss battles. Play solo or together in LAN co-op.

5587540.title: Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle
5587540.short_description: Master the grid in Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle! Drag and drop geometric polyomino shapes into boxes, solve relaxing tangram-style logic puzzles, and experience the ultimate satisfying fit. Play at your own pace!

5587850.title: Seabreeze Atelier
5587850.short_description: Seabreeze Atelier is a cozy island-building game. Shape coastlines, carve rivers, and connect gardens and cottages with paths and bridges. Cast a line from your pier, then turn the island you built into a live Windows wallpaper and watch the boats drift by.

5588000.title: AFK Throne
5588000.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

5588160.title: One Twisted Boxing Day
5588160.short_description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

5588240.title: Dear Astronauts
5588240.short_description: You and up to three friends crew the world's worst space-tourism rocket. Launch it, fly it, feed the tourists, fix what breaks, go outside when you have to, and try to land with most of them still on board. Online co-op for 1-4 players.

5588330.title: 纸牌矿工
5588330.short_description: Card Miner is a casual strategy game blending poker, resource gathering, and deck building. Play cards to earn points and rewards, collect wood, grass, and ore to buy upgrades, and use special cards and multipliers to maximize earnings within limited plays on your way to a million coins.

5588440.title: Casus Foederis: 1815
5588440.short_description: Your ally is attacked and calls you into a war you never wanted. Answer, and you fight. Refuse, and every court in Europe remembers. Lead one of twelve powers from 1815 to 1871; grow too fast and the continent unites against you. A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy. Single-player.

5588570.title: My Cat Cafe Simulator
5588570.short_description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for CAT !!!

5588680.title: Save the Dateless Guy: Case.1 Sakura Hayase
5588680.short_description: A "realistic" dating ADV that tests your "dating skills." As an Apprentice God, you must make the love of a man with no romantic experience come true. A one-of-a-kind, controversial game by an executive at a marriage agency.

5589210.title: Nonogram Kingdom
5589210.short_description: Turn numbers into pictures. Solve 1,400 color nonograms across 28 themes, choose a board you like, and watch each finished picture rise from the grid.

5589470.title: Starry Paws
5589470.short_description: Lost animals have stopped on the road. Guide them to the stars with the crow.

5589520.title: 50 Trillion Grains Of Sand
5589520.short_description: Dig through 50 trillion grains of sand in a first-person incremental digging sim. Start with a spoon, buy bigger tools, and put machines and Egyptian gods to work as you uncover a buried pyramid and discover the treasure hidden in its tomb.

5589760.title: Multi Miner Madness
5589760.short_description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

5589790.title: Club XV: Rugby Manager
5589790.short_description: Take charge of a rugby club in a management simulation. Recruit players, develop young talent, manage your squad and shape your tactics. Watch your team compete in 3D matches as you build your club for long-term success.

5590000.title: Lily's Little Golf Game
5590000.short_description: Party golf for up to four players, all on the same hole at once. Race to the cup on wild mini golf courses, sabotage your rivals on the open links, or turn your clubs into weapons in the battle arena. Play on one screen or play online. You can even build your own minigolf courses!

5590040.title: Lily's Little Dart Game
5590040.short_description: Couch party darts for up to four players. Race from 301 down to zero, cause mayhem in a three-minute Chaos match, or steer your dart in slow motion through an obstacle course in The Gauntlet. Play on one screen or online with friends.

5590280.title: World Trails: Hiking Simulator
5590280.short_description: Walk 30 real hiking trails across six continents, from the Dolomites to Everest Base Camp. Scramble up steep slopes, camp in huts and tents, survive snow, fog and thin air, and photograph the world's great peaks. A third-person hiking simulator.

5590510.title: AntiClimatic
5590510.short_description: A physics based weather simulator where you change the weather patterns throughout 30+ scenarios.

5590590.title: Brilliancy!!
5590590.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

5590870.title: Moscow Lizards vs Aliens
5590870.short_description: Long, long ago, lizard-folk settled near Moscow. They grew fond of all things Russian: *kosovorotka* shirts, *ushanka* fur hats, pickled cucumbers, and, of course, vodka. For centuries, they quietly guarded the land of Rus’… until aliens arrived from the planet Nibiru.

5590880.title: Gop-Stop Increment: Defend the Block
5590880.short_description: A clicker-meets-tower-defense game set in the meme-filled 90s. Hustle vodka, snap up kiosks and video rental shops, and use sunflower seeds to build your entryway defenses—think a granny with a stool, a boombox blasting *shanson* (Russian outlaw folk music), and a chained-up bear.

5590990.title: Mutoid 2
5590990.short_description: Fight east through mutant hordes in a top-down survival shooter where heads pop and limbs come off. Revive fallen allies to fight beside you until the infection turns them back. Find and unlock an arsenal of guns, gear and perks to power your next run.

5591090.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 2
5591090.short_description: This ninja master is back in action in the second installment of this fast-paced, vibrant puzzle-platformer - and this time, he’s brought a friend along.

5591100.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3
5591100.short_description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters

5591120.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
5591120.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level in this new installment of a vibrant ninja-themed puzzle-platformer!

5591240.title: Spellstorm
5591240.short_description: Eight wildly asymmetrical wizards do battle for Storm Shards in this highly original tactical deckbuilder.

5591280.title: This Arcade Is Broken
5591280.short_description: This Arcade Is Broken is a short incremental game about a kid with a screwdriver secretly rewiring three classic arcade cabinets until they print tokens on their own. Upgrade their circuit boards, build helper paddles and drones, unleash fever mode... and don’t let the grumpy owner catch you.

5591380.title: Semi-Realistic Dating Game
5591380.short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a truck? Have you ever wanted to date a truck? Now you can do both! Go on convoys, take them on dates, maybe bring them to your garage in this visual novel style dating game.

5591420.title: WRECKRUN RACING
5591420.short_description: Free arcade racing with competitive AI, 14 race maps, a rally stage and a sandbox. Race five rivals, beat the clock and hold the perfect line. Keyboard, gamepad and steering wheel supported. A high school graduation project.

5591540.title: Hollow Galley
5591540.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel Thessaly goes silent, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this story driven 3D cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery with multiple endings.

5591830.title: Main Event Mogul
5591830.short_description: Book the card, manage the roster and run the business of your own pro wrestling promotion, then watch every match play out in 3D as a live TV broadcast with entrances, commentary and a roaring crowd.

5591840.title: BIG. BAD. BOOM!
5591840.short_description: A hand-drawn Cold War strategy game. Spend three years making decisions, building up your army, culture, science and birth rate, and spying on your neighbors. The red button is dealt at random: wipe your neighbor off the face of the earth or win without firing a single shot.

5592650.title: Everpixel
5592650.short_description: Everpixel is what happens when you combine tactical RPG, pixels, and wiener dogs. Lead your motley crew to pixelated dominance--or die trying.

5592710.title: The Perfect Crime
5592710.short_description: 1974, a city where it always rains. You are the cleaner: you have fifteen minutes before the police arrive to make a death tell another story. Then the detective walks in, and you watch the reasoning unfold, step by step. If it reaches the truth, you lose.

5592890.title: Cat Shelter Simulator
5592890.short_description: Build a cozy cat shelter, rescue abandoned kittens, and give every feline a loving home! Feed, groom, heal and play with your cats, build friendships, and discover the joy of finding them their forever families.

5592980.title: Bermuda Trial
5592980.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore the wonders and dangers of the mysterious Bermuda Island.

5593360.title: Sandgrave
5593360.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

5593520.title: Touhou Hikouroku ~ Flight Risk
5593520.short_description: Marisa fires her Master Spark and the recoil sends her flying. Blast your way around the great library, steal the books, and watch Patchouli's bill grow.

5593890.title: Bricks in Place: Tidy Up the Manor!
5593890.short_description: Build a miniature manor in this relaxing first-person building sim. Find the right pieces in a mountain of bricks, follow 3D blueprints, and bring six buildings to life with a helpful cat. Build solo or team up in co-op for up to four players.

5594030.title: SQUISH N POPS
5594030.short_description: Fire a moonbeam straight up and split every bouncing bubble into two smaller ones until the sky is empty. A 200-level campaign in five acts, each ending in a boss, with 19 bubble traits and eight powerups, then all 200 again with the camera in close. Chain pops into FEVER and earn new looks.

5594850.title: Night Shift: Grandma's Rules
5594850.short_description: You are the last night guard at a closed Thai hospital. Follow your grandmother's rules, solve what each night leaves behind, and find out why the building is still counting its dead.

5595350.title: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
5595350.short_description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

5595530.title: You Can’t Clock Out
5595530.short_description: You dozed off at your desk. Now your coworkers have horses’ heads. You Can’t Clock Out is a first-person horror game about escaping an office gone terribly wrong. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and follow company rules as you make your way downstairs. Don’t let your coworkers catch you.

5595560.title: WHO'S LIVE?
5595560.short_description: Hide among NPCs and stream live! WHO'S LIVE? is an online stealth and deduction game for up to 4 players. Streamers earn donations while staying hidden, while Enforcers use livestream footage delayed by about 2 seconds to track them down. Play solo or with friends!

5595860.title: DEFCON 89
5595860.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

5596240.title: AquaScape Desk
5596240.short_description: A planted aquarium sim that lives on your desktop. Build a hardscape from stones and driftwood, plant it, and let the fish swim. Plants grow in real time, so trimming matters. You can even scan real stones and driftwood and drop them straight in. Reef tanks with corals, too.

5596280.title: Mall Chaos
5596280.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

5596460.title: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
5596460.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

5597010.title: Wool Shop
5597010.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives along the edge of your screen. Your sheep graze, their wool is spun and knitted, and customers shop at your little store while you work. Your sheepdog follows your cursor and helps herd the flock.

5597120.title: Okey Dokey
5597120.short_description: The tile-rummy roguelite. Lay runs and groups, outplay a rival at every table and stack boosts with regulars, drinks and enchanted tiles on a tour of the world's tile clubs, from Lisbon to the Grand Salon.

5597630.title: Vector Rush
5597630.short_description: Sink into space and music in this neon sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Blast through swarms of vector enemies, take down the giants guarding each world, grow stronger with every run, and escape a collapsing star system.

5597670.title: Feudal Fall
5597670.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

5598690.title: Sons of Mercury
5598690.short_description: Atlantic, 1765. Start with a small ship and, turn by turn, build a trading house across 39 ports on four continents. A price is as fresh as the ship that brought it, so the news you buy, steal, or ignore matters. Spy, smuggle, or keep your hands clean. Every house and crown you cross remembers.

5598710.title: Million Layer Gift Simulator
5598710.short_description: A giant gift with 1,000,000 layers of wrapping paper. Peel it strip by strip, sell the paper, and buy better tools, from nail clippers to a leaf blower. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. What’s inside? There’s only one way to find out.

5599050.title: Kicked Out
5599050.short_description: The bailiffs are at the door and you have only one minute. Throw what you can out of the window, then jump after it. Beg, dig through the trash, survive the nights and save $100 before the street breaks you.

5599530.title: I'd Choose the Bear
5599530.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

5599580.title: Universe of the Damned
5599580.short_description: The Year is 2150 and Earth is on the brink of collapse. Humans have resorted to colonizing other planets to prevent their demise. The EFS received a distress call from one of their colonies on Mars. An elite unit is sent down to the surface to find out what has happened.

5599600.title: Fullower
5599600.short_description: Plant 100,456 flowers to decorate the Vegetable Boys' stage. A cozy first-person game about filling the empty terraced field around the stage with flowers, color by color.

5599650.title: Trash Nights
5599650.short_description: Autumn, 1998. You take the night shift on garbage truck No. 7 in Maple Hollow, a quiet suburb whose last crew quit without notice. One street a night, 11 PM to 4 AM. Every house leaves its trash on the curb, and one neighbor's bags should not exist.

5601220.title: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
5601220.short_description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

5601240.title: OVERSPRAY
5601240.short_description: OVERSPRAY is a free-to-play tactical 4v4 paintball shooter. Buy your gear every round and fight over a single flag in the middle of the map. Nobody dies — everybody gets soaked.

5601460.title: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
5601460.short_description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

5601570.title: CRIMSON GATE
5601570.short_description: A roguelite RPG where auto battler meets tower defense! Summon and deploy 30 battle dolls. Grow your legion with gear and card combos, and take on the final boss waiting at the end of 100 waves.

5601590.title: Aldorian Saga:Farming Hero
5601590.short_description: You are the last survivor of the royal family, and the power the goddess gave you is... just farming? But you won't give up! Sell crops for gold, open up mines and forests to craft trade goods, brave dangerous trade routes, and earn the funds and raise the army to take your kingdom back!

5601650.title: Saint Hallow
5601650.short_description: An nice little adventure game with a SPRINKLE of horror on top, this Cat and Mouse game is a steady paced, action oriented experience! Gather coins, find notes, and escape the claws of the Traeger Wolf. Be sure to utilize your powers, they may come in handy later.

5601810.title: Windwhisper Saga
5601810.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

5601990.title: RE: Rags to Royalties
5601990.short_description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

5602250.title: Rolling Toolman 3: Darkness
5602250.short_description: Toolman is back in this 3prd person adventure game. Roll and try to reach goal as soon as you can and avoid falling from map and beware obstacles and traps

5602400.title: Your Lovely Legs
5602400.short_description: Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap. A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet. Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

5602770.title: Witch, Gnomes, Faun and Others
5602770.short_description: Put your gnomes to work, build a settlement, and keep the local witch happy in this first-person mix of village management and fairy-tale horror. Rebuild the Gnomehenge to get everyone home.

5603040.title: Tick or Kick!
5603040.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

5603070.title: GIGALANCE
5603070.short_description: Build a planet-shattering beam cannon from scratch. Combine reactors, accelerators, and cooling systems to unleash devastating firepower. But push too far, and your own weapon could melt or tear itself apart. Design, rebuild, and fire your ultimate creation to save Earth.

5603090.title: Spin & Win: Casino Business Sim
5603090.short_description: Their luck. Your business. Build your casino, work the floor, and hire a crew to keep the cash flowing. Draw crowds with live shows, then join your guests for poker, blackjack, or a spin on the slots.

5603120.title: Save the North Pole
5603120.short_description: Oh no! A snowstorm has buried Santa’s village at the North Pole! The wind blew the ornaments off the giant tree and hid them in the snow, and Christmas is tomorrow! Become an elf and team up with friends to clear the paths, dig up the ornaments and hang them on the tree. Save Christmas!

5603230.title: Sad Virus Mythic Land
5603230.short_description: Sad virus third person simulation adventure game series continue now in small map which include forest and castle themed adventure where mission avoid traps and collect bottles

5603340.title: Pawn Shop Tycoon
5603340.short_description: Run a pixel-art pawn shop, from a tiny corner store to a city emporium. Haggle with every customer, learn what things are really worth, spot fakes and stolen goods, gamble on storage units and drive your rival out of business.

5603370.title: Zoo Life Tycoon
5603370.short_description: Inherit a run-down zoo at the edge of town and turn it into the pride of the city. Repair pens, care for 21 species, welcome families and juggle your own life too: eat, sleep, make friends and upgrade your home in this cozy pixel-art zoo tycoon and life sim.

5603680.title: Desktop Reimu
5603680.short_description: Desktop Reimu is a Touhou Project fan-made idle game that sits along the bottom edge of your screen. Your key presses and clicks turn into donations while you work, and Reimu heads out to resolve incidents.

5604090.title: Corner Club
5604090.short_description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

5604570.title: Kit Keeper
5604570.short_description: Be the Kit Keeper of a football shirt shop. A truck dumps 540 shirts on the floor. Read the badge and number, find the player in the Kit Catalog, print the name and hang the shirt where it belongs. A cozy first-person sorting game.

5604610.title: ALL PASSENGERS BUCKLE UP
5604610.short_description: Run a budget airline in 1-6 player co-op. Check passports, load the bags, fly the route and keep the passengers fed while the jet catches fire around you. Take bribes, dodge storms and climb onto the roof mid-flight. Hit the quota or the whole crew is fired.

5604730.title: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
5604730.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

5604770.title: 검 강화하기
5604770.short_description: Hammer a rusty dagger into a legendary blade. Every press of the forge can succeed, fail or shatter your sword. Evolve 119 swords across elemental lines, sell high and reinvest, then take your blade into real-time 1v1 duels and race tournaments against other players.

5605180.title: Old School Golf
5605180.short_description: Master the swing, shape your shots, and sink the putt in a retro arcade golf game featuring 14 unique courses, dynamic weather, tournaments, and a full season career.

5605290.title: Haoru: Desktop Chaos
5605290.short_description: A chibi anime girl moves onto your real Windows desktop: she keeps you company while you work, reads, naps and plays on your windows, and wrecks everything on screen with 27 over-the-top weapons and 15 pranks. Dress her up, build an island village, befriend Kitsune and Neko. Only pixels get hurt.

5605450.title: Slaysurge
5605450.short_description: The world shattered and its shards rose into the sky. You are the last Warden. Leadyour company across eight floating realms, march through the Firmament and ride asteam citadel into the Gorges in a fast, never-stalling idle RPG.

5605730.title: Modan's Book of Myths: The Nameless Knight
5605730.short_description: Control a party of up to four unique heroes in this turn-based RPG to rid the nation of Haven from evil forces both supernatural and humanoid in nature!

5606100.title: shooter
5606100.short_description: SHOOTER is a pixel-art Wild West quick-draw duel. Play solo, local two-player, or online. Free download for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

5606180.title: 101 Cats: Guangzhou
5606180.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Guangzhou landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

5606190.title: 101 Cats: Hamburg
5606190.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Hamburg landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

5606200.title: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
5606200.short_description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

5606250.title: Block Party Apocalypse
5606250.short_description: A blocky third-person zombie shooter for 1–4 players. Fight 30 waves across three days of the outbreak, stack upgrade cards, grab miniguns and flamethrowers from supply drops, and reach the last evacuation helicopter out of Port Haven.

5606370.title: The Resilience Protocol
5606370.short_description: An incremental game about a switch. Wake up in a small room. Flip the switch. Watch the number go up. A calm voice thanks you for your contribution. Upgrade, automate, sleep, repeat, and listen carefully to what the voice says, and to what it corrects.

5606560.title: Psycho Santa
5606560.short_description: Pilot Santa’s weaponized sleigh, smash through houses, and deliver presents with the police on your tail. When Krampus knocks you out of the sky, fight on foot, hijack tanks, and decide who gets a second chance in this darkly comic Christmas action game.

5606970.title: We Have a Robot Problem
5606970.short_description: Every robot in the vault has wandered off its charging rack. Catch them, stack them in your arms and put each one back in its own spot. Thousands of robots with hats and costumes, handy tools and a Workshop full of upgrades. A cosy, silly tidy up game.

5607210.title: Touhou Gomoku
5607210.short_description: In Touhou Gomoku, you're one stone from five in a row when Marisa's Last Spell, Final Spark, wipes out your line. 50 spell cards freeze points, steal stones and cut lines. Beat nine Kourindou regulars to win their cards, or play a friend locally or online. From the makers of Touhou Chess.

5607420.title: Golden Town Card Shop
5607420.short_description: Run a fantasy card shop and venture into dungeons with a deck of your own. Bring sealed cards home to appraise, then choose what to collect, display, or sell. Turn your earnings into a better shop and prepare for your next adventure.

5607430.title: Retro Cinema - Movie Theater Simulator
5607430.short_description: It's 1988 and the neighborhood cinema is yours. Tear tickets at the box office, pop fresh popcorn, pour sodas and slushies, and thread the reels in the projection booth. A cozy, nostalgic single-player sim about the simple satisfaction of running your own movie theater.

5607470.title: My Summer, Your Silence
5607470.short_description: Linus thought a new city could leave the past behind. But summer lingers: a heartbeat sounds in the woods, an old school lies beneath the water, and a girl says she has been waiting for him. A story-driven visual novel of school days, surreal repetition, and buried memories.

5607540.title: Mahjong: Forever
5607540.short_description: A calm mahjong solitaire journey across six hand-painted worlds. Clear 79 hand-crafted boards, earn up to 237 stars, try timed and hidden-tile challenges, and come back every day for a fresh Daily Challenge. Every deal is guaranteed solvable.

5607680.title: Wildermeld
5607680.short_description: Hunt four dragons in a side-scrolling dark fantasy RPG. Explore a world generated anew each game, build your hero, brave dangerous dungeons, craft equipment and survive hunger, fatigue and the wilds. Earn four kingdoms' trust, with optional permadeath.

5607830.title: Stay Lit
5607830.short_description: You're the last ember. He's the jerk who blew out the rest. Roll through 130 trap-packed levels in 26 worlds while Snuff, a shadow imp, rigs each level right in front of you and takes notes on how you play, so the level changes after you die.

5608020.title: Flag Boom! Chronicles
5608020.short_description: Plant your flag on a fort and your WHOLE ARMY DOUBLES! A pixel-art RTS where hundreds of archers, spearmen and cavalry clash in a rock-paper-scissors war. Pick a unit type, march, seize forts and watch your army explode. 20 stages, 4 giant bosses.

5608170.title: Voidrush
5608170.short_description: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

5608340.title: Little Kingdom Xiangqi
5608340.short_description: Xiangqi (Chinese Chess) with adorable characters! Learn the rules, battle an AI from beginner to master, solve 200 puzzles and dress up your pieces in 11 outfits (5 included, 6 in the Outfit Pack DLC). Offline, no ads.

5608870.title: Smash Arena
5608870.short_description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

5609050.title: Clumsy Robot
5609050.short_description: A clumsy robot wants to prove he's useful. Walk him through 33 physics-based obstacle courses, from farms and offices to airports and banks. Carry fragile cargo, compete against ridiculous rivals, and fall in hilarious ways. Then challenge up to 7 friends in online races!

5609660.title: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!
5609660.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

5610110.title: Dog Soup
5610110.short_description: Your significant other is coming home in a few minutes. The pot is empty. And a hungry beast is running around the house eating your vegetables. Grab them, carry them, throw them in the soup, and try not to get hit with a rolling pin!

5610360.title: Sidepeak
5610360.short_description: A tiny climber lives on the edge of your screen. Every key you press, in any app, carries them from Montmartre to Everest, real peaks at their real altitude. Take a break and they pitch camp, which you decorate with their finds. And when the mountains run out? That's for you to find out.

5610550.title: 돌깨
5610550.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

5610840.title: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险
5610840.short_description: Your desktop is now a tiny planet. MONOVA is a cozy auto-battler ARPG about collecting adorable creatures, building a trio of battlers, and hunting game-changing loot — all while your pets live right on your taskbar.

5610880.title: Baked Blocks
5610880.short_description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

5612780.title: Orb Immortal
5612780.short_description: Roll your god's crystal orb through 150+ hand-built stages across the heavens, into the cosmos, and beyond the halls of the divine. Tilt the world to chase medals and leaderboards and shatter the statues of your rivals. Race your friends and compete to be the first to reach the secret levels.

5613090.title: Into Ember Depths
5613090.short_description: A free online bullet-hell RPG where everyone shares one island. Its 41 bosses are built for groups, so whoever is nearby can jump in. When a hero dies, it is gone for good, and the foe that killed them may take their name. Below the island, the Descent has no bottom.

5613280.title: Piston & Co.
5613280.short_description: You spent years at someone else's bench. Now the sign carries your name. Diagnose the fault, choose the part, look the customer in the eye — then buy wrecks, hire a crew, build a plant and put your marque on the tank. No interest, no gambling: honest trade wins.

5613590.title: Dreams to Studio
5613590.short_description: Build your dream career from a small room to your own gaming empire! Create content, stream, develop games, upgrade your equipment and shape your future in an open-ended life and management simulation where every decision matters.

5614170.title: Karanan: Gravebound
5614170.short_description: A dark turn-based adventure game where you explore deep dungeons, solve puzzles, and fight monsters. Find hidden secrets and rebuild a forgotten graveyard.

5614290.title: FLIP MACHINA
5614290.short_description: Reversi meets roguelike. Plant machine stones on the board, flank them to fire them off, and chain your score through charms and upgrades. Build your own scoring engine and go for the legendary eight-way OCTAFLIP in a cozy late-night puzzle shop.

5614450.title: Rocco’s Card Shop
5614450.short_description: Rip open packs, pull Golden cards and turn Rocco's tiny card shop into an empire. Flip cards on a live market, grade your best, run the auction house, dodge the loan shark, then close up shop and come back bigger. One more pack. Just one more.

5614640.title: DUST & DEBT
5614640.short_description: Framed for a debt of one billion in a ruined world. Explore 10 km × 10 km of Ashfall and shape your build with over 2,500 gear designs and branching skills. Find a loyal canine companion, uncover the truth behind the debt, and confront the man who took your freedom.

5614760.title: BONKABIND
5614760.short_description: Ever forgotten how to shoot in the middle of a gunfight? In BONKABIND, players can swap each other's keyboard and mouse controls! One round you're a sharpshooter. The next, you're running backward, crouching by accident, and wondering where your shoot button went.

5614990.title: Brokie
5614990.short_description: You went all in with borrowed money and lost everything. Start over with $3,000 in a share house: work part-time jobs, gather clues from news, rumors and store shelves, trade 18 fictional stocks and keep your stress in check. How far can you climb in one year?

5615030.title: Spare Parts: Episode 3
5615030.short_description: Unit 02 wants nothing more than to hide away in the basement, passing the days doing nothing of consequence with Unit 04. But Unit 03—now Melanie—seeks to run a cafe for humans upstairs, and it's only a matter of time before their secret is out and their lives are ruined. Where can 02 find peace?

5615600.title: Defend the Village
5615600.short_description: Build towers along winding waterways and Defend your Village against pirate fleets. Combine mythic powers, grow crops, research upgrades, and face powerful bosses across multiple maps in an epic single-player fantasy tower defense adventure.

5615920.title: The Greedy Mimic
5615920.short_description: You are the chest. Heroes raid the dungeon, you eat them and keep their gold. Buy upgrades mid-run from 150 skills in 10 trees, set traps, summon minions and survive a threat that grows every minute. Die, ascend, get greedier.

5616260.title: Afterground: The Children
5616260.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

5616350.title: Become an AI Company Boss
5616350.short_description: Run an AI company in the wildest race in tech. Survive a congressional grilling, chase your own runaway robot through Chinatown, smuggle chips under frozen fish, outfly helicopters in a flying sports car and ship three thousand robots to Mars. Every choice rewrites the ending.

5616970.title: Deepfold: One Day Deep
5616970.short_description: Deepfold is a papercraft mining story about letters from your grandmother, trapped 66 million years in the past since a 2019 accident. She lived there 20 years. Plant ore in the past, fast-forward millions of years, and dig it up by hand. Each upgrade brings up her next letter. Take your time.

5617110.title: Toyworks
5617110.short_description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

5617150.title: Shardfall
5617150.short_description: A classic real-time strategy war for the crystal that fell from the sky. Build a base, harvest Vitrium and command the Concordat, the Ascendancy or the alien Harrow through three campaigns, then wake the Mandate. Fight five levels of AI in skirmish, or battle your friends online.

5617340.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
5617340.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

5617520.title: REAL GO: Go Game (Baduk · Weiqi)
5617520.short_description: Light Go that opens straight to the board. Play Go against an AI that plays like a real person of your rank, from 20 kyu to 9 dan. Ask for advice and see live position analysis mid-game, solve 1,800+ classic tsumego, and pick from 13 boards and 39 stone sets in 3D or 2D. From beginner to pro.

5617700.title: Struggle of Empires
5617700.short_description: Write your orders, wait for the turn, then open your realm's newspaper to find out who betrayed whom. A play-by-email empire game in the old style: rule a fantasy realm, a steampunk power (1750 to 1914) or a real people from 5000 BC to today, against friends, strangers or the computer.

5618360.title: Generations Of Steel
5618360.short_description: The PvE and PvP Tank Battle game from WW1 to 1941. Fight in 30v30 battles over objectives and a career mode that you can customize yourself.

5618440.title: CRUCIBLE OF THE ABYSS
5618440.short_description: Slot, fuse, and discover. A dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawler where you build every action from parts, melt them together into new powers, and descend fifty floors into the abyss.

5618520.title: Voices from the Vase
5618520.short_description: Voices from the Vase is a story-driven psychological horror game about a young couple forced to take odd jobs to make ends meet. But some jobs come with a price far greater than money.

5618830.title: Popscraper
5618830.short_description: Pop one million balloons in a cartoon first-person incremental shooter. Ride the elevator up the tower as every floor holds ten times more, turn confetti into silly weapons and idle machines, and pop the King Balloon on each floor to reach the top.

5618840.title: Please, let me fish.
5618840.short_description: All you want is to fish, but the Tide has other plans. Hold off endless swarms of cute monsters on tiny planets, collect 60 Devices, fuse them into Overclocks, and grow strong enough to face the Tide Lords! Then maybe you’ll cast your line again...

5618890.title: Mortis Survivors: Blood Arena
5618890.short_description: Dark-Fantasy Horde Survivor & Action Roguelite: Conquer 6 fortress arenas, unlock 6 champions, evolve weapons into Mythic forms and Divine or Demonic fusions, forge 64 artifacts & 6 gear sets — solo or in 1–4 player Online & Local Co-op!

5618920.title: Too Many Dudes!
5618920.short_description: A cozy tidy-up game with over 7,000 sleepy dudes in 104 colorful costumes. Match them to their shelves, watch completed rows come alive, and unlock upgrades across 8 themed wings. No timers. No rush. Just too many dudes.

5619350.title: Midgard Arena
5619350.short_description: Lead a party of four anime heroes across a shared 3D world. Hunt in real time on the same maps as other players, take down world bosses together, trade at the player market and test your build in 5v5 Arena and Battle Royale.

5619950.title: Dudo
5619950.short_description: How good are you at lying? Everyone cheats, and cheating is the rules in Dudo. Peek under cups, nudge your dice, lie to a table of crooks and climb through smoky back rooms to find out who is the Owner. A roguelike deckbuilder of bluffs, loaded dice and bad company.

5620150.title: AnkhForge
5620150.short_description: Tower defense in ancient Egypt: build by day, shape-shift into divine forms by night.

5620430.title: Pantheon Wars: Auto Battler
5620430.short_description: Command 198 gods and legends from 18 pantheons in a mythology auto battler. Draft from a shared pool, merge copies into 3 star legends, stack pantheon bonuses and outlast 7 rivals.

5620460.title: The Ludic Wound
5620460.short_description: Beneath the wallpaper, a cursor blinks in a language older than sleep. The apartment remembers you. The machine dreams of the one dreaming it. Somewhere between the pixel and the void, a wound is opened.

5621170.title: Eau de Tycoon
5621170.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

5621210.title: Turret Slayer
5621210.short_description: Build your own turrets, one wild part at a time. Find secret combos, fight off boarders, beat the bosses, then take your winning ships into the Galactic War.

5621850.title: Bubble Boom 2000
5621850.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a free-to-play Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

5622120.title: SiegeLine
5622120.short_description: SiegeLine is a four-way fantasy strategy battle. Your barracks send waves at your neighbors on their own. You decide where the gold goes: income, upgrades, heroes and base spells. No unit control: every choice is about timing. Inspired by the classic Survival Chaos custom map.

5622490.title: Forged in Formation
5622490.short_description: Round up the scattered rebels of '98 on a Crown-held Caribbean island and lead them out past redcoat volleys, charging boars, alligators and one very angry gaoler. One button snaps your crowd into Column, Line or Square. Pick the right shape in time and the danger walks straight past you.

5622620.title: PaperKrieg
5622620.short_description: A real-time strategy game of paper soldiers and fantasy. Build brigades, arm them from your city, and choose formations that counter the enemy. Overwhelm them with trains, balloons, dragons, or tanks. Seize key points on the map, or hold out in endless defense against a paper horde.

5622720.title: Battle for Noalea
5622720.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

5622730.title: Silent Hunt: Horror Escape
5622730.short_description: Investigate a house marked by a massacre, solve puzzles, and uncover what lurks in the darkness. But be careful… you're not alone.

5622850.title: Nedi Multiplayer TD
5622850.short_description: Build a maze, line it with towers and grow it for weeks. Collect creature cards and send them in one ordered wave into other players' mazes, then defend yours while you are away. Beat the weekly World Boss, climb the Sky Race and wake Nedi, the stone titan.

5623160.title: LATENT – Fragment 01
5623160.short_description: You wake up in a rotting clinic. No one is here. Almost no one. LATENT – Fragment 01 is an anime-style survival horror game.

5623230.title: Desktop Doodle
5623230.short_description: Draw a desktop companion or import a PSD file to create one automatically. Give it your voice, feed it, interact with it, and watch it react to your PC activity while you work, study, or play. Share creations and find new friends on Steam Workshop.

5623240.title: Pinball Boss Quest
5623240.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

5623320.title: Taubenchaos
5623320.short_description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat unsuspecting tourists, dodge the janitor and take on 32 wild bosses - alone, on one couch or online with a friend via Steam. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Endless mode and a music box with 101 tracks.

5623410.title: BetterAtGambling
5623410.short_description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

5623500.title: Through the Varnish
5623500.short_description: A love letter to art. Walk into fifteen of the most beloved paintings ever made, explore them as living 3D worlds, and meet the people who live inside them.

5623550.title: Bookshelves
5623550.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

5623820.title: Pinata
5623820.short_description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 3 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

5623920.title: FIREDAMP
5623920.short_description: Ostrava region, November 1994. Following a methane explosion, the entire shift—including your younger brother—remains trapped in the Terezie mine. Descend 900 meters underground with a headlamp, a canary, and a pickaxe. The buried can't see you, but they can hear you.

5623950.title: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic
5623950.short_description: The library's a mess, and it won't let you leave. Sort and stack books at your own pace in this cozy first-person game. Cast spells to send books back to their shelves, open new wings, and carry permanent upgrades into the next time loop.

5623960.title: CANON CANON CANON
5623960.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! Defend your garden against waves of furious animals in this roguelite lane defense.

5624570.title: Crash Sequence
5624570.short_description: Crash-landed alone on an alien world, you survive by sequencing alien bacteria, building custom plasmids, and engineering living cultures for oxygen, food and power. A turn-based sci-fi RPG / strategy simulation where your choices shape how the story ends.

5625200.title: Billard Masters Legacy
5625200.short_description: Precision cue sports powered by deterministic 1,000 Hz physics! Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, 3-Cushion & Carom in the Online Club or vs PC. Conquer 30 Master Challenges, build custom layouts, and collect 84 cues with live match chronicles across 15 atmospheric 3D venues.

5625210.title: Tower vs Zombies
5625210.short_description: Hold the line against relentless zombie hordes! Build and evolve industrial turrets — cannons, machine guns, missiles, flamethrowers, frost and more — grow a huge upgrade tree and defend your command post through a city under siege.

5625470.title: Train Keeper
5625470.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator aboard a night train. Make beds, set tables and sort up to 2,443 objects across 22 cars before the train reaches the station. Unlock helpful skills, restore order at your own pace, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

5625530.title: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT
5625530.short_description: Real or AI? A solo spot-the-fake game show against GEN, the robot host who made the fakes. Two exhibits, one real: zoom into pictures, walk around 3D dioramas, stake your call, slam READY. The reveal circles the tell. 3 campaigns, 7 contestant classes; win a campaign and you drop an anvil on GEN.

5625730.title: Driftworn
5625730.short_description: Lead a squad of drifters through a solar system still broken by a decade old war. Fight, trade, salvage and build across the planets and moons of Sol in an open-world sandbox where nobody is the chosen one, then buy a ship and start your adventure

5625830.title: Greena
5625830.short_description: Your uncle stopped answering his phone. Tonight you drive out to his farm at the end of a valley road, through a storm that won't move on. A short first-person horror game with a PS1 look.

5625860.title: MistTower
5625860.short_description: Every battle has a cost. MistTower is a grid-based strategy RPG where you preview damage, plan routes, and weigh every key, coin, and upgrade. Bypass stronger enemies, return when ready, and conquer four seasonal towers without spending your last strength before the boss.

5625880.title: Penguin Trails Together
5625880.short_description: It all starts with a line. Draw a ramp and send Pengu soaring toward the stars on a sled. Or team up with up to three friends, build a track full of loops, and see who sticks the landing.

5625940.title: Cat-Eye: Nail Salon Simulator
5625940.short_description: Soak off old polish, file and shape real 3D nails, then pull a glowing cat-eye band to life with a magnet. A cozy nail salon sim with fair scoring, regulars with stories, disaster rescues and influencer ready one-click vertical clips to share every set.

5626140.title: Lost Firmament
5626140.short_description: Explore a mysterious world of floating islands in this 3D Action RPG. Fight strange creatures, discover forgotten secrets, and forge your path through a world falling into ruin.

5626220.title: Ceti Break
5626220.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

5626600.title: Empire Autobattler
5626600.short_description: Lead one of history's civilizations from Warriors to Mech Walkers in a single run. Buy and merge units, work your island's land, research techs and pick governments, then watch your army clash against rival empires. Nine civilizations, eight eras, one autobattler.

5626810.title: Boombots
5626810.short_description: A 3D bomb party game starring scrap robots! Blast crates, grab power-ups and be the last bot standing in 16 hazard-packed arenas. Play with up to 4 on one PC, up to 8 online with PC + mobile crossplay, or take on 8 worlds and their bosses in Story mode.

5626870.title: Pixel Platoons
5626870.short_description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

5627390.title: Millennium Classics
5627390.short_description: Millennium Classics brings back the simple, satisfying elegance of classic puzzle games, free from ads, invasive tracking, or distracting progress bars. Just pure relaxation and mental exercise, just like in the good old days.

5627580.title: Crown of Rust
5627580.short_description: One mech against an entire royal court. Bolt weapons onto every slot, fuse them into something far worse, and hold the throne hall against waves of knights, cultists and hounds that never stop coming. A horde-survival roguelite about building the perfect war machine.

5627680.title: Orbitfall
5627680.short_description: Launch your fleets into orbit and let physics fly them. Low orbits are fast, high orbits slow, and every meeting counts down on the map. Seven factions, up to eight players against AI or friends online: claim the planet, bomb it from orbit and outplan everyone.

5628000.title: Defender of Rome
5628000.short_description: A tower defense game about the steadfast defenders of Rome's cities. Build an unbeatable legion, raise veterans and use everything at hand, from shield walls to geese and burning pigs. Defeat five nations, sworn enemies of Rome, in 18 missions from foggy Britain to the sands of Parthia.

5628150.title: Beat Bound
5628150.short_description: Glowing pads explode to the beat! A rhythm dodge game on an 8×8 launchpad. 42 songs across 9 cities, from EASY all the way to PERFECT, where a single hit ends your run.

5628870.title: fogpost
5628870.short_description: Guide a courier and a delayed echo through 250 turn-based puzzles. Collect the letter, plan around tides, bridges and shifting routes, and light both beacons on the same turn. Undo, use hints, then refine your route to earn gold stamps.

5629150.title: A Chat with Naila
5629150.short_description: A Chat with Naila is a psychological horror visual novel disguised as a casual encounter. Grab a warm cup of coffee, sit down, and enjoy a nice conversation. Sounds great, right? I mean, what could go wrong anyway...?

5629230.title: Just One More Load
5629230.short_description: Swing a magnet crane over a cartoon scrapyard, grab as much junk as your battery allows and drop it in the press for combo cash. Grow a 250-node skill tree, collect 17 magnet heads, clear five yards and tell yourself: just one more load.

5629250.title: Used Car Empire
5629250.short_description: You cannot see the car. You can only read it. Buy used cars off strangers, work out what is wrong with them before it costs you, and decide what to tell the next owner. A 2D deduction game about the motor trade, in a small town that remembers every car you sell.

5630000.title: Grave Train
5630000.short_description: An action roguelike where your party is a train of chaos and blood. Arrange your team of monsters. Charge through waves of unwilling sacrifices. Perform a ritual summoning of the strongest beings, and kill them all.

5631050.title: Lancet & Linen
5631050.short_description: Nuremberg, 1382. Live the life of a bathkeeper: diagnose patients, perform period procedures by hand, and run a bustling bathhouse with hired staff. Travel across nine towns, raise an heir, answer to the city council, and shape your house across three careers and six endings.

5631680.title: Mailu — A Chaotic Memory Game
5631680.short_description: Mailu is a memory game with a paper circus inside. Matching a pair is free, missing one costs you — and just when you swear you've memorized the table, a boss pulls a brand-new rule out of its hat. Featuring 18 bosses, 37 effect cards and 5 game modes.

5633140.title: Soul Of Sin
5633140.short_description: One spear. Seven Sins. A single hit ends each phase, for them and for you. Climb a ruined cathedral as the Penitent, face the Sins one by one, and watch your body change with every Sin you slay.

5649340.title: Lights Out
5649340.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.
